60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51627.name: Bahalutiya, the Grand Radiance
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51627.description: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Effect Monster. During your opponent's Main Phase, if your opponent adds a card(s) from the Deck to their hand, except by drawing them, and this card is in your hand, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned from the hand: You can have your opponent banish cards from the top of their Deck, face-down, equal to the number of cards in their hand, then they shuffle their entire hand into the Deck, and if they do, they add the cards banished by this effect to their hand. You can only use this effect of "Bahalutiya, the Grand Radiance" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5164d.name: Bashing Shield
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5164d.description: Equip only to a Normal Summoned/Set monster. It gains 1000 ATK. You take no battle damage from attacks involving it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5164e.name: Basic Insect
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5164e.description: Usually found traveling in swarms, this creature's ideal environment is the forest.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51660.name: Battle Instinct
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51660.description: Activate only when your opponent declares a direct attack and you control no monsters. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Beast-Type monster from your hand, in face-up Attack Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167e.name: Battlin' Boxer Counterpunch
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167e.description: During the Damage Step of either player's turn, when a "Battlin' Boxer" monster you control is attacking or being attacked: You can banish this card from your hand or Graveyard; that monster gains 1000 ATK, until the end of this turn. You can only use the effect of "Battlin' Boxer Counterpunch" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514e8.name: Ape Fighter
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514e8.description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: This card gains 300 ATK. If this card does not attack during your turn, the ATK gained from this effect returns to 0 during the End Phase of that turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514ea.name: Apocatequil
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514ea.description: While this card is face-up on the field, it is Level 5 if you control a face-up Tuner monster. When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can select and Special Summon 1 "Oracle of the Sun" from your Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51503.name: Appropriate
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51503.description: Activate only when your opponent draws a card(s) outside of either Draw Phase. After that, each time your opponent draws a card(s) outside of either Draw Phase, immediately draw 2 cards.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51508.name: Aqua Madoor
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51508.description: A wizard of the waters that conjures a liquid wall to crush any enemies that oppose him.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150d.name: Aquaactress Guppy
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150d.description: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Aquaactress" monster from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51510.name: Aquamirror Illusion
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51510.description: Special Summon 1 "Gishki" Ritual Monster from your hand. It cannot attack, and is returned to the hand during the End Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51518.name: Arcana Call
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51518.description: Select 1 "Arcana Force" monster you control. Remove from play 1 "Arcana Force" monster from either player's Graveyard. Until the End Phase, the selected monster's effect becomes the removed monster's effect for the same coin toss result.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51537.name: Archfiend Interceptor
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51537.description: While you control this face-up Attack Position card, when an opponent's monster declares an attack, inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153e.name: Archfiend's Ascent
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153e.description:
2 Level 6 monsters
This card's name becomes "Summoned Skull" on the field, but is still treated as an "Archfiend" card. If "Summoned Skull(s)" you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead. If this Xyz Summoned card you control is sent to your GY by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Summoned Skull" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156b.name: Armor Break
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156b.description: Negate the activation of an Equip Spell Card and destroy it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156c.name: Armor Breaker
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156c.description: Once per turn, you can equip this card to a Warrior-Type monster you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this effect, when that monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 card on the field. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, this card is destroyed instead.)

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51571.name: Armor Ninjitsu Art of Rust Mist
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51571.description: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field, if you control a "Ninja" monster: Halve the current ATK of that Special Summoned monster(s).

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5157a.name: Armored Lizard
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5157a.description: A lizard with a very tough hide and a vicious bite.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5158e.name: Aromaseraphy Rosemary
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5158e.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
While your LP is higher than your opponent's, all Plant-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF. Once per turn, if you gain LP: Target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; that face-up card has its effects negated until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515a7.name: Artifact Vajra
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515a7.description: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell. During your opponent's turn, if this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed and sent to your GY: Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned during your opponent's turn: Destroy all cards in your Spell & Trap Zones. When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5160b.name: B.E.S. Tetran
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5160b.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51614.name: Babycerasaurus
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51614.description: If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5163d.name: Barrage Blast
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5163d.description: Once per turn, you can detach any number of materials from Machine Xyz Monsters you control, then target that many cards on the field; destroy them. If a Machine Xyz Monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card and 1 Machine Xyz Monster from your GY; inflict damage to your opponent equal to the banished monster's Rank x 100.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5163e.name: Barrel Behind the Door
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5163e.description: Activate only when a card's effect that would inflict damage to you is activated. Your opponent takes the damage instead.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5164b.name: Barrier Wave
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5164b.description: Activate by Tributing 1 Synchro Monster when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Change all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls to Defense Position. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the attacking monster's DEF.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51658.name: Batteryman Fuel Cell
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51658.description: If you control 2 or more face-up "Batteryman" monsters, you can Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 "Batteryman" monster, except this card, to select 1 card your opponent controls and return it to its owner's hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167d.name: Battlin' Boxer Cheat Commissioner
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167d.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
All monsters your opponent controls must attack, if able. While you control another "Battlin' Boxer" monster, your opponent cannot target this card for attacks. When an attack is declared involving another "Battlin' Boxer" monster you control: You can detach 2 Xyz Materials from this card; look at your opponent's hand, then Set 1 Spell Card from their hand to your side of the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51511.name: Aquamirror Meditation
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51511.description: Reveal 1 Ritual Spell Card in your hand to target 2 "Gishki" monsters in your Graveyard; return them to the hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51513.name: Aquarium Lighting
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51513.description: If an "Aquaactress" monster you control battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation: Your battling monster's ATK and DEF each become double its current ATK and DEF during that damage calculation only. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Aqua-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Aqua-Type monsters. You can only control 1 "Aquarium Lighting".

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51520.name: Arcana Force VI - The Lovers
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51520.description: When this card is Summoned, toss a coin: ● Heads: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of an "Arcana Force" monster. ● Tails: You cannot Tribute Summon "Arcana Force" monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51521.name: Arcana Force VII - The Chariot
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51521.description:
When this card is Summoned, toss a coin:
● Heads: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, you can Special Summon that monster to your side of the field.
● Tails: Your opponent gains control of this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51526.name: Arcana Knight Joker
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51526.description:
"Queen's Knight" + "Jack's Knight" + "King's Knight"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above materials. Once per turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that targets this face-up card on the field (Quick Effect): You can discard the same type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); negate the effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152a.name: Arcane Archer of the Forest
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152a.description: While there is a Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, this card cannot be attacked. By Tributing 1 Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51535.name: Archfiend Giant
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51535.description: If this face-up card on the field would be destroyed by a card effect, you can pay 500 LP instead. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field. If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Archfiend" monster from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153f.name: Archfiend's Awakening
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153f.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Contract with the Abyss". This card's name becomes "Summoned Skull" on the field, but is still treated as an "Archfiend" card. Cannot be destroyed by battle, except by battle with a Ritual Monster, and cannot be destroyed by monster effects, except those of Ritual Monsters. If this Ritual Summoned card you control is sent to your GY by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Summoned Skull" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51557.name: Armed Dragon Flash
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51557.description: Special Summon 1 Level 3 "Armed Dragon" monster from your Deck in Defense Position. You can only activate 1 "Armed Dragon Flash" per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51583.name: Aroma Garden
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51583.description: Once per turn, if you control an "Aroma" monster: You can gain 500 LP, also all monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF until the end of your opponent's next turn (even if this card leaves the field). If a face-up "Aroma" monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Gain 1000 LP.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b8.name: Assault Blackwing - Raikiri the Rain Shower
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b8.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned using a "Blackwing" monster as Material, it is treated as a Tuner monster while face-up on the field. Once per turn: You can target cards your opponent controls, up to the number of other "Blackwing" monsters you control; destroy them.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e3.name: Augmented Heraldry
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e3.description: Psychic-Type Xyz Monsters on the field cannot be targeted by Spell/Trap effects. Once per turn: You can discard 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster; add 1 "Heraldry" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand, except "Augmented Heraldry". You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters during the turn you activate this effect, except Psychic-Type Xyz Monsters and "Heraldic Beast" monsters (even if this card leaves the field).

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e6.name: Aurora Paragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e6.description: Neither player can Special Summon monsters. When another monster is Normal Summoned to either player's side of the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515eb.name: Autonomous Action Unit
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515eb.description: Pay 1500 Life Points, then target 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard; Special Summon that target to your side of the field in face-up Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515fd.name: Axe of Fools
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515fd.description: The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK, also its effects are negated. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 500 damage to the controller of the equipped monster.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5160d.name: BM-4 Blast Spider
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5160d.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 DARK Machine monster you control and 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy them. If a monster you control that was originally a DARK Machine destroys an opponent's monster(s) by battle or card effect and sends it to the GY: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the original ATK of 1 of those monster(s) destroyed and sent to the GY. You can only use this effect of "BM-4 Blast Spider" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161a.name: Background Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161a.description: If this card is in the GY and you control no cards: You can Special Summon both this card, and 1 Level 4 or lower Dragon monster from your hand, in Defense Position, but banish this card when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Background Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51620.name: Backup Squad
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51620.description: Each time you take 1000 or more damage by your opponent's card effect or their monster's attack: Draw 1 card for every 1000 damage you took.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51638.name: Bark of Dark Ruler
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51638.description: If a Fiend-Type monster you control battles, during the Damage Step: Pay LP (in multiples of 100 points), then target the opponent's battling monster; that opponent's monster loses that much ATK and DEF, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51659.name: Batteryman Industrial Strength
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51659.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play 2 "Batteryman" monsters from your Graveyard. Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 Thunder-Type monster from your Graveyard to destroy 1 monster and 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51672.name: Battlewasp - Arbalest the Rapidfire
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51672.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 3 or lower Insect monster in your GY; Special Summon that monster in Defense Position. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Battlewasp" monster from your hand or Deck. You can only use this effect of "Battlewasp - Arbalest the Rapidfire" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51673.name: Battlewasp - Azusa the Ghost Bow
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51673.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When your opponent takes effect damage from another "Battlewasp" monster: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the original ATK of that monster. You can only use this effect of "Battlewasp - Azusa the Ghost Bow" once per turn. When a monster is destroyed by battle with your "Battlewasp" monster, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card in Defense Position, but banish it when it leaves the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5151c.name: Arcana Force EX - The Light Ruler
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5151c.description:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 monsters you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card is Special Summoned: Toss a coin and gain the appropriate effect.
● Heads: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can target 1 card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.
● Tails: During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, that targets this card is activated: This card loses exactly 1000 ATK and you negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51527.name: Arcana Knight Joker
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51527.description:
"Queen's Knight" + "Jack's Knight" + "King's Knight"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above materials. Once per turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that targets this face-up card on the field (Quick Effect): You can discard the same type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); negate the effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514f0.name: Apple Magician Girl
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514f0.description: Once per turn, if this card is targeted for an attack: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand, then change the attack target to it, and if you do, the attacking monster's ATK becomes half its current ATK. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target up to 3 other "Magician Girl" monsters with different names in your Graveyard; add them to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152f.name: Archfiend Cavalry
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152f.description: If this card on the field is destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can target 1 "Archfiend" monster in your GY, except "Archfiend Cavalry"; Special Summon it, but it cannot attack this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5155b.name: Armed Dragon LV5
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5155b.description: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to the sent monster's ATK; destroy that target. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Armed Dragon LV7" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51541.name: Archfiend's Manifestation
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51541.description:
"Summoned Skull" + 1 DARK monster
This card's name becomes "Summoned Skull" on the field, but is still treated as an "Archfiend" card. All "Summoned Skull" you control gain 500 ATK. If this Fusion Summoned card you control is sent to your GY by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Summoned Skull" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5155e.name: Armed Dragon Thunder LV10
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5155e.description:
If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of an "Armed Dragon" monster, it gains effects based on its own ATK.
● 1+: This card's name becomes "Armed Dragon LV10".
● 10+: Possession of this card cannot switch.
● 100+: Cannot be destroyed by battle.
● 1000+: Once per turn, during your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 other card on the field; destroy it, and if you do, this card gains 1000 ATK.
● 10000+: Once per turn: You can destroy all other cards on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51566.name: Armed Sea Hunter
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51566.description: After damage calculation, if this card battles an Effect Monster: Negate the effects of that monster (including in the Graveyard). You must control another face-up WATER monster to activate and to resolve this effect. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 3 or lower WATER monster you control instead.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156e.name: Armor Exe
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156e.description: This card cannot attack in the same turn it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned. During each of your and your opponent's Standby Phases, remove 1 Spell Counter on your side of the field. If you do not, destroy this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51584.name: Aroma Gardening
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51584.description: If you Normal or Special Summon an "Aroma" monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can gain 1000 LP. When an opponent's monster declares an attack, while your LP are lower than your opponent's: You can Special Summon 1 "Aroma" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Aroma Gardening" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51573.name: Armored Bee
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51573.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; halve that target's ATK until the End Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51586.name: Aromage Bergamot
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51586.description: While your LP is higher than your opponent's, if a Plant-Type monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. Once per turn, if you gain LP: This card gains 1000 ATK and DEF until the end of your opponent's turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5157f.name: Armoroid
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5157f.description: If this card is Tribute Summoned by Tributing at least 1 "roid" monster: Banish all Spells and Traps on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5158c.name: Aromaseraphy Angelica
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5158c.description: During either player's turn: You can discard this card, then target 1 "Aroma" monster in your Graveyard; gain LP equal to that target's ATK. While your LP is higher than your opponent's, you control an "Aroma" monster, and this card is in your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Aromaseraphy Angelica" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5158b.name: Aromage Rosemary
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5158b.description: While your LP are higher than your opponent's, if a Plant monster you control attacks, your opponent cannot activate monster effects until the end of the Damage Step. Once per turn, if you gain LP: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change its battle position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5159a.name: Artifact Beagalltach
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5159a.description: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell Card. During your opponent's turn, if this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard: Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned during your opponent's turn: Destroy up to 2 Set cards you control (min. 1). You can only use this effect of "Artifact Beagalltach" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ad.name: Ascending Soul
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ad.description: Once per turn, when a Ritual Monster(s) is Ritual Summoned: You can target 1 monster in your Graveyard that was Tributed for the Ritual Summon; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ae.name: Ascension Sky Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ae.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: It gains 800 ATK for each card currently in your hand. When this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY, if all of the monsters that were used for the Synchro Summon of this card are in your GY: You can Special Summon all of them, but their effects are negated. You can only use this effect of "Ascension Sky Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515c2.name: Assault Revival
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515c2.description: Remove from play 1 "Assault Mode Activate" from your Graveyard. Destroy all monsters you control and Special Summon 1 "/Assault Mode" monster from your Graveyard, ignoring its Summoning conditions. Its effect(s) is negated, and it cannot be Tributed. If it is removed from the field, remove it from play.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515c7.name: Assault Wyvern
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515c7.description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand or Graveyard, except "Assault Wyvern".

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515bd.name: Assault Mercenary
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515bd.description: Once per turn, you can return 1 "Assault Mode Activate" from your hand or Graveyard to the Deck to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515d7.name: Atomic Firefly
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515d7.description: When this face-up card on the field attacks or is attacked and it is destroyed as a result of battle, the player who destroyed it takes 500 points of damage.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e2.name: Attribute Bomb
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e2.description: Activate this card by declaring 1 Attribute. If the equipped monster destroys a monster with that Attribute by battle: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515d8.name: Atomic Scrap Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515d8.description:
1 "Scrap" Tuner + 2 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, you can select 1 card you control and up to 3 cards in your opponent's Graveyard. Destroy your selected card and return the opponent's cards you selected to the Deck. When this card is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to the Graveyard, select 1 non-Synchro "Scrap" monster in your Graveyard, and Special Summon it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ec.name: Autorokket Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ec.description: When a Link Monster's effect is activated that targets this face-up card on the field (Quick Effect): You can destroy this card, then send 1 Spell/Trap on the field to the GY. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field by battle or card effect and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Rokket" monster from your Deck, except "Autorokket Dragon". You can only use each effect of "Autorokket Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51628.name: Bahamut Shark
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51628.description:
2 Level 4 WATER monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 Rank 3 or lower WATER Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck. This card cannot attack for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515fe.name: Aye-Iron
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515fe.description: Once per turn: You can have this card gain 400 ATK. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161b.name: Backlinker
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161b.description: If only your opponent controls a monster in the Extra Monster Zone, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can Tribute this card; shuffle all monsters from the Extra Monster Zones into the Deck, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51625.name: Bad Luck Blast
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51625.description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take damage equal to quarter its ATK, then inflict damage to your opponent, equal to the damage you took. If this card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to your Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. You can only activate 1 "Bad Luck Blast" per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162d.name: Ballista of Rampart Smashing
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162d.description: If the equipped monster attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, it gains 1500 ATK during damage calculation only.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51661.name: Battle Mania
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51661.description: Activate only during your opponent's Standby Phase. All face-up monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position, and cannot change their battle positions this turn. All monsters your opponent currently controls must attack this turn, if able.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162e.name: Balloon Lizard
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162e.description: Put 1 counter on this card during each of your Standby Phases. When this card is destroyed, inflict damage to the controller of the card that destroyed it equal to the number of counters X 200 points.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51662.name: Battle Ox
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51662.description: A monster with tremendous power, it destroys enemies with a swing of its axe.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51669.name: Battle Waltz
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51669.description: Target 1 Synchro Monster you control; Special Summon 1 "Waltz Token" with the current Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF of that monster. Neither player takes any battle damage from attacks involving this Token.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167b.name: Battlewasp - Twinbow the Attacker
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167b.description: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Insect monsters. You can only use this effect of "Battlewasp - Twinbow the Attacker" once per turn. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51684.name: Battlin' Boxer Shadow
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51684.description: During your Main Phase: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from a "Battlin' Boxer" Xyz Monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Battlin' Boxer Shadow" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167c.name: Battlin' Boxer Big Bandage
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167c.description: Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. Once per turn: You can target 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster in your Graveyard, or 1 of your banished "Battlin' Boxer" monsters, that has a Level; all "Battlin' Boxer" monsters you currently control become that monster's current Level.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51501.name: Apprentice Magician
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51501.description: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place 1 Spell Counter on that target. If this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Spellcaster monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514e6.name: Antialian
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514e6.description: Once per turn, if this card battled a monster this Battle Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 Cyberse monster. If this face-up card you control leaves the field because of an opponent's card effect: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51531.name: Archfiend Eccentrick
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51531.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You can target 1 other Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy both it and this card. You can only use this effect of "Archfiend Eccentrick" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
You can Tribute this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Archfiend Eccentrick" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153c.name: Archfiend Zombie-Skull
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153c.description:
"Plaguespreader Zombie" + 2+ non-Tuner Zombie monsters
Zombie monsters you control cannot be destroyed by card effects.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153d.name: Archfiend of Gilfer
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153d.description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip that target with this card. That monster loses 500 ATK while equipped with this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5155c.name: Armed Dragon LV7
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5155c.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Armed Dragon LV5". You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to that sent monster's ATK.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51568.name: Armityle the Chaos Phantasm
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51568.description:
"Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" + "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder" + "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be destroyed by battle. Gains 10,000 ATK during your turn only.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156d.name: Armor Dragon Ritual
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156d.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Knight of Armor Dragon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 4 or more. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish monsters from your hand or face-up field whose total Levels equal 4 or more; banish this card from your GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Knight of Armor Dragon" from your GY. You can only use this effect of "Armor Dragon Ritual" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51576.name: Armored Cybern
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51576.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "Cyber Dragon" you control, or 1 Fusion Monster you control that lists "Cyber Dragon" as Fusion Material; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. Once per turn, while equipped to a monster by this effect: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; the equipped monster loses exactly 1000 ATK (even if this card leaves the field), and if it does, destroy that target. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5157d.name: Armored White Bear
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5157d.description: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT Beast-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ca.name: Astra Ghouls
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ca.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but its effects are negated, also banish it during the End Phase. Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die, and the face-up monsters you currently control become the Level equal to the result, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515cd.name: Asura Priest
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515cd.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515cf.name: Asymmetaphys
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515cf.description:
Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Metaphys" card from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card. Once per turn, if your "Metaphys" card in its owner's possession is banished: Apply this effect depending on whose turn it is.
● Your turn: All monsters on the field lose 500 ATK/DEF, except "Metaphys" monsters.
● Opponent's turn: Change the battle positions of all monsters on the field, except "Metaphys" monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51610.name: Baby Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51610.description: Much more than just a child, this dragon is gifted with untapped power.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161f.name: Backup Soldier
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161f.description: While there are 5 or more monsters in your Graveyard: Target up to 3 non-Effect Monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add them to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51657.name: Batteryman D
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51657.description: Your opponent cannot select a Thunder-Type monster you control as an attack target (except "Batteryman D").

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51665.name: Battle Steer
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51665.description: A bull monster often found in the woods, it charges enemy monsters with a pair of deadly horns.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5166b.name: Battle of the Elements
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5166b.description: Activate only while all monsters on the field are face-up. Both players send monsters they control to the Graveyard so that they each control only 1 Attribute.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51685.name: Battlin' Boxer Sparrer
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51685.description: If you control a "Battlin' Boxer" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If you do, you cannot conduct your Battle Phase for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514e9.name: Ape Magician
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514e9.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Once per turn, if this card is in face-up Attack Position: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard to target 1 face-up Defense Position monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase. It cannot change its battle position this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514ed.name: Apoqliphort Skybase
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514ed.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Requires 3 "Qli" Tributes to Normal Summon/Set. If this card is Normal Summoned/Set, it is unaffected by Spell/Trap effects and by activated effects from any monster whose original Level/Rank is lower than this card's current Level. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5151d.name: Arcana Force I - The Magician
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5151d.description:
When this card is Summoned, toss a coin:
● Heads: When a Spell Card is activated, this card's ATK becomes double its original ATK until the End Phase of that turn.
● Tails: When a Spell Card is activated, your opponent gains 500 Life Points.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51522.name: Arcana Force XII - The Hangman
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51522.description: When this card is Summoned: Toss a coin and gain the appropriate effect. ● Heads: Once per turn, during your End Phase: Target 1 face-up monster you control; destroy that target, and if you do, take damage equal to its ATK on the field. ● Tails: Once per turn, during your End Phase: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51523.name: Arcana Force XIV - Temperance
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51523.description:
During damage calculation, in either player's turn: You can discard this card; you take no Battle Damage from that battle. When this card is Summoned: Toss a coin and apply this effect. The effect lasts while this card is face-up on the field.
● Heads: Halve all Battle Damage you take.
● Tails: Halve all Battle Damage your opponent takes.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152b.name: Arcane Barrier
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152b.description: Each time a face-up Spellcaster monster(s) on the field is destroyed, place 1 Spell Counter on this card (max. 4). You can send this card and 1 face-up Spellcaster monster you control to the GY; draw 1 card for each Spell Counter that was on this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51539.name: Archfiend Mirror
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51539.description: A wicked mirror that hypnotizes enemies, diverting attacks from their intended targets.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153a.name: Archfiend Palabyrinth
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153a.description: All Fiend-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK. You can target 1 "Archfiend" monster you control; banish 1 other Fiend-Type monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, 1 "Archfiend" monster with same Level as the targeted monster. You can only use this effect of "Archfiend Palabyrinth" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153b.name: Archfiend Soldier
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5153b.description: An expert at battle who belongs to a crack diabolical unit. He's famous because he always gets the job done.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5154b.name: Ariel, Priestess of the Nekroz
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5154b.description: Once per turn: You can reveal any number of "Nekroz" cards in your hand; increase or reduce this card's Level by the number of revealed cards until the end of this turn. If this card is Tributed by a card effect: You can add 1 "Nekroz" monster from your Deck to your hand, except a Ritual Monster. You can only use this effect of "Ariel, Priestess of the Nekroz" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51561.name: Armed Dragon Thunder LV7
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51561.description:
This card's name becomes "Armed Dragon LV7" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Armed Dragon Thunder LV7" once per turn.
● You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY; send this card from the field to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 10 or lower "Armed Dragon" monster from your hand or Deck.
● If this card is sent to the GY to activate a Dragon monster's effect: You can add 1 "Armed Dragon" card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51595.name: Arsenal Robber
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51595.description: Your opponent selects 1 Equip Spell Card from his/her Deck and sends it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515c4.name: Assault Slash
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515c4.description: Activate only while you control an "/Assault Mode" monster. Destroy all face-up monsters on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515dc.name: Attack Reflector Unit
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515dc.description: Tribute 1 "Cyber Dragon". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Barrier Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e1.name: Attraffic Control
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e1.description: If your opponent controls 3 or more monsters, they cannot declare an attack.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e8.name: Aussa the Earth Charmer
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e8.description: FLIP: While this card is face-up on the field, take control of 1 EARTH monster your opponent controls.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51616.name: Back to Square One
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51616.description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; place that target on the top of the Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51623.name: Bacon Saver
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51623.description: During either player's Battle Step, while an attack is occurring: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the attack. You can only use the effect of "Bacon Saver" once per Duel.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51633.name: Banner of Courage
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51633.description: All monsters you control gain 200 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51636.name: Barbar, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51636.description:
If you control a monster that is not a "Burning Abyss" monster, destroy this card. You can only use 1 of these effects of "Barbar, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss" per turn, and only once that turn.
● If you control no Spell/Trap Cards: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can target up to 3 "Burning Abyss" cards in your Graveyard, except "Barbar, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss"; banish them, and if you do, inflict 150 damage to your opponent for each.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51668.name: Battle Tuned
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51668.description: Remove from play 1 Tuner monster from your Graveyard. Target face-up monster you control gains ATK equal to the removed monster's ATK.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51678.name: Battlewasp - Nest
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51678.description: When your "Battlewasp" monster is targeted for an attack: Special Summon 1 "Battlewasp" monster from your hand or Deck, and if you do, place 1 counter on this card, then end the Battle Phase. You can only use this effect of "Battlewasp - Nest" once per turn. If this card has 2 or more counters during the End Phase, send it to the GY.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51679.name: Battlewasp - Pin the Bullseye
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51679.description: If you control an Insect monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your Main Phase: You can inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each "Battlewasp - Pin the Bullseye" you control. You can only use each effect of "Battlewasp - Pin the Bullseye" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51502.name: Apprentice Piper
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51502.description:
FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.
If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51509.name: Aqua Snake
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51509.description: This monster hypnotizes an opponent with the ball on its tail and draws them to a watery doom.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150a.name: Aqua Spirit
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150a.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WATER monster in your Graveyard. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, you can change the battle position of 1 of your opponent's face-up Monster Cards. Once changed, the monster must remain in this position for the rest of the turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51546.name: Archlord Zerato
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51546.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 face-up "Warrior of Zera" on your side of the field while "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on your side of the field, by discarding 1 LIGHT Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not on your side of the field, this effect is not applied.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51564.name: Armed Protector Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51564.description: Face-up Equip Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. This card gains 500 ATK for each Equip Card equipped to this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51572.name: Armored Axon Kicker
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51572.description: If you control a face-up Psychic-Type monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, you take damage equal to half the destroyed monster's ATK. Then, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your Graveyard with ATK less than or equal to the damage you took.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51594.name: Arsenal Bug
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51594.description: If you control no other Insect-Type monsters, this card's ATK and DEF become 1000.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515de.name: Attack of the Cornered Rat
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515de.description: If a Level 3 or lower Normal Monster you control battles, during the Damage Step you can pay Life Points in multiples of 100. The ATK of the opponent's monster is reduced by the amount of Life Points you paid, until the End Phase. (You cannot pay more Life Points than the ATK of the opponent's monster.)

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e4.name: Auram the World Chalice Blademaster
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e4.description:
2 "World Chalice" monsters
Gains 300 ATK for each "World Legacy" monster in your GY with a different name. You can Tribute 1 "World Chalice" monster this card points to, then target 1 other monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone this card points to. You can only use this effect of "Auram the World Chalice Blademaster" once per turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "World Chalice" monster from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ef.name: Avatar of The Pot
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ef.description: By sending 1 "Pot of Greed" from your hand to the Graveyard, draw 3 cards from your Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515fb.name: Axe Raider
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515fb.description: An axe-wielding monster of tremendous strength and agility.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51609.name: B.E.S. Covered Core
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51609.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 2 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, at the end of the Damage Step toss a coin and call it. If you call it wrong, remove 1 counter. If this card battles without a counter, destroy it at the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5160c.name: BIG Win!?
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5160c.description: Declare a Level between 1 and 12; each player tosses a coin, and if both are Heads, the Levels of all face-up monsters you currently control become the declared Level. If both are tails, you lose Life Points equal to the declared Level x 500.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5160e.name: BOXer
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5160e.description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can place 1 counter on this card. You can send this card with 2 or more counters to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 EARTH monster from your Deck. If this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can remove 1 counter from this card instead.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161d.name: Backup Operator
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161d.description: You can target 1 face-up monster that a Link Monster you control points to; Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return that monster to the hand. If Special Summoned this way, banish this card when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Backup Operator" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5163a.name: Baron of the Fiend Sword
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5163a.description: An aristocrat who wields a sword possessed by a malicious spirit that preys on the weak.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51650.name: Bat
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51650.description: A mechanical bat that drops blasts from its wings.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5165a.name: Batteryman Micro-Cell
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5165a.description: FLIP: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Batteryman" monster from your Deck, except "Batteryman Micro-Cell". After this card has been flipped face-up, when it is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, draw 1 card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51671.name: Battlestorm
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51671.description: This card gains 100 ATK for each Winged Beast-Type monster you control. Once per turn: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target. You must control 3 or more Winged Beast-Type monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51515.name: Aquarium Stage
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51515.description: WATER monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle with a non-WATER monster. "Aquaactress" monsters you control are unaffected by your opponent's monster effects. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Aqua-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Aqua-Type monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152c.name: Arcanite Magician
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152c.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Spellcaster monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: Place 2 Spell Counters on it. This card gains 1000 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from your field, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51538.name: Archfiend Marmot of Nefariousness
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51538.description: An air marmot that has a nefarious horn and wings. It attacks by throwing acorns.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51544.name: Archfiend's Staff of Despair
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51544.description: Equip only to a monster you control. During your Main Phase: You can make all monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK equal to half the equipped monster's ATK, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field). If this card is sent to the GY while equipped to a monster: You can pay 1000 LP; return this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Archfiend's Staff of Despair" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5155d.name: Armed Dragon Lightning
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5155d.description:
If an "Armed Dragon" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by a card effect, you can send this card to the GY instead. You can target 1 "Armed Dragon" monster you control, then activate 1 of these effects;
● It gains ATK equal to its Level x 100.
● Add 1 "Armed Dragon" monster from your GY to your hand with a Level less than or equal to that monster.
You can only use this effect of "Armed Dragon Lightning" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156a.name: Armor Blast
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5156a.description: Target 1 face-up "Inzektor" card you control and 2 face-up cards your opponent controls; destroy them.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51575.name: Armored Core
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51575.description: (This card is also always treated as a "B.E.S." card) If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5157e.name: Armored Zombie
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5157e.description: This warrior blindly swings a deadly blade with devastating force.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5158a.name: Aromage Marjoram
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5158a.description:
While your LP are higher than your opponent's, you take no battle damage from attacks involving your Plant monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "Aromage Marjoram" once per turn.
● When a Plant monster you control is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then gain 500 LP.
● If you gain LP: Target cards in your opponent's GY, up to the number of "Aroma" monsters you control; banish them.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51592.name: Arrivalrivals
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51592.description: During the Battle Phase: Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 monster. You can only activate 1 "Arrivalrivals" per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5159f.name: Artifact Failnaught
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5159f.description: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell Card. During your opponent's turn, if this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard: Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned during your opponent's turn: You can target 1 "Artifact" monster in your Graveyard; Set that target in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell Card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b2.name: Asleep at the Switch
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b2.description: When your opponent gains Life Points: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b6.name: Assault Blackwing - Kunai the Drizzle
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b6.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Blackwing" monster. If Summoned this way, this card is treated as a Tuner monster. Once per turn: You can target 1 Synchro Monster you control, and declare a Level from 1 to 8; it becomes that Level until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e5.name: Aurkus, Lightsworn Druid
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e5.description: Neither player can target "Lightsworn" monsters (anywhere) with card effects. During each of your End Phases: Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515fc.name: Axe of Despair
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515fc.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can Tribute 1 monster; place this card on the top of your Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51615.name: Bachibachibachi
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51615.description:
An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as Xyz Material gains this effect.
● If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51619.name: Backfire
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51619.description: If a face-up FIRE monster(s) you control is destroyed and sent to the GY: Inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161e.name: Backup Secretary
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5161e.description: If you control a Cyberse monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Backup Secretary" once per turn this way.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51626.name: Bad Reaction to Simochi
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51626.description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, any effect of increasing your opponent's Life Points is changed to inflict the same amount of points in damage to your opponent's Life Points.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162b.name: Balancer Lord
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162b.description: Once per turn: You can pay 1000 LP; during your Main Phase this turn, you can Normal Summon 1 Cyberse monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) If this card is banished: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Balancer Lord" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162f.name: Bamboo Scrap
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162f.description: Tribute 1 Plant-Type monster. Special Summon 2 "Plant Tokens" (Plant-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 800/DEF 500) to your opponent's side of the field in Defense Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51632.name: Banishment of the Darklords
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51632.description: Add 1 "Darklord" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Banishment of the Darklords". You can only activate 1 "Banishment of the Darklords" per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51653.name: Batteryman AA
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51653.description: If all "Batteryman AA"(s) you control are in Attack Position, this card gains 1000 ATK for each. If all "Batteryman AA"(s) you control are in Defense Position, this card gains 1000 DEF for each.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5166a.name: Battle Warrior
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5166a.description: A warrior that fights with his bare hands!!!

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167f.name: Battlin' Boxer Glassjaw
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5167f.description: When this card is targeted for an attack: Destroy this card. When this card is sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can target 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster in your Graveyard, except "Battlin' Boxer Glassjaw"; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514e3.name: Anti-Magic Prism
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a514e3.description: Activate only when your opponent activates a Quick-Play Spell Card. Select 1 card on the field and destroy it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51500.name: Apprentice Illusion Magician
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51500.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Dark Magician" from your Deck to your hand. During damage calculation, if your other DARK Spellcaster monster battles an opponent's monster (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; that monster you control gains 2000 ATK/DEF during that damage calculation only.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150b.name: Aqua Story - Urashima
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150b.description: If you have an "Aquaactress" monster in your Graveyard: Target 1 monster on the field; until the end of this turn, its effects are negated, its ATK and DEF become 100, also it is unaffected by your opponent's card effects.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150c.name: Aquaactress Arowana
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150c.description: Once per turn: You can add 1 "Aquaactress" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51530.name: Archfiend Commander
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51530.description: If you control an "Archfiend" card, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand), but it cannot attack this turn. You can only Special Summon "Archfiend Commander" once per turn this way. When Special Summoned this way: Target 1 "Archfiend" card you control; destroy that target. When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 Level 6 "Archfiend" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51550.name: Armades, Keeper of Boundaries
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51550.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card attacks or is attacked, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51582.name: Arnis, the Empowered Warrior
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51582.description: When this card you control is destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in Attack Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51596.name: Arsenal Summoner
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51596.description: FLIP: Add 1 "Guardian" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Celtic Guardian", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #2", "Guardian of the Labyrinth", or "The Reliable Guardian".

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5159b.name: Artifact Caduceus
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5159b.description: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell Card. During your opponent's turn, if this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard: Special Summon it. During your opponent's turn, each time an "Artifact" monster(s) is Special Summoned: Draw 1 card. You must control this face-up card to activate and to resolve this effect. You can only control 1 "Artifact Caduceus".

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515af.name: Asceticism of the Six Samurai
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515af.description: Target 1 "Six Samurai" monster you control; Special Summon 1 "Six Samurai" monster from your Deck with the same ATK but a different name, and if you do, destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b9.name: Assault Blackwing - Sayo the Rain Hider
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b9.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner monster
If this card is Synchro Summoned using a "Blackwing" monster as Material, it is treated as a Tuner while face-up on the field. Twice per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ba.name: Assault Blackwing - Sohaya the Rain Storm
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ba.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned using a "Blackwing" monster as Material, it is treated as a Tuner while face-up on the field. You can only use each of these effects of "Assault Blackwing - Sohaya the Rain Storm" once per turn. ● When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 "Assault Blackwing" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. ● During your Main Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was sent there this turn: You can banish 1 other "Assault Blackwing - Sohaya the Rain Storm" from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e7.name: Aurora Wing
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515e7.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. You can only use the effect of "Aurora Wing" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515f3.name: Awakening of Nephthys
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515f3.description: All "Nephthys" monsters you control gain 300 ATK. If this face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Nephthys" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY, but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Awakening of Nephthys" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ff.name: Ayers Rock Sunrise
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515ff.description: Target 1 Beast-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target, and if you do, all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls lose 200 ATK for each Beast, Plant, and Winged Beast-Type monster currently in your Graveyard, until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Ayers Rock Sunrise" per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51611.name: Baby Raccoon Ponpoko
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51611.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 Beast-Type monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position, except "Baby Raccoon Ponpoko". You cannot Special Summon any monsters during the turn you activate this effect, except Beast-Type monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51618.name: Back-Up Rider
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51618.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5164c.name: Basal Rose Shoot
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5164c.description: Special Summon 1 "Rose Dragon" monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position. If this Set card is destroyed: You can target 1 of your "Black Rose Dragon", or 1 of your monsters that specifically lists that card in its text, that is banished or in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Basal Rose Shoot" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51663.name: Battle Return
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51663.description: During your Battle Phase: Target 1 "Meklord Emperor" monster you control; halve its ATK until the end of this turn, and if you do, it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51683.name: Battlin' Boxer Rib Gardna
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51683.description: During either player's turn: You can banish this card from your hand or Graveyard, then target 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster you control; banish it until your next Standby Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51507.name: Aqua Jet
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51507.description: Target 1 face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150e.name: Aquaactress Tetra
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5150e.description: Once per turn: You can add 1 "Aquarium" card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152d.name: Arcanite Magician/Assault Mode
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5152d.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Assault Mode Activate". When this card is Special Summoned, place 2 Spell Counters on it. This card gains 1000 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 2 Spell Counters from this card to destroy all cards your opponent controls. When this card on the field is destroyed, you can Special Summon 1 "Arcanite Magician" from your Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51532.name: Archfiend Emperor, the First Lord of Horror
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51532.description: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK/DEF become halved. If Summoned this way, this card is destroyed during the End Phase. You cannot Special Summon any monsters, except Fiend monsters. Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Archfiend" card from your hand or GY, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51549.name: Arcjet Lightcraft
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51549.description: If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Level 8 or lower Machine monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, and if you do, its Level becomes 9, also negate its effects. You can only use this effect of "Arcjet Lightcraft" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Machine Xyz Monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5154d.name: Arkbrave Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5154d.description: If this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: You can banish as many face-up Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, this card gains 200 ATK and DEF for each card banished. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was sent there last turn: You can target 1 Level 7 or 8 Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard, except "Arkbrave Dragon"; Special Summon it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51565.name: Armed Samurai - Ben Kei
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51565.description: For each Equip Card equipped to this card, it gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51580.name: Armory Arm
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51580.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, that target gains 1000 ATK. If that target destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51598.name: Artifact Achilleshield
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51598.description: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell Card. During your opponent's turn, if this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard: Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned during your opponent's turn: Your opponent cannot target "Artifact" monsters you control for attacks for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b3.name: Assault Armor
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a515b3.description: Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster that is the only monster you control. It gains 300 ATK. During your Main Phase 1, you can send this equipped card to the Graveyard to allow the equipped monster to attack twice during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51601.name: Azure-Eyes Silver Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51601.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Normal Monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: Until the end of the next turn, neither player can target Dragon monsters you currently control with card effects, also they cannot be destroyed by card effects. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can target 1 Normal Monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51602.name: B-Buster Drake
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51602.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 LIGHT Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card is unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 Union monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51622.name: Backup Warrior
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51622.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) while the only monsters you control are 2 Defense Position monsters. You cannot Synchro Summon the turn you Special Summon this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162c.name: Ballista Squad
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5162c.description: Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51630.name: Banisher of the Light
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51630.description: Any card sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51641.name: Barrel Lily
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51641.description: This wicked flower attacks enemies with pollen projectiles.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51655.name: Batteryman C
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51655.description: If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Attack Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK for each "Batteryman C" you control. If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Defense Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 DEF for each "Batteryman C" you control.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51656.name: Batteryman Charger
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51656.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can Special Summon 1 "Batteryman" monster, except "Batteryman Charger", from your hand or Deck. This card gains 300 ATK and DEF for each Thunder-Type monster you control.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5166d.name: Battlecruiser Dianthus
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5166d.description:
3 Level 3 monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand. You can only use the effect of "Battlecruiser Dianthus" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51687.name: Battlin' Boxer Veil
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51687.description: When you take battle damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, gain Life Points equal to the damage you took.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a4.name: Beautiful Beast Trainer
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a4.description: A rare female beast-master with a very dangerous whip.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516bb.name: Berry Magician Girl
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516bb.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Magician Girl" monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during either player's turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect that targets this card, or targets this card for an attack: You can change this card's battle position, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Magician Girl" monster from your Deck, except "Berry Magician Girl".

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516cc.name: Big Burn
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516cc.description: You can only activate this card when your opponent activates a card that targets a monster in the Graveyard. Remove from play all monsters in both players' Graveyards.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d1.name: Big Koala
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d1.description: A species of huge Des Koala. He's meek, but people are afraid of him because he's very powerful.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516fa.name: Black Luster Soldier - Sacred Soldier
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516fa.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 of your banished LIGHT or DARK monsters and 1 card your opponent controls; return that banished card to the GY, and if you do, banish that card your opponent controls. You can only use this effect of "Black Luster Soldier - Sacred Soldier" once per turn. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can target 1 Level 7 or lower Warrior monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51712.name: Blackback
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51712.description: During your turn: Target 1 "Blackwing" monster with 2000 or less ATK in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. You cannot Normal Summon/Set during the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a6.name: Beautunaful Princess
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a6.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Fish-Type monster from your Deck, except "Beautunaful Princess". You can only use this effect of "Beautunaful Princess" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516c8.name: Bicorn Re'em
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516c8.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Synchro Material Monster for a Synchro Summon, send the top 2 cards from your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516e6.name: Bitelon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516e6.description: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516f1.name: Black Feather Beacon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516f1.description: Activate only when you take damage from a card effect. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Blackwing" monster from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51708.name: Black Sonic
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51708.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack on a "Blackwing" monster you control: Banish all face-up Attack Position monsters your opponent controls. If you control exactly 3 "Blackwing" monsters (and no other monsters), you can activate this card from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51709.name: Black Stego
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51709.description: If this Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Change this card to Defense Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a7.name: Beaver Warrior
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a7.description: What this creature lacks in size it makes up for in defense when battling in the prairie.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51699.name: Beast Striker
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51699.description: Once per turn, you can discard 1 card to Special Summon 1 "Moja" from your Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5169b.name: Beast of the Pharaoh
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5169b.description: If this card is sent to the GY for a Synchro Summon: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ca.name: Big Bang Shot
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ca.description: The equipped monster gains 400 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d2.name: Big One Warrior
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d2.description: During your Main Phase, you can send 1 Level 1 monster, except this card, from your hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon this card from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516df.name: Bird of Paradise Lost
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516df.description: This card gains 100 ATK and DEF for each Tuner monster in your Graveyard. Once per turn: You can send 1 Tuner monster from your hand to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51703.name: Black Return
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51703.description: When exactly 1 "Blackwing" monster (and no other monster) is Special Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; gain LP equal to the ATK of that target, and if you do, return it to the hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51719.name: Blackwing - Abrolhos the Megaquake
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51719.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. This card cannot destroy monsters by battle. If this card battles a monster, after damage calculation: Return that monster to the hand. Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can have this card lose exactly 1000 ATK, and if you do, return all cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone to the hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51723.name: Blackwing - Brisote the Tailwind
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51723.description: If 2 or more face-up "Blackwing" monsters you control were destroyed this turn, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Synchro Material: Gain 600 LP.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51725.name: Blackwing - Damascus the Polar Night
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51725.description: During either player's turn: You can discard this card to target 1 "Blackwing" monster you control; it gains 500 ATK until the End Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516db.name: Bingo Machine, Go!!!
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516db.description:
Reveal 3 cards from your Deck that each meets at least 1 of the criteria listed below, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to add to your hand, and you shuffle the rest into your Deck. You can only activate 1 "Bingo Machine, Go!!!" per turn.
● "Blue-Eyes" monster
● Spell/Trap that specifically lists the card "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon", except "Bingo Machine, Go!!!"

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51704.name: Black Rose Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51704.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can destroy all cards on the field. Once per turn: You can banish 1 Plant monster from your GY, then target 1 Defense Position monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-up Attack Position, and if you do, its ATK becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51706.name: Black Salvo
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51706.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 DARK Machine-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position, but its effects are negated.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5168f.name: Bean Soldier
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5168f.description: A plant-warrior that attacks with seeds and sword.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51697.name: Beast Rising
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51697.description: Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 face-up Beast-Type or Beast-Warrior-Type monster you control to select 1 other face-up Beast-Type or Beast-Warrior-Type monster you control.
