The selected monster gains the original ATK of the monster removed from play for this effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a1.name: Beat, Bladesman Fur Hire
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a1.description: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 monster "Fur Hire" from your hand, except "Beat, Bladesman Fur Hire". If a monster "Fur Hire" is Special Summoned to your field while you control this monster (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 monster "Fur Hire" from your Deck to your hand, except "Beat, Bladesman Fur Hire". You can only use each effect of "Beat, Bladesman Fur Hire" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d5.name: Big Wave Small Wave
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d5.description: Destroy all face-up WATER monsters you control, then you can Special Summon WATER monsters from your hand, up to the number of monsters destroyed by this effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516dd.name: Bio-Mage
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516dd.description: A mysterious priest created as a result of the latest advances in biotechnology.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516e3.name: Birthright
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516e3.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516f4.name: Black Illusion
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516f4.description: Until the end of this turn, all DARK Spellcaster-Type monsters with 2000 or more ATK you currently control cannot be destroyed by battle, their effects are negated, also they are unaffected by your opponent's card effects.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5170c.name: Black Veloci
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5170c.description: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, this card gains 400 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, this card loses 400 ATK during the Damage Step only.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51714.name: Blackbird Close
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51714.description: When a monster your opponent controls activates its effect: You can send 1 face-up "Blackwing" monster you control to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, then, you can Special Summon 1 "Black-Winged Dragon" from your Extra Deck. If you control a "Blackwing" Synchro Monster or "Black-Winged Dragon", you can activate this card from your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51698.name: Beast Soul Swap
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51698.description: Target 1 Beast-Type monster you control; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Beast-Type monster from your hand with the same Level as the monster that was returned to the hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a5.name: Beautiful Headhuntress
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a5.description: A vicious creature that has decapitated numerous enemy monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ae.name: Beetron
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ae.description: You can send 1 face-up Spell/Trap you control to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Insect monster in your GY; Special Summon that Insect monster in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Beetron" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516af.name: Beginning Knight
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516af.description:
A "Black Luster Soldier" monster Ritual Summoned using this card gains these effects. You can only use this effect of "Beginning Knight" once per turn.
● Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it.
● When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can activate this effect; this card can make a second attack in a row.
If this card is banished from the Graveyard: You can add 1 Ritual Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Beginning Knight" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516b0.name: Beginning of Heaven and Earth
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516b0.description: Reveal 3 Warrior-Type monsters from your Deck, including at least 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster or "Gaia The Fierce Knight" monster, and have your opponent randomly pick 1. If they picked a "Black Luster Soldier" monster or "Gaia The Fierce Knight" monster, add it to your hand and send the rest to the Graveyard. Otherwise, send them all to the Graveyard. You can only activate 1 "Beginning of Heaven and Earth" per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516b4.name: Beiige, Vanguard of Dark World
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516b4.description: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Special Summon it from the Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516bd.name: Berserk Gorilla
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516bd.description: If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy this card. This card must attack if able.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d0.name: Big Jaws
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d0.description: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked: Banish it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516e4.name: Bite Bug
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516e4.description: If your opponent controls a face-up Xyz Monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When you do: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; that monster loses 300 ATK.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516e5.name: Bite Shoes
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516e5.description: FLIP: Change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ee.name: Black Dragon Ninja
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ee.description: Cannot be Special Summoned, except with the effect of a "Ninja" monster or "Ninjitsu Art" card. Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can send 1 "Ninja" monster and 1 "Ninjitsu Art" card from your hand and/or face-up from your field to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster on the field; banish it. If this face-up card leaves the field: Special Summon as many monsters banished by this card's effect as possible to their owner's field(s).

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51720.name: Blackwing - Bora the Spear
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51720.description: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Bora the Spear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51689.name: Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51689.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Wyrm-Type monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target cards on the field, up to the number of different original Attributes of the Wyrm-Type monsters used for the Synchro Summon of this card; shuffle them into the Deck. Once per turn: You can target 1 card you control and 1 Level 4 or lower monster in your Graveyard; destroy that card on the field, and if you do, Special Summon that other monster from the Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51696.name: Beast Rage
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51696.description: All monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each of your removed from play Beast-Type and Winged Beast-Type monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5168d.name: Beacon of White
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5168d.description: If you do not control another "Beacon of White", and you have 3 or more "Blue-Eyes" monsters in your GY: Target 1 of them; Special Summon it, but it has its effects negated, also equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster. Other monsters you control cannot attack, also if you have any number of "Blue-Eyes" monster(s) in your GY, the equipped monster can attack up to that number of times during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5168e.name: Beaked Snake
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5168e.description: This monster wraps itself around an opponent and pecks away with its huge beak.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5169a.name: Beast of Talwar
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5169a.description:
Only the master of the sword among Fiend-Type monsters is permitted to hold the Talwar.


(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516a3.name: Beatrice, Lady of the Eternal

If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, or if this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Gaia The Fierce Knight" monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard. You can only Special Summon "Black Luster Soldier - Super Soldier(s)" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5171f.name: Blackwing - Boobytrap
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5171f.description: When this Set card is destroyed by your opponent's card effect while you control a face-up "Blackwing" monster, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent and draw 1 card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516aa.name: Bee List Soldier
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516aa.description: You can Tribute this card and 1 face-up Insect monster, except "Bee List Soldier"; draw 2 cards.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516b2.name: Behegon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516b2.description: With an enormous maw and massive teeth, this monstrosity is one dangerous and strange serpent from the deep.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ba.name: Berlineth the Firestorm Vassal
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ba.description: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn. If this card is Tributed for a Tribute Summon: You can look at your opponent's hand and banish 1 card from their hand until the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "Berlineth the Firestorm Vassal" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516c9.name: Bicular
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516c9.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Unicycular" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ce.name: Big Eye
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516ce.description: FLIP: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your Deck, then place them on the top of the Deck in any order.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d6.name: Big Whale
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a516d6.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 3 Level 3 WATER monsters from your Deck. Their effects are negated.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5171c.name: Blackwing - Backlash
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5171c.description: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack while you have 5 or more "Blackwing" monsters in your Graveyard: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51721.name: Blackwing - Boreas the Sharp
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51721.description: During your Main Phase 1: You can banish this card from the Graveyard, then target 1 "Blackwing" monster you control; if that monster attacks this turn, you take no battle damage from that attack, it is not destroyed by that battle, also destroy the opponent's monster that it battled, after damage calculation.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51729.name: Blackwing - Fane the Steel Chain
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51729.description: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Target 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change that target to Defense Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5172a.name: Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5172a.description: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; that target's ATK and DEF become half its current ATK and DEF.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51743.name: Blackwing - Vayu the Emblem of Honor
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51743.description: This face-up card on the field cannot be used as a Synchro Material. If this card is in the Graveyard: You can target 1 non-Tuner "Blackwing" monster in your Graveyard; banish both this card and that target, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Blackwing" Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck whose Level equals the total Levels of the banished monsters, but its effects are negated.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51745.name: Blackwing Armed Wing
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51745.description:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only, also inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51746.name: Blackwing Armor Master
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51746.description:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle, and you take no battle damage from attacks involving this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a monster: You can place 1 Wedge Counter on that monster (max. 1). You can remove all Wedge Counters from your opponent's monsters; the ATK and DEF of those monsters that had Wedge Counters become 0 until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51752.name: Blast Juggler
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51752.description: You can only activate this effect during your Standby Phase. Tribute this face-up card to select and destroy 2 face-up monsters with an ATK 1000 or less.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51771.name: Block Attack
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51771.description: Target 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517bd.name: Boon of the Meklord Emperor
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517bd.description: If the only face-up monsters on the field are 2 "Meklord" monsters: Draw 2 cards. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c1.name: Boot Staggered
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c1.description: When a Cyberse monster is Normal Summoned to your field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Boot Staggered" once per turn. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can Special Summon 1 "Stag Token" (Cyberse/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517db.name: Boulder Tortoise
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517db.description: A stone turtle that is nearly indestructible.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e7.name: Brain Golem
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e7.description: Effects of face-up LIGHT monsters are negated. If this card destroys a LIGHT monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517eb.name: Brainwashing Beam
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517eb.description: Select 1 monster with at least 1 A-Counter on your opponent's side of the field and take control of that monster. During each of your End Phases, remove 1 A-Counter from that controlled monster. If all A-Counters are removed from that monster, or that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51801.name: Brinegir
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51801.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 WATER monster in your GY; this card gains ATK equal to that monster's ATK until the end of this turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 WATER monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Brinegir" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5180c.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Coyote
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5180c.description: If you control a "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Card, and no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51865.name: Burning Skull Head
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51865.description: When this card is Special Summoned from your hand, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. You can remove from play this face-up card you control to return 1 removed from play "Skull Flame" to its owner's Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5186b.name: Burst Stream of Destruction
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5186b.description: If you control "Blue-Eyes White Dragon": Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" you control cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c6.name: Castle of Dragon Souls
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c6.description: Once per turn: You can banish 1 Dragon monster from your GY, then target 1 monster you control; it gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field). When this face-up card on the field is sent to the GY: You can target 1 of your banished Dragon monsters; Special Summon that target. You can only control 1 "Castle of Dragon Souls".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518cc.name: Cataclysmic Scorching Sunburner
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518cc.description: If a face-up FIRE monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then, you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to quarter the ATK of 1 of those destroyed FIRE monsters in your GY. You can only use this effect of "Cataclysmic Scorching Sunburner" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5175e.name: Blazing Hiita
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5175e.description: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 FIRE monster (except this card) to Special Summon 1 FIRE monster from your hand. The monster Special Summoned by this effect is destroyed if "Blazing Hiita" is removed from your side of the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5177c.name: Bloom Prima the Melodious Choir
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5177c.description:
1 "Melodious Maestra" monster + 1 or more "Melodious" monsters
This card gains 300 ATK for each Fusion Material used for its Fusion Summon. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. If this Fusion Summoned card is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Melodious" monster in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51783.name: Blue Flame Swordsman
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51783.description: Once per turn, during either player's Battle Phase: You can target 1 other Warrior-Type monster you control; this card loses exactly 600 ATK, and if it does, that monster gains 600 ATK. When this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card (by battle or card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517ba.name: Book of Secret Arts
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517ba.description: A Spellcaster-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517bb.name: Book of Taiyou
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517bb.description: Flip 1 face-down monster on the field into face-up Attack Position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c3.name: Boot-Up Corporal - Command Dynamo
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c3.description: You can target up to 2 Machine "Gadget" monsters you control or in your GY with different names; Special Summon this card from your hand, then equip those targets to this card (regardless of their Type). You can only use this effect of "Boot-Up Corporal - Command Dynamo" once per turn. Gains 1000 ATK for each monster equipped to this card by this effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c6.name: Boot-Up Soldier - Dread Dynamo
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c6.description: While you control a "Gadget" monster, this card gains 2000 ATK.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c9.name: Borrel Regenerator
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c9.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 "Rokket" monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card, but banish it when this card leaves the field. If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster is destroyed: You can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Borrel Regenerator" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517d8.name: Bottom Dweller
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517d8.description: This is one sea creature whose wrath is something monsters fear to face.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e0.name: Bowganian
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e0.description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5180f.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eland
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5180f.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Fire Formation - Domei". You can discard 1 monster; Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap directly from your Deck or GY. When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Fire Fist" or "Fire Formation" card you control to the GY, except "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eland"; negate that effect. You can only use each effect of "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eland" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51832.name: Bug Signal
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51832.description: Target 1 Insect Xyz Monster you control; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 Insect monster that is 2 Ranks higher or lower than that monster you control, by using it as the Xyz Material. (This Special Summon is treated as an Xyz Summon. Xyz Materials attached to that target also become Xyz Materials on the Summoned monster.) You can only activate 1 "Bug Signal" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51838.name: Bujin Regalia - The Jewel
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51838.description: Target 1 Rank 4 Xyz Monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 300 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to it. Once per turn, while this card is equipped to a monster by this effect: You can attach 1 "Bujin" monster from your hand to the equipped monster as an Xyz Material.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51858.name: Bujinunity
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51858.description: If you control no other cards and have at least 1 other card in your hand: Shuffle all Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck (min. 1), and if you do, send your entire hand to the Graveyard (min. 1), then you can add up to 3 Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Bujinunity" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51897.name: Call of the Mummy
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51897.description: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51898.name: Call of the Reaper
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51898.description: Activate only when a monster(s) is Special Summoned from your Graveyard. Select and Special Summon 1 "Supay" or 1 "Fire Ant Ascator" from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a3.name: Capacitor Stalker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a3.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 other Cyberse monster you control; while this face-up monster is on the field, that monster gains 800 ATK. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the GY: Each player takes 800 damage. You can only use this effect of "Capacitor Stalker" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c0.name: Cash Back
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c0.description: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, by paying their Life Points: Negate the activation, and if you do, return it to the Deck.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5172e.name: Blackwing - Gram the Shining Star
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5172e.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned. When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower non-Tuner "Blackwing" monster from your hand, but its effects are negated.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51730.name: Blackwing - Harmattan the Dust
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51730.description: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Harmattan the Dust", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Blackwing - Harmattan the Dust" once per turn this way. When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 other "Blackwing" monster you control; increase this card's Level by that monster's.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5173e.name: Blackwing - Silverwind the Ascendant
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5173e.description:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 2 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target up to 2 face-up monsters on the field with DEF lower than this card's ATK; destroy those targets. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect. During each of your opponent's turns, the first "Blackwing" monster you control that would be destroyed by battle, is not destroyed.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5173f.name: Blackwing - Simoon the Poison Wind
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5173f.description: If you control no monsters and have this card in your hand: You can banish 1 other "Blackwing" monster from your hand; place 1 "Black Whirlwind" from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone, then, either send this card to the GY, or immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon it without Tributing. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters. You can only use this effect of "Blackwing - Simoon the Poison Wind" once per turn. During the End Phase, send the "Black Whirlwind" placed by this effect to the GY, and if you do, take 1000 damage.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51786.name: Blue Rose Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51786.description: When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can target 1 "Black Rose Dragon" or 1 Plant monster in your GY; Special Summon that monster.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5179e.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5179e.description: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a1.name: Blustering Winds
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a1.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK and DEF until your next Standby Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517aa.name: Bonding - DHO
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517aa.description: Shuffle 1 "Duoterion", 1 "Hydrogeddon", and 1 "Oxygeddon" from your hand and/or GY into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon Cluster" from your hand or GY. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Water Dragon" or "Water Dragon Cluster" from your Deck or GY to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517cf.name: Borreload Furious Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517cf.description:
2 DARK Dragon monsters
(Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls; destroy them. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 DARK Link Monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but it cannot activate its effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Borreload Furious Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51816.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Lion Emperor
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51816.description:
2 Level 3 FIRE monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 FIRE monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand, but you cannot Normal or Special Summon that monster, or a monster with the same name, for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51817.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Panda
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51817.description: If you activate a "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Card (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can Special Summon 1 "Fire Fist" monster from your GY, except "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Panda", also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Fire Fist" monsters. If a "Fire Fist" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by your opponent's card effect, you can send 1 face-up "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap you control to the GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Panda" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5181a.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Raven
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5181a.description: If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell directly from your Deck. "Fire Formation" Spells/Traps you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51835.name: Bujin Hirume
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51835.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Bujin" monster from your Graveyard, except "Bujin Hirume". If this card, which was Summoned this way, is destroyed by your opponent's card (by battle or card effect), and sent from your side of the field to your Graveyard, and both players have a hand: You can discard 1 card, then your opponent discards 1 card. You can only control 1 "Bujin Hirume".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5184d.name: Bujingi Sinyou
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5184d.description: During either player's Damage Step, if a Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monster you control battles an opponent's monster: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; that monster you control gains ATK equal to the current ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling until the end of the Damage Step, and if it does, all battle damage your opponent takes from that battle is halved. You can only use this effect of "Bujingi Sinyou" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51870.name: Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51870.description:
1 "Buster Blader" + 1 Dragon-Type monster
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card cannot attack directly. This card gains 1000 ATK and DEF for each Dragon-Type monster your opponent controls or is in their Graveyard. Change all Dragon-Type monsters your opponent controls to Defense Position, also Dragon-Type monsters in your opponent's possession cannot activate their effects. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51872.name: Buster Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51872.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
All monsters your opponent controls become Dragon-Type. Once per turn, if you do not control a "Buster Blader" monster: You can target 1 "Buster Blader" in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. Once per turn, during your opponent's turn: You can target 1 "Buster Blader" monster you control; equip it with 1 "Destruction Sword" monster from your Graveyard (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5187a.name: Buzzsaw Shark
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5187a.description: You can target 1 WATER monster you control; Special Summon from your Deck in Defense Position, 1 Fish monster with the same Level as that monster, but with a different name, and if you do, it cannot activate its effects this turn, also, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Xyz Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Buzzsaw Shark" once per turn. If this card is used for the Xyz Summon of a WATER monster, it can be treated as a Level 3 or 5 monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51894.name: Call of the Earthbound
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51894.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You choose the target of the attack.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51896.name: Call of the Haunted
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51896.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ad.name: Card Guard
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ad.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Place 1 Guard Counter on it. This card gains 300 ATK for each Guard Counter on it. Once per turn: You can target 1 other face-up card you control; remove 1 Guard Counter from this card, and if you do, place 1 Guard Counter on that target (if that card would ever be destroyed, remove 1 Guard Counter from it instead).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c7.name: Cat Shark
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c7.description:
2 Level 2 monsters
While this card has an Xyz Material attached that was originally WATER, it cannot be destroyed by battle. Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 Rank 4 or lower Xyz Monster you control; its ATK and DEF each become double its original ATK and DEF until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51762.name: Blessed Winds
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51762.description:
You can activate 1 of the following effects.
● Send 1 Plant monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; gain 500 LP.
● Target 1 Plant monster in your GY; shuffle it into the Deck, then gain 500 LP.
● Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 "Aroma" monster from your GY.
You can only use this effect of "Blessed Winds" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5178c.name: Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5178c.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by revealing "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" in your hand. You can only Special Summon "Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon" once per turn this way. This card's name becomes "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" while it is on the field or in the Graveyard. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51792.name: Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51792.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 2 monsters, while you control "Toon World". Cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 LP to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. Can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster, in which case this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a5.name: Bolt Penguin
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a5.description: With each arm forming an electric whip, this monster paralyzes its enemies with electric shocks.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517ab.name: Bonding - H2O
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517ab.description: Tribute 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon"; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517af.name: Boneheimer
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517af.description: This monster wanders the seas, sucking dry any creatures it may encounter.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517b1.name: Bonze Alone
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517b1.description: Cannot be Normal or Special Summoned if you control a monster. You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Attack Position. If another monster(s) is Summoned to your field while you control this monster: Destroy this card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517cd.name: Borreload Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517cd.description:
3+ Effect Monsters
Neither player can target this card with monster effects. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 500 ATK/DEF. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks an opponent's monster: You can place that opponent's monster in a zone this card points to and take control of it, but send it to the GY during the End Phase of the next turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e3.name: Boycotton
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e3.description: You take any battle damage your opponent would have taken from battles involving this card, instead. If this card battles, is not destroyed, and you took damage from that battle: Return this card to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517f4.name: Breaker the Dark Magical Warrior
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517f4.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 2 Spell Counters on it. If this card is Pendulum Summoned: Place 3 Spell Counters on it. Gains 400 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Breaker the Dark Magical Warrior" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5180a.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Cardinal
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5180a.description:
2 Level 4 "Fire Fist" monsters
You can detach 2 materials from this card, then target 2 "Fire Fist" / "Fire Formation" cards in your GY and/or face-up field, and 2 cards in your opponent's GY and/or face-up field; shuffle those targets into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Cardinal" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51812.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Hawk
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51812.description: If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect): You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell Card directly from your Deck. While you control a "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Card, all "Fire Fist" monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5181e.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Spirit
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5181e.description: Cannot be used as Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a Beast-Warrior monster. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 3 FIRE monster with 200 or less DEF in your GY; Special Summon that target in Defense Position, and if you do, monsters you control cannot attack for the rest of this turn, except Beast-Warrior monsters. You can only use this effect of "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Spirit" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51827.name: Brutal Potion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51827.description: This card becomes an Equip Card, and equips to 1 monster you control. Once per turn, when you inflict damage to your opponent with a card effect, the equipped monster gains 1000 ATK until the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51842.name: Bujingi Centipede
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51842.description: If you control a Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monster: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target. You can only use the effect of "Bujingi Centipede" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51849.name: Bujingi Pavo
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51849.description: When a Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Bujin" monster from your Deck. You can only use the effect of "Bujingi Pavo" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5184a.name: Bujingi Peacock
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5184a.description: At the end of your Battle Phase: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; add 1 "Bujin" monster from your Deck to your hand. You cannot activate cards or effects the turn you activate this effect, except "Bujin" cards. You can only use the effect of "Bujingi Peacock" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5184b.name: Bujingi Quilin
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5184b.description: If you control a Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monster: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy that target. You can only use the effect of "Bujingi Quilin" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5188e.name: Caius the Shadow Monarch
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5188e.description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 card on the field; banish that target, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent if it is a DARK monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51891.name: Call of Darkness
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51891.description: All monsters restored with "Monster Reborn" are sent to the Graveyard. "Monster Reborn" also cannot be played as long as this card remains on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a2.name: Canyon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a2.description: If a Rock-Type monster in Defense Position is attacked, double any Battle Damage to the controller of the attacking monster.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51727.name: Blackwing - Elphin the Raven
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51727.description: If you control a "Blackwing" monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51732.name: Blackwing - Hurricane the Tornado
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51732.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 Synchro Monster on the field; this card's ATK becomes that monster's current ATK, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51741.name: Blackwing - Steam the Cloak
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51741.description: If this face-up card leaves the field: Special Summon 1 "Steam Token" (Aqua-Type/WIND/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100). If this card is in your Graveyard: You can Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Blackwing - Steam the Cloak" once per Duel. If this card Summoned this way is used as a Synchro Material Monster, all other Synchro Material Monsters must be "Blackwing" monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51748.name: Blackwing Tamer - Obsidian Hawk Joe
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51748.description:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Blackwing" monsters
You can target 1 Level 5 or higher Winged Beast-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect that targets only this card, or when your opponent targets this card for an attack: You can target 1 other "Blackwing" monster you control that would be an appropriate target; that card/effect/attack now targets the new target. You can only use each effect of "Blackwing Tamer - Obsidian Hawk Joe" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5174b.name: Blade Garoodia the Cubic Beast
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5174b.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 2 "Cubic" monsters you control to the Graveyard. If Summoned this way, this card gains 2000 ATK. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. When this card destroys a monster by battle: You can target up to 3 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your Graveyard; send this card to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon them, then you can add 1 "Buster Gundil the Cubic Behemoth" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5174f.name: Bladefly
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5174f.description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all WIND monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all EARTH monsters by 400 points.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5175f.name: Blazing Inpachi
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5175f.description: A wicked wooden spirit now burning in flames. Its fire attack is powerful, but it will soon be nothing but ashes.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51764.name: Blessings of the Nile
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51764.description: Each time card(s) are discarded from your hand to the Graveyard by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5176e.name: Blizzard Thunderbird
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5176e.description: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 2 WATER Winged Beast-Type monsters, 1 from your hand and 1 from your Graveyard, except "Blizzard Thunderbird", then return this card from the field to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Blizzard Thunderbird" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51773.name: Block Golem
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51773.description: If all the monsters in your Graveyard are EARTH: You can Tribute this card to target 2 Level 4 or lower Rock-Type monsters in your Graveyard, except "Block Golem"; Special Summon those targets, but their effects that activate on the field cannot be activated this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517ac.name: Bone Crusher
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517ac.description: When this card is Special Summoned from your Graveyard by the effect of a Zombie-Type monster: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target. During the End Phase of the turn this card was Special Summoned: Destroy it.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517bf.name: Booster Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517bf.description:
2 "Rokket" monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 other face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK/DEF. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. If this Link Summoned card is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: You can target 1 other Dragon monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Booster Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c5.name: Boot-Up Order - Gear Force
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c5.description: When either player's monster declares an attack and all monsters you control are face-up Machine monsters (min. 1): Destroy Attack Position monsters your opponent controls, up to the number of Machine monsters you control.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517de.name: Bountiful Artemis
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517de.description: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e2.name: Box of Friends
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e2.description: If this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon from your Deck, 2 Normal Monsters with different names whose ATK or DEF is 0, in face-up Defense Position, but they cannot be used as Synchro Material, also they are destroyed during your next End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Box of Friends" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517ee.name: Brave Scizzar
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517ee.description: Armed with a mass of scissors, this monster can clip an enemy into any desired shape and size.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517f3.name: Break! Draw!
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517f3.description: Equip only to a Machine monster. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Draw 1 card. Destroy this card during your 3rd End Phase after activation.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51809.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Buffalo
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51809.description: If this card is in your Graveyard: You can send a total of 2 "Fire Fist" / "Fire Formation" cards from your hand and/or face-up on your side of the field to the Graveyard; Special Summon this card from your Graveyard. You can only use the effect of "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Buffalo" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51810.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Elephant
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51810.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 face-up "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Fire Fist" monster from your hand, except "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Elephant". You can target 1 "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap in your GY; shuffle it into the Deck, then, you can add 1 Level 5 or higher "Fire Fist" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Elephant" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5183a.name: Bujin Regalia - The Sword
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5183a.description:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 "Bujin" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.
● Target 1 of your banished "Bujin" monsters; send that target to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5185b.name: Burden of the Mighty
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5185b.description: Each face-up monster your opponent controls loses 100 ATK x its own Level.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5185e.name: Burial from a Different Dimension
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5185e.description: Target up to 3 banished monsters; return them to the GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51862.name: Burning Beast
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51862.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Freezing Beast" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 face-up Spell or Trap Card on the field. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5186f.name: Buster Blader, the Destruction Swordmaster
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5186f.description: This card's name becomes "Buster Blader" while it is on the field or in the Graveyard. If a monster(s) your opponent controls is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of those destroyed monsters; equip it to this card. Once per turn: You can send 1 Monster Card you control that is equipped to this card to the Graveyard; destroy all monsters your opponent controls with the same Type as that monster sent to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51871.name: Buster Blaster
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51871.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster loses 500 ATK and DEF. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Destroy all face-up monsters on the field with the same Monster Type as the destroyed monster. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5189a.name: Calming Magic
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5189a.description: This card can only be activated at the start of Main Phase 1. During the Main Phases and Battle Phase of this turn, neither player can Summon monsters.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51734.name: Blackwing - Jin the Rain Shadow
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51734.description: If this card battles a face-up monster with DEF equal to or less than this card's ATK, destroy that monster at the start of the Damage Step (without damage calculation).

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51736.name: Blackwing - Kochi the Daybreak
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51736.description: If this card was Special Summoned, it cannot be used as a Synchro Material.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51739.name: Blackwing - Mistral the Silver Shield
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51739.description: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Reduce the next battle damage you would take this turn to 0.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5173c.name: Blackwing - Pinaki the Waxing Moon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5173c.description: Cannot be used as Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a "Blackwing" Synchro Monster. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there from the field this turn: You can add 1 "Blackwing" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Blackwing - Pinaki the Waxing Moon". You can only use this effect of "Blackwing - Pinaki the Waxing Moon" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51749.name: Blade Armor Ninja
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51749.description:
2 Level 4 Warrior-Type monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 "Ninja" monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51751.name: Blast Held by a Tribute
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51751.description: When an opponent's monster that was Tribute Summoned declares an attack: Destroy as many face-up Attack Position monsters they control as possible, and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5176d.name: Blizzard Princess
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5176d.description: You can Tribute Summon this card in face-up Attack Position by Tributing 1 Spellcaster-Type monster. After this card was Normal Summoned, your opponent cannot activate Spell/Trap Cards for the rest of that turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5176f.name: Blizzard Warrior
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5176f.description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, look at the top card of their Deck, then return that card to either the top or the bottom of their Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517fb.name: Bri Synchron
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517fb.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Synchro Material, until the end of this turn, the Synchro Monster that used this card as a Synchro Material gains 600 ATK, but its effects are negated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51811.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Gorilla
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51811.description: Once per turn, when this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell directly from your Deck. Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap you control to the GY, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51820.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Swan
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51820.description:
2 Beast-Warrior monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap you control. During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap you control to the GY, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Swan" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51843.name: Bujingi Crane
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51843.description: During damage calculation (in either player's turn), if a Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monster you control battles an opponent's monster: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; the ATK of your monster becomes double its original ATK, during that damage calculation only.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51847.name: Bujingi Ibis
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51847.description: During your Main Phase 1: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard, then target 1 "Bujin" monster you control; this turn, if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51857.name: Bujintervention
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51857.description: Target 1 "Bujin" monster on the field; apply this effect to it for the rest of this turn. Each time it destroys a monster by battle whose current ATK is greater than or equal to the targeted monster's original ATK, and sends it to the Graveyard: Banish the destroyed monster, and if you do, banish all monsters from your opponent's hand, Main Deck, Extra Deck, and Graveyard with the same name that the destroyed monster had in the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c2.name: Castle Gate
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c2.description: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. Once per turn, if this card is in face-up Attack Position, you can Tribute 1 Level 5 or lower monster to inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that monster's original ATK.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5172c.name: Blackwing - Gladius the Midnight Sun
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5172c.description: If the only face-up monster you control is 1 "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Gladius the Midnight Sun", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5173b.name: Blackwing - Oroshi the Squall
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5173b.description: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Oroshi the Squall", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Blackwing - Oroshi the Squall" once per turn this way. If this card is sent to the GY as a Synchro Material: You can target 1 monster on the field; change that target's battle position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5176c.name: Blizzard Lizard
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5176c.description: If this card is destroyed by battle: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51780.name: Blue Dragon Ninja
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51780.description: Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can discard 1 "Ninja" monster and 1 "Ninjitsu Art" card to target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; this turn, that monster's effects are negated, also that monster cannot attack.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51799.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51799.description: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517b2.name: Boo Koo
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517b2.description: A book-like wizard with a wealth of magic written inside.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517d5.name: Boss Rush
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517d5.description: You cannot Normal Summon or Set. During the End Phase of the turn that a "B.E.S." monster or a "Big Core" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "B.E.S." monster or 1 "Big Core" from your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517dd.name: Bound Wand
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517dd.description: Equip only to a Spellcaster monster that has a Level. It gains ATK equal to its Level x 100. If the equipped monster is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to the GY, and this card is sent to your GY as a result: You can Special Summon that monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517df.name: Bounzer Guard
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517df.description: Target 1 face-up "Bounzer" monster you control; this turn, it cannot be targeted by other card effects, or be destroyed by battle. This turn, if an opponent's monster attacks, it must target that monster for an attack if it is still on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517ec.name: Branch!
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517ec.description: When a Fusion Monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of the Fusion Materials in your Graveyard that was used for its Fusion Summon; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5181d.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Snake
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5181d.description: Once per turn, if a "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Card(s) is sent to your Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Trap Card directly from your Deck. Once per turn, if you control no other monsters: You can send 2 face-up "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard; draw 1 card.

3 Level 11 monsters
When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to quarter the original ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard. If this card has "Skypalace Gangaridai" as an Xyz Material, it gains this effect.
● Once per turn, if this card destroys a monster by battle: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; it can make a second attack in a row.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ae.name: Card Rotator
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ae.description: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Change the battle positions of all monsters your opponent controls. (Face-down Defense Position monsters are flipped to face-up Attack Position.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518b3.name: Card of Distrain
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518b3.description: If your opponent controls 2 or more Set cards in their Spell & Trap Zone: Target 1 of those cards; that Set card cannot be activated this turn, also each time your opponent activates a Set card in their Spell & Trap Zone this turn, they take 800 damage immediately after it resolves.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518cd.name: Catalyst Field
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518cd.description: Each turn, 1 Level 5 or higher Gemini monster you Normal Summon can be Summoned without Tributing. During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 Gemini monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish 1 Gemini monster you control, that is treated as an Effect Monster and has gained its effects, until your opponent's End Phase, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51742.name: Blackwing - Tornado the Reverse Wind
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51742.description: When this card is Normal Summoned while your opponent controls a Special Summoned monster: You can target 1 "Blackwing" Tuner in your Graveyard; you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "Blackwing" monsters, also Special Summon that monster, but its effects are negated.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51759.name: Blaze Accelerator
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51759.description: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; send 1 Pyro-Type monster with 500 or less ATK from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, destroy that target. You cannot declare an attack during the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51767.name: Blind Spot Strike
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51767.description: Select 1 face-up Defense Position monster your opponent controls and 1 face-up Attack Position monster you control. The monster you control gains ATK equal to the opponent's monster's DEF, until the End Phase.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51776.name: Blockman
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51776.description: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon in Defense Position, a number of "Block Tokens" (Rock-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1500) equal to the number of your turns this card has been face-up on your field. These Tokens cannot declare an attack.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51778.name: Blood Mefist
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51778.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: You can inflict 150 damage to your opponent for each card your opponent controls. Each time your opponent Sets a Spell or Trap Card(s): Inflict 150 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a4.name: Bolt Escargot
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a4.description: After rendering an opponent immobile by spitting a sticky goo, this monster closes in for the attack.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517b0.name: Bonfire Colossus
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517b0.description: If you control a FIRE monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When this card is Special Summoned: Target 2 FIRE monsters you control; destroy those targets.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e5.name: Brain Control
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e5.description: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51800.name: Brilliant Spark
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51800.description: If a face-up "Gem-Knight" monster(s) you control is destroyed by your opponent's attack or card effect: Target 1 of those destroyed monsters; inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its original ATK. If this card is in your Graveyard: You can send 1 "Gem-Knight" card from your hand to the Graveyard; add this card to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Brilliant Spark" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5181f.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Swallow
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5181f.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard. When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Trap Card directly from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Swallow" once per turn. Face-up Beast-Warrior-Type monsters you control cannot be targeted by your opponent's card effects.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51823.name: Broww, Huntsman of Dark World
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51823.description: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Draw 1 card, plus another card if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5183e.name: Bujincarnation
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5183e.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters: Target 1 "Bujin" monster in your Graveyard and 1 of your banished "Bujin" monsters; Special Summon both targets. They cannot be used as Xyz Material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of a Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5184c.name: Bujingi Raven
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5184c.description: When a "Bujin" monster you control is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster and sent to your Graveyard: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; destroy that opponent's monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51853.name: Bujinki Amaterasu
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51853.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
You can only control 1 "Bujinki Amaterasu". Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; apply this effect, depending on whose turn it is.
● Your turn: Target 1 of your banished Level 4 or lower monsters; Special Summon that target.
● Your opponent's turn: Target 1 of your banished Level 4 or lower monsters; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51888.name: Caam, Serenity of Gusto
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51888.description: Once per turn: You can shuffle 2 "Gusto" monsters from your Graveyard into the Main Deck; draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5188b.name: Cagna, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5188b.description:
If you control a monster that is not a "Burning Abyss" monster, destroy this card. You can only use 1 of these effects of "Cagna, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss" per turn, and only once that turn.
● If you control no Spell/Trap Cards: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can send 1 "Burning Abyss" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5189c.name: Candle of Fate
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5189c.description: Decides the fate of an opponent when the candle on its fingertip burns out.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5189d.name: Caninetaur
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5189d.description: Once per turn, if this card battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation (in either player's turn): You can send 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to the sent monster's Level x 100, until the end of the Battle Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a9.name: Card Blocker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a9.description: When this card is Summoned: Change it to Defense Position. When a face-up monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can change the target to this card. When this card is targeted for an attack: You can choose a number from 1 to 3, then send that many cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard; this card gains 500 DEF for each card sent, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518bc.name: Cards of Consonance
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518bc.description: Discard 1 Dragon Tuner with 1000 or less ATK; draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c3.name: Castle Link
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c3.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 Link Monster on the field; move it to a Main Monster Zone it points to on its controller's field. Once per turn: You can switch the locations of 2 Link Monsters in your Main Monster Zones or 2 Link Monsters in your opponent's Main Monster Zones.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5172f.name: Blackwing - Gust the Backblast
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5172f.description: If you control no cards, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If your opponent's monster attacks a "Blackwing" monster you control, the attacking monster loses 300 ATK during the Damage Step only.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51737.name: Blackwing - Kogarashi the Wanderer
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51737.description: When a face-up "Blackwing" monster you control is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. When a monster is Synchro Summoned using this card as a Synchro Material, the opponent of this card's owner cannot activate cards or effects.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51750.name: Blast Asmodian
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51750.description: If any Spell or Trap Card(s) are Chained, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5177e.name: Blossom Bombardment
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5177e.description: When a Plant-Type monster you control destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the destroyed monster's ATK in the Graveyard.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51789.name: Blue-Eyed Silver Zombie
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51789.description: The beams from the eyes of this creature are said to turn enemies into zombies.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a3.name: Bokoichi the Freightening Car
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a3.description: A freight car that is exclusively for Dekoichi. It can transport anything, but most cargo arrives broken.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51807.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51807.description: Once per turn, when this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell directly from your Deck. Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap you control to the GY, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51837.name: Bujin Mikazuchi
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51837.description: When a Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or by card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if a "Bujin" monster(s) was sent from your hand to your Graveyard this turn while you controlled this face-up card: You can add 1 "Bujin" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand. You can only control 1 "Bujin Mikazuchi".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51848.name: Bujingi Ophidian
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51848.description: During your Main Phase 1: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard, then target 1 "Bujin" monster you control; it can attack your opponent directly this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5185a.name: Bunilla
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5185a.description: This rabbit's got a sweet tooth! He's on a quest for the world's sweetest carrot, and just wants to nibble carrots all day today, tomorrow, and the day after that!

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5185d.name: Burglar
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5185d.description: A sly rat. He will come at you with his huge left claw.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5186a.name: Burst Return
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5186a.description: If you control a face-up "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix": Return all face-up "Elemental HERO" monsters on the field to the hand, except "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a8.name: Card Advance
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a8.description: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your Deck, then place them on the top of the Deck in any order. You can Tribute Summon 1 monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set this turn. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ac.name: Card Ejector
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ac.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard; banish that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518bb.name: Cards from the Sky
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518bb.description: Banish 1 LIGHT Fairy monster in your hand, and if you do, draw 2 cards. You cannot Special Summon or conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c4.name: Castle Walls
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518c4.description: Increase the DEF of 1 face-up monster on the field by 500 points until the end of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51728.name: Blackwing - Etesian of Two Swords
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51728.description: If a "Blackwing" monster you control battles an opponent's monster, and your opponent still controls that monster at the end of the Damage Step: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51726.name: Blackwing - Decay the Ill Wind
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51726.description:
Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was sent there this turn: Take 1000 damage. When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Blackwing" monster you control, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Increase its Level by 1.
● Reduce its Level by 1.
You can only use this effect of "Blackwing - Decay the Ill Wind" once per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51768.name: Blindly Loyal Goblin
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51768.description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, control of this card cannot switch.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51782.name: Blue Duston
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51782.description: Cannot be used as a Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Material for a Summon. While this card is face-up on the field, it cannot be Tributed. When this card on the field is destroyed: Banish 1 random card from its controller's hand, face-down, until the Standby Phase of the next turn. You can only control 1 face-up "Blue Duston".

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51785.name: Blue Mountain Butterspy
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51785.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. When you Normal Summon a Warrior monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Cannot be used as Synchro Material.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5179f.name: Blue-Winged Crown
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5179f.description: With hair shaped like a crown and a body encased in bluish white flames, this bird is a formidable sight.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c0.name: Boot Sector Launch
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517c0.description:
All "Rokket" monsters on the field gain 300 ATK/DEF.
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon up to 2 "Rokket" monsters with different names from your hand in Defense Position.
● If your opponent controls more monsters than you do: Special Summon "Rokket" monsters with different names from your GY in Defense Position, up to the difference.
You can only use this effect of "Boot Sector Launch" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e9.name: Brain Jacker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e9.description: FLIP: Equip this card to a monster on your opponent's side of the field and treat it as an Equip Card. Take control of the equipped monster. Your opponent gains 500 Life Points during each of their Standby Phases.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517f5.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517f5.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51805.name: Broken Blocker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51805.description: Activate only when a Defense Position monster you control, whose DEF is higher than its ATK, is destroyed by battle. Special Summon up to 2 monsters with the same name as that monster from your Deck in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5180b.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Caribou
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5180b.description: During the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was destroyed by a card effect and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 "Fire Fist" monster from your Deck, except "Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Caribou". If this card is sent to the Graveyard for the Synchro Summon of a "Fire Fist" monster: You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell Card directly from your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5182e.name: Bubble Shuffle
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5182e.description: Target 1 face-up Attack Position "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" you control and 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change both those targets to Defense Position, then Tribute that "Elemental HERO Bubbleman", then Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51833.name: Bujin Arasuda
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51833.description: If a "Bujin" monster in your Graveyard or face-up on your side of the field is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand in face-up Defense Position. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if a "Bujin" card was added from your Deck to your hand this turn, except by drawing it, while you controlled this face-up card: You can draw 1 card, then discard 1 card. You can only control 1 "Bujin Arasuda".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5183c.name: Bujin Yamato
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5183c.description: Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can add 1 "Bujin" monster from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. You can only control 1 "Bujin Yamato".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5187e.name: Byser Shock
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5187e.description: If this card is Summoned: Return all Set cards on the field to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51895.name: Call of the Grave
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51895.description: When your opponent activates "Monster Reborn": Negate the effect of that "Monster Reborn".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a1.name: Canon the Melodious Diva
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518a1.description: If you control a "Melodious" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Canon the Melodious Diva" once per turn this way. Once per turn: You can target 1 "Melodious" monster you control; change its battle position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518b5.name: Card of Sacrifice
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518b5.description: Draw 2 cards, if the combined ATK of all your face-up Attack Position monsters (minimum 2) is less than the ATK of your opponent's face-up monster with the lowest ATK. You cannot Summon or change Battle Position the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518bd.name: Cards of the Red Stone
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518bd.description: Send 1 Level 7 "Red-Eyes" monster from your hand to the Graveyard; draw 2 cards, then you can send 1 Level 7 "Red-Eyes" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. You can only activate 1 "Cards of the Red Stone" per turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51733.name: Blackwing - Jetstream the Blue Sky
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51733.description: During damage calculation, you can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard to prevent a "Blackwing" monster you control from being destroyed by this battle.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51738.name: Blackwing - Kris the Crack of Dawn
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51738.description: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Kris the Crack of Dawn", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Blackwing - Kris the Crack of Dawn" once per turn this way. Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap effects.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51754.name: Blast Sphere
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51754.description: If this face-down Defense Position card was attacked by an opponent's monster, before damage calculation: Equip this card to the attacking monster. Then, during your opponent's next Standby Phase: Destroy the monster this card is equipped to, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK the destroyed monster had on the field.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5175d.name: Blazewing Butterfly
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5175d.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● You can Tribute this card, then target 1 Gemini monster in your Graveyard, except "Blazewing Butterfly"; Special Summon that target, and if you do, it becomes an Effect Monster, and gains its effect.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51781.name: Blue Dragon Summoner
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51781.description: If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 Dragon, Warrior, or Spellcaster Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51791.name: Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a51791.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Blue-Eyes" monsters
Neither player can Special Summon 2 or more monsters at the same time. Once per turn, during either player's turn, when an effect of a card in the Graveyard is activated: You can negate the activation. During either player's turn: You can Tribute this Synchro Summoned card; Special Summon 1 LIGHT Dragon-Type Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position, except "Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon", but destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5179c.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a5179c.description: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a2.name: Boar Soldier
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a2.description: If this card is Normal Summoned, destroy this card. If your opponent controls 1 or more monsters, decrease the ATK of this card by 1000 points.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a6.name: Bombardment Beetle
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517a6.description: FLIP: Pick up and see 1 face-down Defense Position Monster Card on your opponent's side of the field. If it is an Effect Monster, destroy it (its Flip Effect is not activated), and if the card is not, return it to its original position.

60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517b9.name: Book of Moon
60c2b3a9a0e24f2d54a517b9.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a517e8.name: Brain Hazard
