60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f4.description: Inflict 250 damage to your opponent. If this card was activated as Chain Link 2 or 3, add this card to the Deck and shuffle it. If this card was activated as Chain Link 4 or higher, return this card to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f7.name: Chain Dog
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f7.description: Cannot be used as a Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a Beast-Type monster. If this card is in the Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do, banish it when it leaves the field. You must control exactly 2 Beast-Type monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51907.name: Champion's Vigilance
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51907.description: If you control a Level 7 or higher Normal Monster, when a monster would be Summoned OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5192f.name: Charge of the Light Brigade
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5192f.description: Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard; add 1 Level 4 or lower "Lightsworn" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51975.name: Chrysalis Pantail
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51975.description: You can Tribute this card while "Neo Space" is on the field to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51978.name: Chthonian Blast
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51978.description: When a face-up monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to quarter of that monster's ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5198c.name: Clay Charge
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5198c.description: When an "Elemental HERO Clayman" you control is targeted for an attack (even if it is face-down, but reveal it to your opponent in that case): Destroy the attacking monster and that "Elemental HERO Clayman", and inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a0.name: Cloudian - Altus
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a0.description: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. When you Normal Summon this card, place 1 Fog Counter on it for each "Cloudian" monster on the field. You can remove 3 Fog Counters from anywhere on the field to discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a1.name: Cloudian - Cirrostratus
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a1.description: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. When you Normal Summon this card, place 1 Fog Counter on it for each "Cloudian" monster on the field. You can remove 2 Fog Counters from this card to destroy 1 monster on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a2.name: Cloudian - Eye of the Typhoon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a2.description: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. When this card declares an attack, change the battle positions of all face-up monsters, except "Cloudian" monsters.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ad.name: Cluster Congester
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ad.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned and you control no Link Monsters: You can Special Summon 1 "Congester Token" (Cyberse/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). You can only use this effect of "Cluster Congester" once per turn. Once per Battle Step, if a Link Monster you control is attacked (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY and that Link Monster; Special Summon "Congester Tokens", up to the number of Link Monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519bb.name: Cocoon of Ultra Evolution
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519bb.description: Tribute 1 Insect monster from either field equipped with an Equip Card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Insect monster from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Insect monster in your GY; shuffle it into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Cocoon of Ultra Evolution" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519c6.name: Coffin Seller
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519c6.description: Each time a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519c8.name: Cold Feet
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519c8.description: You cannot activate, Set, or use the effects of any Spell/Trap Cards this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a48.name: Crass Clown
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a48.description: When this card is changed from Defense Position to Attack Position, return 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field to the owner's hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a91.name: Crystal Girl
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a91.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 Level 5 or higher WATER monster from your Deck to your hand. If you control a Level 5 or higher WATER monster and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Crystal Girl" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51abc.name: Cure Mermaid
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51abc.description: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, increase your Life Points by 800 points during each of your Standby Phases.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51abe.name: Curse Necrofear
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51abe.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by a card effect. You can target 3 of your banished Fiend monsters; Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, shuffle those banished monsters into the Deck. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed in your Monster Zone by an opponent's card and sent there this turn: Special Summon this card from your GY, then, you can destroy cards your opponent controls, up to the number of face-up Spells/Traps you control with different names. You can only use each effect of "Curse Necrofear" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ad4.name: Cyber Angel Dakini
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ad4.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Machine Angel Ritual". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can make your opponent send 1 monster they control to the GY (their choice). If a Ritual Monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can target 1 Ritual Monster or 1 "Machine Angel Ritual" in your GY; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51adb.name: Cyber Blader
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51adb.description:
"Etoile Cyber" + "Blade Skater"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While your opponent controls only 1 monster, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. While your opponent controls only 2 monsters, double this card's ATK. While your opponent controls only 3 monsters, negate the effects of your opponent's Spell, Trap, and Effect Monster Cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b01.name: Cyber Raider
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b01.description:
If this card is Summoned: Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 Equip Card on the field; destroy that target.
● Target 1 Equip Card on the field; equip that target to this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b05.name: Cyber Shadow Gardna
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b05.description: During your opponent's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine/EARTH/Level 4/ATK ?/DEF ?). (This card is also still a Trap.) When an opponent's monster declares an attack that targets this card: The ATK/DEF of this card become the ATK/DEF of the attacking monster. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Set this card in its Spell & Trap Zone.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d7.name: Cave Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d7.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned while you control a monster. This card cannot declare an attack unless you control another Dragon-Type monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d0.name: Catapult Zone
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d0.description: Once per turn, if a monster you control would be destroyed by battle, you can send 1 Rock-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard instead.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f0.name: Chachaka Archer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f0.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5190c.name: Changing Destiny
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5190c.description:
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, change it to Defense Position and it cannot change its battle position while it is face-up on the field. Then, your opponent chooses 1 of these effects.
● You (the opponent of this card's activator) gain LP equal to half the target's ATK.
● Your opponent (the activator of this card) takes damage equal to half the target's ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51920.name: Chaos King Archfiend
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51920.description:
1 Fiend-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card declares an attack: You can switch the current ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters your opponent controls, until the end of the Battle Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5192c.name: Chaosrider Gustaph
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5192c.description: Once per turn, you can remove from play up to 2 Spell Cards from your Graveyard. This card gains 300 ATK for each card removed, until the end of your opponent's next turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5194f.name: Chorus of Sanctuary
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5194f.description: Increase the DEF of all Defense Position monsters by 500 points.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51954.name: Chow Chow Chan
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51954.description: When your opponent activates a Normal Trap Card in response to your monster's attack declaration targeting an opponent's monster: You can discard this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5196b.name: Chronomaly Sol Monolith
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5196b.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Chronomaly" monster you control; its Level becomes 6. You cannot Special Summon any monsters during the turn you activate this effect, except "Chronomaly" monsters.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ae.name: Coach Captain Bearman
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ae.description: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1300. Once per turn: You can make all Level 4 Beast-Warrior-Type monsters you currently control become Level 8 until the end of this turn. This card cannot be used as an Xyz Material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of a FIRE Warrior-Type monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519b0.name: Coach King Giantrainer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519b0.description:
3 Level 8 monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; draw 1 card and show it, then if it was a monster, inflict 400 damage to your opponent. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect. You can only use this effect of "Coach King Giantrainer" up to thrice per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519b8.name: Cocoon Rebirth
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519b8.description: You can Tribute 1 face-up "Chrysalis" monster you control to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster written in the card text of that card from either player's Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a35.name: Cost Down
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a35.description: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a49.name: Crawling Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a49.description: This weakened dragon can no longer fly, but is still a deadly force to be reckoned with.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a4a.name: Crawling Dragon #2
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a4a.description: A powerful dragon with teeth that can grind almost anything to dust.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a4d.name: Creation Resonator
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a4d.description: If you control a Level 8 or higher Synchro Monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a60.name: Cross Breed
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a60.description: Banish 2 monsters from your hand and/or face-up field with the same original Type and Attribute, but different names; add 1 monster with the same original Type and Attribute as those monsters, but a different name, from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Cross Breed" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a87.name: Crystal Beast Amethyst Cat
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a87.description: This card can attack your opponent directly, but when it uses this effect, any Battle Damage it inflicts to your opponent is halved. If this face-up card is destroyed while it is in a Monster Card Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Card Zone as a Continuous Spell Card, instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aa9.name: Crystron Rosenix
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aa9.description: You can target 1 face-up card you control; you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Machine-Type Synchro Monsters, also, destroy that card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Crystron" Tuner from your Deck. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Crystron Token" (Machine-Type/WATER/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0), but it cannot be Tributed. You can only use 1 "Crystron Rosenix" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ab0.name: Cubic Dharma
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ab0.description:
You take no battle damage from attacks involving your "Cubic" monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "Cubic Dharma" once per turn, during your Main Phase:
● You can send 1 "Cubic" card from your hand to the GY, and if you do, draw 1 card.
● You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Cubic" monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ac0.name: Curse of Anubis
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ac0.description: Change all Effect Monsters on the field to Defense Position. Until the end of this turn, the original DEF of those monsters becomes 0, also their battle positions cannot be changed.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ad3.name: Cyber Angel Benten
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ad3.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Machine Angel Ritual". If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original DEF in the GY. If this card is Tributed: You can add 1 LIGHT Fairy monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51af8.name: Cyber Laser Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51af8.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Photon Generator Unit". Once per turn, you can destroy 1 monster with ATK or DEF equal to or higher than the ATK of this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f6.name: Chain Dispel
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f6.description: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Destroy all cards in the controller's Deck with the same name as the activated card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5191a.name: Chaos Form
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5191a.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier" Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field and/or banish "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or "Dark Magician" from your GY, whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the "Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier" Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51952.name: Chosen by the World Chalice
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51952.description: Inspired by the World Hero legends he heard as a boy, this crusader adds a piece to his armor from every Mekkstrosity he destroys. He has set out on a quest from Fairy Lee to recover the Seven World Legacies and save their world.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5195c.name: Chronomaly Colossal Head
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5195c.description: You can banish this card from your Graveyard to target 1 Level 3 or higher Attack Position monster on the field; change it to face-up or face-down Defense Position. The effect of "Chronomaly Colossal Head" can only be used once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51971.name: Chrysalis Chicky
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51971.description: You can Tribute this card while "Neo Space" is on the field to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5197a.name: Chthonian Polymer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5197a.description: Activate only when your opponent Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster. Tribute 1 monster to take control of that Fusion Monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5197b.name: Chthonian Soldier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5197b.description: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519c1.name: Code Talker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519c1.description:
2 Effect Monsters
Gains 500 ATK for each monster this card points to. Cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects, while this card points to a monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519d9.name: Commencement Dance
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519d9.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Performance of Sword". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519df.name: Concentrating Current
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519df.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains ATK equal to its current DEF, until the end of this turn. Other monsters you control cannot attack during the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a0e.name: Continuous Destruction Punch
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a0e.description: If the DEF of the attacked Defense Position monster on your side of the field is higher than the ATK of the attacking monster on your opponent's side of the field, destroy the attacking monster. Damage calculation is applied normally.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a10.name: Contract with the Void
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a10.description: If you have 3 or more other cards in your hand: Discard your entire hand, then you can Special Summon 1 "Infernity" monster or 1 Level 8 DARK Dragon Synchro Monster from your GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a14.name: Contract with the Dark Master
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a14.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Dark Master - Zorc". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a17.name: Convert Contact
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a17.description: If you control no monsters: Send 2 "Neo-Spacian" monsters (1 from your hand and 1 from your Deck) to the GY, then draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a1e.name: Coral Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a1e.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. If this Synchro Summoned card is sent from the field to the GY: You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Coral Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a42.name: Crane Crane
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a42.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 3 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target, but it has its effects negated. You can only use this effect of "Crane Crane" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a47.name: Crashbug Z
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a47.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Crashbug Y" from your Deck. You must control a face-up "Crashbug X" to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a4b.name: Crazy Fish
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a4b.description: A flying fish that attacks with its pointed head.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a6d.name: Crowley, the Magistus of Grimoires
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a6d.description: You can send 1 Spellcaster monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can declare 1 Attribute; this card becomes that Attribute until the end of this turn. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Magistus" monster you control; equip it with 1 "Magistus" monster from your GY, except a Level 4 monster. You can only use each effect of "Crowley, the Magistus of Grimoires" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a6f.name: Crowning of the Emperor
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a6f.description: Tribute 1 'Toy Soldier'; Special Summon 1 'Toy Emperor' from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a7b.name: Crusadia Revival
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a7b.description: All "Crusadia" Link Monsters on the field gain 500 ATK. Once per turn: You can target 1 "Crusadia" Link Monster you control; this turn (even if this card leaves the field), it can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each, also other monsters you control cannot attack.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a96.name: Crystal Raigeki
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a96.description: Send 1 "Crystal Beast" card from your Spell & Trap Card Zone to the Graveyard to target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a9c.name: Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a9c.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Once per turn, when another monster's effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster, and if you do that, this card gains ATK equal to the destroyed monster's original ATK until the end of this turn. If this card battles an opponent's Level 5 or higher monster, during damage calculation: This card gains ATK equal to the current ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling during that damage calculation only.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a9f.name: Crystron Citree
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a9f.description: During your opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase: You can target 1 non-Tuner monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, but it has its effects negated (if any), and if you do, immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Machine-Type Synchro Monster using only that monster and this card (this is a Quick Effect). These Synchro Materials are banished instead of being sent to the Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Crystron Citree" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51abf.name: Curse of Aging
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51abf.description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Decrease the ATK and DEF of all monsters on your opponent's side of the field by 500 points until the end of the turn this card is activated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aee.name: Cyber End Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aee.description:
"Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51afd.name: Cyber Petit Angel
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51afd.description: If this card is Summoned: You can add 1 "Cyber Angel" monster or "Machine Angel Ritual" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Cyber Petit Angel" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b09.name: Cyber Soldier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b09.description: Guardian of the Machine Master, it crushes opposition by rolling over them.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d9.name: Celestia
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d9.description: All Wyrm-Type monsters gain 300 ATK and DEF. Once per turn: You can banish 3 Wyrm-Type monsters from your Graveyard, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d4.name: Catoblepas, Familiar of the Evil Eye
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d4.description: You can target 1 "Evil Eye" Spell/Trap you control; once, until the end of the next turn, that card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. If you control an "Evil Eye" monster other than "Catoblepas, Familiar of the Evil Eye", while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Catoblepas, Familiar of the Evil Eye" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518de.name: Celestial Sword - Eatos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518de.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Noble Arms" card.)
The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Guardian Eatos" you control; it gains 500 ATK for each banished monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f1.name: Chain Burst
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f1.description: Each time a player activates a Trap Card, they take 500 damage immediately after it resolves.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518fe.name: Chain Strike
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518fe.description: Activate only as Chain Link 2 or higher; inflict 200 damage to your opponent times the Chain Link number of this card. You cannot activate this card if multiple cards/effects with the same name are in that Chain.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5192e.name: Charge Into a Dark World
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5192e.description: Target 1 Level 4 or lower Fiend monster in your GY; Special Summon it, then discard 1 Fiend monster. You can only activate 1 "Charge Into a Dark World" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51947.name: Chimeratech Rampage Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51947.description:
2+ "Cyber Dragon" monsters
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. When this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon; destroy them. Once per turn: You can send up to 2 LIGHT Machine monsters from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, for each monster sent to the GY, this card gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51951.name: Chosen One
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51951.description: Select 1 Monster Card and 2 non-Monster Cards from your hand. Your opponent randomly selects 1 card among them. If it is a Monster Card, it is Special Summoned and send the remaining 2 cards to the Graveyard. If not, send all the cards to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51955.name: Chow Len the Prophet
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51955.description: Once per turn: You can declare either Spell or Trap, then target 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone; look at that target, and if it is the declared card type, that card cannot be activated this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51959.name: Chronomaly Aztec Mask Golem
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51959.description: During your turn, if you have activated a "Chronomaly" Spell Card previously this turn, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only control 1 "Chronomaly Aztec Mask Golem".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51962.name: Chronomaly Gordian Knot
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51962.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Chronomaly" monster from your hand, and if you do, this card's Level becomes the current Level of that Special Summoned monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51968.name: Chronomaly Nebra Disk
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51968.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Chronomaly" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Chronomaly Nebra Disk". If this card is in the Graveyard and all monsters you control are "Chronomaly" monsters (min. 1): You can Special Summon this card in Defense Position. You cannot activate cards or effects during the turn you activate this effect, except "Chronomaly" cards and effects. You can only use 1 "Chronomaly Nebra Disk" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51974.name: Chrysalis Mole
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51974.description: You can Tribute this card while "Neo Space" is on the field to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5197e.name: Cipher Bit
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5197e.description: Target 1 "Galaxy-Eyes" or "Cipher" Xyz Monster you control; attach this card to it as an Xyz Material, and if you do, the next time it would be destroyed by battle or card effect this turn, it is not destroyed.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51988.name: Citadel Whale
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51988.description: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can Tribute 2 WATER monsters; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Citadel Whale" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Sea Stealth Attack" directly from your Deck. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect that targets 1 WATER monster you control (and no other cards) (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5199a.name: Clock Tower Prison
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5199a.description: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: Place 1 Clock Counter on this card. While there are 4 or more Clock Counters on this card, you do not take any battle damage. If this card with 4 or more Clock Counters is destroyed and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a7.name: Cloudian - Smoke Ball
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a7.description: Smoke Balls are newly born Cloudians. They fear being alone, and would rather swing and sway in the sky with their friends.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a8.name: Cloudian - Storm Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a8.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 "Cloudian" monster from your Graveyard. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. Once per turn, you can place 1 Fog Counter on 1 monster on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519d3.name: Comics Hero King Arthur
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519d3.description:
2 Level 4 Warrior-Type monsters
If this card would be destroyed by battle, you can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card instead. When you do: It gains 500 ATK, and if it does, inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519f1.name: Constellar Belt
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519f1.description: The activation of LIGHT monsters' effects cannot be negated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a03.name: Constellar Twinkle
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a03.description: Target 1 "Constellar" monster you control; increase its Level by 1 or 2. If this card is in the Graveyard: You can banish 1 "Constellar" monster from your Graveyard; add this card from the Graveyard to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Constellar Twinkle" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a05.name: Constellar Zubeneschamali
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a05.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Constellar" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a12.name: Contract with Exodia
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a12.description: If you have all 5 of "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One" in your Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Exodia Necross" from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a20.name: Core Blaster
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a20.description: Equip only to a "Koa'ki Meiru" monster. If it battles a LIGHT or DARK monster, destroy that monster without applying damage calculation. When the equipped monster is removed from the field and this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can return this card to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a34.name: Cosmos Channelling
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a34.description: You can send 1 monster you control that is owned by your opponent to the GY; Special Summon 1 Machine monster from your hand or GY. When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase while you control "Jinzo": You can declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent reveals the card they drew, and if it is the declared card type, send this card to the GY, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Cosmos Channelling" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a5d.name: Criosphinx
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a5d.description: When a monster is returned from the field to the owner's hand, the owner of the returned monster selects and sends 1 card in their hand to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a5f.name: Cross Attack
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a5f.description: Target 2 face-up Attack Position monsters you control with the same ATK; this turn, one of them can attack your opponent directly and the other cannot attack.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a71.name: Crusadia Arboria
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a71.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Defense Position to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only Special Summon "Crusadia Arboria" once per turn this way. If a "Crusadia" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your field or GY instead. You can only use this effect of "Crusadia Arboria" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a76.name: Crusadia Magius
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a76.description:
1 "Crusadia" monster, except "Crusadia Magius"
Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster this card points to. The monster this card points to cannot attack. If an Effect Monster is Special Summoned to the zone this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Crusadia" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Crusadia Magius" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a8c.name: Crystal Beast Topaz Tiger
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a8c.description: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, it gains 400 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this face-up card is destroyed while it is in a Monster Card Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Card Zone as a Continuous Spell Card, instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a90.name: Crystal Conclave
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a90.description: Once per turn, if a face-up "Crystal Beast" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your Deck. You can send this face-up card from the field to the GY, then target 1 "Crystal Beast" card you control and 1 card on the field; return them to the hand. You cannot activate these effects in the same Chain.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aa2.name: Crystron Impact
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aa2.description: Target 1 of your banished "Crystron" monsters; Special Summon it, and if you do, if your opponent controls any face-up monsters, change their DEF to 0. During either player's turn, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard, when a card or effect is activated that targets a "Crystron" monster you control: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate that effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aaa.name: Crystron Smiger
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aaa.description: You can target 1 face-up card you control; you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Machine-Type Synchro Monsters, also, destroy that card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Crystron" Tuner from your Deck. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; add 1 "Crystron" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Crystron Smiger" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aaf.name: Cubic Causality
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aaf.description: Distribute a number of Cubic Counters on face-up monsters your opponent controls, up to the number of "Cubic" monsters you control. (Monsters with a Cubic Counter cannot attack, also negate their effects.) You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Cubic" monster you control; this turn, each time it destroys a monster by battle that has a Cubic Counter, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of that destroyed monster. You can only use each effect of "Cubic Causality" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51adf.name: Cyber Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51adf.description: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ae1.name: Cyber Dragon Drei
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ae1.description: This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field or in the GY. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can make all "Cyber Dragon" you currently control become Level 5. You cannot Special Summon any monsters during the turn you activate this effect, except Machine monsters. If this card is banished: You can target 1 "Cyber Dragon" you control; it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ae8.name: Cyber Dragon Vier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ae8.description: This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field or in the GY. If you Normal or Special Summon "Cyber Dragon", except during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Cyber Dragon Vier" once per turn. Each "Cyber Dragon" you control gains 500 ATK/DEF.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518df.name: Celestial Transformation
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518df.description: Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand. That monster's ATK is halved, also it is destroyed during the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518e7.name: Centaur Mina
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518e7.description:
"Noble Knight's Spearholder" + "Horse of the Floral Knights"
Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Trap Card during your turn (Quick Effect). You can negate that activation, and if you do, Set that card face-down.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ea.name: Centrifugal Field
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ea.description: When a Fusion Monster(s) is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Its owner targets 1 Fusion Material Monster in their Graveyard that is listed on that Fusion Monster; that player Special Summons that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518fa.name: Chain Hole
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518fa.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect in response to a card or effect activation: Negate that opponent's effect, then, your opponent can banish 1 card from their hand or Deck with the same original name as that negated card. If they did not, you can banish 1 random card from their hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518fb.name: Chain Ignition
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518fb.description: Once per turn, if a monster(s) your opponent controls is destroyed by your opponent's card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5191b.name: Chaos Goddess
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5191b.description:
1 LIGHT Tuner + 2+ non-Tuner DARK monsters
Once per turn: You can send 1 LIGHT monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Level 5 or higher DARK monster in your GY; Special Summon that monster, but it cannot be used as Synchro Material.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5191c.name: Chaos Greed
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5191c.description: You can only activate this card if 4 or more of your cards are currently removed from play and there are no cards in your Graveyard. Draw 2 cards from your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5191e.name: Chaos Hunter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5191e.description: When your opponent Special Summons a monster (except during the Damage Step): You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your hand. Your opponent cannot banish cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51932.name: Charioteer of Prophecy
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51932.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 "Spellbook" Spell Card to target 1 Spellcaster-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5193b.name: Chemicritter Oxy Ox
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5193b.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Gemini monster from your hand, and if you do, all Gemini monsters you currently control become that monster's original Level until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Chemicritter Oxy Ox" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51948.name: Chiron the Mage
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51948.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell Card, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5199d.name: Closed Forest
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5199d.description: All Beast-Type monsters you control gain 100 ATK for each monster in your Graveyard. Field Spell Cards cannot be activated. Field Spell Cards cannot be activated during the turn this card is destroyed.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a6.name: Cloudian - Sheep Cloud
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519a6.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon 2 "Cloudian Tokens" (Fairy-Type/WATER/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, unless it is for a "Cloudian" monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ab.name: Cloudian Squall
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ab.description: During each of your Standby Phases, place 1 Fog Counter on every face-up monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519b5.name: Cocatorium the Heavy Metal Avian
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519b5.description: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can Tribute 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can banish 1 Level 4 or lower Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster from your Deck; this card's name becomes that banished monster's name, also it becomes the same Type, Attribute and Level as that monster's, until the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "Cocatorium the Heavy Metal Avian" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519eb.name: Consolation Prize
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519eb.description: If a monster(s) is sent from the hand to the GY: Target 1 of them; Special Summon it to your field. You can only activate 1 "Consolation Prize" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a02.name: Constellar Tempest
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a02.description: During your End Phase: You can target 2 "Constellar" Xyz Monsters you control that have Xyz Material; detach all Xyz Materials from both Xyz Monsters, and if you do, halve your opponent's LP. You can only use this effect of "Constellar Tempest" once per Duel. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can target 1 "Constellar" Xyz Monster you control and 1 "Constellar" monster in your Graveyard; attach that monster from the Graveyard to that Xyz Monster as an Xyz Material.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a2e.name: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a2e.description:
"Alien Ammonite" + 1 or more non-Tuner "Alien" monsters
Once per turn, you can select any number of face-up Spell or Trap Cards. Return those cards to their owners' hands, and distribute new A-Counters among monsters on the field equal to the number of cards returned. Once per turn, you can remove 2 A-Counters from anywhere on the field to destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a39.name: Counter Gate
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a39.description: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: Negate the attack, and if you do, draw 1 card, then if it is a monster, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon it in face-up Attack Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a41.name: Cracking Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a41.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster with equal or lower Level. When your opponent Normal or Special Summons exactly 1 monster (and no other monsters are Summoned) while this monster is on the field: You can make that monster lose ATK equal to its Level x 200 (until the end of this turn), and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK lost by this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a46.name: Crashbug Y
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a46.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Crashbug X" from your Deck. You must control a face-up "Crashbug Z" to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a72.name: Crusadia Draco
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a72.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Defense Position to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only Special Summon "Crusadia Draco" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned to a zone a Link Monster points to: You can target 1 "Crusadia" card in your GY, except "Crusadia Draco"; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Crusadia Draco" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a79.name: Crusadia Reclusia
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a79.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Defense Position to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only Special Summon "Crusadia Reclusia" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned to a zone a Link Monster points to: You can target 1 "Crusadia" card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; destroy them. You can only use this effect of "Crusadia Reclusia" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a7c.name: Crusadia Spatha
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a7c.description:
2 Effect Monsters, including a "Crusadia" monster
Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of any monster this card points to. A monster this card points to cannot attack. Once per turn, if an Effect Monster is Special Summoned to a zone this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 monster in either player's Main Monster Zone, except this card; move it to another Main Monster Zone on its controller's field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a85.name: Crystal Beacon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a85.description: Special Summon 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your Deck. You must have 2 or more "Crystal Beast" cards in your Spell & Trap Card Zone to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a93.name: Crystal Master
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a93.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Your opponent cannot target "Ultimate Crystal" monsters or "Crystal Beast" cards you control with card effects.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
You can Tribute this card; add 1 "Ultimate Crystal" monster, "Crystal Beast" monster, or "Crystal" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a95.name: Crystal Promise
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a95.description: Target 1 "Crystal Beast" card in your Spell & Trap Card Zone; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a99.name: Crystal Seer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a99.description: FLIP: Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck, then add 1 of them to your hand, then place the other on the bottom of your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a9d.name: Crystolic Potential
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a9d.description: All "Crystron" monsters you control gain 300 ATK and DEF. Once per turn, during the End Phase: You can draw cards equal to the number of "Crystron" Synchro Monsters you Synchro Summoned this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ab5.name: Cunning of the Six Samurai
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ab5.description: Send 1 face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 "Six Samurai" monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ac6.name: Curse of Fiend
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ac6.description: Change the battle positions of all Attack Position monsters on the field to Defense Position and vice-versa. These positions cannot be changed during the turn this card is activated except by the effect of a Spell, Trap or Effect Monster Card. You can only activate this card during your Standby Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ada.name: Cyber Barrier Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ada.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Attack Reflector Unit". Once per turn, while this card is in Attack Position, your opponent's next attack is negated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b0d.name: Cyber Tutubon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b0d.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 Warrior or Fairy-Type monster from your hand or field. If this card is Tributed for a Ritual Summon: You can target 1 Ritual Spell Card in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d5.name: Cattle Call
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518d5.description: Send 1 face-up monster you control to the Graveyard, whose original Type is Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast; Special Summon 1 monster from your Extra Deck with the same original Type, but it cannot attack, its effects are negated, also it is destroyed during the End Phase. You can only activate 1 "Cattle Call" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518e9.name: Central Shield
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518e9.description: Equip only to a monster you control. You take no battle damage from attacks involving a monster you control, other than the equipped monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f2.name: Chain Close
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f2.description: When a card(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Your opponent cannot activate Spell/Trap Cards this turn. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51921.name: Chaos Necromancer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51921.description: The ATK of this card is the number of Monster Cards in your Graveyard x 300.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51933.name: Charm of Shabti
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51933.description: During either player's turn: You can discard this card; until the End Phase, "Gravekeeper's" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51946.name: Chimeratech Overdragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51946.description:
"Cyber Dragon" + 1+ Machine monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Fusion Summoned: Send all other cards you control to the GY. The original ATK/DEF of this card each become equal to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon x 800. Each turn, this card can attack your opponent's monsters a number of times equal to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5196f.name: Chronomaly Vimana
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5196f.description:
2 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field and 1 Xyz Monster or "Chronomaly" monster in your GY; that monster on the field gains half the ATK of that monster in the GY (until the end of this turn), then attach that monster from the GY to this card as material. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can detach 2 materials from this card; negate the activation.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519bd.name: Code A Ancient Ruins
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519bd.description: Each time a face-up "Alien" monster(s) is destroyed, place 1 A-Counter on this card. Once per turn, you can remove 2 A-Counters from anywhere on the field to Special Summon 1 "Alien" monster from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519c7.name: Cold Enchanter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519c7.description: You can discard 1 card to target 1 face-up monster on the field; place an Ice Counter on that target. This card gains 300 ATK for each Ice Counter on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ca.name: Collected Power
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ca.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip it with all Equip Cards on the field. If any of those Equip Cards is now equipped to an incorrect target, destroy that Equip Card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519d0.name: Combo Fighter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519d0.description: If a Chain (of 2 or more Links) occurred in your Main Phase 1, this card can attack twice during the Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519dd.name: Compulsory Evacuation Device
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519dd.description: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519f4.name: Constellar Kaus

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519f5.name: Constellar Leonis
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519f5.description: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Constellar" monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519fa.name: Constellar Praesepe
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519fa.description:
2 Level 4 "Constellar" monsters
Once per turn, during the Damage Step of either player's turn, when a "Constellar" monster you control is attacking or being attacked: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; that monster gains 1000 ATK, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ff.name: Constellar Sombre
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ff.description:
You can only use each effect of "Constellar Sombre" once per turn. While this card is in the Graveyard, if it was sent there this turn, you can Normal Summon 1 "Constellar" monster for 1 less Tribute.
You can banish 1 "Constellar" monster from your Graveyard, then target 1 "Constellar" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand, also, this card gains the following effect.
● This turn: You can activate this effect; Normal Summon 1 "Constellar" monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a04.name: Constellar Virgo
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a04.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 "Constellar" monster from your hand in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a1b.name: Copy Knight
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a1b.description: When a Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster is Normal Summoned to your side of the field: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster with the same name and Level as the Normal Summoned monster (Warrior-Type/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0). (This card is also still a Trap Card.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a21.name: Core Compression
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a21.description: Reveal 1 "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" in your hand and discard 1 "Koa'ki Meiru" monster to activate this card. Draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a23.name: Core Reinforcement
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a23.description: Select and Special Summon 1 "Koa'ki Meiru" monster from your Graveyard in Attack Position. When that monster is destroyed during your End Phase, the controller of this card takes damage equal to that monster's ATK. When this card is removed from the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a36.name: Counselor Lily
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a36.description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard for a Synchro Summon, you can pay 500 Life Points to have that Synchro Monster gain 1000 ATK until the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a51.name: Creeping Doom Manta
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a51.description: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a54.name: Crimson Blader
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a54.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Your opponent cannot Normal or Special Summon Level 5 or higher monsters during their next turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a6e.name: Crowned by the World Chalice
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a6e.description: With her magical staff, she can channel the living heart of her world to shield her people from the Mekk-Knights that have overrun it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a8a.name: Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a8a.description: When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon as many "Crystal Beast" Monster Cards as possible from your Spell & Trap Zones. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a8d.name: Crystal Blessing
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a8d.description: Target up to 2 "Crystal Beast" monsters in your Graveyard; place those targets face-up in your Spell & Trap Card Zone as Continuous Spell Cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a9a.name: Crystal Slicer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a9a.description: Send 1 'Crystal Beast' monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; halve the original ATK of that target, also your opponent draws 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aa0.name: Crystron Entry
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aa0.description: Special Summon 2 "Crystron" Tuners (1 from your hand and 1 from your Graveyard). During either player's turn, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 "Crystron" monster you control; send 1 "Crystron" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard whose Level is different from that monster, and if you do, that monster becomes the Level of that monster sent to the Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Crystron Entry" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aa7.name: Crystron Quariongandrax
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aa7.description:
2 or more Tuners + 1 non-Tuner monster
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target monsters your opponent controls and/or in their Graveyard, up to the number of Synchro Materials used for the Synchro Summon of this card; banish them. If this Synchro Summoned card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 banished monster, except this card; Special Summon it to your field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ac2.name: Curse of Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ac2.description: A wicked dragon that taps into dark forces to execute a powerful attack.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ac7.name: Curse of Royal
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ac7.description: Negate the activation and the effect of a Spell or Trap Card that includes the effect of destroying 1 Spell or Trap Card and destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b02.name: Cyber Repair Plant
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b02.description:
If "Cyber Dragon" is in your GY: You can activate 1 of these effects. If you have 3 or more "Cyber Dragon" in your GY at this card's activation, you can activate both effects and resolve in sequence. You can only activate 1 "Cyber Repair Plant" per turn.
● Add 1 LIGHT Machine monster from your Deck to your hand.
● Target 1 LIGHT Machine monster in your GY; shuffle that target into your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518e6.name: Cemetary Bomb
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518e6.description: Inflict 50 damage to your opponent for each card in their Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51949.name: Chirubimé, Princess of Autumn Leaves
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51949.description: Your opponent cannot target face-up Plant monsters for attacks, except this one. If this card in your possession is sent to your GY by your opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 Plant monster from your Deck, except "Chirubimé, Princess of Autumn Leaves".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5194b.name: Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5194b.description: When this card you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Yang Zing" monster from your Deck, except "Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing". When a "Yang Zing" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard, while this card is in your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do, banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51961.name: Chronomaly Golden Jet
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51961.description: Once per turn: You can increase the Levels of all "Chronomaly" monsters you currently control by 1.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51963.name: Chronomaly Mayan Machine
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51963.description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Machine-Type monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5196c.name: Chronomaly Technology
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5196c.description: Target 1 "Chronomaly" monster in your Graveyard; banish it, then look at the top 2 cards of your Deck, add 1 of them to your hand, and send the other to the Graveyard. You can only activate 1 "Chronomaly Technology" per turn. You cannot Special Summon any monsters during the turn you activate this card, except "Chronomaly" monsters.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5196d.name: Chronomaly Tula Guardian
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5196d.description: If there is a face-up Field Spell Card on the field, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only control 1 "Chronomaly Tula Guardian".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51984.name: Cipher Twin Raptor
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51984.description: If your opponent controls a face-up monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Cipher" monster from your hand or Deck, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Cipher" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Cipher Twin Raptor" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ac.name: Clown Zombie
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519ac.description: A clown revived by the powers of darkness. Its deadly dance has sent many monsters to their graves.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519d8.name: Commander of Swords
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519d8.description:
When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase: They reveal the card(s) they drew, then if any is a Spell/Trap Card, you apply 1 of these effects.
● Discard all cards they drew.
● Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card they control.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519e9.name: Conscription
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a519e9.description: Excavate the top card of your opponent's Deck, and if it is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, Special Summon it to your field. Otherwise, add that card to your opponent's hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a1f.name: Core Blast
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a1f.description: You can only activate this card's effect while you control a face-up "Koa'ki Meiru" monster. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if your opponent controls more monsters than you do, you can destroy a number of cards your opponent controls so that your opponent will control the same number of cards as you control monsters.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a2b.name: Cosmic Compass
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a2b.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon a number of "Compass Tokens" (Machine/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) up to the number of monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a45.name: Crashbug X
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a45.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Crashbug Z" from your Deck. You must control a face-up "Crashbug Y" to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a5b.name: Crimson Sentry
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a5b.description: At the end of your Battle Phase: You can Tribute this card, then return 1 monster destroyed by battle this turn in your Graveyard; place it on the bottom of your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a5e.name: Crop Circles
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a5e.description: Send any number of monsters from your side of the field to the Graveyard to activate this card. Select from your Deck 1 "Alien" monster whose Level is equal to the total Levels of the sent monsters, and Special Summon it. If you fail to find a monster to Special Summon, you take 2000 damage.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a64.name: Cross Porter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a64.description: You can send 1 monster you control to the Graveyard and Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster from your hand. When this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can add 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a88.name: Crystal Beast Cobalt Eagle
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a88.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up "Crystal Beast" card you control; return that target to the top of the Deck. If this face-up card is destroyed while it is in a Monster Card Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Card Zone as a Continuous Spell Card, instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a89.name: Crystal Beast Emerald Tortoise
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51a89.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster you control that attacked this turn; change that target to Defense Position. If this face-up card is destroyed while it is in a Monster Card Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Card Zone as a Continuous Spell Card, instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51acb.name: Cursed Armaments
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51acb.description: The equipped monster loses 600 ATK for each monster you control. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip it with this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ad1.name: Curtain of the Dark Ones
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ad1.description: A curtain that a spellcaster made, it is said to raise a dark power.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51af6.name: Cyber Kirin
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51af6.description: You can Tribute this card to make any effect damage you take this turn 0.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aff.name: Cyber Phoenix
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51aff.description: While this card is in Attack Position, negate any Spell/Trap effects that target 1 Machine monster you control (and no other cards). When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b00.name: Cyber Prima
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b00.description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Destroy all face-up Spell Cards on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518da.name: Celestia, Lightsworn Angel
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518da.description: When you Tribute Summon this card by Tributing a "Lightsworn" monster: You can send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the GY, then target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; destroy those targets.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518e0.name: Celestial Wolf Lord, Blue Sirius
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518e0.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 2400 ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ec.name: Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518ec.description:
You can Ritual Summon this card with "Rebirth of Nephthys". You can only use each of the following effects of "Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" once per turn.
● During your Main Phase: You can destroy "Nephthys" cards in your hand and/or face-up field, then destroy an equal number of monsters your opponent controls.
● During your next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card from the GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f9.name: Chain Healing
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a518f9.description: Gain 500 Life Points. If this card was activated as Chain Link 2 or 3, add this card to the Deck and shuffle it. If this card was activated as Chain Link 4 or higher, return this card to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51910.name: Chaos Burst
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51910.description: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: Tribute 1 monster, then target the attacking monster; destroy that target, then inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51941.name: Child's Play
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51941.description: Each time your opponent Summons a monster(s), gain 300 LP. Your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle while you have 10,000 or more LP.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5195b.name: Chronomaly City Babylon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5195b.description: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Chronomaly" monster from your Graveyard, then target 1 "Chronomaly" monster in your Graveyard with the same Level as the banished monster; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51969.name: Chronomaly Temple - Trilithon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51969.description: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Chronomaly" monsters: You can pay 500 LP; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Chronomaly" monster from your hand. If a "Chronomaly" or "Number" Xyz Monster you control would activate an effect by detaching material, you can send this card to the GY instead of 1 of those materials. You can only use each effect of "Chronomaly Temple - Trilithon" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51982.name: Cipher Soldier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51982.description: If this card battles a Warrior-Type monster, during damage calculation: This card gains 2000 ATK and DEF during that damage calculation only.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51992.name: Clear Wing Synchro Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51992.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, when another Level 5 or higher monster activates its effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. 60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b3f.description: Target 1 Cyberse monster you control; banish it, and if you do, add 1 Cyberse monster from your Deck to your hand, whose ATK is lower than that monster's original ATK. During your next Standby Phase, return that monster banished by this effect to the field, and it can attack directly that turn. You can only activate 1 "Cynet Backdoor" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b57.name: D - Time
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b57.description: When a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control leaves the field: Add 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand whose Level is less than or equal to that "Elemental HERO" monster's original Level.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b6d.name: D.D. Telepon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b6d.description: If this face-up card you control is banished: You can banish 1 Psychic-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck. Then, during your next Standby Phase, if this card is still banished: Special Summon that monster banished by this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b8b.name: D/D Swirl Slime
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b8b.description: If this card is in your hand: You can Fusion Summon 1 "D/D/D" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand as Fusion Materials, including this card. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "D/D" monster from your hand. You can only use each effect of "D/D Swirl Slime" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b97.name: D/D/D Flame High King Genghis
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b97.description:
1 Level 5 or higher "D/D" monster + 1 "D/D" monster
If another "D/D" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your field while you control this monster (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 "D/D" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "D/D/D Flame High King Genghis" once per turn. Once per your turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or its effect, is activated (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b9b.name: D/D/D Human Resources
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b9b.description: Shuffle 3 cards into the Deck (any combination of "D/D" monsters in your hand, field, or Graveyard, and/or "D/D" cards in your Pendulum Zone), then you can add 2 "D/D" monsters from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51be6.name: Dark Balter the Terrible
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51be6.description:
"Possessed Dark Soul" + "Frontier Wiseman"
A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. When a Normal Spell Card is activated, negate the effect by paying 1000 Life Points. The effect of an Effect Monster that this monster destroys as a result of battle is negated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bed.name: Dark Bug
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bed.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, select and Special Summon 1 Level 3 Tuner monster from your Graveyard. The effect(s) of that monster is negated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c02.name: Dark Desertapir
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c02.description: When this card is removed from play, you can select 1 Level 4 or lower Beast-Type monster in your Graveyard and Special Summon it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c0a.name: Dark Elf
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c0a.description: This card requires a cost of 1000 of your own Life Points to attack.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c13.name: Dark Flattop
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c13.description:
1 DARK Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Machine-Type monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 "Reactor" monster or "Flying Fortress SKY FIRE" in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target, ignoring its Summoning conditions. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Machine-Type monster from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c53.name: Dark Resonator
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c53.description: The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c58.name: Dark Sacrifice
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c58.description: When your opponent activates a card or effect that would destroy a card(s) on the field: Negate the effect, then send 1 Level 3 or lower DARK monster from your Deck to your GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c83.name: Darkfire Soldier #1
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c83.description: An explosive expert from a special elite force.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c8a.name: Darklord Contact
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c8a.description: Special Summon 1 "Darklord" monster from your GY in Defense Position. You can only activate 1 "Darklord Contact" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c8c.name: Darklord Desire
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c8c.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Fairy-Type monster. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; this card loses exactly 1000 ATK, and if it does, send that target to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c8f.name: Darklord Ixchel
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c8f.description: You can discard this card and 1 "Darklord" card; draw 2 cards. You can only use each effect of "Darklord Ixchel" once per turn. You can only Special Summon "Darklord Ixchel(s)" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b4d.name: Cu Chulainn the Awakened
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b4d.description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, Emblem of the Awakening. Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard. This card gains ATK equal to that Normal Monster's ATK, until the Standby Phase of your next turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b61.name: D.D. Crow
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b61.description: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b63.name: D.D. Destroyer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b63.description: When this card on the field is removed from play, you can select 1 face-up card your opponent controls and destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b6a.name: D.D. Seeker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b6a.description: (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster you control; banish it until the End Phase of the next turn. You can only use this effect of "D.D. Seeker" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b8e.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You can banish 2 "D/D" monsters from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card from your Pendulum Zone.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
During your opponent's turn, if this card is in your hand or Graveyard: You can target 2 face-up Spell/Trap Cards you control; you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Fiend-Type monsters, also destroy the targeted cards, and if you do, Special Summon this card (this is a Quick Effect). You can only use this effect of "D/D/D Chaos King Apocalypse" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b92.name: D/D/D Doom King Armageddon

----------------------------------------

Once per turn, if a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 of those monsters; this card gains ATK equal to that monster's original ATK until the end of this turn. This card cannot attack your opponent directly during the turn this effect is activated. Cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap effects that do not target this card.

2 Level 3 Fiend-Type monsters

If this card battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; make this card unable to be destroyed by that battle, destroy the opponent's monster that battled it after damage calculation, and if you do, inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ba5.name: D/D/D Supreme King Kaiser

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bad.name: DNA Transplant

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c52.description:
3 Level 5 monsters

● Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change its ATK to 0, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to that monster's original ATK.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, then you can Special Summon 1 Xyz Monster from your GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c74.name: Dark Verger
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c74.description: When a Plant-Type Tuner monster is Normal Summoned to your side of the field: You can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard in Attack Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b27.name: Cybernetic Zone
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b27.description: Select 1 face-up Machine-Type Fusion Monster you control and remove it from play until the End Phase of this turn. When that monster is returned to the field, double its ATK. During your next Standby Phase, destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b43.description: Tribute 1 Cyberse monster, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bb5.name: Daigusto Gulldos

1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Gusto" monsters

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bee.name: Dark Burning Attack
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bee.description: If you control a "Dark Magician Girl" monster: Destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bf1.name: Dark Cat with White Tail
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bf1.description: FLIP: Return 2 Monster Cards on your opponent's side of the field and 1 Monster Card on your side of the field to their owners' hands.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bf5.name: Dark City

When this face-down card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, your opponent selects and executes 1 of the following effects:
● Discard 1 random card in their hand.
● Select 1 monster on their side of the field and destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c56.name: Dark Ruler Ha Des
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c56.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with Fiend monsters you control.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ca0.name: Darksea Float
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ca0.description: When this card on the field is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard, the owner of this card draws 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b5e.name: D.D. Assailant
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b5e.description: After damage calculation, when this card is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster: Banish that monster, also banish this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b60.name: D.D. Crazy Beast
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b60.description: A monster that this card destroys as a result of battle is removed from play.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b6e.name: D.D. Trainer

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b71.name: D.D. Warrior
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b71.description: After damage calculation, when this card battles a monster: Banish that monster, also banish this card.
