60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c28.name: Dark Magic Expanded
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c28.description:
Apply these effects in sequence, based on the number of "Dark Magician" and/or "Dark Magician Girl" on the field and in the GYs.
● 1+: 1 DARK Spellcaster monster on the field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.
● 2+: This turn, your opponent cannot activate cards and effects in response to your Spell/Trap Card or effect activation, also Spells/Traps you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.
● 3+: DARK Spellcaster monsters you currently control are unaffected by your opponent's card effects, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c2b.name: Dark Magic Veil
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c2b.description: Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 DARK Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand or Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c37.name: Dark Magician Girl
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c37.description: Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in the GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c43.name: Dark Mimic LV1
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c43.description:
FLIP: Draw 1 card.
Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Mimic LV3" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c44.name: Dark Mimic LV3
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c44.description: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Draw 1 card, but if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Mimic LV1", draw 2 cards instead.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c69.name: Dark Spirit Art - Greed
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c69.description: Tribute 1 DARK monster. Draw 2 cards. Your opponent can negate this effect by revealing 1 Spell Card in their hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c6e.name: Dark Strike Fighter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c6e.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
During your Main Phase 1: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to the Tributed monster's Level on the field x 100. You can only use this effect of "Dark Strike Fighter" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c88.name: Darklord Amdusc
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c88.description: You can discard this card and 1 "Darklord" card, then target 1 "Darklord" card in your Graveyard; add it to your hand. During either player's turn: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 "Darklord" Spell/Trap Card in your Graveyard; apply that target's effect, then shuffle that target into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Darklord Amdusc" once per turn. You can only Special Summon "Darklord Amdusc(s)" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c96.name: Darklord Superbia
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c96.description: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: You can target 1 Fairy-Type monster in your Graveyard, except "Darklord Superbia"; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c9b.name: Darkness Approaches
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c9b.description: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Select 1 face-up monster and change it to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ca8.name: Datacorn
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ca8.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Data Acorn Token" (Cyberse/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). You can only use this effect of "Datacorn" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ca9.name: Dawn Knight
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ca9.description: If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can send 1 LIGHT monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. If this card is sent from your Deck to the Graveyard: Target 1 LIGHT monster in your Graveyard; place that target on the top of your Deck. You can only use 1 "Dawn Knight" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51caf.name: De-Spell
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51caf.description: Target 1 face-up Spell, or 1 Set Spell/Trap, on the field; destroy that target if it is a Spell. (If the target is Set, reveal it.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b14.name: Cyberdark Claw
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b14.description:
If this card is sent to the GY while equipped to a monster: You can target 1 "Cyberdark" monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Cyberdark Claw" once per turn.
● You can discard this card; add 1 "Cyberdark" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.
● During damage calculation, if a monster equipped with this card battles: You can send 1 monster from your Extra Deck to the GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b1e.name: Cyberdarkness Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b1e.description:
5 "Cyberdark" Effect Monsters
Must first be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Special Summoned: You can equip 1 Dragon or Machine monster from your GY to this card. Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Equip Card you control to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b21.name: Cybernetic Fusion Support
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b21.description: Pay half your LP; once, if you Fusion Summon a Machine Fusion Monster this turn, you can banish monsters from your hand, field, and/or GY as the Fusion Materials. You can only activate 1 "Cybernetic Fusion Support" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b36.name: Cyberse Witch
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b36.description:
2 Cyberse monsters
If a monster is Special Summoned to a zone this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can banish 1 Spell from your GY; add 1 Cyberse Ritual Monster and 1 "Cynet Ritual" from your Deck to your hand. During your Main Phase, if this effect was activated this turn: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Cyberse Witch" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b37.name: Cyberse Wizard
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b37.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 Attack Position opponent's monster; change it to Defense Position, and if you do, for the rest of this turn, your monsters cannot attack, except to attack that monster, and if your Cyberse monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b38.name: Cyborg Doctor
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b38.description: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 Tuner monster you control to Special Summon a monster from your Graveyard with the same Attribute and Level as the Tributed monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b3a.name: Cycle of the World
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b3a.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Ruin, Queen of Oblivion" or "Demise, King of Armageddon". You must also Tribute monsters from your field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can shuffle this card into the Deck; add 1 "End of the World" from your Deck to your hand, then, you can add 1 "Ruin, Queen of Oblivion" or "Demise, King of Armageddon" from your GY to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b68.name: D.D. Patrol Plane
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b68.description: During the End Phase, if this card is currently banished, and was banished this turn: You can banish 1 card from your hand, field, or GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card in Attack Position. You can only use this effect of "D.D. Patrol Plane" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b74.name: D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b74.description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 of your banished monsters; Special Summon it in Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ba7.name: D/D/D Wave King Caesar
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ba7.description:
2 Level 4 Fiend-Type monsters
During either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; at the end of the Battle Phase, Special Summon from your Graveyard as many monsters destroyed this turn as possible, but during the next Standby Phase, take 500 damage for each monster Special Summoned by this effect. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Dark Contract" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "D/D/D Wave King Caesar" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bdc.name: Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bdc.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card and choose a number from 1 to 3, then send that many cards from the top of your Deck to the GY; until the end of this turn, this card gains 500 ATK for each card sent to the GY this way. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 "Burning Abyss" card in your GY, except this card; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51be3.name: Dark Armed, the Dragon of Annihilation
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51be3.description:
2+ Level 7 monsters
Once per turn, if you have exactly 5 DARK monsters in your GY, you can also Xyz Summon "Dark Armed, the Dragon of Annihilation" by using 1 Level 5 or higher DARK Dragon monster you control as material. You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it, then banish 1 card from your GY, also, this card cannot attack for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51be8.name: Dark Beckoning Beast
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51be8.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", OR 1 card that specifically lists any of those cards in its text, from your Deck to your hand, except "Dark Beckoning Beast". You can only use this effect of "Dark Beckoning Beast" once per turn. During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 Fiend monster with 0 ATK/DEF in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bf3.name: Dark Cavalry
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bf3.description:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Warrior monster
Gains 100 ATK for each Spell/Trap on the field and in the GYs. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. When a card or effect is activated that targets a card on the field (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bfb.name: Dark Contract with the Swamp King
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bfb.description: During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Fiend-Type Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Materials. You can only use this effect of "Dark Contract with the Swamp King" once per turn. If Summoning a "D/D" Fusion Monster this way, you can also banish monsters from your Graveyard as Fusion Material. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c16.name: Dark General Freed
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c16.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Negate any Spell effects that target a face-up DARK monster(s) you control, and if you do, destroy that Spell Card. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add 1 Level 4 DARK monster from your Deck to your hand. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c1a.name: Dark Hole
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c1a.description: Destroy all monsters on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c26.name: Dark Magic Attack
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c26.description: If you control "Dark Magician": Destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c29.name: Dark Magic Inheritance
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c29.description: Banish 2 Spells from your GY; add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, that specifically lists the card "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" in its text, except "Dark Magic Inheritance". You can only activate 1 "Dark Magic Inheritance" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c39.name: Dark Magician Girl
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c39.description: Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in the GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c4a.name: Dark Paladin
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c4a.description:
"Dark Magician" + "Buster Blader"
Must be Fusion Summoned. When a Spell Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster on the field and in the GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c76.name: Dark Witch
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c76.description: A popular creature in mythology that delivers fatal attacks with a sharp spear.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c7e.name: Darkbishop Archfiend
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c7e.description: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When an Archfiend Monster Card on your side of the field is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 1, 3, or 6, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cab.name: Dawnbreak Gardna
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cab.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● The original DEF of this card becomes 2300.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b10.name: Cyber-Stein
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b10.description: You can pay 5000 LP; Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck in Attack Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b3b.name: Cyclon Laser
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b3b.description: You can only equip this card to "Gradius". Increase the ATK of "Gradius" by 300 points. When the equipped "Gradius" attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b3c.name: Cyclone Blade
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b3c.description: Equip only to a "Destiny HERO" monster. At the end of the Damage Step, if the equipped monster attacked: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b59.name: D-Boyz
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b59.description: FLIP: You can Special Summon any number of "D-Boyz" from your Deck in face-up Attack Position, then you take 1000 damage for each monster Special Summoned by this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b5b.name: D. Human
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b5b.description: Gifted with the power of dragons, this warrior wields a sword created from a dragon's fang.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b66.name: D.D. Guide
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b66.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, give control of it to your opponent. During each player's End Phase, your opponent selects 1 card from the Graveyard of this card's controller and removes it from play.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b88.name: D/D Savant Newton
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b88.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except "D/D" monsters. This effect cannot be negated. Once, while this card is in your Pendulum Zone, you can negate an activated Trap effect that would inflict damage to you, then destroy this card.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
You can discard this card, then target 1 "D/D" or "Dark Contract" card in your Graveyard, except "D/D Savant Newton"; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "D/D Savant Newton" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b8f.name: D/D/D Contract Change

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b94.name: D/D/D Dragonbane King Beowulf
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b94.description:
1 "D/D/D" monster + 1 "D/D" monster
If a "D/D" monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can destroy all cards in the Spell & Trap Zones.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b9a.name: D/D/D Gust King Alexander
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b9a.description:
1 "D/D" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If another "D/D" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your field, while you control this face-up card (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "D/D" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "D/D/D Gust King Alexander" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ba4.name: D/D/D Supersight King Zero Maxwell
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ba4.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; change its DEF to 0 until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field). You can only use this effect of "D/D/D Supersight King Zero Maxwell" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
Before damage calculation, if this card attacked an opponent's Defense Position monster: You can change the DEF of the opponent's monster to 0 until the end of the Damage Step. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bb2.name: Daigusto Eguls
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bb2.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Gusto" monsters
Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can banish 1 WIND monster from your Graveyard to target 1 face-down card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51be2.name: Dark Armed Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51be2.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 3 DARK monsters in your GY. You can banish 1 DARK monster from your GY, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bfd.name: Dark Contract with the Yamimakai
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bfd.description:
Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 500 damage.
You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Dark Contract with the Yamimakai" per turn, and only once that turn.
● During your Main Phase: You can target 1 "D/D" Pendulum Monster in your Graveyard; place it in your Pendulum Zone.
● During your Main Phase: You can place 1 face-up "D/D" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck in your Pendulum Zone.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c00.name: Dark Cure
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c00.description: When your opponent Summons a monster(s), they gain Life Points equal to half the ATK of 1 of the Summoned monsters of your choice.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c14.name: Dark Fusion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c14.description: Fusion Summon 1 Fiend Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. Your opponent cannot target it with card effects this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c1e.name: Dark Hunter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c1e.description: This card's effect changes depending on the number of DARK monsters in your Graveyard. ● 1 or fewer: This card loses 400 ATK. ● 2 to 4: This card gains 400 ATK. ● 5 or more: You can send this card to the Graveyard to destroy all face-down monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c4d.name: Dark Rabbit
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c4d.description: He leaps up, down, and all around! Nobody can lay a hand on this funny bunny.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c5d.name: Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c5d.description:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.
● Send the top 2 cards of their Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ca2.name: Darkstorm Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ca2.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card you control to the Graveyard; destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cad.name: Daybreaker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cad.description: When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Daybreaker" from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cb1.name: Deal of Phantom
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cb1.description: Select 1 face-up monster on the field. Increase the selected monster's ATK by 100 points for each monster in your Graveyard during the turn this card is activated. The number of monsters is applied when this card is activated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b12.name: Cyberdark Cannon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b12.description:
If this card is sent to the GY while equipped to a monster: You can draw 1 card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Cyberdark Cannon" once per turn.
● You can discard this card; add 1 Machine "Cyberdark" monster from your Deck to your hand.
● During damage calculation, if a monster equipped with this card battles: You can send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b48.name: Cynet Refresh
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b48.description: When an opponent's Cyberse monster declares an attack: Destroy all monsters in the Main Monster Zones. During the End Phase of this turn, Special Summon from the GY as many Cyberse Link Monsters as possible, to their owner's fields, that were destroyed by this effect. When an opponent's monster activates its effect: You can banish this card from your GY; Cyberse Link Monsters you currently control are unaffected by card effects, except their own, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b77.name: D/D Cerberus
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51b77.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 "D/D" monster you control; change its Level to 4, and if you do, it gains 400 ATK and DEF (even if this card leaves the field).
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
When this card is Pendulum Summoned from the hand, while you control a "D/D" monster other than "D/D Cerberus": You can target 1 Continuous Spell Card in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bc6.name: Dancing Elf
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bc6.description: An elf that dances across the sky with wings of razor-sharp blades.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bdd.name: Dark Advance
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bdd.description: During either player's Main Phase or Battle Phase: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF; add it to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Tribute Summon 1 monster with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF in face-up Attack Position. You can only activate 1 "Dark Advance" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bdf.name: Dark Angel
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51bdf.description: When your Fairy monster is targeted for an attack: You can Tribute it and send this card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster you control; change the attack target to your targeted monster, and if you do, it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c2a.name: Dark Magic Twin Burst
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c2a.description: Target 1 "Dark Magician" you control; it gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of all "Dark Magician Girl" currently on the field and in the GYs, until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Dark Magic Twin Burst" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c47.name: Dark Nephthys
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c47.description: If you have 3 or more DARK monsters in your Graveyard and this card in your hand: You can banish 2 of them from your Graveyard; send this card from your hand to the Graveyard. During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent to the Graveyard by this effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c61.name: Dark Scorpion Burglars
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c61.description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Your opponent sends 1 Spell Card from their Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c73.name: Dark Valkyria
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51c73.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● Once, while this card is face-up on the field: You can place 1 Spell Counter on it. This card gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d78.description: A subspecies found in electronic space. There's little information on it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d8a.name: Dimension Wanderer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d8a.description: When a monster is banished by the effect of "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon": You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; inflict 1500 damage to your opponent. You can only use the effect of "Dimension Wanderer" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d8b.name: Dimensional Alchemist
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d8b.description: Once per turn, you can activate this effect to remove from play the top card of your Deck and give this card 500 ATK until the End Phase. When this card is destroyed and sent from your side of the field to your Graveyard, you can select 1 of your removed from play monsters and return it to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d97.name: Dinomist Brachion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d97.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once, while this card is in your Pendulum Zone, you can negate an activated card effect that targets another "Dinomist" card(s) you control, then destroy this card.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If you do not control "Dinomist Brachion" in your Monster Zone and your opponent controls a monster that has the highest ATK on the field (even if it's tied), you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d98.name: Dinomist Ceratops
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d98.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If another "Dinomist" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, you can destroy this card instead.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If all monsters you control are "Dinomist" monsters (min. 1), and none are "Dinomist Ceratops", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51daf.name: Dinowrestler Rambrachio
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51daf.description: When your "Dinowrestler" monster inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Dinowrestler Rambrachio" once per turn. Your opponent cannot target other "Dinowrestler" monsters you control with card effects.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51db5.name: Disappear
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51db5.description: Remove from play 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51db8.name: Disc Fighter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51db8.description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster with DEF 2000 or more, destroy the monster with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dc5.name: Divine Dragon - Excelion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dc5.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, it gets 1 of the following effects for each "Divine Dragon - Excelion" in your Graveyard when this effect resolves (your choice). These effects cannot accumulate. ● This card gains 1000 ATK. ● If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row. ● When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dcc.name: Divine Grace - Northwemko
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dcc.description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Ritual of Grace". When this card is Ritual Summoned, select a number of face-up cards on the field (except this card), up to the number of monsters you used for the Ritual Summon. While any of the selected cards are face-up on the field, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51de5.name: Dododo Buster
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51de5.description: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way, its Level becomes 4. When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 "Dododo" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Defense Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dff.name: Dokurorider
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dff.description: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Revival of Dokurorider". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e0a.name: Don Zaloog

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e2a.name: Double Fin Shark
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e2a.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 3 or 4 WATER Fish-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position, but it has its effects negated. You cannot Special Summon any monsters during the turn you activate this effect, except WATER monsters.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e58.name: Dragon Laser
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e58.description: Send 1 "Trigon" equipped to a face-up "Delta Tri" you control to the Graveyard, and destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cc2.name: Deep Sea Aria
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cc2.description: Banish 1 WATER monster from your GY; add 1 Level 4 or lower Sea Serpent monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Deep Sea Aria" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cd2.name: Defender of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cd2.description: While you control another face-up "Ice Barrier" monster, monsters your opponent controls cannot declare an attack if their ATK is greater than or equal to this card's DEF.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cda.name: Defrag Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cda.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by sending 1 other monster from your hand to the GY. You can only Special Summon "Defrag Dragon" once per turn this way. If this card is in the GY: You can banish 3 monsters from your GY with the same name, except "Defrag Dragon"; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Defrag Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce1.name: Delta Attacker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce1.description: You can only activate this card while there are 3 Normal Monsters of the same name (except Tokens) on your side of the field. The 3 Normal Monsters of the same name can attack your opponent's Life Points directly during the turn this card is activated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce4.name: Delta The Magnet Warrior
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce4.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 Level 4 or lower "Magnet Warrior" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can banish 3 Level 4 or lower "Magnet Warrior" monsters from your Graveyard, except "Delta The Magnet Warrior"; Special Summon 1 "Valkyrion the Magna Warrior" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only use each effect of "Delta The Magnet Warrior" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce8.name: Demise, King of Armageddon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce8.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "End of the World". You can pay 2000 LP; destroy all other cards on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d0a.name: Deskbot Base
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d0a.description: All "Deskbot" monsters on the field gain 500 ATK and DEF. Once per turn: You can reveal any number of "Deskbot" cards in your hand and shuffle them into the Deck, then draw the same number of cards. You can banish 9 "Deskbot" cards with different names from your field and/or Graveyard, except "Deskbot Base"; shuffle all cards from your opponent's hand, field and Graveyard into the Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d1a.name: Destiny HERO - Blade Master
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d1a.description: During your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; all "Destiny HERO" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d25.name: Destiny HERO - Dogma
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d25.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters, including at least 1 "Destiny HERO" monster. Once per turn, if you still control this face-up card during your opponent's next Standby Phase after you Special Summoned it this way: Halve your opponent's LP.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d2e.name: Destiny HERO - Dunker
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d2e.description: You can send 1 "Destiny HERO" card from your hand to the Graveyard; inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d41.name: Destruction Sword Memories
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d41.description: Discard 1 "Destruction Sword" card; Special Summon 1 "Buster Blader" monster from the Deck. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Fusion Summon 1 "Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman" from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d44.name: Destructive Draw
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d44.description: If either player has no cards in their hand at the start of their Draw Phase, they can draw 1 more card in addition to their normal draw. This card's controller loses 700 Life Points during their End Phase. (If less than 700, they become 0 instead.) When this face-up card is removed from the field, inflict 3000 damage to the player who controlled it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d5f.name: Dice Re-Roll
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d5f.description: One time, during the rest of this turn, if either player(s) rolls a die (or dice), you can have the player(s) re-roll. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d7a.name: Dillingerous Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d7a.description:
2 DARK Dragon monsters
Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can target 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls that did not declare an attack this turn; destroy it, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that monster's original ATK. If a "Rokket" monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Dillingerous Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d83.name: Dimension Jar
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d83.description: FLIP: Both players can remove from play up to 3 monsters from their opponent's Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d94.name: Dinomic Powerload
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d94.description: All "Dinomist" monsters on the field gain 300 ATK and DEF. If a "Dinomist" monster you control battles, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d9c.name: Dinomist Pteran
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d9c.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If another "Dinomist" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, you can destroy this card instead.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can add 1 "Dinomist" card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dbd.name: Disenchanter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dbd.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Spell on the field; remove 1 Spell Counter from anywhere on the field, and if you do, return that target to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dcf.name: Divine Relic Mjollnir
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dcf.description: Target 1 "Aesir" monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51de7.name: Dododo Swordsman
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51de7.description: While this Flip Summoned card is face-up on the field, it gains 3500 ATK. When this card is flipped face-up: You can target up to 2 face-up monsters on the field; destroy them.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51deb.name: Dodododwarf Gogogoglove
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51deb.description: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Zubaba" or "Gagaga" monster from your hand. If you control a "Gogogo" or "Dododo" monster except "Dodododwarf Gogogoglove", while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Dodododwarf Gogogoglove" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e0b.name: Donpa, Marksman Fur Hire
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e0b.description: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 monster "Fur Hire" from your hand, except "Donpa, Marksman Fur Hire". If a monster "Fur Hire" is Special Summoned to your field while you control this monster (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Donpa, Marksman Fur Hire" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e4a.name: Dracoon Lamp
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e4a.description: Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Wyrm monster; this card gains 1000 DEF until the end of this turn. Once per battle, during damage calculation, if this Attack Position card battles an Attack Position monster (Quick Effect): You can apply each card's DEF for damage calculation.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cd0.name: Defect Compiler
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cd0.description: Once per turn, if you would take damage from an opponent's card effect, place 1 Defect Counter on this card instead (max. 1). Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can remove 1 Defect Counter from this card, then target 1 Cyberse monster you control; it gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cdd.name: Degrade Buster
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cdd.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 Cyberse monsters from your GY. You can target 1 monster your opponent controls with higher ATK than this card (Quick Effect); banish it until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Degrade Buster" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce2.name: Delta Crow - Anti Reverse
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce2.description: If you control a "Blackwing" monster: Destroy all face-down Spells and Traps your opponent controls. If you control exactly 3 "Blackwing" monsters, you can activate this card from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d06.name: Deskbot 006
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d06.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except "Deskbot" monsters. This effect cannot be negated.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster on the field; change its battle position. This card gain 500 ATK for each face-up "Deskbot" monster in your Extra Deck. If this card in the Pendulum Zone is destroyed: You can target 1 "Deskbot" card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Deskbot 006" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d0e.name: Desperado Barrel Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d0e.description: If a face-up DARK Machine monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can toss a coin 3 times; destroy face-up monsters on the field, up to the number of heads, then if the result was 3 heads, draw 1 card. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Level 7 or lower monster that has a coin tossing effect, from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d32.name: Destiny HERO - Fear Monger
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d32.description: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard because it was destroyed by battle and sent there since your last Standby Phase: Target 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your Graveyard, except a "Destiny HERO - Fear Monger"; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d37.name: Destiny Signal
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d37.description: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Destiny HERO" monster from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d48.name: Detonate Deleter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d48.description:
2+ Cyberse monsters
Once per turn, at the start of the Damage Step, when this card battles a face-up monster that is not a Link-3 or higher Link Monster: You can destroy that monster. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster this card points to, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d4a.name: Deus X-Krawler
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d4a.description: When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets this face-down monster (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-up Defense Position; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. After this card was flipped face-up, while it is in the Monster Zone, negate all monster effects activated on your opponent's field. If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can add, from your Deck to your hand, 1 Level 9 monster with a different original Type and Attribute than this card. You can only use this effect of "Deus X-Krawler" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d5b.name: Diana the Light Spirit
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d5b.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT monster from your GY. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Gain 1000 LP.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d64.name: Dicelops
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d64.description:
Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die, then apply the result.
● 1: Look at your opponent's hand, also discard 1 card from their hand.
● 2, 3, 4, 5: Discard 1 card.
● 6: Discard your entire hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d76.name: Digital Bug Scaradiator
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d76.description:
2 or more Level 3 LIGHT Insect-Type monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 2 Xyz Materials from this card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; change its battle position, and if you do, it has its effects negated until the end of this turn. Once per turn, when this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can attach that destroyed monster to this card as Xyz Material.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d79.name: Digvorzhak, King of Heavy Industry
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d79.description:
3 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; send the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck to the GY, then, if any monsters were sent to the GY by this effect, destroy cards your opponent controls, up to the number of monsters sent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d7b.name: Dimension Distortion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d7b.description: You can only activate this card if there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 removed from play monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d87.name: Dimension Slice
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d87.description: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your side of the field (except during the Damage Step): Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; banish that target. If the Summon is an Xyz Summon, you can activate this card the turn it was Set.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d8f.name: Dimensional Prison
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d8f.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target that attacking monster; banish that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d9a.name: Dinomist Eruption
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d9a.description: If a "Dinomist" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: Target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dc2.name: Disturbance Strategy
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dc2.description: Your opponent shuffles their entire hand into the Deck, then draws the same number of cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dc7.name: Divine Dragon Aquabizarre
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dc7.description: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 other face-up WATER monster and select 1 Continuous or Field Spell Card in your Graveyard to return it to the top of your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dfb.name: Dogu
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dfb.description: During the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was sent there by an opponent's card effect this turn while in your possession: You can add, from your Deck to your hand, 1 monster with a different Level from the monsters you control and the monsters in your Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Dogu" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e03.name: Doll Monster Bear-Bear
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e03.description:
''Even if we get so roughed up we nearly break, it's okay.
Grandpa Demetto will fix us right up!''

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e14.name: Doomkaiser Dragon/Assault Mode
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e14.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Assault Mode Activate". When this card is Special Summoned, Special Summon any number of Zombie-Type monsters from either player's Graveyard(s) to your side of the field. Those monsters' effects are negated, and they are destroyed during the End Phase this turn. When this card on the field is destroyed, you can Special Summon 1 "Doomkaiser Dragon" from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e16.name: Doomsday Horror
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e16.description: This card's ATK and DEF are equal to the number of banished DARK monsters x 300. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Return all banished DARK monsters to the Graveyards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e1a.name: Dora of Fate
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e1a.description: You can only activate this card during your opponent's turn. Select 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field. When you Normal Summon a monster that is 1 Level lower than the selected monster during your next turn, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the Level of the selected monster x 250 points.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e29.name: Double Exposure
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e29.description: You can target 2 Level 6 or lower monsters on the field with the same name; double their Levels. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can target 1 "Cipher" monster you control; the name of 1 other face-up monster on the field becomes the targeted "Cipher" monster's name until the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "Double Exposure" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e4f.name: Dragodies, the Empowered Warrior
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e4f.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
At the start of the Damage Step, if a monster you control battles an opponent's face-up monster: You can discard 1 card; the opponent's battling monster's ATK and DEF become half its current ATK and DEF (even if this card leaves the field).
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card in its owner's Monster Zone is destroyed by your opponent's attack or card effect: You can add 1 Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster with 2000 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand, except "Dragodies, the Empowered Warrior", during the End Phase of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e55.name: Dragon Ice
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e55.description: When your opponent Special Summons a monster (except during the Damage Step): You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your hand or Graveyard. There can only be 1 "Dragon Ice" on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cbf.name: Dedication through Light and Darkness
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cbf.description: Tribute 1 "Dark Magician"; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician of Chaos" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce9.name: Demise, Supreme King of Armageddon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ce9.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Cycle of the World". This card's name becomes "Demise, King of Armageddon" while in the hand or on the field. While this Ritual Summoned card is on the field, your Ritual Monsters cannot be destroyed by battle. If all monsters used to Ritual Summon this card were Ritual Monsters, you do not pay LP to activate its effects. Once per turn: You can pay 2000 LP; destroy as many other cards on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each destroyed card they controlled.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cfc.name: Desert Protector
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cfc.description: This card gains 300 DEF for each Spell and Trap Card on the field. If an Insect-Type monster you control would be destroyed, you can destroy this card instead.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cfe.name: Desert Twister
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cfe.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 WIND and 1 EARTH monsters from your GY. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d08.name: Deskbot 008
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d08.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except "Deskbot" monsters. This effect cannot be negated.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
This card gains 500 ATK for each "Deskbot" card in your Graveyard. Your opponent cannot target face-up "Deskbot" cards with card effects, except this one. This card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d36.description: When a "Destiny HERO" monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon, to your side of the field, all "Destiny HERO" monsters that were destroyed and sent to either Graveyard this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d56.name: Diamond Dust
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d56.description: Destroy as many WATER monsters on the field as possible, then inflict 250 damage to your opponent for each WATER monster destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d5d.name: Dice It
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d5d.description:
Roll a six-sided die. Apply this effect, depending on whose turn it is.
● During your turn: Banish cards from your GY equal to the result. Then, if the result was 1, send 6 cards from the top of your Deck to the GY.
● During your opponent's turn: Send cards from the top of your Deck to the GY equal to the result. Then, if the result was 6, banish 1 card from your GY.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d73.name: Digital Bug LEDybug

Cannot be used as an Xyz Material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of an Insect monster. Once per turn, when this face-up card is changed from Attack Position to Defense Position: You can add 1 Level 3 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as Xyz Material gains this effect.
● When this card destroys a monster by battle, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d75.name: Digital Bug Rhinosebus
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d75.description:
2 or more Level 7 LIGHT Insect-Type monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by detaching 2 Xyz Materials from a Rank 5 or 6 Insect-Type Xyz Monster you control, then using that Xyz Monster as the Xyz Material. (Xyz Materials attached to that monster also become Xyz Materials on this card.) If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy the face-up monster(s) your opponent controls with the highest DEF (all, if tied).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ddf.name: DoSolfachord Cutia
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ddf.description:

You can only use this effect of "DoSolfachord Cutia" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e1c.name: Doriado's Blessing

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e21.name: Dotscaper
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e21.description: If this card is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is banished: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use 1 "Dotscaper" effect per turn, and only once that turn. You can only use each effect of "Dotscaper" once per Duel.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e28.name: Double Evolution Pill
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e28.description: Banish 1 Dinosaur monster and 1 non-Dinosaur monster from your hand and/or GY; Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Dinosaur monster from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only activate 1 "Double Evolution Pill" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e49.name: Draconnet
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e49.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Normal Monster from your hand or Deck in Defense Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e52.name: Dragon Core Hexer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e52.description: Many years of dragonslaying have bathed this huntress in countless amounts of blood. Each drop gave her more power, but at a terrible price, as her cursed body now spreads the dragontaint like an epidemic. No village will take her in, and she no longer even remembers what inspired her crusade in the first place.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cce.name: Deepsea Warrior
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cce.description: As long as "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d2c.name: Destiny HERO - Dreamer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d2c.description: During damage calculation, if your "Destiny HERO" monster battles and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do, your monster cannot be destroyed by that battle, also you take no battle damage from that battle. 60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d43.name: Destruction of Destiny
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d43.description: Send 3 cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard, and take 1000 damage for each Spell or Trap Card sent to the Graveyard this way.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d49.name: Detonator Circle "A"
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d49.description: Destroy 1 face-up monster with an A-Counter(s), and then inflict 500 damage to each player.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d4d.name: Dewloren, Tiger King of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d4d.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner WATER monsters
Once per turn, you can return any number of face-up cards you control to the owner's hand. For each card returned to the owner's hand by this effect, this card gains 500 ATK until the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d58.name: Diamond-Dust Cyclone
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d58.description: Select 1 monster with 4 or more Fog Counters. Destroy it and then draw 1 card for every 4 Fog Counters that were on it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d59.name: Dian Keto the Cure Master
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d59.description: Increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

2 Level 8 monsters

If a card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead. If this card is Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Send 1 card your opponent controls to the GY.
● Attach 1 of your banished Machine monsters to this card as material.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d9d.name: Dinomist Rex
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d9d.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once, while this card is in your Pendulum Zone, you can negate an activated card effect that targets another "Dinomist" card (s) you control, then destroy this card.

----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: You can Tribute 1 other "Dinomist" monster, then activate 1 of these effects;
● This card can attack an opponent's monster again in a row, also, if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.
● Shuffle 1 card from your opponent's hand (at random) or field into the Deck, then this card gains 100 ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51db9.name: Disciple of Nephthys
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51db9.description: During your Main Phase: You can destroy 1 card in your hand, and if you do, add 1 "Nephthys" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Disciple of Nephthys". You can only use each effect of "Disciple of Nephthys" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dc1.name: Dissolverock
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dc1.description: A monster born in the lava pits, it generates intense heat that can melt away its enemies.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51de0.name: Doble Passe

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e1d.name: Doron
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e1d.description: This monster splits in two and attacks from opposite sides.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e23.name: Double Cipher

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e3c.name: Double-Edged Sword Technique

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e56.name: Dragon Knight Draco-Equiste

1 Dragon-Type Synchro Monster + 1 Warrior-Type monster
Must first be Fusion Summoned. Once per turn: You can target 1 Dragon-Type Synchro Monster in the Graveyard; banish that target, and if you do, until the End Phase, this card's name becomes that monster's, and replace this effect with that monster's original effects. While this card is in Attack Position, your opponent takes any effect damage you would have taken from their card effects, instead.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e5b.name: Dragon Mastery
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e5b.description: Each monster you control that is equipped with a "Dragunity" monster(s) gains 500 ATK. Once per turn, you can select 1 face-up monster you control, and equip it with 1 Dragon-Type "Dragunity" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cc4.name: Deep Sea Diva

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cc7.name: Deep Sea Repetiteur
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51cc7.description:
"Deep Sea Diva" + 1+ non-Tuner monsters

You can only use this effect of "Deep Sea Repetiteur" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ccf.name: Defcon Bird
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ccf.description: You can discard 1 other Cyberse monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Defcon Bird" once per turn. Once per turn, when your Cyberse monster is targeted for an attack: You can make its ATK/DEF become double its original ATK, then you can change it to Defense Position. This ATK/DEF change lasts until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d1e.description: If you have 3 or more "Destiny HERO" monsters in your GY: You can discard this card, then target 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your opponent's field in Defense Position. When a Spell Card or effect you activate resolves, negate that effect, and if you do, or if it did not have an effect, destroy that card. During your Standby Phase: You can banish this card and 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your GY; each player chooses 1 Normal Spell from their Deck, and places it on top of their Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51dd6.name: Djinn Cursenchanter of Rituals

● You can target 1 "Deskbot" card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Deskbot" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51d51.name: Dharma-Eye Magician

If the targeted monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e33.name: Double Snare

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51e4d.description:
