60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fe3.name: Enchanting Fitting Room
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fe3.description: Pay 800 LP; excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck and Special Summon all excavated Level 3 or lower Normal Monsters, also, after that, shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff2.name: Enishi, Shien's Chancellor
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff2.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 "Six Samurai" monsters from your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster; destroy that target. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5200b.name: Eternal Rest
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5200b.description: Destroy all monsters equipped with Equip Cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52018.name: Evigishki Soul Ogre
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52018.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Gishki" Ritual Spell Card. Once per turn: You can discard 1 "Gishki" monster to target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; shuffle that target into the Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52022.name: Evil Eye Repose
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52022.description: When you activate this card: You can banish 1 "Evil Eye" card from your GY; draw 1 card. Once per turn, after damage calculation, if your "Evil Eye" monster equipped with "Evil Eye of Selene" attacked an opponent's monster: You can banish that opponent's monster. If this card in the Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed by card effect: You can target up to 3 of your banished "Evil Eye" cards; return them to the GY. You can only activate 1 "Evil Eye Repose" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5202d.name: Evil HERO Malicious Bane
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5202d.description:
1 "Evil HERO" monster + 1 Level 5 or higher monster
Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion". Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. During your Main Phase: You can destroy all monsters your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to this card's, also this card gains 200 ATK for each monster destroyed this way, also you cannot declare an attack for the rest of this turn, except with "HERO" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Evil HERO Malicious Bane" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52034.name: Evilswarm Azzathoth
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52034.description: FLIP: Target 1 Special Summoned monster on the field; shuffle that target into the Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52056.name: Evocator Chevalier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52056.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● You can send 1 face-up Equip Card you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52067.name: Evoltile Westlo
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52067.description: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Evolsaur" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52086.name: Exterio's Fang
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52086.description: Activate only if you control a face-up "Naturia" monster and have at least 1 card in your hand. Negate the activation of an opponent's Spell/Trap Card and destroy it. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f04.name: Dverg of the Nordic Alfar
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f04.description: After you Normal Summon this card, you can Normal Summon 1 "Nordic" monster during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) If this face-up card on the field is sent to the GY: Target 1 "Nordic Relic" card in your GY; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51efa.name: Dungeon Worm
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51efa.description: Hidden under the floors of a labyrinth, it swallows any who pass above.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f12.name: Earth Chant
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f12.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any EARTH Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f28.name: Eatgaboon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f28.description: If the ATK of a monster summoned by your opponent (excluding Special Summon) is 500 points or less, the monster is destroyed.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f53.name: Eldeen
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f53.description: The cane of this monster is the source of many powerful spells.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f56.name: Elder of the Six Samurai
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f56.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f64.name: Elegy the Melodious Diva
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f64.description: Special Summoned "Melodious" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. If this card was Special Summoned, all Fairy-Type monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f6a.name: Element Valkyrie
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f6a.description:
(This card is not treated as a "Valkyrie" card.)
This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:
● FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK.
● WATER: Control of this card cannot switch.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f6d.name: Elemental Grace Doriado
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f6d.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 6 or more monsters with different Attributes in the GYs. Gains ATK/DEF equal to the number of different Attributes in the GYs x 500. When your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s) (Quick Effect): You can banish 3 monsters from your GY; negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f70.name: Elemental HERO Aqua Neos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f70.description:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; destroy 1 random card in your opponent's hand. During the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f75.name: Elemental HERO Brave Neos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f75.description:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + 1 Level 4 or lower Effect Monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 100 ATK for each "Neo-Spacian" and "HERO" monster in your GY. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand that specifically lists the card "Elemental HERO Neos" in its text.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f82.name: Elemental HERO Escuridao
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f82.description:
1 "Elemental HERO" monster + 1 DARK monster
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 100 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" monster in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb2.name: Elemental HERO Terra Firma
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb2.description:
"Elemental HERO Ocean" + "Elemental HERO Woodsman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can Tribute 1 face-up "Elemental HERO" monster; this card gains ATK equal to the Tributed monster's ATK, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb9.name: Elemental HERO Woodsman
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb9.description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fcd.name: Embodiment of Apophis
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fcd.description: During either player's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Reptile-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1600/DEF 1800). (This card is also still a Trap Card.)

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff4.name: Enlightenment Paladin
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff4.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned using a "Magician" Pendulum Monster as Material: You can target 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Enlightenment Paladin" once per turn. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that monster's original ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff8.name: Envoy of Chaos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff8.description: During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then target 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster or "Gaia The Fierce Knight" monster you control; it gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn, and if it does, every opponent's monster that battles it this turn has its ATK become that monster's original ATK during damage calculation only. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can banish 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY, except this card; add this card to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201a.name: Evil Blast
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201a.description: Activate only when a monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field. Equip this card to that monster. It gains 500 ATK. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5203e.name: Evilswarm Mandragora
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5203e.description: If your opponent controls more monsters than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52077.name: Exiled Force
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52077.description: You can Tribute this card to target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52089.name: Extra Gate
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52089.description: Declare a Level between 1 and 12; your opponent banishes 1 monster of that Level from their Extra Deck. If your opponent does not have a monster of that Level in their Extra Deck, you discard 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5208e.name: Exxod, Master of The Guard
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5208e.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "sphinx" monster. Each time an EARTH monster is Flip Summoned while this card remains face-up on the field, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f05.name: Dwarf Star Dragon Planeter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f05.description: Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned this turn: You can add 1 Level 7 LIGHT or DARK monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f17.name: Earthbound Immortal Aslla piscu
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f17.description: There can only be 1 "Earthbound Immortal" monster on the field. If there is no face-up Field Spell on the field, destroy this card. Your opponent's monsters cannot target this card for attacks. This card can attack directly. If this face-up card leaves the field, except by its own effect: Destroy as many face-up monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict 800 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f1e.name: Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f1e.description: There can only be 1 "Earthbound Immortal" monster on the field. If there is no face-up Field Spell on the field, destroy this card. Your opponent's monsters cannot target this card for attacks. This card can attack directly. If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 to 3 cards you control, but not more than your opponent has in their hand; shuffle them into the Deck, then discard the same number of random cards from your opponent's hand (or as many as possible), and if you do, this card gains 1000 ATK for each card discarded by this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f3f.name: Ego Boost
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f3f.description: When a monster declares an attack: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of the Battle Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fa4.name: Elemental HERO Prisma
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fa4.description: Once per turn: You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, then send 1 of the Fusion Materials whose name is specifically listed on that card from your Deck to the Graveyard; this card's name becomes the sent monster's until the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fad.name: Elemental HERO Storm Neos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fad.description:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + "Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird" + "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Once per turn: You can destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field. During the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck. When this card is shuffled into the Extra Deck this way: Shuffle all cards on the field into the Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb4.name: Elemental HERO Thunder Giant
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb4.description:
"Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Clayman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card to target 1 face-up monster on the field with original ATK less than the ATK of this card; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fbc.name: Elemental Training
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fbc.description: Your opponent cannot target "Palace of the Elemental Lords" you control with card effects, also it cannot be destroyed by card effects. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 "Elementsaber" monster from your Deck with a different original Attribute than that monster's. You can send this face-up card from the field to the GY; discard your entire hand, then add "Elemental Lord" monsters from your GY to your hand, equal to the number of cards discarded.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52047.name: Evilswarm Zahak
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52047.description: If this face-up card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card (by battle or card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: Target 1 Special Summoned Level 5 or higher monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52050.name: Evo-Force
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52050.description: Tribute 1 "Evoltile" monster; Special Summon 1 "Evolsaur" monster from your Deck. It is treated as if it was Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52052.name: Evo-Karma
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52052.description: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster you control, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5206d.name: Exa, Enforcer of the Nekroz
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5206d.description: If this card is Tributed by a card effect: You can add 1 Dragon-Type "Nekroz" Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is banished: You can target 1 of your banished "Nekroz" monsters, except this card; Special Summon that monster. You can only use 1 "Exa, Enforcer of the Nekroz" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5207f.name: Exploder Dragonwing
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5207f.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Dragon-Type monsters
At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a monster: You can destroy that monster, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK the destroyed monster had on the field. This card's ATK must be greater than or equal to the ATK of that monster to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51eff.name: Dust Storm of Gusto
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51eff.description: Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when "Gusto" monsters you control declare their attacks this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f09.name: Dyna, Hero Fur Hire
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f09.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can banish cards from your opponent's GY, up to the number of monsters "Fur Hire" you control with different names. You can only use this effect of "Dyna, Hero Fur Hire" once per turn. Monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters "Fur Hire" you control for attacks, except this one.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f26.name: Earthshattering Event
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f26.description: If a card(s) is sent from the Deck to the Graveyard: Target 1 card in either player's Graveyard; shuffle it into the Deck, also neither player can send cards from the Deck to the Graveyard for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f2d.name: Eccentric Boy
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f2d.description: When using this card as a Synchro Material Monster, the other Synchro Material Monster is 1 monster in your hand. The Synchro Monster that used this card as a Synchro Material Monster cannot activate its effect, its effect(s) is negated, and it is removed from play when removed from the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f30.name: Eco, Mystical Spirit of the Forest
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f30.description: When you take damage from an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the damage you took, also both players take no further effect damage this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f9c.name: Elemental HERO Neos Alius
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f9c.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● This card's name becomes "Elemental HERO Neos" while on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f9f.name: Elemental HERO Nova Master
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f9f.description:
1 "Elemental HERO" monster + 1 FIRE monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fa0.name: Elemental HERO Ocean
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fa0.description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can target 1 "HERO" monster you control or in your Graveyard; return that target to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc4.name: Elephant Statue of Blessing
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc4.description: When this card is sent from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: You gain 2000 Life Points.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fd4.name: Emes the Infinity
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fd4.description: Each time this card destroys an opponent's monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase the ATK of this card by 700 points.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ffc.name: Erebus the Underworld Monarch
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ffc.description: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Tribute Summoned monster. If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can send 2 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Cards with different names from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, shuffle 1 card from your opponent's hand (at random), Graveyard, or their side of the field into the Deck. Once per turn, during either player's Main Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can discard 1 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card, then target 1 monster in your Graveyard with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52012.name: Everlasting Alloy

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52017.name: Evigishki Mind Augus
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52017.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Gishki" Ritual Spell Card. When this card is Ritual Summoned: Target up to 5 cards in any Graveyard(s); shuffle those targets into the Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201c.name: Evil Eye Awakening
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201c.description: Special Summon 1 "Evil Eye" monster from your hand or GY, or, if "Evil Eye of Selene" is in your Spell & Trap Zone, you can Special Summon 1 "Evil Eye" monster from your Deck instead. You can only activate 1 "Evil Eye Awakening" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52026.name: Evil HERO Adusted Gold
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52026.description: You can discard this card; add 1 "Dark Fusion", or 1 card that specifically lists "Dark Fusion" in its text, from your Deck to your hand, except "Evil HERO Adusted Gold". You can only use this effect of "Evil HERO Adusted Gold" once per turn. Cannot attack unless you control a Fusion Monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5205f.name: Evoltile Casinerio
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5205f.description: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 2 Level 6 or lower FIRE Dinosaur-Type monsters with the same name from your Deck. Their effects are negated and they are banished during the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5208f.name: Eye of the Void
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5208f.description: Special Summon 1 "Infernoid" monster from your hand, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but its effects are negated until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52092.name: F.A. Circuit Grand Prix
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52092.description: Increase the Levels of all "F.A." monsters on the field by 2 during the Battle Phase only. Once per turn, when your "F.A." monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can draw 1 card. If this face-up card on the field is destroyed by a card effect: You can add 1 "F.A." card from your Deck to your hand, except "F.A. Circuit Grand Prix". You can only use this effect of "F.A. Circuit Grand Prix" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f01.name: Dustflame Blast
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f01.description: Banish all "Laval" monsters from your Graveyard; destroy any number of cards on the field, up to the number of monsters banished for this card's activation.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f1c.name: Earthbound Immortal Revival
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f1c.description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 "Earthbound Immortal" monster and 1 Field Spell in your GY; add those targets to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f22.name: Earthbound Whirlwind
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f22.description: If you control an "Earthbound Immortal" monster: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f5c.name: Electric Lizard
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f5c.description: A non Zombie-Type monster attacking "Electric Lizard" cannot attack on its following turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f60.name: Electromagnetic Bagworm
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f60.description:
FLIP: Target 1 Machine-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until your next End Phase.
If this card is destroyed by battle: The monster that destroyed it loses 500 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f74.name: Elemental HERO Blazeman
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f74.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect; you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Fusion Monsters, also send 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Elemental HERO Blazeman", and if you do, this card's Attribute and ATK/DEF become the same as the monster sent to the GY, until the end of this turn. You can only use 1 "Elemental HERO Blazeman" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f7c.name: Elemental HERO Core
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f7c.description:
3 "Elemental HERO" monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn, when this card is targeted for an attack: You can make this card's ATK become double its current ATK until the end of the Damage Step. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: You can target 1 monster on the field; destroy it. When this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 Level 8 or lower "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f89.name: Elemental HERO Grandmerge
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f89.description:
2 "HERO" Normal Monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains ATK/DEF equal to the combined original Levels of the materials used for its Fusion Summon x 300. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but it cannot attack monsters with an equal or lower Level than it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f98.name: Elemental HERO Necroshade
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f98.description: Once, while this card is in the Graveyard, 1 Level 5 or higher "Elemental HERO" monster you Normal Summon can be Summoned without Tributing.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fa7.name: Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fa7.description:
"Elemental HERO Flame Wingman" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 300 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" card in your Graveyard. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51faf.name: Elemental HERO Stratos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51faf.description:
When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects.
● Destroy Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of "HERO" monsters you control, except this card.
● Add 1 "HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fbb.name: Elemental Recharge
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fbb.description: Gain 1000 Life Points for each face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc0.name: Elementsaber Makani
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc0.description: Once per turn: You can send 1 "Elementsaber" monster from your hand to the GY; add 1 "Elementsaber" or "Elemental Lord" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Elementsaber Makani". Once per turn, if this card is in the GY: You can declare 1 Attribute; this card in the GY becomes that Attribute until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fd0.name: Emergency Provisions
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fd0.description: Send any number of other Spell/Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard; gain 1000 LP for each card sent to the Graveyard this way.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fe2.name: Enchanted Javelin
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fe2.description: Select 1 attacking monster. Gain Life Points equal to its ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fea.name: Endymion, the Master Magician
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fea.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or GY) by removing 6 Spell Counters from a "Magical Citadel of Endymion" you control. If Summoned this way: Target 1 Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand. Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff6.name: Enraged Battle Ox
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff6.description: If a Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52000.name: Escalation of the Monarchs
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52000.description: Once per turn, during your opponent's Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon 1 monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52009.name: Eternal Drought
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52009.description: Destroy all face-up Fish-Type monsters on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201b.name: Evil Dragon Ananta
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201b.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play all Reptile-Type monsters from your side of the field and Graveyard. This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of monsters you removed x 600. During each of your End Phases, destroy 1 card on the field.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52024.name: Evil Eye of Gorgoneio
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52024.description: Equip only to an "Evil Eye" monster. You can only activate 1 "Evil Eye of Gorgoneio" per turn. This card's name becomes "Evil Eye of Selene" while in the Spell & Trap Zone. While your LP are lower than your opponent's, the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the difference. You can banish this card from your GY and discard 1 "Evil Eye" card; add 1 "Evil Eye" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Evil Eye of Gorgoneio". You can only use this effect of "Evil Eye of Gorgoneio" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52035.name: Evilswarm Bahamut
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52035.description:
2 Level 4 "lswarm" monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; discard 1 "lswarm" monster, and if you do, take control of that opponent's monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52043.name: Evilswarm Ouroboros
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52043.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then activate 1 of these effects. Each effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.
● Target 1 card your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.
● Send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard.
● Target 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard; banish that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5204f.name: Evo-Diversity
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5204f.description: Add 1 "Evoltile" or "Evolsaur" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Evo-Diversity" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52058.name: Evolsaur Cerato
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52058.description: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster: It gains 200 ATK. If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster, each time this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can add 1 "Evoltile" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5205c.name: Evolsaur Pelta
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5205c.description: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster: It gains 500 DEF. If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster, then is destroyed by battle: You can add 1 "Evoltile" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5206b.name: Evolzar Laggia
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5206b.description:
2 Level 4 Dinosaur-Type monsters
During either player's turn, when a monster(s) would be Normal or Special Summoned, OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: You can detach 2 Xyz Materials from this card; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5206c.name: Evolzar Solda
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5206c.description:
2 Level 6 Dinosaur-Type monsters
This card cannot be destroyed by card effects while it has Xyz Material. When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy that monster(s).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5207d.name: Expendable Dai
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5207d.description: Tribute 1 Warrior monster, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it, and if you do, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5208b.name: Extra Veiler
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5208b.description: When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), except during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, your opponent takes any effect damage you would have taken from their card effects this turn, instead.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5209b.name: F.A. Overheat
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5209b.description: If only your opponent controls a monster: Special Summon 1 "F.A." monster from your hand, and if you do, increase its Level by 3 until the end of this turn. If this card is in the GY and you control no cards in your Field Zone: You can banish this card from the GY; activate 1 "F.A." Field Spell directly from your hand or GY. You can only use this effect of "F.A. Overheat" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f20.name: Earthbound Spirit
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f20.description: A vengeful creature formed by the spirits of fallen warriors, it drags any who dare approach it into the deepest bowels of the earth.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f5d.name: Electric Snake
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f5d.description: When this card is discarded from your hand to the Graveyard by an effect of a card controlled by your opponent, draw 2 cards from your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f7f.name: Elemental HERO Darkbright
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f7f.description:
"Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Necroshade"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, change it to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step. If this card is destroyed: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f84.name: Elemental HERO Flare Neos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f84.description:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + "Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) This card gains 400 ATK for each Spell/Trap Card on the field. During the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f8a.name: Elemental HERO Great Tornado
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f8a.description:
1 "Elemental HERO" monster + 1 WIND monster
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If this card is Fusion Summoned: Halve the ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f8d.name: Elemental HERO Ice Edge
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f8d.description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: You can target 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone; destroy that target. Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can discard 1 card; this card can attack your opponent directly this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f8f.name: Elemental HERO Knospe
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f8f.description: Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: It gains 100 ATK and loses 100 DEF. While you control another face-up "Elemental HERO" monster, your opponent cannot target this card for an attack, and this card can attack your opponent directly.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51faa.name: Elemental HERO Sparkman
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51faa.description: An Elemental HERO and a warrior of light who proficiently wields many kinds of armaments. His Static Shockwave cuts off the path of villainy.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb1.name: Elemental HERO Tempest
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb1.description:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Bubbleman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can send 1 other card you control to the Graveyard to target 1 monster you control; while this card is face-up on the field, that monster cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb8.name: Elemental HERO Wildheart
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fb8.description: This card is unaffected by Trap effects.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc9.name: Elphase
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc9.description:
2 Level 3 or higher Cyberse monsters
Gains 300 ATK for each monster this card points to. If this Link Summoned card leaves the field: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but for the rest of this turn, its effects (if any) are negated and it cannot be used as Link Material. You can only use this effect of "Elphase" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fdd.name: Empowerment
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fdd.description: All Dragon, Warrior, and Spellcaster-Type monsters you control gain 300 ATK and DEF. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Empowered Warrior" monster from your Deck. Once per turn: You can banish a total of 4 Warrior and/or Spellcaster-Type monsters from your Graveyard; add 1 "Aether" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff7.name: Enraged Muka Muka
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ff7.description: This card gains 400 ATK and DEF for each card in your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52004.name: Esper Girl
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52004.description: When this removed from play card is Special Summoned, remove from play the top card of your Deck, face-down. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, add that removed card to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201f.name: Evil Eye Domain - Pareidolia
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201f.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Evil Eye" monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during damage calculation, if your "Evil Eye" monster is attacked, while "Evil Eye of Selene" is in your Spell & Trap Zone: You can make the battle damage you take from this battle also inflicted to your opponent. If this card in the Field Zone is destroyed by card effect: You can target 1 "Evil Eye" monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Evil Eye Domain - Pareidolia" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52025.name: Evil Eye of Selene
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52025.description: Equip only to an "Evil Eye" monster. It cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects, also your opponent cannot target it with card effects. Each time you activate the equipped monster's effect, or you activate another "Evil Eye" Spell/Trap Card: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK, and if it does, you lose 500 LP. (This ATK gain remains even if this card leaves the field.) If this card is in your GY: You can pay 1000 LP, then banish 1 "Evil Eye" Spell/Trap from your GY, except "Evil Eye of Selene"; Set this card. You can only use this effect of "Evil Eye of Selene" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5202b.name: Evil HERO Inferno Wing
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5202b.description:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to either half the ATK or DEF (whichever is higher) of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5203f.name: Evilswarm Nightmare
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5203f.description:
2 Level 4 DARK monsters
When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 material from this card; change that Special Summoned monster(s) to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5204e.name: Evo-Branch
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5204e.description: Target 1 face-up Reptile-Type monster you control; destroy it and Special Summon 1 "Evoltile" monster in face-down Defense Position from your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52065.name: Evoltile Odonto
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52065.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Evolsaur" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52083.name: Explossum
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52083.description: You can target 1 face-up Xyz Monster your opponent controls; equip this monster from your hand or your side of the field to that target. If a monster equipped with this card by this effect has no Xyz Materials, destroy that monster. While this card is equipped to a monster, during each of your opponent's Standby Phases: Detach 1 Xyz Material from the equipped monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52084.name: Express Train Trolley Olley
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52084.description:
An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as Xyz Material gains this effect.
● If it is Xyz Summoned: It gains 800 ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fbd.name: Elementsaber Aina
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fbd.description: Once per turn: You can send 1 "Elementsaber" monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 "Elementsaber" monster (except "Elementsaber Aina") or "Elemental Lord" monster (that has been properly Summoned) in your GY; Special Summon it, ignoring its Summoning conditions. Once per turn, if this card is in the GY: You can declare 1 Attribute; this card in the GY becomes that Attribute until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fbe.name: Elementsaber Lapauila
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fbe.description: Once per turn, when a Spell/Trap Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can send 1 "Elementsaber" monster from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. Once per turn, if this card is in the GY: You can declare 1 Attribute; this card in the GY becomes that Attribute until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc1.name: Elementsaber Malo
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc1.description: Once per turn: You can send 1 "Elementsaber" monster from your hand to the GY; send 1 "Elementsaber" or "Elemental Lord" monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Elementsaber Malo". Once per turn, if this card is in the GY: You can declare 1 Attribute; this card in the GY becomes that Attribute until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc6.name: Elephun
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fc6.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can select 1 of your Level 3 or lower Beast-Type, Beast-Warrior-Type or Winged Beast-Type monsters that is removed from play, and add it to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fe0.name: Empress of Prophecy
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fe0.description:
2 Level 5 Spellcaster-Type monsters
This card gains 300 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to a monster you control. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; shuffle your Deck, then excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, destroy monsters on the field up to the number of "Spellbook" cards excavated, also, after that, place the excavated cards on the top of the Deck in any order.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5200c.name: Eternal Soul

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5202a.name: Evil HERO Infernal Sniper
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5202a.description:
"Elemental HERO Clayman" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card cannot be destroyed by Spell Cards. During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. This card must be in face-up Defense Position to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5202c.name: Evil HERO Lightning Golem
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5202c.description:
"Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Clayman"
Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5203c.name: Evilswarm Kerykeion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5203c.description:
You can only use each effect of "Evilswarm Kerykeion" once per turn. While this card is in the Graveyard, if it was sent there this turn, you can Normal Summon 1 "lswarm" monster for 1 less Tribute.
You can banish 1 "lswarm" monster from your Graveyard, then target 1 "lswarm" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand, also, this card gains the following effect.
● This turn: You can activate this effect; Normal Summon 1 "lswarm" monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52046.name: Evilswarm Thunderbird
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52046.description: During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card you control. During the next Standby Phase, return this card banished by this effect to the field, and if you do, it gains 300 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Evilswarm Thunderbird" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52051.name: Evo-Instant
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52051.description: Tribute 1 Reptile-Type monster; Special Summon 1 "Evolsaur" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5205a.name: Evolsaur Diplo
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5205a.description: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52078.name: Exodia Necross
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52078.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Contract with Exodia", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Cannot be destroyed by battle or Spell/Trap effect. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 500 ATK. Destroy this card unless all 5 of these cards are in your Graveyard - "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One" and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ef7.name: Duke Shade, the Sinister Shadow Lord
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51ef7.description: You can Tribute any number of DARK monsters; Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, it gains 500 ATK for each monster you Tributed. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Level 5 or higher DARK monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Duke Shade, the Sinister Shadow Lord" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except DARK monsters.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f32.name: Ectoplasmer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f32.description: Once per turn, during each player's End Phase: The turn player must Tribute 1 face-up monster, and if they do, inflict damage to their opponent equal to quarter the original ATK of the Tributed monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f38.name: Edge Imp Frightfuloid
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f38.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Frightfur" card.)
You can target 1 "Frightfur" Fusion Monster you control or in your Graveyard; this card's ATK and DEF each become equal to the original ATK and DEF of that monster, until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Edge Imp Frightfuloid" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f39.name: Edge Imp Sabres
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f39.description: If this card is in your GY: You can place 1 card from your hand on the top of the Deck; Special Summon this card in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Edge Imp Sabres" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f43.name: Ehther the Heavenly Monarch
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f43.description: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Tribute Summoned monster. If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can send 2 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Cards with different names from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon 1 monster with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF from your Deck, but return it to the hand during the End Phase. During your opponent's Main Phase, if this card is in your hand: You can banish 1 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card from your Graveyard; immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon this card (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f80.name: Elemental HERO Divine Neos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f80.description: Must be Fusion Summoned using any 5 "Neos", "Neo Space", "Neo-Spacian", or "HERO" monsters, including at least 1 "Neos" or "Neo Space" monster, 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster, and 1 "HERO" monster, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Neos", "Neo Space", "Neo-Spacian", or "HERO" monster from your Graveyard; this card gains 500 ATK, and until the End Phase it also gains the banished monster's effects.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f91.name: Elemental HERO Liquid Soldier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f91.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "HERO" monster in your GY, except "Elemental HERO Liquid Soldier"; Special Summon it. If this card is used as Fusion Material for a "HERO" monster, and sent to the GY or banished: You can draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. You can only use 1 "Elemental HERO Liquid Soldier" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f92.name: Elemental HERO Magma Neos
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f92.description:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + "Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab" + "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) This card gains 400 ATK for each card on the field. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck. If this card is shuffled into the Extra Deck this way: Return all cards on the field to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f9e.name: Elemental HERO Neos Knight
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51f9e.description:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + 1 Warrior monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains ATK equal to half the original ATK of the Warrior Fusion Material used for its Fusion Summon, except "Elemental HERO Neos". Can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. Your opponent takes no battle damage from attacks involving this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fba.name: Elemental Mistress Doriado

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fff.name: Erica the Rikka Fairy
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51fff.description: When an attack is declared involving another Plant monster you control: You can Tribute this card from your hand or face-up field; that monster you control gains 1000 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. If this card is banished from your Graveyard: You can add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Evening Twilight Knight" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5201d.name: Evil Eye Confrontation

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52037.name: Evilswarm Coppelia

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52039.name: Evilswarm Golem

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52041.name: Evilswarm Obliviwisp

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52044.name: Evilswarm Salamandra

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52088.name: Extra Buck
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52088.description: Each time a card(s) is added to your Extra Deck, place 1 Spell Counter on this card (max. 3). You can send this card with 3 Spell Counters to the GY; draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51efd.name: Dust Barrier

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a51efe.name: Dust Knight

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52241.name: Frontline Observer

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52245.name: Frozen Fitzgerald

● Target 1 LIGHT Machine-Type monster with 1200 or less ATK in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5223c.description: When a Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, that target loses 500 ATK until the end of the next turn. You can only use this effect of "Friller Rabca" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520c3.name: Fairy Knight Ingunar
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520c3.description:
3 Level 6 monsters

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520d8.name: Fallen Paradise
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520d8.description: Your opponent cannot target "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", or "Armityle the Chaos Phantom" in your Monster Zones with card effects, also those monsters cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects while you control them. If you control "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" or "Armityle the Chaos Phantom" in your Monster Zone: You can draw 2 cards. 60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520f0.name: Faustian Bargain
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520f0.description: Target 1 Special Summoned monster on either field; send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52138.name: Fire Formation - Tensu
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52138.description: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 Beast-Warrior monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) All Beast-Warrior monsters you control gain 100 ATK.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5213f.name: Fire King Avatar Kirin
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5213f.description: If a face-up "Fire King" monster you control is destroyed by a card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can send 1 FIRE monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52142.name: Fire King Island
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52142.description:
If this face-up card in the Field Zone is sent to the Graveyard or banished: Destroy all monsters you control. You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Fire King Island" per turn, and only once that turn.
● During your Main Phase: You can destroy 1 monster in your hand or you control, and if you do, add 1 "Fire King" monster from your Deck to your hand.
● If you control no monsters: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE Winged Beast-Type monster from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52162.name: Fishborg Archer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52162.description: If this card is in your Graveyard and you control no monsters during either of your Main Phases: You can discard 1 WATER monster; Special Summon this card from your Graveyard, but destroy all monsters you control at the beginning of this turn's Battle Phase, except for WATER monsters. 60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52183.name: Flamvell Dragnov
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52183.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. You can remove from play this card in your Graveyard, along with 1 face-up FIRE monster you control, to add 1 "Flamvell Dragnov" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521b7.name: Fluffal Cat
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521b7.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Fusion Material for a Fusion Summon: You can target 1 "Polymerization" in your Graveyard; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Fluffal Cat" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521c2.name: Fluffal Wings
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521c2.description: If this card is in your Graveyard and you control "Toy Vendor": You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 "Fluffal" monster in your Graveyard; banish it, and if you do, draw 1 card, then you can send 1 "Toy Vendor" you control to the Graveyard, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Fluffal Wings" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521d5.name: Flying Pegasus Railroad Stampede
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521d5.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 EARTH Machine monster in your GY, except "Flying Pegasus Railroad Stampede"; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but negate its effects. You can target 1 other face-up monster you control; the Level of that monster or this card becomes the Level of the other. You cannot declare attacks the turn you activate this effect, except with Xyz Monsters. You can only use each effect of "Flying Pegasus Railroad Stampede" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521dd.name: Fool of Prophecy
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521dd.description: Once per turn: You can send 1 "Spellbook" Spell Card from your Deck to the Graveyard. During the End Phase of the turn this card activated this effect: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher DARK Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck. You must have 5 or more "Spellbook" Spell Cards with different names in your Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521f2.name: Forgotten Temple of the Deep
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521f2.description: While this card is on the field, this card's name becomes "Umi". Once per turn: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent or Aqua-Type monster you control; banish that target. During your End Phase: Special Summon the monster(s) banished by this effect.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521fa.name: Fortress Whale

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52216.name: Fossil Machine Skull Convoy

1 Rock monster in your GY + 1 Level 7 or higher monster

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52219.name: Fossil Warrior Skull Bone

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520ba.name: Factory of 100 Machines

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520bf.name: Fairy Dragon

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52108.name: Fiend Comedian

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52123.name: Final Geas
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52123.description: If a monster(s) with an original Level of 7 or higher is sent from each player's field to the Graveyard this turn: Banish as many monsters from the Graveyards as possible, then you can Special Summon the 1 highest-Level Spellcaster-Type monster among those banished monsters to your field (your choice, if tied).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52126.name: Final Light
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52126.description: Pay LP in multiples of 1000, then target 1 "Valkyrie" monster in your GY with a different name for every 1000 LP paid; Special Summon them, then your opponent can Special Summon monsters with 2000 or less ATK from their GY, up to the number of monsters you Special Summoned by this effect. You can only activate 1 "Final Light" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52184.name: Flamvell Fiend

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520ae.name: Fabled Lurrie

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5213d.name: Fire King Avatar Barong

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520ad.name: Fabled Leviathan

1 "Fabled" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5213e.description: If a face-up "Fire King" monster you control is destroyed by a card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. 60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52166.description: Once, while this card is in the GY: You can send the top card of your Deck to the GY, then, if it is a WATER monster, Special Summon this card from the GY. You can only use this effect of "Fishborg Planter" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521ac.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521b0.name: Flower Cardian Zebra Grass with Moon

Once per turn, if this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52201.name: Fortune Fairy Hu
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52201.description: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon it from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned from the hand: You can target 1 of your banished Spellcaster monsters; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Fortune Fairy Hu" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5221b.name: Fossil Warrior Skull Knight
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5221b.description:
1 Rock monster + 1 Level 5 or 6 monster

When this attacking card destroys a monster by battle: You can activate this effect; this card can make a second attack in a row. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Fossil Warrior Skull Knight" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52237.name: Frightfur Sabre-Tooth
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52237.description:
1 "Frightfur" Fusion Monster + 1+ "Fluffal" and/or "Edge Imp" monsters

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52240.name: Frontline Base

If this card is Level 7 or higher, it can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520df.name: Familiar-Possessed - Dharc
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520df.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Dharc the Dark Charmer" you control and 1 face-up DARK monster you control to the Graveyard. When you do: You can add 1 Level 3 or 4 LIGHT Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card was Special Summoned by this effect and attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520ee.name: Fatal Abacus
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520ee.description: Each time 1 monster is sent from the field to the Graveyard, inflict 500 points of damage per card to the respective card owner's Life Points.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520f4.name: Feather Shot
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a520f4.description: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Avian" you control; during this turn, that target can attack a number of times equal to the number of monsters you control when this card resolves, but cannot attack directly, and other monsters you control cannot attack this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52125.name: Final Inzektion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52125.description: Send 5 face-up "Inzektor" cards you control to the Graveyard; destroy all cards your opponent controls, also, during the Battle Phase of this turn, your opponent cannot activate monster effects that activate in the hand or Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5212e.name: Fire Eye
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5212e.description: An eye engulfed in flames that flaps its wings to create hot blasts of air.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5214c.name: Fire Trooper
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5214c.description: When this card is Summoned, you can send it to the Graveyard to inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5214e.name: Firebrand Hymnist
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5214e.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send cards from the top of your opponent's Deck to the GY, equal to the number of cards they control. If this card is Special Summoned: You can send cards from the top of your Deck to the GY, equal to the number of cards your opponent controls. You can only use this effect of "Firebrand Hymnist" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52151.name: Firestorm Prominence
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52151.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-FIRE monsters.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52161.name: Fish and Swaps

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52179.name: Flame Spirit Ignis
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52179.description: You can Tribute 1 face-up FIRE monster to inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each FIRE monsters in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52189.name: Flamvell Poun
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52189.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 monster with 200 DEF from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52194.name: Fleur Synchron
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52194.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Synchro Material: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower monster from your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52199.name: Flint Lock
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52199.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Flint" in the Spell & Trap Zone; equip it to this card. During your Main Phase: You can target 1 "Flint" equipped to this card, and 1 face-up monster on the field, except this card; equip that "Flint" to that targeted monster. This card can only be equipped with 1 "Flint". While equipped with "Flint", this card is unaffected by the effect of "Flint", and cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521b4.name: Flowerbot
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521b4.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard: Draw 1 card, then place 1 card from your hand on the top of the Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521b8.name: Fluffal Crane
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521b8.description: When a face-up "Fluffal" monster(s) you control is destroyed by your opponent's attack or card effect and sent to your Graveyard: Target 1 of those destroyed monsters; add it to your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521e4.name: Forbidden Arts of the Gishki
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521e4.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Gishki" Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute face-up monsters from anywhere on the field, whose total Levels equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. Halve the ATK of the monster Ritual Summoned by this effect. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521f6.name: Formula Synchron
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521f6.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner monster
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can draw 1 card. Once per Chain, during your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521fb.name: Fortress Whale's Oath
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a521fb.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Fortress Whale". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 7 or more.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5221e.name: Fragment Fusion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5221e.description: Banish from your Graveyard the Fusion Material Monsters that are listed on a "Gem-Knight" Fusion Monster Card, then Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck. (This Special Summon is treated as a Fusion Summon.) Destroy it during the End Phase.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52220.name: Fraud Freeze
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52220.description: Once per turn, when your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) from the hand (except during the Damage Step): You can return to the hand all monsters your opponent controls that were Special Summoned from the hand. If neither player controls a "Flower Cardian" Synchro Monster, send this card to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5223a.name: Frightfur Tiger
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5223a.description:
"Edge Imp Sabres" + 1 or more "Fluffal" monsters
When this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target cards on the field, up to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon; destroy them. All "Frightfur" monsters you control gain 300 ATK for each "Fluffal" monster and "Frightfur" monster you control. You can only control 1 "Frightfur Tiger".

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52242.name: Frost Blast of the Monarchs
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52242.description: If you control a monster with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy it. You can banish this card and 1 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Set card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52243.name: Frost and Flame Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52243.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE and 2 WATER monsters from your Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card to target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5225c.name: Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5225c.description: You can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing, but its original ATK and DEF become halved.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522c1.name: Galaxy-Eyes Solflare Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522c1.description:
2 LIGHT monsters, including a monster with 2000 or more ATK
If this card is Link Summoned: You can target 1 "Photon" or "Galaxy" monster in your GY; add it to your hand. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 "Photon" card and 1 "Galaxy" card, OR discard 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon", then target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Galaxy-Eyes Solflare Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52287.name: Gagaga Samurai
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52287.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 "Gagaga" monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn. When another monster you control is targeted for an attack while this card is in Attack Position: You can change this card to face-up Defense Position, and if you do, change the attack target to this card and perform damage calculation.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52289.name: Gagagaback
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52289.description: During the turn a "Gagaga" monster you control was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon from your Graveyard as many monsters as possible that were destroyed by battle this turn, in face-up Defense Position, then take 300 damage for each monster Special Summoned by this effect. You can only activate 1 "Gagagaback" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522a9.name: Galaxy Cyclone
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522a9.description: Target 1 Set Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Galaxy Cyclone" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522ac.name: Galaxy Knight
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522ac.description: If you control a "Photon" or "Galaxy" monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If Summoned this way: Target 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" in your GY (if possible); regardless, this card loses 1000 ATK, and if it does, Special Summon that target (if any) in Defense Position. This ATK decrease lasts until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522b4.name: Galaxy Trance
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522b4.description: Pay 2000 LP, then target 1 "Photon" monster in your GY; Special Summon both it and 1 "Galaxy" monster from your Deck, with the same Level, both in Defense Position, and if you do, each monster's ATK become 2000, also their effects are negated. You can only activate 1 "Galaxy Trance" per turn. You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters during the turn you activate this card, except "Photon" and "Galaxy" monsters.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522c3.name: Gale Lizard
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522c3.description: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522d4.name: Garbage Lord

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52267.name: Fusion Reserve
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52267.description: Reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, add 1 of the Fusion Materials whose name is specifically listed on that card from your Deck to your hand, then you can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52269.name: Fusion Substitute
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52269.description:
(This card's name is always treated as "Polymerization".)
Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control as Fusion Material. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster in your GY; return it to the Extra Deck, then draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5226b.name: Fusion Tag
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5226b.description: Target 1 monster you control; reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, and if you do, the targeted monster's name can be treated as the revealed Fusion Monster's, if used for a Fusion Summon this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52277.name: Gachi Gachi Gantetsu
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52277.description:
2 Level 2 monsters 
If this face-up card would be destroyed, you can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card instead. Face-up monsters you control gain 200 ATK and DEF for each Xyz Material attached to this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52284.name: Gagaga Head
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52284.description:
If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing as a Level 4 monster. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target up to 2 "Gagaga" monsters in your Graveyard, except "Gagaga Head"; Special Summon them, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except by an Xyz Summon that uses only "Gagaga" monsters as materials. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as Xyz Material gains this effect.
● If it is Xyz Summoned: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522bb.name: Galaxy-Eyes Cipher Blade Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522bb.description:
3 Level 9 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a Rank 8 "Galaxy-Eyes" Xyz Monster you control as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Cannot be used as material for an Xyz Summon. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it. If this Xyz Summoned card you control, is destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster, or destroyed by an opponent's card effect, and sent to your GY: You can target 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Cipher Dragon" in your GY; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522bf.name: Galaxy-Eyes Full Armor Photon Dragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522bf.description:
3 Level 8 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a "Galaxy-Eyes" Xyz Monster you control as material, except "Galaxy-Eyes Full Armor Photon Dragon". (Transfer its materials to this card.) Once per turn: You can target up to 2 Equip Cards equipped to this card; attach them to this card as material. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522d3.name: Garbage Collector
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522d3.description: You can target 1 other Cyberse monster you control that began the Duel in the Main Deck; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon from your Deck 1 Cyberse monster with the same Level, but with a different name. You can only use this effect of "Garbage Collector" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52255.name: Fullmetalfoes Fusion
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52255.description: Fusion Summon 1 "Metalfoes" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Materials.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52260.name: Fusion Devourer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52260.description: When this card battles a Fusion Monster, the ATK of the Fusion Monster becomes 0 during the Damage Step only.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52286.name: Gagaga Mancer
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52286.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Gagaga" monster in your Graveyard, except "Gagaga Mancer"; Special Summon it, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Gagaga" monsters. If this card is detached from an Xyz Monster and sent to the Graveyard to activate that monster's effect: You can target 1 face-up Xyz Monster you control; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5228f.name: Gagagarush
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5228f.description: When a face-up "Gagaga" monster(s) you control is targeted by the effect of an opponent's monster: Negate the effect of that opponent's monster, and if you do, destroy it, then inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the destroyed monster's ATK or DEF in the Graveyard (whichever is higher).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52297.name: Gaia Knight, the Force of Earth

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522b0.name: Galaxy Serpent
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522b0.description: Your hopes and dreams will be refreshed if you catch a glimpse of this rare creature in the evening twilight, soaring in the Sea of Stars.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522ca.name: Gamma The Electromagnet Warrior
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522ca.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Magnet Warrior" monster from your hand, except "Gamma The Electromagnet Warrior". You can only use this effect of "Gamma The Electromagnet Warrior" once per turn. During your opponent's turn: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Level 4 "Magnet Warrior" monster from your Deck (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5227c.name: Gadget Soldier
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5227c.description: A rust-free machine warrior born to battle.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52285.name: Gagaga Magician
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52285.description: Once per turn: You can declare a Level from 1 to 8; this card becomes that Level until the End Phase. You can only control 1 "Gagaga Magician". This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52299.name: Gaia Power
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52299.description: All EARTH monsters gain 500 ATK and lose 400 DEF.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522be.name: Galaxy-Eyes Cloudragon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522be.description: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Galaxy-Eyes" monster from your hand or Graveyard, except "Galaxy-Eyes Cloudragon". You can only use this effect of "Galaxy-Eyes Cloudragon" once per turn. If this card is in the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Galaxy-Eyes" Xyz Monster you control; attach this card to it as an Xyz Material. You can only use this effect of "Galaxy-Eyes Cloudragon" once per Duel.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522d1.name: Gandora-X the Dragon of Demolition
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522d1.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned from the hand: You can destroy as many other monsters on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the highest original ATK on the field among those destroyed monsters (your choice, if tied). This card's ATK becomes equal to the damage inflicted to your opponent by this effect. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Halve your LP.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522dd.name: Garoozis
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522dd.description: An axe-swinging beast-warrior with the head of a dragon.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5225b.name: Fushioh Richie
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5225b.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned from your hand or your Deck by Tributing 1 "Great Dezard" that has fulfilled the condition. You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. As long as this monster remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them. When this card is flipped face-up, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52264.name: Fusion Parasite
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52264.description: This card can be used as a substitute for any 1 Fusion Material whose name is specifically listed on the Fusion Monster Card, but the other Fusion Material(s) must be correct. Cannot be used as Fusion Material otherwise. If this card is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control as Fusion Materials, including this card.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52274.name: G.B. Hunter
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52274.description: Cards on the field cannot be returned to the Deck.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52288.name: Gagaga Sister
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52288.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Gagaga" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 other "Gagaga" monster you control; the Levels of that monster and this card become their combined current Levels, until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Gagaga Sister" once per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52291.name: Gagagatag
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52291.description: All "Gagaga" monsters you currently control gain 500 ATK for each "Gagaga" monster you currently control, until your next Standby Phase. You can only activate 1 "Gagagatag" per turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a522c8.description: Once per turn, you can toss a coin 3 times and apply the appropriate effect: ● 3 Heads: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. ● 2 Heads: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand. ● 1 Head: Destroy 1 card you control. ● 3 Tails: Discard your entire hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52253.name: Full-Force Strike

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52268.name: Fusion Sage
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52268.description: Add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5226c.name: Fusion Weapon
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5226c.description: Equip only to a Level 6 or lower Fusion Monster. The equipped monster gains 1500 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52275.description: All monsters are changed to Attack Position, also their battle positions cannot be changed. (Flip Effects are not activated.) Once per turn: You can reveal any number of Fiend monsters in your hand; this card gains 300 ATK for each, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5228b.name: Gagagadraw
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a5228b.description: Banish 3 "Gagaga" monsters from your Graveyard; draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52295.name: Gaia Dragon, the Thunder Charger
60c2b3aaa0e24f2d54a52295.description:
2 Level 7 monsters
