60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52446.name: Goblin Pothole Squad
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52446.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, Trap Cards cannot be activated. Also, "Trap Hole" Trap Cards cannot be activated when a monster is Summoned, except "Dark Trap Hole".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52456.name: Gogiga Gagagigo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52456.description: His soul long-since collapsed, his body recklessly continues onward, driven by a lust for more power. He no longer resembles his former self....

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52460.name: Gokibore
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52460.description: A large, spherical roach that attacks its enemies by rolling over them.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52479.name: Gora Turtle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52479.description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, monsters with an ATK equal to 1900 or more cannot declare an attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5248a.name: Gouki Face Turn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5248a.description: Target 1 "Gouki" card you control and 1 "Gouki" monster in your GY; destroy that card on the field, and if you do, Special Summon that other monster from the GY. You can only activate 1 "Gouki Face Turn" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5248d.name: Gouki Headbatt
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5248d.description: If this card is in your hand: You can send 1 other "Gouki" monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 "Gouki" monster you control; Special Summon this card in Defense Position, and if you do, the targeted monster gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Gouki" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Gouki Headbatt". You can only use each effect of "Gouki Headbatt" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ae.name: Gradius' Option
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ae.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This monster can only be Special Summoned by selecting 1 face-up "Gradius" on your side of the field. The ATK and DEF of this card becomes the same as the ATK and DEF of the selected "Gradius". If the selected "Gradius" is removed from the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c1.name: Grass Phantom
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c1.description: This card gains 500 ATK for each "Grass Phantom" in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d5.name: Gravekeeper's Oracle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d5.description:
You can Tribute 3 monsters or 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can activate any of these effects, and resolve in sequence, up to the number of "Gravekeeper's" monsters Tributed for its Summon;
● This card gains ATK equal to the combined Levels that all monsters Tributed for its Tribute Summon had on the field x 100.
● Destroy all Set monsters your opponent controls.
● All monsters your opponent currently controls lose 2000 ATK/DEF.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524de.name: Gravekeeper's Supernaturalist
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524de.description:
2 "Gravekeeper's" monsters
Gains ATK/DEF equal to the combined original Levels of the materials used for its Fusion Summon x 100. While "Necrovalley" is on the field, this card, and any card in your Field Zone, cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster or 1 "Necrovalley" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Gravekeeper's Supernaturalist" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e7.name: Gravi-Crush Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e7.description: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell Card you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ec.name: Gravity Blaster
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ec.description: Equip only to a Machine-Type monster. Once per turn: You can activate this effect; it permanently gains 400 ATK. (This ATK gain remains even if this card leaves the field or the monster becomes unaffected by card effects.) If it battles an opponent's monster, that monster's effect is negated during the Battle Phase only.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f1.name: Gray Wing
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f1.description: Discard 1 card from your hand during your Main Phase 1. This monster can attack twice during the Battle Phase of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fc.name: Great Angus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fc.description: A very violent beast, it is always berserk. People say that they have never seen it silent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52514.name: Green Turtle Summoner
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52514.description: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52524.name: Gruesome Goo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52524.description: A slime boss that is definitely tougher than it looks.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5255a.name: Gusto Squirro
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5255a.description: When this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher "Gusto" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52567.name: Hack Worm
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52567.description: If your opponent controls no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258b.name: Harpie Conductor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258b.description:
2 WIND monsters
This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Harpie Conductor" once per turn.
● If a "Harpie" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap you control instead.
● If another face-up "Harpie" monster you control returns to your hand (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; return it to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525af.name: Hazy Flame Sphynx
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525af.description: Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. You can declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard, then if it was the declared card type, you can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster from your hand or Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Hazy Flame Sphynx" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b1.name: Hazy Pillar
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b1.description: You can Normal Summon "Hazy Flame" monsters for 1 less Tribute. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 "Hazy Flame" monster from your hand or your side of the field to that Xyz Monster as an Xyz Material.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b7.name: Heartfelt Appeal
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b7.description: When you take battle damage from your opponent's direct attack: Take control of the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the highest DEF, until your next End Phase. (If it's a tie, you get to choose.) Its effects are negated, also it cannot declare an attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ca.name: Hecatrice
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ca.description: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f3.name: Hero Heart
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f3.description: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control; halve its ATK until the end of this turn, but it can attack twice during this turn's Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f5.name: Hero Mask
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f5.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; send 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, that target's name becomes the sent monster's name, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fe.name: Heroic Challenger - Assault Halberd
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fe.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can add 1 "Heroic" card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5262e.name: Hieratic Dragon of Tefnuit
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5262e.description: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). This card cannot attack during the turn it is Special Summoned this way. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY, but make its ATK/DEF 0.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52639.name: Hieratic Sun Dragon Overlord of Heliopolis
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52639.description:
2 Level 8 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; Tribute any number of monsters from your hand and/or your side of the field (minimum 1), then destroy an equal number of cards on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263a.name: Hieroglyph Lithograph
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263a.description: Pay 1000 Life Points. During the current Duel, your hand size limit becomes 7.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52644.name: Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52644.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52672.name: Humanoid Slime
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52672.description: This slime apparently has some human genes in its genetic makeup.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52681.name: Hushed Psychic Cleric
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52681.description: If this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: Change it to Defense Position. Once per turn: You can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, then target 1 Psychic-Type monster in your Graveyard; banish that target. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster banished by this card's effect; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52687.name: Hyena
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52687.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon any number of "Hyenas" from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52691.name: Hyper Psychic Riser
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52691.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Monsters with less ATK than this card cannot attack, also neither player can activate the effects of face-up monsters on the field with more ATK than this card. If this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY: You can target 1 Tuner and 1 non-Tuner monster in your GY with the same Type and Attribute as each other; add them to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Hyper Psychic Riser" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ad.name: Idaten the Conqueror Star
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ad.description:
2 Level 5 or higher Warrior monsters
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can add 1 Level 5 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Idaten the Conqueror Star" once per turn. Once per turn: You can discard any number of cards; this card gains 200 ATK for each card discarded. Once per battle, during damage calculation, if this card battles an opponent's monster with an equal or lower Level (Quick Effect): You can make that opponent's monster's ATK 0 during that damage calculation only.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52487.name: Gouki Bearhug
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52487.description: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gouki" card, or Normal Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; its ATK becomes half its original ATK until the end of this turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Gouki" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Gouki Bearhug". You can only use each effect of "Gouki Bearhug" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5248b.name: Gouki Finishing Move
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5248b.description: Target 1 "Gouki" Link Monster you control; it gains ATK equal to its Link Rating x 1000 until the end of this turn, also if it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot declare attacks, except with "Gouki" monsters. You can only activate 1 "Gouki Finishing Move" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b9.name: Grandram
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b9.description: If your opponent controls a face-up Xyz Monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in face-up Attack Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524da.name: Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524da.description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ff.name: Great Long Nose
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ff.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent skips their next Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52503.name: Great Phantom Thief
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52503.description: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card name; look at your opponent's hand, and if you do, discard all cards with that name in their hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5253b.name: Guardian of Order
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5253b.description: If you control 2 or more LIGHT monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only control 1 "Guardian of Order".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52542.name: Guardragon Corewakening
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52542.description: You can send 1 Effect Monster from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dragon Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY, in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Guardragon Corewakening" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5254e.name: Guldfaxe of the Nordic Beasts
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5254e.description: If your opponent controls a Synchro Monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52555.name: Gusto Codor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52555.description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 WIND Psychic-Type monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52592.name: Harpie Lady 3
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52592.description:
(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
An opponent's monster that battles this card cannot declare an attack during your opponent's next 2 turns.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525aa.name: Hazy Flame Griffin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525aa.description: If your opponent controls a monster, and all the monsters (if any) on your side of the field and in your Graveyard are FIRE (and only FIRE), you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b5.name: Heart of Clear Water
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b5.description: If the equipped monster's ATK is 1300 or higher, this card is destroyed. The monster equipped with this card is not destroyed as a result of battle or by the effect of a card that targets the monster. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52616.name: Hi-Speedroid Hagoita
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52616.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
During either player's turn: You can Tribute this card; increase the Levels of all monsters currently on the field by 1, until the end of this turn. If this card is in your Graveyard and you control a "Speedroid" Tuner monster: You can Special Summon this card, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except WIND monsters. You can only use this effect of "Hi-Speedroid Hagoita" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52619.name: Hi-Speedroid Puzzle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52619.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a Special Summoned monster: You can make this card's ATK become double its current ATK until the end of the Damage Step. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because this Synchro Summoned card was sent there from the field this turn: You can target 1 "Speedroid" monster in your Graveyard, except "Hi-Speedroid Puzzle"; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263e.name: High Tide Gyojin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263e.description: A very agile half-fish warrior known for its relentless attacks.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52647.name: Hip Hoshiningen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52647.description:
2 LIGHT monsters
All LIGHT monsters on the field gain 500 ATK/DEF, also all DARK monsters on the field lose 400 ATK/DEF. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 LIGHT monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Hip Hoshiningen" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52653.name: Honeybot
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52653.description:
2 Cyberse monsters
Neither player can target monsters this card points to with card effects, and those monsters cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5266d.name: Howling Insect
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5266d.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526be.name: Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracoslayer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526be.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Pendulum Monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 Pendulum Monster on the field or 1 card in the Pendulum Zone; destroy it, and if you do, shuffle 1 card on the field into the Deck. Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Dracoslayer" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, but it cannot be used as a Synchro Material for a Summon.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52493.name: Gouki Re-Match
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52493.description: Target 2 "Gouki" monsters in your GY with different Levels; Special Summon them in Defense Position. You can only activate 1 "Gouki Re-Match" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a2.name: Goyo Defender
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a2.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, if all monsters you control are EARTH Warrior-Type Synchro Monsters (min. 1): You can Special Summon "Goyo Defender" from your Extra Deck. When this card is targeted for an attack: You can make this card gain 1000 ATK for each EARTH Warrior-Type Synchro Monster you control (other than this card), until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c2.name: Grasschopper
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c2.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c4.name: Grave Ohja
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c4.description: While there is a face-down Defense Position monster(s) on your side of the field, no player can select this card as an attack target. Each time a monster on your side of the field is Flip Summoned, inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52506.name: Great Shogun Shien
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52506.description: If you control 2 or more face-up "Six Samurai" monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Your opponent can only activate 1 Spell/Trap Card each turn. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy a face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52529.name: Guard Go!
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52529.description: If a "Gagaga", "Dododo", and/or "Gogogo" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon it, then you can Special Summon up to 2 "Gagaga", "Dododo", and/or "Gogogo" monsters from your hand in Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52544.name: Guardragon Garmides
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52544.description: If a Normal Monster(s) is sent to your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Dragon monster from your hand to the GY; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Guardragon Garmides" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5255c.name: Gusto Thunbolt
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5255c.description: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard this turn: You can banish 1 "Gusto" monster from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 WIND Psychic-Type monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5256b.name: Half Counter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5256b.description: During damage calculation, if a monster you control is being attacked: Target that monster you control; that target gains ATK equal to half the original ATK of the attacking monster, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5256f.name: Halfway to Forever
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5256f.description: Target 2 monsters in your GY; Special Summon both, but negate their effects (if any), and if you do, immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 LIGHT "Utopia" or "Utopic" Xyz Monster using only those 2 monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52583.name: Hard Armor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52583.description: A living suit of armor that attacks enemies with a bone-jarring tackle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52596.name: Harpie Oracle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52596.description:
This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of these effects of "Harpie Oracle" once per turn.
● If you control a Level 5 or higher "Harpie" monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand, that specifically lists the card "Harpie Lady Sisters" in its text, during the End Phase of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a4.name: Hate Buster
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a4.description: When a Fiend-Type monster you control is targeted for an attack: Target the opponent's attacking monster and that monster you control; destroy both targets, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the original ATK of the opponent's destroyed monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a7.name: Hayate the Earth Star
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a7.description: If only your opponent controls a monster, or if you control a LIGHT monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 LIGHT Warrior monster from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Hayate the Earth Star" once per turn. Once per turn, when your Warrior monster is targeted for an attack: You can make this card lose exactly 500 ATK, and if you do, negate the attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ae.name: Hazy Flame Peryton
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ae.description: Cannot be Special Summoned, except by a "Hazy Flame" monster's effect. Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. You can send 1 FIRE monster from your hand to the Graveyard and Tribute this card; Special Summon 2 "Hazy Flame" monsters from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Hazy Flame Peryton" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e2.name: Heraldic Beast Basilisk
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e2.description: After damage calculation: Destroy any opponent's monster that battles this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ff.name: Heroic Challenger - Clasp Sword
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ff.description: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Heroic Challenger" monster: You can add 1 "Heroic Challenger" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Heroic Challenger - Clasp Sword" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5262a.name: Hieratic Dragon of Nebthet
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5262a.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Hieratic" monster. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Hieratic" monster, except this card, from your hand or your side of the field, to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5262f.name: Hieratic Seal From the Ashes
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5262f.description: Once per turn, during your opponent's turn: You can send 1 "Hieratic" monster from your Deck to your Graveyard. Once per turn, during your turn: You can target 1 of your banished "Hieratic" monsters; return that target to the Graveyard. When this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 "Hieratic" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52641.name: Hiita the Fire Charmer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52641.description: FLIP: Target 1 face-up FIRE monster your opponent controls; take control of that target while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52656.name: Horn Imp
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52656.description: A small fiend that dwells in the dark, its single horn makes it a formidable opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52675.name: Humid Winds
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52675.description: You can pay 1000 LP; add 1 "Aroma" monster from your Deck to your hand. If your LP is lower than your opponent's: You can gain 500 LP. You can only use each effect of "Humid Winds" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52677.name: Hundred Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52677.description: Once per turn: You can have this card gain Levels equal to the number of cards you control, and if you do, it gains 100 ATK for each Level gained. These changes last until the end of this turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 face-up monster you control that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; the first time that face-up monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, it is not destroyed. You can only use this effect of "Hundred Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52680.name: Hurricail
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52680.description: A tornado that ravages the wastelands with sharp winds that can cut to the bone.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a6.name: Ice Master
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a6.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 2 WATER monsters. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; place an Ice Counter on that target. You can Tribute this card; destroy all monsters with an Ice Counter(s).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a8.name: Ice Princess Zereort
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a8.description:
2 Level 5 Winged Beast-Type monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; its ATK becomes 0.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ac.name: Icy Crevasse
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ac.description: When exactly 1 monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; send that target to the Graveyard, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its original ATK in the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c2.name: Ignoble Knight of High Laundsallyn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c2.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Noble Knight" monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can equip 1 "Noble Arms" Equip Spell Card from your Deck to this card. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle and sent it to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Noble Knight" or "Noble Arms" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only control 1 "Ignoble Knight of High Laundsallyn".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524bb.name: Granmarg the Mega Monarch
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524bb.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Tribute Summoned monster. When this card is Tribute Summoned: Target up to 2 Set cards on the field; destroy those targets. If this card was Tribute Summoned by Tributing an EARTH monster, add this additional effect.
● Also, draw 1 card after that.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ea.name: Gravity Behemoth
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ea.description: If it is not the first turn of the Duel and there are no cards on the field, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can destroy all Field Spell Cards on the field. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5251c.name: Griggle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5251c.description: When the control of this face-up card on the field shifts to your opponent, increase your Life Points by 3000 points. This effect can only be used once as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252d.name: Guarded Treasure
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252d.description: Activate this card by discarding 5 cards; draw 2 cards. While this card is on the field, draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52548.name: Guardragon Reincarnation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52548.description: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it, that are all Link Monsters, from your field or GY. You can only activate 1 "Guardragon Reincarnation" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52562.name: Gyakutenno Megami
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52562.description: This fairy uses her mystical power to protect the weak and provide spiritual support.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52578.name: Hand of Nephthys
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52578.description: You can Tribute this card and 1 other monster; Special Summon 1 "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52584.name: Hard-sellin' Goblin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52584.description: Each time a monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, return 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone to its owner's hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525dc.name: Herald of Purple Light
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525dc.description: When your opponent activates a Trap Card (Quick Effect): You can send this card and 1 other Fairy monster from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e5.name: Heraldic Beast Leo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e5.description: During the End Phase of the turn this card was Normal Summoned: Destroy this card. When this card is sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Heraldic Beast Leo". You can only use this effect of "Heraldic Beast Leo" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52604.name: Heroic Challenger - Swordshield
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52604.description: During either player's turn, if you control a face-up "Heroic" monster: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; for the rest of this turn, you take no Battle Damage and "Heroic" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52637.name: Hieratic Seal of the Sun Dragon Overlord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52637.description: A mysterious engraved Hieratic relic. It was thought to be a simple stone, but it was actually infused with the power of a sun-wielding dragon. Aeons passed, and the power of the relic grew and grew until it finally shone like the sun itself.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52640.name: High and Low
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52640.description: When your face-up monster is targeted for an attack: Apply the following effect up to 3 times while you control that face-up attack target. ● Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard, and if it is a monster, the attack target gains ATK equal to the ATK of the monster you sent to the Graveyard, but if the attack target's ATK is higher than the attacking monster's ATK, destroy the attack target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5265a.name: Horn of the Phantom Beast
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5265a.description: Target 1 Beast or Beast-Warrior monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 800 ATK. If the equipped monster destroys your opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52662.name: Hoshiningen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52662.description: All LIGHT monsters on the field gain 500 ATK, also all DARK monsters on the field lose 400 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52676.name: Humpty Grumpty
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52676.description: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: It gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267a.name: Hungry Burger
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267a.description: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Hamburger Recipe". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52686.name: Hydrotortoise, the Empowered Warrior
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52686.description: FLIP: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a9.name: Ice Queen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a9.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. When this face-up card you control is destroyed and sent to your GY: You can target 1 Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand. You must have 3 or more Spellcaster monsters in your GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a1.name: Goyo Chaser
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a1.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
This card gains 300 ATK for each EARTH Warrior-Type Synchro Monster on the field (other than this card). When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon that monster to your side of the field, but its ATK becomes halved.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a3.name: Goyo Emperor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a3.description:
2 EARTH Warrior-Type Synchro Monsters
When this card, or a monster you control that is owned by your opponent, destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon that monster to your side of the field. When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), except during the Damage Step: You can Tribute 1 EARTH Warrior-Type Synchro Monster; take control of that monster(s). If this face-up card leaves the field: Return control of all monsters you control to the owner.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b6.name: GranSolfachord Musecia
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b6.description:
2 Pendulum Monsters
During your Main Phase: You can add 1 Pendulum Monster from your hand to the Extra Deck face-up, and 1 face-up Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to the hand, as long as one of them has an even Pendulum Scale, and the other has an odd Pendulum Scale. When you Pendulum Summon a "Solfachord" monster(s): You can target 1 of them; add 1 "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand, whose Level equals the Pendulum Scale of that monster. You can only activate each effect of "GranSolfachord Musecia" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524cf.name: Gravekeeper's Curse
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524cf.description: If this card is Summoned: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524dd.name: Gravekeeper's Stele
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524dd.description: Target 2 "Gravekeeper's" monsters in your GY; add those targets to your hand. This effect cannot be negated by the effect of "Necrovalley".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e4.name: Graverobber's Retribution
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e4.description: During each of your Standby Phases, inflict 100 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each of your opponent's monsters that have been removed from play.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f4.name: Graydle Combat

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52500.name: Great Maju Garzett
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52500.description: The ATK of this card becomes twice the original ATK of 1 monster that you Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52512.name: Green Gadget
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52512.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Red Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52518.name: Grenosaurus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52518.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52520.name: Ground Attacker Bugroth
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52520.description: A surface battle robot that was once used for sea warfare.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52528.name: Guard Ghost
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52528.description: If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can target 1 monster you control; it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn. During the End Phase, if this card is currently banished, and was banished this turn: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Guard Ghost" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52531.name: Guardian Dreadscythe
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52531.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If a "Guardian Eatos" is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. When this card is Special Summoned: You can equip 1 "Reaper Scythe - Dreadscythe" from your Deck to this card. You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters (but you can Normal Set). If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52549.name: Guardragon Shield
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52549.description: You can target 1 Dragon monster you control; it gains ATK/DEF equal to the total Link Rating of the Link Monsters currently on the field x 100, until the end of the opponent's turn. You can only use this effect of "Guardragon Shield" once per turn. Once per turn, if exactly 1 Dragon monster you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can send 1 Normal Monster from your hand or Deck to the GY instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257e.name: Hanewata
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257e.description: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; you take no effect damage this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52581.name: Happy Lover
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52581.description: Enemies become overjoyed when struck by the Heart Ray emitted from the forehead of this tiny cherub.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52587.name: Harmonic Oscillation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52587.description: If your opponent has 2 cards in their Pendulum Zones: Target those 2 cards; while both targets are in their Pendulum Zones, you can Pendulum Summon using their Pendulum Scales this turn, but only from the Extra Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258f.name: Harpie Lady
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258f.description: This human-shaped animal with wings is beautiful to watch but deadly in battle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52597.name: Harpie Perfumer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52597.description: This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand that specifically lists the card "Harpie Lady Sisters" in its text. If you controlled a Level 5 or higher "Harpie" monster when you activated this effect, you can also add a second such card, with a different name from the first. You can only use this effect of "Harpie Perfumer" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a9.name: Hazy Flame Cerbereus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a9.description: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1000. Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Hazy" card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ac.name: Hazy Flame Hyppogrif
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ac.description: Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 other FIRE monster; this card gains 300 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525c3.name: Heavy Slump
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525c3.description: If your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand: They shuffle their entire hand into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525cf.name: Helios Trice Megistus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525cf.description: You can Special Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Helios Duo Megistus". This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 300. After this card attacks, it can attack once more if your opponent controls a monster. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase and it gains 500 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525de.name: Herald of the Abyss
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525de.description: Pay 1500 LP and declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; your opponent must send 1 face-up monster with the declared Type and Attribute from their field to the GY, if possible. For the rest of this turn, your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters with that sent monster's name. You can only activate 1 "Herald of the Abyss" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e4.name: Heraldic Beast Eale
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e4.description: If you control 2 or more "Heraldic Beast" monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e8.name: Heraldry Change
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e8.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Special Summon 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster from your hand, then end the Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e9.name: Heraldry Reborn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e9.description: Target 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f6.name: Hero Medal
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f6.description: When this Set card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, shuffle this card into its owner's Deck. Then draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f8.name: Hero Signal
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f8.description: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52601.name: Heroic Challenger - Extra Sword
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52601.description:
An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card as Xyz Material gains this effect.
● When it is Xyz Summoned: It gains 1000 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52610.name: Hey, Trunade!
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52610.description: Return all Set Spells and Traps on the field to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52613.name: Hi-Speedroid Chanbara
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52613.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles: It gains 200 ATK. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 of your banished "Speedroid" cards; add it to your hand. You can only Special Summon "Hi-Speedroid Chanbara(s)" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5261f.name: Hidden Passage
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5261f.description: All Level 2 or lower Spellcaster-Type monsters you control with ATK lower than the face-up monster your opponent controls with the lowest ATK can attack your opponent directly.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52626.name: Hieratic Dragon King of Atum
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52626.description:
2 Level 6 Dragon monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 Dragon monster from your Deck, but make its ATK/DEF 0. This card cannot attack during the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a4.name: Ice Hand
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a4.description: When this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card (by battle or card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card they control; destroy that target, then you can Special Summon 1 "Fire Hand" from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b3.name: Igknight Gallant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b3.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have an "Igknight" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy both cards in your Pendulum Zones, and if you do, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
A leader of the most dashing Igknight commando unit. His greatest challenge is keeping the hot tempers of his men under control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b4.name: Igknight Lancer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b4.description: While this card is in your hand: You can target 3 "Igknight" cards you control; destroy them, and if you do, Special Summon this card. Once per turn: You can target 1 other "Igknight" monster you control; return it to the hand, and if you do, place 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls on the bottom of the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ac.name: Graceful Tear
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ac.description: Add 1 card from your hand to your opponent's hand, then gain 2000 LP.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b1.name: Granadora
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b1.description: When this monster is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Special Summoned, increase your Life Points by 1000 points. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you take 2000 points of damage.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ef.name: Gravity Lash
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ef.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses ATK equal to its DEF until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fa.name: Graydle Slime Jr.
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fa.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Graydle" monster in your Graveyard; for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon other monsters, except WATER monsters, also Special Summon that monster, then you can Special Summon from your hand, 1 Aqua-Type monster with the same Level as the monster Special Summoned by this card's effect. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Graydle" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fd.name: Great Bill
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fd.description: Nothing escapes from this beast's massive mouth.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5255f.name: Gwenhwyfar, Queen of Noble Arms
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5255f.description:
You can target 1 "Noble Knight" monster you control; equip this card from your hand or Graveyard to that target. You can only use this effect of "Gwenhwyfar, Queen of Noble Arms" once per turn. The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. Apply the appropriate effect, depending on the Attribute of the equipped monster.
● LIGHT: If the equipped monster would be destroyed by a card effect, you can destroy this card instead.
● DARK: If the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster, at the start of the Damage Step: You can destroy that monster, then destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52575.name: Hammer Shot
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52575.description: Destroy 1 face-up Attack Position monster with the highest ATK. (If it is a tie, you get to choose.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52580.name: Hannibal Necromancer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52580.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 face-up Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52591.name: Harpie Lady 2
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52591.description:
(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
Negate the effects of Flip monsters this card destroys by battle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5259b.name: Harpie's Feather Rest
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5259b.description: Target 3 "Harpie Lady" and/or "Harpie Lady Sisters" in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card. If you controlled a Level 5 or higher "Harpie" monster when you activated this effect, draw 2 cards instead. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except WIND monsters. You can only activate 1 "Harpie's Feather Rest" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525bf.name: Heavy Knight of the Flame
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525bf.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a Special Summoned monster: You can banish that monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525c1.name: Heavy Mech Support Platform
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525c1.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 500 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e3.name: Heraldic Beast Berners Falcon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e3.description: When this card is Summoned: You can make all face-up Level 5 or higher monsters you currently control become Level 4.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ee.name: Hermit of Prophecy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ee.description: Each time a "Spellbook" Spell Card is activated, increase this card's Level by 2 and ATK by 300.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f0.name: Hero Blast
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f0.description: Target 1 "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand, then if your opponent controls any monsters with ATK less than or equal to that target's ATK, destroy 1 of them.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fc.name: Heroic Advance
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fc.description: When a face-up "Heroic" monster you control is targeted for an attack: Target another face-up Level 4 or lower "Heroic" monster you control; double its ATK during this Battle Phase, then switch the attack target to it and conduct damage calculation, but monsters cannot be destroyed by this battle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5261b.name: Hibernation Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5261b.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Dragon monster in your GY; add it to your hand. While you control no Link Monsters, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 DARK Dragon Link Monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Hibernation Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52620.name: Hidden Soldiers
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52620.description: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower DARK monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5264a.name: Hitodenchak
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5264a.description: A rabid starfish that spits a lethal acid that can melt almost anything.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52658.name: Horn of Light
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52658.description: Increase the DEF of a monster equipped with this card by 800 points. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, if you pay 500 Life Points, this card returns to the top of your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5266b.name: House of Adhesive Tape
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5266b.description: If the DEF of a monster summoned by your opponent (excluding Special Summon) is 500 points or less, the monster is destroyed.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52674.name: Humhumming the Key Djinn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52674.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Djinn" Xyz Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, then you can attach up to 2 cards from your hand to it as Xyz Materials. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 "Djinn" Xyz Monster you control; this turn, it can attack your opponent directly.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52685.name: Hydrogeddon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52685.description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Hydrogeddon" from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52689.name: Hyo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52689.description: None can survive the cold touch of this sub-zero warrior.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5269e.name: Ib the World Chalice Priestess
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5269e.description:
2 monsters with different Types and Attributes
This linked card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Your opponent cannot target this linked card with card effects. If a monster(s) this card points to would be destroyed by a card effect, you can send this card to the GY instead. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "World Chalice" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b0.name: Igknight Cavalier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b0.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have an "Igknight" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy both cards in your Pendulum Zones, and if you do, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
The vaunted weapons of this pink Igknight have inflicted as much damage to her enemies as to her own troops, but she gets results so very few complain.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526bf.name: Ignition Beast Volcannon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526bf.description:
1 Machine-Type monster + 1 Pyro-Type monster
When this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, also destroy this card, then if both monsters were destroyed, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK of the monster in the Graveyard that was targeted by this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ad.name: Gradius
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ad.description: A high-performance jet fighter with power capsules for variable attack capabilities.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5249c.name: Gouki The Master Ogre
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5249c.description:
2+ "Gouki" monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can return to the hand any number of "Gouki" monsters you control that this card points to, then target the same number of face-up cards your opponent controls; they have their effects negated until the end of this turn. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. If your opponent controls a face-up monster(s), this card can only target their monster with the highest ATK for attacks (your choice, if tied).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a4.name: Goyo Guardian
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a4.description:
1 EARTH Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon that monster to your field in Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524bf.name: Grappler
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524bf.description: A devious snake with a thick body that wraps around an enemy monster and squeezes the life out of it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d2.name: Gravekeeper's Headman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d2.description: If this card is Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Gravekeeper's Headman" once per turn. This effect is unaffected by "Necrovalley".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524df.name: Gravekeeper's Vassal
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524df.description: Any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is treated as effect damage instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252c.name: Guard Penguin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252c.description: When you take damage from a card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, gain LP equal to the damage you took.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52558.name: Gusto Griffin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52558.description: If this card is sent from the hand to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Gusto" monster from your Deck. You can only use the effect of "Gusto Griffin" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52564.name: H - Heated Heart
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52564.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; until the end of this turn, it gains 500 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52586.name: Hardened Armed Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52586.description:
(This card is not treated as an "Armed Dragon" card.)
You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by sending 1 Level 8 or higher monster from your hand to the Graveyard. If you Tribute this card for the Tribute Summon of a Level 7 or higher monster, that monster cannot be destroyed by card effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a1.name: Harpies' Hunting Ground
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a1.description: All Winged Beast monsters gain 200 ATK/DEF. If any "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" is Normal or Special Summoned: The player who conducted the Summon targets 1 Spell/Trap on the field; that player destroys that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b2.name: Head Judging
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b2.description: When a monster on the field activates its effect: You can make the activating player toss a coin and call it. If they call it right, send this card to the GY. If they call it wrong, negate that effect's activation, and if you do, change control of that monster to their opponent. You can only use this effect of "Head Judging" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d2.name: Helmer, Helmsman Fur Hire
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d2.description: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 monster "Fur Hire" from your hand, except "Helmer, Helmsman Fur Hire". If a monster "Fur Hire" is Special Summoned to your field while you control this monster (except during the Damage Step): You can discard 1 card "Fur Hire"; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Helmer, Helmsman Fur Hire" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d6.name: Herald of Creation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d6.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Level 7 or higher monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d7.name: Herald of Green Light
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d7.description: When your opponent activates a Spell Card (Quick Effect): You can send this card and 1 other Fairy monster from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e7.name: Heraldic Beast Unicorn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e7.description: You can banish this card from your Graveyard to target 1 Psychic-Type Xyz Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. Its effects are negated. You can only use the effect of "Heraldic Beast Unicorn" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f7.name: Hero Ring
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f7.description: Target 1 Warrior-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK; equip this card to that target. Monsters your opponent controls with 1900 or more ATK cannot attack that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52624.name: Hidden Village of Ninjitsu Arts
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52624.description: If a "Ninja" monster is Summoned to your field: You can target 1 "Ninja" monster or 1 "Ninjitsu Art" card in your GY; add it to your hand, but you cannot activate cards, or the effects of cards, with that name for the rest of this turn. If a "Ninja" monster(s) or "Ninjitsu Art" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, you can banish 1 "Ninja" monster from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Hidden Village of Ninjitsu Arts" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5264b.name: Hitotsu-Me Giant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5264b.description: A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52665.name: Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Bane
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52665.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner DARK Dragon Synchro Monster
You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can Special Summon 2 Tuners with the same Level (1 from your Deck and 1 from your GY) in Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Bane" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52683.name: Hydro Genex
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52683.description:
"Genex Controller" + 1 or more non-Tuner WATER monsters
When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, gain Life Points equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5268e.name: Hyper Hammerhead
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5268e.description: At the end of the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster that battled this card is not destroyed: Return that opponent's monster to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5269a.name: Hysteric Sign
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5269a.description: When this card is activated: Add 1 "Elegant Egotist" from your Deck or GY to your hand. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there from the hand or field this turn: Add up to 3 "Harpie" cards with different names from each other from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Hysteric Sign" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a3.name: Ice Dragon's Prison
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a3.description: Target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your field, but its effects are negated, then, you can banish 1 monster from both players' fields that have the same Type as each other. You can only activate 1 "Ice Dragon's Prison" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b2.name: Igknight Crusader
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b2.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have an "Igknight" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy both cards in your Pendulum Zones, and if you do, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
This impulsive Igknight warrior is fanatical about the causes he fights for. Because of this passion, his comrades try to keep him at arm's length.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ba.name: Grandsoil the Elemental Lord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ba.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 5 EARTH monsters in your GY. When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster in either player's GY; Special Summon that target. You can only use this effect of "Grandsoil the Elemental Lord" once per turn. If this face-up card leaves the field, skip the Battle Phase of your next turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ca.name: Gravekeeper's Ambusher
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ca.description: When this card is flipped face-up: You can target 1 card in your opponent's GY; place that target on the bottom of their Deck. If this card is sent from the field to the GY after being flipped face-up: You can target 1 "Necrovalley" card in your GY; add that target to your hand. These effects are unaffected by "Necrovalley".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524cb.name: Gravekeeper's Assailant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524cb.description: When this card declares an attack while "Necrovalley" is on the field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ce.name: Gravekeeper's Commandant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ce.description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "Necrovalley" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e2.name: Gravelstorm
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e2.description: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on each side of the field; return them to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52511.name: Green Duston
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52511.description: Cannot be used as a Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Material for a Summon. While this card is face-up on the field, it cannot be Tributed. When this card on the field is destroyed: The controller targets 1 Spell/Trap Card they control; return that target to the hand. You can only control 1 face-up "Green Duston".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52534.name: Guardian Grarl
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52534.description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Gravity Axe - Grarl". If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52545.name: Guardragon Justicia
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52545.description: ''The fate of the World depends on the Guardragons, born from the World Legacy.''

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52553.name: Gust
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52553.description: You can activate this card when 1 or more of your Spell Cards are destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard by a card effect your opponent controls. Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52565.name: HERO's Bond
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52565.description: If there is a face-up "HERO" monster on the field: Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower "Elemental HERO" monsters from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52566.name: HTS Psyhemuth
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52566.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52568.name: Hade-Hane
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52568.description: FLIP: You can return up to 3 monsters on the field to the owner's hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5256c.name: Half Shut
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5256c.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it cannot be destroyed by battle this turn, also its ATK is halved until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ad.name: Hazy Flame Mantikor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ad.description: Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can send 1 FIRE monster, except this card, from your hand or face-up from your side of the field to the Graveyard; this card cannot be destroyed by card effects this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e6.name: Heraldic Beast Twin-Headed Eagle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e6.description: You can banish this card from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up Xyz Monster you control with no Xyz Materials and 2 "Heraldic Beast" monsters in your Graveyard; attach those monsters from the Graveyard to that face-up Xyz Monster, as Xyz Materials. You can only use the effect of "Heraldic Beast Twin-Headed Eagle" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ec.name: Hercules Beetle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ec.description: A massive beetle with a tough carapace and a dangerous horn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ef.name: Hero Barrier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ef.description: During your opponent's turn: You can activate this card; during the Battle Step, any opponent's attack that takes place while you control an "Elemental HERO" monster is negated, but this effect only works once.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52612.name: Hi-Speed Re-Level
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52612.description: Banish 1 "Speedroid" monster from your Graveyard, then target 1 Synchro Monster you control; until the end of this turn, change its Level to the banished monster's Level, and it gains ATK equal to that monster's Level x 500.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52621.name: Hidden Spellbook
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52621.description: During your turn: Target 2 Spell Cards in your Graveyard; shuffle those targets into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52625.name: Hieracosphinx
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52625.description: Your opponent cannot select a face-down Defense Position monster as an attack target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52628.name: Hieratic Dragon of Eset
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52628.description: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1000. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Dragon-Type Normal Monster on the field; the Levels of all face-up "Hieratic" monsters currently on the field become the Level of that monster, until the End Phase. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263c.name: High Priestess of Prophecy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263c.description: You can reveal 3 "Spellbook" Spells in your hand; Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Spellbook" Spell from your hand or GY, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5265e.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5265e.description: Control of this face-up card cannot switch. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52667.name: Hourglass of Courage
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52667.description: If this card is Normal or Flip Summoned, its original ATK and DEF are halved until the End Phase of your next turn. After that, the original ATK and DEF are doubled.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267b.name: Hunter Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267b.description: This dragon has taken down countless prey with its sharp fangs. It strikes very quickly, because if it does not strike first it is vulnerable to a counter-attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52688.name: Hymn of Light
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52688.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Saffira, Queen of Dragons". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 6 or more. If a Ritual Monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect while this card is in your Graveyard, you can banish this card instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c4.name: Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Sprite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c4.description: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Dream Mirror" monster: You can add 1 "Dream Mirror" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Sprite". During the Main or Battle Phase, if "Dream Mirror of Terror" is in a Field Zone (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Mara" from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Sprite" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5248f.name: Gouki Iron Claw
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5248f.description: During the Damage Step, when your "Gouki" monster battles an opponent's monster (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; until the end of this turn, your monster gains 500 ATK, and if it does, it is unaffected by your opponent's card effects. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Gouki" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Gouki Iron Claw". You can only use each effect of "Gouki Iron Claw" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a0.name: Gouki Twistcobra
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a0.description: (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 "Gouki" monster, then target 1 "Gouki" monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster until the end of this turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Gouki" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Gouki Twistcobra". You can only use each effect of "Gouki Twistcobra" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ab.name: Graceful Revival
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524ab.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 Level 2 or lower monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b5.name: Grand Tiki Elder
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b5.description: A masked monster that wields the most deadly of curses.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b7.name: Grandmaster of the Six Samurai
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b7.description: You can only control 1 "Grandmaster of the Six Samurai". If you control a "Six Samurai" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: Target 1 "Six Samurai" monster in your GY; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524cd.name: Gravekeeper's Chief
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524cd.description: You can only control 1 face-up "Gravekeeper's Chief". Your GY is unaffected by "Necrovalley". When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5250c.name: Greed
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5250c.description: Each time a player draws cards because of a card effect, they take 250 damage during the End Phase for each card drawn by the card effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252a.name: Guard Mines
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252a.description: Activate only when a card is activated with an effect that would target and destroy 1 monster you control. Negate the effect and destroy that card. Then inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252e.name: Guardian Angel Joan
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252e.description: When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Gain Life Points equal to the original ATK of that destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52532.name: Guardian Eatos
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52532.description: If you have no monsters in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can send 1 of your Equip Spell Cards equipped to this card to the Graveyard, then target up to 3 monsters in your opponent's Graveyard; banish those targets, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK for each monster banished by this effect, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52540.name: Guardragon Andrake
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52540.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by a card effect. If this card is Special Summoned from the hand or Deck: You can double this card's original ATK/DEF, until the end of the next turn. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY, or if this banished card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Guardragon Andrake" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52573.name: Hammer Bounzer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52573.description: If your opponent controls a card and you control no cards, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If this card attacks an opponent's monster, as long as you control no Spell/Trap Cards, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52585.name: Hard-sellin' Zombie
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52585.description: Each time a monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, select 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard and return it to the bottom of their Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258c.name: Harpie Dancer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258c.description: You can target 1 WIND monster you control; return it to the hand, then you can Normal Summon 1 WIND monster. You can only use this effect of "Harpie Dancer" once per turn. This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258e.name: Harpie Harpist

● During the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was sent there this turn: You can add 1 Level 4 Winged Beast-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52598.name: Harpie Queen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52598.description: This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Harpies' Hunting Ground" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525cd.name: Helios - The Primordial Sun
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525cd.description: This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 100.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e0.name: Heraldic Beast Aberconway
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e0.description: If this card is in the Graveyard: You can banish another "Heraldic Beast Aberconway" from your Graveyard to target 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Heraldic Beast Aberconway" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5260b.name: Heroic Gift
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5260b.description: If your opponent's Life Points are 2000 or less: Make their Life Points 8000, and if you do, draw 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Heroic Gift" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5260d.name: Hexa Spirit of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5260d.description: While you control another "Ice Barrier" monster, monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK/DEF. During your Main Phase: You can send 1 Level 3 or lower "Ice Barrier" monster from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, this card's Level becomes the same as that monster's, until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Hexa Spirit of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52617.name: Hi-Speedroid Kendama
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52617.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hi-Speedroid Kendama" once per turn.
● You can banish 1 Machine-Type monster from your Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.
● If this card is in your Graveyard and you control no cards: You can Special Summon this card. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52650.name: Holograh
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52650.description: This machine generates illusions that leave an enemy wide open to attacks.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52679.name: Hundred-Footed Horror
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52679.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1300.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267e.name: Hunter of Black Feathers
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267e.description: While your opponent controls 2 or more face-up monsters, all of the same Type, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to select and destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52699.name: Hysteric Party
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52699.description: Activate this card by discarding 1 card; Special Summon as many copies of "Harpie Lady" as possible from your Graveyard. When this face-up card leaves the field, destroy those monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b1.name: Igknight Champion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b1.description: While this card is in your hand: You can target 3 "Igknight" cards you control; destroy them, and if you do, Special Summon this card. Once per turn: You can target 1 other "Igknight" monster you control; return it to the hand, and if you do, place 1 monster your opponent controls on the bottom of the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b5.name: Igknight Margrave
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b5.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have an "Igknight" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy both cards in your Pendulum Zones, and if you do, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
A high-ranking Igknight warrior. When he does enter the fray, his sweeping attacks are feared not just by the enemy but also his own troops.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b8.name: Igknight Squire
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b8.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have an "Igknight" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy both cards in your Pendulum Zones, and if you do, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
The cold steel armor of this young squire cannot hide the keen, burning mind contained within.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524b0.name: Gragonith, Lightsworn Dragon
