60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d1.name: Gravekeeper's Guard
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d1.description: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d7.name: Gravekeeper's Recruiter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d7.description: If this card you control is sent to your GY: Add 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52508.name: Great Spirit
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52508.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned, you can switch the original ATK and DEF of 1 face-up EARTH monster on the field until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52517.name: Gren, Tactician of Dark World
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52517.description: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52570.name: Hallohallo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52570.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; roll a six-sided die and that monster's Level becomes the same as the result until the end of this turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
Hallo Hallo, brain of tallow,
Guts are gone, noggin's hollow.
Seeking sweets and marshing mallows,
Watch your back, and your candy sack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258a.name: Harpie Channeler
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258a.description: You can discard 1 "Harpie" card; Special Summon 1 "Harpie" monster from your Deck in face-up Defense Position, except "Harpie Channeler". You can only use this effect of "Harpie Channeler" once per turn. While you control a Dragon-Type monster, this card's Level becomes 7. This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while it is on the field or in the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52593.name: Harpie Lady Elegance

If this card you control is destroyed by a "Harpie" card's effect or your opponent's card effect: Add 1 "Harpie" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Harpie Lady Elegance" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5259e.name: Harpie's Pet Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5259e.description: Gains 300 ATK/DEF for each "Harpie Lady" on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a8.name: Hazy Flame Basiltrice
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a8.description:
2 or more Level 6 FIRE monsters

Your opponent cannot target a monster equipped with this card with card effects, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525db.name: Herald of Pure Light
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525db.description:
2 Level 2 monsters

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5261c.name: Hibikime

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c6.name: Grave Squirmer

When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5265c.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Noble Knight's Spearholder" or 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52668.name: Hourglass of Life

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267f.name: Hunting Instinct

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52692.name: Hyper Synchron

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52693.name: Hyper-Ancient Shark Megalodon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52693.description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

2 Level 4 Winged Beast-Type monsters

This Igknight has a reputation as a thinker with a cool head. But the truth is that his emotions just take longer to heat up.

● During their Main Phase, they can Normal Summon 1 monster from their hand to their zone this card points to, in addition to their Normal Summon/Set. (They can only gain this effect once per turn.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524dc.name: Gravekeeper's Spy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524dc.description: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e9.name: Gravity Axe - Grarl
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e9.description: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. Monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f9.name: Graydle Slime
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f9.description: If this card is in your hand or Graveyard: You can target 2 "Graydle" cards you control; destroy them, and if you do, Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Graydle Slime" once per turn. When Summoned this way: You can target 1 "Graydle" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52526.name: Gryphon's Feather Duster
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52526.description: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on your side of the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of destroyed cards x 500 points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5253a.name: Guardian of Felgrand
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5253a.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can equip 1 Level 7 or 8 Dragon-Type monster from your hand or Graveyard to this card. This card gains ATK and DEF equal to half the ATK and DEF of the monster equipped to it by this effect. You can Tribute 1 monster and this card, then target 1 Level 7 or 8 Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5255e.name: Guts of Steel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5255e.description: Select 3 "Scrap" monsters in your Graveyard. Your opponent picks 1 of them, you Special Summon it to either player's side of the field, and remove the rest from play.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ab.name: Hazy Flame Hydra
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ab.description:
Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. You cannot Special Summon monsters, except FIRE monsters. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card as an Xyz Material gains this effect.
● When it is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 "Hazy Flame" monster in your Graveyard; attach that target to this card as an Xyz Material.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b6.name: Heart of the Underdog
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b6.description: During your Draw Phase, when you draw a Normal Monster(s): You can reveal it; draw 1 more card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525bd.name: Heavy Forward
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525bd.description:
When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Infinitrack" monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn: You can target 1 Machine Xyz Monster you control, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Change its battle position.
● Attach this card to it as material.
You can only activate 1 "Heavy Forward" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ce.name: Helios Duo Megistus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ce.description: You can Special Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Helios - The Primordial Sun". This card's ATK and DEF are equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 200. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase, and it gains 300 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e1.name: Heraldic Beast Amphisbaena
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525e1.description: You can discard 1 other "Heraldic Beast" monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn: You can discard 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster; this card gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ea.name: Heraldry Record
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525ea.description: When an effect of your opponent's Xyz Monster is activated by detaching its own Xyz Material(s): Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5262b.name: Hieratic Dragon of Nuit
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5262b.description: Once per turn, during either player's turn, when this face-up card on the field is targeted by a Spell Card, Trap Card, or card effect: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52633.name: Hieratic Seal of Reflection
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52633.description: When a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect is activated: Tribute 1 "Hieratic" monster; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52682.name: Hydra Viper
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52682.description: Each time this card declares an attack, you must Tribute 1 Aqua-Type monster. This card can attack 3 times during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5268b.name: Hyozanryu
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5268b.description: A dragon created from a massive diamond that sparkles with blinding light.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5268c.name: Hyper Blaze
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5268c.description: To Special Summon "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" using its own procedure, you can also use face-down Traps you control. Once per battle, when an attack is declared involving your "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames": You can send 1 Trap from your hand or Deck to the GY; its ATK/DEF become the number of face-up Traps on the field and in the GYs x 1000, for the rest of this turn. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; add to your hand or Special Summon, 1 "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" from your GY, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5268f.name: Hyper Psychic Blaster
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5268f.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Psychic-Type Monsters
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a Defense Position monster and that monster's DEF is lower than this card's ATK (use its original values if the other monster is no longer on the field): Gain LP equal to the surplus.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c3.name: Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Mara
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c3.description: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Dream Mirror" monster: You can Special Summon 1 "Dream Mirror" monster from your hand, except "Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Mara". During the Main or Battle Phase, if "Dream Mirror of Joy" is in a Field Zone (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Sprite" from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Mara" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52490.name: Gouki Jet Ogre
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52490.description:
2 "Gouki" monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 "Gouki" card you control; destroy it, and if you do, change all monsters on the field to face-up Attack Position. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can make all "Gouki" monsters you currently control gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Gouki Jet Ogre" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524bd.name: Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524bd.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your Graveyard) by returning 1 "Dark World" monster you control to the hand, except "Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World". If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target, then, if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, look at 1 random card in your opponent's hand, then, if it was a monster, you can Special Summon it to your side of the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d0.name: Gravekeeper's Descendant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d0.description: You can Tribute 1 other face-up "Gravekeeper's" monster to target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d3.name: Gravekeeper's Heretic
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d3.description: This card on the field is unaffected by all other card effects, as long as "Necrovalley" is also on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d6.name: Gravekeeper's Priestess
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d6.description: While there is no face-up Field Spell, the field is treated as "Necrovalley". All "Gravekeeper's" monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d8.name: Gravekeeper's Servant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524d8.description: Your opponent must send 1 card from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard to declare an attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524db.name: Gravekeeper's Spiritualist
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524db.description: During your Main Phase, if "Necrovalley" is on the field: You can Fusion Summon 1 Spellcaster Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using this card you control and other monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. You can only use this effect of "Gravekeeper's Spiritualist" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e0.name: Gravekeeper's Visionary
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e0.description: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster. This card gains 200 ATK for each "Gravekeeper's" monster in your Graveyard. If this face-up card would be destroyed, you can discard 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e3.name: Graverobber
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e3.description: Select 1 Spell Card from your opponent's Graveyard. You can use it as your hand until the end of the turn. If you use it, you take 2000 points of damage.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f0.name: Gravity Warrior
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f0.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: It gains 300 ATK for each face-up monster your opponent controls. Once per turn, during your opponent's Battle Phase: You can target 1 Defense Position monster your opponent controls; change it to face-up Attack Position, also it must attack this turn, if able.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52504.name: Great Poseidon Beetle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52504.description: If this card targets an opponent's face-up Attack Position monster for an attack, and that monster is not destroyed by the battle, this card can attack the same monster again in a row. This effect can only be used twice per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52509.name: Great White
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52509.description: A giant white shark with razor-sharp teeth.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52515.name: Greenkappa
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52515.description: FLIP: Target 2 Set Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52525.name: Gryphon Wing
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52525.description: When your opponent activates "Harpie's Feather Duster": Negate its effect, and if you do, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52530.name: Guardian Ceal
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52530.description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Shooting Star Bow - Ceal". You can send 1 Equip Spell Card you control that is equipped to this card to the Graveyard to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52539.name: Guardian Tryce
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52539.description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce". When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon the monster from the Graveyard that was used for its Tribute Summon.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5253e.name: Guardian of the Throne Room
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5253e.description: A robot guard built to protect throne rooms, it is armed with homing missiles.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257a.name: Hand-Holding Genie
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257a.description: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one. This card gains DEF equal to the combined original DEF of all other face-up Defense Position monsters you control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52582.name: Happy Marriage
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52582.description: The equipped monster gains ATK equal to the combined original ATK of all monsters you control that are owned by your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52594.name: Harpie Lady Phoenix Formation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52594.description: If you control 3 or more "Harpie Lady" and/or "Harpie Lady Sisters": Target as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, but not more than the total number of "Harpie Lady" and "Harpie Lady Sisters" you control; destroy those targets, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the highest original ATK among those destroyed monsters (your choice, if tied). You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Main Deck or Extra Deck, nor conduct your Battle Phase, the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a3.name: Harvest Angel of Wisdom
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a3.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can target 1 Counter Trap in your GY; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b9.name: Heat Wave
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b9.description: At the start of your Main Phase 1: Neither player can Normal or Special Summon Effect Monsters, until your next Draw Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f1.name: Hero Counterattack
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525f1.description: When an "Elemental HERO" monster you control is destroyed by battle: Your opponent chooses and reveals 1 random card from your hand, then, if it is an "Elemental HERO" monster, you destroy 1 monster your opponent controls and Special Summon the chosen monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52606.name: Heroic Challenger - War Hammer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52606.description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can equip the destroyed monster to this card. (You can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card with this effect.) This card gains ATK equal to that equipped monster's ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52609.name: Heroic Champion - Kusanagi
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52609.description:
3 Level 4 Warrior-Type monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a Trap Card is activated: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, then this card gains 500 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52631.name: Hieratic Seal of Convocation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52631.description: Add 1 "Hieratic" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52635.name: Hieratic Seal of the Dragon King
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52635.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Hieratic" monster, except "Hieratic Seal of the Dragon King", from your hand, Deck or Graveyard, in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263b.name: Hierophant of Prophecy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263b.description:
2 Level 7 Spellcaster-Type monsters
 Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy Spell/Trap Card(s) your opponent controls, up to the number of "Spellbook" Spell Cards in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a8.name: Gozuki
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524a8.description: During your Main Phase: You can send 1 Zombie monster from your Deck to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY: You can banish 1 Zombie monster from your GY, except "Gozuki"; Special Summon 1 Zombie monster from your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gozuki" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52646.name: Hinotama Soul
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52646.description: An intensely hot flame creature that rams anything standing in its way.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52670.name: Huge Revolution
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52670.description: This card can only be activated during your Main Phase when "People Running About", "Oppressed People", and "United Resistance" are face-up on your side of the field. Send all cards in your opponent's hand to the Graveyard and destroy all cards your opponent controls on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524aa.name: Graceful Dice
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524aa.description: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters you currently control gain ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52671.name: Human-Wave Tactics
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52671.description: During the End Phase of each turn, select a number of Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters from your Deck equal to the number of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters destroyed as a result of battle during that turn, and Special Summon them to your side of the field. The Deck is then shuffled.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524bc.name: Granmarg the Rock Monarch
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524bc.description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c3.name: Grave Lure
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c3.description: Turn the top card of your opponent's Deck face-up, then your opponent shuffles their Deck. When your opponent draws the face-up card, immediately send it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c5.name: Grave Protector
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c5.description: Any monster destroyed by battle is shuffled into the Deck instead of going to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5250b.name: Greatfly
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5250b.description:
2 WIND monsters
All WIND monsters on the field gain 500 ATK/DEF, also all EARTH monsters on the field lose 400 ATK/DEF. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 WIND monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Greatfly" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5251b.name: Griffore
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5251b.description: This monster's tough hide deflects almost any attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52522.name: Ground Spider
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52522.description: Once per turn, if you control this face-up Defense Position monster when your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s), you can change that monster(s) to Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52550.name: Gundari
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52550.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card battles a Synchro Monster, return both monsters to their owners' hands at the start of the Damage Step (without damage calculation).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52560.name: Gyaku-Gire Panda
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52560.description: Increase the ATK of this card by 500 points for each monster on your opponent's side of the field. When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52563.name: Gyroid
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52563.description: Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52572.name: Hamburger Recipe
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52572.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Hungry Burger". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52574.name: Hammer Shark
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52574.description: Once per turn: You can reduce the Level of this card by 1, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower WATER monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52576.name: Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52576.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Continuous Spells you control to the GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. While this card is in face-up Defense Position, monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257c.name: Handigallop
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257c.description: Cannot attack directly. Gains ATK equal to the difference between your LP and your opponent's. If your LP are higher than your opponent's, you take any battle damage your opponent would have taken from battles involving this attacking card, instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257d.name: Hane-Hane
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257d.description: FLIP: Select 1 monster on the field and return it to its owner's hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257f.name: Haniwa
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257f.description: An earthen figure that protects the tomb of an ancient ruler.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258d.name: Harpie Girl
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5258d.description: A Harpie chick who aspires to flit about beautifully and gorgeously, but attack sharply.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a6.name: Hayabusa Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525a6.description: This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b8.name: Heartless Drop Off
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b8.description: When a face-up card(s) on the field and/or in the GY is added to your opponent's hand by an effect: Look at their hand, also banish the added card(s) and all cards with the same name, if any.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525be.name: Heavy Freight Train Derricrane
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525be.description: If an EARTH Machine monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, but its original ATK/DEF become halved. You can only use this effect of "Heavy Freight Train Derricrane" once per turn. If this card is detached from an Xyz Monster and sent to the GY to activate that monster's effect: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d3.name: Helping Robo for Combat
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d3.description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card, then return 1 card from your hand to the bottom of the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52634.name: Hieratic Seal of Supremacy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52634.description: Special Summon 1 "Hieratic" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52678.name: Hundred Eyes Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52678.description:
1 DARK Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Fiend-Type monsters
Once per turn: You can banish 1 Level 6 or lower DARK Effect Monster from your Graveyard; until the End Phase, this card's name becomes that banished monster's, and replace this effect with that banished monster's original effects. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 "Earthbound Immortal" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267c.name: Hunter Owl
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5267c.description: This card gains 500 ATK for each face-up WIND monster you control. While you control another face-up WIND monster, your opponent cannot select this card as an attack target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52684.name: Hydro Pressure Cannon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52684.description: Equip only to a Level 3 or lower WATER monster. If it destroys an opponent's monster by battle, send 1 random card in your opponent's hand to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52696.name: Hypnocorn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52696.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, if your opponent controls a monster and you control no other monsters: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52697.name: Hypnosister
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52697.description:
This card gains effects based on the total number of cards in both players' Pendulum Zones.
● 1 or more: This card gains 800 ATK and DEF.
● 2 or more: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a Pendulum Summoned monster: Destroy that monster.
● 3 or more: Monsters your opponent controls must attack this card, if able.
● 4: If this card destroys a monster by battle or by its own effect: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526aa.name: Ice Water
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526aa.description: A very aggressive mermaid that attacks enemies with the spikes growing from its body.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c1.name: Ignoble Knight of Black Laundsallyn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c1.description: You can send 1 face-up LIGHT Normal Monster you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon this card from your hand or Graveyard. You can Tribute 1 "Noble Knight" monster; add 1 "Noble Arms" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ignoble Knight of Black Laundsallyn" once per turn. You can only control 1 "Ignoble Knight of Black Laundsallyn".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52489.name: Gouki Destroy Ogre
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52489.description:
2+ "Gouki" monsters
The first time each monster this card points to would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect; you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Gouki" monsters, also, your opponent Special Summons 1 or 2 monsters from their GY, then, you Special Summon up to that many non-Link "Gouki" monsters from your GY to a Zone(s) this card points to. You can only use this effect of "Gouki Destroy Ogre" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52492.name: Gouki Octostretch
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52492.description: If your opponent's monster attacks, during damage calculation (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; the damage you take from that battle is halved. When your opponent activates an effect that would inflict damage to you (even during the Damage Step) (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; the damage you take from that effect is halved. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Gouki" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Gouki Octostretch". You can only use this effect of "Gouki Octostretch" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52495.name: Gouki Riscorpio
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52495.description: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Gouki" monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Gouki" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Gouki Riscorpio". You can only use this effect of "Gouki Riscorpio" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524be.name: Grapple Blocker
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524be.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can select 1 monster your opponent controls. The selected monster cannot attack or be Tributed, while this card remains face-up on the field. During each of your End Phases, pay 500 Life Points or destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c0.name: Grappler Angler
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c0.description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: You can target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e5.name: Graveyard and the Hand of Invitation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e5.description: A graveyard that serves as a power source for zombies.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52507.name: Great Sorcerer of the Nekroz
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52507.description: If this card is Tributed by a card effect: You can add 1 Spellcaster-Type "Nekroz" Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is banished: You can send 1 "Nekroz" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, except "Great Sorcerer of the Nekroz". You can only use 1 "Great Sorcerer of the Nekroz" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52510.name: Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52510.description: If this card is in your hand or Graveyard when a face-up Beast-Type monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can pay 1000 Life Points; Special Summon this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52516.name: Gren Maju Da Eiza
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52516.description: This card's ATK/DEF are each equal to the number of your banished cards x 400.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52547.name: Guardragon Promineses
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52547.description: You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY, then target 1 Dragon monster you control; it gains 500 ATK/DEF until the end of your opponent's turn. If a Normal Monster(s) is sent to your GY, while this card is in the GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Guardragon Promineses" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5254a.name: Guerilla Kite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5254a.description: If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Inflict 250 damage to your opponent. You can only use this effect of "Guerilla Kite" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52554.name: Gust Fan
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52554.description: A WIND monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 400 points and decreases its DEF by 200 points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52556.name: Gusto Egul
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52556.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower non-Tuner "Gusto" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52557.name: Gusto Falco
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52557.description: When this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard, except by battle: You can Special Summon 1 "Gusto" monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52571.name: Hallowed Life Barrier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52571.description: Discard 1 card; you take no damage from your opponent's cards this turn, also your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52579.name: Hand of the Six Samurai
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52579.description: If you control another "Six Samurai" monster: You can Tribute 1 "Six Samurai" monster, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525bc.name: Heavy Armored Train Ironwolf
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525bc.description:
2 Level 4 Machine-Type monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; this turn, it can attack your opponent directly, also other monsters cannot attack. If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card (by battle or card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: You can add 1 Level 4 Machine-Type monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d1.name: Hellebore the Rikka Fairy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d1.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect that targets a monster(s) you control, while you control a "Rikka" monster (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card from your hand or face-up field; negate that effect. If this card is in your GY: You can Tribute 1 Plant monster; Special Summon this card in Defense Position, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Hellebore the Rikka Fairy" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d4.name: Helpoemer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525d4.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. At the end of your opponent's Battle Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle: Make your opponent discard 1 random card. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fa.name: Hero of the East
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fa.description: Feel da strength ah dis sword-swingin' samurai from da Far East.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52611.name: Hi-Five the Sky
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52611.description: During your Battle Phase: Target 1 face-up Xyz Monster that attacked this turn; it can make a second attack during this Battle Phase. If it does so using this effect, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52618.name: Hi-Speedroid Kitedrake
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52618.description:
1 WIND Machine Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy all other cards on the field.
● Negate the effects of all face-up cards your opponent currently controls.
If this card in your possession is sent to your GY by an opponent's card: You can add 1 "Speedroid" monster from your Deck to your hand.
You can only use each effect of "Hi-Speedroid Kitedrake" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52630.name: Hieratic Seal of Banishment
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52630.description: Tribute 1 "Hieratic" monster to target 1 card your opponent controls; banish that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5265f.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5265f.description: This card is unaffected by Spell effects. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52690.name: Hyper Psychic Blaster/Assault Mode
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52690.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Assault Mode Activate". If this card battles a monster, at the end of the Damage Step, inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's DEF and gain Life Points equal to its ATK. When this card on the field is destroyed, you can Special Summon 1 "Hyper Psychic Blaster" from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52698.name: Hysteric Fairy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52698.description: Tribute 2 monsters on your side of the field to increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a7.name: Ice Mirror
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526a7.description: Target 1 Level 3 or lower WATER monster you control; Special Summon 1 monster with the same name from your Deck, but it cannot declare an attack this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b9.name: Igknight Templar
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526b9.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have an "Igknight" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy both cards in your Pendulum Zones, and if you do, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
An experienced Igknight warrior who fights for justice and despises the corrupt. He even questions his own weapon these days, due to his absolute quest for righteousness.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526bb.name: Igknights Unite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526bb.description: Target 1 "Igknight" card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Igknight" monster from your Deck. You can only activate 1 "Igknights Unite" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5249a.name: Gouki The Great Ogre
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5249a.description:
2+ "Gouki" monsters
All monsters on the field lose ATK equal to their original DEF. If this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 of your monsters this card points to instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c8.name: Gravedigger Ghoul
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524c8.description: Select up to 2 Monster Card(s) from your opponent's Graveyard. Remove the selected card(s) from play.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e1.name: Gravekeeper's Watcher
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e1.description: During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that could make them discard when it resolves: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e8.name: Gravitic Orb
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524e8.description: FLIP: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f5.name: Graydle Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524f5.description:
1 Aqua-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target cards your opponent controls, up to the number of WATER monsters used for the Synchro Summon of this card; destroy them. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 other WATER monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, but its effects are negated. You can only use each effect of "Graydle Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fb.name: Graydle Split
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fb.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to it. It gains 500 ATK. During your Main Phase: You can send this card equipped to a monster by this effect to the Graveyard; destroy the monster this card was equipped to, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Graydle" monsters with different names from your Deck, but destroy them during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Graydle Split" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fe.name: Great Dezard
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a524fe.description:
When this monster destroys the following number of monsters as a result of battle, the following effects are activated in order:
One: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them.
Two: You can Special Summon 1 "Fushioh Richie" from your hand or your Deck by Tributing this card during your Main Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52502.name: Great Moth
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52502.description: This monster cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by Tributing "Petit Moth" during your 4th turn after "Petit Moth" has been equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5250d.name: Greed Grado
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5250d.description: Activate only if you destroyed a face-up Synchro Monster controlled by your opponent this turn, either by battle or by a card effect. Draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5250e.name: Greed Quasar
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5250e.description: This card's original ATK and DEF are each equal to its Level x 300. This monster's Level is increased by the Level of monsters it destroys by battle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52527.name: Guard Dog
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52527.description: FLIP: Your opponent cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252b.name: Guard Penalty
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252b.description: Select 1 monster on the field. If it is changed to Defense Position this turn, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252f.name: Guardian Baou
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5252f.description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou". When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: It gains 1000 ATK. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52537.name: Guardian Sphinx
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52537.description: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Return all monsters your opponent controls to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5253d.name: Guardian of the Labyrinth
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5253d.description: A monster that guards the entrance to the Netherworld.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5254c.name: Guiding Light
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5254c.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 1 LIGHT monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52569.name: Hailon, the Timelord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52569.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: If your LP is lower than your opponent's, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the difference. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Shuffle this card into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5256d.name: Half Unbreak
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5256d.description: Target 1 monster on the field; this turn, that monster cannot be destroyed by battle, also any battle damage you take from attacks involving that monster is halved.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257b.name: Handcuffs Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5257b.description: When this card is destroyed by battle with an attacking monster your opponent controls and is sent to the Graveyard, you can equip this card to that monster. The equipped monster loses 1800 ATK. When it is destroyed and this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52588.name: Harmonic Waves
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52588.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it becomes Level 4 until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52595.name: Harpie Lady Sisters
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52595.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Elegant Egotist".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b0.name: Hazy Glory
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b0.description: You can Normal Summon "Hazy Flame" monsters for 1 less Tribute. You can send this face-up card from the field to the Graveyard to target 1 "Hazy" card in your Graveyard, except "Hazy Glory"; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b4.name: Healing Wave Generator
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525b4.description: Once per turn, you can select another face-up monster you control to gain Life Points equal to that monster's Level x 100.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fb.name: Hero's Rule 2
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fb.description: Negate the activation of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster's effect that targets a card(s) in the Graveyard, and destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fd.name: Heroic Challenger - Ambush Soldier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a525fd.description: During your Standby Phase: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon up to 2 "Heroic Challenger" monsters from your hand and/or Graveyard, except "Heroic Challenger - Ambush Soldier". You can only use this effect of "Heroic Challenger - Ambush Soldier" once per turn. When you do: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; make all "Heroic Challenger" monsters you currently control become Level 1.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52600.name: Heroic Challenger - Double Lance
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52600.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Heroic Challenger - Double Lance" from your hand or Graveyard in face-up Defense Position. This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster. This card cannot be used as an Xyz Material, except for the Xyz Summon of a Warrior-Type monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52607.name: Heroic Champion - Excalibur
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52607.description:
2 Level 4 Warrior-Type monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 2 Xyz Materials from this card; this card's ATK becomes double its original ATK until your opponent's next End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5260c.name: Heroic Retribution Sword
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5260c.description: Target 1 face-up "Heroic" monster you control; equip this card to that target. All Battle Damage you take from battles involving the equipped monster is also inflicted to your opponent. After damage calculation: Destroy any opponent's monster that battles the equipped monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263f.name: High Tide on Fire Island
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5263f.description:
If you control a Level 7 or higher WATER or FIRE monster: Apply the appropriate effects, in sequence, depending on the Attributes of monsters you control at that time.
● WATER: Special Summon as many WATER monsters as possible that were sent to your Graveyard to activate monster effects this turn, then destroy 1 monster you control.
● FIRE: Destroy 1 monster on the field, then if you have any cards in your hand, discard 1 card to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526af.name: Igknight Burst
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526af.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can destroy up to 3 other "Igknight" cards you control, then return an equal number of cards your opponent controls to the hand. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 face-up "Igknight" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ba.name: Igknight Veteran
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ba.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have an "Igknight" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy both cards in your Pendulum Zones, and if you do, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
This grizzled leader of the bodyguards division acts as chaperone to the Cavalier, and is one of the few complainers about her recklessness (mostly to the Gallant, the only one who understands him).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c0.name: Ignition Phoenix
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c0.description: All "Igknight" monsters on the field gain 300 ATK and DEF. Once per turn: You can target 1 "Igknight" card you control; destroy it, and if you do, add 1 "Igknight" card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c5.name: Il Blud
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c5.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster from your hand or from either GY, but if this card leaves the field, destroy all Zombie monsters Special Summoned by this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526dd.name: Imperial Tombs of Necrovalley
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526dd.description: When a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect is activated, while both a "Gravekeeper's" monster and "Necrovalley" are on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. You can only activate 1 "Imperial Tombs of Necrovalley" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526cc.name: Imairuka
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526cc.description: If this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY: Send the top card of your Deck to the GY, then, if it is a WATER monster, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ed.name: Infernal Incinerator
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ed.description: This card can only be Normal Summoned or Set by discarding all other card(s) in your hand and Tributing 1 card you control with 2000 or more ATK. This card gains 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. This card loses 500 ATK for each other monster you control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526fb.name: Infernity Dwarf
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526fb.description: While you have no cards in your hand, if a monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52700.name: Infernity Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52700.description: When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can discard 2 cards; Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52702.name: Infernity Mirage
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52702.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. If you have no cards in your hand, you can Tribute this card to select 2 "Infernity" monsters in your Graveyard. Special Summon those monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52707.name: Infernity Randomizer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52707.description: Once per turn, while you have no cards in your hand, you can draw 1 card and reveal it. For a Monster Card drawn with this effect, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the Level of that monster x 200. For a Spell or Trap Card, you take 500 damage.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5273c.name: Infinitrack Tunneller
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5273c.description: You can Tribute 1 EARTH Machine monster; Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 5 EARTH Machine monsters in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 2 cards. You can only use each effect of "Infinitrack Tunneller" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5274a.name: Insect Princess
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5274a.description: All Insect monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position. If this card destroys an Insect monster by battle: This card gains 500 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5274e.name: Inspection
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5274e.description: During your opponent's Standby Phase, you can pay 500 Life Points to randomly select 1 card in your opponent's hand and look at it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52783.name: Inzektor Picofalena
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52783.description:
2 Insect monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 other Insect monster you control; equip 1 Insect monster from your Deck to it as an Equip Spell that gains this effect.
● The equipped monster gains 500 ATK/DEF.
You can target 3 Insect monsters in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Inzektor Picofalena" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52786.name: Iris, the Earth Mother
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52786.description: After a Chain with 3 or more Links resolves, draw 1 card. This effect cannot activate if multiple cards/effects with the same name were activated in that Chain.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52787.name: Iron Blacksmith Kotetsu
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52787.description: FLIP: Add 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5279f.name: Izanami
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5279f.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, you can discard 1 card to add 1 Spirit monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527b1.name: Javelin Beetle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527b1.description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Javelin Beetle Pact".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527c7.name: Jinzo - Layered
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527c7.description:
2 Level 6 monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase, but it cannot activate its effects or declare an attack. If a Trap is on the field: You can Tribute 1 monster, and if you do, destroy 1 face-up card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Jinzo - Layered" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52804.name: Jurrac Ptera
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52804.description: If this card is attacked, return the attacking monster to the hand after damage calculation and this card gains DEF equal to the returned monster's Level x 100.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5281e.name: Kairyu-Shin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5281e.description: A sea dragon known as the King of the Ocean, it attacks its enemies with huge tidal waves.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52820.name: Kaiser Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52820.description: "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1" + "Fairy Dragon"

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5282a.name: Kamion, the Timelord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5282a.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: Shuffle 1 card your opponent controls into the Deck, and if you do, inflict 250 damage to your opponent. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Shuffle this card into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5282e.name: Kangaroo Champ
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5282e.description: A monster that battles with this card is changed to Defense Position after damage calculation.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5283c.name: Karakuri Klock
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5283c.description: Activate only when a face-up Defense Position "Karakuri" monster is selected as an attack target. Destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52854.name: Keeper of Dragon Magic
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52854.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add 1 "Polymerization" Normal Spell or "Fusion" Normal Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck; Special Summon 1 of the Fusion Materials whose name is specifically listed on that monster from your GY, in face-down Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Keeper of Dragon Magic" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters, the turn you activate either of this card's effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52855.name: Keeper of the Shrine
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52855.description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Dragon monster. While this card is in your hand or GY, if a face-up Dragon monster on the field, except "Keeper of the Shrine", is sent to the GY by a card effect or because it was destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon this card, then, if that monster sent to the GY is a Normal Monster, you can add 1 Dragon Normal Monster from your GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Keeper of the Shrine" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5286a.name: King of the Beasts
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5286a.description: You can Tribute 1 face-up "Moja" you control to Special Summon this card from your hand or Graveyard. There can only be 1 face-up "King of the Beasts" on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526eb.name: Infernal Flame Emperor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526eb.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can remove from play up to 5 FIRE monsters in your Graveyard. Destroy a number of Spell/Trap Cards on the field equal to the number of monsters removed from play for this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526f1.name: Infernity Avenger
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526f1.description: When a monster you control, except "Infernity Avenger", is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster and sent to the Graveyard, while you have no cards in your hand, you can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard. In that case, the Level of this card is equal to the Level of your destroyed monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52728.name: Infestation Ripples
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52728.description: Pay 500 Life Points to target 1 Level 4 or lower "Steelswarm" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52730.name: Infinite Machine
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52730.description:
Activate this card by sending 1 face-up "Empty Machine" from your Spell & Trap Zone to the GY. Once per turn, this face-up card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.
● During the Main Phase: Special Summon 1 "Timelord" monster from your hand.
● You can target 1 "Timelord" monster in your GY; shuffle it into the Deck, then, you can Set 1 "Infinite Light" directly from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5273b.name: Infinitrack Trencher
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5273b.description: You can Tribute 1 EARTH Machine monster; Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 5 or lower "Infinitrack" monster in your GY, except "Infinitrack Trencher"; Special Summon that monster in Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Infinitrack Trencher" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52744.name: Inpachi
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52744.description: A log that attacks lost travelers in the forest. Originally a big tree, it was cut down and possessed by a wicked spirit.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52753.name: Intercept
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52753.description: Activate only when a monster is Tribute Summoned with 1 Tribute. Take control of that monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52778.name: Inzektor Exa-Beetle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52778.description:
2 Level 6 monsters
When this card is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 monster in either player's Graveyard; equip that target to this card. This card gains ATK and DEF equal to half the original ATK and DEF of the monster equipped by this effect. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 face-up card on each side of the field; send those targets to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527ab.name: Jam Defender
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527ab.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack on a monster you control: You can target 1 "Revival Jam" you control; switch the attack target to that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527af.name: Jar of Generosity
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527af.description: Place 1 card from your hand on either the top or bottom of the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527b6.name: Jenis, Lightsworn Mender
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527b6.description: During the End Phase, if a card(s) was sent from your Deck to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Lightsworn" card this turn: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent, and if you do, gain 500 LP.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527cd.name: Job-Change Mirror
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527cd.description: A wicked mirror that blocks off the damaging effects of an attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527ce.name: Jolt Counter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527ce.description: During the Battle Phase, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Battlin' Boxer" monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527ea.name: Junk Destroyer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527ea.description:
"Junk Synchron" + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target cards on the field, up to the number of non-Tuner monsters used for the Synchro Summon of this card; destroy those targets.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527fc.name: Jurrac Giganoto
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527fc.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Dinosaur-Type monsters
All face-up "Jurrac" monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each "Jurrac" monster in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52805.name: Jurrac Spinos
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52805.description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Spinos Token" (Dinosaur/FIRE/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 0) in Attack Position to your opponent's field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5280c.name: Justi-Break
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5280c.description: Activate only when your opponent declares an attack against a face-up Normal Monster you control. Destroy all monsters on the field, except face-up Attack Position Normal Monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5280f.name: Jutte Fighter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5280f.description: Once per turn, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52819.name: Kahkki, Guerilla of Dark World
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52819.description: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52823.name: Kaiser Sea Horse
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52823.description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52837.name: Karakuri Cash Inn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52837.description: Target 1 "Karakuri" monster you control and 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; change the battle position of your monster, and if you do, negate the effects of that opponent's monster until the end of this turn. If you control a "Karakuri" monster(s): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that monster's battle position. You can only activate 1 "Karakuri Cash Inn" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52846.name: Karakuri Spider
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52846.description: If this card attacks a DARK monster, destroy the attack target after damage calculation.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5284f.name: Karma of the Destruction Swordsman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5284f.description: Target up to 3 monsters of the same Type in your opponent's Graveyard; banish them, and if you do, 1 "Buster Blader" monster or 1 "Destruction Sword" monster you control gains 500 ATK and DEF for each of those banished monsters, until the end of this turn. If this card is in your Graveyard: You can discard 1 "Destruction Sword" card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Karma of the Destruction Swordsman" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52859.name: Key Mace
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52859.description: Enemies' hearts will melt at the sight of this small fairy's cuteness.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c8.name: Illusion Magic
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526c8.description: Tribute 1 Spellcaster monster; add up to 2 copies of "Dark Magician" from your Deck and/or GY to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Illusion Magic" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526cf.name: Immortal Phoenix Gearfried
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526cf.description: You can banish 1 Equip Spell from your field or GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks: You can equip 1 face-up monster on the field to this card (max. 1) as an Equip Spell that gives this card 500 ATK. When a monster effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up Equip Card you control to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Immortal Phoenix Gearfried" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526e0.name: Inaba White Rabbit
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526e0.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. This monster attacks your opponent's Life Points directly.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52712.name: Infernoble Knight - Roland
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52712.description: (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card from your hand to that target as an Equip Spell that gives that card 500 ATK. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there this turn: You can add 1 FIRE Warrior monster, except "Infernoble Knight - Roland", or 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Infernoble Knight - Roland" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52734.name: Infinitrack Drag Shovel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52734.description: You can Tribute 1 EARTH Machine monster; Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. 60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52739.description:
2 Level 7 monsters

● You can detach 1 material from this card; it gains 1000 ATK.
● If this card is in your GY: You can Tribute 1 Machine Link Monster; Special Summon this card in Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52741.name: Inherited Fortune
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52741.description: Activate during the turn a face-up "Fortune Lady" monster you control was destroyed. Special Summon up to 2 "Fortune Lady" monsters from your hand during your next Standby Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52756.name: Interdimensional Matter Transporter

"Aleister the Invoker" + 1 WATER monster

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52797.name: Iron Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52797.description: Loses 1000 ATK while you control "Iron Hans". If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or sent to the GY by a card effect: You can add 1 "Iron Hans" from your Deck to your hand, or, if "Golden Castle of Stromberg" is in a Field Zone, you can add 1 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand, instead. You can only use this effect of "Iron Knight" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5279a.name: Island Turtle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5279a.description: A huge turtle that is often mistaken for an island.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527a9.name: Jain, Twilightsworn General
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527a9.description: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Lightsworn" monster from your hand or GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses ATK and DEF equal to the banished monster's Level x 300, until the end of this turn. Once per turn, if your other "Lightsworn" monster's effect is activated: Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527b3.name: Jawsman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527b3.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. If you Tribute Summon this card, all Tributes must be WATER. This card gains 300 ATK for each face-up WATER monster you control, except this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527b7.name: Jerry Beans Man
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527b7.description: Jerry, a bean soldier, believes he is the strongest warrior in the world, but his true abilities are still untested.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527c9.name: Jinzo - Returner
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527c9.description: This card can attack your opponent directly. When this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Jinzo" from your Graveyard. Destroy it during your End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527de.name: Junk Anchor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527de.description: For a Synchro Summon, you can substitute this card for any 1 "Synchron" Tuner monster. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 non-Tuner "Junk" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target, and if you do, immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster that lists a "Synchron" monster as a Tuner, using that monster and this card only. These Synchro Materials are banished instead of being sent to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5280b.name: Just Desserts
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5280b.description: Inflict 250 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52821.name: Kaiser Glider
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52821.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has the same ATK. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5283f.name: Karakuri Muso mdl 818 "Haipa"

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526df.name: Imprisoned Queen Archfiend
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526df.description: During each of your Standby Phases, you must pay 1000 Life Points (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. During your Standby Phase: Target 1 Level 4 or lower Fiend-Type monster on the field; that target gains 1000 ATK until the End Phase. "Pandemonium" must be on the field and this card must be in your Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ff.name: Infernity Inferno
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a526ff.description: Discard up to 2 cards, and send the same number of "Infernity" cards from your Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5270c.name: Inferno
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5270c.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE monster from your GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict 750 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5271f.name: Infernoid Onuncu
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5271f.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. When this card is Special Summoned: You can destroy all other monsters on the field. Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card or effect is activated: You can Tribute 1 monster; negate the activation, and if you do, banish that card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52733.name: Infinitrack Crab Crane
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52733.description: You can Tribute 1 EARTH Machine monster; Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. You can banish 1 Machine monster from your GY; add 1 "Outrigger Extension" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Infinitrack Crab Crane" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52746.name: Insect Barrier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52746.description: Insect-Type monsters your opponent controls cannot declare an attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52748.name: Insect Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52748.description: Of all Insect fighters, he is the paragon of the Indestructible Insect Invaders, which only the elite of the elite can join. We can no longer ignore their unmatched battle prowess.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52759.name: Interplanetarypurplythorny Beast
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52759.description: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, while this card is in your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard. If Summoned this way, banish this card when it leaves the field. You can only use the effect of "Interplanetarypurplythorny Beast" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5277f.name: Inzektor Hopper
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5277f.description: Once per turn: You can equip 1 "Inzektor" monster from your hand or Graveyard to this card. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's Level is increased by 4. While this card is equipped to a monster: You can send this Equip Card to the Graveyard; the monster it was equipped to can attack your opponent directly this turn. Other monsters cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5279b.name: Isolde, Belle of the Underworld
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5279b.description: If you control "Tristan, Knight of the Underworld", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can target up to 2 Zombie monsters you control and declare a Level from 5 to 8; they become that Level until the end of this turn, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Zombie monsters. You can only use this effect of "Isolde, Belle of the Underworld" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5279e.name: Izanagi
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5279e.description: You can Special Summon this card from your hand by removing from play 1 Spirit monster from your hand. Spirit monsters you control do not have to have their effects that return them to the hand activated.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527ae.name: Jar of Avarice
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527ae.description: Target 5 cards in your GY, except "Jar of Avarice"; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Jar of Avarice" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527c8.name: Jinzo - Lord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527c8.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending 1 face-up "Jinzo" you control to the Graveyard. Trap Cards cannot be activated and the effects of all Trap Cards on the field are negated. Once per turn, you can destroy all face-up Trap Cards. Inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each card destroyed by this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527df.name: Junk Archer

"Junk Synchron" + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527fe.name: Jurrac Herra
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a527fe.description: When a Defense Position "Jurrac" monster you control, except "Jurrac Herra", is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52812.name: Kabuki Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52812.description: Once per turn, before damage calculation, if your monster attacked an opponent's monster: You can change the battle position of that monster your opponent controls. Once per turn, before damage calculation, if an opponent's monster attacked your monster: You can change the battle position of that monster you control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52814.name: Kagemucha Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52814.description: When you Normal Summon a Level 3 monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Cannot be used as Synchro Material.
