60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52952.description: Change all face-up "Wind-Up" monsters you control to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52956.name: Lemon Magician Girl
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52956.description: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Magician Girl" monster, except "Lemon Magician Girl"; add 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, if this card is targeted for an attack: You can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand, but its effects (if any) are negated, then change the attack target to it, and if you do, the attacking monster's ATK becomes half its current ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52958.name: Leng Ling
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52958.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. The original ATK of a monster equipped with this card becomes 1000, it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5296a.name: Level Retuner
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5296a.description: Reduce the Level of 1 face-up monster you control by up to 2.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52995.name: Lightray Diabolos
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52995.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 5 or more LIGHT monsters with different names in your Graveyard. Once per turn: You can banish 1 LIGHT monster from your Graveyard, then target 1 Set card your opponent controls; reveal that target, then place that target on either the top or bottom of the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529f7.name: Lucky Pied Piper
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529f7.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529f8.name: Lucky Punch
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529f8.description: Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can toss a coin 3 times. If the result is 3 heads, draw 3 cards, but if the result is 3 tails, destroy this card. If this face-up card on the field is destroyed: You lose 6000 Life Points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529fe.name: Luminous Dragon Ritual
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529fe.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Paladin of Photon Dragon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal exactly 4. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; banish monsters from your Graveyard whose total Levels equal exactly 4, and Special Summon 1 "Paladin of Photon Dragon" from your hand after that. (This Special Summon is treated as a Ritual Summon.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a08.name: Lunalight Fusion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a08.description: Fusion Summon 1 "Lunalight" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. If your opponent controls a monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, you can also use 1 "Lunalight" monster in your Deck or Extra Deck as Fusion Material. You can only activate 1 "Lunalight Fusion" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a1b.name: Lyna the Light Charmer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a1b.description: FLIP: Take control of 1 LIGHT monster your opponent controls, while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a30.name: Mach Synchron
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a30.description: Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was sent there this turn as Synchro Material: You can target 1 other monster in your Graveyard, that was used as material for that Synchro Summon; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a47.name: Machine Assembly Line
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a47.description: All Machine-Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK. Each time a face-up Machine-Type monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect, place 2 Junk Counters on this card. You can send this card to the Graveyard, then target 1 Machine-Type monster in your Graveyard whose Level is less than or equal to the number of Junk Counters that were on this card; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a48.name: Machine Attacker
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a48.description: This machine, created to lead charges into enemy territory, mows down enemies by rushing.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a58.name: Madolche Butlerusk
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a58.description: When this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: Shuffle this card into your Deck. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. There must be another face-up "Madolche" monster on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a59.name: Madolche Chateau
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a59.description: When this card is activated: Shuffle all "Madolche" monsters in your Graveyard into the Deck. All "Madolche" monsters on the field gain 500 ATK and DEF. If a monster(s) in your Graveyard would be returned to the Deck by the effect of a "Madolche" monster, you can add it to your hand instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a60.name: Madolche Magileine
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a60.description: If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to your GY: Shuffle this card into the Deck. When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 "Madolche" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a6d.name: Madolche Ticket
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a6d.description: When a "Madolche" card(s) is returned from your side of the field or Graveyard to your hand or Main Deck by a card effect: Add 1 "Madolche" monster from your Deck to your hand. If you control a face-up Fairy-Type "Madolche" monster, you can Special Summon the monster from your Deck in face-up Attack Position instead of adding it to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Madolche Ticket" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a8b.name: Magical Hats
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a8b.description: During your opponent's Battle Phase: Choose 2 Spell/Trap Cards from your Deck and 1 monster in your Main Monster Zone. Special Summon them as Normal Monsters (ATK 0/DEF 0) in face-down Defense Position, Set the chosen monster if it is face-up, and shuffle them on the field. The 2 cards chosen from your Deck are destroyed at the end of the Battle Phase, and cannot remain on the field except during this Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aaa.name: Magical Thorn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aaa.description: When your opponent's card(s) in their hand are discarded to the Graveyard, inflict 250 points of damage to their Life Points for each card that was discarded.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52882.name: Knightmare Mermaid
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52882.description:
1 "Knightmare" monster, except "Knightmare Mermaid"
If this card is Link Summoned: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Knightmare" monster from your Deck, then, if this card was co-linked when this effect was activated, you can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Knightmare Mermaid" once per turn. Monsters on the field lose 1000 ATK/DEF, unless they are co-linked.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5288f.name: Koa'ki Meiru Ice
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5288f.description: During each of your End Phases, destroy this card unless you send 1 "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" from your hand to the Graveyard or reveal 1 Continuous Spell Card in your hand. You can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to destroy 1 Special Summoned monster on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528b0.name: Kozmo Forerunner
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528b0.description: Cannot be targeted by an opponent's card effects. During your Standby Phase: Gain 1000 LP. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower "Kozmo" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528b6.name: Kozmo Soartroopers
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528b6.description: During either player's turn: You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or higher "Kozmo" monster from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Kozmo Soartroopers" once per turn. Once per turn: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Psychic-Type "Kozmo" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528ca.name: Kujakujaku
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528ca.description: If this card on the field is Tributed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower WIND monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand, except "Kujakujaku". You can only use the effect of "Kujakujaku" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52904.name: Laser Qlip
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52904.description: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Qli" monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) Normal Summons of "Qli" monsters cannot be negated.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52915.name: Lava Battleguard
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52915.description: This card gains 500 ATK for each "Swamp Battleguard" you control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52920.name: Laval Lakeside Lady
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52920.description: If this card is in your Graveyard and you have 3 or more "Laval" monsters with different names in your Graveyard: You can banish this card and 1 other "Laval" monster from your Graveyard to target 1 Set card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5292d.name: Lavalval Ignis
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5292d.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
If this card attacks or is attacked, during the Damage Step (in either player's turn): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card once per battle; this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52940.name: Legendary Atlantean Tridon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52940.description: You can Tribute this card and 1 Sea Serpent-Type monster; Special Summon 1 "Poseidra, the Atlantean Dragon" from your hand or Deck, then all monsters your opponent currently controls lose 300 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5299c.name: Lightsworn Judgment
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5299c.description: Place this card on top of the Deck. If this card is sent from the Deck to the Graveyard by a "Lightsworn" monster's effect: You can add 1 "Judgment Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529a1.name: Lillybot
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529a1.description: When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: You can target 1 "Orbital 7" in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. Once per turn: You can Tribute any number of Machine-Type monsters; Special Summon an equal number of "Photon" and/or "Galaxy" monsters from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a13.name: Lunalight Yellow Marten
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a13.description: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can target 1 "Lunalight" card you control, except "Lunalight Yellow Marten"; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon this card in Defense Position, but banish this card when it leaves the field. If this card is sent to the GY by a card effect: You can add 1 "Lunalight" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Lunalight Yellow Marten" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a15.name: Luster Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a15.description: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a39.name: Machina Gearframe
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a39.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Machina" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Machina Gearframe". Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a5a.name: Madolche Chickolates
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a5a.description: When this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: Shuffle this card into the Deck. Once per turn, when the battle position of a "Madolche" monster(s) you control is changed (and is now face-up), while this card is face-up on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 monster on the field; change it to face-up Defense Position, and if you do, unless it is a "Madolche" monster, it cannot attack, also its effects are negated.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a65.name: Madolche Petingcessoeur
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a65.description:
If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to your GY: Shuffle this card into the Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Madolche Petingcessoeur" once per turn.
● If you have no monsters in your GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Madolche" monster from your hand or Deck, except "Madolche Petingcessoeur", and if you do, reduce its Level by 1, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Madolche" monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a6e.name: Madolche Waltz
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a6e.description: Each time a "Madolche" monster you control attacks or is attacked, after damage calculation: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a75.name: Magic Deflector
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a75.description: For the rest of this turn, negate all Equip, Field, Continuous and Quick-Play Spell Card effects on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a7b.name: Magic Jammer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a7b.description: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a80.name: Magical Android
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a80.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
During each of your End Phases: Gain 600 LP for each Psychic-Type monster you currently control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a90.name: Magical Marionette
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a90.description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. This card gains 200 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 2 Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a97.name: Magical Musket - Desperado
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a97.description: If you control a "Magical Musket" monster: Target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it. You can only activate 1 "Magical Musket - Desperado" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a98.name: Magical Musket - Fiendish Deal
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a98.description: "Magical Musket" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. If this card in your possession is sent to your GY by an opponent's card effect: You can add 1 "Magical Musket" card from your Deck or GY to your hand, except "Magical Musket - Fiendish Deal". You can only activate 1 "Magical Musket - Fiendish Deal" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a9d.name: Magical Musketeer Caspar
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a9d.description: During either player's turn, you can activate "Magical Musket" Spell/Trap Cards from your hand. If a Spell/Trap Card is activated in this card's column (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Magical Musket" card from your Deck to your hand, but not a card with the same name as that activated card. You can only use this effect of "Magical Musketeer Caspar" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aa7.name: Magical Spring
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aa7.description: Draw a number of cards equal to the number of face-up Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls, then discard a number of cards equal to the number of face-up Spell/Trap Cards you control. Until the end of your opponent's next turn after this card resolves, Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls cannot be destroyed (by battle or card effect), also their activation and effects cannot be negated. You can only activate 1 "Magical Spring" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528a3.name: Kojikocy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528a3.description: A man-hunter with powerful arms that can crush boulders.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528b7.name: Kozmo Strawman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528b7.description: During either player's turn: You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 Level 3 or higher "Kozmo" monster from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Kozmo Strawman" once per turn. Once per turn: You can pay 500 LP, then target 1 of your banished "Kozmo" monsters; Special Summon it, but its effects are negated, also destroy it during the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528c0.name: Krawler Dendrite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528c0.description:
FLIP: You can send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY.
If this face-up card in its owner's control leaves the field because of an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 2 "Krawler" monsters with different names from your Deck in face-down Defense Position, except "Krawler Dendrite". You can only use each effect of "Krawler Dendrite" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528c6.name: Krokodilus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528c6.description: A vicious crocodile with great intelligence.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528e0.name: Kuro-Obi Karate Spirit
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528e0.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If a monster(s) is Pendulum Summoned: Return this card from the Pendulum Zone to the hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send to the GY all Spells/Traps your opponent controls in the same column as the card(s) in your Pendulum Zones. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up this turn: Return this card to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528ef.name: Labyrinth of Nightmare
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528ef.description: Once per turn, during each player's End Phase: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters the turn player controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528fc.name: Lancer Lindwurm
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a528fc.description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52919.name: Laval Blaster
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52919.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, if you have a "Laval" monster in your Graveyard other than "Laval Blaster": You can choose a number from 1 to 5, then send that many cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard; this card gains 200 ATK for each "Laval" monster sent to the Graveyard to activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5291a.name: Laval Burner
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5291a.description: If you have 3 or more "Laval" monsters with different names in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5291b.name: Laval Cannon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5291b.description: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can target 1 of your banished "Laval" monsters; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52931.name: Lazion, the Timelord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52931.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: Shuffle all cards from your opponent's GY into the Deck. Once per turn, if your opponent draws a card: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Shuffle this card into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52947.name: Legendary Knight Hermos
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52947.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Legend of Heart". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; banish that target. Once per turn, when this card is targeted for an attack: You can target 1 Effect Monster in your GY; until the End Phase of your next turn, this card's name becomes that target's original name, and replace this effect with that target's original effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52966.name: Level Limit - Area A
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52966.description: Change all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters to Attack Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5296f.name: Leviair the Sea Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5296f.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 banished Level 4 or lower monster; Special Summon that target to your field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52975.name: Life Equalizer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52975.description: Activate only when the difference between both players' Life Points is 8000 or more. Both players' Life Points become 3000.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5298c.name: Lightning Punisher
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5298c.description: After a Chain with 3 or more Links resolves, destroy 1 card on your opponent's side of the field. This effect cannot activate if multiple cards/effects with the same name were activated in that Chain.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5299a.name: Lightserpent
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5299a.description: If this card is sent from the hand to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon it from the Graveyard. This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529a3.name: Limit Impulse
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529a3.description: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 2 "Soul Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). They cannot be Tributed except for a Tribute Summon.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529f3.name: Lucky Chance
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a529f3.description: Once per Chain, if a monster effect is activated that tosses a coin once: Call heads or tails. If your call matches the coin toss for that monster effect, draw 1 card immediately after that effect resolves.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a2f.name: Mabarrel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a2f.description: This cannon-like creature fires eyeballs so fast they can't be seen.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a43.name: Machina Soldier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a43.description: When this card is Normal Summoned while you control no other monsters: You can Special Summon 1 "Machina" monster from your hand, except "Machina Soldier".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a77.name: Magic Formula
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a77.description: Equip only to "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl". It gains 700 ATK. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Gain 1000 LP.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a7e.name: Magic Triangle of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a7e.description: Reveal 3 "Ice Barrier" monsters with different names in your hand to select 1 card your opponent controls. Destroy the opponent's card and Special Summon 1 "Ice Barrier" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a95.name: Magical Musket - Cross-Domination
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52a95.description: If you control a "Magical Musket" monster: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; until the end of this turn, change its ATK/DEF to 0, also it has its effects negated. You can only activate 1 "Magical Musket - Cross-Domination" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aa2.name: Magical Musketeer Wild
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aa2.description: During either player's turn, you can activate "Magical Musket" Spell/Trap Cards from your hand. If a Spell/Trap Card is activated in this card's column: You can target 3 "Magical Musket" cards in your GY; shuffle all 3 into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Magical Musketeer Wild" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aa4.name: Magical Reflect Slime
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aa4.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● Your opponent takes all Battle Damage that you would have taken from a battle involving this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aab.name: Magical Undertaker
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aab.description: FLIP: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Spellcaster monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aaf.name: Magicat
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aaf.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard for the Synchro Summon of a Spellcaster-Type Synchro Monster, you can return 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard to the top of your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab1.name: Magician of Black Chaos
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab1.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Magic Ritual".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ac0.name: Magicians' Defense
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ac0.description: While you control a Spellcaster-Type monster, any damage you take is halved. (You cannot halve the same damage twice this way.) If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Spellcaster-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52acd.name: Magistus Invocation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52acd.description: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material, including a Spellcaster monster. If Summoning a "Magistus" Fusion Monster this way, you can also use monsters in your Spell & Trap Zones that are equipped to a "Magistus" monster. You can only activate 1 "Magistus Invocation" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad1.name: Magna Drago
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad1.description: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: It gains 200 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aec.name: Majespecter Raccoon - Bunbuku
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aec.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Majespecter" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Majespecter Raccoon - Bunbuku" once per turn. Cannot be targeted or destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aed.name: Majespecter Sonics
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aed.description: Target 1 "Majespecter" monster you control; until the end of this turn, its ATK and DEF become double its current ATK and DEF, also any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is halved.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52af4.name: Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracoslayer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52af4.description:
2 Level 4 Pendulum Monsters
When this card is Xyz Summoned: You can add 1 Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand during the End Phase of this turn. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; Special Summon 1 face-up "Dracoslayer" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot be used as an Xyz Material for a Summon.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52af6.name: Majestic Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52af6.description: Cannot be used as a Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a "Majestic" monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52af8.name: Majestic Mech - Ohka
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52af8.description: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If you do, during the End Phase: Send it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52afc.name: Majestic Star Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52afc.description:
"Majestic Dragon" + "Stardust Dragon" + 1 non-Tuner monster
During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect: You can Tribute this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy all cards your opponent controls. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn, and you can activate 1 of its effects as this card's effect once this turn. During the End Phase: Target 1 "Stardust Dragon" in your Graveyard; return this card from the field to the Extra Deck, then Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b00.name: Majesty's Pegasus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b00.description: All "Majespecter" monsters on the field gain 300 ATK and DEF. You can Tribute 1 WIND Spellcaster-Type monster; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Majespecter" monster from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Majesty's Pegasus" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b1f.name: Malice Dispersion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b1f.description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Destroy all face-up Continuous Trap Cards.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b34.name: Mara of the Nordic Alfar
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b34.description: When using this card as Synchro Material, the other Synchro Materials must be 2 "Nordic" monsters in your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b35.name: Marauding Captain
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b35.description: Your opponent cannot target Warrior monsters for attacks, except this one. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b4c.name: Marincess Sea Star
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b4c.description: You can send this card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 "Marincess" monster you control; it gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn. You can use this effect of "Marincess Sea Star" up to twice per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5e.name: Mask Charge
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5e.description: Target 1 "HERO" monster and 1 "Change" Quick-Play Spell Card in your Graveyard; add them to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5f.name: Mask of Brutality
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5f.description: The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK and loses 1000 DEF. During each of your Standby Phases, pay 1000 LP or destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b63.name: Mask of Weakness
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b63.description: Target 1 attacking monster; that target loses 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba1.name: Mayakashi Metamorphosis
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba1.description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 of your "Mayakashi" monsters that is banished or in your GY; Special Summon it. Your opponent cannot target it with card effects this turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this card, except "Mayakashi" monsters. You can only activate 1 "Mayakashi Metamorphosis" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba3.name: Mayakashi Winter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba3.description:
Monsters your opponent controls lose 100 ATK/DEF for each "Mayakashi" monster with a different name in your GY. You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Mayakashi Winter" per turn, and only once that turn.
● Send this card and 1 "Mayakashi" monster you control to the GY; draw 1 card.
● Banish this card and 1 Zombie monster from your GY, then target 1 "Mayakashi" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb2.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Hamstrat
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb2.description: When this card is flipped face-up: Special Summon 2 "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You can Tribute 1 Token, then target 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. You can only use this effect of "Mecha Phantom Beast Hamstrat" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc6.name: Medallion of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc6.description: Add 1 "Ice Barrier" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd9.name: Megalosmasher X
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd9.description: With its sound-baffling armor and gargantuan jaws, this primeval predator's phosphorescence was the only possible pardon for its primitive prey.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bea.name: Mekk-Knight Red Moon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bea.description: If 2 or more cards are in the same column, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in that column. You can only Special Summon "Mekk-Knight Red Moon" once per turn this way. You can banish 1 "Mekk-Knight" monster from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster in this card's column; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf9.name: Meklord Emperor Skiel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf9.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When a face-up monster you control is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Other monsters you control cannot declare an attack. Once per turn: You can target 1 Synchro Monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card. This card gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of the monsters equipped to it by this effect. You can send 1 monster you control that is equipped to this card to the Graveyard; this card can attack your opponent directly this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c12.name: Memory Loss
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c12.description: When a face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls just activated an effect (except during the Damage Step): Negate that effect, and if you do, change that monster to face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c20.name: Mermail Abysshilde
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c20.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Mermail" monster from your hand, except "Mermail Abysshilde". You can only use the effect of "Mermail Abysshilde" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae2.name: Maiden in Love
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae2.description: This Attack Position card cannot be destroyed by battle. After damage calculation, if this card is attacked: Place 1 Maiden Counter on the monster that attacked this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae9.name: Majespecter Cyclone
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae9.description: Tribute 1 WIND Spellcaster-Type monster, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b06.name: Makiu, the Magical Mist
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b06.description: Target 1 "Summoned Skull", or 1 Thunder monster, in your Monster Zone; destroy all monsters your opponent controls with DEF less than or equal to the ATK of that monster. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b0d.name: Malefic Force
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b0d.description: Target 1 "Malefic" monster you control: that monster is unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects while it is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b20.name: Malice Doll of Demise
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b20.description: During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the Graveyard by the effect of a Continuous Spell Card: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b38.name: March of the Monarchs
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b38.description: Tribute Summoned monsters you control cannot be targeted by, or destroyed by, card effects. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b6b.name: Masked HERO Anki
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b6b.description: Must be Special Summoned by "Mask Change". This card can attack directly, but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is halved. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can add 1 "Change" Quick-Play Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Masked HERO Anki" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b6c.name: Masked HERO Blast
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b6c.description: Must be Special Summoned with "Mask Change". If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; its ATK becomes half its current ATK. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can pay 500 LP, then target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; return it to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b97.name: Mathmech Subtraction
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b97.description: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Cyberse monsters, also Special Summon this card from your hand (but it cannot attack this turn), and if you do, the targeted monster loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Mathmech Subtraction" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbc.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Turtletracer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbc.description: This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Each turn, the first "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" you control that would be destroyed by battle, is not destroyed.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc8.name: Medium of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc8.description: If your opponent controls 4 or more cards than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Your opponent can only activate 1 Spell/Trap Card each turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bed.name: Mekk-Knight of the Morning Star
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bed.description:
2 monsters, including a "Mekk-Knight" monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can discard 1 "Mekk-Knight" monster or 1 "World Legacy" card; add 1 "World Legacy" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mekk-Knight of the Morning Star" once per turn. If your "Mekk-Knight" monster battles a monster in a different column than it, your monster cannot be destroyed by that battle, also you take no battle damage from that battle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c02.name: Melffy Fenny
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c02.description: If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step), or if an opponent's monster targets this card for an attack: You can return this card to the hand, then you can Special Summon 1 Beast monster from your hand, except "Melffy Fenny". During your End Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use each effect of "Melffy Fenny" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c13.name: Memory of an Adversary
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c13.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You take damage equal to the attacking monster's ATK, and if you do, banish that monster. During the End Phase of your opponent's next turn, Special Summon that monster to your side of the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c14.name: Mental Seeker
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c14.description: When this removed from play card is Special Summoned, reveal the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck. Choose 1 of those cards and remove it from play. Then, shuffle the others into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c21.name: Mermail Abyssleed
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c21.description: You can discard 3 other WATER monsters to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. When Summoned this way: You can target 1 "Abyss-" Spell/Trap in your GY; add that target to your hand. You can Tribute 1 other Attack Position "Mermail" monster; send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Mermail Abyssleed" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c23.name: Mermail Abysslung
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c23.description: Your opponent cannot target face-up WATER monsters for attacks, except this one. All WATER monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c25.name: Mermail Abyssmegalo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c25.description: You can discard 2 other WATER monsters to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. When Summoned this way: You can add 1 "Abyss-" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can Tribute 1 other Attack Position WATER monster; this card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c31.name: Metabo-Shark
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c31.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 2 Fish-Type monsters in your Graveyard; shuffle those targets into your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c34.name: Metal Detector
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c34.description: You can only activate this card when a Continuous Trap Card is activated. Negate all Continuous Trap Cards during the turn this card is activated.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c3d.name: Metalfoes Crimsonite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c3d.description: 1 "Metalfoes" monster + 2 monsters with 3000 or less ATK

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad0.name: Magma Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad0.description: When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 Wyrm-Type monster in your Graveyard, except "Magma Dragon"; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but its effects are negated. You can only use this effect of "Magma Dragon" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate this effect, except Wyrm-Type monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad3.name: Magnarokket Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad3.description: When a Link Monster's effect is activated that targets this face-up card on the field (Quick Effect): You can destroy this card, then send 1 monster on the field to the GY. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field by battle or card effect and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Rokket" monster from your Deck, except "Magnarokket Dragon". You can only use each effect of "Magnarokket Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae0.name: Mahjong Munia Maidens
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae0.description:
FLIP: You can draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52afe.name: Majesty with Eyes of Blue
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52afe.description: Send 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your hand or Deck to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it cannot attack while it is face-up on the field. You can only activate 1 "Majesty with Eyes of Blue" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b01.name: Maji-Gire Panda
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b01.description: Each time a Beast-Type monster(s) on the field is destroyed, this card gains 500 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b14.name: Malefic Selector
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b14.description: Banish 2 "Malefic" cards from your GY; add 2 "Malefic" cards from your Deck to your hand, except "Malefic Selector", with different names from each other and from the banished cards. You can only activate 1 "Malefic Selector" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b26.name: Mammoth Graveyard
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b26.description: A mammoth that protects the graves of its pack and is absolutely merciless when facing grave-robbers.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba2.name: Mayakashi Return
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba2.description: Take 1 "Mayakashi" card from your Deck, except "Mayakashi Return", and either add it to your hand or send it to the GY. You can only activate 1 "Mayakashi Return" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bad.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Blackfalcon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bad.description: When this card declares an attack: Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can Tribute 1 Token, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb3.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Harrliard
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb3.description: Once per turn, when a monster(s) you control is Tributed to activate a card or effect other than this card's: Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 Token; Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbb.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Tetherwolf
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbb.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Once per battle, during the Damage Step, when this card battles an opponent's monster (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 Token; this card gains 800 ATK, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bcf.name: Megalith Bethor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bcf.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Megalith" card. You can discard this card; Ritual Summon 1 "Megalith" Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can target cards your opponent controls, up to the number of Ritual Monsters with different names in your GY; destroy them. You can only use each effect of "Megalith Bethor" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd2.name: Megalith Och
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd2.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Megalith" card. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can draw 1 card, then discard 1 card. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can activate this effect; Ritual Summon 1 Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, including this card on your field, whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster. You can only use this effect of "Megalith Och" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd7.name: Megalith Promotion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd7.description: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower monster you control; its Level becomes double its original Level until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field). You can only use this effect of "Megalith Promotion" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bee.name: Meklord Army Deployer Obbligato
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bee.description: During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect; destroy this card, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Meklord Army" monsters from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Meklord Army Deployer Obbligato", also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Machine monsters. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, you can inflict 50 damage to your opponent for each "Meklord" monster you control. You can only use each effect of "Meklord Army Deployer Obbligato" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bfd.name: Meklord Fortress
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bfd.description: "Meklord Emperor" monsters you control cannot be targeted by the effects of Synchro Monsters. When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Meklord Emperor" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c09.name: Melffy Tag
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c09.description: Target 1 "Melffy" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only activate 1 "Melffy Tag" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c27.name: Mermail Abyssnose
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c27.description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Mermail" monster from your Deck in face-up Defense Position. You can only use the effect of "Mermail Abyssnose" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c3f.name: Metalfoes Goldriver
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c3f.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 other face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Set 1 "Metalfoes" Spell/Trap Card directly from your Deck.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
That gleaming, golden buggy breaks bad guys good. What wonderful wheels! (With a bumbling buffoon....)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c40.name: Metalfoes Mithrilium
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c40.description:
1 "Metalfoes" monster + 1 Pendulum Monster
You can target 2 "Metalfoes" cards in your GY and 1 card on the field; shuffle the targets from your GY into the Deck, and if you do, return the target on the field to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Metalfoes Mithrilium" once per turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Metalfoes" Pendulum Monster from your GY or face-up Extra Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad9.name: Magnetic Mosquito
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad9.description: FLIP: Destroy all face-up Machine-Type monsters on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52adf.name: Maharaghi
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52adf.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, look at 1 card on the top of your Deck during your next Draw Phase (before you draw), and return the card to the top or the bottom of your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c32.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You take no battle damage from attacks involving this Attack Position card. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: Return as many monsters on the field as possible to the hand (other than this card), and if you do, inflict 150 damage to your opponent for each card returned. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Shuffle this card into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c33.name: Metal Armored Bug
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c33.description: A gigantic insect-like creature covered by thick armor. Everything in his path is destroyed.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c41.name: Metalfoes Orichalc
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c41.description:
2 "Metalfoes" monsters
If a "Metalfoes" monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict double piercing battle damage to your opponent. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aae.name: Magicalized Fusion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aae.description: Fusion Summon 1 Spellcaster Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or GY. You can only activate 1 "Magicalized Fusion" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab4.name: Magician of Dark Illusion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab4.description:
This card's name becomes "Dark Magician" while on the field. You can only use each of these effects of "Magician of Dark Illusion" once per turn.
● During your opponent's turn, if you activate a Spell/Trap Card or effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● If you activate a Spell/Trap Card or effect while this card is face-up on your field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 "Dark Magician" in your GY; Special Summon it. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab5.name: Magician of Faith
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab5.description: FLIP: Target 1 Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab7.name: Magician's Circle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab7.description: When a Spellcaster monster declares an attack: Each player Special Summons 1 Spellcaster monster with 2000 or less ATK from their Deck in Attack Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ac2.name: Magidog
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ac2.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard for the Synchro Summon of a Spellcaster-Type monster, you can select and add 1 Field Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52afb.name: Majestic Red Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52afb.description:
"Majestic Dragon" + "Red Dragon Archfiend" + 1 non-Tuner monster
Cannot be destroyed by card effects. After damage calculation, if this card attacks: Destroy all Defense Position monsters on the field. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to that monster's ATK. These changes last until the end of this turn. During the End Phase: Target 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" in your Graveyard; return this card from the field to the Extra Deck, then Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b11.name: Malefic Parallel Gear
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b11.description: When using this card as a Synchro Material Monster, the other Synchro Material Monster is 1 "Malefic" monster in your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b2f.name: Mandragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b2f.description: This mandragora harbors the soul of a sorrowful dragon. The cursed tones of its wailing cause both fear and despair.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b36.name: March Towards Ragnarok
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b36.description: Target 1 "Aesir" monster you control; until the end of this turn, its effects are negated, also that face-up monster is unaffected by the effects of other Spells/Traps.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b51.name: Marionette Mite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b51.description: You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 Fiend or Zombie monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7c.name: Master Craftsman Gamil
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7c.description: During the Damage Step, when a face-up monster you control battles (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; that monster gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7d.name: Master Gig
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7d.description: Once per turn, you can pay 1000 Life Points to destroy monsters your opponent controls equal to the number of face-up Psychic-Type monsters you control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b89.name: Mataza the Zapper
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b89.description: This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. Control of this face-up card on the field cannot switch.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b9b.name: Mausoleum of the Emperor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b9b.description: During any Main Phase: The turn player can pay 1000 LP x the number of monsters normally needed for the Tribute Summon of a monster (max. 2000); that player Normal Summons/Sets that monster without Tributing. (This is their one Normal Summon/Set for that turn. This is not a Tribute Summon.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba9.name: Mech Mole Zombie
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba9.description: This creature attacks by launching missile-like arms.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb8.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Raiten
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb8.description: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0), also you can only use "Mecha Phantom Beast" monsters as Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Material for a Summon, for the rest of this turn. This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bba.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Stealthray
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bba.description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 Token, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc5.name: Meda Bat
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc5.description: An eyeball fiend created by a servant of the wicked, it uses "Dark Blasts" to blow away its enemies.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52be9.name: Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52be9.description: If 2 or more cards are in the same column, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in that column. You can only Special Summon "Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall" once per turn this way. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Mekk-Knight" monster you control; banish it (until the Standby Phase of your next turn), and if you do, add 1 "Mekk-Knight" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall". You can only use this effect of "Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bec.name: Mekk-Knight Yellow Star
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bec.description: If 2 or more cards are in the same column, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in that column. You can only Special Summon "Mekk-Knight Yellow Star" once per turn this way. You can banish 1 "Mekk-Knight" monster from your GY, then target 1 Spell/Trap in this card's column; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf0.name: Meklord Army of Skiel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf0.description: This card gains 200 ATK for each "Meklord" monster on the field, except this card. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Meklord Army" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c04.name: Melffy Mommy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c04.description:
2+ Level 2 Beast monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can attach 1 Beast monster from your hand or face-up field to this card as material. This card gains effects based on the number of materials attached to it.
● 3+: Cannot be destroyed by battle.
● 4+: You take no damage from battles involving this card.
● 5+: When an attack is declared involving this card and an Attack Position monster: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that Attack Position monster's ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c08.name: Melffy Rabby
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c08.description: ''Rabby's up on that favorite stump again, looking all around the forest at all the fluffy friends! Do you like exploring, too? Good! Let's go find more Melffy friends with Rabby!''

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c2a.name: Mermail Abyssteus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c2a.description: You can discard 1 other WATER monster to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. When Summoned this way: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower "Mermail" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mermail Abyssteus" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c2d.name: Mesmeric Control
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c2d.description: During your opponent's next turn after you activate this card, your opponent cannot change the battle positions of monsters, except with a card effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c4a.name: Metalmorph
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c4a.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 300 ATK/DEF. If it attacks, it gains ATK equal to half the ATK of the attack target, during damage calculation only.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ace.name: Magistus Theurgy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ace.description: Target 1 "Magistus" monster you control; equip it with 1 "Magistus" monster, except a Level 4 monster, from your Extra Deck, GY, or face-up field. If you have at least 1 each "Magistus" Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters in your GY, you can equip it with 1 non-"Magistus" Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster from your Extra Deck, instead. You can only activate "Magistus Theurgy" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52acf.name: Magistus Vritra
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52acf.description: Target 1 Level 4 or lower "Magistus" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. If a "Magistus" card(s) in your Spell & Trap Zone would be destroyed by your opponent's card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Magistus Vritra" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae3.name: Maiden of Macabre
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae3.description: Each time this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, place 1 Spell Counter on it. This card gains 200 ATK for each Spell Counter on it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae5.name: Maiden of the Moonlight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae5.description: A sorcerer blessed by lunar light with powers far beyond mortal comprehension.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b0b.name: Malefic Cyber End Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b0b.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned, except by removing from play 1 "Cyber End Dragon" from your Extra Deck. There can only be 1 face-up "Malefic" monster on the field. Other monsters you control cannot declare an attack. If there is no face-up Field Spell Card on the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b73.name: Masked Knight LV3
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b73.description: During your Standby Phase: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Masked Knight LV5" from your hand or Deck. Once per turn: You can inflict 200 damage to your opponent. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b92.name: Mathmech Equation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b92.description: Target 1 "Mathmech" monster in your GY; Special Summon it, and if you do, it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Mathmech Equation" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b99.name: Matriarch of Nephthys
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b99.description: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "Nephthys" monster in your GY, except "Matriarch of Nephthys"; destroy 1 card in your hand, and if you do, Special Summon the targeted monster in Defense Position, but negate its effects. During your next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card from the GY. You can only use each effect of "Matriarch of Nephthys" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b9d.name: Max Warrior
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b9d.description: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, this card gains 400 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, until your next Standby Phase: this card becomes Level 2 and its original ATK and DEF are halved.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bae.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Blue Impala
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bae.description: Cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster, except for the Synchro Summon of a Machine-Type monster. The other Synchro Material Monster(s) are "Mecha Phantom Beast" monsters in your hand or on your side of the field. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc0.name: Mechaleon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc0.description: A large chameleon with the ability to alter its body coloring. Using this ability, it can conceal itself in any location.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bcb.name: Mefist the Infernal General
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bcb.description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Make your opponent discard 1 random card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd0.name: Megalith Emergence
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd0.description: You can target 1 "Megalith" monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but place it on the bottom of the Deck when it leaves the field (even if this card leaves the field). You can only use this effect of "Megalith Emergence" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c15.name: Meotoko
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c15.description: Dis big ol' guy wit' a big ol' eye shoots a nasty ray beam right atcha!

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c19.name: Mermaid Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c19.description: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c2b.name: Mermail Abysstrite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c2b.description:
3 Level 3 monsters
During either player's turn, when your opponent targets exactly 1 face-up "Mermail" monster you control for an attack, or with a Spell/Trap effect that could have targeted this card (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; that attack/effect now targets this card. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Mermail" monster in your Graveyard, except "Mermail Abysstrite"; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c2e.name: Message in a Bottle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c2e.description: Target 3 monsters with different Levels in your Graveyard; Special Summon all 3 of them. Their ATK's become 0, also their effects are negated. If you do not Xyz Summon this turn after Summoning those 3 monsters, you lose 4000 Life Points during the End Phase. You cannot Special Summon any other monsters, except by Xyz Summon, during the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab3.name: Magician of Chaos
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab3.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Chaos Form". This card's name becomes "Dark Magician" while on the field or in the GY. Once per turn, when a Spell/Trap Card or effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it. If this Ritual Summoned card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier" Ritual Monster from your hand, except "Magician of Chaos", ignoring its Summoning conditions.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52abd.name: Magician's Valkyria
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52abd.description: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target face-up Spellcaster-Type monsters for attacks, except this one.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad5.name: Magnet Conversion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad5.description: Target up to 3 Level 4 or lower "Magnet Warrior" monsters in your Graveyard; add them to your hand. During either player's turn, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 of your banished Level 4 or lower "Magnet Warrior" monsters; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b09.name: Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b09.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your Deck. There can only be 1 "Malefic" monster on the field. Other monsters you control cannot declare an attack. If there is no face-up Field Spell Card on the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b16.name: Malefic Territory
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b16.description: When this card is activated: You can activate 1 "Malefic World" from your Deck. While that card is in the Field Zone, neither player can target a card(s) in the Field Zone with card effects. The "Malefic" monster effect, "There can only be 1 face-up "Malefic" monster on the field" becomes "There can only be 1 face-up "Malefic" monster on the field with the same name". During the Battle Phase, negate the effects of face-up "Malefic" monsters on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b30.name: Manga Ryu-Ran
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b30.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Toon" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 2 monsters, while you control "Toon World". Cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 LP to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. Can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster, in which case this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7a.name: Massivemorph
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7a.description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; its ATK and DEF become double its current ATK and DEF, but it cannot attack directly.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb6.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Megaraptor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb6.description: When a Token(s) is Special Summoned to your side of the field: Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). You can only use this effect of "Mecha Phantom Beast Megaraptor" once per turn. This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 Token; add 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbd.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Warbluran
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbd.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard for the Synchro Summon of a Machine-Type monster: Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0), also, for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon any other monsters, except WIND monsters. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You can Tribute 1 other "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster; increase this card's Level by 1. You can only use 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Warbluran" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc9.name: Medusa Worm
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc9.description: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52be0.name: Megistric Maginician
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52be0.description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves. During the End Phase: You can remove 3 Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 of your banished Spells; add 1 card with the target's name from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Megistric Maginician" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf7.name: Meklord Deflection
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf7.description: Target 1 "Meklord" monster you control; your opponent takes no battle damage from attacks involving that face-up monster until the end of this turn, also its ATK becomes (permanently) the combined original ATK of all "Meklord" monsters you currently control. If a "Meklord" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only activate 1 "Meklord Deflection" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf8.name: Meklord Emperor Granel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf8.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When a face-up monster you control is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. This card gains ATK and DEF equal to half your LP. Once per turn: You can target 1 Synchro Monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card. This card gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of the monsters equipped to it by this effect. You can target 1 of these equipped monsters; Special Summon that target to your side of the field in Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c0e.name: Meltiel, Sage of the Sky
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c0e.description: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, gain 1000 LP, and if you do, if "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field, destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c1a.name: Mermaid Shark
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c1a.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 Level 3, 4 or 5 Fish-Type monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c1c.name: Mermail Abyssbalaen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c1c.description:
You can discard 4 other "Mermail" monsters to the Graveyard; Special Summon this card from your hand. When you do: Target cards your opponent controls, up to the number of "Mermail" monsters in your Graveyard (if possible); this card gains 500 ATK, and if it does, destroy those targets (if any). You can Tribute 1 other face-up Attack Position "Mermail" monster; this card gains the following effect this turn.
● At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c1f.name: Mermail Abyssgunde
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c1f.description: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Mermail" monster in your Graveyard, except "Mermail Abyssgunde"; Special Summon that target. You can only use the effect of "Mermail Abyssgunde" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c24.name: Mermail Abyssmander

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c28.name: Mermail Abyssocea
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c28.description: You can target 1 "Mermail" monster you control; Special Summon any number of Level 4 or lower "Mermail" monsters from your Deck whose combined Levels are less than or equal to the Level of that monster, then send that monster to the Graveyard. You can only use the effect of "Mermail Abyssocea" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c3b.name: Metalfoes Combination
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c3b.description: Once per turn, if a Fusion Monster is Fusion Summoned: You can target 1 "Metalfoes" monster in your Graveyard with a lower Level than that Fusion Monster; Special Summon it. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Metalfoes" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c48.name: Metallizing Parasite - Soltite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c48.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster cannot be targeted or destroyed by your opponent's monster effects. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52abe.name: Magicians Unite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52abe.description: If you control 2 or more Attack Position Spellcaster monsters: Target 1 of them; its ATK becomes 3000 until the end of this turn, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, other Spellcaster monsters you control cannot attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52adc.name: Maha Vailo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52adc.description: This card gains 500 ATK for each Equip Card equipped to this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b1e.name: Malice Ascendant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b1e.description: During your opponent's Standby Phase, send 1 card from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard for each "Malice Ascendant" in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b23.name: Malicevorous Knife
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b23.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Malicevorous" monster in your Graveyard except "Malicevorous Knife"; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b28.name: Man Eater
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b28.description: Man-eating plant with poison feelers for attacking enemies.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b2a.name: Man-Eating Plant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b2a.description: A meat-eating plant that is attractive to the eye but dangerous when approached.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b2e.name: Mana Dragon Zirnitron
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b2e.description: If a Spell/Trap you control leaves the field because of an opponent's effect, and is now in the GY or banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when that Spell/Trap left) or hand (even if not), then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap that is banished or in your GY to your Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use this effect of "Mana Dragon Zirnitron" once per turn. If Summoned this way, banish this card when it leaves the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b54.name: Marmiting Captain
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b54.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, then draw 1 card, then you can Special Summon it if it is a monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b68.name: Masked Clown
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b68.description: This warrior's fatal dance is performed with a lethal sickle.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b80.name: Master Monk
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b80.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Monk Fighter". This card can attack twice during the same turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b87.name: Master's Diploman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b87.description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 monster in your GY and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip the monster from your GY to that opponent's monster. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster loses ATK equal to the ATK of that monster equipped to it. Your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters they control that are equipped with Equip Cards in your Spell & Trap Zones.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b9e.name: Maximum Six
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b9e.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned: Roll a six-sided die, and this card gains ATK equal to the result x 200.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52baa.name: Mecha Bunny
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52baa.description: When this card is flipped face-up, select 1 card on the field and inflict 250 damage to its controller. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Mecha Bunny" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bde.name: Megazowler
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bde.description: Nothing stands in the way of this spike-covered dinosaur!

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf1.name: Meklord Army of Wisel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf1.description: This card gains 100 ATK for each "Meklord" monster on the field, except this card. Once per turn, when another "Meklord" monster you control declares an attack on a Defense Position monster your opponent controls: You can activate this effect; during that battle, if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bfb.name: Meklord Emperor Wisel - Synchro Absorption
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bfb.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Meklord" monster you control to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Meklord Emperor Wisel - Synchro Absorption" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack for the rest of this turn. When a card or effect is activated that would destroy a card(s) on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c00.name: Melchid the Four-Face Beast
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c00.description: This monster has four different masks for four different attacks.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c39.name: Metal Shooter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c39.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, place 2 counters on it. This card gains 800 ATK for each of these counters on it. If this card would be destroyed by a card effect, remove 1 of this card's counters instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c3e.name: Metalfoes Fusion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c3e.description: Fusion Summon 1 "Metalfoes" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Materials. If this card is in your Graveyard: You can shuffle it into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Metalfoes Fusion" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aeb.name: Majespecter Gust
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aeb.description: Target 1 "Majespecter" card in your Pendulum Zone; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b0e.name: Malefic Paradigm Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b0e.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Malefic" monster from your Extra Deck while "Malefic Paradigm Dragon" is not on the field. If "Malefic World" is not on the field, destroy this card. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Malefic" card from your Deck to the GY; return 1 of your banished Level 8 Synchro Monsters to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon that monster from the Extra Deck, also you can only attack with "Malefic" monsters for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b10.name: Malefic Paradox Gear
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b10.description: If a face-up Field Spell is on the field: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Malefic Parallel Gear" from your Deck, then, add 1 "Malefic" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Malefic Paradox Gear".
