If a "Malefic" monster would banish a monster to Special Summon itself by its own way, you can banish this card you control or in your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Malefic Paradox Gear" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b13.name: Malefic Red-Eyes Black Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b13.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" from your Deck. There can only be 1 "Malefic" monster on the field. Other monsters you control cannot declare an attack. If there is no face-up Field Spell on the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b1c.name: Malevolent Nuzzler
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b1c.description: The equipped monster gains 700 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 LP; place this card on the top of your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b31.name: Maniacal Servant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b31.description: Once per turn during your opponent's Standby Phase, you can remove from play any number of DARK monsters from your Graveyard. This monster gains 500 DEF for each monster you removed, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5b.name: Masaki the Legendary Swordsman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5b.description: Legendary swordmaster Masaki is a veteran of over 100 battles.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b61.name: Mask of Dispel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b61.description: Select 1 face-up Spell Card on the field. The controller of the Spell Card takes 500 points of damage during each of your Standby Phases. When the selected card is removed from the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bcd.name: Mega Ton Magical Cannon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bcd.description: Remove 10 Spell Counters on your side of the field. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf6.name: Meklord Astro the Eradicator
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf6.description: Target 3 "Meklord" monsters with different names in your GY; add them to your hand, OR Special Summon them, ignoring their Summoning conditions. Until the end of your next turn after this card is activated, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except Machine monsters. If you control a "Meklord Astro" monster: You can banish this card from your GY; destroy 1 Synchro Monster your opponent controls, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Meklord Astro the Eradicator" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c30.name: Metabo Globster
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c30.description: When you Tribute this card for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster, Special Summon 2 "Metabo Tokens" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c46.name: Metalhold the Moving Blockade
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c46.description: Activate this card by targeting any number of Level 4 Machine-Type monsters you control; Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 0/DEF 0), then equip those face-up monsters to this card. (This card is also still a Trap Card.) If Summoned this way, this card gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of the monsters equipped to it by this effect, monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters you control for attacks, except this one, also your opponent cannot target monsters you control with card effects, except this one.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c47.name: Metallizing Parasite - Lunatite
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c47.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to a face-up monster on your side of the field as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, that monster will be unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards controlled by your opponent. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the monster that this card is equipped to is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52abc.name: Magician's Rod
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52abc.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, that specifically lists the card "Dark Magician" in its text. During your opponent's turn, if you activate a Spell/Trap Card or effect while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Tribute 1 Spellcaster monster; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Magician's Rod" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad7.name: Magnet Reverse
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad7.description: Target 1 of your Machine or Rock monsters, that is banished or is in your GY, that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae4.name: Maiden of the Aqua
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ae4.description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the field is treated as "Umi" (however there is no increasing or decreasing of ATK/DEF due to "Umi"'s effect). If there is an active Field Spell Card on the field, this effect is not applied.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aee.name: Majespecter Storm
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52aee.description: Tribute 1 WIND Spellcaster-Type monster, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; shuffle it into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb9.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Sabre Hawk
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb9.description: This card cannot attack your opponent directly. If you have a monster in your Graveyard that is not a "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster, this card cannot attack. This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 Token, then target 1 card in either player's Graveyard; banish that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd4.name: Megalith Phaleg
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd4.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Megalith" card. You can discard this card; Ritual Summon 1 "Megalith" Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use this effect of "Megalith Phaleg" once per turn. Monsters you control gain 300 ATK/DEF for each Ritual Monster in your GY.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52be8.name: Mekk-Knight Orange Sunset
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52be8.description: If 2 or more cards are in the same column, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in that column. You can only Special Summon "Mekk-Knight Orange Sunset" once per turn this way. If an opponent's card in this card's column is destroyed by battle, or leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "Mekk-Knight" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bfe.name: Meklord Nucleus Infinity Core
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bfe.description: The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. You can only use each of the following effects of "Meklord Nucleus Infinity Core" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Meklord" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Meklord Emperor" monster from your hand or Deck with a different Attribute from the monsters you control, ignoring its Summoning conditions, also for the rest of this turn, you can only declare an attack with 1 monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c10.name: Memory Crush King
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c10.description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent by a direct attack, remove from play all Synchro Monsters in your opponent's Graveyard, and inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each monster removed.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c1d.name: Mermail Abyssdine
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c1d.description: When this card is added from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand by a card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You must control a "Mermail" monster to activate and to resolve this effect. When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Mermail" monster: You can target 1 Level 3 or lower "Mermail" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. You can only use 1 "Mermail Abyssdine" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c36.name: Metal Fish
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c36.description: A metal fish with a razor-sharp caudal fin.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c37.name: Metal Guardian
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c37.description: A fiend guarding the treasures of the netherworld, it's most at home in the dark.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c42.name: Metalfoes Silverd
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c42.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 other face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Set 1 "Metalfoes" Spell/Trap Card directly from your Deck.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
Sizzling soldier on a silver sublight speedjet. Can't track her, can't see her, can't escape that lightspeed laser.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad2.name: Magna-Slash Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad2.description: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell Card you control to the Graveyard to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad4.name: Magnet Circle LV2
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad4.description: Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Machine-Type monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad6.name: Magnet Force
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad6.description: This turn, all monsters on the field whose original Types are Machine or Rock, are unaffected by your opponent's monster effects (except their own).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad8.name: Magnetic Field
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ad8.description: If you control a Level 4 or lower EARTH Rock-Type monster: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "Magnet Warrior" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Magnetic Field" once per turn. Once per turn, at the end of the Damage Step, when an EARTH Rock-Type monster you control battled an opponent's monster, but the opponent's monster was not destroyed by the battle: You can return that opponent's monster to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b18.name: Malefic Tune
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b18.description: If a face-up "Malefic" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: Draw 2 cards. If a face-up "Malefic" monster(s) you control is destroyed, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Malefic" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Malefic Tune" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b29.name: Man-Eater Bug
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b29.description: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b74.name: Masked Knight LV5
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b74.description: During your Standby Phase: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Masked Knight LV7" from your hand or Deck. You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Summoned or flipped face-up. Once per turn: You can inflict 500 damage to your opponent. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b76.name: Masked Ninja Ebisu
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b76.description: Once per turn, if you control a face-up "Ninja" monster other than "Masked Ninja Ebisu", you can activate this effect: Return a number of your opponent's Spell/Trap Cards to the hand, equal to the number of "Ninja" monsters you control, also every face-up "Goe Goe the Gallant Ninja" you control can attack your opponent directly this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7f.name: Master Kyonshee
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7f.description: A wandering Kyonshee searching for a strong rival to defeat. They say he was known as the master of all martial arts.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b9a.name: Mausoleum of White
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b9a.description: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 Level 1 LIGHT Tuner in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; send 1 Normal Monster from your hand or Deck to the GY, and if you do, the targeted monster gains ATK/DEF equal to the Level of the monster sent to the GY x 100, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field). You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Burst Stream of Destruction" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba6.name: Mayosenju Hitot
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba6.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ] You can target 1 "Yosenju" card in your Pendulum Zone; for the rest of this turn, its Pendulum Scale becomes 11, also you cannot Special Summon monsters, except "Yosenju" monsters (even if this card leaves the field). During your End Phase: Return this card to the hand. You can only use each Pendulum Effect of "Mayosenju Hitot" once per turn.
[ Monster Effect ] Cannot be Special Summoned, except by Pendulum Summon. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; return it to the hand. Each time a card(s) on the field is returned to the hand or Main Deck by your card effect, while this card is on the field: All "Yosenju" monsters you currently control gain 500 ATK. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned this turn: Return it to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba8.name: Mech Bass
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ba8.description: A mechanized bass with a large mouth and a cannon on its back. The cannon fires blinding plasma rays.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bca.name: Medusa, Watcher of the Evil Eye
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bca.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Evil Eye" card in your GY, except "Medusa, Watcher of the Evil Eye"; add it to your hand. If this card is equipped with "Evil Eye of Selene" (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; banish it. You can only use this effect of "Medusa, Watcher of the Evil Eye" once per turn. Once per turn, during the next Standby Phase after this effect was activated: Banish 1 card in your GY.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bef.name: Meklord Army of Granel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bef.description: This card gains 100 ATK for each "Meklord" monster on the field, except this card. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; halve that target's ATK, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab0.name: Magician Navigation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ab0.description: Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand, then Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower DARK Spellcaster monster from your Deck. If you control "Dark Magician", except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52acc.name: Magistery Alchemist
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52acc.description: Banish 4 "HERO" monsters from your GY and/or face-up field, then target 1 "HERO" monster in your GY; Special Summon it, ignoring its Summoning conditions. If you banished EARTH, WATER, FIRE, and WIND Attributes to activate this effect, the monster's original ATK becomes doubled, also negate the effects of all face-up cards your opponent currently controls. You can only activate 1 "Magistery Alchemist" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b22.name: Malicevorous Fork
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b22.description: You can send 1 other Fiend-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard; Special Summon this card from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b27.name: Man Beast of Ares
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b27.description: After a Chain (of 2 or more Links) resolves, this card gains 500 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b77.name: Masked Sorcerer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b77.description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, draw 1 card from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7b.name: Master & Expert
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b7b.description: A deadly duo consisting of a beast master and its loyal servant.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b8f.name: Mathmech Billionblade Nayuta
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b8f.description: Equip only to a Cyberse monster. If the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation: You can send 1 "Mathmech" monster from your Deck to the GY; the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the sent monster's ATK, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field). If this card is sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY: You can target 1 "Mathmech" card in your GY, except "Mathmech Billionblade Nayuta"; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Mathmech Billionblade Nayuta" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bcc.name: Mega Thunderball
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bcc.description: Rolls along the ground releasing bolts of electricity to attack its enemies.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52be6.name: Mekk-Knight Green Horizon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52be6.description: If 2 or more cards are in the same column, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in that column. You can only Special Summon "Mekk-Knight Green Horizon" once per turn this way. When an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's monster in this card's column: You can target 1 "Mekk-Knight" monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c0d.name: Melomelody the Brass Djinn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c0d.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 "Djinn" Xyz Monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c11.name: Memory Crusher
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c11.description: If this card successfully attacks directly, inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their Extra Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52af7.name: Majestic Mech - Goryu
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52af7.description: You can Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card with 1 Tribute. If Summoned this way, during the End Phase: Send it to the Graveyard. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b08.name: Malacoda, Netherlord of the Burning Abyss
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b08.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Good & Evil in the Burning Abyss". Must be Ritual Summoned, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can send 1 "Burning Abyss" monster from your hand to the Graveyard, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; until the end of this turn, that target loses ATK and DEF equal to the ATK and DEF of the "Burning Abyss" monster sent to the Graveyard this way. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 card on the field; send it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b0c.name: Malefic Divide
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b0c.description: Target 1 "Malefic" monster in your GY; Special Summon it, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but its effects are negated, also banish it during the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b2b.name: Man-Eating Treasure Chest
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b2b.description: A monster disguised as a treasure chest that is known to attack the unwary adventurer.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b83.name: Master Pendulum, the Dracoslayer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b83.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once, while this card is in your Pendulum Zone: You can target 1 card in a Pendulum Zone; destroy it.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
"Luster Pendulum, the Dracoslayer" continues his journey to uncover the secrets of Dragon Alchemy, believing it is the key to dispelling his curse and restoring his memory. His power continues to grow... perhaps the same power used by the Dracofiends?

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb7.name: Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bb7.description: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster from your hand. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). You can only use this effect of "Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbe.name: Mecha Sea Dragon Plesion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbe.description: If you control a face-up Sea Serpent-Type monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 WATER monster to target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbf.name: Mecha-Dog Marron
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bbf.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to both players. When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard except by battle, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc3.name: Mechanicalchaser
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc3.description: A hunter that relentlessly pursues its target by order of the Machine King.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc7.name: Medium Piece Golem
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bc7.description: When this card is Summoned, if you control a "Big Piece Golem", you can Special Summon 1 "Small Piece Golem" from your Deck. That monster's effect is negated while it is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd1.name: Megalith Hagith
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd1.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Megalith" card. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 1 "Megalith" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect; Ritual Summon 1 Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, including this card on your field, whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster. You can only use this effect of "Megalith Hagith" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd6.name: Megalith Portal
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bd6.description: The first time each Ritual Summoned monster would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. If a "Megalith" monster is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Megalith Portal" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bdf.name: Megirus Light
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bdf.description: The fatal beams from the eyes of this monster result in grim destruction.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf4.name: Meklord Astro Dragon Triskelion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bf4.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 3 "Meklord" monsters with different names from your GY. Once per turn, when this card declares an attack: You can look at your opponent's Extra Deck and equip 1 monster from it to this card. This card gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of those equipped monsters. While equipped with a Synchro Monster, this card can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bfc.name: Meklord Factory
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bfc.description: When a "Meklord" monster on the field is targeted for an attack: Target 1 "Meklord Army" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand, then destroy the attack target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c0c.name: Melodious Illusion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c0c.description: Target 1 "Melodious" monster you control; this turn, that face-up monster you control is unaffected by your opponent's Spell/Trap effects, and it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c29.name: Mermail Abysspike
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c29.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard; add 1 Level 3 WATER monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mermail Abysspike" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c43.name: Metalfoes Steelen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c43.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 other face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Set 1 "Metalfoes" Spell/Trap Card directly from your Deck.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
Cool iron bodies meet burning metal machines and man/machine combine. Burn up the soul - Metalfoes Fusion!!

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52abb.name: Magician's Robe
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52abb.description: During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Spell/Trap; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your Deck. During your opponent's turn, if you activate a Spell/Trap Card or effect while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Magician's Robe" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ada.name: Magnificent Machine Angel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ada.description: Tribute 1 "Cyber Angel" Ritual Monster from your hand or field, then target 1 LIGHT Fairy monster you control; it gains ATK/DEF equal to the Level the monster had when Tributed x 200, until the end of this turn. This turn, if it battles an opponent's monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, that opponent's monster's effects are negated during that Battle Phase only. You can only activate 1 "Magnificent Machine Angel" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b02.name: Majioshaleon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b02.description: Your opponent cannot select this card as an attack target while they control any Spell/Trap Cards. During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b04.name: Major Riot
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b04.description: You can activate this card when 1 or more of your monsters are returned from the field to your hand by your opponent's effect. Return all Monster Cards on the field to your respective hands. Both you and your opponent then Special Summon from your hand the same number of Monster Cards on the field in face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b1d.name: Malfunction
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b1d.description: Pay 500 Life Points. Negate the activation of a Trap Card and return it to its original position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5a.name: Maryokutai
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5a.description: During your opponent's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5c.name: Mask Change
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b5c.description: Target 1 "HERO" monster you control; send it to the GY, also, after that, if it left the field by this effect, Special Summon 1 "Masked HERO" monster from your Extra Deck with the same Attribute that the sent monster had when it was on the field (its original Attribute, if face-down).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b60.name: Mask of Darkness
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b60.description: FLIP: Target 1 Trap in your GY; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b70.name: Masked HERO Goka
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b70.description: Must be Special Summoned with "Mask Change". Gains 100 ATK for each "HERO" monster in your GY.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b93.name: Mathmech Induction
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52b93.description: All Cyberse monsters you control gain 500 ATK. If you control a "Mathmech" monster: You can send this face-up card from the field to the GY, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Mathmech Induction" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bff.name: Mektimed Blast
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52bff.description: Target 1 "Meklord" monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls; destroy them.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c22.name: Mermail Abysslinde
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c22.description: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Mermail" monster from your Deck, except "Mermail Abysslinde". You can only use the effect of "Mermail Abysslinde" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c45.name: Metalfoes Volflame
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c45.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 other face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Set 1 "Metalfoes" Spell/Trap Card directly from your Deck.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
Roasting red rockets boost its blazing, bright-blast burners to liquified lava levels. Vanquisher of the Vanisher!

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c63.name: Meteor Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c63.description: This dragon appeared from the sky and crashed to the earth.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c65.name: Meteor Flare
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c65.description: Activate by sending 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard while your opponent has more than 3000 Life Points. Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If this card is in the Graveyard, you can add it to your hand instead of conducting your normal draw during your Draw Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c9f.name: Miracle Contact
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c9f.description: Shuffle into the Deck, from your hand, field, or GY, the Fusion Materials that are listed on an "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster that lists "Elemental HERO Neos" as Fusion Material, then Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ca0.name: Miracle Dig
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ca0.description: If 5 or more of your monsters are currently removed from play, return 3 of them to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52caf.name: Mirage Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52caf.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Dark Flare Knight" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During damage calculation only, this card gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling. During the End Phase of a turn this card attacked or was attacked: Banish this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cb4.name: Mirror Force Launcher
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cb4.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can discard 1 monster; add 1 "Mirror Force" from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this Set card is destroyed by your opponent's card effect and sent to your GY: You can Set this card from your GY and 1 "Mirror Force" from your hand, Deck, or GY. They can be activated this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cc7.name: Mist Bird Clausolas
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cc7.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; its ATK becomes 0, and if it does, its effects are negated. These changes last until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cd0.name: Mist Valley Thunder Lord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cd0.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Mist Valley" monsters
Once per turn, you can select 1 card you control. Return it to the hand, and this card gains 500 ATK until the End Phase. This effect can be activated during either player's turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cd1.name: Mist Valley Thunderbird
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cd1.description: When this face-up card on the field returns to the hand, Special Summon it. This card cannot attack during the turn it was Special Summoned by this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cd7.name: Mistaken Arrest
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cd7.description: Until the end of your next turn after this card resolves, neither player can add cards from their Deck to their hand except by drawing them.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d09.name: Mormolith
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d09.description: You can Tribute 1 face-up EARTH monster to destroy all face-up monsters with DEF equal to or less than the ATK of the Tributed card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d10.name: Morphtransition
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d10.description: Activate only when a face-up "Morphtronic" monster you control is selected as an attack target. Negate the attack, and change the battle position of the selected "Morphtronic" monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d46.name: Muscle Medic
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d46.description: If a player would take damage from a battle involving this card, they gain that much LP, instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d70.name: Mystical Sheep #2
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d70.description: A monstrous sheep with a long tail for hypnotizing enemies.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d71.name: Mystical Shine Ball
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d71.description: A soul of light covered by mystical shine. When you see its beautiful shape, your dream will come true.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dbc.name: Naturia Stag Beetle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dbc.description: Once per turn, during the Battle Step or Damage Step of this card's attack, when your opponent activates a card or effect, you can select 1 "Naturia" monster in your Graveyard. Special Summon that monster from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52de9.name: Nekroz of Brionac
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52de9.description:
You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Nekroz" Ritual Spell. Must be Ritual Summoned, without using "Nekroz of Brionac". You can only use each of these effects of "Nekroz of Brionac" once per turn.
● You can discard this card; add 1 "Nekroz" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Nekroz of Brionac".
● You can target up to 2 face-up monsters on the field that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; shuffle them into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e00.name: Neo Flamvell Shaman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e00.description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle while you have 3 or more "Flamvell" monsters in your Graveyard, select 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard and remove it from play. If your opponent does not have any Spell Cards in their Graveyard when this effect activates, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e09.name: Neo-Parshath, the Sky Paladin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e09.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Airknight Parshath". If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card. While "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field and your LP is higher than your opponent's, this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the difference in LP.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e0b.name: Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e0b.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 monster. If you control a monster with ATK greater than or equal to the ATK of the chosen card, destroy the chosen card, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Otherwise, take 500 damage.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e11.name: Neo-Spacian Twinkle Moss
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e11.description: This card's name is also treated as "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss". This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "NEX". When this card attacks or is attacked, draw 1 card. Reveal that card, and based on its type apply the proper effect: ● Monster: End the Battle Phase. ● Spell: You can change this card's attack to a direct attack. ● Trap: This monster is changed to Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e1a.name: Network Trap Hole
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e1a.description: When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) from the Main Deck or GY: Banish it face-down.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e23.name: Night Express Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e23.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 0.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e24.name: Night Lizard
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e24.description: A lizard warrior protected by a hide of very tough emerald scales.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e3d.name: Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e3d.description: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-up Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e49.name: Nitwit Outwit
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e49.description: Discard 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses ATK equal to the discarded monster's original ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e62.name: Noble Knights of the Round Table
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e62.description:
During your End Phase: You can activate each of these effects up to once per turn, depending on the total number of "Noble Knight" cards with different names in your Graveyard and/or you control;
● 3 or more: Send 1 "Noble Knight" card from your Deck to the Graveyard.
● 6 or more: Special Summon 1 "Noble Knight" monster from your hand, then you can equip 1 "Noble Arms" Equip Spell Card from your hand to that monster.
● 9 or more: Target 1 "Noble Knight" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.
● 12: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e72.name: Nordic Relic Megingjord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e72.description: Target 1 "Aesir" or "Nordic" monster you control; its ATK/DEF become double its original ATK/DEF, until the end of this turn, but it cannot attack your opponent directly this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e88.name: Number 17: Leviathan Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e88.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; this card gains 500 ATK. If this card has no Xyz Material, it cannot attack your opponent directly.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c53.name: Metaphys Armed Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c53.description: Usually visible despite its phantom existence.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c57.name: Metaphys Dimension
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c57.description: If your opponent Special Summons a monster (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of your banished "Metaphys" monsters; Special Summon it, but banish it during the End Phase of the next turn. If your other "Metaphys" card in its owner's possession is banished while this card is already face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it. You can only use each effect of "Metaphys Dimension" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c61.name: Meteor Black Comet Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c61.description:
1 Level 7 "Red-Eyes" monster + 1 Level 6 Dragon-Type monster
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can send 1 "Red-Eyes" monster from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to quarter the original ATK of that monster. If this card is sent from the Monster Zone to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c6a.name: MiSolfachord Eliteia
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c6a.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ] Pendulum Summons of your "Solfachord" Pendulum Monsters cannot be negated.
[ Monster Effect ] While you have an even Pendulum Scale in your Pendulum Zone, you take no damage from battles involving your "Solfachord" Pendulum Monsters. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; return it to the hand. You can only use this effect of "MiSolfachord Eliteia" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c93.name: Minefield Eruption
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c93.description: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each face-up "Mine Golem" on your side of the field. After that, destroy all face-up "Mine Golem"(s) on your side of the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cab.name: Miracle's Wake
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cab.description: Target 1 monster that was destroyed by battle and sent to your GY this turn; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cc5.name: Missus Radiant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cc5.description:
2 EARTH monsters
All EARTH monsters on the field gain 500 ATK and DEF, also all WIND monsters on the field lose 400 ATK and DEF. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 EARTH monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Missus Radiant" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cc9.name: Mist Condor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cc9.description: You can Special Summon this card from your hand by returning 1 face-up "Mist Valley" monster you control to the hand. If you do, this card's ATK becomes 1700.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ccd.name: Mist Valley Falcon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ccd.description: This card cannot declare an attack unless you return 1 card you control to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ce9.name: Molting Escape
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ce9.description: Equip only to a Reptile-Type monster. Once per turn, if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, it is not destroyed. The equipped monster gains 300 ATK at the end of the Damage Step each time this effect is applied.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cee.name: Monoceros
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cee.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 Spell Card from your hand. When you Synchro Summon using this card and a Beast-Type Tuner monster as the Synchro Material Monsters, you can select 1 Beast-Type Tuner monster used for the Synchro Summon and Special Summon it from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf0.name: Monster Express
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf0.description: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; send 1 monster from your Extra Deck to the GY with the same original Type as that face-up monster, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except monsters with the same original Type as the monster sent to the GY by this effect. You can only use this effect of "Monster Express" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d04.name: Morale Boost
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d04.description: Each time a player equips an Equip Spell Card, increase the Life Points of the controller of that Equip Spell Card by 1000 points. Each time an Equip Spell Card is removed from the field, the controller of that Equip Spell Card takes 1000 points of damage.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d15.name: Morphtronic Cameran
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d15.description: ● While in Attack Position: When this card is destroyed by battle, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Morphtronic" monster from your hand or Graveyard, except "Morphtronic Cameran". ● While in Defense Position: "Morphtronic" monsters on the field cannot be targeted by effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d19.name: Morphtronic Datatron
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d19.description: ● While in Attack Position: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 monster to inflict 300 damage to your opponent. ● While in Defense Position: Once per turn, you can inflict 150 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d26.name: Morphtronic Scopen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d26.description:
● While in Attack Position: Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 "Morphtronic" monster from your hand. Destroy it during the End Phase.
● While in Defense Position: While this card is in face-up Defense Position, it is Level 4.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d56.name: Mystery Shell Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d56.description: Mysterious living matter that suddenly appeared from a different dimension. Its attack paralyzes the target's nerves, and causes intense hallucinations.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d5b.name: Mystic Macrocarpa Seed
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d5b.description: Cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster, except for the Synchro Summon of an EARTH monster. You can target 1 EARTH monster on the field; reduce its Level by 1. You can use the effect of "Mystic Macrocarpa Seed" up to twice per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d6a.name: Mystical Fairy Elfuria
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d6a.description: Once per turn: You can reveal 1 WIND monster in your hand; until the end of your opponent's next turn, neither player can Xyz Summon using monsters with a different Level from the revealed monster as Xyz Material.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d91.name: NEXT
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d91.description: Special Summon any number of monsters with different names from your hand and/or GY, in Defense Position, that are all "Neo-Spacian" monsters or "Elemental HERO Neos", but negate their effects, and as long as you control any of those Special Summoned monsters face-up, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters. You can only activate 1 "NEXT" per turn. If you control no cards, you can activate this card from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d97.name: Nanobreaker
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d97.description: If this card attacks a face-up Level 3 or lower monster, destroy the monster immediately with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dab.name: Naturia Gaiastrio
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dab.description:
2 EARTH Synchro Monsters
During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that targets exactly 1 card on the field (and no other cards): You can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52df9.name: Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52df9.description:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"
At the end of the Damage Step, if this is the only face-up card you control, and this Fusion Summoned card attacked: You can send 1 "Blue-Eyes" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to the Graveyard; this card can attack again in a row. You can use this effect of "Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" up to twice per turn. During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that targets a "Blue-Eyes" monster(s) you control: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e05.name: Neo Space Connector
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e05.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster or 1 "Elemental HERO Neos" from your hand or Deck in Defense Position. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster or 1 "Elemental HERO Neos" in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Neo Space Connector" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e0f.name: Neo-Spacian Grand Mole
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e0f.description: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles an opponent's monster: You can return both the opponent's monster and this card to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e17.name: Nephthys, the Sacred Preserver
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e17.description:
2 "Nephthys" monsters
You can only use the following effect of "Nephthys, the Sacred Preserver" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was Link Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 Level 8 Winged Beast monster from your Deck to your hand, then you can add 1 Ritual Spell from your GY to your hand.
● Destroy 1 "Nephthys" monster this card points to, and Special Summon 1 "Nephthys" monster with a different original name from your GY, but negate its effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e1d.name: Next to be Lost
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e1d.description: Select 1 face-up monster you control. Send 1 card from your Deck to the Graveyard with the same name as the selected card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e29.name: Nightmare Horse
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e29.description: This card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly even if there is a monster on your opponent's side of the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e41.name: Ninjitsu Art of Mirage-Transformation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e41.description: Tribute 1 "Ninja" monster, then target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your field. It is also treated as a "Ninja" monster while this card is face-up on the field. When this card leaves the field, send that monster to the GY. You can only activate 1 "Ninjitsu Art of Mirage-Transformation" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e55.name: Noble Knight Brothers
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e55.description: This card can only attack if you control exactly 3 "Noble Knight" monsters (and no other monsters). When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 2 "Noble Knight" monsters from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Noble Knight" monsters. Once per turn: You can target 3 "Noble Knight" and/or "Noble Arms" cards in your GY; shuffle all 3 into the Deck, then draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e89.name: Number 18: Heraldry Patriarch
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e89.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per Chain, during either player's turn, if 2 or more monsters with the same name are on the field: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; choose 1 monster among those with the same name, and destroy all other monsters with that name. While this card remains face-up on the field, your opponent cannot Summon monsters with the same name as any of the monster(s) chosen for this card's effect. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can send 2 "Heraldic Beast" monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c59.name: Metaphys Factor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c59.description: Each turn, 1 Level 5 or higher "Metaphys" monster you Normal Summon can be Summoned without Tributing, but banish it during the End Phase of the next turn. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to your "Metaphys" monsters' effect activations.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c58.name: Metaphys Executor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c58.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 5 "Metaphys" cards with different names from your GY and/or face-up from your field. Cannot be destroyed, or banished, by card effects. Once per turn, if your opponent controls more cards than you do: You can target 1 of your banished "Metaphys" monsters; Special Summon it, but banish it during the End Phase of the next turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c74.name: Mikazukinoyaiba
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c74.description: A dragon warrior of the moon armed with a crescent sword.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c81.name: Mimiclay
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c81.description: If your opponent controls a monster: Target 1 Level 2 or lower Defense Position monster you control; Special Summon from your Deck, in Defense Position, 1 monster with the same name as that monster on the field, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only activate 1 "Mimiclay" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52caa.name: Miracle Synchro Fusion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52caa.description: Remove from play, from your side of the field or your Graveyard, the Fusion Material Monsters listed on a Fusion Monster Card that lists a Synchro Monster as a Fusion Material Monster, and Special Summon that Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck. (This Special Summon is treated as a Fusion Summon.) If this Set card is destroyed by your opponent's card effect and sent to the Graveyard, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cae.name: Mirage Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cae.description: Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf3.name: Monster Rebone
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf3.description: If your opponent Special Summoned a monster this turn: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard; Special Summon it to your side of the field in Defense Position. When this card leaves the field, banish that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d0f.name: Morpho Butterspy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d0f.description: Once per turn, when the battle position of an opponent's monster(s) is changed (except during the Damage Step): You can target one of those monsters; it loses 1000 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d1f.name: Morphtronic Map
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d1f.description: Each time a monster's battle position is changed, place 1 Morph Counter on this card. All "Morphtronic" monsters gain 300 ATK for each Morph Counter on this card. When this card is destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Morphtronic" monster from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d22.name: Morphtronic Radion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d22.description: ● While in Attack Position: "Morphtronic" monsters you control gain 800 ATK. ● While in Defense Position: "Morphtronic" monsters you control gain 1000 DEF.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d36.name: Mozarta the Melodious Maestra
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d36.description: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Fairy-Type monster from your hand. You cannot Special Summon other monsters the turn you activate this effect, except for LIGHT monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d80.name: Mythical Bestiary
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d80.description: Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY, then target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place up to 2 Spell Counters on it. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck that you can place a Spell Counter on, and if you do, place up to 2 Spell Counters on it. You can only activate 1 "Mythical Bestiary" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d9c.name: Naturia Antjaw
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d9c.description: When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), you can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower "Naturia" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dc2.name: Naturia White Oak
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dc2.description: When this card is targeted by an opponent's card effect, you can send this face-up card you control to the Graveyard to Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower "Naturia" monsters from your Deck. They cannot declare an attack, and are destroyed during your End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dd7.name: Needle Ceiling
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dd7.description: When there are 4 or more monsters on the field: Destroy all face-up monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ddd.name: Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousness
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ddd.description: You can only control 1 "Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousness". If you control a Spellcaster-Type monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52de5.name: Nekroz Cycle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52de5.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Nekroz" Ritual Monster. Tribute monsters from your hand or field, then Ritual Summon 1 "Nekroz" Ritual Monster from your hand or GY whose Level exactly equals the total Levels of those monsters. You can only use this effect of "Nekroz Cycle" once per turn. If you control no monsters: You can banish this card and 1 "Nekroz" monster from your GY; add 1 "Nekroz" Spell from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dec.name: Nekroz of Decisive Armor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dec.description:
You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Nekroz" Ritual Spell Card. Must be Ritual Summoned without using any Level 10 monsters, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can only use each of these effects of "Nekroz of Decisive Armor" once per turn.
● During either player's turn: You can discard this card, then target 1 "Nekroz" monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK and DEF until the end of this turn.
● You can target 1 Set card your opponent controls; destroy it, and if you do, banish it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e08.name: Neo the Magic Swordsman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e08.description: A dimensional drifter who not only practices sorcery, but is also a sword and martial arts master.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e44.name: Ninjitsu Art of Transformation
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e44.description: Activate this card by Tributing 1 face-up "Ninja" monster; Special Summon 1 Beast, Winged Beast, or Insect monster from your hand or Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the Level the Tributed monster had on the field +3. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e5b.name: Noble Knight Iyvanne
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e5b.description: If a "Noble Arms" Equip Spell becomes equipped to this card: You can Special Summon 1 "Noble Knight Token" (Warrior/LIGHT/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1000), also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Noble Knight" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Noble Knight Iyvanne" once per turn. While this card is equipped with a "Noble Arms" Equip Spell, all other "Noble Knight" monsters you control gain 500 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e5d.name: Noble Knight Medraut
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e5d.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field. While equipped with a "Noble Arms" Equip Spell, this card becomes an Effect Monster with this effect.
● This card becomes DARK and its Level is increased by 1. Once per turn, if you control no other monsters: You can Special Summon 1 "Noble Knight" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Noble Knight Medraut", and if you do, destroy 1 Equip Spell you control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e63.name: Nobledragon Magician
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e63.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Unless you have a "Magician" card in your other Pendulum Zone, destroy this card.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
Cannot be used as Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a Dragon Synchro Monster. If this card is used as Synchro Material, unless all other Synchro Materials are "Odd-Eyes" monsters, place this card on the bottom of the Deck. If this card is in your hand or GY: You can target 1 Level 7 or higher "Odd-Eyes" monster you control; reduce its Level by 3, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e64.name: Nobleman of Crossout
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e64.description: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Flip monster, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e75.name: Nova Summoner
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e75.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Fairy monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field, you can Special Summon 1 "Airknight Parshath" instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e85.name: Number 14: Greedy Sarameya
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e85.description:
2 Level 5 monsters
Your opponent takes any effect damage you would have taken from their card effects, instead. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy all monsters on the field whose current ATK is less than or equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c5b.name: Metaphys Nephthys
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c5b.description: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Metaphys" monster: You can banish all Set Spells and Traps on the field. If this card is banished, during the Standby Phase of the next turn: You can shuffle this banished card into the Deck; add 1 "Metaphys" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Metaphys Nephthys".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c6d.name: Michizure
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c6d.description: When a monster is sent from the field to your GY, even during the Damage Step: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c85.name: Minar
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c85.description: When this card is discarded directly from your hand to the Graveyard by an effect of a card controlled by your opponent, inflict 1000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c86.name: Mind Control
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c86.description: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, take control of that target, but it cannot declare an attack or be Tributed.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c99.name: Miniaturize
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c99.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster on the field with more than 1000 original ATK that has a Level; its Level is reduced by 1, also it loses 1000 ATK. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ccc.name: Mist Valley Executor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ccc.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, return all face-up Spell and Trap Cards on the field to their owners' hands.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cd8.name: Mistar Boy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cd8.description:
2 WATER monsters
All WATER monsters on the field gain 500 ATK and DEF, also all FIRE monsters on the field lose 400 ATK and DEF. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 WATER monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mistar Boy" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cdc.name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cdc.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cdd.name: Mobius the Mega Monarch
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cdd.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Tribute Summoned monster. When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 3 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets. If this card was Tribute Summoned by Tributing a WATER monster, add this additional effect.
● Your opponent cannot activate the targeted cards in response to this effect's activation.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ce2.name: Mokey Mokey King
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ce2.description:
"Mokey Mokey" + "Mokey Mokey" + "Mokey Mokey"
When this card is removed from the field, you can Special Summon as many "Mokey Mokey" as possible from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf6.name: Monster Reborn Reborn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf6.description: Target 3 monsters in your GY; your opponent chooses 1, you Special Summon it, and if you do, banish the rest. You can only activate 1 "Monster Reborn Reborn" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d00.name: Moon Envoy
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d00.description: Many have fallen victim to this lunar warrior's crescent pike.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d14.name: Morphtronic Boomboxen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d14.description:
● While in Attack Position, this card can attack twice during each Battle Phase.
● Once per turn, while in Defense Position, when a face-up "Morphtronic" monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can negate the attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d1c.name: Morphtronic Lantron
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d1c.description:
● While in Attack Position: Any effect damage you would take from an opponent's card effect is inflicted to your opponent instead.
● While in Defense Position: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you take no Battle Damage this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d2b.name: Morphtronic Videon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d2b.description:
● While in Attack Position: This card gains 800 ATK for each Equip Card equipped to it. 
● While in Defense Position: This card gains 800 DEF for each Equip Card equipped to it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d30.name: Motivating Captain
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d30.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but it has its effects negated.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d3c.name: Mudora
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d3c.description: This card gains 200 ATK for each Fairy-Type monster in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d43.name: Multiply
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d43.description: Tribute 1 face-up "Kuriboh"; Special Summon as many "Kuriboh Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 200) as possible, in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d44.name: Murmur of the Forest
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d44.description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-down Defense Position, then you can return all Field Spell Cards on the field to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d59.name: Mystic Horseman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d59.description: Half man and half horse, this monster is known for its extreme speed.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d74.name: Mystik Wok
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d74.description: Tribute 1 monster. Select either its ATK or DEF and gain that many Life Points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52db2.name: Naturia Mantis
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52db2.description: When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, you can send 1 "Naturia" monster from your hand to the Graveyard to destroy that monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52db8.name: Naturia Rock
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52db8.description: When a Trap Card is activated, you can send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard to Special Summon this card from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dd2.name: Necrovalley Temple
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dd2.description: While a "Gravekeeper's" monster(s) and "Necrovalley" are both on the field, monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK/DEF. Once per turn, during the Main Phase, if you control no card in your Field Zone: You can activate 1 "Necrovalley" directly from your hand or GY. If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's effect and sent to your GY: You can Set 1 "Necrovalley" Spell/Trap directly from your Deck, except "Necrovalley Temple".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52deb.name: Nekroz of Clausolas
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52deb.description:
You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Nekroz" Ritual Spell. Must be Ritual Summoned. You can only use each of these effects of "Nekroz of Clausolas" once per turn.
● You can discard this card; add 1 "Nekroz" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.
● (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; until the end of this turn, that target's ATK becomes 0, also that target's effects are negated.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dfc.name: Neo Flamvell Hedgehog
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dfc.description: If this card is destroyed by battle, select 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard and remove it from play. If this card on the field is destroyed by a card effect, select 1 FIRE monster with 200 or less DEF in your Graveyard, except "Neo Flamvell Hedgehog", and add it to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dfe.name: Neo Flamvell Origin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dfe.description: If you control a face-up "Flamvell" monster, except "Neo Flamvell Origin", and your opponent has 3 or less cards in their Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dff.name: Neo Flamvell Sabre
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dff.description: While your opponent has 4 or less cards in their Graveyard, this card gains 600 ATK. While your opponent has 8 or more cards in their Graveyard, this card loses 300 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e06.name: Neo Space Pathfinder
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e06.description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 "Neo Space" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e19.name: Nettles
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e19.description: If this face-up card would be destroyed, you can destroy 1 face-up Plant-Type monster you control instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e2f.name: Nimble Angler
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e2f.description: If this card is sent from the hand or Deck to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon up to 2 Level 3 or lower "Nimble" monsters from your Deck, except "Nimble Angler".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e33.name: Nimble Musasabi
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e33.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. You can also Special Summon up to 2 "Nimble Musasabi" from your Deck to your opponent's side of the field in face-up Attack Position. This card cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e34.name: Nimble Sunfish
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e34.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, send 1 Fish-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Nimble Sunfish" from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e4d.name: Noble Arms - Caliburn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e4d.description: You can only control 1 "Noble Arms - Caliburn". Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster. It gains 500 ATK. Once per turn: You can gain 500 LP. If this face-up card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Warrior-Type "Noble Knight" monster you control; equip this card to that target. You can only use this effect of "Noble Arms - Caliburn" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e50.name: Noble Arms - Gallatin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e50.description: You can only control 1 "Noble Arms - Gallatin". Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster. It gains 1000 ATK. During each of your Standby Phases, it loses 200 ATK. If this face-up card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Warrior-Type "Noble Knight" monster you control; equip this card to that target. You can only use this effect of "Noble Arms - Gallatin" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e68.name: Noisy Gnat
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e68.description: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard to target 1 face-up monster on the field; increase that target's Level by 1, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e6f.name: Nordic Relic Draupnir
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e6f.description: Equip only to an "Aesir" or "Nordic" monster. It gains 800 ATK. If this face-up card on the field is destroyed by a card effect: You can add 1 "Nordic Relic" card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e71.name: Nordic Relic Laevateinn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e71.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field that destroyed a monster by battle this turn; destroy it. Cards and effects cannot be activated in response to this card's activation.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e81.name: Number 10: Illumiknight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e81.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e82.name: Number 11: Big Eye
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e82.description:
2 Level 7 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e86.name: Number 15: Gimmick Puppet Giant Grinder
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e86.description:
2 Level 8 monsters
Up to twice per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; destroy it, then if it was an Xyz Monster, inflict damage to your opponent equal to  half its original ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c7f.name: Milus Radiant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c7f.description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all EARTH monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all WIND monsters by 400 points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c5a.name: Metaphys Horus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c5a.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can activate the appropriate effect(s), depending on the non-Tuner monster(s) used as Synchro Material;
● Normal Monster: This face-up card is unaffected by other card effects this turn.
● Effect Monster: You can target 1 other face-up card on the field; negate that target's effects.
● Pendulum Monster: Your opponent chooses 1 monster they control and gives control of it to you, but it cannot attack this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c84.name: Mimir of the Nordic Ascendant
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c84.description: Once per turn, at the start of your Standby Phase, if you control a "Nordic" monster and this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Spell from your hand to the GY; Special Summon this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cba.name: Mirror of Oaths
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cba.description: When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) from their Main Deck: Destroy that monster(s), and if you do, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ce5.name: Molten Conduction Field
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ce5.description: Send 2 "Laval" monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ce6.name: Molten Destruction
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ce6.description: All FIRE monsters gain 500 ATK and lose 400 DEF.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d05.name: Moray of Greed
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d05.description: Shuffle 2 WATER monsters from your hand into the Deck, then draw 3 cards.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d23.name: Morphtronic Remoten
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d23.description:
● Once per turn, while in Attack Position: You can target 1 "Morphtronic" monster in your Graveyard; banish that target and add 1 "Morphtronic" monster with the same Level as the target from your Deck to your hand.
● Once per turn, while in Defense Position: You can send 1 "Morphtronic" monster from your hand to the Graveyard and add 1 other "Morphtronic" monster with the same Level as that monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d2f.name: Mother Spider
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d2f.description: If you have only Insect-Type monsters in your Graveyard, you can send 2 face-up Defense Position monsters your opponent controls to the Graveyard and Special Summon this card from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d34.name: Mountain
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d34.description: All Dragon, Winged Beast, and Thunder monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d76.name: Mythic Tree Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d76.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 WATER Dragon-Type monster you control; this card's Level becomes the current Level of that monster.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d77.name: Mythic Water Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d77.description: If you control an EARTH monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Mythic Water Dragon" once per turn this way.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d95.name: Naglfar, Generaider Boss of Fire
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d95.description: You can only control 1 "Naglfar, Generaider Boss of Fire". If a card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 "Generaider" monster or 1 Beast-Warrior monster you control instead. You can only use this effect of "Naglfar, Generaider Boss of Fire" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d9a.name: Natural Tune
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d9a.description: Select 1 face-up Level 4 or lower Normal Monster you control. It is treated as a Tuner monster while it is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52db9.name: Naturia Rosewhip
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52db9.description: Your opponent can only activate 1 Spell/Trap Card per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dc6.name: Necklace of Command
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dc6.description:
When a monster you control that's equipped with this card is destroyed by battle, and this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can either:
● Draw 1 card. OR
● Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dc8.name: Necro Fleur
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dc8.description: If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Sorciere de Fleur" from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dde.name: Nega-Ton Corepanel
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dde.description: Activate only if you control a face-up "Koa'ki Meiru" monster and have "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" in your Graveyard. Negate the activation of an Effect Monster's effect, and destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52de7.name: Nekroz Mirror
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52de7.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Nekroz" Ritual Monster. Tribute monsters from your hand or field, and/or banish "Nekroz" monsters from your GY, then Ritual Summon 1 "Nekroz" Ritual Monster from your hand whose Level exactly equals the total Levels of those monsters. You can only use this effect of "Nekroz Mirror" once per turn. If you control no monsters: You can banish this card and 1 "Nekroz" monster from your GY; add 1 "Nekroz" Spell from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e26.name: Night Wing Sorceress
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e26.description: You can activate "Assault Mode Activate" the turn it is Set.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e31.name: Nimble Manta
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e31.description: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can Special Summon any number of "Nimble Manta" from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e3a.name: Ningirsu the World Chalice Warrior
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e3a.description:
2+ Link Monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: Draw cards equal to the number of "World Chalice" monsters this card points to. You can only use this effect of "Ningirsu the World Chalice Warrior" once per turn. Once per turn: You can send 1 card from each player's field to the GYs. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "World Chalice" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e40.name: Ninjitsu Art of Duplication
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e40.description: Tribute 1 "Ninja" monster; Special Summon any number of "Ninja" monsters from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position, with combined Levels less than or equal to the Level of the Tributed monster. When this card leaves the field: Destroy those monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e4a.name: Niwatori
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e4a.description: Swallows enemies whole and uses their essence as energy.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e5e.name: Noble Knight Pellinore
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e5e.description: You can target 1 "Noble Arms" Equip Spell equipped to this card and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy them, then draw 1 card, also, this card cannot attack for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Noble Knight Pellinore" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c68.name: Metrognome
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c68.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 other card in a Pendulum Zone; this card's Pendulum Scale becomes equal to that card's, until the end of this turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
While you have 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones with the same Pendulum Scale, this card gains ATK and DEF equal to the Pendulum Scale x 100, and can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Destroy all cards in the Pendulum Zones.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c88.name: Mind Drain
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c88.description: Activate this card by paying 1000 LP. Effects of monsters in the hand cannot be activated.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c9b.name: Minoan Centaur
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c9b.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. You can Tribute this card to Special Summon 2 Level 4 Beast-Warrior-Type Normal Monsters from your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c9c.name: Minomushi Warrior
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c9c.description: A rock warrior that wields a heavy blade carved from stone.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cde.name: Mogmole
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cde.description: When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon it from your Graveyard in face-up Defense Position. You can only use the effect of "Mogmole" once per Duel.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf1.name: Monster Eye
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf1.description: You can pay 1000 Life Points; add 1 "Polymerization" from your Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf7.name: Monster Recovery
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cf7.description: Target 1 monster you control that is owned by you; if that monster is still on the field, shuffle it and your entire hand into the Deck, also, after that, draw cards equal to the number of cards you shuffled from your hand into the Deck by this effect. (You cannot activate this card if you have a card in your hand that is owned by your opponent.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cfc.name: Monsturtle
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cfc.description: Protected by a spiked shell, this turtle has a very nasty disposition.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d02.name: Moonlit Papillon
