60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ced.description: When using this card as Synchro Material, the other Synchro Material(s) must be Level 4 or lower Warrior or Machine-Type monsters, and they are treated as Level 1.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d3e.name: Muka Muka
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d3e.description: This card gains 300 ATK and DEF for each card in your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d45.name: Musakani Magatama
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d45.description: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, that destroys a card(s), while you control a "Six Samurai" monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d49.name: Mushroom Man #2
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d49.description: A player controlling this monster loses 300 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases when this card is face-up on the field. Control of this card is shifted to your opponent by paying 500 Life Points at your own End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d4b.name: Mustering of the Dark Scorpions
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d4b.description: If you control a face-up "Don Zaloog": You can Special Summon any number of "Dark Scorpion" monsters from your hand, but only 1 copy of each.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d72.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d72.description: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d90.name: NEX
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d90.description: Send 1 face-up "Neo-Spacian" monster you control to the Graveyard. Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster with the same name from your Extra Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52da2.name: Naturia Butterfly
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52da2.description: Once per turn, when your opponent's monster declares an attack, you can send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard and negate that attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dd6.name: Needle Burrower
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dd6.description: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the Level of the destroyed monster x 250 points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dfa.name: Neo Bug
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dfa.description: A huge bug-like monster said to come from another planet. It gathers in swarms.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e0c.name: Neo-Spacian Dark Panther
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e0c.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, this card's name becomes that monster's original name, also replace this effect with that monster's original effects (if any).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e1b.name: Neutron Blast
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e1b.description: Target 1 Fusion Summoned "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" you control; this turn, it can make a second and third attack during each Battle Phase, also when it attacks, your opponent's cards and effects cannot be activated until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e1c.name: Newdoria
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e1c.description: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e45.name: Nirvana High Paladin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e45.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If a Pendulum Monster you control attacks, for that battle, it cannot be destroyed by battle, also you take no battle damage. At the end of the Damage Step, if a Pendulum Monster you control attacked: All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK equal to that attacking monster's ATK, until the end of this turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
For this card's Synchro Summon, you can treat 1 Pendulum Summoned Pendulum Monster you control as a Tuner. If this card is Synchro Summoned using a Pendulum Summoned Pendulum Monster Tuner: You can target 1 card in your Graveyard; add it to your hand. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can halve your opponent's LP. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e60.name: Noble Knight's Shield-Bearer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e60.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can banish 1 LIGHT Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard: draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e61.name: Noble Knight's Spearholder
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e61.description: You can Tribute this card; add 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e76.name: Novox's Prayer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e76.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Skull Guardian". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 7 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e91.name: Number 25: Force Focus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e91.description:
2 Level 6 monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 Level 5 or higher Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate the effects of that opponent's face-up monster, until the end of the turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c66.name: Meteor of Destruction
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c66.description: If your opponent's Life Points are higher than 3000: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c8e.name: Mind Trust
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52c8e.description: Tribute 1 Level 2 or higher monster. Add 1 Tuner Monster from your Graveyard to your hand whose Level is less than or equal to half of the Tributed monster's.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cb6.name: Mirror Ladybug
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cb6.description: If you control at least 1 face-up monster and have no monsters in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card from your hand. When this card is Special Summoned this way, this card's Level becomes equal to the total Levels of all other monsters you control. If the Level of this card is higher than 12, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cce.name: Mist Valley Shaman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cce.description: Once per turn, you can return 1 other monster you control to the hand, to have this card gain 500 ATK until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ccf.name: Mist Valley Soldier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ccf.description: While you control this face-up card, any opponent's monster that battles this card, but is not destroyed by the battle, returns to its owner's hand at the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cda.name: Mixeroid
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52cda.description: You can Tribute 1 Machine monster; Special Summon 1 non-WIND "roid" monster from your Deck. You can pay half your LP and banish any number of Machine monsters from your GY, including this card; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "roid" Fusion Monster with the same Level as the number of those banished monsters, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "Mixeroid" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d03.name: Mooyan Curry
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d03.description: Choose 1 player; that player gains 200 Life Points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d25.name: Morphtronic Rusty Engine
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d25.description: Equip only to a "Morphtronic" monster. If the equipped monster is destroyed, inflict damage to each player equal to half its original ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d2c.name: Morphtronics, Scramble!
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d2c.description: Activate only when your opponent declares a direct attack while you control no monsters. Negate that attack and Special Summon 1 "Morphtronic" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d37.name: Mr. Volcano
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d37.description: This seemingly mild-mannered creature has an extremely volatile temper.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d5d.name: Mystic Piper
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d5d.description: You can Tribute this card to draw and reveal 1 card. If that card is a Level 1 Monster Card, draw 1 more card. The effect of "Mystic Piper" can only be activated once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d65.name: Mystical Beast of Serket
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52d65.description: If you do not control "Temple of the Kings", destroy this card. Banish any monster destroyed by battle with this card. If this card destroys a monster by battle: It gains 500 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52db0.name: Naturia Landoise
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52db0.description:
1 EARTH Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner EARTH monsters
While this card is face-up on the field, you can send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to negate the activation of an Effect Monster's effect and destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dd8.name: Needle Soldier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dd8.description: If this card is used as a Synchro Material Monster for a Synchro Monster, during battle between that Synchro Monster and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of that Synchro Monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dfb.name: Neo Flamvell Garuda
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52dfb.description: During your End Phase, if you control another face-up "Flamvell" monster, select 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard and remove it from play.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e10.name: Neo-Spacian Marine Dolphin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e10.description: This card's name is also treated as "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin". This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "NEX". Once per turn, you can discard 1 card to look at your opponent's hand and select 1 Monster Card in it. If you control a monster with ATK greater than or equal to the selected monster's, destroy the selected monster and inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e5f.name: Noble Knight Peredur
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e5f.description: While equipped with a "Noble Arms" Equip Spell Card, this card becomes DARK and its Level is increased by 1. If this card is sent to the Graveyard while equipped with a "Noble Arms" Equip Spell Card: Target 1 "Noble Arms" card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e6d.name: Nopenguin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e6d.description: During either player's turn, when an effect of a "Penguin" monster is activated: Special Summon this card from your Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Nopenguin" once per turn. If a card would be returned from the field to the hand by the effect of a "Penguin" card, banish it instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e6e.name: Nordic Relic Brisingamen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e6e.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; the ATK of the first target becomes equal to the original ATK of the second target, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ec3.name: Number 63: Shamoji Soldier
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ec3.description:
2 Level 1 monsters
You can only use the effect of "Number 63: Shamoji Soldier" once per turn. You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then activate 1 of these effects;
● At the start of your opponent's next Standby Phase, each player draws 1 card.
● Each player gains 1000 Life Points.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ed5.name: Number 7: Lucky Straight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ed5.description:
3 Level 7 monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; roll a six-sided die twice and this card's ATK becomes the larger number rolled x 700 until your opponent's next End Phase, then if the total roll was exactly 7, apply 1 of these effects.
● Send all other cards on the field to the Graveyard.
● Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or from either Graveyard.
● Draw 3 cards, then discard 2 cards.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52edd.name: Number 87: Queen of the Night
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52edd.description:
3 Level 8 monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 Set Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; while this card is face-up on the field, that Set card cannot be activated.
● Target 1 Plant-Type monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.
● Target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target gains 300 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ea8.name: Number 40: Gimmick Puppet of Strings
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ea8.description:
2 Level 8 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; place 1 String Counter on each face-up monster on the field, except this card. Once per turn, during the next End Phase of the opponent of the player who placed a String Counter(s) by this effect: Destroy the monsters with String Counters, and if you do, inflict 250 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ede.name: Number 88: Gimmick Puppet of Leo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ede.description:
3 Level 8 monsters
Once per turn, if you have no cards in your Spell & Trap Card Zone: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, and if you do, place 1 Destiny Counter on this card. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect. When 3 Destiny Counters are on this card, you win the Duel.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee5.name: Number 94: Crystalzero
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee5.description:
2 Level 5 WATER monsters
During either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; its ATK becomes half its current ATK until the end of your turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f31.name: Odd-Eyes Advance Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f31.description: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Level 5 or higher monster. If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that monster's original ATK. When this card destroys a monster by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, except "Odd-Eyes Advance Dragon". You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Advance Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f37.name: Odd-Eyes Lancer Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f37.description: If a Pendulum Monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If an "Odd-Eyes" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 "Odd-Eyes" card in your hand, Monster Zone, or Pendulum Zone instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52eec.name: Number 9: Dyson Sphere
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52eec.description:
2 Level 9 monsters
Once per Battle Step, during your opponent's turn, if this card with Xyz Material is attacked: Negate the attack (this is a Quick Effect). When this card is targeted for an attack while it has no Xyz Materials: You can target 2 monsters in your Graveyard; attach those targets to this card as Xyz Materials. During your Main Phase 1: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; this card can attack your opponent directly this turn. Your opponent must control a monster with higher ATK than this card for you to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f40.name: Odd-Eyes Raging Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f40.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn, if you have no cards in your other Pendulum Zone: You can place 1 Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
2 Level 7 Dragon-Type monsters
If you can Pendulum Summon Level 7, you can Pendulum Summon this face-up card in your Extra Deck. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can place it in your Pendulum Zone. If this card is Xyz Summoned using an Xyz Monster as Material, it gains these effects.
● It can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.
● Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy as many cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, this card gains 200 ATK for each, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f88.name: Ooguchi
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f88.description: This monster may attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f91.name: Oracle of Zefra
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f91.description:
When this card is activated: Add 1 "Zefra" monster from your Deck to your hand. When you Ritual Summon using a "Zefra" monster, or Special Summon using a "Zefra" monster as Material, you can activate these effects depending on the monster Summoned, once per turn per effect:
● Ritual: Shuffle 1 monster on the field into the Deck.
● Fusion: Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.
● Synchro: Choose 1 monster from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck.
● Xyz: Draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
You can only activate 1 "Oracle of Zefra" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa5.name: Ordeal of a Traveler
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa5.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent chooses 1 random card in your hand and calls the type of the card (Monster, Spell, or Trap), and if they call it wrong, return the attacking monster to the hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f0e.name: Number XX: Utopic Dark Infinity
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f0e.description:
2+ Level 10 monsters
When a monster is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target that monster; Special Summon it to your field in Defense Position. You can target 1 other face-up Special Summoned monster you control; gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Number XX: Utopic Dark Infinity" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fca.name: Overpowering Eye
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fca.description: Target 1 Zombie monster you control with 2000 or less ATK; it can attack directly this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2f.name: Ocubeam
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2f.description: Frightening in appearance, this creature uses its large eyes and ears to keep track of any movement.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fcd.name: Overwind
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fcd.description: Target 1 face-up "Wind-Up" monster you control; its ATK and DEF are doubled, and it returns to the hand during the End Phase. You can only activate 1 "Overwind" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f59.name: Ojama Black
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f59.description: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd0.name: Oxygeddon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd0.description: If this card is destroyed by battle with a Pyro monster and sent to the GY: Each player takes 800 damage.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f81.name: Oni-Gami Combo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f81.description: Target 1 face-up Xyz Monster you control and detach all of its Xyz Material; this turn, that target can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fea.name: Pair Cycroid
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fea.description:
2 Machine-Type monsters with the same name
This card can attack your opponent directly.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f84.name: Onomatopaira
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f84.description:
You can only activate 1 "Onomatopaira" per turn. Send 1 card from your hand to the GY; add up to 2 of these monsters from your Deck to your hand (you cannot add 2 from the same category).
● 1 "Zubaba" monster
● 1 "Gagaga" monster
● 1 "Gogogo" monster
● 1 "Dododo" monster

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f87.name: Onslaught of the Fire Kings
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f87.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters: Special Summon 1 FIRE Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster from your Deck. Its effects are negated, also it is destroyed during the End Phase. You can only activate 1 "Onslaught of the Fire Kings" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ff3.name: Pale Beast
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ff3.description: With skin tinged a bluish-white, this strange creature is a fearsome sight to behold.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f90.name: Option Hunter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f90.description: Activate only when a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard. Gain Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53012.name: Parallel Twister
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53012.description: Send 1 other Spell/Trap Card you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa4.name: Orcustrion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa4.description:
2+ Effect Monsters, including an "Orcust" monster
This linked card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You can target 3 of your banished Machine monsters; shuffle them into the Deck, and if you do, the ATK/DEF of any linked monster(s) your opponent currently controls become 0, also their effects are negated. You can only use this effect of "Orcustrion" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd8.name: PSY-Framegear Alpha
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd8.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by a card effect, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) while you control no monsters (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon both this card from your hand and 1 "PSY-Frame Driver" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and if you do, add 1 "PSY-Frame" card from your Deck to your hand, except "PSY-Framegear Alpha". During the End Phase, banish the face-up monsters Special Summoned by this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fec.name: Palace of the Elemental Lords
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fec.description: All monsters you control gain ATK/DEF equal to the number of different Attributes in your GY x 200. Once per turn: You can add 1 "Elementsaber" monster from your Deck to your hand, but skip the Battle Phase of your next turn (even if this card leaves the field). Once per turn, if an "Elementsaber" monster in your hand or field would send a card(s) from the hand to the GY to activate an effect, you can send that many "Elementsaber" monster(s) from your Deck to the GY, instead.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fef.name: Paladin of Photon Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fef.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Luminous Dragon Ritual". You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" from your hand or Deck. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e9c.name: Number 34: Terror-Byte
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e9c.description:
3 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 Level 4 or lower Attack Position monster your opponent controls; gain control of it until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ebd.name: Number 58: Burner Visor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ebd.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up Xyz Monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in Attack Position. The equipped monster can attack your opponent directly. When the equipped monster inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can discard 1 card; inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee3.name: Number 92: Heart-eartH Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee3.description:
3 Level 9 monsters
This card cannot be destroyed by battle, also your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. During your opponent's End Phase: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; banish all cards your opponent currently controls that were Normal or Special Summoned, or were Set, this turn. If this card is destroyed while it has Xyz Material: You can Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When you do: It gains 1000 ATK for every card currently banished.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f26.name: Obese Marmot of Nefariousness
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f26.description: An ill-mannered field varmint that will sink its teeth into anything.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f28.name: Obnoxious Celtic Guard
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f28.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or more ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2c.name: Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2c.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Levia-Dragon - Daedalus". You can send "Umi" you control to the Graveyard to send all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the Graveyard, except this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f41.name: Odd-Eyes Rebellion Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f41.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn, if you have no cards in your other Pendulum Zone: You can place 1 Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
2 Level 7 Dragon-Type monsters
If you can Pendulum Summon Level 7, you can Pendulum Summon this face-up card in your Extra Deck. If this card is Xyz Summoned by using an Xyz Monster as a Material: Destroy as many Level 7 or lower monsters your opponent controls as possible, inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each card destroyed, and if you do, this card can make 3 attacks during each Battle Phase this turn. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can destroy as many cards in your Pendulum Zones as possible (min. 1), and if you do, place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f56.name: Oh F!sh!
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f56.description: When an Effect Monster's effect activates: Shuffle 1 of your banished Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monsters into the Main Deck; negate the activation and destroy it.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f61.name: Ojama Knight
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f61.description:
1 "Ojama" monster + 1 "Ojama" monster
Select up to 2 of your opponent's Monster Card Zones. The selected zones cannot be used.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f68.name: Ojamandala
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f68.description: Pay 1000 Life Points. Special Summon 1 "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f6c.name: Old Entity Cthugua
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f6c.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can return all Rank 4 Xyz Monsters on the field to the Extra Deck. If you Fusion Summon using this card as Fusion Material: Draw 1 card. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as Xyz Material gains this effect.
● If it is Xyz Summoned: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f70.name: Omega Goggles
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f70.description: Equip only to a monster you control. Once per turn, you can look at 1 random card in your opponent's hand. The equipped monster cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f79.name: One-Eyed Shield Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f79.description: This dragon wears a shield not only for its own protection, but also for ramming its enemies.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f95.name: Orbital 7
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f95.description: When this card is flipped face-up: Place 1 You Got It Boss! Counter on it. You can remove all You Got It Boss! Counters on this card; its ATK becomes 2000. After you change this card's ATK with this effect, it cannot attack your opponent directly for the rest of this turn, and is sent to the Graveyard during the End Phase. You can Tribute this card to target 1 "Photon" or "Galaxy" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa8.name: Orea, the Sylvan High Arbiter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa8.description:
2 Level 7 monsters
Once per turn: You can send 1 Plant-Type monster from your hand or face-up from your side of the field to the Graveyard; look at a number of cards from the top of your Deck equal to the Level that the sent monster had in the hand or on the field, then place them on the top of the Deck in any order. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; choose a number from 1 to 3, then excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, send any excavated Plant-Type monsters to the Graveyard, and if you do, return up to that many cards on the field to the hand (min.1), except this card. Also, place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb0.name: Otherworld - The "A" Zone
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb0.description: If your opponent's monster battles an "Alien" monster you control, the opponent's monster loses 300 ATK and DEF during damage calculation only.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb2.name: Otohime
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb2.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fc3.name: Overlay Capture
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fc3.description: Target 1 face-up Xyz Monster your opponent controls that has Xyz Material and 1 face-up Xyz Monster you control; detach all Xyz Materials from the opponent's monster, and if you do, attach this card to your monster as an Xyz Material.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd6.name: PSY-Frame Multi-Threader
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd6.description: This card's name becomes "PSY-Frame Driver" while it is in the hand or Graveyard. If a "PSY-Frame" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can discard this card instead. If a "PSY-Frame" Tuner is Special Summoned to your field, while this card is in your Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "PSY-Frame Multi-Threader" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5300c.name: Papa-Corn
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5300c.description: While a Field Spell Card is face-up on the field, this card gains 1000 ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ea1.name: Number 39: Utopia
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ea1.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
When a monster declares an attack: You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the attack. If this card is targeted for an attack, while it has no material: Destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f12.name: Numen erat Testudo
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f12.description: Neither player can Special Summon monsters with 1800 or less ATK.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2e.name: Octoberser
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2e.description: With the head of a fish and the legs of an octopus, this strange creature attacks enemies by flinging spears.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f3c.name: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f3c.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You can reduce the battle damage you take from an attack involving a Pendulum Monster you control to 0. During your End Phase: You can destroy this card, and if you do, add 1 Pendulum Monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each Pendulum Effect of "Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card battles an opponent's monster, any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is doubled.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f8c.name: Opera the Melodious Diva
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f8c.description: Cannot attack the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Fusion Material for a Fusion Summon: You can activate this effect; for the rest of this turn, "Melodious" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f9c.name: Orcust Harp Horror
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f9c.description: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Orcust" monster from your Deck, except "Orcust Harp Horror", also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters. You can only use this effect of "Orcust Harp Horror" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa2.name: Orcustrated Release
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa2.description: Tribute 2 Machine monsters, then target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it. If your opponent controls a Link Monster, you can target 2 monsters, instead. You can only activate 1 "Orcustrated Release" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa7.name: Order to Smash
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa7.description: Target 1 Level 2 or lower non-Token Normal Monster you control; Tribute that Normal Monster, and if you do, destroy up to 2 Spells/Traps your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fcf.name: Owner's Seal
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fcf.description: Return control of all monsters on the field to their original owners.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fe7.name: Painful Decision
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fe7.description: Send 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, add 1 card with the same name as that card from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Painful Decision" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ffc.name: Paleozoic Marrella
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ffc.description: Send 1 Trap from your Deck to the GY. Once per Chain, when a Trap Card is activated while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 2/ATK 1200/DEF 0). (This card is NOT treated as a Trap.) If Summoned this way, this card is unaffected by monster effects, also banish it when it leaves the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ffe.name: Paleozoic Opabinia
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ffe.description:
2 Level 2 monsters
This card is unaffected by other monsters' effects. You can activate "Paleozoic" Trap Cards from your hand. If this card has a Trap Card as Xyz Material: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; add 1 "Paleozoic" Trap Card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Paleozoic Opabinia" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a53005.name: Pandemonium Watchbear
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a53005.description: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, "Pandemonium" on your side of the field is not destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e98.name: Number 31: Embodiment of Punishment
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e98.description:
2 Level 1 monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; change all monsters your opponent controls to face-up Attack Position, also all monsters your opponent currently controls must attack this card this turn, if able. While you control "Number 13: Embodiment of Crime", this card gains these effects.
● This card cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects while it has Xyz Material.
● Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from attacks on this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52eb6.name: Number 51: Finisher the Strong Arm
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52eb6.description:
3 Level 3 monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; place 1 Counter on this card (max. 3). At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled, and has 3 of these Counters: You can destroy all cards your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee0.name: Number 8: Heraldic King Genom-Heritage
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee0.description:
2 Level 4 "Heraldic Beast" monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Xyz Monster your opponent controls; this card's name and original ATK become that monster's name and current ATK, and this card's effect becomes that monster's original effect, then that monster's ATK becomes 0 and its effects are negated. These changes last until the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2a.name: Obsessive Uvualoop
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2a.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Synchro Monster you control or in your GY; banish it, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 Synchro Monster you control or in your GY; banish it, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Obsessive Uvualoop" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f4e.name: Offerings to the Doomed
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f4e.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target, also skip your next Draw Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f5b.name: Ojama Country
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f5b.description: Once per turn, you can send 1 "Ojama" card from your hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Ojama" monster from your Graveyard. While you control a face-up "Ojama" monster, switch the original ATK and DEF of all monsters on the field. ("Ojama" can include "Ojamuscle".)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f98.name: Orca Mega-Fortress of Darkness
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f98.description: By Tributing 1 "Torpedo Fish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 monster on the field. By Tributing 1 "Cannonball Spear Shellfish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52faa.name: Orichalcos Shunoros
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52faa.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. If a Normal Monster you control is destroyed by battle, you can Special Summon this card from your hand. This card gains 1000 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. Face-up Level 4 Normal Monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by card effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fac.name: Orion the Battle King
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fac.description: None have lived to tell tales of this powerful battle fairy.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb3.name: Otoshidamashi
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb3.description: While you control a monster that is not a Tuner, your opponent's monsters cannot target this card for attacks. If a monster(s) is sent from the field to your opponent's GY: Place 1 Otoshidamashi Counter on this card, then Special Summon "Otoshidamashi Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK ?/DEF ?) up to the number of Otoshidamashi Counters on this card. Each Token's Level is increased when Summoned by the number of Otoshidamashi Counters on this card, also each Token's ATK/DEF are its Level when Summoned x 500. You can only use this effect of "Otoshidamashi" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fc4.name: Overlay Eater
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fc4.description: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; take 1 Xyz Material from a monster your opponent controls and attach it to an Xyz Monster you control as Xyz Material.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd1.name: Oyster Meister
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd1.description: If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, except when destroyed by battle: Special Summon 1 "Oyster Token" (Fish-Type/WATER/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0).

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ffd.name: Paleozoic Olenoides
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ffd.description: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy it. Once per Chain, when a Trap Card is activated while this card is in your Graveyard: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua-Type/WATER/Level 2/ATK 1200/DEF 0). (This card is NOT treated as a Trap Card.) If Summoned this way, this card is unaffected by monster effects, also banish it when it leaves the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e97.name: Number 30: Acid Golem of Destruction
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e97.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
During your Standby Phase: Detach 1 Xyz Material from this card or take 1000 damage. You cannot Special Summon any monsters. While this card has no Xyz Materials, it cannot attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e9a.name: Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e9a.description:
2 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; inflict damage to your opponent equal half to the difference between its original ATK and current ATK, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to the damage inflicted.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52eb1.name: Number 48: Shadow Lich
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52eb1.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn, during your opponent's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Phantom Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 500/DEF 500). (This is a Quick Effect.) While you control a "Phantom Token", your opponent cannot target this card for attacks. This card gains 500 ATK for each "Phantom Token" you control.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52eca.name: Number 6: Chronomaly Atlandis
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52eca.description:
2 Level 6 monsters
When this card is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 "Number" monster in your Graveyard; equip that target to this card. This card gains ATK equal to half the ATK of that equipped monster. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then send the monster equipped by this effect to the Graveyard; halve your opponent's Life Points. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f33.name: Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f33.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If an "Odd-Eyes" card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Odd-Eyes" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY. You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
Made from miracles, this valiant and beautiful dragon has gleaming eyes that reflect an arc drawn in the sky.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f55.name: Ogre of the Scarlet Sorrow
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f55.description: During your opponent's turn, when your opponent declares a second direct attack during the same Battle Phase, you can Special Summon this card from your hand. When you do, this card's ATK and DEF becomes equal to the ATK and DEF of the first monster that attacked directly this turn, if it is still face-up on the field. The turn this card is Special Summoned with this effect, your opponent cannot select monsters other than this card as an attack target while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f57.name: Oh Tokenbaum!
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f57.description: Tribute 2 or more Tokens with the same Level, then target monsters in your GY with that same Level, up to the number of Tokens Tributed; Special Summon them, but their effects are negated, also destroy them during the End Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f58.name: Oilman
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f58.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, if the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f5c.name: Ojama Delta Hurricane!!
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f5c.description: You can only activate this card while "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" are face-up on your side of the field. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f60.name: Ojama King
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f60.description:
"Ojama Green" + "Ojama Yellow" + "Ojama Black"
Select up to 3 of your opponent's Monster Card Zones. The selected zones cannot be used.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f77.name: One for One
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f77.description: Send 1 monster from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 Level 1 monster from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f7a.name: One-Eyed Skill Gainer
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f7a.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 face-up Xyz Monster your opponent controls; this card's name and original effect become the same as that monster. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f7c.name: One-Shot Wand
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f7c.description: Equip only to a Spellcaster-Type monster. It gains 800 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks or is attacked, after damage calculation: You can destroy this card, and if you do, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fba.name: Over Destiny
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fba.description: Target 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your GY; Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck whose Level is less than or equal to half of that target's Level, but destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fbd.name: Overdone Burial
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fbd.description: Activate this card by discarding 1 monster, then target 1 monster in your GY whose Level is lower than the discarded monster's original Level; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. The equipped monster has its effects negated. You can only activate 1 "Overdone Burial" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fc1.name: Overflow Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fc1.description: When a monster(s) on the field is destroyed by card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then, if 2 or more monsters on the field were destroyed by that card effect, you can Special Summon 1 "Overflow Token" (Dragon/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). You can only use this effect of "Overflow Dragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fcb.name: Overtex Qoatlus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fcb.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling 5 of your banished Dinosaur monsters into the Main Deck. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 Dinosaur monster in your hand or face-up on your field, and if you do, negate the activation, and if you do that, destroy that card. If this card is sent to the GY by a card effect: You can add 1 "Evolution Pill" Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Overtex Qoatlus" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fdb.name: PSY-Framegear Epsilon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fdb.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by a card effect, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Trap Card while you control no monsters: You can Special Summon both this card from your hand and 1 "PSY-Frame Driver" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and if you do, negate that activation, and if you do that, destroy that Trap Card. During the End Phase, banish the face-up monsters Special Summoned by this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee9.name: Number 98: Antitopian
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee9.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
When any player's monster declares an attack: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; change that monster to Defense Position. During either player's turn, while this card is in your Graveyard: You can target 1 "Utopia" monster on the field; Special Summon this card in Defense Position, and if you do, attach that monster to this card as an Xyz Material. You can only use this effect of "Number 98: Antitopian" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f20.name: Oasis of Dragon Souls
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f20.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Defense Position. It becomes Wyrm-Type. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f21.name: Oath of Companionship
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f21.description: If you control no monsters that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; take control of it until the End Phase. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2d.name: Ocean's Keeper
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2d.description: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. When this card is destroyed by battle, add 1 "Thousand-Eyes Jellyfish" or 1 "Cranium Fish" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f66.name: Ojama Yellow
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f66.description: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f71.name: Omega Summon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f71.description: Target any number of your banished "Invoked" monsters with different names; Special Summon them in Defense Position.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa1.name: Orcustrated Einsatz
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa1.description: If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can take 1 "Orcust" or "World Legacy" monster from your hand or Deck, and either send it to the GY or banish it. You can only use this effect of "Orcustrated Einsatz" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa3.name: Orcustrated Return
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa3.description: Send 1 "Orcust" or "World Legacy" monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; draw 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Orcustrated Return" per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa6.name: Order to Charge
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa6.description: Target 1 non-Token Normal Monster you control; Tribute that Normal Monster, and if you do, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa9.name: Orgoth the Relentless
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fa9.description:
Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can roll a six-sided die 3 times and this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the total x 100 (until the end of your opponent's turn), then, if 2 of the results were the same, apply the appropriate effect. If all 3 were the same, apply all of these effects.
● 1 or 2: This card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, until the end of your opponent's turn. ● 3 or 4: Draw 2 cards. ● 5 or 6: This card can attack directly this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb4.name: Out of the Blue
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb4.description: Destroy this card if your opponent activates a card or effect that targets a card(s) in the Graveyard. When this card is destroyed by this effect and sent to the Graveyard, your opponent shuffles all cards in their Graveyard into the Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fc5.name: Overlay Owl
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fc5.description: Once per turn: You can pay 600 Life Points; detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fe5.name: Pain to Power
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fe5.description: If a monster you control other than the equipped monster attacks and you take battle damage: The equipped monster gainst ATK equal to the damage you took until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ff7.name: Paleozoic Canadia
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ff7.description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change it to face-down Defense Position. Once per Chain, when a Trap Card is activated while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 2/ATK 1200/DEF 0). (This card is NOT treated as a Trap.) If Summoned this way, this card is unaffected by monster effects, also banish it when it leaves the field.

Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to this card's; send it to the Graveyard, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ebc.name: Number 57: Tri-Head Dust Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ebc.description:
3 Level 4 monsters

If your opponent controls more cards than you do: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then choose 1 unused Main Monster Zone or Spell & Trap Zone; while this card is face-up on the field, that zone cannot be used.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ec1.name: Number 61: Volcasaurus
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ec1.description:
2 Level 5 monsters

This card cannot attack your opponent directly during the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2b.name: Obsidian Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f2b.description: Negate the effects of Spell and Trap Cards that target only 1 face-up DARK monster you control, and destroy them.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52faf.name: Ostinato
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52faf.description: If you control no monsters: Fusion Summon 1 "Melodious" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using 2 monsters from your hand and/or Deck as Fusion Material. During the End Phase of this turn, destroy the monster Fusion Summoned by this effect, and if you do, if all the Fusion Materials that were used for its Fusion Summon are in your GY, you can Special Summon all of them.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fbe.name: Overdoom Line
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fbe.description: If a Plant-Type monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Graveyard to your side of the field: It gains 1000 ATK while this card is face-up on the field. Destroy this card during your 2nd End Phase after activation.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd2.name: P.M. Captor
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd2.description:

When you Pendulum Summon a Zombie-Type monster(s): You can activate this effect; it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card destroys a monster by battle: You can target 1 Pendulum Monster in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd5.name: PSY-Frame Driver
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fd5.description: A Psychic soldier that rides into battle against the Security Forces on currents of lightning, using an autonomic amplifier called "PSY-Frame".

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ff9.name: Paleozoic Eldonia
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ff9.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. Once per Chain, when a Trap Card is activated while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 2/ATK 1200/DEF 0). (This card is NOT treated as a Trap.) If Summoned this way, this card is unaffected by monster effects, also banish it when it leaves the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5300e.name: Paradox Fusion
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a5300e.description: When a monster(s) would be Special Summoned, OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Banish 1 face-up Fusion Monster you control; negate the Special Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card, also during your 2nd End Phase, return the banished Fusion Monster to your field in face-up Attack Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53016.name: Paralyzing Potion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53016.description: A non Machine-Type monster equipped with this card cannot attack.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ec4.name: Number 64: Ronin Raccoon Sandayu
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ec4.description:
2 Level 2 Beast-Type monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Kagemusha Raccoon Token" (Beast-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK ?/DEF 0). (When Summoned, its ATK becomes equal to the current ATK of the monster on the field that has the highest ATK. Your choice, if tied.) While you control another Beast-Type monster, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ed4.name: Number 79: Battlin' Boxer Nova Kaiser
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ed4.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can attach 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster from your hand or Graveyard to this card as an Xyz Material. This card gains 100 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to it. When this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card (by battle or card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: You can target Level 4 or lower "Battlin' Boxer" monsters in your Graveyard, up to the number of Xyz Materials this card had on the field; Special Summon those targets.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee1.name: Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee1.description:
2 Level 8 monsters
If this card has a "Photon" card as material, it cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord" once per turn.
● When an opponent's monster activates its effect (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; negate that monster's effect, and if the detached material was a "Galaxy" card, destroy that card.
● During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can take 1 "Photon" or "Galaxy" card from your Deck, and either add it to your hand or attach it to this card as material.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee2.name: Number 91: Thunder Spark Dragon
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ee2.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.
● Detach 3 Xyz Materials from this card; destroy all other face-up monsters on the field.
● Detach 5 Xyz Materials from this card; destroy all cards your opponent controls.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f13.name: Numeral Hunter
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f13.description: If this card is Summoned: Return all "Number" Xyz Monsters on the field to the Extra Deck. Neither player can Special Summon "Number" Xyz Monsters. Cannot be destroyed by battle with an Xyz Monster. This card is unaffected by the effects of Xyz Monsters.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f1d.name: Nuvia the Wicked
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f1d.description: If this monster is Normal Summoned, destroy this card. If your opponent controls any monster, decrease the ATK of this card by 200 points for each monster on your opponents side of the field.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f1f.name: Oafdragon Magician
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f1f.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have a "Magician" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can add 1 face-up "Magician" or "Odd-Eyes" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand, except "Oafdragon Magician". You can only use this effect of "Oafdragon Magician" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Magician" Pendulum Monster or 1 "Odd-Eyes" monster in your Graveyard, except "Oafdragon Magician"; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Oafdragon Magician" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f54.name: Ogre of the Black Shadow
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f54.description: An ogre possessed by the powers of the dark. Few can withstand its rapid charge.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f7d.name: One-Time Passcode

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f82.name: Onikuji
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f82.description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Your opponent declares 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap). Place the excavated card on the bottom of your Deck.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ffb.name: Paleozoic Leanchoilia

(This Special Summon is treated as an Xyz Summon.)

You can only use this effect of "Number 69: Heraldry Crest" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ed9.name: Number 83: Galaxy Queen
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ed9.description:

Once per Chain, during damage calculation, if this card battles an opponent's monster while this card has a "Utopia" Xyz Monster as material (Quick Effect): You can detach 2 materials from this card; this card's ATK becomes 5000 during that damage calculation only.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f22.name: Obedience Schooled
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f22.description: If you control no monsters: Special Summon 3 Level 2 or lower Beast-Type Effect Monsters with different names from your Deck. Once per turn: You can make this card be unaffected by Spell/Trap effects until the end of this turn. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this face-up card you controlled was destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY this turn: You can banish 1 "Nordic Ascendant" Tuner from your GY; Special Summon this card. When Summoned this way: You can draw 1 card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f8a.name: Oops!

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f9b.name: Orcust Cymbal Skeleton
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f9b.description: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Orcust" monster in your GY, except "Orcust Cymbal Skeleton"; Special Summon it, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters. You can only use this effect of "Orcust Cymbal Skeleton" once per turn.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb7.name: Outrigger Extension
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fb7.description: Your opponent cannot target Machine Xyz Monsters you control with card effects. 60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fcc.name: Overwhelm
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52fcc.description: Activate only while you control a face-up Level 7 or higher monster that was Tribute Summoned. Negate the activation of a Trap Card or Effect Monster's effect and destroy that card.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52e99.description:
3 Level 4 monsters

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ec5.name: Number 65: Djinn Buster
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ec5.description:
2 Level 2 DARK monsters
During either player's turn, when an effect of an opponent's monster is activated: You can detach 2 Xyz Materials from this card; negate the activation, and if you do, inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ecb.name: Number 70: Malevolent Sin
60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52ecb.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it until your opponent's next Standby Phase. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: You can make this card gain 300 ATK, and if you do, increase its Rank by 3.

You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Meteorburst Dragon" once per turn. Monsters in your opponent's possession cannot activate their effects during the Battle Phase.

60c2b3aba0e24f2d54a52f4b.description: When your opponent's monster declares a direct attack while you have 3000 or less LP: Negate the attack, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Ceremonial Tokens" (Rock-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0), and if you do that, add 1 "Earthbound Immortal" card, "Earthbound Revival", or "Roar of the Earthbound" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Piwraithe the Ghost Pirate" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53155.name: Pot the Trick
