60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531a8.name: Prevent Rat
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531a8.description: This creature is shielded with a tough hide of hair and is excellent at defending itself.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531c3.name: Progleo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531c3.description:
2 monsters, except Tokens
During your Main Phase, if you control this Link Summoned card: You can banish this card and 1 of your monsters this card points to, then target 1 Link Monster in either GY; Special Summon it, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Progleo" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531fd.name: Psychic Wheeleder
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531fd.description: If you control a Level 3 monster other than "Psychic Wheeleder", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Defense Position. You can only Special Summon "Psychic Wheeleder" once per turn this way. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can target 1 monster on the field with less ATK than the Synchro Monster that used this card as material; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Psychic Wheeleder" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53202.name: Pulse Mines
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53202.description: If you control a Machine monster: Change your opponent's Attack Position monsters (if any) to Defense Position, also, until the end of this turn, if a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your opponent's field, change them to Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5320e.name: Puppet Ritual
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5320e.description: If your opponent's Life Points are at least 2000 higher than yours: You can target 2 Level 8 "Gimmick Puppet" monsters in your Graveyard; Special Summon those targets. You can only activate 1 "Puppet Ritual" per turn. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53214.name: Putrid Pudding Body Buddies
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53214.description: Cannot be used as a Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Material for a Summon. While this card is face-up on the field, it cannot be Tributed. During your End Phase: You can target 1 card in your Pendulum Zone; destroy it, and if you do, give control of this card to your opponent. During each of your Standby Phases: Take 150 damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5322b.name: Qlipper Launch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5322b.description: Until the end of this turn, all Normal Summoned/Set "Qli" monsters currently on the field gain 300 ATK, but are unaffected by other Spell/Trap effects, also their effects are negated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5325c.name: Raging Cloudian
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5325c.description: Activate only when a "Cloudian" monster(s) you control is destroyed by its own effect and sent to the Graveyard. Special Summon 1 of those monsters from your Graveyard in Attack Position and place 1 Fog Counter on it. It cannot be changed to Defense Position by a card effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5325f.name: Raging Flame Sprite
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5325f.description: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: This card gains 1000 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53272.name: Raidraptor - Fuzzy Lanius
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53272.description: If you control a "Raidraptor" monster other than "Raidraptor - Fuzzy Lanius": You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Raidraptor - Fuzzy Lanius" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Raidraptor - Fuzzy Lanius" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except "Raidraptor" monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5301f.name: Parrot Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5301f.description: A dragon from the cartoons that's more dangerous than it appears to be.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5303f.name: Pendulum Shift
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5303f.description: Target 1 card in either player's Pendulum Zone and declare a Pendulum Scale from 1 to 10; this turn, that card becomes that Pendulum Scale.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53042.name: Pendulum Transfer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53042.description: Target up to 2 Pendulum Monsters you control; place those targets in your Pendulum Zones. You can only activate 1 "Pendulum Transfer" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5305b.name: Performance of Sword
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5305b.description: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Commencement Dance". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53085.name: Performapal Lizardraw
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53085.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have a "Performapal" card in your other Pendulum Zone, except "Performapal Lizardraw": You can destroy this card, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Performapal Lizardraw" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If another face-up monster you control is destroyed by your opponent's attack or card effect: You can draw cards equal to the number of "Performapal" monsters you currently control. You can only use this effect of "Performapal Lizardraw" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53086.name: Performapal Longphone Bull
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53086.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Performapal" monster from your Deck to your hand, except a Pendulum Monster. You can only use this effect of "Performapal Longphone Bull" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5309b.name: Performapal Seal Eel
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5309b.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; that face-up monster has its effects negated until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field).
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; that Set card cannot be activated this turn. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530bb.name: Pestilence
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530bb.description: Equip only to a Warrior-Type, Beast-Warrior-Type, or Spellcaster-Type monster. Its ATK becomes 0. During each of your Standby Phases, inflict 250 damage to the controller of the equipped monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530d9.name: Phantom Gryphon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530d9.description: A legendary monster that dwells secretly in the mountains, fighting with the harpies over hunting grounds. A single wingbeat is said to cause the fiercest of storms.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530e7.name: Pharaonic Protector
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530e7.description: The mummy of a soldier that has been guarding the royal family for thousands of years. Even now, its spirit does not allow anybody to trespass.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530f1.name: Photon Booster
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530f1.description: Target 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT monster on the field, except a Token; the ATK of all monsters currently on the field with its name become 2000, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530fc.name: Photon Leo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530fc.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can have your opponent shuffle their entire hand into the Deck, then they draw the same number of cards as they shuffled into the Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53114.name: Pilgrim of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53114.description: This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster with 1900 or more ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5313b.name: Poisonous Winds
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5313b.description: WIND monsters cannot be Special Summoned. All face-up WIND monsters on the field lose 500 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53145.name: Poseidon Wave
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53145.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster you control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53182.name: Precious Cards from Beyond
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53182.description: When you Tribute Summon a monster using 2 or more Tributes: Draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531a1.name: Prediction Princess Tarotrei
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531a1.description:
You can Ritual Summon this card with "Prediction Ritual". Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Flip monster from your hand or Graveyard in face-down Defense Position. You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Prediction Princess Tarotrei" per turn, and only once that turn.
● During either player's turn: You can target 1 face-down monster on the field; change it to face-up Attack Position.
● During either player's turn: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; change it to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531b9.name: Primitive Butterfly
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531b9.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn: You can increase the Levels of all Insect-Type monsters you currently control by 1.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531ca.name: Prominence, Molten Swordsman
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531ca.description: Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can banish 1 "Laval" monster from your Graveyard; this card gains 300 ATK until the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531d8.name: Protron
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531d8.description: Ancestral species found in electronic space. No one knows how much information it holds.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531ed.name: Psychic Kappa
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531ed.description: An amphibian with a myriad of powers to shield it from enemy attacks.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5320d.name: Puppet Plant
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5320d.description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard, then target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5321b.name: Pyro Clock of Destiny
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5321b.description: Move the turn count forward by 1 turn. The turn in which this card is activated continues as normal.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53239.name: Queen's Pawn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53239.description: Activate only when an "Amazoness" monster you control destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Amazoness" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5325d.name: Raging Earth
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5325d.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-EARTH monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5326b.name: Raidraptor - Blade Burner Falcon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5326b.description:
2 Level 4 Winged Beast-Type monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned, and your opponent's LP is at least 3000 higher than yours: You can make this card gain 3000 ATK. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can detach any number of Xyz Materials from this card; destroy exactly that number of monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5326f.name: Raidraptor - Fiend Eagle
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5326f.description:
2 Level 3 "Raidraptor" monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 face-up Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its original ATK on the field. You can only use this effect of "Raidraptor - Fiend Eagle" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5301d.name: Parasitic Ticky
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5301d.description: The ATK and DEF of this card are each equal to the number of tokens on the field x 500.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5304d.name: Perditious Puppeteer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5304d.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; gain control of all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters your opponent controls, until the End Phase. These monsters cannot activate their effects, and cannot be Tributed or used as a Synchro Material Monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53063.name: Performapal Camelump
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53063.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; the monsters your opponent currently controls lose 800 DEF until the end of this turn, and if they do, if the targeted monster attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. (These effects remain even if this card leaves the field.)
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is destroyed by battle: You can make the monster that destroyed this card lose 800 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53076.name: Performapal Gold Fang
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53076.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn, if your "Performapal" monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: All "Performapal" monsters you currently control gain 200 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5307f.name: Performapal Kaleidoscorp
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5307f.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
All LIGHT monsters you control gain 300 ATK.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; this turn, it can attack all Special Summoned monsters your opponent controls, once each.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5308d.name: Performapal Odd-Eyes Minitaurus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5308d.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If your "Performapal" or "Odd-Eyes" monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
During damage calculation, if your Pendulum Monster attacks an opponent's monster: You can make that opponent's monster lose 100 ATK for each "Performapal" and "Odd-Eyes" card you control, during damage calculation only.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5308f.name: Performapal Odd-Eyes Unicorn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5308f.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once, while this card is in your Pendulum Zone, when your "Odd-Eyes" monster declares an attack: You can target 1 other "Performapal" monster you control; that attacking monster gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the targeted monster on the field, until the end of the Battle Phase (even if this card leaves the field).
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Performapal" monster in your GY; gain LP equal to its ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53093.name: Performapal Pinch Helper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53093.description: Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: You can negate the attack, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Performapal" monster from your Deck, but its effects are negated. When an attack is declared involving a monster you control and an opponent's monster: You can send this card to the Graveyard; you take no battle damage from that battle.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53096.name: Performapal Rain Goat
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53096.description: When a card or effect is activated that would inflict damage to you (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; make that effect damage to you 0. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then target 1 "Performapal" or "Odd-Eyes" card you control; this turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530af.name: Performapal Trump Girl
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530af.description: Once per turn: You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control as Fusion Materials, including this card. If this card in the Pendulum Zone is destroyed: You can target 1 Dragon-Type Fusion Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, but destroy it during the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530b6.name: Performapal Whim Witch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530b6.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If your opponent controls a face-up monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck and you do not: You can Special Summon this card from your Pendulum Zone. You can only use this effect of "Performapal Whim Witch" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Pendulum Monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530e0.name: Phantom Knights' Wing
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530e0.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK, also the first time that target would be destroyed by battle or card effect this turn, it is not destroyed. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Phantom Knights' Wing" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530e9.name: Phoenix Gearfried
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530e9.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● If your opponent activates a Spell Card: You can target 1 Gemini monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card is activated that targets a monster(s) on the field: You can send 1 face-up Equip Card you control to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530f6.name: Photon Circle
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530f6.description: Any Battle Damage you take from battles involving this card is halved.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530fa.name: Photon Hand
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530fa.description: If you control a "Photon" or "Galaxy" monster: Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it. If you do not control "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" at activation, you can only target an Xyz Monster. You can only activate 1 "Photon Hand" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53111.name: Pikeru's Second Sight
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53111.description: Until your opponent's second End Phase, your opponent shows you all cards that they draw before adding them to their hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53186.name: Predaplant Chimerafflesia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53186.description:
1 "Predaplant" monster + 1 DARK monster
Once per turn: You can target 1 monster on the field with a Level less than or equal to this card's; banish it. When an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's face-up monster: You can activate this effect; until the end of this turn, that opponent's monster loses 1000 ATK, and if it does, this card gains 1000 ATK. Once per turn, during the next Standby Phase after this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Polymerization" Spell Card or "Fusion" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53193.name: Predaplant Spinodionaea
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53193.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; place 1 Predator Counter on it, and if it is Level 2 or higher, it becomes Level 1 as long as it has a Predator Counter. After damage calculation, if this card battled a monster with an equal or lower Level: You can Special Summon 1 "Predaplant" monster from your Deck, except "Predaplant Spinodionaea".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531bd.name: Princess Curran
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531bd.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Trial of the Princesses". During your Standby Phase, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531d5.name: Proto-Cyber Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531d5.description: This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531f0.name: Psychic Nightmare
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531f0.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Psychic-Type monsters
Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can pick 1 random card in your opponent's hand and call what type of card it is (Monster, Spell or Trap). If you call it right, this card gains 1000 ATK until your opponent's End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531f4.name: Psychic Rejuvenation
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531f4.description: Gain 1000 Life Points for each face-up Psychic-Type monster you control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53251.name: Radian, the Multidimensional Kaiju
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53251.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) to your opponent's side of the field in Attack Position, by Tributing 1 monster they control. If your opponent controls a "Kaiju" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Attack Position. You can only control 1 "Kaiju" monster. Once per turn: You can remove 2 Kaiju Counters from anywhere on the field; Special Summon 1 "Radian Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 7/ATK 2800/DEF 0), but it cannot be used as a Synchro Material.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53264.name: Rai-Mei
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53264.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can add 1 Level 2 or lower LIGHT monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5326c.name: Raidraptor - Blaze Falcon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5326c.description:
3 Level 5 Winged Beast-Type monsters
This card can attack directly while it has Xyz Material. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy as many Special Summoned monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict 250 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5303a.name: Pendulum Machine
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5303a.description: A horrible torture machine with a large pendulum blade.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53041.name: Pendulum Switch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53041.description: You can target 1 card in your Pendulum Zone; Special Summon it. You can target 1 Pendulum Monster in your Monster Zone; place that Pendulum Monster in your Pendulum Zone. You can only use 1 "Pendulum Switch" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5308b.name: Performapal Odd-Eyes Light Phoenix
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5308b.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack while you have a card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy the card in your other Pendulum Zone, and if you do, Special Summon this card.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
(Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card, then target 1 "Performapal" monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53091.name: Performapal Partnaga
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53091.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 300 ATK for each "Performapal" card you currently control, until the end of this turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster you control; it gains 300 ATK for each "Performapal" monster you currently control. Level 5 or lower monsters cannot attack.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530ad.name: Performapal Thunderhino
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530ad.description: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target face-up "Performapal" monsters for attacks, except this one. If a "Performapal" card(s) you control, except "Performapal Thunderhino", would be destroyed by battle or card effect while this card is in your Graveyard, you can banish this card instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530d2.name: Phantom Bounzer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530d2.description: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 2 "Bounzer" cards from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530d8.name: Phantom Ghost
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530d8.description: A vengeful spirit made up of many restless souls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530f0.name: Photon Alexandra Queen
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530f0.description:
2 Level 4 "Butterspy" monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; return all monsters on the field to the hand, then inflict 150 damage to each player for each card returned to their hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53107.name: Photon Thrasher
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53107.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) while you control no monsters. Cannot attack if you control another monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5311c.name: Piranha Army
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5311c.description: The Battle Damage this card inflicts by attacking your opponent's Life Points directly is doubled.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53127.name: Planet Pathfinder
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53127.description: You can Tribute this card; add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53138.name: Poison Fangs
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53138.description: Each time a Beast-Type monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5314b.name: Pot of Benevolence
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5314b.description: Select 2 cards from the Graveyard(s), and shuffle them into their owner's Deck(s). After activation, remove this card from play instead of sending it to the Graveyard. You can only activate 1 "Pot of Benevolence" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5315e.name: Power Frame
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5315e.description: When a face-up monster you control is targeted for an attack by a monster with a higher ATK: Target the attack target; negate that attack, and if you do, equip this card to that target. The equipped monster gains ATK equal to the difference between its ATK and the ATK of its attacker when this card resolves.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53183.name: Predaplanet
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53183.description: If a monster with a Predator Counter leaves the field while this card is face-up on the field: Add 1 "Predap" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Predaplanet" once per turn. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Materials. Only "Predaplant" monsters can be used as Fusion Materials for a Fusion Summon using this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531cf.name: Protective Soul Ailin
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531cf.description: Once per turn, you can equip this card to an "Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, you can change that monster's battle position once per turn. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531e3.name: Psi-Station
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531e3.description: When a Psychic-Type monster is Normal Summoned: You can pay 500 LP; increase its Level by 1 and ATK by 300. (This remains even if this card leaves the field.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531ec.name: Psychic Jumper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531ec.description: Once per turn: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and 1 Psychic-Type monster you control, except "Psychic Jumper"; switch control of both those targets, and if you do, their battle positions cannot be changed this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531ef.name: Psychic Megacyber
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531ef.description: If your opponent controls more Spells/Traps than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Psychic Megacyber" once per turn this way. When this card declares an attack on an opponent's Effect Monster while you control "Jinzo": You can Tribute this card; place that opponent's monster face-up in their Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap. You can only use this effect of "Psychic Megacyber" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531f5.name: Psychic Shockwave
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531f5.description: Activate only when your opponent activates a Trap Card. Discard 1 Spell/Trap Card to Special Summon 1 Level 6 DARK Machine-Type monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53203.name: Pumpkin Carriage
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53203.description: "Prinzessin" you control can attack directly. Your opponent cannot target "Golden Castle of Stromberg" you control with card effects, also it cannot be destroyed by card effects.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53215.name: Puzzle Reborn

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5324c.name: RAM Clouder
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5324c.description: You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "RAM Clouder" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53258.name: Rafflesia Seduction
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53258.description: FLIP: Take control of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5304b.name: Penumbral Soldier Lady

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5304e.name: Perfect Machine King

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5305f.name: Performapal Bot-Eyes Lizard
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5305f.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can send 1 "Odd-Eyes" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard; this card's name becomes the sent monster's original name, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53074.name: Performapal Friendonkey
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53074.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Performapal" monster from your hand or Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5307d.name: Performapal Hip Hippo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5307d.description: After you Normal Summon this card, you can Tribute Summon 1 Level 7 or higher monster in face-up Attack Position during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53083.name: Performapal Lebellman
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53083.description:

Once per turn: You can increase the Levels of all Pendulum Summoned monsters you currently control by 1 (even if this card leaves the field).
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
Once per turn: You can declare a Level from 1 to 5, then target 1 other "Performapal" monster you control; until the end of this turn, reduce this card's Level by the declared Level, and if you do, increase the Level or the other monster by the same amount.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530a9.name: Performapal Stamp Turtle
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530a9.description: Once per turn: You can target up to 2 face-up monsters on the field; increase their Levels by 1.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530bc.name: Peten the Dark Clown

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530e2.name: Phantom Skyblaster
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530e2.description: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can Special Summon any number of "Skyblaster Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 4/ATK 500/DEF 500), up to the number of monsters you control. "Skyblaster" monsters you control cannot declare an attack during the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a530ff.name: Photon Papilloperative

2 Level 4 monsters

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531af.description: When a card or effect is activated that targets this card (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Effect Monster you control to the GY, and if you do, add up to 2 "Blue-Eyes" monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Priestess with Eyes of Blue" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531c9.name: Prominence Hand
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531c9.description: If you control a "Magic Hand", "Fire Hand", or "Ice Hand", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a531d3.name: Protector of the Throne

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53201.name: Pulling the Rug

2 monsters with different Levels
