60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53678.description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: Banish 1 random card from your opponent's hand, until the End Phase. You can only use the effect of "Snapdragon" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53688.name: Soitsu
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53688.description: Apparently totally unreliable, he wonders if he has incredible potential.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5369b.name: Solidarity
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5369b.description: If you have only 1 original Type of monster in your Graveyard, all monsters you control with the same Type gain 800 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a6.name: Sonic Duck
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a6.description: A duck which can walk at a sonic speed. Sometimes, he cannot deal with his incredible pace and loses control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536cb.name: Soul of the Pure
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536cb.description: Increase your Life Points by 800 points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d9.name: Spacegate
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d9.description: Each time a monster your opponent controls attacks or is attacked, place 1 Gate Counter on this card at the end of the Damage Step. During your Main Phase: You can send this card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand whose Level is less than or equal to the number of Gate Counters on this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ea.name: Speed Warrior
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ea.description: Once per Battle Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned this turn (except during the Damage Step): You can make its ATK become double its original ATK, until the end of the Battle Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536fc.name: Speedroid Fuki-Modoshi Piper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536fc.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can excavate cards from the top of your Deck equal to the number of other WIND monsters you control, add 1 excavated card to your hand, also place the rest on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 3 or higher WIND monster you control; reduce its Level by 2. You can only use each effect of "Speedroid Fuki-Modoshi Piper" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53726.name: Spellbook of Knowledge
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53726.description: Send to the GY either 1 Spellcaster monster you control, or 1 other "Spellbook" card from your hand or face-up field, except "Spellbook of Knowledge", and if you do, draw 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of Knowledge" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372b.name: Spellbook of Wisdom

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53733.name: Spider Egg
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53733.description: When your opponent declares a direct attack, while you have 3 or more Insect monsters in your GY: Negate the attack, and if you do, Special Summon 3 "Spider Tokens" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53738.name: Spiked Snail
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53738.description: A very fast, bipedal snail with a pair of lethal arms.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5376a.name: Spiritualism
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5376a.description: Return 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls to the hand. This card's activation and effect cannot be negated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5378d.name: Star Blast
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5378d.description: Pay any number of Life Points in multiples of 500; reduce the Level of 1 monster you control or that is in your hand by 1 for each 500 Life Points you paid, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537b0.name: Stardust Xiaolong
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537b0.description: When you Synchro Summon "Stardust Dragon", you can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard in face-up Attack Position. Once per turn, if this card would be destroyed by battle, it is not destroyed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537b2.name: Starfish
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537b2.description: Once per turn: You can increase the Levels of all "Starfish" you currently control by 1.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537bc.name: Starry Knight Astel
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537bc.description: (Quick Effect): You can target 1 LIGHT monster you control; Tribute it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster from your hand. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use each effect of "Starry Knight Astel" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537d2.name: Steel Cavalry of Dinon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537d2.description: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a Pendulum Monster: This card's ATK and DEF become half its current ATK and DEF until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537fc.name: Storm Cipher
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537fc.description: Cannot attack directly, or attack monsters in the Extra Monster Zone. Unaffected by monster effects activated in the Extra Monster Zone. Cannot be destroyed by battle with monsters in the Extra Monster Zone.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53671.name: Smoke Grenade of the Thief
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53671.description: When this card is destroyed by a card effect while equipped to a monster: Look at your opponent's hand and discard 1 card from their hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5367f.name: Snowdust Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5367f.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by removing 4 Ice Counters from anywhere on the field. Other monsters with Ice Counters cannot attack or change their battle positions.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53698.name: Solfachord Harmonia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53698.description:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 face-up "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand.
● Increase the Pendulum Scale of 1 "Solfachord" card in your Pendulum Zone by its Level this turn.
● If you control "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster Cards with at least 3 different even Pendulum Scales or at least 3 different odd Pendulum Scales, destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
You can only use each effect of "Solfachord Harmonia" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536bf.name: Soul Resurrection
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536bf.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Defense Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c1.name: Soul Rope
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c1.description: When a monster you control is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c8.name: Soul of Fire
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c8.description:
Your opponent draws 1 card. Select 1 Pyro-Type monster from your Deck and remove it from play. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to quarter 
the ATK of the removed monster. If you activate this card, you cannot declare an attack this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e9.name: Speed Recovery
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e9.description: Target 1 "Speedroid" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 "Speedroid" monster in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f4.name: Speedroid Hexasaucer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f4.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ] You can target 1 of your WIND Synchro Monsters that is banished or in your GY; return it to the Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Hexasaucer" once per turn.
[ Monster Effect ] Both players take any battle damage from attacks involving this card. Any battle damage from battles involving this card is halved. If this card is destroyed in the Pendulum Zone: You can Special Summon 1 face-up "Speedroid" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f7.name: Speedroid Maliciousmagnet
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f7.description: Cannot be used as Synchro Material except for a Synchro Summon by its own effect. During your Main Phase, if this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 WIND Synchro Monster using only this card you control and that monster. You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Maliciousmagnet" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53711.name: Spell Reclamation
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53711.description: Discard 1 card and chain this card to a Spell Card you activated. Whenever that Spell Card is sent to the Graveyard, return it to its owner's hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53719.name: Spell Wall
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53719.description:
Activate 1 of these effects. Your opponent takes no further damage this turn.
● During this turn, no Summon of a Spellcaster-Type monster can be negated, and when a Spellcaster-Type monster is Summoned, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects.
● Target 1 Spellcaster-Type monster you control; if it attacks this turn, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5371b.name: Spell-Stopping Statute
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5371b.description: Activate only when your opponent activates a Continuous Spell Card. Negate the activation and the effect of the card and destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53739.name: Spikeshield with Chain
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53739.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks or is attacked while in Defense Position, it gains DEF equal to its ATK during damage calculation only.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5373a.name: Spin Turn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5373a.description:
Activate 1 of the following effects.
● Target 1 EARTH Machine Xyz Monster you control in Attack Position and 1 monster your opponent controls; change the battle position of your monster, and if you do, destroy that opponent's monster.
● Target 1 EARTH Machine Xyz Monster you control in Defense Position and 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; change the battle position of your monster, and if you do, destroy that opponent's Spell/Trap.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5373b.name: Spined Gillman
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5373b.description: All Fish, Sea Serpent, and Aqua-Type monsters you control gain 400 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5378a.name: Stamping Destruction
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5378a.description: If you control a Dragon monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to its controller.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5378b.name: Stand In
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5378b.description: Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 monster in your opponent's GY with the same original Type and Attribute; Special Summon it to your field. You can only activate 1 "Stand In" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53799.name: Star Seraph Scout
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53799.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Star Seraph" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e3.name: Steelswarm Roach
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e3.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
During either player's turn, when a Level 5 or higher monster would be Special Summoned: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; negate the Special Summon, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e8.name: Stellarknight Alpha
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e8.description: Equip only to a "tellarknight" monster you control. It gains 500 ATK and DEF, also it is unaffected by your opponent's card effects. If you control a face-up monster that is not a "tellarknight" monster, destroy this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f2.name: Stoic of Prophecy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f2.description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 Level 3 "Prophecy" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f3.name: Stone Armadiller
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f3.description: Dis stone crittah's got rock-hahd fur. Dat gives him some really good dee-fense!

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53689.name: SolSolfachord Gracia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53689.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ] Your opponent cannot activate a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, when your "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster(s) is Pendulum Summoned.
[ Monster Effect ] While you have an even Pendulum Scale in your Pendulum Zone, if your "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster attacks, your opponent cannot activate monster effects until the end of the Damage Step. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Solfachord" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "SolSolfachord Gracia" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a5.name: Sonic Chick
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a5.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or more ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a7.name: Sonic Jammer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a7.description: FLIP: Your opponent cannot activate any Spell Cards until the end of the End Phase of the next turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536af.name: Sorcerer of the Doomed
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536af.description: A slave of the dark arts, this sorcerer is a master of life-extinguishing spells.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536b1.name: Sorciere de Fleur
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536b1.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned, select 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard. Special Summon that monster to your side of the field. It cannot attack your opponent directly, and is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn. The effect of "Sorciere de Fleur" can only be activated once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536b6.name: Soul Demolition
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536b6.description: You can only activate this card's effect when you have a Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field. Pay 500 Life Points to use this effect. Both players select 1 Monster Card from their opponent's Graveyard. Remove the selected cards from play.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5370c.name: Spell Gear
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5370c.description: Send 3 "Ancient Gear" cards you control to the Graveyard. You can Special Summon up to 1 "Ancient Gear Golem" from your hand and 1 from your Deck, ignoring the Summoning conditions. Then, destroy all monsters you control except "Ancient Gear Golems". You cannot Normal Summon or Set until the end of your next turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53717.name: Spell Striker
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53717.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard. This card can attack directly. You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53722.name: Spellbook Star Hall
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53722.description: Each time a "Spellbook" Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card. All Spellcaster-Type monsters you control gain 100 ATK for each Spell Counter on this card. When this card with Spell Counter(s) is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck to your hand, whose Level is less than or equal to the number of Spell Counters that were on this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53729.name: Spellbook of Power
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53729.description: Target 1 Spellcaster monster you control; this turn, it gains 1000 ATK. And if it does, each time it destroys an opponent's monster by battle this turn: You can add 1 "Spellbook" Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of Power" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372c.name: Spellbook of the Master
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372c.description: If you control a Spellcaster-Type monster: You can reveal 1 other "Spellbook" card in your hand, then target 1 "Spellbook" Normal Spell Card in your Graveyard, except "Spellbook of the Master"; this card's effect becomes that target's effect. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of the Master" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372e.name: Spellstone Sorcerer Karood
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372e.description: Once per turn, when another Monster Card's effect is activated while there is no Spellstone Counter on this card, place 1 Spellstone Counter on this card (max. 1). This card gains 300 DEF for each Spellstone Counter on it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 Spellstone Counter from your side of the field to select 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard, and remove that card from play.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53732.name: Sphinx Teleia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53732.description: You can pay 500 Life Points to Special Summon this card when "Pyramid of Light" is on the field. This card cannot attack during the turn that it is Normal Summoned or Special Summoned. This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. If this card destroys a Defense Position monster as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to half of the DEF of the destroyed monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53742.name: Spirit Barrier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53742.description: While you control a monster, you take no battle damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53750.name: Spirit of Flames
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53750.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE monster from your Graveyard. This card gains 300 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53758.name: Spirit of the Six Samurai
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53758.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK and DEF. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5375c.name: Spiritual Beast Cannahawk
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5375c.description: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Ritual Beast" card from your Deck, face-up. During your second Standby Phase after this effect's activation, add the card banished by this effect to your hand. You can only Special Summon "Spiritual Beast Cannahawk(s)" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53763.name: Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53763.description: Tribute 1 FIRE monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that monster's original ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a1.name: Stardust Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a1.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When a card or effect is activated that would destroy a card(s) on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. During the End Phase, if this effect was activated this turn (and was not negated): You can Special Summon this card from your GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a4.name: Stardust Flash
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a4.description: Target 1 "Stardust" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a9.name: Stardust Shimmer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a9.description: Select 1 Dragon-Type Synchro Monster in your Graveyard. Remove from play other monsters in your Graveyard whose total Levels equal the Level of the selected monster and Special Summon it from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ab.name: Stardust Spark Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ab.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up card you control; once during this turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537bb.name: Starry Knight Arrival
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537bb.description:
During the Main Phase: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Target 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster you control; return it to the hand.
● Special Summon 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster from your hand.
You can only use this effect of "Starry Knight Arrival" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537bd.name: Starry Knight Balefire
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537bd.description: Add 1 "Starry Knight" monster, or 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster, from your Deck to your hand, then, if you control no monsters and your opponent controls a DARK monster, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster from your hand. You can only activate 1 "Starry Knight Balefire" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53801.name: Straight Flush
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53801.description: Activate only when all of your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zones are occupied. Destroy all cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zones.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5380d.name: Strong Wind Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5380d.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has the same ATK. If this card is Tribute Summoned by Tributing a Dragon-Type monster: It gains ATK equal to half the original ATK of the Tributed monster. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53686.name: Soaring Eagle Above the Searing Land
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53686.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard for a Synchro Summon: You can Special Summon this card. You must have 3 or more "Laval" monsters with different names in your Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect. If this card is Special Summoned with this effect, banish it when it leaves the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a8.name: Sonic Maid
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a8.description: A maiden that uses sound to her advantage, she wields a scythe that's shaped like a musical note.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ca.name: Soul of Silvermountain
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ca.description:
2 Level 3 EARTH monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone; it cannot be activated while this card is face-up on the field. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle while it has Xyz Material: You can target 1 EARTH monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d1.name: Sound the Retreat!
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d1.description: Return all monsters you control to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e1.name: Spear Cretin
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e1.description: FLIP: When this card is sent to the Graveyard after being flipped, each player selects 1 monster from their Graveyard, and Special Summons it in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e4.name: Spearfish Soldier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e4.description: This card gains 100 ATK for each of your banished Fish, Sea Serpent, and Aqua-Type monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e6.name: Special Schedule
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e6.description: Target 1 Machine monster in your GY with 3000 or more ATK; Special Summon that target in Defense Position. If this Set card is sent from the field to the GY: You can target 1 Level 10 Machine monster in your GY; add that target to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Special Schedule" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53712.name: Spell Recycler
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53712.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard; send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, return the target to the bottom of your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53723.name: Spellbook of Eternity
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53723.description: Target 1 of your banished "Spellbook" Spell Cards, except "Spellbook of Eternity"; add that target to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of Eternity" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53724.name: Spellbook of Fate
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53724.description:
If you control a Spellcaster-Type monster: You can banish up to 3 "Spellbook" Spell Cards from your Graveyard; apply this effect, depending on the number of Spell Cards banished for this card's activation. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of Fate" per turn.
● 1: Return 1 Set Spell/Trap Card on the field to the hand.
● 2: Change 1 monster on the field to face-down Defense Position or face-up Attack Position.
● 3: Banish 1 card your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53734.name: Spider Web
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53734.description: If a monster declares an attack, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step. It cannot change its battle position until the End Phase of its controller's next turn, while this card remains on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5379a.name: Star Seraph Sovereignty
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5379a.description: Cannot be used as material for an Xyz Summon, except for an Xyz Summon that uses 3 or more monsters as material. If you Normal or Special Summon a "Star Seraph" monster(s), except during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card, then you can Special Summon it if it is a "Star Seraph" monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ca.name: Statue of the Wicked
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ca.description: When this face-down card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Wicked Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) on your side of the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537cb.name: Staunch Defender
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537cb.description: You can only activate this card when your opponent declares an attack. Select 1 face-up monster on your side of the field. During this turn, your opponent can only designate the selected monster as an attack target and your opponent must attack the selected monster with all face-up monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e1.name: Steelswarm Moth
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e1.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned by Tributing a "Steelswarm" monster: You can pay 1000 Life Points to target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; return those targets to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ee.name: Stellarnova Wave
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ee.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "tellarknight" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f4.name: Stone Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f4.description: A dragon formed by huge boulders that are also used to attack the enemy.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f9.name: Stop Defense
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f9.description: Select 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's side of the field and change it to Attack Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53807.name: Strength of Prophecy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53807.description: Once per turn: You can shuffle 1 "Spellbook" Spell Card from your Graveyard into your Deck to target 1 face-up Spellcaster-Type monster on the field; increase its Level by 1 and its ATK by 500.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53808.name: Strike Ninja
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53808.description: (Quick Effect): You can banish 2 DARK monsters from your GY; banish this face-up card until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Strike Ninja" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5381d.name: Subterror Behemoth Burrowing
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5381d.description: You can banish 1 "Subterror" monster from your Graveyard; for the rest of this turn, face-down monsters you control cannot be destroyed by card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. If this card on the field is destroyed by a card effect: You can add 1 "Subterror" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 "Subterror" monster you control; change it to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53823.name: Subterror Behemoth Stygokraken
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53823.description:
FLIP: You can target Set cards on the field, equal to the number of "Subterror Behemoth" monsters you control; destroy them. You can only use this effect of "Subterror Behemoth Stygokraken" once per turn.
When a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, if you control no face-up monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53692.name: Solemn Scolding
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53692.description: If this is the only Set card in your Spell & Trap Zone, when a monster would be Summoned, OR a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect is activated: Pay 3000 LP; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5369c.name: Solitaire Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5369c.description: Once per turn, you can select 1 face-up "Fortune Lady" monster you control and 1 other face-up monster on the field. Reduce the Level of the selected "Fortune Lady" monster by 3, and destroy the other selected monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a3.name: Sonic Bird
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a3.description: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a4.name: Sonic Boom
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a4.description: During your turn: Target 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster on the field; this turn, its ATK becomes double its original ATK, it is unaffected by other Spell/Trap effects, also if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If this effect is applied to that monster, destroy all Machine-Type monsters you control during the End Phase of this turn. Other monsters cannot attack during the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ae.name: Sorcerer of Dark Magic
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ae.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 2 Level 6 or higher Spellcaster-Type monsters, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During either player's turn, when a Trap Card is activated: You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c3.name: Soul Strike
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c3.description: If your LP is 4000 or less, when an attack is declared involving a monster you control and an opponent's monster: Pay half your LP, then target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the deficit between your current LP and 4000 until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only activate 1 "Soul Strike" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d3.name: Space Cyclone
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d3.description: Detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d6.name: Space Insulator
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d6.description:
2 monsters
Monsters this card points to lose 800 ATK/DEF. When a Cyberse Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field, while this card is in the GY, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card to your zone that monster points to, but it cannot be used as Link Material, also banish it when it leaves the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536de.name: Spatial Collapse
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536de.description: You can only activate this card if both you and your opponent each have 5 or less cards on the field. The maximum number of cards that each player can have on the field is 5.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ef.name: Speedroid Den-Den Daiko Duke
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ef.description: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Speedroid" Tuner monster from your hand or Graveyard, except "Speedroid Den-Den Daiko Duke". You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Den-Den Daiko Duke" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53706.name: Speedroid Tri-Eyed Dice
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53706.description: During your opponent's turn: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the next attack this turn from a monster your opponent controls (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5370a.name: Spell Chronicle
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5370a.description: Activate this card by sending your entire hand to the GY; banish 5 Spells/Traps from your Deck. Each time your opponent activates a Spell Card, place 1 Chronicle Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. You can remove 2 Chronicle Counters from this card; your opponent chooses 1 card banished by this card's effect for you to add to your hand. If this face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone leaves the field: You take 500 damage for each card currently banished by this card's effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53710.name: Spell Reactor RE
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53710.description: Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card, you can destroy the Spell Card and inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53728.name: Spellbook of Miracles
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53728.description: Target 1 Spellcaster-Type Xyz Monster in your Graveyard and up to 2 of your banished "Spellbook" Spell Cards; Special Summon that monster, and if you do, attach the targeted "Spellbook" Spell Card(s) to it as Xyz Material. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of Miracles" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53748.name: Spirit Force
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53748.description: During your opponent's turn, at damage calculation: Make the battle damage you take from this battle 0, then you can add 1 Warrior-Type Tuner monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53754.name: Spirit of the Harp
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53754.description: A spirit that soothes the soul with the music of its heavenly harp.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53759.name: Spirit of the Winds
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53759.description: A free-spirited wind elemental that flits about as it desires. It brings storms when it becomes upset.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ba.name: Starlight Road
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ba.description: When a card or effect is activated that would destroy 2 or more cards you control: Negate the effect, and if you do, destroy that card, then you can Special Summon 1 "Stardust Dragon" from your Extra Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537c2.name: Starry Knight Rayel
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537c2.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Starry Knight" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Starry Knight" monster in your GY, except "Starry Knight Rayel"; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Starry Knight Rayel" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537fd.name: Storm Dragon's Return
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537fd.description: Target 1 banished monster; Special Summon it to your field, but return it to the hand during the End Phase. You can only activate 1 "Storm Dragon's Return" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53812.name: Stygian Dirge
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53812.description: Reduce the Levels of all monsters your opponent controls by 1.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53813.name: Stygian Security
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53813.description: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 1 Fiend-Type monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53817.name: Sublimation Knight
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53817.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can equip 1 FIRE Warrior or 1 Gemini monster from your hand or Deck to this card as an Equip Spell that gives this card 500 ATK. If this card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card while equipped with a Gemini monster(s): You can Special Summon as many of those Gemini monsters from your GY as possible, as Effect Monsters that gain their effects. You can only use each effect of "Sublimation Knight" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5381e.name: Subterror Behemoth Dragossuary
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5381e.description:
FLIP: You can activate this effect; this turn, "Subterror" cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. You can only use this effect of "Subterror Behemoth Dragossuary" once per turn.
When a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, if you control no face-up monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53822.name: Subterror Behemoth Stalagmo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53822.description:
FLIP: You can discard 1 "Subterror" monster, and if you do, draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Subterror Behemoth Stalagmo" once per turn.
When a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, if you control no face-up monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53824.name: Subterror Behemoth Ultramafus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53824.description:
FLIP: You can change all other face-up monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Subterror Behemoth Ultramafus" once per turn.
When a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, if you control no face-up monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53695.name: Solemn Wishes
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53695.description: Increase your Life Points by 500 points each time you draw a card (or cards).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53696.name: Solfachord Elegance
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53696.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Place 1 "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone.
● Add 1 "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster from your hand to your Extra Deck face-up, then, place 2 "Solfachord" Pendulum Monsters, 1 odd and 1 even Pendulum Scale, from your Deck in your Pendulum Zones.
● Add 2 cards, 1 odd and 1 even Pendulum Scale, from your Pendulum Zones to the Extra Deck face-up, and if you do, draw 2 cards.
You can only activate 1 "Solfachord Elegance" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c9.name: Soul of Purity and Light
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c9.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 2 LIGHT monsters in your Graveyard. All monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK during their Battle Phase only.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e2.name: Spear Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e2.description: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ed.name: Speedroid Block-n-Roll
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ed.description: If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can Special Summon 1 "Speedroid Token" (Machine/WIND/ATK 0/DEF 0) with a Level equal to the original Level of the Synchro Monster that used this card as material. You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Block-n-Roll" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ee.name: Speedroid CarTurbo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ee.description: If you control a WIND monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot activate monster effects for the rest of this turn, except WIND monsters. You can banish this card and 1 "Speedroid" monster from your GY; all WIND monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Speedroid CarTurbo" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ff.name: Speedroid Red-Eyed Dice
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ff.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Speedroid" monster you control, except "Speedroid Red-Eyed Dice", and declare a Level from 1 to 6; it becomes that Level until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53744.name: Spirit Caller
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53744.description: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your side of the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53746.name: Spirit Converter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53746.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 face-up Level 4 LIGHT monster you control to that target as an Xyz Material. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Target 2 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder-Type monsters with the same name in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5376f.name: Spool Code
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5376f.description: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack, while you have 3 or more Cyberse monsters in your GY: Negate the attack, then, you can Special Summon up to 3 "Spool Tokens" (Cyberse/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53786.name: Stack Reviver
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53786.description: If this card is used as material for a Link Summon: You can target 1 other Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster in your GY, that was used as material for that Link Summon; Special Summon it in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Stack Reviver" once per Duel.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5379f.name: Stardust Charge Warrior
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5379f.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Stardust Charge Warrior" once per turn. This card can attack all Special Summoned monsters your opponent controls, once each.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a0.name: Stardust Chronicle Spark Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a0.description:
1 Tuner Synchro Monster + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 Synchro Monster from your GY; this card is unaffected by other cards' effects for the rest of this turn. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card (by battle or card effect): You can target 1 of your banished Dragon Synchro Monsters; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ce.name: Stealthroid
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ce.description: If this card attacks, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card at the end of the Battle Phase if you control another "roid" monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f0.name: Stinging Swordsman
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537f0.description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Return all face-up cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zones to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537fa.name: Storm
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537fa.description: Destroy as many Spell/Trap Cards you control as possible, then destroy as many Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls as possible, up to the number of cards destroyed by this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537fe.name: Storm Shooter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537fe.description: Once per turn, you can select and activate 1 of these effects: ● Move this card to an adjacent (horizontal) unoccupied Monster Card Zone. ● Return 1 Spell, Trap or Monster Card on your opponent's side of the field in the same column as this card to its owner's hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53666.name: Slip of Fortune
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53666.description: Activate only when your opponent's monster declares an attack targeting a monster. Negate the attack and remove from play the attack target monster until the next Standby Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53674.name: Snake Fang
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53674.description: Decrease 1 selected monster's DEF by 500 points during the turn this card is activated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53677.name: Snakeyashi
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53677.description: This monster is formed by several serpents that break off to individually attack nearby enemies.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5367b.name: Snipe Hunter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5367b.description: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; roll a six-sided die, and destroy that target unless you roll a 1 or 6.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53680.name: Snowdust Giant
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53680.description:
2 Level 4 WATER monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; reveal any number of WATER monsters from your hand, and place that many Ice Counters on face-up monsters on the field. Non-WATER monsters on the field lose 200 ATK for each Ice Counter on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53699.name: Solfachord Musica
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53699.description:
Activate 1 of these effects, based on the Pendulum Scales of "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster Cards you control;
● Odd: Special Summon 1 face-up "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster with an odd Pendulum Scale from your Extra Deck.
● Even: Special Summon 1 face-up "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster with an even Pendulum Scale from your Extra Deck.
● Even and Odd: Target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.
You can only activate 1 "Solfachord Musica" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5369e.name: Solitude
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5369e.description: This beast-warrior swings a massive scythe that feeds on the souls of the slain.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a9.name: Sonic Shooter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a9.description: If there are no cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone, this card can attack your opponent directly. If it does, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is the original ATK of this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ac.name: Sophia, Goddess of Rebirth
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536ac.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 face-up Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz Monster from anywhere on the field, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card's Special Summon cannot be negated. When this card is Special Summoned: Banish all other cards from both players' hands, fields, and Graveyards. Cards and effects cannot be activated in response to this effect's activation.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c5.name: Soul Tiger
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c5.description: The soul of a tiger that is said to devour human souls. He is a famous soul that you wouldn't want to run into in a dark alley.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536db.name: Spark Blaster
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536db.description: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Sparkman". During your Main Phase: You can target 1 face-up monster; change the battle position of that target. After you use this effect 3 times, destroy this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536fb.name: Speedroid Pachingo-Kart
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536fb.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Machine-Type monster, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372f.name: Sphere Kuriboh
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372f.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can send this card from your hand to the GY; change the attacking monster to Defense Position. When you Ritual Summon, you can banish this card from your GY as 1 of the monsters required for the Ritual Summon.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53735.name: Spiders' Lair
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53735.description: Once per turn, you can select 1 face-up Insect-Type monster you control. While this card remains on the field, any opponent's monster that battles with one of those monsters is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase, and cannot change its battle position while this card is on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5374d.name: Spirit Reaper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5374d.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle. After resolving a card effect that targets this face-up card, destroy this card. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from their hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5375d.name: Spiritual Beast Pettlephin
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5375d.description: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Ritual Beast" card from your hand, then target 1 card your opponent controls; return it to the hand. You can only Special Summon "Spiritual Beast Pettlephin(s)" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5375e.name: Spiritual Beast Rampengu
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5375e.description: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Ritual Beast" monster from your Extra Deck and send 1 "Ritual Beast" monster with the same Type as that monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. You can only Special Summon "Spiritual Beast Rampengu(s)" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53770.name: Spore
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53770.description: If this card is in your Graveyard: You can banish 1 other Plant-Type monster from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card from your Graveyard and increase its Level by the Level of that banished monster. Each player can only activate the effect of "Spore" once per Duel.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53781.name: Spyder Spider
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53781.description: When this card destroys an opponent's Defense Position monster by battle, you can select and Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Insect-Type monster from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5379c.name: Star Siphon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5379c.description: When a Synchro Monster(s) is Special Summoned: Target 1 of them; Special Summon 1 "Siphon Token" (Spellcaster-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). Its Level becomes that monster's current Level and that monster's Level becomes 1.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a7.name: Stardust Phantom
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537a7.description: When this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to your Graveyard, you can select 1 "Stardust Dragon" in your Graveyard and Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position. You can remove from play this card in the Graveyard to select 1 face-up Dragon-Type Synchro Monster you control. Once per turn, that Synchro Monster cannot be destroyed by battle, but each time this effect is applied, it loses 800 ATK and DEF at the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537b3.name: Stargazer Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537b3.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If a Pendulum Monster you control battles, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Unless you have a "Magician" card or "Odd-Eyes" card in your other Pendulum Zone, this card's Pendulum Scale becomes 4.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
Once per turn, when exactly 1 other Pendulum Monster you control (and no other cards) is returned to your hand by an opponent's card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand with the same name as that returned to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537bf.name: Starry Knight Ceremony
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537bf.description: During your Main Phase: You can reveal 1 LIGHT Fairy monster in your hand, and if you do, add 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster from your Deck to your hand, then place that revealed monster on the bottom of your Deck. If your opponent activates a card or effect: You can Special Summon 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster from your hand. You can only use 1 "Starry Knight Ceremony" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537c3.name: Starry Knight Sky
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537c3.description: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Starry Knight" monster, or 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) During your turn, if a face-up Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster you control returns to the hand: You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Starry Knight Sky" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537cd.name: Stealth Bird
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537cd.description: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e0.name: Steelswarm Mantis
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e0.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned by Tributing a "Steelswarm" monster: You can pay 1000 Life Points to target 1 "Steelswarm" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5380c.name: Striping Partner
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5380c.description:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by the following effect. If the effect activation of a monster you control is negated (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Striping Partner" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53821.name: Subterror Behemoth Speleogeist
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53821.description:
FLIP: You can target 1 monster on the field; change it to face-up Attack Position if it is in Defense Position, also change its ATK to 0. You can only use this effect of "Subterror Behemoth Speleogeist" once per turn.
When a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, if you control no face-up monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53675.name: Snake Rain
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53675.description: Discard 1 card. Select 4 Reptile-Type monsters from your Deck and send them to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5368f.name: Soldier Gaia the Fierce Knight
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5368f.description: (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 Dragon Fusion Monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 Attack Position monster on the field; change it to Defense Position. You can Tribute this card; add 1 Level 7 or higher Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Soldier Gaia the Fierce Knight". You can only use each effect of "Soldier Gaia the Fierce Knight" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c4.name: Soul Taker
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536c4.description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, then your opponent gains 1000 LP.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536dc.name: Spark Breaker
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536dc.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster you control; destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536dd.name: Sparks
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536dd.description: Inflict 200 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e7.name: Specimen Inspection
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e7.description: Reveal 1 "Fossil Fusion" in your hand; send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, and if you do, declare a Type and a Level, then your opponent looks at their hand and Deck, and sends 1 monster with the declared Type and Level from one of them to the GY (if possible). You can only activate 1 "Specimen Inspection" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f3.name: Speedroid Gum Prize
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f3.description: During the Battle Phase, if you take battle or effect damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During either player's Battle Phase in which this card was Special Summoned by its effect, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster, using only WIND monsters you control, including this card. If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Synchro Material: You can send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard, and if the sent card was a "Speedroid" monster, the Synchro Monster that used this card as Synchro Material gains 1000 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5370f.name: Spell Purification
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5370f.description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Destroy all face-up Continuous Spell Cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5371f.name: Spellbook Library of the Heliosphere
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5371f.description: If you have 5 or more "Spellbook" Spell Cards in your Graveyard: Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck, add any excavated "Spellbook" Spell Cards to your hand, also shuffle the other cards into the Deck. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook Library of the Heliosphere" per turn. You cannot activate any Spell Cards the turn you activate this card, except "Spellbook" Spell Cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53756.name: Spirit of the Pharaoh
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53756.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "The First Sarcophagus". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target any number of Level 2 or lower Zombie Normal Monsters in your Graveyard; Special Summon those targets.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53792.name: Star Light, Star Bright
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53792.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; all face-up monsters you currently control with an ATK or DEF equal to that monster's become the same Level as that monster, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53798.name: Star Seraph Scepter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53798.description:
When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Star Seraph" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Star Seraph Scepter". An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using 3 or more monsters, including this card on the field, as materials gains this effect.
● When it is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 other card on the field; destroy it, and if you do, you can draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e7.name: Stegocyber
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e7.description: During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks while this card is in your Graveyard: You can pay 1000 LP; Special Summon this card, and if you do, you take no battle damage from that battle, but banish this card when it leaves the field (this is a Quick Effect). You can only use this effect of "Stegocyber" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53803.name: Stray Asmodian
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53803.description: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, both players gain 800 Life Points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53804.name: Stray Lambs
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53804.description: Special Summon 2 "Lamb Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5380a.name: Strike of the Monarchs
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5380a.description: You can Tribute 1 face-up Level 5 or higher Normal Summoned/Set monster, then target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects, then draw 1 card. (The effects remain negated until the end of this turn.) During your Main Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can banish this card, then declare 1 Attribute; all face-up monsters currently on the field become that Attribute until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53687.name: Sogen
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53687.description: All Warrior and Beast-Warrior monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5368a.name: Solar Flare Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5368a.description: While you control another Pyro-Type monster, this card cannot be attacked. During each of your End Phases: Inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5368e.name: Soldier Dragons
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5368e.description: Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Dragon monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a2.name: Sonata the Melodious Diva
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536a2.description: If you control a "Melodious" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). While this Special Summoned card is on the field, all Fairy-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536fe.name: Speedroid Razorang
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536fe.description: Cannot attack the turn it is Normal Summoned. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; change this card to Defense Position, and if you do, that target loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53705.name: Speedroid Terrortop
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53705.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Speedroid" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Speedroid Terrortop". You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Terrortop" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53716.name: Spell Strider
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53716.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 2 face-up Spell Cards on the field (1 from each side of the field); banish them, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53718.name: Spell Vanishing
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53718.description: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it. Also, look at your opponent's hand and Deck and if you find any Spell Cards of the same name as the destroyed Spell Card, send all of them to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53730.name: Sphere of Chaos
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53730.description: While this card is face-up on the field its Attribute is also treated as LIGHT. Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can add 1 Level 3 monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53740.name: Spiral Serpent
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53740.description: When huge whirlpools lay cities asunder, it is the hunger of this sea serpent at work. No one has ever escaped its dreaded Spiral Wave to accurately describe the terror they experienced.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53764.name: Spiritual Forest
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53764.description: Each turn, the first face-up Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Plant-Type monster you control that would be destroyed by battle, is not destroyed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53780.name: Spy-C-Spy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53780.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Look at 1 random card in your opponent's Extra Deck, and if it has 2000 or more ATK, this card gains 1000 ATK. If it has less than 2000 ATK, you gain LP equal to that monster's ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53797.name: Star Seraph Scale
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53797.description:
When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Star Seraph" monster from your hand, then you can place 1 LIGHT monster from your Graveyard on top of your Deck. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using 3 or more monsters, including this card on the field, as Xyz Materials gains this effect.
● Once per turn, while this card has Xyz Material, if a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the hand, immediately draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537c1.name: Starry Knight Flamel
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537c1.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can send this card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster from your hand. (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon monster you control or in your GY; return it to your hand. You can only use 1 "Starry Knight Flamel" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537d9.name: Steelswarm Caucastag
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537d9.description:
When this card is Tribute Summoned by Tributing 2 "Steelswarm" monsters: Activate 1 of these effects.
● Destroy all monsters on the field, except this card.
● Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537dc.name: Steelswarm Genome
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537dc.description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a "Steelswarm" monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e4.name: Steelswarm Scout
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e4.description: At the start of your Main Phase 1, if you control no Spell/Trap Cards: You can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard. You cannot Special Summon another monster(s) the turn you activate this effect. While this card is face-up on the field, it cannot be Tributed, except for the Tribute Summon of a "Steelswarm" monster, and cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ea.name: Stellarknight Delteros
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ea.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
While this card has Xyz Material, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when you Normal or Special Summon a monster(s). Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "tellarknight" monster from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53820.name: Subterror Behemoth Phospheroglacier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53820.description:
FLIP: You can send 1 card from your Deck to the Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Subterror Behemoth Phospheroglacier" once per turn.
When a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, if you control no face-up monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53670.name: Smile World
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53670.description: All face-up monsters currently on the field gain 100 ATK for each monster currently on the field, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5367e.name: Snowdrop the Rikka Fairy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5367e.description: You can Tribute 1 Plant monster; Special Summon both this card and 1 other Plant monster from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Plant monsters. You can target 1 Plant monster you control; all Plant monsters you currently control become that monster's Level until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Snowdrop the Rikka Fairy" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5369f.name: Solo the Melodious Songstress
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5369f.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Melodious" monster from your Deck, except "Solo the Melodious Songstress".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536b0.name: Sorcerous Spell Wall
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536b0.description: All monsters you control gain 300 ATK during your turn only. All monsters you control gain 300 DEF during your opponent's turn only.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e3.name: Spear Shark
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536e3.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can increase the Levels of all Level 3 Fish-Type monsters you currently control by 1. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f5.name: Speedroid Horse Stilts
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f5.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Speedroid" monster from your hand. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; send 1 WIND monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Horse Stilts" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372d.name: Spellbreaker of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5372d.description: Once per turn, you can send 1 "Ice Barrier" monster from your hand to the Graveyard. If you do, Spell Cards cannot be activated until the End Phase of your next turn, as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53731.name: Spherous Lady
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53731.description: Many have been deceived by the beauty of this vampire.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5375f.name: Spiritual Beast Tamer Winda
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5375f.description: If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card (by battle or card effect): You can Special Summon 1 "Ritual Beast" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only Special Summon "Spiritual Beast Tamer Winda(s)" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5377f.name: Sprite's Blessing
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5377f.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any LIGHT Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53796.name: Star Seraph Sage
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53796.description: Once per turn: You can send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Star Seraph" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537c9.name: Statue of Anguish Pattern
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537c9.description: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Rock-Type/EARTH/Level 7/ATK 0/DEF 2500). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) If Summoned this way, this card cannot be targeted by an opponent's card effects while you control another Trap Card that is a monster. If a card is Special Summoned from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Monster Zone while this card is a monster: You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537da.name: Steelswarm Cell
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537da.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). While this card is face-up on the field, it cannot be Tributed, except for the Tribute Summon of a "Steelswarm" monster, and cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e6.name: Steelswarm Sting
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537e6.description: When this card you control is sent to your Graveyard: Target 1 face-up Ritual, Fusion or Synchro Monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53814.name: Stygian Sergeants
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53814.description:
1 Fiend-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can have this card gain 800 ATK until the end of the Battle Phase, also this card can make a second attack in a row.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53819.name: Submarineroid
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53819.description: This card can attack your opponent directly, but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is the original ATK of this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can change this card to Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53676.name: Snake Whistle
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53676.description: Activate only when a Reptile-Type monster you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Reptile-Type monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53685.name: Snyffus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53685.description: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 Plant-Type monster to select and destroy 1 face-up card your opponent controls. When a Plant-Type monster(s) on the field is destroyed while this card is in the Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. If you do, remove this card from play when it is removed from the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5368b.name: Solar Ray
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5368b.description: Inflict 300 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each face-up LIGHT monster on your side of the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d2.name: Soundproofed
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d2.description: This card can only be activated at the start of Main Phase 1, and only if you control no face-up Synchro Monsters. Neither player can Special Summon a Synchro Monster until your opponent's next End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d8.name: Space-Time Police
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536d8.description: When this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; banish that target. When this card leaves the field: Set the card that was banished by this effect to your opponent's side of the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f1.name: Speedroid Double Yoyo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a536f1.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 3 or lower "Speedroid" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53701.name: Speedroid Rubberband Plane
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53701.description: If a monster is Special Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except WIND monsters. You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Rubberband Plane" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53713.name: Spell Reproduction
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53713.description: Send 2 Spells from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53720.name: Spellbook Magician of Prophecy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53720.description: If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Add 1 "Spellbook" Spell from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53721.name: Spellbook Organization
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53721.description: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, then return them to the top of the Deck in any order.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5373d.name: Spiral Flame Strike

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53753.name: Spirit of the Fall Wind
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53753.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 Flip monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53755.name: Spirit of the Mountain
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53755.description: An elderly magician that raises mountains with his flute.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5378e.name: Star Boy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5378e.description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all WATER monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all FIRE monsters by 400 points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53790.name: Star Drawing
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53790.description:
If this card is used for an Xyz Summon, you can treat it as a Level 5 monster. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card as an Xyz Material gains this effect.
● If it is Xyz Summoned: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537b4.name: Staring Contest
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537b4.description: When you Special Summon a monster to the Extra Monster Zone: You can target 1 monster in your opponent's Main Monster Zone; move that target to their zone in the same column as that Extra Monster Zone monster. When your opponent Special Summons a monster to the Extra Monster Zone: You can target 1 monster in your Main Monster Zone; move that target to your zone in the same column as that Extra Monster Zone monster. These effects cannot be activated in the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537eb.name: Stellarknight Triverr
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537eb.description:
3 Level 4 "tellarknight" monsters
During the turn you Xyz Summon this card, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except "tellarknight" monsters. If this card is Xyz Summoned: Return all other cards on the field to the hand. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard. If this card with Xyz Material is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "tellarknight" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ef.name: Stim-Pack
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a537ef.description: The equipped monster gains 700 ATK. During each of your Standby Phases, the equipped monster loses 200 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53825.name: Subterror Behemoth Umastryx
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53825.description:
FLIP: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it. You can only use this effect of "Subterror Behemoth Umastryx" once per turn.
When a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, if you control no face-up monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5382f.name: Success Probability 0%
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5382f.description: Send 2 random Fusion Monsters from your opponent's Extra Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53842.name: Summoner's Art
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53842.description: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5385d.name: Super Anti-Kaiju War Machine Mecha-Thunder-King
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5385d.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; banish 1 "Kaiju" monster you control that is owned by your opponent, then, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your GY. You can only control 1 "Kaiju" monster. This card is unaffected by other "Kaiju" cards' effects, also it cannot be destroyed by battle with a "Kaiju" monster. During your End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Super Anti-Kaiju War Machine Mecha-Thunder-King" once per Duel.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5386c.name: Super Quantal Fairy Alphan
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5386c.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Super Quant" monster you control; all face-up monsters you currently control become that monster's Level. You can Tribute this card; reveal 3 "Super Quant" monsters with different names from your Deck, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Special Summon to your field, and you send the rest to the Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Super Quantal Fairy Alphan" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5389b.name: Superheavy Samurai Flutist
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5389b.description: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Superheavy Samurai" monster from your hand. During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that targets a "Superheavy Samurai" monster you control: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use each effect of "Superheavy Samurai Flutist" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538a8.name: Superheavy Samurai Soulbeads
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538a8.description: You can target 1 "Superheavy Samurai" monster you control; equip this monster from your hand or your side of the field to that target. Each turn, the first time the monster equipped with this card by this effect would be destroyed by a card effect, it is not destroyed. When a Defense Position monster is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; Special Summon that monster in Attack Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538bc.name: Supersonic Skull Flame
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538bc.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 "Skull Flame" from your Graveyard. Once per turn, you can inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each "Burning Skull Head" in your Graveyard. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Skull Flame" from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538c0.name: Supporter in the Shadows
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538c0.description: A cute little elf that hides in the shadows and provides spiritual support.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5393d.name: T.G. Cyber Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5393d.description: If this card you control would be used as Synchro Material for a "T.G." monster, "T.G." monsters in your hand can be used as the non-Tuner Synchro Materials. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can add 1 "T.G." monster from your Deck to your hand, except "T.G. Cyber Magician".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53943.name: T.G. Jet Falcon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53943.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Synchro Material: Inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53948.name: T.G. Screw Serpent
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53948.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "T.G." monster in your GY, except "T.G. Screw Serpent"; Special Summon that monster, but its effects are negated. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "T.G." monster you control; increase or reduce its Level by 1 until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "T.G. Screw Serpent" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53958.name: Tackle Crusader
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53958.description:
If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-down Defense Position.
● Target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; return that target to the hand. This turn, your opponent cannot activate cards with the same name as the card returned to the hand by this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a09.name: The Inexperienced Spy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a09.description: Select and see 1 card in your opponent's hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a4b.name: The Six Samurai - Zanji
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a4b.description: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: Destroy the monster this card attacked. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53875.name: Super Quantum Blue Layer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53875.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Super Quant" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Super Quantum Blue Layer".
