60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5397c.description: During your Main Phase, if you have activated a "Spellbook" Spell Card previously this turn: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT or DARK Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck. You cannot Special Summon another Level 5 or higher monster during the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5398d.name: Tentacle Plant
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5398d.description: A carnivorous plant that has an outgrowth of tentacles. It attacks someone nearby by extending its tentacles.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539bf.name: The Big Cattle Drive
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539bf.description: If you control a Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster: Draw 1 card for each of those Monster Types you control. You cannot activate other Spell/Trap Cards or effects during the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d2.name: The Deep Grave
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d2.description: Target 1 monster in either player's GY; during your next Standby Phase, Special Summon it from the GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d3.name: The Despair Uranus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d3.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned while you control no Spell/Trap Cards: You can activate this effect; your opponent declares either Continuous Spell or Continuous Trap, then you Set 1 card of that type directly from your Deck. This card gains 300 ATK for each face-up Spell/Trap Card you control. Face-up cards in your Spell & Trap Zone cannot be destroyed by card effects.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539e2.name: The Fabled Chawa
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539e2.description: During your Main Phase, you can discard 1 "Fabled" monster and Special Summon this card from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539e7.name: The Fabled Peggulsus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539e7.description: When this card is discarded to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon it face-down on your side of the field. When this card is flipped face-up, you can reveal 1 "Fabled" monster in your hand to send 1 "Fabled" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539e9.name: The Fabled Unicore
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539e9.description:
1 "Fabled" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
While you and your opponent have the same number of cards in hand, negate all Spell, Trap, and Effect Monster effects activated by your opponent, and destroy that Spell/Trap/Monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539f8.name: The Gates of Dark World
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539f8.description: All Fiend-Type monsters gain 300 ATK and DEF. Once per turn: You can banish 1 Fiend-Type monster from your Graveyard; discard 1 Fiend-Type monster, then draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539fc.name: The Grand Spellbook Tower
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539fc.description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if you have a Spellcaster-Type monster on your side of the field or in your Graveyard: You can place 1 "Spellbook" Spell Card from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck, except "The Grand Spellbook Tower", then draw 1 card. When this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand or Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the number of "Spellbook" Spell Cards in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539fd.name: The Grave of Enkindling
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539fd.description: You can only activate this card when a monster on your side of the field is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard. You and your opponent each select 1 monster from your respective Graveyards and Special Summon them in Defense Position. Neither monster Special Summoned by this card's effect can change its battle position while it is face-up on the field, except with a card effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a14.name: The Legendary Fisherman II
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a14.description: This card's name becomes "The Legendary Fisherman" while on the field or in the GY. While "Umi" is on the field, this card is unaffected by other monsters' effects. If this face-up card is destroyed by battle, or leaves the field because of an opponent's card effect while its owner controls it: You can add 1 Level 7 WATER monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a19.name: The Masked Beast
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a19.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Curse of the Masked Beast".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a1b.name: The Melody of Awakening Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a1b.description: Discard 1 card; add up to 2 Dragon monsters with 3000 or more ATK and 2500 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a3c.name: The Rock Spirit
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a3c.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 EARTH monster in your Graveyard. Increase the ATK of this monster by 300 points during your opponent's Battle Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5383f.name: Summoned Skull
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5383f.description:
A fiend with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the Fiend-Type monsters, this monster boasts considerable force.

(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53859.name: Supay
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53859.description: When this card is sent from the field to the GY by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Oracle of the Sun" from your Deck, and if you do, double its ATK, also return it to the hand during the End Phase of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53861.name: Super Defense Robot Elephan
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53861.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Super Defense Robot" monster or "Orbital 7" from your hand. Once per turn: You can target 1 "Super Defense Robot" monster or "Orbital 7" you control; it becomes Level 8 until the end of this turn. This card cannot be used as an Xyz Material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of a Machine-Type monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53869.name: Super Polymerization
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53869.description: Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field as Fusion Material. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53871.name: Super Quantal Mech King Great Magnus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53871.description:
3 Level 12 monsters
If this card is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 3 "Super Quantal Mech Beast" Xyz Monsters with different names from your GY. This card gains these effects, based on the number of materials with different names attached to it. ● 2+: Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; shuffle 1 card on the field into the Deck. ● 4+: It is unaffected by card effects, except "Super Quant" cards. ● 6+: Your opponent cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand by card effects.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53882.name: Super Soldier Soul
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53882.description: You can send 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster from your hand to the Graveyard; until your opponent's next End Phase, this card's ATK becomes 3000, and this card's name becomes "Black Luster Soldier". You can banish this card from your Graveyard; add 1 "Beginning Knight" or "Evening Twilight Knight" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Super Soldier Soul" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53887.name: Super Vehicroid - Stealth Union
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53887.description:
"Truckroid" + "Expressroid" + "Drillroid" + "Stealthroid"
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up non-Machine monster on the field; equip that target to this card. While equipped with a monster by this effect, this card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. If this card attacks, its original ATK is halved. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5389c.name: Superheavy Samurai General Coral
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5389c.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
While you have a Spell/Trap Card(s) in your Graveyard, this card's Pendulum Scale becomes 4. Once per turn, when a "Superheavy Samurai" monster you control destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can activate this effect; that monster can make a second attack in a row (even if this card leaves the field).
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If you have no Spell/Trap Cards in your Graveyard: You can Tribute up to 2 "Superheavy Samurai" monsters; draw that many cards. You can only use this effect of "Superheavy Samurai General Coral" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538a0.name: Superheavy Samurai Kabuto
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538a0.description: If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can change as many Attack Position "Superheavy Samurai" monsters you control as possible to Defense Position, and if you do, the ones changed by this effect gain 500 DEF until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538c2.name: Supremacy Berry
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538c2.description: If your Life Points were lower than your opponent's when this card was activated, gain 2000 Life Points. If your Life Points were higher than your opponent's, you take 1000 damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538d3.name: Susa Soldier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538d3.description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. The Battle Damage this card inflicts to your opponent's Life Points is halved.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53904.name: Sylvan Guardioak
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53904.description: Once per turn: You can choose a number from 1 to 3, then excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, send any excavated Plant-Type monsters to the Graveyard, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can target 1 other Plant-Type monster in your Graveyard; place that target on the top of your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53912.name: Symbols of Duty
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53912.description: Send 1 Normal Monster you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon it, and if you do, equip this card to it. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5391a.name: Synchar
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5391a.description: This two-headed creature spits laser blasts at its enemies.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5391b.name: Synchro Back
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5391b.description: Target 1 Synchro Monster you control; return that target to the Extra Deck, also during the Standby Phase of your next turn, Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 Synchro Monster with the same name as that monster returned to the Extra Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53928.name: Synchro Gift
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53928.description: Select 2 face-up monsters you control (1 Synchro Monster and 1 non-Synchro monster). Until the End Phase of this turn, reduce the ATK of the Synchro Monster to 0, and the other monster gains ATK equal to the Synchro Monster's original ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5394a.name: T.G. Striker
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5394a.description: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can add 1 "T.G." monster from your Deck to your hand, except "T.G. Striker".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5395a.name: Tactical Exchanger
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5395a.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Rokket" monster with a different original name from your Deck or GY. You can only activate 1 "Tactical Exchanger" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53974.name: Telekinetic Charging Cell
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53974.description: Equip only to a Psychic-Type monster. You do not have to pay Life Points to activate its effect(s). When the equipped monster is destroyed and this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can pay 1000 Life Points to return this card to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53982.name: Temple of the Six
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53982.description: Each time a "Six Samurai" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned, place 1 Bushido Counter on this card. Monsters your opponent controls lose 100 ATK for each Bushido Counter on this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53984.name: Temtempo the Percussion Djinn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53984.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 face-up Xyz Monster your opponent controls; detach 1 Xyz Material from that monster, and if you do, all "Djinn" Xyz Monsters you currently control gain 500 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539a7.name: Tethys, Goddess of Light
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539a7.description: When you draw a Fairy monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can reveal 1 of those monsters; draw 1 card. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539ad.name: That Wacky Magic!
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539ad.description: Banish all Spell Cards from your Graveyard; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls with DEF less than or equal to the number of Spell Cards you banished x 300.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539b8.name: The Agent of Wisdom - Mercury
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539b8.description: During your Standby Phase, if you controlled this face-up card and had no cards in your hand at the end of the opponent's last End Phase: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539c0.name: The Big March of Animals
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539c0.description: Until the end of this turn, all face-up Beast-Type monsters on your side of the field gain 200 ATK for each Beast-Type monster on your side of the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539c2.name: The Bistro Butcher
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539c2.description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, your opponent draws 2 cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539cd.name: The Creator Incarnate
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539cd.description: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "The Creator" from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539da.name: The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539da.description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding EARTH Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a15.name: The Legendary Fisherman III
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a15.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "The Legendary Fisherman". When this card is Special Summoned: You can banish all monsters your opponent controls, also this card cannot attack this turn. Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, also unaffected by Spell/Trap effects. Once per turn: You can return as many of your opponent's banished cards as possible to their GY, and if you do, the first battle or effect damage your opponent takes this turn becomes doubled.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a35.name: The Prime Monarch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a35.description: Once per turn: You can target 2 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Cards in your Graveyard; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card. If this card is in your Graveyard: You can banish 1 other "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card in Defense Position as a Normal Monster (Fairy-Type/LIGHT/Level 5/ATK 1000/DEF 2400). (This card is NOT treated as a Trap Card.) You can only use this effect of "The Prime Monarch" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a47.name: The Six Samurai - Kamon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a47.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card; destroy that target. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. This card cannot declare an attack during the turn this effect is activated. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53827.name: Subterror Cave Clash
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53827.description: All "Subterror" monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF for each Set monster on the field. Once per turn, when a "Subterror" monster you control inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 "Subterror" card in your Graveyard, except "Subterror Cave Clash"; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5383a.name: Summon Reactor SK
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5383a.description: The first time a monster(s) is Summoned to your opponent's side of the field each turn, inflict 400 damage to your opponent. During the Battle Phase of the turn this effect is activated, you can negate the attack of 1 monster your opponent controls. You can send 1 face-up "Trap Reactor・Y FI", 1 face-up "Spell Reactor・RE" and this face-up card you control to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Flying Fortress SKY FIRE" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53843.name: Summoning Curse
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53843.description: If a monster(s) is Special Summoned: The current controller of that monster(s) banishes 1 card from their hand. Once per turn, during your End Phase, pay 500 LP or destroy this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53867.name: Super Junior Confrontation
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53867.description: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Negate the battle, and 1 monster with the lowest ATK in face-up Attack Position your opponent controls battles against 1 monster with the lowest DEF in face-up Defense Position you control. After that battle, end the Battle Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53888.name: Super Vehicroid Jumbo Drill
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53888.description:
"Steamroid" + "Drillroid" + "Submarineroid"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5388f.name: Supercharge
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5388f.description: When your opponent declares an attack while the only monsters you control are Machine-Type "roid" monster(s): Draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538a4.name: Superheavy Samurai Prepped Defense
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538a4.description: Cannot be Normal or Flip Summoned, if you have any Spell/Trap Cards in your Graveyard. When you take battle damage, if you have no Spell/Trap Cards in your Graveyard and this card is in your hand: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do, it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538af.name: Superheavy Samurai Soulpiercer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538af.description: You can target 1 "Superheavy Samurai" monster you control; equip this monster from your hand or your side of the field to that target. If it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Superheavy Samurai" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Superheavy Samurai Soulpiercer".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538bb.name: Supernatural Regeneration
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538bb.description: Activate only during the End Phase. Gain 1000 Life Points for each Psychic-Type monster sent to the Graveyard this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538c3.name: Supreme Arcanite Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538c3.description:
1 Spellcaster-Type Synchro Monster + 1 Spellcaster-Type monster
This monster can only be Special Summoned by Fusion Summon (from the Extra Deck). When this card is Fusion Summoned, place 2 Spell Counters on it. This card gains 1000 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 Spell Counter from your side of the field to activate 1 of the following effects: ● Select 1 card on the field, and destroy it. ● Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538cf.name: Surface
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538cf.description: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster in your GY; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538ef.name: Sword Slasher
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538ef.description: A lethal engine of destruction that wields two well-honed blades.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538f0.name: Sword of Dark Destruction
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538f0.description: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 400 ATK and loses 200 DEF.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5390c.name: Sylvan Princessprout
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5390c.description:
You can only activate each effect of "Sylvan Princessprout" once per turn.
● You can Tribute this card; excavate the top card of your Deck, send it to the Graveyard, then you can place 1 "sprout" monster in your Graveyard on top of your Deck.
● If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can declare a Level from 1 to 8; Special Summon this card from the Graveyard, and if you do, it becomes that Level.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5390d.name: Sylvan Sagequoia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5390d.description: When a "Sylvan" monster is sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant-Type monster, send it to the Graveyard. Otherwise, place it on the bottom of your Deck. If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can target 1 "Sylvan" Spell/Trap Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53937.name: Synthetic Seraphim
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53937.description: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, Special Summon 1 "Synthetic Seraphim Token" (Fairy/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 300).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53978.name: Teleport
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53978.description: Once per turn, if your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can pay 800 Life Points to Special Summon 1 Psychic-Type monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53980.name: Temple of the Kings
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53980.description: You can activate 1 Trap Card the turn it was Set. You can send 1 "Mystical Beast of Serket" in your Monster Zone and this card you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck, or 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Temple of the Kings" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53988.name: Tengu, the Winged Mayakashi
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53988.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters / You can only control 1 "Tengu, the Winged Mayakashi". You can only use each of these effects of "Tengu, the Winged Mayakashi" once per turn.
● If a Synchro Monster in your possession whose original Level is 9 is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect while this card is in the GY: You can banish 1 other Zombie monster from your GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card.
● If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can destroy 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539b7.name: The Agent of Mystery - Earth
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539b7.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can add 1 "The Agent" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "The Agent of Mystery - Earth". While "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is face-up on the field, you can add 1 "Master Hyperion" from your Deck to your hand instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539c3.name: The Black Stone of Legend
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539c3.description: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower "Red-Eyes" monster from your Deck, except "Red-Eyes B. Chick". If this card is in your Graveyard: You can target 1 Level 7 or lower "Red-Eyes" monster in your Graveyard, except "Red-Eyes B. Chick"; shuffle it into the Deck, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use 1 "The Black Stone of Legend" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d1.name: The Dark Magicians
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d1.description:
"Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" + 1 Spellcaster monster
Once per turn, if a Spell/Trap Card or effect is activated (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card, then if it was a Spell/Trap, you can Set it, and if it was a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, you can activate it this turn. If this card is destroyed: You can Special Summon both 1 "Dark Magician" and 1 "Dark Magician Girl" from your hand, Deck, and/or GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539f6.name: The Fountain in the Sky
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539f6.description: When a LIGHT monster is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard, you can remove that monster from play to gain Life Points equal to its ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539fe.name: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539fe.description: Add 2 "LV" monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a22.name: The Phantom Knights of Ancient Cloak
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a22.description: If this card is in Attack Position: You can target 1 DARK monster on the field; change this card to Defense Position, and if you do, that monster gains 800 ATK/DEF until the end of your opponent's turn. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "The Phantom Knights" card from your Deck to your hand, except "The Phantom Knights of Ancient Cloak". You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Ancient Cloak" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a26.name: The Phantom Knights of Dark Gauntlets
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a26.description: Send 1 "Phantom Knights" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY. When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack while you control no cards and this card is in your GY: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Warrior/DARK/Level 4/ATK 300/DEF 600), but banish it when it leaves the field. (This card is NOT treated as a Trap.) If Summoned this way, this card gains 300 DEF for each "Phantom Knights" Spell/Trap in your GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a38.name: The Reliable Guardian
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a38.description: Increase 1 face-up monster's DEF by 700 points until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a40.name: The Seal of Orichalcos
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a40.description: All monsters you control gain 500 ATK. Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects. While you control 2 or more face-up Attack Position monsters, your opponent cannot target your monster(s) with the lowest ATK for an attack. If this card is activated: Destroy all Special Summoned monsters you control. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck. You can only activate "The Seal of Orichalcos" once per Duel.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53839.name: Summon Over
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53839.description: Each time a monster(s) is Special Summoned, place 1 Summon Counter on this card (max. 6). This card with 6 Summon Counters cannot be destroyed by card effects. At the start of each Main Phase 1, if this card has 6 Summon Counters: The turn player can activate this effect; they send this card to the GY, and if they do, they send all Special Summoned monsters their opponent controls to the GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5385f.name: Super Conductor Tyranno
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5385f.description: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. This card cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538b2.name: Superheavy Samurai Steam Train King
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538b2.description:
1 "Superheavy Samurai" Tuner + 2+ non-Tuner "Superheavy Samurai" monsters
This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its DEF for damage calculation. Once per turn: You can discard up to 2 cards, then target that many cards your opponent controls; destroy them. Once per turn: You can banish all Spells and Traps from the GYs, and if you do, inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card banished.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538bd.name: Supervise
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538bd.description: Equip only to a Gemini monster. It becomes an Effect Monster, and gains its effects. If this face-up card is sent from the field to the GY: Target 1 Normal Monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538e4.name: Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538e4.description: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Normal Summon it without Tributing.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538f7.name: Swords at Dawn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538f7.description: Target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard and 1 appropriate monster on the field; equip the Equip Spell Card to that monster. Destroy that Equip Spell Card during the End Phase. If you activate this card, you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Swords at Dawn" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53924.name: Synchro Deflector
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53924.description: Activate only when a face-up Synchro Monster you control is selected as an attack target. Negate the attack and destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53933.name: Synchron Explorer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53933.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Synchron" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target, but its effects are negated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53936.name: Synthesis Spell
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53936.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Lycanthrope". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53945.name: T.G. Power Gladiator
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53945.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "T.G." monsters
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If this card on the field is destroyed: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53947.name: T.G. Rush Rhino
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53947.description: If this card attacks, it gains 400 ATK during the Damage Step only. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can add 1 "T.G." monster from your Deck to your hand, except "T.G. Rush Rhino".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5395b.name: Tail Swipe
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5395b.description: Target 1 Level 5 or higher Dinosaur monster you control; if that Dinosaur monster is still face-up on the field, choose up to 2 monsters your opponent controls that have a lower Level than it, or are face-down, and return the chosen monsters to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5396b.name: Tardy Orc
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5396b.description: This card cannot attack the turn it is Normal Summoned.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53970.name: Tatsunootoshigo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53970.description: A stallion-fish that races across the ocean floor.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53972.name: Taunt
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53972.description: Activate only during your opponent's Main Phase 1; select 1 monster on your side of the field. While the selected card remains on the field, if your opponent attacks with a monster(s) this turn, they must select the selected monster as the attack target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53977.name: Telepathic Power
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53977.description: When a Psychic-Type monster you control is destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster: Target the opponent's monster; destroy that target, and if you do, gain LP equal to the destroyed monster's ATK on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53986.name: Tenacity of the Monarchs
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53986.description: Reveal 1 monster in your hand with 2400 ATK & 1000 DEF, or 2800 ATK & 1000 DEF; add 1 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand, except "Tenacity of the Monarchs". You can only activate 1 "Tenacity of the Monarchs" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5399f.name: Terrorking Archfiend
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5399f.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned unless you have an Archfiend Monster Card on your side of the field. The controller of this card pays 800 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 2 or 5, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. The effects of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed as a result of battle are negated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539a8.name: Teva
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539a8.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned successfully, your opponent cannot declare an attack during his/her next turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539bc.name: The Atmosphere
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539bc.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 monsters you control and 1 monster from your Graveyard. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card. (You can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card with this effect.) This card gains ATK and DEF equal to the ATK and DEF of that equipped monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539bd.name: The Beginning of the End
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539bd.description: If you have 7 or more DARK monsters in your GY: Banish 5 DARK monsters from your GY; draw 3 cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539ca.name: The Claw of Hermos
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539ca.description:
(This card is also always treated as "Legendary Dragon Hermos".)
Send 1 monster from your hand or field to the GY, of the Type that is listed on a Fusion Monster that can only be Special Summoned with "The Claw of Hermos" (if that card is Set, reveal it), then Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck. You can only activate 1 "The Claw of Hermos" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d4.name: The Door of Destiny
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d4.description: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: Negate the attack, then Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Fiend-Type/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) During your Standby Phase, while this card is treated as a monster: You can banish any number of "Utopia" monsters with different names from your Graveyard; inflict 250 damage to your opponent for each of those banished monsters, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to the damage they took.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d7.name: The Dragon's Bead
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d7.description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Negate the effect of a Trap Card that targets 1 face-up Dragon-Type monster and destroy the Trap Card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539ed.name: The First Monarch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539ed.description: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 6/ATK 1000/DEF 2400). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) If Summoned this way: You can discard 1 card, then declare 1 Attribute; this card becomes that Attribute, and can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a monster with the same Attribute as this card. If this card was Summoned this way, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except monsters with this card's Attribute.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539ee.name: The First Sarcophagus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539ee.description: During each of your opponent's End Phases, place 1 card face-up on your side of the field from your hand or Deck in this order: "The Second Sarcophagus", "The Third Sarcophagus". If 1 Sarcophagus card is removed from your side of the field, all of them on your side of the field are sent to the Graveyard. When you have all 3 Sarcophagus cards on your side of the field, send all Sarcophagus cards on your side of the field to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Spirit of the Pharaoh" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a30.name: The Phantom Knights of Tomb Shield
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a30.description: Special Summon this card in Attack Position as a Normal Monster (Warrior/DARK/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). (This card is NOT treated as a Trap.) During your turn, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up Trap your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a32.name: The Phantom Knights of Wrong Magnetring
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a32.description:
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Negate that attack, then Special Summon this card in Attack Position as an Effect Monster (Warrior/DARK/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the following effect. (This card is NOT treated as a Trap.)
● (Quick Effect): You can send this card and 1 face-up card you control to the GY (either a "The Phantom Knights" monster or a "Phantom Knights" Continuous Spell/Trap); draw 2 cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a33.name: The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Launch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a33.description: During the Main Phase: Target 1 DARK Xyz Monster you control with no material; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 DARK Xyz Monster that is 1 Rank higher than that monster you control, by using it as the Xyz Material, and if you do, attach this card to it as additional material. (This is treated as an Xyz Summon. Transfer its materials to the Summoned monster.) During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 DARK Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster from your hand to that monster as material.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a3f.name: The Sanctum of Parshath
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a3f.description: This card's name becomes "The Sanctuary in the Sky" while on the field or in the GY. Fairy monsters on the field gain 300 ATK/DEF. Set Spells/Traps cannot be targeted by, or destroyed by, card effects. Once per turn: You can target a total of 3 Fairy monsters and/or Counter Traps with different names in your GY; place them on top of your Deck in any order.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a46.name: The Six Samurai - Irou
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a46.description: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53831.name: Succubus Knight
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53831.description: A warrior wizard adept in casting bone-chilling spells.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5385c.name: Super Anti-Kaiju War Machine Mecha-Dogoran
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5385c.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) while your opponent controls a "Kaiju" monster. You can only control 1 "Kaiju" monster. Once per turn: You can remove 2 Kaiju Counters from anywhere on the field; equip 1 "Kaiju" monster from your hand or Graveyard to this card. This card gains ATK equal to the combined original ATK of the "Kaiju" monsters equipped to it by this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53860.name: Super Crashbug
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53860.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) in face-up Defense Position, by banishing "Crashbug X", "Crashbug Y", and "Crashbug Z" from your Graveyard. Switch the ATK and DEF of all face-up Attack Position monsters on the field. There can only be 1 face-up "Super Crashbug" on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5386e.name: Super Quantal Mech Beast Grampulse
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5386e.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Cannot attack unless it has Xyz Material. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy it. This effect can be activated during either player's turn, if this card has "Super Quantum Blue Layer" as Xyz Material. Once per turn: You can attach 1 "Super Quantum" monster from your hand or field to this card as an Xyz Material.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53894.name: Superheavy Samurai Beast Kyubi
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53894.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Superheavy Samurai" monsters
This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its DEF for damage calculation. If you have no Spell/Trap Cards in your Graveyard, this card gains 900 DEF for each Special Summoned monster your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53899.name: Superheavy Samurai Drum
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53899.description: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Superheavy Samurai" monster in your Graveyard, except "Superheavy Samurai Drum"; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Superheavy Samurai Drum" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538a1.name: Superheavy Samurai Magnet
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538a1.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Superheavy Samurai" monster from your hand, then change this card to Defense Position. Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack any monsters, except this one.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538b4.name: Superheavy Samurai Swordsman
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538b4.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can change its battle position. If a "Superheavy Samurai" monster you control battles an opponent's monster, after damage calculation: The opponent's monster's ATK and DEF become 0.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538e5.name: Swift Samurai Storm!
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538e5.description: Each turn, after the first time a "Six Samurai" monster you control battles, all "Six Samurai" monsters you control gain 300 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53909.name: Sylvan Mikorange
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53909.description: When this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant-Type monster, send it to the Graveyard. Otherwise, place it on the bottom of your Deck. If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: All Plant-Type monsters you currently control gain 300 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5390a.name: Sylvan Peaskeeper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5390a.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant-Type monster, send it to the Graveyard. Otherwise, place it on the bottom of your Deck. If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Plant-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. You can only use this effect of "Sylvan Peaskeeper" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5390f.name: Sylvan Waterslide
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5390f.description: Each time an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant-Type monster, send it to the Graveyard. Otherwise, place it on the bottom of your Deck. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: Excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant-Type monster, send it to the Graveyard. Otherwise, add it to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5391f.name: Synchro Call
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5391f.description: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, but it has its effects negated (if any), and if you do, immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 DARK Dragon or Fiend-Type Synchro Monster using only monsters you control as Materials, including the Summoned monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53934.name: Synch Realm
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53934.description: Each time you Synchro Summon a Synchro Monster, inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5393e.name: T.G. Drill Fish
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5393e.description:
This card can attack directly. You can only use each of the following effects of "T.G. Drill Fish" once per turn.
● If all monsters you control are "T.G." monsters (min. 1): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● When a "T.G." monster you control inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5399c.name: Terrible Deal
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5399c.description: Activate only by paying 1000 Life Points when your opponent activates a Spell Card. Your opponent discards 1 random card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539b3.name: The Agent of Entropy - Uranus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539b3.description: If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn: You can send 1 "The Agent" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, this card's Level becomes the Level of the monster sent to the Graveyard by this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d5.name: The Dragon Dwelling in the Cave
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539d5.description: A huge dragon dwelling in a cave. It is horrible when it gets angry, although it is usually quiet. It is said to preserve certain treasures.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539dd.name: The Eye of Timaeus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539dd.description:
(This card is also always treated as "Legendary Dragon Timaeus".)
Target 1 "Dark Magician" monster you control; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that lists that monster on the field as Fusion Material, using it as the Fusion Material. You can only activate 1 "The Eye of Timaeus" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539e8.name: The Fabled Rubyruda
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539e8.description: When this face-up card you control is selected as an attack target, you can discard 1 "Fabled" monster to negate the attack.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a1c.name: The Melting Red Shadow
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a1c.description: This monster melts away to materialize under its enemies, taking them by surprise.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a34.name: The Portrait's Secret
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a34.description: A portrait cursed by the artist, it is said to bring ill fortune to anyone who owns it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5387f.name: Super Soldier Rebirth
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5387f.description: Target 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster you control; send it to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster from your hand with a different name from that monster, ignoring its Summoning conditions. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster in your Graveyard; add it to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Super Soldier Rebirth" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53885.name: Super Team Buddy Force Unite!
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53885.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or GY, with the same original Type as that monster's, but with a different original name. If this card in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can Set 1 "Super Team Buddy Force Unite!" directly from your Deck to your Spell & Trap Zone.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5388c.name: Super-Nimble Mega Hamster
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5388c.description: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Beast-Type monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538b9.name: Superheavy Samurai Warlord Susanowo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538b9.description:
1 Machine-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Superheavy Samurai" monsters
This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its DEF for damage calculation. Once per turn, during either player's turn, if you have no Spell/Trap Cards in your Graveyard: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card in your opponent's Graveyard; Set it to your side of the field, but banish it when it leaves the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538c1.name: Suppression Collider
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538c1.description: ''All data crushed by this network warrior's hammer is irretrievably compressed.''

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538cc.name: Supreme King's Castle
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538cc.description: You can Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters that must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion", with effects other than "Dark Fusion". Once per turn, during damage calculation, if your Fiend monster battles an opponent's monster: You can send 1 "Evil HERO" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck to the GY; your monster gains ATK equal to the Level of the monster sent to the GY x 200, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538d1.name: Survival of the Fittest
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538d1.description: Target 1 Dinosaur-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 1000 ATK. When that attacking monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can activate this effect; the equipped monster can make a second attack on an opponent's monster in a row.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538d7.name: Svartalf of the Nordic Alfar
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538d7.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Nordic" monster in your GY; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538df.name: Swarm of Crows
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538df.description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538e1.name: Swarm of Scarabs
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538e1.description: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538f6.name: Sword of the Soul-Eater
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538f6.description: You can only equip this card to a Level 3 or lower Normal Monster on your side of the field. When you activate this card, Tribute all Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field, except the equipped monster. Increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 1000 points for each Normal Monster that you Tributed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a538fb.name: Swordsman from a Distant Land

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539cb.name: The Creator

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a539eb.name: The Fiend Megacyber

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a02.name: The Huge Revolution is Over

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53845.name: Sun Dragon Inti

"Fire Ant Ascator" + 1+ non-Tuner monsters

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a5387a.name: Super Robolady
