60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9e.description: Destroy all monsters you control, and if you do, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab2.name: Thunder Sea Horse
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab2.description: You can discard this card; add 2 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder-Type monsters of the same name with 1600 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Thunder Sea Horse" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af9.name: Token Sundae
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af9.description: Destroy all Tokens you control, then destroy cards on the field up to the number of Tokens destroyed by this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b14.name: Toon Masked Sorcerer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b14.description: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b1d.name: Top Runner
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b1d.description: All face-up Synchro Monsters you control gain 600 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b37.name: Toy Emperor
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b37.description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can add 1 Trap from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b4e.name: Transmigration Break
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b4e.description: Any cards that would be returned to the Deck from the Graveyard are removed from play instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b24.name: Tornado
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b24.description: Activate only when there are 3 or more cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone. Destroy 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b31.name: Tour Bus From the Underworld
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b31.description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster in either player's Graveyard, except "Tour Bus From the Underworld"; shuffle that target into the Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b45.name: Training Fur Hire, Fur All Your Training Needs
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b45.description: If a face-up monster(s) "Fur Hire" you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: You can target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon 1 monster "Fur Hire" from your Deck, whose Level is lower than that target's original Level. You can only use this effect of "Training Fur Hire, Fur All Your Training Needs" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b61.name: Traptrix Dionaea
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b61.description: This card is unaffected by the effects of "Hole" Normal Trap Cards. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Traptrix" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position. When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Hole" Normal Trap Card in your Graveyard; Set that target, but banish it during the End Phase of your next turn if it is still on the field. You can only use this effect of "Traptrix Dionaea" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9a.name: Trickstar Band Sweet Guitar
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9a.description:
1 "Trickstar" Link Monster + 1 "Trickstar" monster
Effect damage inflicted to your opponent by your "Trickstar" Link Monster linked to this card is doubled. If your opponent takes damage by a "Trickstar" monster's effect: This card gains ATK equal to the damage they took. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card attacked this turn: The ATK gained from this effect returns to 0, then you can add 1 "Trickstar" monster from your GY to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b71.name: Trent
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b71.description: A guardian of the woods, this massive tree is believed to be immortal.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bbf.name: Tripod Fish
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bbf.description: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster on the field; increase its Level by 1.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc3.name: Trishula, the Dragon of Icy Imprisonment
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc3.description:
3 monsters with different names
Must first be either Fusion Summoned using only monsters in your hand and/or field, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control (in which case you do not use "Polymerization"). If this card was Special Summoned using only monsters that were originally Dragons: You can reveal and banish 3 cards (1 from your Deck, 1 from the top of your opponent's Deck, and 1 from their Extra Deck). You can only use this effect of "Trishula, the Dragon of Icy Imprisonment" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bdf.name: Tuning
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bdf.description: Add 1 "Synchron" Tuner from your Deck to your hand, then send the top card of your Deck to the GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b81.name: Tri-Horned Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b81.description: An unworthy dragon with three sharp horns sprouting from its head.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be5.name: Turbo Rocket
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be5.description: While attacking, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks, after damage calculation, inflict damage equal to quarter the ATK of the attack target to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8d.name: Triamid Loading
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8d.description: If a Field Spell is placed face-up in the Field Zone: You can add 1 "Triamid" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Triamid Loading". If a face-up Rock monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Triamid" monster with a different name from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Triamid Loading" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bad.name: Trickstar Lycoris
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bad.description: (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand, then target 1 "Trickstar" monster you control, except "Trickstar Lycoris"; Special Summon this card, and if you do, return that monster to the hand. Each time a card(s) is added to your opponent's hand, inflict 100 damage to them for each.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc0.name: Tripwire Beast
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc0.description: This creature attacks with electromagnetic waves.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be8.name: Turnabout
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be8.description: If there is a face-up monster on the field whose current Level is different from its original Level: Change all monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aac.name: Thunder End Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aac.description:
2 Level 8 Normal Monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy all other monsters on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac1.name: Tiki Soul
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac1.description: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Rock-Type/LIGHT/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1800). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) While this card is an Effect Monster, if another Trap Card you control that is a monster would be destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to your Graveyard, you can Set it in the Spell & Trap Card Zone instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b04.name: Toon Ancient Gear Golem
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b04.description: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b18.name: Toon Summoned Skull
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b18.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 monster, while you control "Toon World". Cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 LP to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. Can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster, in which case this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b2f.name: Totem Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b2f.description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Dragon-Type monster. If this card is in your Graveyard during your Standby Phase and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card in Attack Position. You cannot activate this effect if there are any monsters in your Graveyard that are not Dragon-Type. If this card is Special Summoned with this effect, remove it from play when it is removed from the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9f.name: Trickstar Candina
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9f.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Trickstar" card from your Deck to your hand. Each time your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, inflict 100 damage to them immediately after it resolves.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba2.name: Trickstar Delfiendium
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba2.description:
2+ "Trickstar" monsters
When this card declares an attack while pointing to a "Trickstar" monster: You can target your banished "Trickstar" cards, up to the number of Link Monsters your opponent controls; add them to your hand, and if you do, this card gains 1000 ATK for each card added, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba5.name: Trickstar Foxglove Witch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba5.description:
2+ Fairy monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card they control. If this Link Summoned card is destroyed by battle or effect: You can Special Summon 1 Link-2 or lower "Trickstar" monster from your Extra Deck, then inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card they control. You can only use each effect of "Trickstar Foxglove Witch" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb3.name: Trickstar Rhodode
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb3.description: You can discard 1 "Trickstar" card, then target 1 "Trickstar" Link Monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Rhodode" once per turn. Each time a card(s) is banished from your opponent's GY, immediately inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card banished.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb5.name: Tricular
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb5.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Bicular" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc9.name: Troposphere
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc9.description: If you Tribute Summon this card, the Tribute must be Winged Beast-Type. This card is unaffected by the effects of Trap Cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bca.name: Truckroid
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bca.description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Equip the destroyed monster to this card. This card gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of the monsters equipped to it by this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bd7.name: Tsukuyomi
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bd7.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up this turn: Return it to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bdc.name: Tuner's Barrier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bdc.description: Select 1 face-up Tuner monster you control. That monster cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects, until the End Phase of the next turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be2.name: Tuningware
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be2.description: This card can be treated as a Level 2 monster when used for a Synchro Summon. If this card is sent to the Graveyard for a Synchro Summon: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be6.name: Turbo Synchron
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be6.description: When this card declares an attack: You can change the attack target to Defense Position. When you take battle damage while this card is attacking: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand with ATK less than or equal to the battle damage you took.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6f.name: The Weather Painter Thunder
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6f.description: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell/Trap you control to the GY; place 1 "The Weather" Spell/Trap from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use this effect of "The Weather Painter Thunder" once per turn. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of the turn after this card was banished from the field to activate a "The Weather" card's effect: You can Special Summon this banished card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a74.name: The Weather Thundery Canvas
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a74.description:
"The Weather" Effect Monsters in your Main Monster Zones of this card's column and its adjacent columns gain this effect.
● At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish this card; return that opponent's monster to the hand.
You can only control 1 "The Weather Thundery Canvas".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a86.name: Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a86.description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand, then, if it was a Monster Card, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 100.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9a.name: Three-Legged Zombies
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9a.description: A pair of friendly skeletons, lean and fat, that travel with extreme difficulty.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac5.name: Time Machine
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac5.description: When a monster is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon that monster to the same field it was on, in the same battle position it was in when destroyed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac6.name: Time Magic Hammer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac6.description: Must be Special Summoned with "The Claw of Hermos", using a Spellcaster monster. If this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 other face-up monster on the field; equip this card to it. At the start of the Damage Step, if it battles an opponent's monster: You can roll a six-sided die, and banish that opponent's monster until the Standby Phase of the Nth turn after this effect's activation (N = the result).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53acb.name: Time Stream
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53acb.description: Target 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster you control; Tribute it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, whose original Level is 2 higher than that monster's. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon with "Fossil Fusion".) During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card and 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster from your GY, then target 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ae1.name: Timidity
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ae1.description: Neither player can destroy Set Spell and Trap Cards on the field until your opponent's next End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b00.name: Tomozaurus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b00.description: Small but vicious, this monster even attacks its own kind.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b92.name: Triangle Power
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b92.description: Increase the original ATK and DEF of all face-up Level 1 Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field by 2000 points until the End Phase. Destroy all Level 1 Normal Monsters on your side of the field during the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9d.name: Trickstar Bloom
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9d.description:
1 Level 2 or lower "Trickstar" monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can make your opponent draw 1 card. If a face-up "Trickstar" monster this card points to is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Bloom" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9e.name: Trickstar Bouquet
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9e.description: Target 1 "Trickstar" monster you control and 1 face-up monster on the field; return that "Trickstar" monster to the hand, and if you do, the other monster gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the returned monster, until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Trickstar Bouquet" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb8.name: Trifortressops
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb8.description: During either player's turn, if your opponent Summoned 3 or more monsters this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If Summoned this way, it is unaffected by other cards' effects, but loses 500 DEF during each player's Standby Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bbb.name: Trigon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bbb.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can equip this card to a Machine-Type monster you control as an Equip Card, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this effect, if the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle, select and Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT Machine-Type monster from your Graveyard. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bbc.name: Triple Burst Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bbc.description:
2+ monsters, except Tokens
Once per turn, during the Damage Step, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was Special Summoned: You can Tribute this card, then target 1 Link-2 or lower monster in your GY; Special Summon it, then you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dragon monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be7.name: Turbo Warrior
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be7.description:
"Turbo Synchron" + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card declares an attack on a Level 6 or higher Synchro Monster: Halve the ATK of the attack target until the end of the Damage Step. This card cannot be targeted by the effects of Level 6 or lower monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bef.name: Turu-Purun
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bef.description: A strange, one-eyed monster that can fell an enemy with a single stab of its spear.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf3.name: Twilight Ninja Getsuga, the Shogun
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf3.description: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Ninja" monster. If this card is in Attack Position: You can target 2 "Ninja" monsters in your GY, except "Twilight Ninja Getsuga, the Shogun"; change this card to Defense Position, and if you do, Special Summon those monsters. You can only use this effect of "Twilight Ninja Getsuga, the Shogun" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6e.name: The Weather Painter Sun
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6e.description: If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon this card in Defense Position, and if you do, place 1 "The Weather" Spell/Trap from your hand face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use this effect of "The Weather Painter Sun" once per turn. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of the turn after this card was banished from the field to activate a "The Weather" card's effect: You can Special Summon this banished card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a75.name: The White Stone of Ancients
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a75.description: Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there this turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "The White Stone of Ancients" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a82.name: Theban Nightmare
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a82.description: Gains 1500 ATK while you have no cards in your hand nor in your Spell & Trap Zones.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af7.name: Token Feastevil
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af7.description: When a Token(s) is Special Summoned: Destroy as many Tokens on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict 150 damage to your opponent for each Token destroyed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53afa.name: Token Thanksgiving
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53afa.description: Destroy all tokens on the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of tokens destroyed x 800 points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b19.name: Toon Table of Contents
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b19.description: Add 1 "Toon" card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b5d.name: Trap of the Imperial Tomb
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b5d.description: When a Zombie monster(s) is Special Summoned from your opponent's GY to your field: Target 2 cards on the field; destroy them.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b72.name: Tri-Blaze Accelerator
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b72.description: Activate only by sending 1 face-up "Blaze Accelerator" on your side of the field to the Graveyard. You can send 1 Pyro-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard to destroy 1 monster your opponent controls and inflict 500 damage to your opponent, but you cannot declare an attack during this turn if you do.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc6.name: Trojan Blast
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc6.description: Activate only when an opponent's card effect shifts control of a monster from your side of the field to theirs. Destroy that 1 monster and inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf2.name: Twilight Eraser
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf2.description: If you control 2 or more "Lightsworn" monsters with the same Type but different names: Banish 2 "Lightsworn" monsters from your GY, then target 2 cards on the field; banish them. If this card is sent from the Deck to the GY by a "Lightsworn" monster's effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Lightsworn" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf5.name: Twilight Ninja Kagen
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf5.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except "Ninja" monsters. This effect cannot be negated. Once per turn, when your "Ninja" monster declares an attack: You can make that monster gain 1000 ATK until the end of the Damage Step (even if this card leaves the field).
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
You can Tribute this card, then target 1 "Ninja" monster you control; it gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a54.name: The Supremacy Sun
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a54.description: Cannot be Special Summoned, except by its own effect. After this face-up card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, during the Standby Phase of the next turn: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab0.name: Thunder King, the Lightningstrike Kaiju
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab0.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) to your opponent's side of the field in Attack Position, by Tributing 1 monster they control. If your opponent controls a "Kaiju" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Attack Position. You can only control 1 "Kaiju" monster. Once per turn: You can remove 3 Kaiju Counters from anywhere on the field; your opponent's cards and effects cannot be activated for the rest of this turn, also this card can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab3.name: Thunder Short
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab3.description: Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac8.name: Time Passage
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac8.description: Increase the Level of 1 face-up "Fortune Lady" monster you control by 3, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ae2.name: Tin Archduke
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ae2.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; change its battle position. (Flip monsters' effects are not activated.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ae3.name: Tin Goldfish
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ae3.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b05.name: Toon Barrel Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b05.description: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. Once per turn: You can target 1 card on the field; toss a coin 3 times and destroy it if at least 2 of the results are Heads.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0b.name: Toon Cyber Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0b.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3b.name: Toy Vendor
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3b.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; draw 1 card and show it, then if it is a "Fluffal" monster, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand. Otherwise, discard the card you drew. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Edge Imp Sabres" or 1 "Fluffal" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3c.name: Trackblack
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3c.description:
2 Effect Monsters
You can target 1 monster you control this card points to; this turn, each time it destroys an opponent's monster by battle, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Trackblack" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b46.name: Trakodon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b46.description: A tiger-striped dragon that is often seen racing across the wasteland at tremendous speeds.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b50.name: Transmodify
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b50.description: Send 1 face-up monster you control to the GY; Special Summon from your Deck, 1 monster with the same Type and Attribute as that monster in the GY, but 1 Level higher. You can only activate 1 "Transmodify" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b68.name: Traptrix Trap Hole Nightmare
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b68.description: When a monster that was Special Summoned this turn activates its effect on your opponent's field: Negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b90.name: Triamid Sphinx
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b90.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with the effect of a "Triamid" card, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If a face-up "Triamid" card(s) you control, except "Triamid Sphinx", is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. While you control another "Triamid" card, this card gains 500 ATK and DEF for each Field Spell Card with a different name in your Graveyard, also monsters your opponent controls cannot attack, except to attack "Triamid Sphinx".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc7.name: Trojan Gladiator Beast
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc7.description: Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your hand to your opponent's side of the field. Then, draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bd4.name: Tsuchigumo, the Poisonous Mayakashi
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bd4.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters / You can only control 1 "Tsuchigumo, the Poisonous Mayakashi". You can only use each of these effects of "Tsuchigumo, the Poisonous Mayakashi" once per turn.
● If a Synchro Monster in your possession whose original Level is 7 is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect while this card is in the GY: You can banish 1 other Zombie monster from your GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card.
● If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can have each player send the top 3 cards from their Deck to the GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bd9.name: Tune Warrior
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bd9.description: The Warrior's antenna can attune it to any energy wave. It can monitor transmissions from miles away but always suffers from bad reception.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be4.name: Turbo Cannon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be4.description:
"Turbo Rocket" + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, you can destroy 1 face-up monster on the field and inflict damage to its controller equal to quarter of its ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf0.name: Tutan Mask
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf0.description: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated that targets exactly 1 Zombie monster on the field (and no other cards): Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a4f.name: The Spell Absorbing Life
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a4f.description: Flip all face-down Defense Position Monster Cards on the field face-up. Flip Effects are not activated at this time. Increase your Life Points by 400 points for each Effect Monster Card on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a63.name: The Unhappy Girl
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a63.description: While this card is in face-up Attack Position on the field, this card is not destroyed as a result of battle. (Damage calculation is applied normally.) A monster that battled with this card cannot change its battle position, except with a card effect, or attack while this card is in face-up Attack Position on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a92.name: Thousand-Eyes Jellyfish
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a92.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Ocean's Keeper". Your opponent must play with their hand revealed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a95.name: Three Strikes Barrier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a95.description:
If your opponent controls exactly 3 cards: Activate 1 of these effects;
● This turn, your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle.
● This turn, you take no battle damage.
● This turn, each time your monster inflicts battle damage to your opponent, you gain the same amount of LP.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac0.name: Tiki Curse
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac0.description: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Rock-Type/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 1000). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) While this card is an Effect Monster, if another Trap Card that is a monster battles an opponent's monster, after damage calculation: Destroy that opponent's monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53add.name: Timebreaker Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53add.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Each turn, the first Pendulum Monster(s) you control that would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, is not destroyed.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
When this card is Pendulum Summoned from the hand (and no other cards are Pendulum Summoned at the same time): You can make this card's ATK become double its original ATK. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster on the field; banish both it and this card from the field, but return them in your next Standby Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af6.name: Token Collector
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af6.description: If a Token is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from the GY (if it was there when the Token was Special Summoned) or hand (even if not). You can only use this effect of "Token Collector" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: Destroy as many Tokens on the field as possible, and if you do, this card gains 400 ATK for each Token destroyed. Neither player can Special Summon Tokens.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aff.name: Tomato in Tomato
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aff.description: Cannot be used as an Xyz Material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of a Plant-Type monster. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Tomato in Tomato" from your hand or Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b02.name: Tongyo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b02.description: This monster captures other fish with its long tongue and sucks the energy out of them.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b52.name: Trap Eater
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b52.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by sending 1 face-up Trap Card your opponent controls to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b53.name: Trap Hole
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b53.description: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons 1 monster with 1000 or more ATK: Target that monster; destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6f.name: Treeborn Frog
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6f.description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and you do not control "Treeborn Frog": You can Special Summon this card. You must control no Spell/Trap Cards to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b86.name: Trial of Nightmare
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b86.description: This fiend passes judgment on enemies that are locked in coffins.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8a.name: Triamid Fortress
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8a.description: All Rock-Type monsters on the field gain 500 DEF. "Triamid" monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by card effects. If this face-up card in the Field Zone is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Triamid" monster in your Graveyard; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Triamid Fortress" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9c.name: Trickstar Black Catbat
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9c.description:
2 "Trickstar" monsters
Each time a monster(s) this card points to is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY, inflict 100 damage to your opponent. Each time your opponent takes damage by a "Trickstar" monster's effect: Face-up monsters they control lose 200 ATK for each monster this card points to, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc1.name: Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc1.description:
1 Tuner + 2+ non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can banish up to 1 card each from your opponent's hand, field, and GY. (The card in the hand is chosen at random.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be0.name: Tuning Gum
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be0.description: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; that face-up monster is treated as a Tuner this turn. You can only use this effect of "Tuning Gum" once per turn. You can only attack with Synchro Monsters during the turn you activate this effect. During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that targets exactly 1 Synchro Monster you control (and no other cards): You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the activation.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a98.name: Three of a Kind
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a98.description: If you control 3 or more monsters with the same name, except Tokens: Target 3 cards your opponent controls; destroy those targets.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9b.name: Threshold Borg
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9b.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 Cyberse monster. All monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aab.name: Thunder Dragons' Hundred Thunders
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aab.description: Target 1 Thunder monster in your GY; Special Summon it, then you can Special Summon as many monsters with that same name as possible from your GY. The monster(s) Special Summoned by this effect are banished when they leave the field, also while they are face-up on the field, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except Thunder monsters. You can only activate 1 "Thunder Dragons' Hundred Thunders" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab4.name: Thunder Unicorn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab4.description:
1 Beast-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. It loses 500 ATK for each monster you control, until the End Phase. During the turn this effect is activated, no other monsters can attack, except this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab9.name: TiSolfachord Beautia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab9.description:

Your opponent cannot activate a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, when your "Solfachord" Pendulum Monster(s) is Pendulum Summoned.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ] 
(Quick Effect): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, or, if you have an even Pendulum Scale in your Pendulum Zone, you can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap your opponent controls; this turn, banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "TiSolfachord Beautia" once per turn. Once per turn, at the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a monster with an equal or higher ATK than the lowest Pendulum Scale in your Pendulum Zone x 300: Destroy that monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac4.name: Time Escaper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac4.description: During either player's turn: You can discard this card, then target 1 Psychic-Type monster you control; banish it until your next Standby Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ada.name: Time Wizard of Tomorrow
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ada.description:
"Time Wizard" + 1 Effect Monster
Once per turn, while you control this Fusion Summoned card: You can toss a coin and call it. Destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict damage equal to quarter the total original ATK of the destroyed face-up monsters. If you called the coin toss right, your opponent takes the damage, if you called it wrong, you take the damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aea.name: Tindangle Intruder
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aea.description:
FLIP: You can add 1 "Tindangle" card from your Deck to your hand.
When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send 1 "Tindangle" card from your Deck to the GY. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field in face-down Defense Position while this card is in your GY: Special Summon this card in face-down Defense Position (this is not optional). You can only use each effect of "Tindangle Intruder" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b09.name: Toon Buster Blader
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b09.description: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster your opponent controls or is in their GY. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0d.name: Toon Dark Magician Girl
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0d.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 monster, while you control "Toon World". If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. Can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster, in which case this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks. Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in either player's GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b12.name: Toon Kingdom
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b12.description: When this card is activated: Banish 3 cards from the top of your Deck, face-down. This card's name becomes "Toon World" while in the Field Zone. Your opponent cannot target Toon monsters you control with card effects. If a Toon monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish 1 card from the top of your Deck, face-down, for each of those monster(s) instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b23.name: Torike
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b23.description: Although a poor defender, this monster's sharp horn gives it an edge when attacking.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b87.name: Trial of the Princesses

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b88.name: Triamid Cruiser
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b88.description: Each time a Rock-Type monster is Normal Summoned, gain 500 LP. If a "Triamid" monster is Normal Summoned: You can draw 1 card, then discard 1 card. If this face-up card in the Field Zone is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Triamid" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Triamid Cruiser" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8e.name: Triamid Master
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8e.description: Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up "Triamid" card you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 Set Card on the field; destroy it. Once per turn, during your opponent's turn: You can target 1 "Triamid" Field Spell Card in your Field Zone; send it to the Graveyard, and if you do, activate 1 "Triamid" Field Spell Card from your Deck with a different name (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8f.name: Triamid Pulse
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8f.description:
Once per turn: You can banish 2 cards from your Graveyard (any combination of Rock-Type monsters or Field Spell Cards), then activate 1 of these effects;
● Target 1 other face-up card on the field; destroy it.
● Target 1 Rock-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Defense Position.
● Target up to 3 Field Spell Cards in your Graveyard; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53baa.name: Trickstar Light Stage
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53baa.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Trickstar" monster from your Deck to your hand. Each time a "Trickstar" monster you control inflicts battle or effect damage to your opponent, inflict 100 damage to them.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb0.name: Trickstar Narkissus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb0.description: If your opponent takes effect damage (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Narkissus" once per turn. Each time your opponent activates a monster effect in their hand or GY, inflict 200 damage to them immediately after it resolves.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53beb.name: Turtle Bird
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53beb.description: An unusual turtle that not only swims at tremendous speeds, but can also sail across the skies.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa1.name: Thunder Dragon Discharge
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa1.description: The activation of your Thunder monsters' effects cannot be negated. Once per turn, if a "Thunder Dragon" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your field: You can target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; banish 1 Thunder monster from your Deck, and if you do, destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53abe.name: Tiger Axe
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53abe.description: A fast and powerful axe-wielding beast-warrior.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ad9.name: Time Wizard
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ad9.description: Once per turn: You can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, destroy all monsters your opponent controls. If you call it wrong, destroy as many monsters you control as possible, and if you do, take damage equal to half the total ATK those destroyed monsters had while face-up on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aec.name: Tindangle Protector
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aec.description: FLIP: You can change up to 3 face-down Defense Position monsters you control to face-up Defense Position, then if all those monsters are "Tindangle" monsters, you can add up to that many "Tindangle" cards from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Tindangle Protector" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53afb.name: Tokkosho of Ghost Destroying
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53afb.description: When the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can select up to 2 monsters in your opponent's Graveyard, and remove them from play.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0e.name: Toon Defense
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0e.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting a face-up Level 4 or lower Toon Monster you control: You can make the attack a direct attack instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b1e.name: Topologic Bomber Dragon

2+ Effect Monsters
If another monster is Special Summoned to a zone a Link Monster points to, while this monster is on the field: Destroy all monsters in the Main Monster Zones, also your other monsters cannot attack for the rest of this turn. After damage calculation, if this card attacked an opponent's monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b28.name: Torpedo Fish
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b28.description: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b38.name: Toy Knight

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b54.name: Trap Hole of Spikes
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b54.description: When an opponent's monster that was Normal or Special Summoned this turn declares an attack: Destroy that attacking monster, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to quarter the original ATK of that monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b95.name: Tribe-Shocking Virus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b95.description: Once per turn: You can banish 1 monster from your hand; destroy all face-up monsters on the field with the same Type as that monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba0.name: Trickstar Corobane

You can only use 1 "Trickstar Corobane" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba1.name: Trickstar Crimson Heart

2 "Trickstar" monsters

You can discard 1 "Trickstar" card; both players draw 1 card, but if your LP was at least 2000 higher than your opponent's when this effect was activated, you draw 2 cards instead. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Crimson Heart" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be3.name: Turbo Booster

At the end of your Battle Phase: You can Tribute this card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls that battled one of your monsters this turn, destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf6.name: Twilight Ninja Nichirin, the Chunin

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a5b.name: The Tricky
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a5b.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a65.name: The Wandering Doomed

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a67.name: The Weather Auroral Canvas
