"The Weather" Effect Monsters in your Main Monster Zones of this card's column and its adjacent columns gain this effect.
● When exactly 1 card is added to one player's hand (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; banish the added card, and if you do, that player draws 1 card.
You can only control 1 "The Weather Auroral Canvas".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a8e.name: Thousand Energy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a8e.description: Increase the original ATK and DEF of all face-up Level 2 Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field by 1000 points until the End Phase. Destroy all Level 2 Normal Monsters on your side of the field during the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a97.name: Three Trolling Trolls
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a97.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Beast-Warrior monster in your GY; this card's Attribute and Level become the same as that monster's, until the end of this turn. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Beast-Warrior monster with the same Attribute and Level as this card from your hand. You can only use each effect of "Three Trolling Trolls" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except Beast-Warrior monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac3.name: Timaeus the Knight of Destiny
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac3.description:
"Legendary Knight Timaeus" + "Legendary Knight Critias" + "Legendary Knight Hermos"
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per battle, if this card battles, during damage calculation (in either player's turn): You can make this card's ATK and DEF become equal to the ATK of the monster on the field with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). When this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 3 "Legendary Knight" monsters from your hand, Deck, and/or Graveyard, ignoring their Summoning conditions.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b32.name: Tour Bus To Forbidden Realms
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b32.description: FLIP: Add 1 Fiend-Type monster from your Deck to your hand, except a DARK or LIGHT monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b39.name: Toy Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b39.description: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell. During the End Phase, if this Set card in your Spell & Trap Zone was destroyed by an opponent's card effect and sent to the GY this turn: Special Summon this card. If this card is Flip Summoned: Destroy Spells and Traps on the field, equal to the number of "Toy Magicians" on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3f.name: Trading Places
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3f.description: If your LP is higher than your opponent's, switch your LP with your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b43.name: Tragoedia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b43.description: When you take battle damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Gains 600 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the same Level the sent monster had in the hand; take control of that face-up monster. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your GY; this card's Level becomes the same as that target's, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b48.name: Trance the Magic Swordsman
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b48.description: A peculiar magician with considerable abilities. Supposedly, he's just returned from a trip to outer space.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6e.name: Tree Otter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6e.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. You must control a Beast-Type monster (other than this card) to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b70.name: Tremendous Fire
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b70.description: Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points and 250 points of damage to your Life Points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b89.name: Triamid Dancer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b89.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Triamid" card in your Graveyard; shuffle it into the Deck, and if you do, all Rock-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF. Once per turn, during your opponent's turn: You can target 1 "Triamid" Field Spell Card in your Field Zone; send it to the Graveyard, and if you do, activate 1 "Triamid" Field Spell Card from your Deck with a different name (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8b.name: Triamid Hunter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8b.description: If a Field Spell Card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon 1 Rock-Type monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) Once per turn, during your opponent's turn: You can target 1 "Triamid" Field Spell Card in your Field Zone; send it to the Graveyard, and if you do, activate 1 "Triamid" Field Spell Card from your Deck with a different name (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b98.name: Tribute to The Doomed
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b98.description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9b.name: Trickstar Bella Madonna
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b9b.description:
2+ "Trickstar" monsters
While this Link Summoned card points to no monsters, it is unaffected by other cards' activated effects. If this card points to no monsters: You can inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each "Trickstar" monster in your GY with a different name. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Bella Madonna" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bba.name: Triggering Wurm
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bba.description: If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material for the Link Summon of a DARK monster: You can Special Summon this card from your GY in Attack Position, to your zone that Link Monster points to, but it cannot be used as Link Material. If this card is destroyed or banished by an effect activated by a Link Monster: Draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Triggering Wurm" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc4.name: Trismagistus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc4.description:
The first time each "Magistus" monster equipped with an Equip Card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Trismagistus" per turn, and only once that turn.
● During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 Spellcaster monster from your hand.
● You can send this face-up card to the GY; Special Summon any number of "Magistus" monsters with different names from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf4.name: Twilight Ninja Jogen
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf4.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If your "Ninja" monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
You can reveal 1 "Ninjitsu Art" card in your hand; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a56.name: The Thing That Hides in the Mud
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a56.description: This monster melts its way underground to attack enemies from below.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a57.name: The Thing in the Crater
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a57.description: When this card is destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Pyro-Type Monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a83.name: Theinen the Great Sphinx
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a83.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by paying 500 Life Points when both "Andro Sphinx" and "Sphinx Teleia" on your side of the field are destroyed at the same time; then you can Special Summon this monster from your hand or Deck. When this card is Special Summoned, by paying 500 Life Points, increase the ATK of this card by 3000 points until the end of the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a91.name: Thousand-Eyes Idol
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a91.description: A wicked entity that controls the hearts of men, its thousand eyes are able to see and expand the negative influences in an individual's soul.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b03.name: Toon Alligator
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b03.description: An alligator monster straight from the cartoons.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b17.name: Toon Rollback
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b17.description: Target 1 Toon monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b1c.name: Toon World
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b1c.description: Activate this card by paying 1000 LP.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b2a.name: Torque Tune Gear
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b2a.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card is treated as a Tuner, it gains 500 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b2d.name: Total Defense Shogun
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b2d.description: This card is changed to Defense Position when it is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned successfully. This card can attack while it is in Defense Position. If this card attacks while in Defense Position, apply the ATK of this card for damage calculation.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b47.name: Trance Archfiend
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b47.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Fiend-Type monster, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. When this card you control is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard: You can target 1 of your banished DARK monsters; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b58.name: Trap Reclamation
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b58.description: Discard 1 card and chain this card to a Trap Card you activated. Whenever that Trap Card is sent to the Graveyard, return it to its owner's hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b5f.name: Traptrix Atrax
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b5f.description: This card is unaffected by the effects of "Hole" Normal Trap Cards. You can activate "Hole" Normal Trap Cards from your hand. The activation and effects of Normal Trap Cards activated on your side of the field cannot be negated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6b.name: Treasure Map
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6b.description: You can only activate this card in response to the activation of an effect that would return this card from the field to the hand. Draw 2 cards from your Deck and discard 1 card from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b97.name: Tribute Doll
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b97.description: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 Level 7 monster from your hand that can be Normal Summoned/Set. It cannot attack this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb6.name: Trident Dragion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb6.description:
1 Dragon-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Dragon-Type monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target up to 2 other cards you control; destroy those targets, and if you do, for each destroyed card, this card gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bbd.name: Triple Star Trion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bbd.description: During the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was sent there this turn as a Tribute for a successful Tribute Summon: You can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc8.name: Troop Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc8.description: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Troop Dragon" from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a58.name: The Third Sarcophagus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a58.description: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a62.name: The Unfriendly Amazon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a62.description: Tribute 1 of your monsters on the field (excluding this monster) during each of your Standby Phases. If you do not, this card is destroyed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a68.name: The Weather Cloudy Canvas
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a68.description:
"The Weather" Effect Monsters in your Main Monster Zones of this card's column and its adjacent columns gain this effect.
● You can banish this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field (except during the Damage Step) (Quick Effect); halve its current ATK for the rest of this turn, but it can attack directly this turn.
You can only control 1 "The Weather Cloudy Canvas".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6a.name: The Weather Painter Cloud
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6a.description: If another face-up "The Weather" card you control is sent to the GY: You can target up to 2 "The Weather" Spells/Traps in your GY; place them face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use this effect of "The Weather Painter Cloud" once per turn. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of the turn after this card was banished from the field to activate a "The Weather" card's effect: You can Special Summon this banished card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a73.name: The Weather Sunny Canvas
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a73.description:
"The Weather" Effect Monsters in your Main Monster Zones of this card's column and its adjacent columns gain this effect.
● You can banish this card, then target 1 monster you control (Quick Effect); Tribute that target, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Weather" monster from your hand or GY, but not with the same name the Tributed monster had on the field.
You can only control 1 "The Weather Sunny Canvas".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a76.name: The White Stone of Legend
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a76.description: If this card is sent to the GY: Add 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a7c.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a7c.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, other cards and effects cannot be activated. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can pay LP so that you only have 100 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid. You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a7d.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a7d.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, other cards and effects cannot be activated. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can pay LP so that you only have 100 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid. You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a85.name: Thermal Genex
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a85.description:
"Genex Controller" + 1 or more non-Tuner FIRE monsters
This card gains 200 ATK for each FIRE monster in your Graveyard. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each "Genex" monster in your Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a87.name: Thestalos the Mega Monarch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a87.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Tribute Summoned monster. If this card is Tribute Summoned: Look at your opponent's hand and discard 1 card from their hand, then, if it was a Monster Card, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 200. If this card was Tribute Summoned by Tributing a FIRE monster, add this additional effect.
● Also, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent after that.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a96.name: Three Thousand Needles
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a96.description: At the end of the Damage Step, if this Defense Position card was attacked by a monster whose ATK is lower than this card's DEF: Destroy the attacking monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53abc.name: Ties of the Brethren
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53abc.description: Pay 2000 LP, then target 1 Level 4 or lower monster you control; for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters, also Special Summon 2 monsters from your Deck, with the same Type, Attribute, and Level as that monster, but with different names from each other and that monster. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af1.name: Tlakalel, His Malevolent Majesty
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af1.description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can destroy any number of face-up monsters your opponent controls whose combined ATK is less than or equal to the original ATK of the monster Tributed to Tribute Summon this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b10.name: Toon Goblin Attack Force
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b10.description: This card cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon Monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase, and its battle position cannot be changed until the End Phase of your next turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b49.name: Trancefamiliar
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b49.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster you control; move that target to another of your Main Monster Zones.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b59.name: Trap Stun
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b59.description: Negate all other Trap effects on the field this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6d.name: Treaty on Uniform Nomenclature
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6d.description:
If you control 2 or more face-up monsters with the same name, except Tokens: Apply this effect, depending on how many you control.
● Exactly 2: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls.
● Exactly 3: Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8c.name: Triamid Kingolem
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b8c.description: All Rock-Type monsters on the field gain 500 ATK. If a "Triamid" monster you control battles, your opponent's cards and effects cannot be activated until the end of the Damage Step. If this face-up card in the Field Zone is sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Triamid" monster from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Triamid Kingolem" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb1.name: Trickstar Nightshade
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb1.description: If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material for the Link Summon of a "Trickstar" monster: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Nightshade" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb4.name: Tricky Spell 4
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb4.description: Send 1 face-up "The Tricky" you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon "Tricky Tokens" (Spellcaster-Type/WIND/Level 5/ATK 2000/DEF 1200) in Defense Position, equal to the number of monsters your opponent controls. "Tricky Tokens" cannot declare an attack.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf1.name: Twilight Cloth
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf1.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; banish any number of "Lightsworn" monsters from your GY, and if you do, that monster gains 200 ATK and DEF for each monster banished by this effect, until the end of this turn. If this card is sent from the Deck to the GY by a "Lightsworn" monster's effect: You can activate this effect; this turn, "Lightsworn" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a90.name: Thousand Needles
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a90.description: When this Defense Position card is attacked and if the DEF of this card is higher than the ATK of the attacking monster, destroy the attacking monster at the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a93.name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a93.description:
"Relinquished" + "Thousand-Eyes Idol"
Other monsters on the field cannot change their battle positions or attack. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9d.name: Throwstone Unit
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9d.description: Tribute 1 Warrior-Type monster on your side of the field to destroy 1 face-up monster on the field whose DEF is equal to or less than the ATK of this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9f.name: Thunder Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a9f.description: You can discard this card; add up to 2 "Thunder Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa6.name: Thunder Dragonduo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa6.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn, if a monster effect is activated in the hand: This card gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can banish 1 card from your GY; add 1 Thunder monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can target 1 of your banished cards; place it on the top or bottom of your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53afe.name: Tomato King
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53afe.description: 2 Level 3 Plant-Type monstersOnce per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; this card's ATK becomes double its original ATK until the end of the opponent's turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0c.name: Toon Dark Magician

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0f.name: Toon Gemini Elf
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b0f.description: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b15.name: Toon Mermaid
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b15.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand), while you control "Toon World". Cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 LP to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. Can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster, in which case this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b2b.name: Torrential Reborn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b2b.description: When a face-up WATER monster you control is destroyed by battle or by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon the monsters destroyed and sent from the field to your Graveyard at that time, then inflict 250 damage to your opponent for each of those Special Summoned monsters. You can only activate 1 "Torrential Reborn" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b56.name: Trap Master
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b56.description: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card on the field and destroy it. If the selected card is Set, pick up and see the card. If it is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If it is a Spell Card, return it to its original position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b82.name: Tri-Wight
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b82.description: Target 3 Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters in your Graveyard; Special Summon them from the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b96.name: Tribute Burial
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b96.description: You cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. Once during this turn, you can conduct a Tribute Summon that requires 2 Tributes by banishing 1 monster from each Graveyard instead of Tributing (it is still treated as a Tribute Summon).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb7.name: Trident Warrior
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb7.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb9.name: Triggered Summon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bb9.description: Activate only when a monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field. Each player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from their hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bda.name: Tuned Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bda.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● This card is treated as a Tuner monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bdd.name: Tuner's High
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bdd.description: Discard 1 monster; Special Summon from your Deck, 1 Tuner monster with the same original Type and Attribute, but 1 Level higher than the discarded monster had in hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be9.name: Turning of the World
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be9.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Ruin, Queen of Oblivion" or "Demise, King of Armageddon" from your hand or Deck. You must also Tribute Ritual Monsters from your hand whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. You can only activate 1 "Turning of the World" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bea.name: Turret Warrior
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bea.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 Warrior-Type monster, and if you do, it gains ATK equal to the Tributed monster's original ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bed.name: Turtle Raccoon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bed.description: A cunning raccoon protected by a solid turtle shell, it attacks with deception.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a59.name: The Transmigration Prophecy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a59.description: Target 2 cards in the GY(s); shuffle those targets into the Deck(s).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a51.name: The Statue of Easter Island
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a51.description: A stone monument from Easter Island that launches laser blasts from its rock-hewn lips.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a81.name: The World Tree
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a81.description:
Each time a face-up Plant-Type monster(s) on the field is destroyed, place 1 Flower Counter on this card. You can remove any number of Flower Counters from this card to activate these effects.
● 1 Counter: Target 1 Plant-Type monster on the field; that target gains 400 ATK and DEF until the end of this turn. (This ATK gain remains even if this card leaves the field.)
● 2 Counters: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.
● 3 Counters: Target 1 Plant-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa7.name: Thunder Dragonhawk
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa7.description: You can discard this card; Special Summon 1 of your "Thunder Dragon" monsters that is banished or in your GY, except "Thunder Dragonhawk". If this card is banished, or sent from the field to the GY: You can shuffle any number of cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw the same number of cards. You can only use 1 "Thunder Dragonhawk" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa9.name: Thunder Dragonmatrix
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa9.description: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then target 1 Thunder monster you control; it gains 500 ATK. If this card is banished, or sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Thunder Dragonmatrix" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Thunder Dragonmatrix" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ade.name: Timegazer Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ade.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You must control no monsters to activate this card. If a Pendulum Monster you control battles, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Unless you have a "Magician" card or "Odd-Eyes" card in your other Pendulum Zone, this card's Pendulum Scale becomes 4.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
Each turn, the first card(s) in your Pendulum Zone that would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, is not destroyed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af4.name: Togex
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af4.description: An agile monster that rolls up to ram its opponents.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b01.name: Tongue Twister
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b01.description: If this card was Tribute Summoned, when it is sent from the field to the Graveyard, draw 2 cards and remove this card from play.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b25.name: Tornado Bird
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b25.description: FLIP: Return 2 Spell or Trap Cards on the field to their owners' hands.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b33.name: Tour Guide From the Underworld
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b33.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 Fiend monster from your hand or Deck, but negate its effects, also it cannot be used as Synchro Material.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b5b.name: Trap of Board Eraser
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b5b.description: You can only activate this card when an effect that inflicts damage to your Life Points is activated (except Battle Damage). Negate the Effect Damage you receive and your opponent then selects 1 card from his/her hand and discards it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b91.name: Triangle Ecstasy Spark
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b91.description: Until the end of this turn, the ATK of all "Harpie Lady Sisters" currently on the field becomes 2700, your opponent cannot activate any Trap Cards, also negate all your opponent's Trap effects on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba4.name: Trickstar Festival
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba4.description: Special Summon 2 "Trickstar Tokens" (Fairy/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). If a "Trickstar" monster(s) you control that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters the turn you activate this card, except "Trickstar" monsters. You can only activate 1 "Trickstar Festival" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba6.name: Trickstar Fusion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba6.description: Fusion Summon 1 "Trickstar" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Trickstar" monster in your GY; add it to your hand, but you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with that name for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bab.name: Trickstar Lilybell
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bab.description: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Lilybell" once per turn. This card can attack directly. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 "Trickstar" monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc2.name: Trishula, Zero Dragon of the Ice Barrier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc2.description:
1 Tuner + 2+ non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can banish up to 3 cards your opponent controls. If this Synchro Summoned card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" from your Extra Deck or GY, its ATK becomes 3300, then halve the ATK of any face-up monsters your opponent currently controls, also negate their effects. You can only use this effect of "Trishula, Zero Dragon of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc5.name: Tristan, Knight of the Underworld
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bc5.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Zombie monster with 0 DEF in your GY; add it to your hand. Gains 300 ATK if you control another Zombie monster(s).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bd3.name: Trust Guardian
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bd3.description: This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster, except for the Synchro Summon of a Level 7 or higher Synchro Monster. Once per turn, that Synchro Monster cannot be destroyed by battle. Each time this effect is applied, that Synchro Monster loses 400 ATK and DEF at the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bec.name: Turtle Oath
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bec.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Crab Turtle". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 8 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a5c.name: The Tripper Mercury
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a5c.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can change all monsters on the field to face-up Attack Position. You can Tribute 3 monsters to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. If Summoned this way, while this card is on the field all monsters your opponent controls lose ATK equal to their original ATK. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a66.name: The Warrior Returning Alive
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a66.description: Target 1 Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6d.name: The Weather Painter Snow
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6d.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can place 1 "The Weather" Spell/Trap from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use this effect of "The Weather Painter Snow" once per turn. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of the turn after this card was banished from the field to activate a "The Weather" card's effect: You can Special Summon this banished card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a72.name: The Weather Snowy Canvas
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a72.description:
"The Weather" Effect Monsters in your Main Monster Zones of this card's column and its adjacent columns gain this effect.
● You can banish this card (Quick Effect); add 1 "The Weather" card from your Deck to your hand, also you cannot add cards from your Deck to your hand for the rest of this turn, except by drawing them.
You can only control 1 "The Weather Snowy Canvas".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a88.name: Thor, Lord of the Aesir
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a88.description:
1 "Nordic Beast" Tuner + 2+ non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn: You can negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls, until the end of this turn. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this face-up card you controlled was destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY this turn: You can banish 1 "Nordic Beast" Tuner from your GY; Special Summon this card. If Summoned this way: Inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a89.name: Thorn of Malice
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a89.description: Equip only to "Black Rose Dragon" or a Plant-Type monster. It gains 600 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If the equipped monster attacks a monster, after damage calculation: The attacked monster loses 600 ATK and DEF. An opponent's monster that battles with the equipped monster cannot be destroyed by that battle.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa5.name: Thunder Dragondark
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aa5.description: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; add 1 "Thunder Dragondark" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is banished, or sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Thunder Dragon" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Thunder Dragondark". You can only use 1 "Thunder Dragondark" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aaa.name: Thunder Dragonroar
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aaa.description: You can discard this card; add to your hand, 1 of your "Thunder Dragon" cards that is banished or in your GY, except "Thunder Dragonroar". If this card is banished, or sent from the field to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Thunder Dragon" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, but return it to the hand during the End Phase. You can only use 1 "Thunder Dragonroar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab1.name: Thunder Nyan Nyan
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ab1.description: If there is a non-LIGHT monster on your side of the field, destroy this face-up card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53abf.name: Tiger Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53abf.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned by Tributing a Dragon monster: You can target up to 2 Set cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone; destroy those targets.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac7.name: Time Maiden
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ac7.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a "Timelord" monster. You can Tribute this card; add 1 "Timelord" monster with 0 ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Timelord" monster with 0 ATK from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You cannot Special Summon other monsters during the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b22.name: Torapart
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b22.description: This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster, except for the Synchro Summon of a Warrior-Type Synchro Monster. If the Synchro Monster that used this card as a Synchro Material Monster attacks, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3a.name: Toy Soldier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3a.description: Once per turn during your Standby Phase: You can Special Summon 1 'Toy Soldier' from your Deck in Attack Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6a.name: Treacherous Trap Hole
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6a.description: If you have no Trap Cards in your Graveyard: Target 2 monsters on the field; destroy those targets.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba9.name: Trickstar Light Arena
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba9.description: If you Link Summon a "Trickstar" monster: You can target 1 "Trickstar" monster in your GY that was used as its material; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but negate its effects. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Light Arena" once per turn. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone; while this card is in the Field Zone, that Set card cannot be activated until the End Phase, and your opponent must activate it during the End Phase or else return it to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bce.name: True King Agnimazud, the Vanisher
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bce.description: If this card is in your hand: You can destroy 2 other monsters in your hand and/or face-up field, including a FIRE monster, and if you do, Special Summon this card, and if you do that, you can banish 1 monster from your opponent's field or GY, if both the destroyed monsters were FIRE. If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can add 1 non-FIRE Wyrm monster from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "True King Agnimazud, the Vanisher" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bde.name: Tuner's Scheme
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bde.description: Activate only when a Synchro Monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field. Take control of that Synchro Monster. Remove it from play when it is destroyed. Destroy this card when that monster is removed from the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bee.name: Turtle Tiger
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bee.description: A tiger encased in a protective shell that attacks with razor-sharp fangs.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a4e.name: The Snake Hair
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a4e.description: A monster with a head of poison snakes. One look from this monster can turn an opponent to stone.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a5a.name: The Traveler and the Burning Abyss
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a5a.description: Target any number of "Burning Abyss" monsters in your Graveyard that were sent there this turn; Special Summon them in Defense Position. You can only activate 1 "The Traveler and the Burning Abyss" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6b.name: The Weather Painter Rain
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a6b.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can place 1 "The Weather" Spell/Trap from your hand face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use this effect of "The Weather Painter Rain" once per turn. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of the turn after this card was banished from the field to activate a "The Weather" card's effect: You can Special Summon this banished card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a8f.name: Thousand Knives
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a8f.description: If you control "Dark Magician": Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a99.name: Three-Headed Geedo
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53a99.description: A three-headed nocturnal monster that is absolutely ruthless when fighting.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aee.name: Tiras, Keeper of Genesis
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53aee.description:
2 Level 5 monsters
This card's effects can only be applied/resolved while it has Xyz Material. This card cannot be destroyed by card effects. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked: Target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target. During each of your End Phases: Detach 1 Xyz Material from this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af8.name: Token Stampede
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53af8.description: All Tokens in Attack Position gain 1000 ATK, also they cannot be destroyed by battle.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3e.name: Tradetoad
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b3e.description: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 Aqua-Type monster to select 1 "Frog" monster in your Graveyard, except "Frog the Jam". Special Summon that monster from your Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b41.name: Tragedy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b41.description: When a face-up Attack Position monster(s) your opponent controls is changed to face-up Defense Position: Destroy all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b44.name: Train Connection
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b44.description: Must be equipped to an EARTH Machine-Type monster, by banishing 2 Level 10 or higher Machine-Type monsters from your Graveyard, and cannot be equipped by other ways. The equipped monster's ATK becomes double its original ATK, also if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. Other monsters you control cannot attack.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b4b.name: Transcicada
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b4b.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Moult Token" (Insect/EARTH/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). While the Token Special Summoned by this effect is on the field, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Insect monsters. You can only use this effect of "Transcicada" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b4d.name: Transforming Sphere
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b4d.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Defense Position monster your opponent controls; discard 1 card and equip that target to this card. (You can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card with this effect.) This card gains the ATK of the equipped monster. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. During the End Phase: The monster equipped to this card by this card's effect is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b55.name: Trap Jammer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b55.description: When your opponent activates a Trap Card during the Battle Phase: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b57.name: Trap Reactor Y FI
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b57.description: Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Trap Card, you can destroy the Trap Card and inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6c.name: Treasure Panda
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b6c.description: You can banish up to 3 Spells/Traps from your GY face-down; Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your Deck, whose Level equals the number of cards banished to activate this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b85.name: Trial and Tribulation
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53b85.description:
You can only activate 1 "Trial and Tribulation" per turn. During the End Phase of the turn this card was activated, apply this effect, depending on the number of monsters you Tributed from the field and from your hand this turn, except Tokens.
● 1: Draw 1 card.
● 2: Add 2 monsters from your Graveyard to your hand.
● 3+: Destroy up to 3 face-up cards on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba3.name: Trickstar Divaridis
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba3.description:
2 Level 3 or lower "Trickstar" monsters
You can only control 1 "Trickstar Divaridis". If this card is Special Summoned: You can inflict 100 damage to your opponent. If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s): Inflict 100 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba7.name: Trickstar Holly Angel
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ba7.description:
2 "Trickstar" monsters
Each time a "Trickstar" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to a zone(s) this card points to, inflict 100 damage to your opponent. "Trickstar" monsters this card points to cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. If your opponent takes damage by a "Trickstar" monster's effect: This card gains ATK equal to the damage they took, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bae.name: Trickstar Magical Laurel
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bae.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 "Trickstar" monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. Once per turn, if the equipped monster inflicts battle or effect damage to your opponent: You can Special Summon 1 "Trickstar" monster from your hand. You can only activate 1 "Trickstar Magical Laurel" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53baf.name: Trickstar Mandrake
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53baf.description: If this card is sent from the hand to the GY: You can Special Summon this card in Defense Position, but banish it when it leaves the field. If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material for the Link Summon of a "Trickstar" monster: You can target 1 monster an opponent's Link Monster points to; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Trickstar Mandrake" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bdb.name: Tuner Capture
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bdb.description: Activate only when your opponent Synchro Summons a monster. Special Summon 1 Tuner Monster used for that Synchro Summon from their Graveyard to your side of the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be1.name: Tuning Magician
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53be1.description: If you have 2 "Magician" cards in your Pendulum Zones, while this card is in your hand or Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Tuning Magician" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Your opponent gains 400 LP, then you take 200 damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf7.name: Twilight Ninja Shingetsu
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf7.description: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target face-up "Ninja" monsters for attacks, except this one. Your opponent cannot target face-up "Ninja" monsters with card effects, except this one. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, or if this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can add 1 "Ninja" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Twilight Ninja Shingetsu". You can only use this effect of "Twilight Ninja Shingetsu" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c2e.name: U.A. Perfect Ace
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c2e.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 "U.A." monster you control to the hand, except "U.A. Perfect Ace". You can only Special Summon "U.A. Perfect Ace" once per turn this way. Once per turn, during your opponent's turn, when a card or effect is activated: You can discard 1 card; negate that activation, and if you do, destroy it (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c33.name: U.A. Signing Deal
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c33.description: Special Summon 1 "U.A." monster from your Deck, but its effects are negated, also it cannot be used as Synchro or Xyz Material for a Summon. Then you lose LP equal to the Level of the monster you Special Summoned by this effect x 300. You can only activate 1 "U.A. Signing Deal" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c66.name: Underground Arachnid
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c66.description:
1 DARK Tuner + 1 non-Tuner Insect-Type monster
If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Once per turn, you can select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and equip it to this card. If this card would be destroyed by battle, you can destroy the monster equipped to this card by its effect instead. (You can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c93.name: Urgent Synthesis
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c93.description: Return 1 "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" from your Graveyard to the Deck. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Koa'ki Meiru" monster from your hand or your Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c94.name: Urgent Tuning
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c94.description: During the Battle Phase: Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster using monsters you control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c9f.name: Ursarctic Polari
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c9f.description: Cannot be Synchro Summoned. Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending 2 monsters you control with a Level difference of 1 to the GY (1 Tuner and 1 non-Tuner). If this card is Special Summoned: You can activate 1 "Ursarctic Big Dipper" directly from your Deck. You can Tribute 1 Level 7 or higher monster; add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 "Ursarctic" monster from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Ursarctic Polari" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca5.name: Utopia Buster
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca5.description: If you control a "Utopia" monster: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the destroyed monster's ATK on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cde.name: Vanity's Call
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cde.description: Activate only as Chain Link 4 or higher. Pay half your Life Points. Negate the activation and effects of all other cards in the same Chain, and destroy them.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce5.name: Vector Pendulum, the Dracoverlord
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce5.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Negate all card effects in your opponent's Pendulum Zones.
----------------------------------------
[ Flavor Text ]
This Overlord overran an entire world with his army of Dracofiends, using his Dragon Alchemy to convert all life into his terrible minions. The source of this power is unidentified, and probably extra-dimensional.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cea.name: Vendread Battlelord
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cea.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Vendread" Ritual Spell. You can banish 1 "Vendread" card from your GY and declare 1 type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); for the rest of this turn, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects of that type. If this Ritual Summoned card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, send 1 "Vendread" monster from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Vendread Battlelord" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d2c.name: Viser Des
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d2c.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; during your third Standby Phase after this effect's activation, destroy that monster. This card cannot be destroyed by battle while the targeted monster is on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d2f.name: Vision HERO Adoration
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d2f.description:
2 "HERO" monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and 1 other "HERO" monster you control; the opponent's targeted monster loses ATK and DEF equal to the ATK of your targeted monster, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d32.name: Vision HERO Increase
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d32.description: If you take battle or effect damage while this card is in your GY: You can place this card from your GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. During the Main Phase, if this card is treated as a Continuous Trap: You can Tribute 1 "HERO" monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Vision HERO" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Vision HERO Increase" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d50.name: Volcanic Scattershot
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d50.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 250 damage to your opponent. If this card is sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Blaze Accelerator" card: You can send 2 "Volcanic Scattershots" from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d51.name: Volcanic Shell
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d51.description: Once per turn: You can pay 500 LP; add 1 "Volcanic Shell" from your Deck to your hand. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d53.name: Volcanic Wall
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d53.description: Once per turn: You can send 3 cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, inflict 250 damage to your opponent for each Pyro-Type monster sent to the Graveyard by this effect. You cannot declare an attack during the turn you activate this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6e.name: Vylon Pentachloro
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6e.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up "Vylon" monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, if the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8d.name: War Rock Mammud
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8d.description: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are Warrior monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If your EARTH Warrior monster battles, after damage calculation: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy it, then all "War Rock" monsters you currently control gain 200 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use this effect of "War Rock Mammud" once per turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dcd.name: Wave-Motion Inferno
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dcd.description: While you have no cards in your hand, face-up "Infernity" monsters you control gain 400 ATK and DEF. You can send this face-up card from the field to the Graveyard to send all cards from your hand to the Graveyard.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dfb.name: White-Horned Dragon
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dfb.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Target up to 5 Spell Cards in your opponent's Graveyard; banish those target(s), and if you do, this card gains 300 ATK for each card banished by this effect.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dff.name: Wicked Dragon with the Ersatz Head
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dff.description: A two-headed dragon with a pair of jaws that can tear an enemy to shreds.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e22.name: Wind-Up Zenmaines
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e22.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
If this face-up card on the field would be destroyed, you can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card instead. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this effect was used this turn: Target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e28.name: Windrose the Elemental Lord
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e28.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 5 WIND monsters in your GY. If this card is Special Summoned: Destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls. You can only use this effect of "Windrose the Elemental Lord" once per turn. If this face-up card leaves the field, skip the Battle Phase of your next turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e35.name: Wing Egg Elf
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e35.description: This fairy in an eggshell uses massive wings to blow back almost any projectile attack.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c06.name: Twin-Shield Defender
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c06.description: When this card you control is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard, you can halve the current ATK of 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, until the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c25.name: U.A. Dreadnought Dunker
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c25.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 "U.A." monster you control to the hand, except "U.A. Dreadnought Dunker". You can only Special Summon "U.A. Dreadnought Dunker" once per turn this way. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c26.name: U.A. Goalkeeper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c26.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 "U.A." monster you control to the hand, except "U.A. Goalkeeper". You can only Special Summon "U.A. Goalkeeper" once per turn this way. Once per turn, during your opponent's turn: You can target 1 "U.A." monster you control; once during this turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c57.name: Umiiruka
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c57.description: Increase the ATK of all WATER monsters by 500 points and decrease their DEF by 400 points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c88.name: Unshaven Angler
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c88.description: When Tribute Summoning a WATER monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd0.name: Vampire Scarlet Scourge
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd0.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 "Vampire" monster in your GY, except "Vampire Scarlet Scourge"; Special Summon it, but it cannot attack this turn. You can only use this effect of "Vampire Scarlet Scourge" once per turn. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card destroyed any monster(s) by battle: You can Special Summon them from the GYs to your field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cdb.name: Van'Dalgyon the Dark Dragon Lord
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cdb.description:
If you negate the activation of an opponent's Spell/Trap Card(s), or opponent's monster effect(s), with a Counter Trap Card (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If Summoned this way, activate these effects and resolve in sequence, depending on the type of card(s) negated by that Counter Trap:
● Spell: Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.
● Trap: Target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.
● Monster: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d04.name: Ventdra, the Empowered Warrior
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d04.description: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Dragon, Warrior, or Spellcaster-Type Normal Monster in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d14.name: Vilepawn Archfiend
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d14.description: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 3, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. As long as this card remains on the field, your opponent cannot attack any Archfiend Monster Card on your side of the field except "Vilepawn Archfiend".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d38.name: Vision HERO Witch Raider
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d38.description: To Tribute Summon this card face-up, you can Tribute Trap(s) you control, as well as monsters. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls. You cannot Special Summon monsters during the turn you activate this effect, except "HERO" monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4e.name: Volcanic Recharge
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4e.description: Return up to 3 "Volcanic" Monster Cards from your Graveyard to your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5e.name: Vulcan Dragni the Cubic King
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5e.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 2 "Cubic" monsters you control to the Graveyard. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled: You can target up to 3 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your Graveyard; send this card to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon them, then you can add 1 "Indiora Doom Volt the Cubic Emperor" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6d.name: Vylon Omega

2 Tuners + 1 non-Tuner "Vylon" monster

During either player's turn, when a monster effect activates: You can send 1 Equip Card equipped to this card to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d79.name: Vylon Vanguard
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d79.description: When this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can draw 1 card for each Equip Card that was equipped to this card.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df0.name: White Night Dragon

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bfb.name: Twin Long Rods 1

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1e.name: Tyrant's Tantrum
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1e.description: Activate by Tributing 2 monsters. Your opponent cannot activate a Spell Card unless they also send 1 Spell Card from the Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c32.name: U.A. Rival Rebounder
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c32.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 "U.A." monster you control to the hand, except "U.A. Rival Rebounder". You can only use this effect of "U.A. Rival Rebounder" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c3c.name: Ultimate Baseball Kid
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c3c.description: This card gains 1000 ATK for each face-up FIRE monster on the field, except this card. You can send 1 other face-up FIRE monster you control to the Graveyard; inflict 250 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c55.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 5 DARK monsters in your GY. If this face-up card leaves the field, skip the Battle Phase of your next turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c68.name: Underworld Fighter Balmung

1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c71.name: Unicorn Beacon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c71.description: Select 1 removed from play Level 5 or lower Beast-Type or Winged Beast-Type monster. Remove from play 1 card in your hand and Special Summon the selected monster in Attack Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c72.name: Unicycular
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c72.description: The third of the brothers, following Tricular and Bicular.

You can only use this effect of "Until Noble Arms are Needed Once Again" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c99.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other Level 7 or higher monster from your hand; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except monsters with a Level. If this card is Special Summoned while you control another "Ursarctic" monster: You can target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish it. You can only use each effect of "Ursarctic Megabilis" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc1.name: Vampire Baby
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc1.description: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle and sent it to the Graveyard this turn: You can Special Summon that monster to your side of the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce9.description:
You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 of your banished "Vendread" monsters, except "Vendread Anima"; Special Summon it, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Zombie monsters. A "Vendread" monster Ritual Summoned using this card on the field gains the following effect. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Vendread Anima" once per turn.
● Banish any monster destroyed by battle with this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf1.description: You can discard 1 card; add 1 "Vendread" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Vendread Nights" once per turn. When your "Vendread" monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can banish 1 "Vendread" monster from your GY; it can attack an opponent's monster again in a row.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d44.name: Void Trap Hole
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d44.description: When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) with 2000 or more ATK: Negate the effects of 1 of those monsters with 2000 or more ATK, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d46.name: Vola-Chemicritter Methydraco

2 Level 8 Gemini monsters

While this card has Xyz Material, monsters your opponent controls cannot target Gemini monsters you control for attacks, also your opponent cannot target Gemini monsters you control with card effects. When a Gemini monster is Normal Summoned: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; make your opponent send 1 card from their hand or field to the Graveyard (their choice).

If this card is Special Summoned in this way, you can destroy cards your opponent controls up to the number of Fairy-Type monsters you Tributed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d76.name: Vylon Stigma
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d76.description: Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can target 1 face-up "Vylon" Equip Card you control and 1 appropriate face-up monster; equip the first target to the second target.

(A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53da3.name: Water Dragon

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df3.name: White Potan

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c0f.name: Two-Pronged Attack
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c0f.description: Select and destroy 2 of your monsters and 1 of your opponent's monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c21.name: Tyrant's Tirade
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c21.description: Tribute 2 monsters. Effects of Effect Monsters that activate in the hand or on the field cannot be activated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c46.name: Ultimate Insect LV5
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c46.description: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV3", while it remains on the field all of your opponent's monsters lose 500 ATK. During your Standby Phase, by sending this face-up card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV7" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c9e.name: Ursarctic Miktanus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c9e.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other Level 7 or higher monster from your hand; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except monsters with a Level. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Ursarctic" monster in your GY, except "Ursarctic Miktanus"; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Ursarctic Miktanus" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca6.name: Utopian Aura
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca6.description: Detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster you control; the face-up Xyz Monsters you currently control cannot be destroyed by card effects until the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb8.name: Valkyrie Funfte
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb8.description: "Valkyrie" monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each of your opponent's banished monsters. If you control a "Valkyrie" monster other than "Valkyrie Funfte": You can send 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Valkyrie Funfte" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cdd.name: Vanguard of the Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cdd.description: You can send 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard; this card gains 300 ATK. When this card you control is sent to your Graveyard by your opponent's card effect: You can target 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d05.name: Verdant Sanctuary
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d05.description: When a face-up Insect monster is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: Its controller can add 1 Insect monster with the same Level as the destroyed monster from their Deck to their hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d0f.name: Victoria
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d0f.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 Dragon-Type monster in your opponent's Graveyard; Special Summon that target to your side of the field. Your opponent cannot target face-up Fairy-Type monsters for attacks, except this one.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d18.name: Violet Witch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d18.description: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 Plant-Type monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d2d.name: Vishwar Randi
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d2d.description: This lady warrior with unquenchable bloodlust serves the forces of darkness.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d43.name: Void Seer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d43.description: Target 1 "Infernoid" monster you control; that target is unaffected by the opponent's card effects this turn. If an "Infernoid" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by a card effect, you can banish this card from your Graveyard instead of destroying 1 of those monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d57.name: Voltic Bicorn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d57.description:
1 Beast-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect), both players send the top 7 cards of their Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d60.name: Vylon Alpha
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d60.description:
1 "Vylon" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; equip that target to this card. While this card is equipped with an Equip Card, it cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap effects, except for Equip Cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d69.name: Vylon Hept
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d69.description: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Vylon" Monster Card you control that is an Equip Card; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position. Banish it when it leaves the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d7b.name: W-Wing Catapult
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d7b.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "V-Tiger Jet" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d7f.name: Wall Shadow
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d7f.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Magical Labyrinth".

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d90.name: War Rock Ordeal
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d90.description: You can only control 1 "War Rock Ordeal". When this card is activated: Place 3 counters on it. When your "War Rock" monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to their GY: You can remove 1 counter from this card, and if you do, draw 1 card. If the last counter has been removed by this effect, send this card to the GY.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53db4.name: Wattcannon
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53db4.description: Once per turn, when a Level 4 or lower Thunder-Type monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the field, inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd2.name: Weathering Soldier
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd2.description: If this card is destroyed by battle or sent to the GY by a card effect: You can add 1 "Fossil Fusion", or 1 card that specifically lists "Fossil Fusion" in its text except "Weathering Soldier", from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Weathering Soldier" once per turn. Once per turn, during your End Phase: This card loses 600 ATK.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd7.name: Wetha
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd7.description: A spirit that controls rain and is capable of summoning hurricanes to blow the enemy away.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dea.name: White Howling
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dea.description: If you control a WATER monster: Target 1 Spell in your opponent's GY; banish it, and if you do, for the rest of this turn negate all Spell effects on your opponent's field.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dfd.name: Whitefish Salvage
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dfd.description: You can target 1 Fish monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Whitefish Salvage" once per turn. If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect and sent to your GY: Take 1 Fish monster from your Deck, and either add it to your hand or Special Summon it.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e02.name: Widespread Dud
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e02.description: Select 2 face-up Attack Position monsters on the field. When any of the selected monsters are removed from the field, destroy this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the selected monster(s).

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e14.name: Wind-Up Dog
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e14.description: During your Main Phase: You can increase this card's Level by 2 and ATK by 600, until the End Phase. This effect can be used only once while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bfd.name: Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bfd.description: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard; equip this card to a monster. It loses 500 ATK, but it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c0d.name: Two-Man Cell Battle
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c0d.description: During each player's End Phase, the turn player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 Normal Monster from their hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c54.name: Umbral Soul
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c54.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-DARK monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c58.name: Uminotaurus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c58.description: If a Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c5a.name: Unauthorized Bootup Device
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c5a.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. If this card is destroyed and sent to the GY while equipped to a monster: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Unauthorized Bootup Device" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c77.name: Unifrog
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c77.description: This card can attack your opponent directly. When this card successfully attacks directly, if you control a "Frog" monster other than "Frog the Jam" or "Unifrog", you can destroy 1 Spell or Trap your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c81.name: Unity
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c81.description: Select 1 monster on your side of the field. The DEF of the selected monster becomes equal to the combined original DEF of all face-up monsters on your side of the field, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c8f.name: Upstart Golden Ninja
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c8f.description: Once per turn: You can send 1 Trap from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Ninja" monster from your Deck in face-up Defense Position or face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c9c.name: Ursarctic Mikbilis
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c9c.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other Level 7 or higher monster from your hand; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except monsters with a Level. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Ursarctic" monster from your hand, except "Ursarctic Mikbilis". You can only use each effect of "Ursarctic Mikbilis" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca3.name: Ushi Oni
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca3.description: A bull fiend restored by the dark arts, this monster appears out of a jar.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cac.name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cac.description:
"VW-Tiger Catapult" + "XYZ-Dragon Cannon"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish that target. When this card declares an attack on an opponent's monster: You can target the attack target; change that attack target's battle position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53caf.name: Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53caf.description: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Level 2 or lower Beast monster in your GY, except "Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest"; Special Summon it in Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cca.name: Vampire Hunter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cca.description: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a DARK monster: Destroy that monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cda.name: Vampiric Orchis
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cda.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Des Dendle" from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce3.name: Variable Form
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce3.description:
Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 2 face-up "Inzektor" monsters you control; equip one to the other.
● Target 1 "Inzektor" monster you control that is an Equip Card; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ced.name: Vendread Core
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ced.description:
If this card is in your GY: You can banish 1 other Zombie monster from your GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. A "Vendread" monster Ritual Summoned using this card on the field gains the following effect. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Vendread Core" once per turn.
● Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf4.name: Vendread Revenants
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf4.description:
If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card (by battle or card effect) and sent to your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. A "Vendread" monster Ritual Summoned using this card on the field gains this effect. You can only use the preceding effect of "Vendread Revenants" once per turn.
● Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; banish it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d33.name: Vision HERO Minimum Ray
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d33.description: If you take battle or effect damage while this card is in your GY: You can place this card from your GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. During the Main Phase, if this card is treated as a Continuous Trap: You can Tribute 1 "HERO" monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone: You can destroy 1 Level 4 or lower monster your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "Vision HERO Minimum Ray" once per turn.
