60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4a.name: Volcanic Eruption
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4a.description: During your End Phase, if you control "Jurassic World": Destroy all cards on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4c.name: Volcanic Queen
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4c.description:
This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned from your hand to your opponent's side of the field by Tributing 1 monster your opponent controls. If you Special Summon this card, you cannot Normal Summon or Set this turn.
Once per turn, you can send 1 other card you control to the Graveyard to inflict 500 damage to your opponent. During your End Phase, either Tribute 1 other monster or take 500 damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5f.name: Vulcan the Divine
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5f.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: Target 1 face-up card you control and 1 face-up card your opponent controls; return those targets to the hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot activate cards, or the effects of cards, with the same name as those returned to the hand by this effect. You can only use this effect of "Vulcan the Divine" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6f.name: Vylon Polytope
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6f.description: Target any number of "Vylon" Monster Cards you control that are Equip Cards; Special Summon them in face-up Defense Position. Banish them when they leave the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d71.name: Vylon Segment
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d71.description: Equip only to a "Vylon" monster. It cannot be targeted by the opponent's monster effects or Trap effects. If this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Vylon" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d7a.name: W Nebula Meteorite
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d7a.description: Change all face-down monsters on the field to face-up Defense Position. During the End Phase this turn, change all face-up LIGHT Reptile-Type monsters you control to face-down Defense Position, then draw 1 card for each. After that, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Reptile-Type monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d86.name: Wandering Mummy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d86.description: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. After you use this effect, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters in your Main Monster Zones, then return them in face-down Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8e.name: War Rock Meteoragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8e.description: Cannot be destroyed by an opponent's card effects. When an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's monster: You can negate that opponent's monster's effects this turn, as well as the activated effects and effects on the field of monsters with its same original name. Once per turn, during a Battle Phase in which your EARTH Warrior monster battles (Quick Effect): You can make all "War Rock" monsters you currently control gain 200 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn, also this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d91.name: War Rock Orpis
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d91.description: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are Warrior monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If your EARTH Warrior monster battles, after damage calculation: You can send 1 EARTH Warrior monster from your Deck to the GY, except "War Rock Orpis", then all "War Rock" monsters you currently control gain 200 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use this effect of "War Rock Orpis" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d99.name: Warrior Dai Grepher
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d99.description: The warrior who can manipulate dragons. Nobody knows his mysterious past.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc0.name: Wattkeeper
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc0.description: Select 1 Level 4 or lower "Watt" monster in your Graveyard. Special Summon that monster from the Graveyard. Destroy it during the End Phase.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd0.name: Weather Control
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd0.description: This creature controls weather and is often the cause of mountain storms.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd8.name: Wetlands
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd8.description: All Aqua-Type/WATER/Level 2 or lower monsters gain 1200 ATK.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df5.name: White Rose Dragon
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df5.description:
When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Rose Dragon" monster from your hand or GY, except "White Rose Dragon". You can only use each of these effects of "White Rose Dragon" once per turn:
● If you control a Dragon Tuner or Plant Tuner: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can send 1 Level 4 or higher Plant monster from your Deck to the GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c14.name: Type Zero Magic Crusher
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c14.description: Discard 1 Spell Card from your hand to inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1c.name: Tyrant Red Dragon Archfiend
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1c.description:
2 Tuners + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can only use each of these effects of "Tyrant Red Dragon Archfiend" once per turn.
● During your Main Phase 1: You can destroy all other cards on the field, also, for the rest of this turn, other monsters you control cannot attack.
● During either player's Battle Phase, when a Spell/Trap Card is activated: You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, and if you do that, this card gains 500 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c24.name: U.A. Blockbacker
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c24.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 "U.A." monster you control to the hand, except "U.A. Blockbacker". You can only Special Summon "U.A. Blockbacker" once per turn this way. Once per turn, when your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can change their battle positions, and if you do, negate their effects.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c2c.name: U.A. Mighty Slugger
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c2c.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 "U.A." monster you control to the hand, except "U.A. Mighty Slugger". You can only Special Summon "U.A. Mighty Slugger" once per turn this way. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c38.name: UFOroid Fighter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c38.description:
"UFOroid" + 1 Warrior-Type monster
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. The original ATK and DEF of this card become equal to the combined original ATK of the 2 Fusion Material Monsters you used for the Fusion Summon of this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c3b.name: Ultimate Axon Kicker
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c3b.description:
1 Psychic-Type Synchro Monster + 1 Psychic-Type monster
This monster can only be Special Summoned by Fusion Summon (from the Extra Deck). This card cannot be destroyed by card effects. During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, you gain Life Points equal to the destroyed monster's ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c4c.name: Ultimate Tyranno
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c4c.description: This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. During your Battle Phase, if you control an "Ultimate Tyranno" that can attack, monsters other than "Ultimate Tyranno" cannot attack.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c80.name: United We Stand
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c80.description: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK/DEF for each face-up monster you control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c90.name: Uraby
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c90.description: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c97.name: Ursarctic Departure
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c97.description: Discard 1 card; add 2 "Ursarctic" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If you would Tribute a monster(s) to activate an "Ursarctic" monster's effect, except the turn this card was sent to the GY, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Ursarctic Departure" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbb.name: Valkyrie Vierte
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbb.description: During your Main Phase: You can excavate the top cards of your Deck equal to the number of other "Valkyrie" monsters you control, and if you do, add 1 excavated Normal Spell/Trap to your hand, also send the remaining cards to the GY. Otherwise, shuffle all excavated cards into the Deck. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Valkyrie" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Valkyrie Vierte" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbe.name: Valkyrie's Embrace
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbe.description: If all monsters you control are "Valkyrie" monsters: Target 1 Attack Position "Valkyrie" monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change your monster to Defense Position, and if you do, banish that opponent's monster. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate this card, except "Valkyrie" monsters. You can only activate 1 "Valkyrie's Embrace" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc0.name: Vampire Awakening
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc0.description: Special Summon 1 "Vampire" monster from your Deck, but destroy it during the End Phase of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Vampire Awakening" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc3.name: Vampire Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc3.description: When this Tribute Summoned card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc7.name: Vampire Genesis
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc7.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Vampire Lord" you control, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can discard 1 Zombie-Type monster to the Graveyard, then target 1 Zombie-Type monster in your Graveyard with a Level less than the discarded Zombie-Type monster's; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ccf.name: Vampire Retainer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ccf.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can pay 500 LP; add 1 "Vampire" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 "Vampire" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Vampire Retainer" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d08.name: Versago the Destroyer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d08.description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster. When you do this, the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be the correct one(s).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d0b.name: Vic Viper T301
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d0b.description: When an attack is declared involving your face-up monster and an opponent's monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Vic Viper T301" once per turn. Other LIGHT Machine monsters you control gain 1200 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d19.name: Viper's Rebirth
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d19.description: Activate only if all monsters in your Graveyard are Reptile-Type. Select 1 non-Tuner monster in your Graveyard. Special Summon it. Destroy it during the End Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d39.name: Vision Release
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d39.description: Target 1 "Vision HERO" Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Vision HERO" monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d49.name: Volcanic Doomfire
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d49.description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by sending a face-up "Tri-Blaze Accelerator" you control to the Graveyard. During your opponent's Battle Phase, your opponent must attack this monster with any Attack Position monsters they control. When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard, destroy all monsters your opponent controls and inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed by this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4d.name: Volcanic Rat
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4d.description: This mutated mouse dwells in the core of active volcanoes. No amount of heat is too much for it to bear.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4f.name: Volcanic Rocket
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d4f.description: When this card is Summoned: You can add 1 "Blaze Accelerator" card from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d62.name: Vylon Component
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d62.description: Equip only to a "Vylon" monster. If it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent. If this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Vylon" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d84.name: Wall of Thorns
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d84.description: When a Plant-Type monster you control is targeted for an attack: Destroy all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8b.name: War Rock Gactos
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8b.description: If an EARTH Warrior monster is Normal Summoned to your field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is sent from your Monster Zone to your GY by an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher "War Rock" monster from your hand or Deck. You can only use this effect of "War Rock Gactos" once per turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53db5.name: Wattcastle
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53db5.description: Any monster that attacks a "Watt" monster loses 1000 ATK after damage calculation.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc3.name: Wattkinetic Puppeteer
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc3.description: (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; move that target to another of their Main Monster Zones.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc9.name: Wattsquirrel
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc9.description: This card can attack twice during each Battle Phase. If this card battles, negate the effects of the monster it battled, after damage calculation (including in the Graveyard).

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dcf.name: Weapon Change
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dcf.description: Once during each of your Standby Phases: You can pay 700 Life Points, then target 1 Warrior or Machine-Type monster you control; switch the current ATK and DEF of that target until the end of your opponent's next turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53ddd.name: Whirlwind Weasel
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53ddd.description: FLIP: Your opponent cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dde.name: Whirlwind of Gusto
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dde.description: If you control no monsters: Target 2 "Gusto" monsters in your Graveyard; shuffle both targets into the Deck, then Special Summon 1 "Gusto" monster with 1000 or less DEF from your Deck.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53de4.name: White Dragon Ninja
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53de4.description: Cannot be Special Summoned, except with a "Ninjitsu Art" card's effect. Spells/Traps you control cannot be destroyed by card effects.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df8.name: White Tiger Summoner
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df8.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand. All monsters you control gain 100 ATK and DEF.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e13.name: Wind-Up Carrier Zenmaity
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e13.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Wind-Up" monster from your hand or Deck. When a face-up "Wind-Up" monster on the field is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target that monster; return that target to the hand.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e15.name: Wind-Up Factory
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e15.description: Once per turn, if an effect of a "Wind-Up" monster is activated (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 Level 4 or lower "Wind-Up" monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e1a.name: Wind-Up Knight
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e1a.description: When a face-up "Wind-Up" monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can negate the attack. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bfc.name: Twin Photon Lizard
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bfc.description:
2 "Photon" monsters
You can Tribute this card; Special Summon, from your Graveyard, both of the Fusion Material Monsters used for the Fusion Summon of this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c31.name: U.A. Powered Jersey
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c31.description: Equip only to a "U.A." monster. It gains 1000 ATK and DEF, also if it battles an opponent's monster, any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is doubled. If the equipped monster destroys a monster by its attack: It can make a second attack during this Battle Phase. During your Standby Phase: Banish the equipped monster. If this card is sent to the Graveyard because the equipped monster returned to the hand: You can return this card to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c4e.name: Ultra Evolution Pill
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c4e.description: Tribute 1 Reptile monster; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c6b.name: Unexpected Dai
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c6b.description: If you control no monsters: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from the Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c6e.name: Uni-Song Tuning
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c6e.description: Target 1 Tuner in either GY and 1 face-up monster on the field; banish that Tuner in the GY, then, until the end of this turn, the Level of the targeted monster on the field becomes the Level of the banished Tuner, also it is treated as a Tuner. You can only activate 1 "Uni-Song Tuning" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c7d.name: Union Scramble
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c7d.description: Target up to 3 of your banished LIGHT Machine-Type Normal Monsters and/or LIGHT Machine-Type Union monsters; Special Summon them. During either player's turn, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 of your banished LIGHT Machine-Type Normal Monsters or LIGHT Machine-Type Union monsters; return it to the hand. You can only activate 1 "Union Scramble" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c7e.name: United Front
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c7e.description: When a Trap Card is activated while you control 2 or more face-up monsters with the same Level: Negate the activation and destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c91.name: Urgent Ritual Art
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c91.description: If you control no Ritual Monsters: Banish 1 Ritual Spell from your hand or GY; this card's effect becomes that card's effect that Ritual Summons a monster when the card is activated.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca1.name: Ursarctic Septentrion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca1.description: Cannot be Synchro Summoned. Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending 2 monsters you control with a Level difference of 7 to the GY (1 Level 8 or higher Tuner and 1 non-Tuner Synchro Monster). Negate the effects of face-up monsters without a Level that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Ursarctic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ursarctic Septentrion" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb2.name: Valkyrian Knight
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb2.description: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target face-up Warrior-Type monsters for attacks, except "Valkyrian Knight". When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can banish 1 Warrior-Type monster and this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Level 5 or higher Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb6.name: Valkyrie Erda
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb6.description: You can only control 1 "Valkyrie Erda". While you control this card, Special Summoned by the effect of a "Valkyrie" card, all face-up monsters your opponent controls lose 1000 ATK. Any card destroyed by battle or card effect that would be sent to your opponent's GY is banished instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cba.name: Valkyrie Sigrun
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cba.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap you control; send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower "Valkyrie" monster from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Valkyrie Sigrun" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbd.name: Valkyrie of the Nordic Ascendant
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbd.description:
(This card is not treated as a "Valkyrie" card.)
When this card is Normal Summoned, if your opponent controls a monster and you control no other cards: You can banish 2 "Nordic" monsters from your hand; Special Summon 2 "Einherjar Tokens" (Warrior/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) in Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbf.name: Valkyrion the Magna Warrior
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbf.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" from your hand and/or field. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" in your Graveyard; Special Summon them.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc4.name: Vampire Duke
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc4.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 DARK "Vampire" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position. When this card is Special Summoned: You can declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Vampire Duke" once per turn. This card cannot be used as an Xyz Material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of a DARK monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce8.name: Veil of Darkness
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce8.description: During your Draw Phase, if you draw a DARK monster(s): You can reveal any number of them; send them to the GY, then you can draw 1 more card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf5.name: Vendread Revolution
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf5.description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 "Vendread" monster and 1 Ritual Spell in your GY; Special Summon that monster in Defense Position, and if you do, add that Ritual Spell to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 5 of your banished Zombie monsters; shuffle them into your Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Vendread Revolution" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf9.name: Vengeful Shinobi
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf9.description: When this face-up Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cfd.name: Venom Boa
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cfd.description: Once per turn, you can place 2 Venom Counters on 1 monster your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d09.name: Vertical Landing
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d09.description: Tribute any number of WIND monsters, except Tokens; Special Summon an equal number of "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). You can only activate 1 "Vertical Landing" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d11.name: Victory Viper XX03
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d11.description:
If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Activate 1 of these effects.
● This card gains 400 ATK.
● Target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.
● Special Summon 1 "Option Token". Its Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF are always the same as this card, but it leaves the field if this card is no longer face-up on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d12.name: Vijam the Cubic Seed
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d12.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled an opponent's monster: You can place this card face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell Card, and if you do, place 1 Cubic Counter on that opponent's monster. (Monsters with a Cubic Counter cannot attack, also negate their effects.) If this card is treated as a Continuous Spell Card by this effect, during your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your Spell & Trap Zone.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d35.name: Vision HERO Poisoner
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d35.description: If you take battle or effect damage while this card is in your GY: You can place this card from your GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. During the Main Phase, if this card is treated as a Continuous Trap: You can Tribute 1 "HERO" monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone: You can halve the ATK of 1 face-up monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Vision HERO Poisoner" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d61.name: Vylon Charger
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d61.description: All face-up LIGHT monsters you control gain 300 ATK for each Equip Card equipped to this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d74.name: Vylon Sphere
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d74.description: If this card is sent from the Monster Card Zone to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 Life Points to target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. You can send this Equip Card to the Graveyard to target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; equip that target to the monster this card was equipped to.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8a.name: War Rock Fortia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8a.description: If your EARTH Warrior monster battles, after damage calculation: You can add 1 "War Rock" card from your Deck to your hand, except "War Rock Fortia", then all "War Rock" monsters you currently control gain 200 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn. If this card is sent from your Monster Zone to your GY by an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher "War Rock" monster from your hand or Deck. You can only use each effect of "War Rock Fortia" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d97.name: Warm Worm
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d97.description: If this card is destroyed, send the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53da5.name: Water Element
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53da5.description: A sea-dwelling spirit that takes away sight by clouding the area in fog.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53de0.name: White Aura Dolphin
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53de0.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; its ATK becomes half its original ATK until the end of this turn. If this card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card (by battle or card effect) and sent to your GY: You can banish 1 other WATER monster from your GY; Special Summon this card, and if you do, it is treated as a Tuner.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df2.name: White Ninja
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df2.description: FLIP: Target 1 Defense Position monster on the field; destroy that target.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e0e.name: Wilmee
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e0e.description: A rabid rabbit that shears through opposition with its sharp skewers.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e0f.name: Wind Effigy
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e0f.description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a WIND Normal Monster.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e21.name: Wind-Up Warrior
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e21.description: You can target 1 face-up "Wind-Up" monster you control; increase its Level by 1 and its ATK by 600, until the End Phase. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e34.name: Wing Eagle
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e34.description: This flying creature never misses its intended target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c05.name: Twin-Headed Wolf
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c05.description: While you control another Fiend monster, negate the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c0b.name: Two Thousand Needles
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c0b.description: When this Defense Position card is attacked and the ATK of the attacking monster is lower than the DEF of this card, destroy the attacking monster at the end of the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1a.name: Tyrant Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1a.description: During your Battle Phase, if your opponent controls a monster after this card's first attack, this card can make a second attack. Negate any Trap effects that target this card on the field, and if you do, destroy that Trap. This card cannot be Special Summoned from the GY, unless you Tribute 1 Dragon monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c3a.name: Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c3a.description:
"Ancient Gear Golem" + 2 "Ancient Gear" monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this card is destroyed: You can target 1 "Ancient Gear Golem" in your GY; Special Summon it, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c50.name: Umbral Horror Ghost
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c50.description: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card and 1 Level 4 or lower Fiend-Type monster from your hand. You cannot Normal Summon/Set during the turn you activate this effect. You can only use this effect of "Umbral Horror Ghost" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c53.name: Umbral Horror Will o' the Wisp
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c53.description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Umbral Horror" monster you control or in your Graveyard, except this card; this card's Level becomes the current Level of that monster. When this Attack Position card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, and was in face-up Attack Position at the start of the Damage Step: Destroy the monster that destroyed this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c6c.name: Unformed Void
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c6c.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn, during your opponent's Main Phase: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; this card gains ATK and DEF equal to the total ATK of all face-up Xyz Monsters your opponent currently controls (this is a Quick Effect).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c8c.name: Update Jammer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c8c.description:
2 Level 2 or higher Cyberse monsters
Once per battle, during damage calculation, if your Cyberse monster battles (Quick Effect): You can activate this effect; negate all other card effects on the field until the end of the Damage Step, damage calculation for this battle uses each monster's original ATK/DEF, also if an opponent's monster is destroyed by this battle and sent to the GY, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material: That Link Monster can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca0.name: Ursarctic Quint Charge
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca0.description:
Once per turn: You can pay 700 LP, then activate 1 of the following effects;
● Add 1 "Ursarctic" monster from your GY to your hand.
● Tribute 2 "Ursarctic" monsters (even if face-down), and if you do, Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Ursarctic" monster with a Level equal to the difference in Levels of those monsters, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
When your "Ursarctic" Synchro Monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack: You can activate this effect; your opponent must shuffle cards into the Deck so the total number of cards in their field, hand, and GY is 7.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca7.name: Utopic Onomatopoeia
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca7.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Zubaba", "Gagaga", "Gogogo", and "Dododo" card.)
During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon up to 1 each "Zubaba", "Gagaga", "Gogogo", and/or "Dododo" monster(s) from your hand in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Xyz Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Utopic Onomatopoeia" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cad.name: Vahram, the Magistus Divinity Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cad.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
While this card is an Equip Card, the equipped monster cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Spell/Trap effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Vahram, the Magistus Divinity Dragon" once per turn. If this Synchro Summoned card is destroyed: You can destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. At the start of the Damage Step, if the monster this card is equipped to battles an opponent's monster: You can destroy that opponent's monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb9.name: Valkyrie Sechste
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb9.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Valkyrie" monster from your Deck, except "Valkyrie Sechste". During your Main Phase: You can send the top 2 cards of your opponent's Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Valkyrie Sechste" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd9.name: Vampiric Koala
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd9.description: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by battle with a monster: Gain LP equal to the battle damage inflicted.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce6.name: Vector Scare Archfiend
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce6.description:
2+ Cyberse monsters
When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Tribute 1 monster that this card points to; Special Summon that destroyed monster to any zone this card points to. If you Special Summon to your opponent's field by this effect, this card can make a second attack during this Battle Phase (although your opponent gains control of that Special Summoned monster).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf8.name: Vengeful Servant
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf8.description: When control of the equipped monster changes, inflict damage equal to half its original ATK to its new controller.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cfb.name: Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cfb.description: Cannot be Special Summoned by another Effect Monster's effect. This card is unaffected by "Venom Swamp". This card gains 500 ATK for each Reptile-Type monster in your Graveyard. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can banish 1 other Reptile-Type monster from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cfe.name: Venom Burn
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cfe.description: Select 1 monster with a Venom Counter(s). Remove all Venom Counters from that card, and inflict 350 damage to your opponent for each Venom Counter removed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d17.name: Violet Crystal
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d17.description:
(This card is not treated as a "Crystal" card.)
Equip only to a Zombie monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d2a.name: Virus Cannon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d2a.description: Tribute any number of monsters, except Tokens; your opponent sends an equal number of Spells from their Deck to the GY (or all their Spells, if lower than the number of Tributes).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d30.name: Vision HERO Faris
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d30.description: You can discard 1 other "HERO" monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Vision HERO" monster from your Deck, except "Vision HERO Faris", in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "HERO" monsters. You can only use each effect of "Vision HERO Faris" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d45.name: Void Vanishment
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d45.description: You can discard 1 card; add 1 "Void" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand, except "Void Vanishment" or "Null and Void", also you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Infernoid" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Void Vanishment" once per turn. If an "Infernoid" monster you control battles an opponent's monster, after damage calculation: You can send this card to the Graveyard; banish those monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d47.name: Volcanic Blaster
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d47.description: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, you can place 1 "Volcanic" monster in your Deck on top of your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5c.name: Vortex the Whirlwind
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5c.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Winged Beast-Type monsters
When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Winged Beast-Type monster from your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d65.name: Vylon Disigma
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d65.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 face-up Attack Position Effect Monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a monster whose Attribute is the same as a card equipped by this effect: Destroy that monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d67.name: Vylon Epsilon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d67.description:
1 LIGHT Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Equip Cards equipped to this card cannot be targeted by cards or effects. Once per turn: You can send 1 Equip Card equipped to this card to the Graveyard to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53db1.name: Wattbetta
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53db1.description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent by a direct attack, your opponent discards 1 card of their choice.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc1.name: Wattkey
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc1.description: Face-up "Watt" monsters you control can attack your opponent directly this turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc4.name: Wattkiwi
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc4.description: "Watt" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle while they are attacking.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc6.name: Wattmole
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dc6.description: This card can attack twice during each Battle Phase. If this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, you can destroy that monster immediately with this card's effect without flipping it face-up or applying damage calculation.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dcb.name: Wattwoodpecker
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dcb.description: This card can attack twice during each Battle Phase. Any monster that battles with this card cannot change its battle position.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd4.name: Weed Out
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd4.description: Pay 500 Life Points. Destroy all face-up Attack Position Level 3 monsters.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53de3.name: White Dolphin
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53de3.description: A white dolphin with a horn that summons huge tidal waves.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e25.name: Winda, Priestess of Gusto
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e25.description: When this card is destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Gusto" Tuner monster from your Deck.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e26.name: Windaar, Sage of Gusto
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e26.description: When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Level 3 or lower "Gusto" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bfa.name: Twin Long Rods #2
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bfa.description: An amphibious creature with two whip-like tails.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c00.name: Twin Vortex
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c00.description: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control and 1 monster your opponent controls: destroy both targets.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c35.name: U.A. Turnover Tactics
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c35.description: If you control 2 or more "U.A." monsters with different names: Shuffle as many monsters on the field as possible into the Deck, then Special Summon "U.A." monsters from your Deck that have different names from each other, up to the number of cards shuffled into your Main Deck, but those monsters cannot attack this turn. Then your opponent can Special Summon monsters from their Deck, up to the number of cards shuffled into their Main Deck. You can only activate 1 "U.A. Turnover Tactics" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c43.name: Ultimate Fire Formation - Sinto
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c43.description: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated, while you control a "Fire Fist" monster and a "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only activate 1 "Ultimate Fire Formation - Sinto" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c52.name: Umbral Horror Unform
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c52.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard while attacking a monster: You can Special Summon 2 "Umbral Horror" monsters from your Deck. You can only use the effect of "Umbral Horror Unform" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c67.name: Underworld Egg Clutch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c67.description: When a face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster you control is banished: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c8b.name: Unwavering Bond
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c8b.description: When your opponent activates a Pendulum Monster's effect, or an effect of a card in the Pendulum Zone: Negate the activation, and if you do, banish that card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cab.name: VW-Tiger Catapult
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cab.description:
"V-Tiger Jet" + "W-Wing Catapult"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) You can discard 1 card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb0.name: Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb0.description: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb5.name: Valkyrie Dritte
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb5.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Valkyrie" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Valkyrie Dritte". You can only use this effect of "Valkyrie Dritte" once per turn. Gains 200 ATK for each of your opponent's banished monsters.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc8.name: Vampire Grace
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc8.description: When a Level 5 or higher Zombie-Type monster(s) is Special Summoned to your side of the field by the effect of a Zombie-Type monster while this card is in your Graveyard: You can pay 2000 LP; Special Summon this card from your Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Vampire Grace" once per turn. Once per turn: You can declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ccd.name: Vampire Lord
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ccd.description: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the GY. Once per turn, during your next Standby Phase after this card in your possession was destroyed and sent to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd1.name: Vampire Sorcerer
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd1.description: If this card in your possession is sent to your GY by your opponent's card: You can add 1 DARK "Vampire" monster or 1 "Vampire" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; 1 DARK "Vampire" monster you Normal Summon this turn can be Summoned without Tributing.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf6.name: Vendread Striges
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf6.description:
If this card is sent to the GY: You can reveal 1 "Vendread" card in your hand; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. A "Vendread" monster Ritual Summoned using this card on the field gains the following effect. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Vendread Striges" once per turn.
● After damage calculation, if this card battled an opponent's monster: You can draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d58.name: Voltic Kong
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d58.description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Send 1 card from the top of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard for each face-up LIGHT monster you control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d64.name: Vylon Delta
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d64.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner LIGHT monsters
If this card is in face-up Defense Position during your End Phase, you can add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8f.name: War Rock Mountain
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d8f.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "War Rock" monster from your Deck to your hand. At the start of the Battle Phase, if you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are Warrior monsters: You can Special Summon 1 "War Rock" monster from your hand with a different name than the cards you control. If your Warrior monster would be destroyed by battle, you can send this card to the GY instead. You can only activate 1 "War Rock Mountain" per turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53da9.name: Water Magician
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53da9.description: This monster swamps an opponent with an almost endless supply of water.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df7.name: White Stingray
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53df7.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 WATER monster. You can only Special Summon "White Stingray" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can treat it as a Tuner this turn. You can only use this effect of "White Stingray" once per turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dfe.name: Wicked Acolyte Chilam Sabak
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dfe.description: If you have 5 or more cards in your hand, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card in Defense Position, and if you do, it is treated as a Tuner. You can only use this effect of "Wicked Acolyte Chilam Sabak" once per turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e00.name: Wicked Rebirth
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e00.description: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Synchro Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Attack Position. Its effects are negated, also it cannot declare an attack this turn. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e08.name: Wightprince
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e08.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can send 1"Skull Servant" and 1 "The Lady in Wight" from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard. You can banish 2 "Skull Servants" and this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "King of the Skull Servants" from your Deck. This card's name becomes "Skull Servant" while it is in the Graveyard.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e1f.name: Wind-Up Snail
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e1f.description: During your Main Phase: You can target 1 Set card on the field; return that target to the hand. This effect can be used only once while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c11.name: Tyhone
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c11.description: Capable of firing cannonballs from its mouth for long-range attacks, this creature is particularly effective in mountain battles.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c23.name: Tytannial, Princess of Camellias
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c23.description: When a card or effect is activated that targets a card(s) on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 face-up Plant monster; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c30.name: U.A. Playmaker
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c30.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 "U.A." monster you control to the hand, except "U.A. Playmaker". You can only Special Summon "U.A. Playmaker" once per turn this way. When another "U.A." monster you control declares an attack: You can have this card lose exactly 800 ATK, and if it does, your attacking monster gains 800 ATK.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c42.name: Ultimate Fire Formation - Seito
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c42.description: Banish 7 "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Cards from your Graveyard; Special Summon as many "Fire Fist" monsters as possible from your Graveyard, then you can Set "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Cards directly from your Deck, except "Ultimate Fire Formation - Seito", up to the number of monsters Special Summoned by this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c70.name: Unibird
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c70.description: You can remove from play this face-up card, and 1 face-up monster you control, to select 1 Synchro Monster in your Graveyard with a Level less than or equal to the combined original Levels of the other 2 monsters. Special Summon that Synchro Monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c78.name: Union Attack
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c78.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; add up the total ATK of all other face-up Attack Position monsters you currently control, then during the Battle Phase of this turn only, the monster gains that much ATK, but cannot inflict battle damage to your opponent, also other face-up Attack Position monsters cannot attack.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c7c.name: Union Rider
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c7c.description: You can take control of up to 1 Union Monster that is currently a monster on your opponent's side of the field, and equip it to this card. The Union Monster that is equipped to this card cannot be changed back to a monster using its own effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc9.name: Vampire Grimson
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc9.description: If a monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, you can pay 1000 LP for each monster that would be destroyed, instead (you must protect all your monsters that would be destroyed, if you use this effect). At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card destroyed any monster(s) by battle: You can Special Summon them from the GYs to your field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd4.name: Vampire Vamp
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd4.description: Once per turn, when this card or a "Vampire" monster is Normal Summoned to your field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, whose ATK is higher than this card's; equip it to this card. This card gains ATK equal to the combined original ATK of the monsters equipped to it by this effect. If this card is sent to the GY, while equipped with a card(s) by this effect: Special Summon this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cec.name: Vendread Chimera
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cec.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Vendread" Ritual Spell. When a card or effect is activated that would destroy a card on the field (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 Zombie monster from your GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If this card is Tributed, or banished, for a Ritual Summon: All monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK/DEF. You can only use each effect of "Vendread Chimera" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf3.name: Vendread Reunion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf3.description: Reveal 1 "Vendread" Ritual Monster in your hand, Special Summon any number of your banished "Vendread" monsters with different names, in face-down Defense Position, whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the revealed Ritual Monster, Tribute all those face-down Defense Position monsters, then Ritual Summon that Ritual Monster from your hand. You must be able to Ritual Summon to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d06.name: Vermillion Dragon Mech
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d06.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn: You can banish 1 Tuner from your hand, GY, or face-up field, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it. If this Synchro Summoned card is destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can target 1 of your banished Tuners; add it to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d41.name: Void Ogre Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d41.description:
1 DARK Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card while you have no cards in your hand: You can negate the activation and destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d54.name: Voloferniges, the Darkest Dragon Doomrider
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d54.description:
2 Level 7 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 2 materials from this card, then target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it, and if you destroyed a monster, you can make 1 face-up monster you control gain ATK equal to the destroyed monster's original Level/Rank x 300 until the end of the next turn. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect. This is a Quick Effect if this card has a Dragon monster as material, but cannot be activated in the Damage Step.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5a.name: Vorse Raider
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5a.description: This wicked Beast-Warrior does every horrid thing imaginable, and loves it! His axe bears the marks of his countless victims.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5d.name: Vorticular Drumgon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5d.description:
3 DARK Dragon monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Vorticular Drumgon" once per turn. If this effect resolves, the unused Monster Zones this card points to cannot be used for the rest of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d68.name: Vylon Filament
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d68.description: Equip only to a "Vylon" monster. If the equipped monster attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Vylon" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d81.name: Wall of Illusion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d81.description: If this card is attacked by a monster, after damage calculation: Return that monster to the hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53da0.name: Watapon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53da0.description: If this card is added from your Deck to your hand by a card effect: You can Special Summon this card.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53da7.name: Water Hazard
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53da7.description: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WATER monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dba.name: Wattdragonfly
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dba.description: If this card is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect), you can Special Summon 1 "Watt" monster from your Deck.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53de1.name: White Aura Monoceros
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53de1.description:
1 WATER Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 Fish monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but it cannot attack this turn. You can only use this effect of "White Aura Monoceros" once per turn. If this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY: You can banish 1 other WATER monster from your GY; Special Summon this card, and if you do, it is treated as a Tuner.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dec.name: White Magical Hat
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dec.description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent discards 1 card randomly from his/her hand.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e07.name: Wightmare
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e07.description:
This card's name becomes "Skull Servant" while in the GY. You can discard this card, then activate 1 of the following effects.
● Target 1 of your banished "Skull Servant" or "Wightmare"; return it to the GY.
● Target 1 of your banished "The Lady in Wight" or "King of the Skull Servants"; Special Summon it.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e09.name: Wightprincess
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e09.description: This card's name becomes "Skull Servant" while it is in the Graveyard. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Wightprince" from your Deck to the Graveyard. During either player's turn: You can send this card from your hand or field to the Graveyard; all monsters currently on the field lose ATK and DEF equal to their own Level/Rank x 300, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e12.name: Wind-Up Bat
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e12.description: You can target 1 "Wind-Up" monster in your Graveyard; change this face-up Attack Position card you control to face-up Defense Position, and add that target to your hand. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e1d.name: Wind-Up Rat
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e1d.description: During your Main Phase: You can target 1 "Wind-Up" monster in your Graveyard; change this face-up Attack Position card you control to face-up Defense Position, and Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c17.name: Tyranno Infinity
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c17.description: The original ATK of this card is the number of your banished Dinosaur-Type monsters x 1000.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1d.name: Tyrant Wing
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1d.description: Target 1 Dragon monster on the field; equip this card to it. It gains 400 ATK/DEF, also it can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if the monster equipped with this card by this effect attacked an opponent's monster this turn: Destroy this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1f.name: Tyrant's Temper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c1f.description: Tribute 1 monster to activate this card. All face-up monsters on the field that you own are unaffected by other Trap Cards.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c2b.name: U.A. Midfielder
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c2b.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 "U.A." monster you control to the hand, except "U.A. Midfielder". You can only Special Summon "U.A. Midfielder" once per turn this way. During either player's turn: You can target 1 other "U.A." monster you control; return that face-up monster to the hand, then Special Summon 1 "U.A." monster from your hand with a different name from that monster. You can only use this effect of "U.A. Midfielder" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c2d.name: U.A. Penalty Box
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c2d.description: At the start of the Damage Step, if your "U.A." monster battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that opponent's monster until your opponent's 2nd End Phase. You can only use this effect of "U.A. Penalty Box" once per turn. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; add 1 "U.A." Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c34.name: U.A. Stadium
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c34.description: If a "U.A." monster is Normal Summoned to your side of the field: You can add 1 "U.A." monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, if a "U.A." monster(s) is Special Summoned to your side of the field: All monsters you currently control gain 500 ATK (even if this card leaves the field).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c44.name: Ultimate Insect LV1
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c44.description: While this card is on the field, it is unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards. During your Standby Phase, by sending this face-up card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV3" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c59.name: Unacceptable Result
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c59.description: If you control a Spellcaster monster: Special Summon 1 "Fortune Fairy" monster from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c96.name: Ursarctic Big Dipper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c96.description: Once per turn, if your "Ursarctic" monster would Tribute a monster(s) to activate its effect, you can banish 1 Level 7 or higher "Ursarctic" monster from your GY instead. Each time a monster(s) is Special Summoned, place 1 counter on this card. Once per turn, if a monster(s) is Special Summoned and an "Ursarctic" Synchro Monster is on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can remove all counters from this card (min. 7), then target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca9.name: V-LAN Hydra
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ca9.description:
2+ monsters, except Tokens
Gains 300 ATK for each monster co-linked to this card. You can target 1 Link-3 or lower monster co-linked to this card; Tribute it, and if you do, Special Summon "V-LAN Tokens" (Cyberse/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) equal to the Tributed monster's Link Rating, also you cannot Special Summon monsters with the same Link Rating as that targeted monster for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "V-LAN Hydra" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb4.name: Valkyrie Chariot
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cb4.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Fairy monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. When the equipped monster declares an attack: You can have it gain 500 ATK. (This ATK gain remains even if this card leaves the field.)

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ccc.name: Vampire Lady
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ccc.description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce4.name: Variety Comes Out
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ce4.description: Return 1 face-up Synchro Monster you control to the Extra Deck to select and Special Summon a Tuner monster(s) from your Graveyard, whose total Levels equal the Level of that Synchro Monster. You cannot Synchro Summon the turn you activate this card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cef.name: Vendread Houndhorde
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cef.description:
If this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 "Vendread" card; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. A "Vendread" monster Ritual Summoned using this card on the field gains the following effect. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Vendread Houndhorde" once per turn.
● Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; banish it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf0.name: Vendread Nightmare
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cf0.description: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 or more "Vendread" monsters from your hand and/or field, then target 1 face-up monster you control; increase its Level by the number of monsters Tributed, until the end of this turn. When your attacking "Vendread" Ritual Monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can have your monster gain 1000 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Vendread Nightmare" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d01.name: Venom Shot
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d01.description: Activate only while you control a face-up "Venom" monster, "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes", or "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes". Send 1 Reptile-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard and place 2 Venom Counters on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d0d.name: Vice Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d0d.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand), but its original ATK and DEF become halved.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d31.name: Vision HERO Gravito
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d31.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 of your banished "HERO" monsters; add it to your hand. You can Tribute this card, then target 2 "Vision HERO" Monster Cards in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon them. You can only use each effect of "Vision HERO Gravito" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d40.name: Void Launch
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d40.description: During each of your Standby Phases: You can send up to 2 "Infernoid" monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard. If you control a monster that is not an "Infernoid" monster, send this card to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d42.name: Void Purification
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d42.description:
If you control a monster that is not an "Infernoid" monster, send this card to the Graveyard. You can only use each of these effects of "Void Purification" once per turn.
● During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: You can target 1 "Infernoid" monster in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.
● During each of your Standby Phases: You can target 1 of your banished "Infernoid" monsters; return it to the Graveyard.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5b.name: Vortex Trooper
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d5b.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can shuffle 2 cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw 2 cards. If this card is destroyed: Draw 1 card.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d66.name: Vylon Element
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d66.description: When any face-up "Vylon" Equip Card(s) you control are destroyed (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon an equal or lower number of "Vylon" Tuner monsters from your Deck. They cannot be used as Synchro Material Monsters, except for the Synchro Summon of a "Vylon" Synchro Monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d70.name: Vylon Prism
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d70.description: If this card is sent from the Monster Card Zone to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 Life Points, then target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. If the equipped monster attacks or is attacked: It gains 1000 ATK during the Damage Step only.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d80.name: Wall of Disruption
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d80.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: All Attack Position monsters your opponent controls lose 800 ATK for each monster they control.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d95.name: War-Lion Ritual
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d95.description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Super War-Lion". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 7 or more.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dcc.name: Wave-Motion Cannon
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dcc.description: During your Main Phase: You can send this face-up card to the GY; inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each of your Standby Phases that have passed since this card was activated.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e1e.name: Wind-Up Shark
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e1e.description:
When a "Wind-Up" monster is Normal or Special Summoned to your side of the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn: You can activate 1 of these effects.
● Increase this card's Level by 1, until the End Phase.
● Reduce this card's Level by 1, until the End Phase.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e29.name: Winds Over the Ice Barrier
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53e29.description: Tribute any number of "Ice Barrier" monsters; Special Summon from your Deck that many Level 4 or lower "Ice Barrier" monsters with different names from each other. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 of your "Ice Barrier" monsters that is banished or in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Winds Over the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c01.name: Twin-Barrel Dragon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c01.description: When this card is Summoned: Target 1 card your opponent controls; toss a coin twice, and if the result is 2 Heads, destroy it.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c07.name: Twin-Sword Marauder
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c07.description: Once per Battle Phase, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster, it can make a second attack in a row. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c08.name: Twinheaded Beast
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c08.description: This card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c12.name: Tyhone #2
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c12.description: A crimson dragon that spits fireballs to create a blazing sea of fire.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c5c.name: Unbreakable Spirit
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c5c.description: If you control only 1 face-up monster: Target that monster; until the end of this turn, it gains ATK equal to the ATK of the monster your opponent currently controls with the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c76.name: Uniflora, Mystical Beast of the Forest
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c76.description: If all the monsters in your Graveyard are Beast-Type: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Beast-Type monster from your hand or Graveyard, except "Uniflora, Mystical Beast of the Forest", but it cannot attack this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c83.name: Unknown Synchron
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c83.description: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Unknown Synchron" once per Duel this way.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c8d.name: Updraft
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c8d.description: Remove all Fog Counters from the field. Inflict 150 damage to your opponent for each Fog Counter you removed.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c9b.name: Ursarctic Megatanus
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53c9b.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other Level 7 or higher monster from your hand; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except monsters with a Level. If this card is Special Summoned while you control another "Ursarctic" monster: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change it to face-down Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Ursarctic Megatanus" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbc.name: Valkyrie Zweite
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cbc.description: If this card is Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it. After damage calculation, if this card battled: You can target 1 Continuous Spell in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Valkyrie Zweite" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc5.name: Vampire Familiar
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cc5.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can pay 500 LP; add 1 "Vampire" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Vampire Familiar". If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 "Vampire" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Vampire Familiar" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ccb.name: Vampire Kingdom
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53ccb.description: Zombie-Type monsters gain 500 ATK during damage calculation only. Once per turn, when a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard: Target 1 card on the field; send 1 DARK "Vampire" monster from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, destroy that target.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cff.name: Venom Cobra
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cff.description: Hard scales cover all parts of this gigantic cobra. It hunts by shooting out massive amounts of venom, but because of its large size, its attack pattern is easily predicted.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d13.name: Vile Germs
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d13.description: A Plant-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d37.name: Vision HERO Vyon
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d37.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "HERO" monster from your Deck to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Vision HERO Vyon" once per turn. Once per turn: You can banish 1 "HERO" monster from your GY; add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d3c.name: Void Cauldron
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d3c.description: If an "Infernity" monster(s) and/or a Level 8 DARK Dragon Synchro Monster(s) you control would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, you can banish 1 "Infernity" card from your GY instead. If you have any cards in your hand, send this card to the GY.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d75.name: Vylon Stella
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d75.description: If this card is sent from the Monster Card Zone to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 Life Points, then target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. At the end of the Damage Step, if the equipped monster battled an opponent's monster: Destroy that opponent's monster.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d78.name: Vylon Tetra
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d78.description: If this card is sent from the Monster Card Zone to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 Life Points, then target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, you can destroy this Equip Card instead.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d82.name: Wall of Ivy
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d82.description: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Ivy Token" (Plant-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position to your opponent's side of the field. When this Token is destroyed, its controller takes 300 damage.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d89.name: War Rock Dignity
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d89.description:
You must control a "War Rock" monster to activate either of these effects.
● When a monster your opponent controls activates its effect: Negate that effect.
● During the Battle Phase, when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect: Negate that effect.
You can only activate 1 "War Rock Dignity" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d94.name: War Rock Wento
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d94.description: If your EARTH Warrior monster battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation (Quick Effect): You can pay 800 LP; your battling monster gains 800 ATK, until the end of this turn. If this card is sent from your Monster Zone to your GY by an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher "War Rock" monster from your hand or Deck. You can only use each effect of "War Rock Wento" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d9a.name: Warrior Elimination
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d9a.description: Destroy all Warrior monsters on the field.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d9b.name: Warrior Lady of the Wasteland
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d9b.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 EARTH Warrior-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53db6.name: Wattchimera
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53db6.description:
1 "Watt" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Thunder-Type monsters
This card can attack your opponent directly. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent by a direct attack, place 1 random card from your opponent's hand on top of their Deck.

60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd9.name: Wheel of Prophecy
60c2b3ada0e24f2d54a53dd9.description: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a Spellcaster-Type monster: You can target any number of your banished "Spellbook" Spell Cards; shuffle them into the Deck, and if you do, return your other banished "Spellbook" Spell Cards to your Graveyard. You can only use the effect of "Wheel of Prophecy" once per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf9.name: Twilight Twin Dragons
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53bf9.description: If you control "Punishment Dragon": Target 1 "Judgment Dragon" in your GY; add it to your hand, then send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the GY. If this card is sent from the Deck to the GY by a "Lightsworn" monster's effect: You can target 1 "Punishment Dragon" in your GY; add it to your hand, then banish the top 4 cards of your Deck.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53caa.name: V-Tiger Jet
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53caa.description: This ace fighter is unbeatable in a dogfight. It combines with other monsters to launch an array of encircling attacks.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd3.name: Vampire Takeover
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cd3.description: If you have no card in your Field Zone and all face-up monsters you control (min. 1) are Zombie-Type: Activate 1 "Vampire Kingdom" directly from your Deck, then, you can Special Summon 1 DARK "Vampire" monster from your Graveyard in face-up Defense Position. You can only activate 1 "Vampire Takeover" per turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cdc.name: Vanadis of the Nordic Ascendant
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53cdc.description: For a Synchro Summon, you can substitute this card for any 1 "Nordic" Tuner. If this card is used as Synchro Material, all other Synchro Materials must be "Nordic" monsters. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Nordic" monster from your Deck to the GY; this card's Level becomes the Level of that monster, until the end of this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d02.name: Venom Snake
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d02.description: Once per turn, you can place 1 Venom Counter on 1 monster your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d0e.name: Vicious Claw
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d0e.description: The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, return this card to its owner's hand instead. Then, destroy 1 monster, except the one that battled the equipped monster, and inflict 300 damage to your opponent. After that, Special Summon 1 "Evil Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 7/ATK 2500/DEF 2500) on your opponent's side of the field. During the turn this card is returned to your hand, you cannot use "Vicious Claw" from your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d3d.name: Void Expansion
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d3d.description: During your Standby Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Infernoid Token" (Fiend-Type/FIRE/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). To Special Summon an "Infernoid" monster using its own procedure, you can banish "Infernoid" monster(s) you control instead of those in the Graveyard (or any combination of both). Your opponent cannot target "Infernoid" monsters you control for attacks or with card effects, except the "Infernoid" monster you control with the highest Level (either, if tied).

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d63.name: Vylon Cube
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d63.description: If this card is sent to the Graveyard for the Synchro Summon of a LIGHT monster: You can add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6b.name: Vylon Matter
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6b.description: Select 3 Equip Spell Cards in your Graveyard. Return them to the Deck and apply 1 of these effects: ● Draw 1 card. ● Destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6c.name: Vylon Ohm
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d6c.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; banish that target, and if you do, add it to your hand during your next Standby Phase.

60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d73.name: Vylon Soldier
60c2b3aca0e24f2d54a53d73.description: When this card declares an attack: You can target monsters your opponent controls, up to the number of Equip Cards equipped to this card; change those targets' battle positions.
