If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can destroy 1 FIRE Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster in your hand, Deck, or face-up field, except "Sacred Fire King Garunix", and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to half the destroyed monster's ATK it had there, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Sacred Fire King Garunix" once per turn.

64b005c147d76121f846733a.name: Synchro Rumble
64b005c147d76121f846733a.description: Target 1 Tuner or 1 Level 7 or 8 Dragon Synchro Monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. If a Level 7 or 8 Dragon Synchro Monster(s) or "Crimson Dragon" you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only activate 1 "Synchro Rumble" per turn.

64b00630451b5d913c3accfd.name: T.G. Rocket Salamander
64b00630451b5d913c3accfd.description: You can Tribute 1 "T.G." monster; Special Summon 1 "T.G." monster from your Deck with a different original name than that Tributed monster's. If you control a Machine "T.G." monster: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "T.G." monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "T.G. Rocket Salamander" once per turn.

64b0065247d76121f846801e.name: T.G. Mighty Striker
64b0065247d76121f846801e.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner monster
Once per turn, during your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "T.G. Mighty Striker" once per turn. If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 "T.G." Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent from your Monster Zone to the GY: You can send 1 "T.G." card from your Deck to the GY.

64b0066947d76121f84681e8.name: T.G. Over Dragonar
64b0066947d76121f84681e8.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon any number of "T.G." monsters from your GY in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "T.G." monsters. You can only use this effect of "T.G. Over Dragonar" once per turn. If this card on the field is destroyed: Draw 1 card.

64b0068347d76121f8468413.name: T.G. Glaive Blaster
64b0068347d76121f8468413.description:
1 Tuner Synchro Monster + 2+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster on the field Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; banish it. You can use this effect a number of times per turn, up to the number of non-Tuner Synchro Monsters used as Synchro Material for this card. Once per turn, if a monster(s) is banished face-up (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; Special Summon it to your field, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

64b0069447d76121f846863a.name: T.G. Limiter Removal
64b0069447d76121f846863a.description: Discard 1 card; add 2 "T.G." monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "T.G." monster in your GY; shuffle it into the Deck, or if you control a Machine "T.G." monster, you can add it to your hand instead. You can only use 1 "T.G. Limiter Removal" effect once per turn, and only once that turn.

64b006a647d76121f8468842.name: T.G. All Clear
64b006a647d76121f8468842.description: All "T.G." monsters on the field become Machine monsters. During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "T.G." monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) During your Main Phase: You can destroy 1 "T.G." monster in your hand or field, and if you do, add 1 "T.G." monster with a different name from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "T.G. All Clear" once per turn.

64b006b247d76121f846899d.name: T.G. Close
64b006b247d76121f846899d.description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a Machine "T.G." monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If a Synchro Monster(s) is banished while this card is in your GY: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "T.G. Close" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

64b0075247d76121f8469823.name: Xyz Armor Torpedo
64b0075247d76121f8469823.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Cannot attack unless it has material. You can detach 2 materials from this card; draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Xyz Armor Torpedo" once per turn. Apply these effects while this card is equipped to a monster.
● If the equipped monster battles, until the end of the Damage Step, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects, also negate the effects of all face-up monsters they control.
● If the equipped monster is an Xyz Monster, your opponent cannot target it with card effects.

64b0076447d76121f84699a0.name: Xyz Armor Fortress
64b0076447d76121f84699a0.description:
2 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Xyz Armor Fortress" by using 1 Rank 3 or 4 Xyz Monster you control. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Cannot be used as material for an Xyz Summon while it has material. Once per turn: You can detach up to 2 materials from this card; add "Armored Xyz" cards with different names from your Deck to your hand, equal to the number detached. If a monster equipped with this card battles a monster, any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is doubled.

64b00781112c2829ee9fc10d.name: Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer
64b00781112c2829ee9fc10d.description:
3 Level 7 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer" by using 1 Rank 5 or 6 Xyz Monster you control. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Gains 300 ATK for each material and Equip Card it has. Once per turn: You can target 1 "Xyz" card in your GY; add it to your hand. Once per turn, if an Equip Card becomes equipped to a monster you control (except during the Damage Step): You can attach 1 monster your opponent controls to this card as material.

64b0078e112c2829ee9fc267.name: Xyz Entrust
64b0078e112c2829ee9fc267.description: Add 1 "Armored Xyz" card from your Deck or GY to your hand, then you can make up to 2 face-up monsters you control become all Level 3 or all Level 5, until the end of this turn. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster Card treated as an Equip Card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it. You can only activate 1 "Xyz Entrust" per turn.

64b0079a112c2829ee9fc378.name: Full-Armored Xyz
64b0079a112c2829ee9fc378.description:
If an Xyz Monster(s) is on the field: Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Xyz Monster using monsters you control. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster you control; equip 1 other Xyz Monster from your face-up field or GY to that monster as an Equip Spell with the following effects.
● The equipped monster gains ATK equal to this card's ATK.
● If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

64b17f25a9ffbc5440594d53.name: Signs of the Tistina
64b17f25a9ffbc5440594d53.description:
Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster on the field; Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Aqua/LIGHT/Level 10/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the following effect (this card is also still a Trap).
● During your opponent's turn, when that target leaves the field, destroy this card. During your opponent's turn, when this card leaves the field, destroy that target.

64b17f32a9ffbc5440594eaa.name: Breath of the Tistina
64b17f32a9ffbc5440594eaa.description: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Tistina" monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) You can target 1 face-up monster you control, or if you control a LIGHT "Tistina" monster, you can target 1 face-up monster on the field instead; change that monster to face-down Defense Position, then add 1 "Tistina" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Breath of the Tistina". You can only use this effect of "Breath of the Tistina" once per turn.

64b17f3fa9ffbc5440594f95.name: Divine Domain Baatistina
64b17f3fa9ffbc5440594f95.description: During your Main Phase: You can send 1 "Tistina" monster from your Deck to your GY, then if your opponent controls 3 or more face-up cards, you can Special Summon 1 "Crystal God Tistina" from your hand or Deck. You can only use this effect of "Divine Domain Baatistina" once per turn. If this card in your Field Zone is destroyed by your opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Tistina" monster from your Deck or GY.

64b17f59a9ffbc544059519c.name: Crystal God Tistina
64b17f59a9ffbc544059519c.description: During your Main Phase: You can change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can send all face-up cards your opponent controls to the GY. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can send all face-up cards your opponent controls to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Crystal God Tistina" once per turn.

64b17f67a9ffbc54405952ba.name: Demigod of the Tistina
64b17f67a9ffbc54405952ba.description: If you control a "Tistina" card: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 "Tistina" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. During your opponent's turn, if you control "Crystal God Tistina" (Quick Effect): You can change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can send all face-up cards your opponent controls to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Demigod of the Tistina" once per turn.

64b17f79a9ffbc54405953f8.name: Hound of the Tistina
64b17f79a9ffbc54405953f8.description: If this card is in your hand or GY and you control a LIGHT "Tistina" monster: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Hound of the Tistina" once per turn. "Tistina" monsters you control can attack directly while your opponent controls a face-down Defense Position monster.

64b17f8ea9ffbc5440595611.name: Sentinel of the Tistina
64b17f8ea9ffbc5440595611.description: If this card is in your hand or GY and you control a LIGHT "Tistina" monster: You can Special Summon this card. You can target 1 "Tistina" monster or 1 face-down card you control; destroy it, then add 1 "Tistina" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Sentinel of the Tistina" once per turn.

64b17fb5960e7e6b6ff80a53.name: Zuttomozaurus
64b17fb5960e7e6b6ff80a53.description: While you control another Dinosaur monster, your opponent's monsters cannot target this card for attacks. You can target 1 other card you control; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Zuttomozaurus" once per turn.

64b17fca960e7e6b6ff80c47.name: Finis Terrae, Tower of the Necroworld
64b17fca960e7e6b6ff80c47.description: If you control a Level 10 monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Finis Terrae, Tower of the Necroworld" once per turn this way. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 face-up card on the field; that card cannot be destroyed by card effects this turn. You can only use this effect of "Finis Terrae, Tower of the Necroworld" once per turn.

64b17fe1960e7e6b6ff80e23.name: Kuibelt the Blade Dragon
64b17fe1960e7e6b6ff80e23.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it. If this card on the field is destroyed: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; that monster cannot attack until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use each effect of "Kuibelt the Blade Dragon" once per turn.

64b17ff9960e7e6b6ff81037.name: Storagepod
64b17ff9960e7e6b6ff81037.description:
"Trifortressops" or "Stegocyber" + 1 Machine or Dinosaur monster
Cannot be destroyed by battle while a monster Special Summoned from the GY is on the field. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the hand while this monster is on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; destroy them. You can only use this effect of "Storagepod" once per turn.

64b1800b960e7e6b6ff8118a.name: Synchro Forceback
64b1800b960e7e6b6ff8118a.description: Target monsters on the field, up to the number of Synchro Monsters with different names you control; return them to the hand. You can only activate 1 "Synchro Forceback" per turn.

64b28f88180d4d8dd0483996.name: S:P Little Knight
64b28f88180d4d8dd0483996.description:
2 Effect Monsters
If this card is Link Summoned using a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster as material: You can target 1 card on the field or in either GY; banish it, also your monsters cannot attack directly this turn. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can target 2 face-up monsters on the field, including a monster you control; banish both until the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "S:P Little Knight" once per turn.

64b3f18ea4b3ce5d600718eb.name: Dark Hole Dragon
64b3f18ea4b3ce5d600718eb.description: Cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dark Hole Dragon" once per turn. If a monster(s) on the field is destroyed by a card effect that does not target it (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from the GY (if it was there when the monster was destroyed) or hand (even if not). If this card is Special Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 "Dark Hole" from your Deck to your hand.

64b5437cf6796fe548599082.name: Arias the Labrynth Butler
64b5437cf6796fe548599082.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Labrynth" monster, or Set 1 Normal Trap, from your hand. The Set Normal Trap can be activated this turn. When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your card or effect activation of a Normal Trap or a "Labrynth" card, except "Arias the Labrynth Butler" (Quick Effect): You can activate this effect in the GY; Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Arias the Labrynth Butler" once per turn.

64b60df5e41b31a4ff439e1b.name: Battlin’ Boxing Cross Counter
64b60df5e41b31a4ff439e1b.description:
When your opponent activates a monster effect: Destroy 1 "Battlin' Boxer" or "Number" Xyz Monster you control, and if you do, negate the activation, and if you do that, destroy that monster, then you can apply the following effect.
● Special Summon 1 "Battlin' Boxer" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck with a different name than the first monster, and if you do, attach this card to it as material.
You can only activate 1 "Battlin' Boxing Cross Counter" per turn.

64b60e8585a1d838bfc3fa88.name: Battlin' Boxer Chief Second
64b60e8585a1d838bfc3fa88.description: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) When an opponent's monster declares an attack, while you control a Warrior or FIRE monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, negate that attack, then banish 1 monster on the field until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Battlin' Boxer Chief Second" once per turn.

64b60e9a85a1d838bfc3fc64.name: Battlin' Boxer Uppercutter
64b60e9a85a1d838bfc3fc64.description:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster or 1 "Counter" Counter Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Battlin' Boxer Uppercutter". If this card is sent to the GY by card effect: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster from your GY, except "Battlin’ Boxer Uppercutter".
● Set 1 "Counter" Counter Trap from your GY to your field.
You can only use 1 "Battlin' Boxer Uppercutter" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

64b60eac85a1d838bfc3fdbb.name: Battlin' Boxer Promoter
64b60eac85a1d838bfc3fdbb.description: If your opponent controls a monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon up to 2 "Battlin' Boxer" monsters with different names from your Deck, except "Battlin' Boxer Promoter". You can banish this card from your GY; increase or decrease the Levels of all "Battlin' Boxer" monsters you currently control by 1. You can only use each effect of "Battlin' Boxer Promoter" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate any of this card's effects, except "Battlin' Boxer" monsters.

64b60ec485a1d838bfc3ffd8.name: Number C79: Battlin' Boxer General Kaiser
64b60ec485a1d838bfc3ffd8.description:
3 Level 5 monsters
Gains 200 ATK for each material attached to it. Once per turn, when your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s) (Quick Effect): You can detach 2 materials from this card, and if you do, negate the Summon, and if you do that, destroy that monster(s). If this card has "Number 79: Battlin' Boxer Nova Kaiser" as material, it gains this effect.
● Once per turn, when an attack is declared involving your "Battlin' Boxer" monster and an opponent's monster: You can send 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster from your hand or Deck to the GY, and if you do, attach that opponent's monster to this card as material.

64b60ede85a1d838bfc40290.name: Battlin' Boxer King Dempsey
64b60ede85a1d838bfc40290.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can take 1 Level 4 or lower FIRE Warrior monster or 1 "Battlin' Boxing" Spell/Trap from your Deck, and either add it to your hand or send it to the GY. (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from a monster you control, and if you do, apply the following effect.
● Your opponent cannot target "Battlin' Boxer" monsters you control with card effects for the rest of this turn.
You can only use each effect of "Battlin' Boxer King Dempsey" once per turn.

64b6856f961894ef5fd48863.name: Exceed the Pendulum
64b6856f961894ef5fd48863.description:
2+ Effect Monsters, including a Pendulum Monster
Gains 100 ATK for each Pendulum Monster Card you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Exceed the Pendulum" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 face-up Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 Pendulum Monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, with a Level between the Pendulum Scales of the 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones.

64b7d9f804c2630a5ed10d3f.name: Super Starslayer TY-PHON - Sky Crisis
64b7d9f804c2630a5ed10d3f.description:
2 Level 12 monsters
During the turn, or turn after, your opponent Special Summoned 2 or more monsters from the Extra Deck, you can also Xyz Summon this card by using 1 monster you control with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). (Transfer its materials to this card.) If you do, you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn. While this Xyz Summoned monster is on the field, neither player can activate the effects of monsters with 3000 or more ATK. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; return 1 monster from the field to the hand.

64baa41d5694bb6206e4bb3d.name: I.A.S. -Invasive Alien Species-
64baa41d5694bb6206e4bb3d.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while your opponent has a face-up card in their Field Zone. You can only use each of the following effects of "I.A.S. -Invasive Alien Species-" once per turn. If your opponent has a face-up card in their Field Zone: You can target 1 monster they control; destroy it, and if you do, this card gains 1000 ATK. If your opponent has a face-up card in their Field Zone, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card.

64baa44020073f621373db5d.name: UFOLight
64baa44020073f621373db5d.description: Your opponent cannot target this card on the field with card effects, except during the Battle Phase. If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. During the End Phase: You can draw 1 card, then you must banish any number of cards from your hand (min. 1), and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK for each. You can only use this effect of "UFOLight" once per turn.

64baaa335694bb6206e52df6.name: Master Tao the Chanter
64baaa335694bb6206e52df6.description: If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 Illusion monster in your GY, except "Master Tao the Chanter"; Special Summon it in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon from the GY for the rest of this turn, except Illusion monsters. You can only use this effect of "Master Tao the Chanter" once per turn.

64baaa515694bb6206e530a8.name: Tarai
64baaa515694bb6206e530a8.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 face-up monster in the Main Monster Zone that has activated its effect on the field this turn; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card to the zone that monster was in. You can only use this effect of "Tarai" once per turn.

64baaa6d5694bb6206e532ab.name: Cursed Bride Doll
64baaa6d5694bb6206e532ab.description: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon this card. At the start of each Battle Phase: If there are more cards in your Deck than your opponent's, this card gains ATK equal to the difference x 300, until the end of this turn. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there this turn: Place this card on top of the Deck.

64baaa8a5694bb6206e5347c.name: Seed-Spitting Saplings
64baaa8a5694bb6206e5347c.description: Once per turn, when a card or effect is activated that targets this card on the field, or when this card is targeted for an attack (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 "Snack Token" (Plant/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 800/DEF 800). Once per turn, when your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s) (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 Normal Monster; negate the Special Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s).

64baaaa45694bb6206e5366a.name: Origami Goddess
64baaaa45694bb6206e5366a.description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can toss a coin until the result is tails, and if you do, draw 1 card for every 2 heads. Each time a coin tossing effect resolves while this monster is on the field: Double this card's ATK for each heads from that effect.

64baaac65694bb6206e538bc.name: Card Scanner
64baaac65694bb6206e538bc.description: Once per turn: You can declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); both players reveal the bottom card of their Decks, and if it was the declared card type, they add it to their hand. Otherwise, they place it on top of their Deck. If this face-up card in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can make your opponent place 1 card from their hand on the bottom of the Deck.

64baaad45694bb6206e53a00.name: The Immortal Bushi Mourns the Mortal Body
64baaad45694bb6206e53a00.description: All monsters in your GY become Warrior monsters. Once per turn, during the End Phase: You can destroy all monsters you control.

64baaaf4f748db475150a1e1.name: Starry Dragon's Cycle
64baaaf4f748db475150a1e1.description:
Target 1 Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster on the field; return that face-up monster to the Extra Deck, then, based on its card type, you can Special Summon 1 appropriate monster from either GY to your field.
● Fusion: Monster with the same Attribute.
● Synchro: Monster with a lower Level.
● Xyz: Monster with the same Level as its Rank.
● Link: Monster with the same Type.
You can only activate 1 "Starry Dragon's Cycle" per turn.

64baab07f748db475150a2ef.name: Escapegoat
64baab07f748db475150a2ef.description: When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets a monster(s) you control, except a Token: You can Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 "Escapegoat Token" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. If a non-Token monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 Token in your Monster Zone instead.

64c0dac4ba20ae8d7d4b9dce.name: Scab Scarknight
64c0dac4ba20ae8d7d4b9dce.description: You can only control 1 "Scab Scarknight". Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy this card. Monsters your opponent controls must attack this card, if able. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls that battled this card this Battle Phase; take control of it.

64c0db322888788c6103976c.name: Archfiend Matador
64c0db322888788c6103976c.description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Ritual of the Matador". This card cannot attack. This card is not destroyed as a result of battle and any Battle Damage to the controller of this card becomes 0. A monster that battles with this card is destroyed at the end of the Damage Step.

64c0db71ba20ae8d7d4ba5aa.name: Ritual of the Matador
64c0db71ba20ae8d7d4ba5aa.description:
This card is used to Ritual Summon "Archfiend
Matador". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

64ccdc6656b1225435f5d477.name: Angello Vaalmonica
64ccdc6656b1225435f5d477.description:
[Pendulum Effect]
Each time you gain LP while you control a Fiend Monster Card in your other Pendulum Zone, place 1 Resonance Counter on this card. Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares an attack, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 "Vaalmonica" Link Monster.
[Monster Effect]
If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other card; take 1 "Dimonno Vaalmonica" from your Deck, and place this card and that card in your Pendulum Zones. During your Main Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can banish 1 "Vaalmonica" Normal Spell/Trap from your GY; apply whichever effect on that card includes gaining LP. You can only use each effect of "Angello Vaalmonica" once per turn.

64ccdc8d56b1225435f5d739.name: Dimonno Vaalmonica
64ccdc8d56b1225435f5d739.description:
[Pendulum Effect]
Each time you take effect damage while you control a Fairy Monster Card in your other Pendulum Zone, place 1 Resonance Counter on this card. Monsters your opponent controls lose 100 ATK for each Resonance Counter on your field.
[Monster Effect]
If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other card; take 1 "Angello Vaalmonica" from your Deck, and place this card and that card in your Pendulum Zones. During your Main Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can banish 1 "Vaalmonica" Normal Spell/Trap from your GY; apply whichever effect on that card includes taking damage. You can only use each effect of "Dimonno Vaalmonica" once per turn.

64ccdcc556b1225435f5dbd6.name: Duralume, Vaalmonican Heathen Hallow
64ccdcc556b1225435f5dbd6.description:
1 Effect Monster
Cannot be Link Summoned unless you have 3 or more Resonance Counters on Fairy Monster Card(s) in your Pendulum Zone. You can only Special Summon "Duralume, Vaalmonican Heathen Hallow" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can target monsters your opponent controls, up to the number of Resonance Counters in your Pendulum Zone; destroy them. You can remove 3 Resonance Counters from your Pendulum Zone; this card can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase this turn.

64ccdce656b1225435f5df30.name: Zebufera, Vaalmonican Hallow Heathen
64ccdce656b1225435f5df30.description:
1 Effect Monster
Cannot be Link Summoned unless you have 3 or more Resonance Counters on Fiend Monster Card(s) in your Pendulum Zone. You can only Special Summon "Zebufera, Vaalmonican Hallow Heathen" once per turn. If a card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can remove 3 Resonance Counters from your Pendulum Zone instead. Once per opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 of your "Vaalmonica" Normal Spells/Traps that is banished or in your GY; apply that card's activation effect.

64ccdd0256b1225435f5e29d.name: Vaalmonica, the Agathokakological Voice
64ccdd0256b1225435f5e29d.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Vaalmonica" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a card in your Pendulum Zone has a 3rd Resonance Counter placed on it: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase, but it cannot declare an attack. You can only use this effect of "Vaalmonica, the Agathokakological Voice" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Vaalmonica, the Agathokakological Voice" per turn.

64ccdd1356b1225435f5e428.name: Vaalmonica Versare
64ccdd1356b1225435f5e428.description:
Apply 1 of these effects. Unless you have a "Vaalmonica" card in your Pendulum Zone, your opponent chooses the effect.
●Gain 500 LP, then you can excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a "Vaalmonica" card, then add that card to your hand, also shuffle the rest into the Deck.
●Take 250 damage, then you can send 1 "Vaalmonica" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Vaalmonica Versare".
You can only activate 1 "Vaalmonica Versare" per turn.

64ccdd2356b1225435f5e5bf.name: Vaalmonica Intonare
64ccdd2356b1225435f5e5bf.description:
Apply 1 of these effects. Unless you have a "Vaalmonica" card in your Pendulum Zone, your opponent chooses the effect.
●Gain 500 LP, then if you have any monsters in your GY that can be Special Summoned, your opponent chooses 1 for you to Special Summon to your field.
●Take 250 damage, then you can add 1 Level 4 monster from your GY to your hand.
You can only activate 1 "Vaalmonica Intonare" per turn.

64ccdd3a56b1225435f5e7aa.name: Vaalmonica Followed Rhythm
64ccdd3a56b1225435f5e7aa.description:
Apply 1 of these effects. You must control a "Vaalmonica" Monster Card to activate and to resolve this effect. If you control a "Vaalmonica" Link Monster, you can apply both effects in sequence.
●Gain 500 LP, then you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap on the field.
●Take 250 damage, then you can return 1 monster from the field to the hand.
You can only activate 1 "Vaalmonica Followed Rhythm" per turn.

64ccdd4a56b1225435f5e928.name: Vaalmonica Chosen Melody
64ccdd4a56b1225435f5e928.description:
Apply 1 of these effects. You must control a "Vaalmonica" Monster Card to activate and to resolve this effect. If you control a "Vaalmonica" Link Monster, you can apply both effects in sequence.
●Gain 500 LP, also for the rest of this turn, your opponent cannot target "Vaalmonica" Monster Cards you control with card effects.
●Take 250 damage, then you can negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn.
You can only activate 1 "Vaalmonica Chosen Melody" per turn.

64d0713262f5a1b091f8a549.name: Rescue Hedgehog
64d0713262f5a1b091f8a549.description: You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower monsters from your Deck with the same Type, Attribute, and Level as each other (1 Normal Monster and 1 Effect Monster), but their effects are negated, also destroy them during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Hedgehog" once per turn.

64d1bbe2c9085641ca480b78.name: Echelon of the Fire Kings
64d1bbe2c9085641ca480b78.description: Special Summon 3 FIRE monsters (1 Beast, 1 Beast-Warrior, 1 Winged Beast), 1 each from your hand, Deck, and GY, but their effects are negated, also destroy them during the End Phase. You can banish this card from your GY; this turn, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when you Normal or Special Summon a "Fire King" monster(s). You can only use each effect of "Echelon of the Fire Kings" once per turn.

64d1bc01afac3d4c45ffa025.name: Fire King Sky Burn
64d1bc01afac3d4c45ffa025.description: Target an equal number of "Fire King" monsters you control and cards your opponent controls; destroy them. If a "Fire King" card(s) you control would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use 1 "Fire King Sky Burn" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

64d1bc35afac3d4c45ffa52c.name: Fire King Avatar Rangbali
64d1bc35afac3d4c45ffa52c.description: If a face-up "Fire King" monster(s) you control is destroyed by card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. When a Spell/Trap Card or effect is activated, while this card is on the field (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy 1 other FIRE monster in your hand or face-up field. You can only use each effect of "Fire King Avatar Rangbali" once per turn.

64d386c22bfaaf27acb47157.name: Mementotlan Dark Blade
64d386c22bfaaf27acb47157.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 "Memento" card, then target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy it. During your Main Phase: You can destroy 1 "Memento" monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower "Memento" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Mementotlan Dark Blade" once per turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82a.name: Spell Archer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82a.description: A young bowman loved by the wind. His arrows are made from magic and fly endlessly.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f823.name: Sevens Road Magician
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f823.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of different Attributes in your Graveyard] x 300, until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f825.name: Ansler the Magical Swordsman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f825.description: A magical sword that uses a flame spirit puppet to wield itself. It is said that the sword recognizes the one who can best the flame spirit as its true wielder.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f835.name: Dragorite
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f835.description: A dragon that spawned from an underground mineral vein. It uses the energy from an unknown ore as a power source for doing battle. The ultra-hard blows it delivers are incredibly effective!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f837.name: Dragon's Sage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f837.description: A young priestess from a bloodline of ancient dragons. She offers daily prayers for the peace of her people. It is said her clear eyes have the power to alter the fate of those reflected in them.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83c.name: Dragon's Inferno
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Dragon Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f840.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f840.description: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f845.name: Kuribot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f845.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 "Kuribot" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f847.name: Sportsdragon Slugger
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f847.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Sportsdragon Pitcher" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. This turn, your Level 6 and lower monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84c.name: Spice the Elite Noodle Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] All face-up Pyro Type monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of Normal Monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84d.name: Tang the Noodle Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84d.description: A ninja who is proud of his chewy noodles and their unique texture. Those bound by his soup-infused noodles cannot escape.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f852.name: Thunder the Thunder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f852.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 300 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f854.name: Pierce!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f854.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f857.name: Road Magic - Tempest
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f857.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field, send 1 WIND Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change the battle position of up to 3 monsters on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85d.name: Crawling Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85d.description: This weakened dragon can no longer fly, but is still a deadly force to be reckoned with.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f860.name: Faith Bird
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f860.description: This long-tailed bird blinds its enemies with mystical light.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f865.name: Lizard Soldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f865.description: A beast soldier derived from dragons, it is small for a Dragon Type. Moving very quickly, this monster is an excellent strategist.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f869.name: Skull Servant
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f869.description: A skeletal ghost that isn't strong but can mean trouble in large numbers.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86a.name: Seal of the Ancients
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Look at all face-down cards on your opponent's field, then return them to their original positions.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86e.name: Call of the Earthbound
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] You choose the attack target for your opponent's attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f872.name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f872.description: A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f873.name: Black Dragon's Chick
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f873.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f876.name: Dark Magician
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f876.description: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f879.name: Watangel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f879.description: A guitar that has descended to the lower realm. The tones it plays are angelic.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f886.name: Sevens Road Mage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f886.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 7 or higher monster on your opponent's field loses 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, it loses additional [number of Spellcaster Type monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 ATK until the end of this turn, if you have "Sevens Road Magician" face-up on your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f888.name: Full Meteor Impact
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f888.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 6 or higher monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f889.name: Sportsdragon Defender
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f889.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Sportsdragon Keeper" on your field in Attack Position, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position "Sportsdragon Keeper" on your field and 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88f.name: Esperade the Smashing Superstar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your LP are 1000 or lower.
[Effect] Destroy up to 2 monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f892.name: Beast Gear Emperor Catapult Kong
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f892.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 2 face-up Beast-Warrior Type monsters other than this card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy Defense Position monsters on your opponent's field equal to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f894.name: Wicked Shadow Dark Lurker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f894.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. Then, return this card to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a4.name: Double Block
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, send 2 Level 2 Normal Monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change up to 2 face-up monsters on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ab.name: Volcano Attack Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ab.description: A drill instructor for the Fire Dragon Kingdom's elite strike forces. The scorching heat he releases sweeps away those who would harm the king.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ae.name: Sea Dragon King Granganus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ae.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b2.name: The Noodle Art of Roastery
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Pyro Type monster on your field.
[Effect] All face-up Pyro Type monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of Normal Monsters in both players' Graveyards] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b5.name: Bait Bite Ball
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of face-up Level 3 or lower Fish Type monsters on your field] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b7.name: Beast Summoner
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up Level 6 or higher monster on their field, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast Type monster from your hand to your field, face-up.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8bb.name: Kuribotriple
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8bb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 "Kuribot" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8bc.name: Triple Threat Thunder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8bc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 face-up Aqua Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Change the original ATK of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field to 0 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8be.name: Stock the Noodle Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8be.description: A ninja who prides himself on being al dente. He constantly trains himself to reach the hardness of steel wire. He isn't great with water techniques.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c6.name: Masaki the Legendary Samurai
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c6.description: This legendary samurai is a veteran of over a hundred battles.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c8.name: Shield & Sword
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Switch the original ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters on the field until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ca.name: Block Attack
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ca.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8cf.name: Royal Rebel's Growl
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8cf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing a Level 5 or higher monster, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field loses ATK/DEF equal to [its Level] x 200 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d0.name: Royal Rebel's Rocker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 6 or higher Fiend Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. You cannot attack directly this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d3.name: Followl of the Dark Wisdom
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d3.description: A researcher of the nature of darkness. He serves a king who seeks to conquer the continent, but his true aims are unknown.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8db.name: Folder Blitz the Infinite Dream
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8db.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours.
[Effect] Inflict 1500 damage to the opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8de.name: Amusi Performer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8de.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 800 LP.
[Effect] Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e0.name: Concert Costume Creator
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e0.description: A designer that uses her psychic talents to make costumes for shows. She is stubborn and won't accept jobs from artists she doesn't like.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e5.name: Climax Finale
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay LP equal to [the number of Psychic Type monsters in your Graveyard] x 100.
[Effect] 1 face-up Psychic Type monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the number of Psychic Type monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ea.name: Summoned Skull
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ea.description: A fiend with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the Fiend Type monsters, this monster boasts considerable force.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f5.name: Sparkhearts Girl
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can Set 1 "Sparks" and/or 1 "Curtain of Sparks" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f6.name: Sieth, the Scabbard of Noble Arms
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 4 Warrior and/or Spellcaster Type monsters from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck in any order.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 Warrior Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fb.name: Burning Blaze Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Level 5 or lower Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck.
[Effect] Destroy a face-up Field Spell Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fc.name: Ancient Arise Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn. If you have "Clear Ice Dragon" and "Burning Blaze Dragon" in your Graveyard, you can also shuffle both into the Deck. If you do, you can destroy 1 face-up monster with 1500 or less DEF on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fd.name: Illusion Strike Dragon Miragias
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Up to 2 face-up Level 7 or lower monsters on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, if this card destroyed a monster by battle, it can make a second attack on a monster during that Battle Phase.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ff.name: Seahorse Server
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ff.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up LIGHT Attribute Aqua Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Gain 500 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f905.name: Anchor Moray
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f905.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Umi" or "Big Umi" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 3 or lower Fish Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f908.name: Survival Swordfish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f908.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 Fish Type monster on your field, place 1 Fish Type monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck.
[Effect] Up to 2 face-up Fish Type monsters on your field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90e.name: Shining City Nights
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up LIGHT Attribute monsters on the field gain 200 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90f.name: Aqua Boost
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Umi" or "Big Umi" face-up on your field.
[Effect] 1 face-up Fish Type monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Fish Type monsters on your field] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f911.name: Umi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f911.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, and Aqua Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF, and face-up Machine and Pyro Type monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91b.name: Silent Learning
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have Level 5 or higher monsters of at least 3 different Types in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Look at 1 face-down card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone then return it to its original position. If it was a Trap Card, place 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck and draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91c.name: Cranked to Ten!!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up monster on your field. This turn, it gains 400 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). If the monster's Level is 10, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91f.name: Yggdrago the Sky Emperor (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82b.name: Shining Shaman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 4 or lower Spellcaster Type monster on your field can attack directly this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82e.name: Magical Stream
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Spellcaster Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f838.name: Dragon Bat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f838.description: Even scholars argue whether this mysterious creature is a bird or a beast. When flying in swarms, they somewhat resemble dragons, so it is possible that's what they are.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83d.name: Dragon Encounter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Dragon Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83f.name: Sevens Road Witch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher, DARK Attribute, Spellcaster Type monster from your hand, face-up to your field. If you Special Summoned "Sevens Road Magician" by this effect, this card gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f846.name: Dragonic Slayer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f846.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monster other than this card on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f849.name: Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f849.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84a.name: Yamiruler the Dark Delayer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, change its battle position (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).
[Effect] Until the end of the opponent's next turn, while this card is face-up, neither player can Tribute Summon Level 7 or higher monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84f.name: Max Raider
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84f.description: An axe-wielding warrior. He has pushed himself to the limit in honing his body. The attacks from the two axes he brandishes are quite powerful.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f853.name: Defender of Dragon Sorcerers
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f853.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spellcaster or Dragon Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 monster on your field cannot be destroyed by an opponent's card effect this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f855.name: Recovery Force
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f855.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Spellcaster Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f856.name: Road Magic - Explosion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f856.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field, send 1 FIRE Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of cards on their field] x 400.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f858.name: Hammer Crush
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f858.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85a.name: Counter Cannonball
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the Level of the attacking monster] x 200.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85e.name: Machine Attacker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85e.description: This machine, created to lead charges into enemy territory, mows down enemies by rushing.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85f.name: LaMoon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85f.description: A sorcerer that draws its powers from the lunar landscape.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f861.name: Feral Imp
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f861.description: A playful little fiend that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86b.name: Sparks
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Inflict 200 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f874.name: Inferno Fire Blast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f874.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Inflict 2400 damage to your opponent. Your "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" cannot attack this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f875.name: Righteous Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f875.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Dragon Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Dragon Type monster in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f877.name: Sportsdragon Keeper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f877.description: A clutch player for the team. No matter what flies at him, he will risk his life to stop it.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f878.name: Wattkiss
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f878.description: Blows kisses that leave you tingling. They get the feeling across.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87a.name: Mammoth Graveyard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87a.description: A mammoth that protects the graves of its pack and is absolutely merciless when facing grave-robbers.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87c.name: Bubbly Elf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87c.description: This girl is delicate no more. While poised and collected, she's always down to party. Pager pals with LaMoon the Party Princess.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87e.name: Kanan the Sword Diva
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87e.description: A swordswoman who leads the vanguard in the entertainment district. Even in full makeup, she always carries her sword and shield. Friends with Bubbly Elf.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f880.name: Beast Gear Buggy Dog
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f880.description: A canine that extorts scraps of dog food from an old man. He is full of himself and acts tough, but has no real convictions. He used to hate living life on a leash, but now he feels that he was happier just to have an owner.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f884.name: Harpie Girl
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f884.description: A Harpie chick who aspires to flit about beautifully and gorgeously, but attack sharply.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f887.name: Lightning Voltcondor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f887.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your opponent's field with the same Attribute as the monster sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement lose ATK/DEF equal to [the Level of that monster sent to the Graveyard] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88c.name: Piercing Dragon Bunker Strike
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Draw cards equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field], then place cards from your hand equal to [the number of cards drawn by this effect] on either the top or bottom of the Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88d.name: Romanpick
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your LP are lower than your opponent's, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. If a Psychic Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, add 1 Psychic Type monster from the Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f890.name: Nandes the Fire Awakener
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f890.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Change 1 face-up Defense Position Warrior Type monster on your field to Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f891.name: Dian Keto the Boogie Master
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f891.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Gain 1000 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f897.name: Archfiend's Summoning Flute
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f897.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field and have 3 or more Normal Monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Send this card from your field to the Graveyard, then Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89a.name: Road Magic - Tectonic Shift
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field, send 1 EARTH Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the ATK of the monster with the highest ATK in your Graveyard] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89f.name: Dark Magic Attack
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Dark Magician" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a3.name: Party Time - Disco Ball
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 5 or higher monster.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Aqua Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a5.name: Driving Snow
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Trap Card(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on either side of the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a6.name: Siesta Hold
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 4 or lower monster while they have no other monsters on their field.
[Effect] Change that monster to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8aa.name: Silver Wolf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8aa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Beast Type monster on your field other than this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 200 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8af.name: Light Sorcerer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8af.description: A spellcaster who has devoted himself to the heavens. He is wreathed in divine blessings, but what fate awaits him?

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b9.name: Eldign Patrol Ship
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck.
[Effect] Look at 1 face-down card on your opponent's field, then return it to its original position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ba.name: Savage Claw Tiger
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Level 7 or higher monsters on your field] x 400 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c1.name: Umegumi the Ruler's Squad
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If a face-up Defense Position monster is on the field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c2.name: Yurushima Sage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change this Attack Position card to face-up Defense Position.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position, and if you do, it loses 600 DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c7.name: Crying Moon Rabbit
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c7.description: The days and months flowed by. Each day was full. Those really were the good old days.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8cb.name: Powerful Pierce!!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8cb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 2 face-up monsters on your field with the same Level as each other. If those monsters attack a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8cc.name: Scroll of Salutation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8cc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster while you have 2 or more face-up Level 5 or higher monsters on your field.
[Effect] Return 1 monster from your field to the owner's hand, also you can change all Attack Position monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d2.name: Palace Gargoyle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Increase this card's Level by 1 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d6.name: Royal Rebel's Fanatic
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d6.description: A girl who has trouble making eye contact when talking with others. She seeks friends and true love.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d7.name: King's Reward
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Level 1 Fiend Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 6 or lower monster on your opponent's field. If you do, your opponent draws 1 card. You cannot attack directly this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8dc.name: Berry Bassist
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8dc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Psychic Type monster other than this card on your field, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 2 Psychic Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e3.name: Elepsychic Amp Up
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose up to 2 face-up Level 2 or lower Psychic Type Normal Monsters on your field, and gain LP equal to [the total ATK of the chosen monsters].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e4.name: Psychic Divergence
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Psychic Type monster on your field, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Place 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's field on top of the owner's Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e8.name: Royal Rebel's Blues
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Fiend Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. You can only attack with Fiend Type monsters this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ec.name: Mushroom Man
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ec.description: Found in humid regions, this creature attacks enemies with a lethal rain of poison spores.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ef.name: Baby Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ef.description: Much more than just a child, this dragon is gifted with untapped power.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f2.name: Water Magician
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f2.description: This monster swamps an opponent with an almost endless supply of water.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f3.name: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f3.description: This monster moves so fast that it looks like an illusion to mortal eyes.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f4.name: Ojisan
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f4.description: A tired old fish that can't seem to get rid of his aches.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f9.name: Dragon Merchant
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 6 or lower Dragon Type monster on your field gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fa.name: Clear Ice Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Level 5 or lower Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck.
[Effect] Shuffle up to 2 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into their Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f902.name: Beast Gear Trike Fox
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f902.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and your opponent has 3 monsters on their field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower Beast-Warrior Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. Your Level 6 or lower monsters cannot attack this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f903.name: Beast Gear King Convoy Liogon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f903.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 face-up Level 4 or lower, Beast-Warrior Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the total Level of the monsters sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 100 until the end of this turn. Also this turn, you can only attack with this card, can only declare an attack on Attack Position monsters, and can attack all monsters on the opponent's monsters once each.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f904.name: Extra Spice the Elite Noodle Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f904.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Pyro Type Normal Monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f920.name: Yggdrago the Sky Emperor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f920.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Yggdrago the Sky Emperor [L]" and "Yggdrago the Sky Emperor [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f923.name: Femtron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f923.description: The source of the draconic tree that holds the secret of all providence. When assailed by microcosm and macrocosm, the world will be guided to a new domain.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f926.name: Yoctron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f926.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 "Femtron", 1 "Attron", and 1 "Zeptron" from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck in any order.
[Effect] Send this card from your field to the Graveyard and draw 3 cards. Then, send 3 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f928.name: Trap Hole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f928.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster with 1000 or more ATK.
[Effect] Destroy that monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92c.name: Washsprayer the Cleansketeer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field.
[Effect] Shuffle 1 "Bleach Mortar" from your Graveyard into the Deck. Then draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f931.name: Cat's Eye
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f931.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 face-up Beast Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Your opponent declares 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) and sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard. If it was not the declared card type, all face-up monsters on your field can attack directly this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f933.name: Thunderbeetle Bassdrum
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f933.description:
A gentle but powerful and trustworthy creature that stands in the background.
It sends out its sounds every day with the belief that it will find friends it can resonate with.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f938.name: Thunderbeetle Boost
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f938.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster with ATK greater than your LP declares an attack while you have a face-up Thunder Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Gain LP equal to [the ATK of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93a.name: Dahut, Dark Ruler of the Chair
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the Level of 1 other face-up monster on your field with 0 ATK] x 500 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93c.name: Scarechair Bone
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93c.description: One of the earliest organic chairs said to be made by a family of artisans. Has a distinctive feel when sat upon.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f946.name: Shrinker Shrimp
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f946.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 2 face-up Cyberse Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f947.name: Heavenly Gift
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f947.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send any number of monsters from your hand to the Graveyard. If [the total Levels of those monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] is 10 or higher, you can draw 2 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94a.name: Necromaid Nana
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Place 1 Level 7 monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck and draw 2 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94b.name: Psychic Burial
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if your opponent has 3 monsters on their field, you can send 1 additional card from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94c.name: Cure Shot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Gain LP equal to [the Level of 1 WATER Attribute monster in your Graveyard] x 100, and inflict damage to your opponent equal to [that monster's Level] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f954.name: Constructor Soldier Drillzard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f954.description: A humanoid reincarnated from a dragon. His masterful strategy and deft hands help reduce construction times considerably.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95f.name: Descendant of Titans
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95f.description: A successor of old gods. Skilled at hiding, few know of their existence.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f962.name: Steel Mech Lord Mirror Innovator
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f962.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose up to 3 monsters in your Graveyard with the same Type as this card. This card gains ATK equal to [the total Levels of those monsters] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, shuffle those monsters into the Deck. If you shuffled exactly 1 monster by this effect, this card inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference), if it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f965.name: Tama the Mancer Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f965.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have another face-up monster with 0 ATK on your field.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. If a monster(s) with 0 ATK is among the cards sent, you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f969.name: Wyrm Excavator the Heavy Cavalry Draco
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f969.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Wyrm Excavator the Heavy Cavalry Draco [L]" and "Wyrm Excavator the Heavy Cavalry Draco [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96c.name: Nuncharinet the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up monster on their field.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. If you sent a WIND Attribute Warrior Type monster to the Graveyard by this effect, 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK/DEF equal to [the number of face-up WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters on your field] x 500 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96f.name: Gingangel, the Deluxe Sushi Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent's LP are 4000 or higher, send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict damage equal to [the ATK of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field] to your opponent. This turn, you can only attack with this card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f970.name: Drilling Mandrill
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f970.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Change face-down Defense Position monsters on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position, up to [the number of face-up Machine Type monsters on your field]. The original ATK of the monsters changed to face-up Attack Position by this effect become 0 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f973.name: Anmagmabear
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f973.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, place 1 Pyro Type monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck.
[Effect] Add 1 Pyro Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f975.name: Magmassage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f975.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 4 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 4 or lower monster on either side of the field gains ATK equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 500 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f978.name: Type Change Beam
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f978.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 monster in your hand.
[Effect] Choose up to 3 face-up monsters on the field. This turn, those monsters become the same Type as the monster revealed to meet the requirement.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97a.name: Evil Star Beacon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no Attack Position monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 2 LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type Normal Monsters whose total Levels equal 10 or less, from your Graveyard in face-up Attack Position to your field. This turn, you can only attack with Fiend Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97f.name: Music Princess's Breath
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 face-up WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field, but it cannot attack directly this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f982.name: Apocalypse - The Unstoppable Beast-Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f982.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Apocalypse - Beast Gear World" face-up on your field, pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Beast-Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. If the monster Special Summoned by this effect attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f983.name: Fiery Blaze
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f983.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Pyro Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Inflict 300 damage to your opponent. Then, if you inflicted damage to your opponent by this effect, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98a.name: Heavy Cavalry Starter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 5 or higher monster.
[Effect] Change the battle position of 1 face-up Machine Type monster on your field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position). If you do, that monster on your field gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98e.name: Jewelry Trap Hole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster while you have 3 face-up Aqua Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f999.name: Tyhone
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f999.description: Capable of firing cannonballs from its mouth for long-range attacks, this creature is particularly effective in mountain battles.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99c.name: Dian Keto the Security Master
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Look at your opponent's hand and send 1 card from it to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a Level 7 or higher monster to the Graveyard by this effect, gain 1000 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a0.name: Buster Blader
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of Dragon Type monsters on your opponent's field and in their Graveyard] x 500.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a8.name: Bombing Bird
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a8.description: A bird that releases bombs. There may be little people inside.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ad.name: Ice Age Catapult
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, place 1 WATER Attribute monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Return 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's field to the owner's hand. Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 600 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9af.name: Hyper Engine Vast Vulcan
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9af.description:
