You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Hyper Engine Vast Vulcan [L]" and "Hyper Engine Vast Vulcan [R]".

[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b0.name: Hyper Engine Vast Vulcan (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on either side of the field loses ATK equal to [its Level] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [that monster's Level] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b2.name: Endoll
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send this card from your field to the Graveyard. Then, you can Set up to 2 "Climax Finale" and/or "Psychic Introduction" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b5.name: Wondering Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 Warrior and/or Winged Beast Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard to your field in face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b6.name: Icezark the Unequaled
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 2 Level 7 or higher Warrior Type monsters with different names from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c3.name: Maginical Miracle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c3.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c5.name: Kheiron the Star Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c5.description:

[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Level 5 or higher Fiend Type monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c7.name: JAM:P Start!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c7.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ca.name: Transmigration of Curiosity
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ca.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9cd.name: Last Day of Beautiful Witch

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ce.name: Hydration
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ce.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Aqua Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Gain 500 LP. Then, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9cf.name: Shadow Flower Spore
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9cf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Level 4 or lower Plant Type Normal Monster in your Graveyard, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Plant Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field, but place it on the bottom of the Deck during the End Phase.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9dd.name: Laughing Grass
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9dd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Plant Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned a Normal Monster by this effect, you can Special Summon up to 2 Level 1 Plant Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e2.name: Jasmine the Shadow Flower Festival
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Plant Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Change 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position. Then, if the monster changed to face-up Attack Position by this effect was EARTH Attribute, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e3.name: Nullstrike Dragon Zerogias
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change the original ATK of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field to 0 until the end of this turn. This turn, if this card attacked a monster, it can make a second attack on a monster during that Battle Phase.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e9.name: Dynamic Dino Dynamix
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e9.description:

[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: If your opponent has no face-up Level 9 or higher monsters on their field, send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy up to 2 monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ea.name: Dynamic Dino Dynamix (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ea.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ed.name: Ritzy King Rex
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ed.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has no cards in their hand.
[Effect] Each player draws 1 card, then, if both players drew by this effect, you can Set 1 "Upstart Goblin" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ee.name: Supressaurus Sternptera
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ee.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can place 1 random card from the opponent's hand on the bottom of their Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f2.name: Jurassic World
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f4.name: Dinosaur Crush
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Dinosaur Type monster on your field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-down card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f5.name: Upstart Goblin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f9.name: Cycliptron

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fa.name: Tribute to The Doomed
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fa.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fb.name: Dahut Abyss, Dark Mirror Ruler of the Chair
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle any number of monsters with 0 ATK from your Graveyard into the Deck.

This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters shuffled into the Deck to meet the requirement] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fc.name: Scarechair Relaxer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster with 0 ATK from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f906.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 Winged Beast Type monster with 1500 or more ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f913.name: Soul of a Reporter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f913.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an Attack Position monster(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon either 1 "Printing Presser" or 1 "Scoop Scooter" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91a.name: Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the Level of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field] x 200 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92b.name: Scrubbing Santa Cloth
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal Summoned or Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Your opponent draws cards equal to [the number of monsters on their field]. Then, you gain LP equal to [the number of cards they drew by this effect] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92e.name: Odd-Eyes Twin Tail Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92e.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f935.name: Thunderbeetle Snare
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f935.description:
Popular, unique, and always energetic.
It sends out its sounds every day with the belief that it will find friends it can resonate with.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f936.name: Thunderbeetle Gift
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f936.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f939.name: Throne of Darkness
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f939.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f967.name: Semeruler the Dark Summoner

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f968.name: Wyrm Excavator the Heavy Cavalry Draco (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f968.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f974.name: Aromagmabear
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f974.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Gain LP equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f976.name: Magmax Mantleveda
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f976.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Pyro Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Defense Position monsters on the field with the same Level as the monster sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f979.name: Ancient Barrier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f979.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters with the same Type from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, up to 2 face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97d.name: Geological Survey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Excavate cards from the top of your Deck equal to [the number of cards on the opponent's field]. Then, place the excavated cards on either the top or bottom of your Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f984.name: Grand Extreme
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f984.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Fish or Sea Serpent Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, shuffle up to 5 monsters from the opponent's Graveyard into their Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f987.name: Sword & Shield
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f987.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 9 or lower monster declares an attack targeting your Attack Position monster.
[Effect] Switch the original ATK and DEF of the attacking monster until the end of this turn. Switch the original ATK and DEF of the attack target until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Shield & Sword" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f991.name: Picklon the Constructor Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f991.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Wyrm Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f996.name: Trumpet Charge
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f996.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your Warrior Type monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Warrior Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99d.name: Sevens Road Warlock
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 7 or higher DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if you added "Sevens Road Magician" to your hand by this effect, you can add 1 Level 6 or higher Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a2.name: CAN:D
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a2.description: Carrying infinite potential, she continues to chase her shining dream with a smile on her face.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a4.name: Guarding Mermaid
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a4.description: A fierce mermaid that torments the damned who fell to hell. She has a great reputation of making recidivists beg "I will never do anything bad again, please forgive me".

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a6.name: Kurobana the Shadow Flower Wolf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a6.description: A group of grass ninjas who protect their lord from crises, while concealed in the shadow. Even if they are struck down, they strike back from the shadows of blades of grass.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ab.name: Baked Bean Soldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ab.description: A surprisingly hot plant-warrior that attacks with seeds and sword.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ac.name: Metal Armored Ant
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ac.description: A gigantic ant-like creature covered by thick armor. Everything in its path that tries to harm the forest will be blocked.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b1.name: Fortitude Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster with 2000 or more ATK on your opponent's field loses 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can Set 1 "Dragon's Fortitude" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b3.name: CAN - Re:D
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Return 1 face-up monster with 500 or less ATK from your field to the hand. This turn, while this card is face-up, you cannot Tribute Summon monsters with 1500 or more DEF in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b4.name: Takegumi the Ruler's Squad
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field and you have a monster with 0 ATK in your Graveyard, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters with 0 ATK in your Graveyard] x 200 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b7.name: Royal Rebel's Phaser
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Fiend Type monster on your field, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Fiend Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ba.name: Acacia the Shadow Flower Priestess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Plant Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Change 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position. Then, if you changed a monster to face-up Attack Position by this effect, gain LP equal to [that monster's original ATK].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9bc.name: Etraynze the Shadow Flower Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9bc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Etraynze the Shadow Flower Ninja" in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Send 1 Plant Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, Special Summon 1 "Etraynze the Shadow Flower Ninja" from your Graveyard face-up to your field, but place it on the bottom of the Deck during the End Phase. This turn, this card cannot attack directly.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9be.name: Garland the True Shadow Flower Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9be.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Plant Type monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower Plant Type monster from your hand face-up to your field, but place it on the bottom of the Deck during the End Phase.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9bf.name: Gatling the Shadow Flower Shinobi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9bf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 Plant Type Normal Monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy up to 2 Attack Position Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters destroyed by this effect] x 500. This turn, you can only attack with 1 monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c0.name: Blasting Bird
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 2 Spell/Trap Cards in your hand.
[Effect] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Winged Beast Type monster in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c6.name: JAM:P Up!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Psychic Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 Psychic Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. If you sent "CAN:D" to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, the monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d0.name: Majinrai, the Striking Storm
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up "Summoned Skull" or a face-up Level 7 or higher Fiend Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Send 1 Normal Monster from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, inflict 1300 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d1.name: Nature's Invasion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Plant Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d5.name: Bursting Your Bubble
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Level 8 or higher Aqua Type monster.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 600 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if your opponent has a face-up Spellcaster Type monster on their field, 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 1,000,000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d6.name: Shadow Flower Stance
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Plant Type monster, shuffle 2 Plant Type monsters from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[Effect] Change all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d9.name: Clowning Cookoo Clock
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster and you have a face-up Winged Beast Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Night Vision the Phantom Pigeon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, gain 1500 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9db.name: Archfiend's Revival
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9db.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your "Summoned Skull" or Level 7 or higher Fiend Type Normal Monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e6.name: Supreme Skystream Magnum Overlord (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, this card cannot attack directly, it can attack all your opponent's monsters once each, also it inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e8.name: Dynamic Dino Dynamix (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by battle with Level 7 or lower monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ec.name: Mech Therizinoraptor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ec.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Dinosaur Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f0.name: Celebrontosaurus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f0.description: A newly rich Saurus who changed its name from Petite and became absurdly lucky. It used to live in a cave of all things.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f6.name: Ascending Evolution
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 7 or higher monster.
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up Level 7 or higher Dinosaur Type monster on your field gains 1500 ATK, and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f8.name: Seedchrotron Brusselun
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a Cyberse Type monster was sent to the Graveyard by this effect, you can add Cyberse Type monsters with 0 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand, up to [the number of face-up monsters on your opponent's field].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fe.name: Darkness Ri-chair-al
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fe.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a DARK Attribute monster in your Graveyard, send 3 face-up DARK Attribute monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 DARK Attribute monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have 3 DARK Attribute monsters with the same name in your Graveyard, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa00.name: Constructor Demolisher Wyrm Drake Crush
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa00.description: A Constructor Wyrm enveloped in specialized construction gear. It is said that no matter the size of the project, the wyrm could demolish the site in one blow.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa02.name: Constructor Art - Buildestruction
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa02.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] All face-up Level 7 or higher Wyrm Type Normal Monsters on your field gain 600 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can make all face-up monsters with 3000 or more ATK on your opponent's field lose 1200 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa04.name: Clubinet the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa04.description: The jack of all trades of the band. The gentle melody fills weight in each swing. The top of the head glows when excited.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa05.name: Horn Knives the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa05.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a Warrior Type monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can add 1 Warrior Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa08.name: Music Princess Art - Triplet
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa08.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, if they have 3 monsters on their field.
[Effect] All face-up WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0d.name: Spider Roll the Sushi Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0d.description: A follower of the gods that dine in the Divine Sushi Realm. All of the rice is swept over by their characteristic seaweed and peculiar aroma.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0e.name: Inside Out Roll
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 5 or higher Fairy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn, then, if your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours, that monster loses 1500 more ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa01.name: Silvermountain of Blisstopia
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa01.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, if a player would Tribute Summon a Level 7 or higher Wyrm Type monster in Attack Position, they require only 1 Tribute.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa03.name: Constructor Resurrection
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa03.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your Level 7 or higher Wyrm Type monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Wyrm Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa07.name: Music Princess's Whirling Wind
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa07.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 5 or higher WIND Attribute Warrior Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Change up to 2 Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0f.name: Angel Judge
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Fairy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Place 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field on the bottom of the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa10.name: Rolled Sticky Save
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa10.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] 1 Attack Position Fairy Type monster on your field cannot be destroyed by battle this turn. Your opponent gains LP equal to [that monster's ATK].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa11.name: Rolled Hot Arrow
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa11.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] Inflict 500 damage to your opponent, then, if you have a face-up Fairy Type monster on your field, you can Special Summon 1 Fairy Type monster from your hand to your field face-up.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa12.name: Upgrade Goblin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa12.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower monster from your hand to your field face-up. The monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Upstart Goblin" in your Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa13.name: Heavenly Revelation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa13.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send any number of monsters from your field to the Graveyard. Then, if [the total original Levels of those monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] is 10 or higher, you can Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. The monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d16af18b8fbb2736897404.name: Twin Edge Dragon
64d16af18b8fbb2736897404.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card can attack twice during this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f824.name: Torna the Windweaver
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f824.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f827.name: Dark Sorcerer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f827.description: A sorcerer whose hands have been tainted by the forbidden arts. He does not yet know the price for the power he desired.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f831.name: Multistrike Dragon Dragias
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f831.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, if this card destroyed a monster by battle, it can make a second attack during that Battle Phase.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f833.name: Fire Guardian
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f833.description: The gatekeeper standing watch over the path to the Fire Dragon Kingdom. Those who cannot withstand its breath do not have the right to go past it.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f839.name: Phoenix Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f839.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83e.name: Vengeful Dragon's Counterattack
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Dragon Type monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f843.name: Fire Golem
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f843.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 600 LP.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 600 DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f844.name: Whispering Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f844.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle up to 2 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f848.name: Sportsdragon Pitcher
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f848.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Sportsdragon Slugger" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. This turn, your Level 6 and lower monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84b.name: Ancient Turtle Protector
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84b.description: A respecter of tradition that reminisces about times long past. Those really were the good old days.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f859.name: One-Side Reverse
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f859.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or more face-down monsters on their field.
[Effect] Change 1 face-down monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85c.name: 1-Up
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f864.name: Silver Fang
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f864.description: A snow wolf that's beautiful to the eye, but absolutely vicious in battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f867.name: Binding Chain
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f867.description: The mystic links of this chain can rob enemies of their power.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f868.name: Petit Moth
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f868.description: This small but deadly creature is better off avoided.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86c.name: Mountain
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Dragon, Winged Beast, and Thunder Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86d.name: Darkness Approaches
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 face-up monster on either side of the field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86f.name: Gust
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f86f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Spell Card on your field is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on either side of the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87b.name: Megazowler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87b.description: Nothing stands in the way of this spike-covered dinosaur!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87d.name: LaMoon the Party Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87d.description: A sorceress that has escaped dull, everyday life. She uses lunar magic to captivate affluent men. Besties with Kanan the Sword Diva.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f881.name: Beast Gear Moto Wolf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f881.description: A beast continually looting citizens of their food and gasoline. He might appear to be a lone wolf, but he believes that evil is right and does everything he can for his gang. For such a wicked criminal, one can't help but wonder why his distant howls touch the heart so deeply.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f882.name: Jet Barracuda
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f882.description: This creature uses jet propulsion to charge in shocking speeds. Some wonder whether it even is a fish.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f883.name: Heat Dartfish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f883.description: A fish with a proboscis that heats up when attacking. Its mild flavor makes it a true delicacy.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f885.name: Vishwar Randi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f885.description: This lady warrior with unquenchable bloodlust serves the forces of darkness.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88a.name: Sportsdragon Striker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Sportsdragon Keeper" on your field in Attack Position, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up monster on your field gains 400 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88b.name: Shock Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Until the end of this turn, all face-up monsters with the highest ATK on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the ATK of the face-up monster with the highest ATK on your field]. This card can only attack Attack Position monsters this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88e.name: Romic n' Roller
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f88e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your LP are 2000 or lower.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK and DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f893.name: Super King Rex
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f893.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Dinosaur Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f896.name: Hydro Cannon Big Bluefin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f896.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Up to 2 face-up Fish Type monsters on your field with 1000 or less ATK can attack directly this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f899.name: Innocent Lancer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f899.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] If this card attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89b.name: Lullabind
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Psychic Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89c.name: Party Party Party
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Change all Attack Position Aqua Type monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position, and gain LP equal to [the number of monsters changed to face-up Defense Position by this effect] x 400.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89d.name: Apocalypse - Beast Gear World
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Beast-Warrior, Fiend, and Machine Type monsters on the field gain 300 ATK, and face-up Dragon, Spellcaster, and Fairy Type monsters on the field lose 300 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89e.name: Thousand Knives
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f89e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Dark Magician" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a1.name: Attribute Shift Bomb
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 monster in your hand to your opponent.
[Effect] The Attributes of up to 3 face-up monsters on your opponent's field become the same as the monster revealed to meet the requirement.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a8.name: Phantom Bind
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses ATK equal to [the number of monsters with its same Type in your opponent's Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a9.name: Road Magic - Flowback
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field, send 1 WATER Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Return 1 monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ad.name: Dragon's Fortitude
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses ATK equal to [the Level of 1 Dragon Type monster in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, shuffle that monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b1.name: Printing Presser
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Your opponent excavates the top 5 cards of their Deck. This card gains ATK equal to [the number of excavated monsters] x 100 until the end of this turn. Your opponent places the excavated cards on the bottom of their Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b3.name: Thousand Attack Rocket
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Normal Monster on your field with 1000 or less ATK gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b4.name: Wasteland
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Dinosaur, Zombie, and Rock Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b6.name: Return
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent adds a card from the Graveyard to the hand.
[Effect] Shuffle 1 random card from your opponent's hand into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8bd.name: Counter Shield
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8bd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Normal Monster, shuffle 1 Normal Monster with 1000 or more DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c0.name: Kimeruler the Dark Raider
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has no Attack Position monsters on their field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card can attack directly, also you can only attack with Warrior Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c4.name: Blue Falcon Tengu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c4.description: A ruthless tengu who leaves opponents stunned by attacking without mercy.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c9.name: Bonded Bowing
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change 1 Attack Position Level 7 or higher Warrior Type monster on your field to face-up Defense Position.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ce.name: Royal Rebel's Invasion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ce.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing 2 Level 5 or higher monsters.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 4 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d4.name: Garmr the Lone Wolf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d4.description: A beast that has refused divine protection, exchanging tranquility for freedom.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d5.name: Babysitter Goat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d5.description: A playmate for children of the underworld. Though it is a hard worker, it eats any paper it sees. As its ward grows into an adult, its magical power also grows.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d8.name: Genie's Fire Breath
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Fiend Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Return 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8da.name: Rebel's Scream
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8da.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, send 2 Fiend Type monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8df.name: Psy Stage Bouncer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8df.description: The psychic menace has been growing in recent years, and a crack team of bodyguards has been entrusted to protect Psychic Diva, the key to solving it all.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e7.name: Severing Psychic Wall
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Psychic Type monster, shuffle 1 Psychic Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] The attack target gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ed.name: Niwatori
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ed.description: Swallows enemies whole and uses their essence as energy.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f0.name: Hitotsu-Me Giant
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f0.description: A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f1.name: Doriado
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f1.description: A spirit of the forest powered by the surrounding trees and wildlife.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f7.name: Bendorbreak the Conqueror
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If [the number of face-up monsters on your opponent's field] and [the number of Spell/Trap Cards on your field] are the same, send up to 3 Spell/Trap Cards from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK/DEF equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 1000 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f8.name: Treasure Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8f8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 4 or more Dragon Type monsters in your Graveyard during your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card from your hand or the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f909.name: Darkness Crested Hawk
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f909.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up LIGHT Attribute monster on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Winged Beast Type monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90a.name: Rightful Magic
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up monsters with the same Attribute on your field.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90c.name: Blazing Chestnut
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Warrior Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a monster is sent to the Graveyard by this effect, 1 face-up Warrior Type monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the Level of the monster sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 300 until the end of this turn and you take the same amount of damage.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f910.name: Big Umi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f910.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if you have 3 face-up WATER Attribute monsters on your field.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up non-WATER Attribute monsters on the field lose 300 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f912.name: Forest
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f912.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Insect, Beast, Plant, and Beast-Warrior Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f914.name: Counter Pigeons
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f914.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your Attack Position Winged Beast Type monster.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses ATK equal to [the Level of the attacking monster] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d16a528cdac9eb7407d7a5.name: Mystic Dealer
64d16a528cdac9eb7407d7a5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spellcaster Type Monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 Card

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f826.name: Hydro Magician
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f826.description: A young wizard who can communicate telepathically with water. His brilliant blue dance leaves his foes in awe.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f829.name: Magical Beast Wolfang
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f829.description: The former familiar of a well-known magician. At some point its magical power surpassed that of its master, and it now toys with its foes by manipulating flames at will.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82c.name: Straynge Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82c.description: A familiar said to hold great powers. It doesn't like being alone, and is very lonely now that it's been separated from its friends.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82d.name: Wind Spirit's Protection
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Spellcaster Type monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of the turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82f.name: Dark Revelation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f82f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 4 Spellcaster Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f830.name: Curtain of Sparks
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f830.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack and you have a Spellcaster Type monster in your Graveyard.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f832.name: Gravity Press Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f832.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 700 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f834.name: Dragon Knight of Darkness
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f834.description: A dragon knight leading a dark army. His merciless attacks have unparalleled strength, and the cursed sword he wields devours the souls of his foes and makes him stronger.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83a.name: Draco the Tiny
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83a.description: A small peace-loving dragon that will affectionately approach you if fed some nuts. The ring on its necklace is rumored to hold a great secret.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83b.name: Dragonic Pressure
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f83b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 3 Dragon Type monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all monsters on the field. If you destroyed a monster by this effect, Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f841.name: Raidacross, Hero of the Dawn
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f841.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Spellcaster Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 Level 5 or lower Spellcaster Type monsters face-up from your hand to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f842.name: Hilt, the Bearer of Noble Arms
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f842.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] 1 Attack Position Warrior Type monster on your field gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84e.name: Battle Shark Samegalon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f84e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 WATER Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f850.name: Diabolic King Beetle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f850.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the number of Level 1 monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f851.name: Sonic Attacker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f851.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Your opponent gains 1000 LP. This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85b.name: Brutal Retribution
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f85b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When 2 or more face-up Normal Monsters on your field are destroyed at the same time by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f862.name: Lesser Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f862.description: A minor dragon incapable of breathing fire.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f863.name: Arma Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f863.description: An ammonite warrior that has protected the seas throughout history.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f866.name: Little D
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f866.description: Yo, this tyrannosaurus tot's got a terrible temper.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f870.name: Mask of Volos
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f870.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change the original ATK of 1 face-up Level 6 or lower monster on your opponent's field to 1500 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f871.name: Gaia The Fierce Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f871.description: A knight whose horse travels faster than the wind. His battle-charge is a force to be reckoned with.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87f.name: Beast Gear Gyro Jackal
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f87f.description: A beast that drives around wildly, always in search of some fun. He is petty, and only picks fights he thinks he can win, so he often falls to unexpected counterattacks. He grows uninhibited when he's got friends around, which leads to misunderstandings, and he still hasn't figured out that he can't do anything on his own.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f895.name: Royal Rebel's Heavy Metal
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f895.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing a Level 5 or higher monster.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster with the lowest Level on your opponent's field, and this card gains ATK equal to [that monster's ATK] until the end of this turn. Destroy that monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f898.name: Shaman Octopus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f898.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 800 LP.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the Level of 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, shuffle that monster into your Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a0.name: Blades of Divine Wind
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Destroy 2 face-up Normal Monsters on your field and 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a7.name: Rage and Conspiracy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8a7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster while you have 2 or more different Types of Normal Monster(s) on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 6 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ac.name: Burst Breath of Destruction
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ac.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Dragon Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 6 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b0.name: Echeclus the Star Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b0.description: A man who carries the power of an evil star. He charges across the battlefield each day, filled with faith in his own sense of justice.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b8.name: Long Shield Gardna
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8b8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change this card's battle position (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up Normal Monster with 2000 or more DEF on your field gains 500 ATK, and cannot be destroyed by an opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8bf.name: The Noodle Art of Savory
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8bf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the number of face-up Pyro Type monsters on your field] x 400 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c3.name: Yurushima Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Warrior Type monster on your field. Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when it declares an attack this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c5.name: Yurushima the Hermit
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8c5.description: A living ball of desires, he criticizes others, but not himself. He's that kind of hermit.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8cd.name: Hermit's Soul
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8cd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up monster with 0 ATK.
[Effect] Change the attacking monster to face-up Defense Position. If you do, Special Summon 1 Normal Monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d1.name: Royal Rebel's Shout
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send up to 2 random cards from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d9.name: King's Majesty
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8d9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 1 Level 1 Fiend Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Negate the attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8dd.name: Telepathic Agent
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8dd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent's LP are at least 1000 higher than yours, shuffle 1 Psychic Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This card can attack directly this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e1.name: Keytar Kid
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e1.description: The youngest member of the band, she's often teased by Romic n' Roller, but everyone recognizes her talents. She dreams of the day she'll play on stage with her bandmates as a quintet.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e2.name: Howlingbird
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e2.description: A bird that constantly emits sound as it flies with the wind. It is said the noise its wings make reflects the heart of the listener. To some it sounds like a beautiful song, but to others it's an ominous drone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e6.name: Psychic Introduction
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster.
[Effect] Gain LP equal to [the number of face-up Psychic Type monsters on your field] x 500.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e9.name: Bascule the Moving Fortress
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8e9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change this card's battle position (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position). Then, Special Summon 1 EARTH Attribute Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8eb.name: Scoop Scooter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8eb.description: Delivers the morning edition before breakfast! Also delivers the evening edition before breakfast!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ee.name: Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8ee.description: A fiery mouse, travelling the world to become the strongest fighter in the world of mice. Be careful not to touch him, or you will get burned.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fe.name: Kesshin the Dark Decimator
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f8fe.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send your entire hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 600 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f900.name: Seahorse Carrier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f900.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 LIGHT Attribute Aqua Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f901.name: Vishwar Lambadi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f901.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add 1 "Shining City Nights" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f907.name: Luminous Parrot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f907.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 2 or more face-up monsters on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] The Attribute of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field becomes LIGHT this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90b.name: Dragon's Return
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Dragon Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90d.name: The Noodle Art of Spicery
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f90d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up Pyro Type monster on your field gains 300 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f915.name: Giant Tortoise of Greed
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f915.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f916.name: Triple Trio
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f916.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have 3 face-up Level 3 Normal Monsters on your field.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your field gain 900 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f918.name: Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f918.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: If your LP are lower than your opponent's, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the difference between your LP and your opponent's LP] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91d.name: Magiquartet Shock
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK face-up, shuffle 4 Normal Monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91e.name: Widening Whisper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f91e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Sets a monster from their hand.
[Effect] Both players shuffle up to 5 monsters from their Graveyards into the owner's Decks.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f925.name: Zeptron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f925.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field and have "Femtron" and "Attron" in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Send this card from your field to the Graveyard and draw 2 cards. Then, place 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f927.name: Pair Production
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f927.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 Level 5 or lower Cyberse Type monsters with the same Level from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the Level of 1 of the monsters sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 400 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f929.name: Quantum Hole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f929.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Cyberse Type monster on your field is destroyed in battle by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards. Then, place 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92a.name: Clean Beret - Colonel Mop
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field.
[Effect] Place 1 "Bleach Mortar" from your Graveyard on top of your Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f930.name: Blue-Eyes White Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f930.description: A white cat with blue eyes. Said to bring good luck if treated well.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f932.name: Lost Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f932.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Your opponent declares a card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) and sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard. If it was not the declared card type, negate the attack, and inflict 300 damage to the opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f937.name: Thunderbeetle Storm
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f937.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 face-up Level 4 or lower Thunder Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower Effect Monsters on your opponent's field. If you destroyed any monster by this effect, you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93b.name: Scarechair Gear
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93b.description: A mechanical chair that is easy to mass produce. It is not as comfortable to sit in as the organic chairs from before.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93e.name: Collapsing Chairs
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your Attack Position DARK Attribute monster with 0 ATK is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Destroy all Level 8 or lower Attack Position monsters on the field. Then, each player sends cards equal to [the number of monsters destroyed by this effect] from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93f.name: Cosmic String Noodryad
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f93f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If "Outer Space" is face-up on the field, send 2 Pyro Type monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 7 or lower monsters on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f941.name: Cosmoscallion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f941.description: A maiden who freely drifts around the Milky Way like a shooting star. Countless people make wishes on her, but she dryly states that real dreams are the ones you can fulfill on your own.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f917.name: Faulty Fire
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f917.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Spell/Trap Card(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 6 or lower Effect Monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f919.name: Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f919.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord [L]" and "Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f922.name: Peacock Picotron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f922.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field and have "Femtron" in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Send this card from your field to the Graveyard and draw 2 cards. Then, send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92d.name: Bleach Mortar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 7 or higher monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92f.name: Red-Eyes Black Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f92f.description: A black cat with red eyes. Said to bring bad luck to those around it.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f934.name: Thunderbeetle Highhat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f934.description:
A multifaceted older brother type.
It sends out its sounds every day with the belief that it will find friends it can resonate with.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f943.name: Outer Space
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f943.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Level 4 or lower monsters on the field lose 300 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94d.name: Mokey Mokey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94d.description: An outcast angel. Nobody knows what he is thinking at all. Sometimes he gets mad and that is dreadful.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94e.name: Shovel Crusher
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94e.description: Armed with a pair of shovels, this monster will destroy anything that stands in its way.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94f.name: Gokibore
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f94f.description: A large, spherical roach that attacks its enemies by rolling over them.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f951.name: Ancient Telescope
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f951.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Your opponent excavates the top 5 cards of their Deck and shows them, then your opponent places the excavated cards on the top of their Deck in the same order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f955.name: Constructor Warrior Shovelon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f955.description: A young warrior. Each day he passionately uses his shovel to dig up work sites.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f958.name: Flutomahawk the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f958.description: The vanguard of the band. She creates beautiful melodies by swinging her axes through the air. Some believe she chooses her outfit to hide her weaponry, but it's just because she gets cold easily.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95a.name: Oppressed Ant
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95a.description: An ant who is oppressed, but believes it will have freedom someday.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95c.name: Ants Running About
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95c.description: Although they always suffer in silence, they swear an oath to inevitably revolt.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f966.name: Modorina the Light Retriever
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f966.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Return 1 face-up Level 7 or higher Warrior Type monster from your field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f971.name: Shield Boring Kong
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f971.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-down Defense Position monster on your opponent's field. If you do, this card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97b.name: Peaks of Blisstopia
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Wyrm Type monsters on the field gain 400 ATK and lose 400 DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f981.name: Apocalypse - Legend of the Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f981.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Beast-Warrior Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Beast-Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f989.name: Constructor Blockade
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f989.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 7 or higher monster, send 1 face-up Wyrm Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field. This turn, your opponent cannot attack with monsters with the same Type as that monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98b.name: Gi-ant Revolution
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent's monster declares an attack while you have 3 face-up Insect Type monsters with 100 or less ATK on your field.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98c.name: Antiberty Flag
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Insect Type monster with 100 or less ATK from your hand or your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98d.name: Earth Pressure Explosion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an Attack Position Pyro Type monster(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their Trap Card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Magmassage" or 1 "Magmax Mantleveda" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have an EARTH Attribute Pyro Type monster in your Graveyard, gain 1000 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f992.name: Ensembullfighter the Music Fiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f992.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, while this card is face-up, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when your WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters declare attacks.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f995.name: Stardom Light
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f995.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Normal Monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Psychic Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, if you sent a Level 2 or lower monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, gain 1000 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f997.name: Volcanic Rat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f997.description: This mutated mouse dwells in the core of active volcanoes. No amount of heat is too much for it to bear.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f998.name: Tristegatops
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f998.description: A dinosaur that lives in a herd. It looks tough, but it's not really that strong.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99a.name: Bean Soldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99a.description: A plant-warrior that attacks with seeds and sword.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99e.name: Triad Drago
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field and you have 2 face-up non-Level 3 Dragon Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99f.name: Monster Reincarnation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a1.name: The Fire Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a1.description: A very beautiful dragon covered with FIRE. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a3.name: Royal Rebel's No Wave
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a3.description: A bizarre demonic devil who serves the King. It absorbs every sound and repels every attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a5.name: Kanan the Security Guard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a5.description: A lady warrior whose main battlefield is a prison island. Armed with sword and shield, she rebukes harshly. She has a great reputation of bringing recidivists back to their senses.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a7.name: Lindo the Shadow Flower Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9a7.description: A group of grass ninjas who secretly support the path to victory while concealing themselves in the shadows. They continue to loyally serve their lord.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b8.name: Royal Rebel's Doom Metal
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing 2 Level 7 or higher Fiend Type monsters.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up monsters on your opponent's field, then inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the total original Levels of the monsters destroyed by this effect] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c1.name: Night Vision the Phantom Pigeon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Trap Card in your Graveyard, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of Trap Cards in your Graveyard] x 200 until the end of this turn. Then, if you have 5 or more Trap Cards in your Graveyard, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c2.name: Siesta Torero
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 "Siesta Hold" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c8.name: Royal Rebel's Command
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Fiend Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn, then you can change its battle position (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9cb.name: Mighty Gaze of the Sky Emperor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9cb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position). Then, if you have a face-up Level 10 monster on your field, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d2.name: Judgment of the Rising Light
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Shuffle 1 monster from either player's Graveyard into the owner's Deck. If the opponent has 0 cards in their hand, you can also return 1 face-up monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d3.name: Avian Spell Tactics
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Warrior and/or Winged Beast Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, you can place 1 Level 8 or lower Warrior or Winged Beast Type monster from your Graveyard on top of the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9da.name: Music Princess's Recital
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9da.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack while you have exactly 1 monster on your field.
[Effect] Negate the attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9dc.name: Maraimei, the Igniting Inferno
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9dc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 6 or higher monster(s) face-up, and you have a face-up "Summoned Skull" or a face-up Level 7 or higher Fiend Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] You take damage equal to [the number of monsters in your opponent's Graveyard] x 100. Then, shuffle all monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f3.name: Coevolutionary Miracle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Dinosaur Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Dinosaur Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. It gains ATK equal to [the original Level of the monster sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f7.name: Dinomic Pressure
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 3 Dinosaur Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fd.name: Scarechair Scale
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9fd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, place 2 monsters with 0 ATK from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ff.name: Joining Chairs
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ff.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster while you have 3 face-up monsters with 0 ATK on your field.
[Effect] Change up to 2 monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position. This turn, if you have a Defense Position monster on your field, your opponent's monsters can only attack Defense Position monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa06.name: Straight Pierce
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa06.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 5 WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up Level 7 or 8 monster on your field gains 2000 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0a.name: Dragon Roll the Sushi Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn this card was Normal Summoned, place 1 Fairy Type monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. This turn, you cannot attack with Level 6 or lower monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0b.name: Tiger Roll the Sushi Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add up to 2 Level 8 or lower Fairy Type monsters from your Graveyard to your hand. You cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters from the hand for the rest of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0c.name: Monkey Roll the Sushi Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa0c.description: A follower of the gods that dine in the Divine Sushi Realm. All of the rice is swept up by their characteristic seaweed and peculiar sweetness.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa15.name: Cyber-Tech Alligator
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa15.description: Originally a pterodactyl, he was viciously attacked by a dragon. Using the newest technologies, his keeper saved him from near-fatal wounds and brought him back as a powerful Cyborg.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f942.name: Big Bang Egger
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f942.description: Which came first, space or the egg? This girl has an explosive imagination.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f944.name: Chashooting Star
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f944.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons or Special Summons a Level 5 or higher monster face-up.
[Effect] Gain LP equal to [the Level of 1 face-up Pyro Type monster on your field] x 200. Then, return it to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f948.name: Celtic Guardian
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f948.description: An elf who learned to wield a sword, he baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f949.name: Cyber Falcon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f949.description:
A jet-powered hawk that travels at the speed of sound.

(This card is not treated as a "Cyber" card.)

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f950.name: Sky Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f950.description: A flying dragon with four wings housing some very dangerous blades.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f953.name: Jinzo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f953.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Neither player can activate Trap Cards, and all Trap Card effects are negated.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f957.name: Brassaxophone the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f957.description: The heart and soul of the band. Her dynamic tones make her an excellent solo fighter, but she needs help to equip the weapon on her left arm.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95b.name: United Ants
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95b.description: Ants that gather to swear to fight their oppressors. A revolution is coming.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95d.name: Tsuvolcano
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95d.description: Here comes a magma-hot shiatsu massage! Pressure Point Eruption!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95e.name: Enchanting Mermaid
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f95e.description: A beautiful mermaid that lures voyagers to a watery grave.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f963.name: Insurrection Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f963.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 4 Normal Monsters from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck in any order.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters on the field] x 700 until the end of this turn. Once this turn, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96a.name: Wyrm Excavator the Heavy Cavalry Draco (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Place 1 card from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on either side of the field and draw 1 card. Then, if you destroyed a Field Spell Card by this effect, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96d.name: Trumpetonfa the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a Warrior Type Normal Monster in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard, then 1 face-up monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the number of Warrior Type Normal Monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96e.name: Digisoon the Music Fiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f96e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a Defense Position monster on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of Defense Position monsters on the opponent's field] x 800 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f972.name: Antrebellion of the Rebellion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f972.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 100 LP.
[Effect] All Attack Position Insect Type monsters with 100 or less ATK on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your field] x 800 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f977.name: Sakakaze the Talismanic Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f977.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Warrior Type monster other than this card on your field.
[Effect] Shuffle monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck, up to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97c.name: Constructor Sword Foreman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] A face-up Field Spell Card is on the field.
[Effect] Change 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position. Then, if you changed a Normal Monster to face-up Attack Position by this effect, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97e.name: Primal Howling
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f97e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Wyrm Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Place 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f980.name: Heavy Cavalry Tactics
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f980.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up EARTH Attribute Machine Type Normal Monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 EARTH Attribute Machine Type Effect Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with the monster Special Summoned by this effect.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f985.name: Sogen
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f985.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Warrior and Beast-Warrior Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.
