64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f986.name: Triangle Reborn
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f986.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster while you have 3 or more monsters with the same Type in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle 3 monsters with the same Type from your Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you have no Attack Position monsters on your field, Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f988.name: Constructor Ambush
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f988.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Wyrm Type monster on your field, send 1 Level 6 or lower Wyrm Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses ATK equal to [the ATK of the monster sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98f.name: Beast Gear Secret Art - Primal Fist
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f98f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Level 7-9 Beast-Warrior, Fiend, or Machine Type monster.
[Effect] Change the attacking monster to face-up Defense Position. Then, if you changed a Dragon, Spellcaster, or Fairy Type monster to Defense Position by this effect, destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f994.name: Yuri the Shadow Flower Fiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f994.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Plant Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Each player sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99b.name: Tyhone #2
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f99b.description: A crimson dragon that spits fireballs to create a blazing sea of fire.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9aa.name: Surge Bolt Lizard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9aa.description: Materializes alongside a flash of lightening. This electric creature can zap through machinery to short-circuit their being.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ae.name: Hyper Engine Vast Vulcan (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ae.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can destroy a Field Spell Card on your opponent's field. Then, if you destroyed a Field Spell Card by this effect, inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b9.name: Vice Jacker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9b9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 8 DARK Attribute monster on your field can make a second attack this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9bb.name: Gekka the Shadow Flower Beauty
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9bb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 EARTH Attribute Plant Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9bd.name: Gajumaru the Shadow Flower Lion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9bd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other face-up EARTH Attribute Plant Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change the original ATK of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower EARTH Attribute monster on your opponent's field to 0 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c4.name: Coil Dragon of the Fertile Land
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Field Spell Card from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c9.name: Royal Rebel's Arena
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9c9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9cc.name: Prison Island - Cell Block 5 & 6
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9cc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, neither player can Tribute Summon Level 5 or 6 monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d4.name: Imprisoned Beautiful Witch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster while you have a face-up Level 8 or higher Aqua Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Shuffle up to 5 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if your opponent has a face-up Spellcaster Type monster on their field, you can shuffle up to 5 additional monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d7.name: Shadow Flower Return
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack, shuffle 3 Plant Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy the attacking monster. Then, if you destroyed a monster by this effect, you can Special Summon 1 Plant Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d8.name: Brocoohearted Pigeon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9d8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 5 or higher monster face-up while you have a face-up Winged Beast Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position. Then, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9de.name: Acetic Acid Trap Hole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9de.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 3 or lower Effect Monster.
[Effect] Destroy that monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9df.name: Ultimate Flag Mech Ace Breaker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9df.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e0.name: Dark Magician Girl
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of "Dark Magician" in both players' Graveyards] x 500.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e4.name: Supreme Skystream Magnum Overlord (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Shuffle 1 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the Level of 1 monster in your Graveyard] x 100, then, if you inflicted damage to your opponent by this effect, you can add that monster to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e5.name: Supreme Skystream Magnum Overlord
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e5.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Supreme Skystream Magnum Overlord [L]" and "Supreme Skystream Magnum Overlord [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 monsters from your hand face-up to your field, then you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e7.name: Emergency Return
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9e7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Return 1 face-up Level 5 or higher monster from your field to the owner's hand. If you returned a monster to the hand by this effect, then negate the attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9eb.name: Sneezing Greedizauls
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9eb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your LP are lower than your opponent's, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of each player's Deck to the Graveyard, then, if a monster was sent to the Graveyard by this effect, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 400.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ef.name: Uraby
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9ef.description: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f1.name: Platnidon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87f9f1.description: A Pteranodon that loves to collect shiny metals. The shell on its head is its favorite.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa09.name: Agaribel, the Finest Sushi Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa09.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Fairy Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa14.name: Turnback Shot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa14.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase.
[Effect] Return 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa16.name: Sunny Fairy Spinangel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa16.description: An angel that's totally bringing the bling in the modern style. Nobody be stoppin' him, man.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1a.name: Mystic Roastman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1a.description: Half man and half horse, this monster is known for its extreme dine and dashing.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1b.name: Archfiend Marmot of Deliciousness
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1b.description: An air marmot that has a nefarious dipping sauce and dish. It attacks by throwing around steak-cut rankings.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1c.name: Hampering Hippo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1c.description: An unexpectedly fast hippopotamus that pushes back against every attack. It can even use its treads to swim skillfully.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1f.name: Flying Kamakiri #2
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1f.description: A flying mantis that feeds primarily on insects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa22.name: Handy Lady
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa22.description: From lost cats to dignitary protection, she's a multifaceted troubleshooter. Lately its been all lunch deliveries, but out of nowhere, she receives a message from an unknown sender.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa28.name: Future Diviner
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa28.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Psychic Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Draw 1 card, then send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2f.name: Beast Drive Mega Elephant
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Level 6 or lower Beast Type Normal Monster in your Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Beast Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have 3 or more Beast Type Normal Monsters in your Graveyard, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa34.name: Heat Hyena
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa34.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Send cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa36.name: Rindrmuhle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa36.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If a face-up Field Spell Card is on the field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa40.name: Storm Sonic
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa40.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up WIND Attribute monsters on your field.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 600 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a face-up "Cyber-Tech Alligator"‎ on your field, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa41.name: Following World
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa41.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up WIND Attribute Normal Monsters on the field gain 500 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa43.name: Nutrient Zero
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa43.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Gain LP equal to [the Level of 1 face-up Normal Monster on your field] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa44.name: Best Bite
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa44.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Beast Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if 4 FIRE Attribute Beast Type monsters were sent to the Graveyard by this effect, 1 face-up monster on the field gains 2900 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa48.name: Dekorelic Dessert
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa48.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 Pyro Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] All face-up EARTH Attribute Pyro Type monsters on your field gain 800 ATK until the end of this turn, then gain 800 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4b.name: Rage of the Beasts
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Beast and/or Beast-Warrior Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, you can shuffle 1 Field Spell Card from your Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4c.name: Barrage of Steel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Machine Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4e.name: 7 Chance
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 7 or higher monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Draw 3 cards and show them. Then, if there are 2 or more Level 7 monsters among them, gain LP equal to [the number of those Level 7 monsters] x 1500.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa66.name: Stop Defense
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa66.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Change 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6f.name: Dream Drummer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Psychic Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Shuffle 1 monster from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you have a face-up Normal Monster on your field, you can gain 500 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa70.name: Psychic Trap Hole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa70.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 5 or higher monster while you have 2 or more face-up Psychic Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Destroy that Normal Summoned monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa73.name: Nessus the Star Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa73.description: A man who carries the power of an evil star. He respects Echeclus the Star Knight as his teacher and mentor.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa77.name: Connector Dog
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa77.description: A digital beast that transports information through the network world. Through generations of modification, it has evolved into a creature with a straightforward and honest nature.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa78.name: Particle Acceleration
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa78.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Cyberse Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa79.name: Constructor Fighter Mixer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa79.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If a face-up Field Spell Card is on the field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a Wyrm Type Normal Monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7b.name: Constructor Sapper Draftannin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Excavate the top card of your Deck and place it on either the top or bottom of your Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7c.name: Barrier Armordillo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7c.description: An unexpectedly powerful armadillo that can deflect anything that comes close. It can use its tank treads to skillfully dig.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa82.name: Metarion Herculestar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa82.description:
"Imaginary Actor" + "Magic Juggler"
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Shuffle up to 3 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.
● Shuffle up to 2 face-up Spellcaster Type monsters from your opponent's field into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa83.name: Metarion Ladonstar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa83.description:
"Imaginary Actor" + "Glaciasaurus"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 1500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.
● All face-up Dinosaur Type monsters on your opponent's field lose 2000 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa85.name: Imaginary Actor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa85.description: A mechanical doll incapable of expressing emotions outside of laughing. It uses the emotions of its audience as energy.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa87.name: Serpainter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa87.description: A beautiful dragon that once lived in a clear and pure watering hole. Now it serves as the popular mascot of the circus, adored by the audience.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa89.name: Magic Juggler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa89.description: A very mysterious man who doesn't talk about his past. He captures the attention of the audience by manipulating his baton almost as if it were magic.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8b.name: Imaginary Arc Tower
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if you have a LIGHT Attribute Normal Monster with 500 DEF in your Graveyard.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up non-LIGHT Attribute monsters on the field lose 300 ATK, and face-up Level 9 LIGHT Attribute monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8c.name: Imaginary Arc Turbulence
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster while you have a LIGHT Attribute Normal Monster with 500 DEF in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position Level 8 or higher LIGHT Attribute monster on your field to face-up Defense Position, then you can destroy 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field with the same Type as a Normal Monster in your Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa90.name: Straynge Clowder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa90.description:
"Straynge Cat" + "Straynge Cat"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Spellcaster Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned "Straynge Cat" by this effect, this card also gains 1400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa91.name: Kuribotorero
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa91.description:
"Kuribot" + "Siesta Torero"
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Return 1 Defense Position monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa92.name: Mr. Alchemy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa92.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 "Straynge Cat" from your Graveyard to your hand, then you can draw 1 card. If you drew by this effect, you cannot attack with Level 6 or lower monsters this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa94.name: Hyperstrike Dragon Dragiastar F
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa94.description:
"Multistrike Dragon Dragias" + "The Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] If all monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon and/or Dragon Type monsters, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● This turn, this card gains 900 ATK, and it can make up to 2 attacks on monsters.
● This turn, this card can attack twice, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa97.name: The Wyvern
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa97.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Dragon Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa7.name: Cannon Soldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster on your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faac.name: Yami
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faac.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Fiend/Spellcaster Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF, and face-up Fairy Type monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab3.name: Mirror Force
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab7.name: Haniwaffle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab7.description: A product developed to relieve the food shortage. Its sweet appearance and taste are drawing excited cheers.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab9.name: The All-Seeing White Tiger
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab9.description: A proud ruler of the jungle that some fear and others respect.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabf.name: Dolphin King Iruqua
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabf.description: A dolphin that has braved the stormy seas and hardships of the world, throwing itself headfirst into learning the ways of royalty.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac2.name: Zubaba Batter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac2.description: A baseball warrior with weight behind his swing. Also known as the marauding captain, he aggresively swings from the first pitch.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac3.name: ExPress Train
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac3.description: A train that uses news tips as fuel and runs on the rails of getting scoops. Its fact-gathering and writing are very streamlined!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87facb.name: Mezame the Ringing Alarm
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87facb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and your opponent has a face-up monster with 2500 or more ATK on their field.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 7 or higher Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot attack with monsters with 1900 or less DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad1.name: Light Dolphin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up "Umi" or "Big Umi" and a face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, or Aqua Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad2.name: Sea Star Trooper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle 1 monster from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you have "Umi" or "Big Umi" face-up on your field, you can send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad3.name: Kataomoiruka
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 "Umi" or "Big Umi" from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad6.name: Dododo Second
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If a face-up "Feverous Spirit Stadium" is on the field, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a FIRE Attribute monster in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fadf.name: CAN:D LIVE
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fadf.description:
"CAN:D" + "Psypickupper"
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Take 2000 damage, then you can make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 3000 ATK until the end of this turn.
● Gain 1000 LP, then you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Psychic Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae6.name: Supreme Marine Fortress Magnum Overbase
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if your LP are lower than your opponent's.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Level 7 or higher Machine Type monsters on the field gain 400 ATK, and face-up Level 10 Machine Type monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae7.name: Five Types of Assistance
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Warrior, Fairy, Beast, Winged Beast, or Reptile Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Up to 2 face-up monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae8.name: Bizarrmor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 3 Level 7 or higher monsters with different Types from your Graveyard on the top or bottom of the Deck in any order.
[Effect] Add 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand, then you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faed.name: Reprinter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faed.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Printing Presser" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack directly.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faee.name: The Noodle Art of Saucery
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faee.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send cards from your hand to the Graveyard, up to the number of Pyro Type Normal Monsters in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw cards equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement]. Then, if you have a face-up Pyro Type Normal Monster on your field, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faef.name: Ship of Seven Treasures
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faef.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you sent a Level 7 monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can draw 1 additional card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf4.name: Pair Collision
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Level 10 or higher monster.
[Effect] Monsters cannot be destroyed by that battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf6.name: Dolphin Counterattack
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Fish or Sea Serpent Type monster, shuffle 1 "Umi" or "Big Umi" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field with the highest ATK. Draw 1 card and show it. Then, if that card is "Umi" or "Big Umi", inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafb.name: Spiral Geyser
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons or Sets a monster from the hand.
[Effect] Inflict 400 damage to your opponent. This turn, your opponent cannot Tribute face-down monsters for a Tribute Summon.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafc.name: Hardefense Mission
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster with 2500 or more original ATK declares an attack.
[Effect] Destroy the attacking monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafd.name: Cladsoul Dragon Gaigias
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard, then Special Summon 1 Level 7 Dragon Type monster from your hand to your field in face-up Attack Position. The monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafe.name: Mach Mega Falcon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafe.description:
"Cyber Falcon" + "Cyber Falcon"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Gain 500 LP. Then, if you gained LP by this effect, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa18.name: Worker Warrior - Bad Boss
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa18.description: A mid-level drone that allocates most of its memory to trying to get ahead in life. Its report is a storm filled with slander.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1d.name: Dogulce Jomont Blanc
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1d.description: Who knew adding Mont Blanc cakes to a clay pot would grant it with a soul. The sight of them roaming the stilt houses are met with screams beyond surprise.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa21.name: Fazuzu the King of Mythical Wind Beasts
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa21.description: A Mythical Beast with 2 pairs of wings. It has been safeguarding the Royal City in silence.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa23.name: Sevens Road Wiz
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa23.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change the original ATK of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field with the same ATK as this card to 0 until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Sevens Road Magician" in your Graveyard, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa27.name: Speedy Performer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa27.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa31.name: Doki Doki Hexenhaus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa31.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Pyro Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa32.name: Crafter Drone
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa32.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Machine Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3b.name: Road Magic - Uplifter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field, send 1 LIGHT Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the ATK of the face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field with the lowest ATK] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa45.name: B・B・Q
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa45.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Beast Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] All face-up FIRE Attribute monsters on the field gain ATK equal to [the number of face-up FIRE Attribute monsters on the field] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa54.name: Forever Freeze
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa54.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster with 2500 or more ATK, send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Place that Normal Summoned monster on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa56.name: Nightbringer Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa56.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Your opponent draws 2 cards. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of cards in their hand] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa59.name: Ultimate Flag Beast Aim Eagle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa59.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field, send 2 face-up LIGHT Attribute monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Machine Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. It gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5c.name: Mystical Elf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5c.description: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5f.name: Accel Wonder Splat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Increase the Level of 1 face-up Spellcaster Type monster on your field by 2 and its ATK by 200 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa67.name: Sportsdragon Connection
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa67.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or 6 Dragon Type Normal Monster from your hand or Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have "Sportsdragon Keeper" face-up on your field, you can add 1 "Sportsdragon Striker" or "Sportsdragon Defender" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa68.name: Dragonic Disorder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa68.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 7 or higher monster, send 1 Dragon Type Normal Monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change that Normal Summoned monster to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6a.name: Hero of the Yeast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6a.description: A samurai from the Far East. His knife easily slices through bread.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa74.name: King's Right
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa74.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase.
[Effect] Add 2 or 3 Fiend Type Normal Monsters with different Levels from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7e.name: Ultimate Flag Beast Surge Bicorn
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monster in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7f.name: Ultimate Flag Beast Cannon Rhino
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage. Then, if you have a face-up Machine Type Normal Monster ​on your field, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8e.name: Sevens Paladin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8e.description:
"Sevens Road Magician" + "Swordsman of Roadstar"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● This card gains ATK equal to [the number of different Attributes in both players' Graveyards] x 400 until the end of this turn.
● Shuffle 1 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck, then draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8f.name: Whispark Fairy Girl
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8f.description:
"Sparkhearts Girl" + "Whispering Fairy"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle up to 2 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck, then you can make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa95.name: Full Moon Dragon Umbralancer F
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa95.description:
"Dragon Knight of Darkness" + "Dragon Bat"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, except "Fusion".
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Special Summon 1 High Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.
● Add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa96.name: Sportsdragon Kickbase Master
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa96.description:
"Sportsdragon Slugger" + "Sportsdragon Striker"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 "Sportsdragon Pitcher" or "Sportsdragon Defender" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9a.name: The Barrier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 1 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9b.name: Amusi Howling Performer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9b.description:
"Amusi Performer" + "Howlingbird"
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 "Amusi Performer" or "Howlingbird" from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9c.name: Chemical Cure Purple
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9c.description:
"Chemical Cure Red" + "Chemical Cure Blue"
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 3 Spell/Trap Cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw cards equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement], then you can gain 900 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa5.name: Worker Warrior - Overhauled Organizer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Worker Warrior - Sinister CEO" from your hand face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with Machine Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa8.name: Giga-Tech Wolf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa8.description: An iron wolf with razor-sharp fangs that can penetrate any armor.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa9.name: Ether Seeker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Fusion" in your Graveyard, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faab.name: Star Restart
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faab.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field, then you can add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faae.name: The Warrior Returning Alive
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faae.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add 1 Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab0.name: Fusion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Fusion Summon by sending face-up monsters from your field to the Graveyard as material.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab1.name: The Star Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab5.name: Cyber Soldier of Darkworld
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab5.description: A mechanical soldier that won't stop attacking until all life readings have been extinguished from its sensors.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabc.name: Levia-Dragon - Daedalus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up "Umi" from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all other cards on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabd.name: Needlkyrie the Celestial Seamstress
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabd.description: A servant of the gods who stitches and sews the way to the heavens. She can illuminate the darkness.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac4.name: Flavor Inspector
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac4.description: A professional with an understanding that the world is either sweet or sour. Any dish she treats will be seasoned with perfection.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87facc.name: Piercing Samurai
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87facc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 face-up monsters on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Warrior Type monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87facd.name: Kimeluna the Dark Shifter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87facd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Change the battle positions of up to 2 monsters on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position). Then, if you changed a battle position by this effect, you can change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87face.name: Royal Rebel's Break
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87face.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up Level 8 or higher monster on their field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Fiend Type Normal Monster from your hand to your field in face-up Defense Position. Increase this card's Level by 5 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad9.name: Reporter Raccoon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Printing Presser" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 "Scoop Scooter" or 1 "Soul of a Reporter" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fadb.name: Sea Dragon Kleindros
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fadb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field, place 1 "Sea Dragon King Granganus" or 1 "Grand Extreme" from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Fish or Sea Serpent Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with WATER Attribute monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae3.name: Extra Meat the Special Noodle Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae3.description:
"Extra Spice the Elite Noodle Ninja" + "Flavor Inspector"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. Draw 1 card. Then, if you drew by this effect, you can Set 1 "The Noodle Art of Savory" and/or 1 "The Noodle Art of Saucery" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae5.name: Fenriritter Sol
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae5.description:
"Sigurstate Sol" + "Connector Dog"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if your opponent has a monster on their field, you can Special Summon 1 Cyberse Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faec.name: Hot Off the Press
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faec.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster on your field, send 1 EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Your opponent takes the bottom 5 cards of their Deck and shows them. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters among the shown cards] x 400. Your opponent places the shown cards on top of their Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf8.name: Requesting 9
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Gain 900 LP. Then, if you have 9 or more FIRE Attribute monsters in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Player #39: Home Run Hitter" or "Player #99: Grand Slam Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafa.name: Breaking News!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fafa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a face-up Machine Type monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[Effect] Inflict 300 damage to your opponent. Then, you can Special Summon up to 2 "ExPress Train" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb00.name: Ultimate Flag Mech Gold Rush
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb00.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Machine Type Effect Monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 Machine Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if your opponent has 3 Attack Position monsters on their field, you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb04.name: Royal Rebel's Hard Rock
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb04.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing 2 Level 7 or higher Fiend Type monsters.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Level 7 or higher monster on your opponent's field. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the difference in ATK between the chosen monster and this card]. This card gains ATK equal to [the chosen monster's ATK] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb05.name: Attrashoot Hydron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb05.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 or more Cyberse Type monsters in your Graveyard, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, if you have 8 or more Cyberse Type monsters in your Graveyard, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0f.name: Secret Order
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 Normal Monster from your hand or Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 700 ATK, and cannot be destroyed by an opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb10.name: Temporary Storm Blockade
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb10.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a card is sent from your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can shuffle 1 random card from your opponent's hand into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb11.name: Counter Back
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb11.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Spell/Trap Card(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Effect Monster with 2300 or more ATK on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb15.name: Ground Attacker Bugroth
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb15.description: A surface battle robot that was once used for sea warfare.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1f.name: Great Multistrike Dragon Dragias Burst
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1f.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Great Multistrike Dragon Dragias Burst [L]" and "Great Multistrike Dragon Dragias Burst [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb20.name: Great Multistrike Dragon Dragias Burst (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb20.description:

[Effect] This turn, this card gains 1000 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb23.name: Blue-Eyed Silver Zombie
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb23.description: The beams from the eyes of this creature are said to turn enemies into zombies.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb26.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send up to 2 random cards from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2d.name: Pluggyfish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2d.description: An organism formed from jellyfish and electrical plugs. It is an ecological enigma.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb33.name: Rhythmical Performer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb33.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Your opponent sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if they sent a Spell/Trap Card to the Graveyard by this effect, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb34.name: Excutie Feena
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb34.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up monster with 1700 or more ATK on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your field gain 200 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3f.name: Rocketortoise Modularchelon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 2 other face-up Reptile Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 700 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb42.name: Lightning Bringer Spirit
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb42.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if it was a Spell/Trap Card, you can shuffle 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb02.name: CAN - Melo:D
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb02.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Return 1 other face-up Level 5 or higher monster from your field to the hand.
[Effect] Shuffle 1 face-down card from your opponent's field into the Deck. Then, if your LP are lower than your opponent's, you can add 1 Level 1 Psychic Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb06.name: Infinite Constructor Wyrm Buildream
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb06.description:
"Constructor Wyrm Buildragon" + "Constructor Princess Pylon"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your Field Zone to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 2 monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb08.name: Elegant Firebird Harpyia
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb08.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0b.name: Ether Finder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if "Fusion" is in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Ether Seeker" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0e.name: Magical Stone Excavation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb13.name: Gyakutenno Megami
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb13.description: This fairy uses her mystical power to protect the weak and provide spiritual support.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb14.name: Alligator's Sword
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb14.description: ey, dis mighty lissard man can swing his sword so fast, dat it's more dan da speed a sound!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1a.name: Unfulfilled Goblin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn, then you can place 1 "Upstart Goblin" from your Graveyard on top of the Deck, and if you do, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1d.name: Black Dragon's Roar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 5 or higher monster.
[Effect] 1 face-up Dragon Type Normal Monster on your field gains 700 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a face-up "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" on your field, you can place 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard on top of the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1e.name: Great Multistrike Dragon Dragias Burst (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card can make 3 attacks on monsters this turn. Shuffle this card into the Deck during the End Phase of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb27.name: The Creator
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb27.description:
This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] You have a card in your hand.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2a.name: Ancient Lizard Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2a.description: Before the dawn of man, this lizard warrior ruled supreme.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2c.name: Boosturtle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2c.description: A tortoise born from an unhinged project proposal. Some assumed the tortoise maneuvers through outer space with its boosters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2f.name: Lauan Adventurers
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2f.description: Adventurers who seek unknown land. They originally competed to see how far they could fly, but at some point they began to travel together.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb36.name: Mecha Umbretta
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb36.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and have a face-up WIND Attribute Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Add 1 "Following World" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3c.name: Predator Ganleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your LP are 1000 or lower, send the top 5 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the difference between your LP and your opponent's LP] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb41.name: Zap Zap Octospark
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb41.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and have a face-up Thunder Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] This card gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb44.name: Emitter Stag
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb44.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Reduce the Level of 1 face-up Level 5 or higher Thunder Type monster on your field by 4 until the end of this turn. Then, inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb47.name: Thunder Cavalry Triggerdrago
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb47.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if your opponent has no cards in their hand, this card inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference), if it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb49.name: Hazy Strike Dragon Miragiastar F
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb49.description:
"Illusion Strike Dragon Miragias" + "The Dragon"

[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Up to 3 face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters.
● This turn, this card can attack directly.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4b.name: Hero of the Kin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4b.description:
"Hero of the Yeast" + "Hero of the Yeast"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4c.name: Semeterasu the Divine Ruler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4c.description:
"Semeruler the Dark Summoner" + "Needlkyrie the Celestial Seamstress"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] ●Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower Warrior or Fairy Type monster from your Graveyard, face-up to your field. ●Shuffle monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck up to [the number of monsters with 0 ATK in your Graveyard].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4d.name: Meika Etraynze the Shadow Flower Venus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4d.description:
"Etraynze the Shadow Flower Ninja" + "Etraynze the Shadow Flower Ninja"

[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower Plant Type monster from your hand or your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb55.name: Vulcan Ignite Hyperdrive
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb55.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up FIRE Attribute Warrior Type Maximum Monster on your field.
[Effect] Inflict 800 damage to your opponent. Then, if you have a monster in Maximum Mode on your field, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb5e.name: Spy Observation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb5e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Reptile Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Excavate the top card of your Deck. Then, place the excavated card on either the top or bottom of your Deck. Then, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb62.name: Makiu, the Magical Mist
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb62.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Destroy all face-up monsters on your opponent's field with DEF less than or equal to the ATK of 1 face-up "Summoned Skull" or 1 face-up Thunder Type monster on your field. Your monsters cannot attack this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6a.name: Harpie Lady
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6a.description: This human-shaped animal with wings is beautiful to watch but deadly in battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6c.name: Unknown Flyleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Change 1 face-down monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6d.name: Perion the Star Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, increase the Levels of 1 face-up monster on your field and 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field by 2, also they gain 500 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb70.name: Accel Wonder Pebble
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb70.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Spellcaster Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb72.name: Milky Wave Neo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb72.description: A new galactic warrior born from the river of stars, the Milky Way. He fights by gathering massive energy from the Stars. Gyanaari Du Zuwaai!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb78.name: One Year Broom
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb78.description: A broom with a soul. It's said those who wield this broom work hard to get things done.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7c.name: Protector of the Throne
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7c.description: While the king is away, this queen protects his throne with a mighty defense.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb81.name: Transam Ephyrai
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb81.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Make 1 face-up "Transam Linac" on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb86.name: Poet Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb86.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Shuffle 3 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you have 2 face-up non-Level 1 Spellcaster Type monsters on your field, you can shuffle 3 additional monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb88.name: Princess Ladybug White
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb88.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change this card's battle position (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).
[Effect] Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower Insect Type monsters from your hand face-up to your field. Then, inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb98.name: Meika Etraynzeyes the Shadow Flower Lunatic
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb98.description:
"Etraynze the Shadow Flower Ninja" + "Etraynze the Shadow Flower Ninja"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Up to 2 face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 730,000 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9f.name: Sword Skill - Ruler's Slash
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a Spell/Trap Card on their field, shuffle 1 Level 8 Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster with 2500 or more ATK and 2500 or more DEF on your field gains 2500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. This turn, you can only attack with 1 monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba0.name: Defense Destroying Sword
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up EARTH Attribute Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster with 2000 or more DEF on your opponent's field. Gain 800 LP, and inflict 800 damage to your opponent. This turn, you cannot attack with Effect Monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba1.name: Telegraphed Strike
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 EARTH Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 2 or more face-up EARTH Attribute Normal Monsters on your field, you can draw 1 additional card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba3.name: Insect Rampage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] All face-up Insect Type monsters on your field gain 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if your opponent has a face-up Insect Type monster on their field, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba5.name: Excutie Power Up!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose 2 face-up monsters with different Types on your field. This turn, the chosen monsters can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a monster in Attack Position. If you have a face-up Level 6 monster with 500 DEF on your field, inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba8.name: Wooly Wonderland - Graveyard Grudge
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your Attack Position Beast Type Normal Monster, send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] The attack target loses 2000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add up to 4 cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba9.name: Lucky Mask of Omens
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbaa.name: Card Restoration
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbaa.description:

[Effect] Draw until you have 5 cards in your hand and reveal all cards in your hand. Then, if there is a monster(s) among them, gain LP equal to [the number of those monsters] x 200.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbae.name: Engage and Strike!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbae.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the Level of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb0.name: Ignoring Insect
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] Change up to 3 Attack Position Insect Type monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position. Then, if you have 2 or more face-up Defense Position monsters on your field, you can change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb6.name: Dream Ladybug Rainbow
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb6.description: A vibrant ladybug whose trademark are the stars on its back. Even today, it brings happiness while drawing a rainbow in its trail.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb7.name: Hero of the East
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb7.description: Feel da strength ah dis sword-swingin' samurai from da Far East.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb9.name: Alien Shocktrooper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb9.description: The Aliens have used a mysterious biological substance to create a supreme race of soldiers. They do not have the natural powers of the other Aliens, but can make stunning physical attacks.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbd.name: Tribute Doll
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc2.name: Cyclinne

[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 Galaxy Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc8.name: Galactic Enforcer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc8.description: A space weapon whose structure resembles a spiral galaxy. It attacks with highly maneuverable appendages. Wuhjah!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbcb.name: Transam Kleine
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbcb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Add 1 LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with Galaxy Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd4.name: Gadget Soldier

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd5.name: Coilephant

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd9.name: Lightning Braver
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd9.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbdb.name: Tribute Lock
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbdb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 5 or higher monster while your LP are lower than your opponent's.
[Effect] Change that monster to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbdd.name: Direct Dive Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbdd.description:

● Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbdf.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb46.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or less cards in their hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb56.name: Royal Rebel's Echo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb56.description:

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb57.name: Shadow Flower Wish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb57.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Plant Type monster in your Graveyard, send 2 face-up Plant Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb59.name: Tag-Up-Magic Sacrifice Force

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb5f.name: Clapping Thunder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb5f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Thunder Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 400 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. Then, if you have 3 Thunder Type monsters on your field, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb61.name: Parallel Birth Gate
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb61.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have no cards in your hand, you can Special Summon up to 2 Normal Monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6e.name: Transam Linac
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6e.description: Fight for the Light! Pure Finish!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6f.name: Stone Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6f.description: A dragon formed by huge boulders that are also used to attack the enemy.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb73.name: Galactica Oblivion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb73.description: Fight for the Light! Good Night!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb74.name: Wooly Wonderland Ground Mouton
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb74.description: The newcomer of the Wooly Wonderland flock. A dyed-in-the-wool slacker.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7b.name: Atlas Combat Beetle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7b.description: A type of beetle that fights over dark tree sap. It has more power than you can even imagine.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7d.name: Griffore
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7d.description: This monster's tough hide deflects almost any attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb83.name: Great Cosmonarch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb83.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8f.name: Bio Mechmantis
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Insect Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can make that monster become Insect Type until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb96.name: Sevensgias the Magical Dragon Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb96.description:
"Sevens Road Magician" + "Multistrike Dragon Dragias"
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● This turn, this card gains ATK equal to [the number of different Types in your Graveyard] x 700, and it can make up to 2 attacks on monsters.
● Destroy all face-up cards on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb99.name: Hero of the Sweep
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb99.description:
"Hero of the Yeast" + "One Year Broom"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK/DEF equal to [the number of face-up EARTH Attribute monsters on your field] x 200 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9a.name: Wooden Blade Samurai
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9a.description:
"Masaki the Legendary Samurai" + "Centennial Wooden Blade"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Normal Monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you destroyed a monster by this effect, you can add 1 "Climax Clash" or "Engage and Strike!" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9c.name: Meteor Charge
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). Also, if the chosen monster is a Normal Monster, you can change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9e.name: Future Mining
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or more face-up monsters on their field.
[Effect] Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated monster to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba2.name: Sunny Forest
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Defense Position Insect Type monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbaf.name: Anciant Barrier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbaf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack, shuffle 2 Insect Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if a face-up Defense Position Insect Type monster is on the field, you can destroy the attacking monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb2.name: Sacred Tower in Crisis
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 7 or higher monster.
[EFFECT] Change 1 face-up Level 8 or lower Effect Monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb3.name: Delight of the Mighty
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster.
[Effect] 1 face-up Normal Monster on your field gains ATK/DEF equal to [that Normal Summoned monster's Level] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb4.name: Fantasy Ladybug Pastel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb4.description: A kindhearted ladybug whose trademark is the heart on its back. It is said that if you touch it, your love will come true.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb5.name: Archfiend Marmot of Nefariousness
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb5.description: An air marmot that has a nefarious horn and wings. It attacks by throwing acorns.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb8.name: Frenzied Panda
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb8.description: A savage beast that carries a big bamboo stick for beating down its enemies.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbb.name: Dark Factory of Mass Production
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add 2 Normal Monsters from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc1.name: Silver Seyfert
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc1.description: A knight that wanders across the galaxy looking for strong fighters. Kuinduragyomai Gyuinduraijimai!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc5.name: Bright Sentinel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc5.description: A galactic warrior who guards order. It charges at extreme speed to rescue allies from danger, leaving a jet of light in its wake. Migui Gyaran Gonaidewei!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc9.name: Strange Traveler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Galaxy Type Normal Monster on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbce.name: Asteroeva
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbce.description: A space life form that travels through space by piloting a UFO that looks like a rock. Jubyidoggu Higyumei!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd1.name: Nebula Power
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster.
[Effect] 1 face-up Galaxy Type Normal Monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 500 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd7.name: Flare Sorcerer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd7.description: A magician with burning passion. His feelings eventually burned up his own heart.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbda.name: Tamabot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbda.description: Althought it hatched without any exact plan, it's always ready to roll.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe0.name: Supreme Beasteam Magnum Overlord (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 500. If you have 10 or more monsters in your Graveyard, this card inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference), if it attacks a Defense Position monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe1.name: Supreme Beasteam Magnum Overlord
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe1.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Supreme Beasteam Magnum Overlord [L]" and "Supreme Beasteam Magnum Overlord [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe3.name: Solid Strike Dragon Metagiastar F
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe3.description:
"Steel Strike Dragon Metagias" + "The Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● All face-up monsters on your field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn, also this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters this turn.
● All face-up monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's Trap Card effects until the end of this turn, also this card can attack twice this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe6.name: Darkness Fource Seeker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 or more DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters with different Levels in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. This turn, you can only attack with DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbef.name: CAN:D ALL
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbef.description:
"CAN:D" + "Ice Pop Bear"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Psychic Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf1.name: Progress Potter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 5 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Shuffle up to 2 cards from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, you can draw cards equal to [the number of "Progress Potter" and "Pot of Avarice" with different names in your Graveyard].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf2.name: Ice Pop Bear
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "CAN:D" or "Ama Lilith" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with Omega Psychic or Psychic Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf3.name: Ama Lilith
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf3.description: A girl who sings her feelings freely. The love will never fade away.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfe.name: Bubbleburst Shock!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfe.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 8 or higher Aqua Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Take damage equal to [the total ATK of all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field]. Then, if you took damage by this effect, destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc04.name: Ghoulish Gal
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc04.description: In the men's bathroom down in the basement, you'll suddenly feel a presence behind your back. But you know, you should absolutely not turn back until you've finished your business. If you happen to look back and end up seeing that monster...

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc05.name: The Thing in the Purple Mirror
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc05.description: Everyone... Do you know the phrase "purple mirror"? If you do know it, then be careful. If you don't forget it by the time you turn 20, then...

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc09.name: Frightening Fan Mail
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc09.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has cards in their hand, change all Attack Position Zombie Type Normal Monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position.
[Effect] Send random cards from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard, up to [the number of face-up Defense Position Zombie Type monsters on your field]. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa17.name: Worker Warrior - New Recruit
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa17.description: A newbie drone that continues to update through trial and error. It operates on a frantic pace.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa19.name: Barbeque Ox
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa19.description: A cattle monster with tremendously tasty tongue and stomach, it burns enemies with a swing of its skewer.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa26.name: Steel Strike Dragon Metagias
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa26.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's Trap Card effects, also it can make a second attack on a monster during the Battle Phase in which it attacked a monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa29.name: Betrayer of Peace
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa29.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position Warrior Type monster on the field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2a.name: Karchizark the Unequaled
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 7 or higher monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you sent a Warrior or Winged Beast Type monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can add 1 Level 6 or lower Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2c.name: Worker Warrior - Syndicate Security
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase in which this card was Normal or Special Summoned, pay 600 LP.
[Effect] Set up to 1 each of "Business Card Barrage" and "Nutrient Zero" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone. This turn, you cannot attack with non-Machine Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2e.name: Shichirin Samurai - Kushiro the Skewer Master
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase in which this card was Normal or Special Summoned, if you have 7 or more FIRE Attribute monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters with 2500 or more ATK on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa30.name: Dogulce Langue De Shakoki
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa30.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a Pyro Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can add 1 Level 6 or higher Pyro Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa33.name: Assault Cannon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa33.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 face-up Machine Type monsters on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 300 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa38.name: Vietor the Prevailing Wind
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa38.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up WIND Attribute monster on your field. This turn, if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa39.name: Bladesaurus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa39.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 200 ATK until the end of this turn, then you can add up to 1 each of "Jurassic World" and "Wasteland" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3a.name: Arzareth the Sweeping Wind
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.
