64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3c.name: Hypernova
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 face-up Level 7 non-LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3e.name: Ruler's Current
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Warrior Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Warrior Type monster with 2000 or more DEF on your field gains ATK equal to [its original DEF] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa42.name: Business Card Barrage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa42.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Worker Warrior - Sinister CEO" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 7 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you destroyed a monster by this effect, you can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Machine Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4f.name: Psychicounter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your Psychic Type monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa50.name: Dark Ruler Battle Slash
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa50.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack on your face-up Warrior Type monster.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a face-up Level 8 or higher Warrior Type monster on your field, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa52.name: Salary Slash
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa52.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack on your face-up monster, pay 600 LP.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Monsters cannot be destroyed by that battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa55.name: Scaredy Cats
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa55.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster face-up and you have a face-up Beast Type monster on your field.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn, then you can Special Summon 1 Level 1 Beast Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your field face-up.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa57.name: Ultimate Flag Mech Tough Striker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa57.description: An invincible fist that can shatter even mountains. Yearning for the battle flag to be raised. There is no defeat in the strongest battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa58.name: Ultimate Flag Beast Avant Wolf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa58.description: A Gear Beast designed to live as weaponry. And such doggedness awakens the Ultimate Fighting Bravery.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5a.name: Millennium Shield
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5a.description: A famous shield said to belong to an ancient Egyptian Pharaoh. Legends tell of its power to block any strong attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5b.name: Vorse Raider
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5b.description: This wicked Beast-Warrior does every horrid thing imaginable, and loves it! His axe bears the marks of his countless victims.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5d.name: Monster Reborn
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 monster from either Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5e.name: Sakuretsu Armor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa5e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Destroy the attacking monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa62.name: Amazing Dealer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa62.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 or less monsters in your Graveyard, pay 300 LP.
[Effect] Send 3 cards from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, draw 3 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa63.name: Mystery Handcuffs
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa63.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field. This turn, while that monster is face-up, your opponent cannot Tribute it for a Tribute Summon.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa64.name: Sportsdragon Closer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa64.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has an Attack Position Level 9 or lower monster on their field, pay 3000 LP.
[Effect] This card gains 2000 ATK until the end of this turn. If your opponent has 8 or more monsters in their Graveyard, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa65.name: Sylphidra
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa65.description: A dragon whelp of the four great Element Dragons, it commands the winds. It manipulates the atmosphere as it desires, using this power to protect the land.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6c.name: Dark Ruler's Sword Swipe
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Level 7 or higher Attack Position Warrior Type monster(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their Trap Card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Yamiruler the Dark Delayer", "Kimeruler the Dark Raider", or "Semeruler the Dark Summoner" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6d.name: Giftarist
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of other face-up Psychic Type monsters on your field] x 400 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6e.name: Peace Holder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6e.description: A police officer who keeps the peace in the local area. She is struggling to solve certain missing persons cases.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa71.name: Asbolus the Star Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa71.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change 1 Attack Position Level 5 or higher Fiend Type monster on your field to face-up Defense Position.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on either side of the field gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa75.name: Sigurstate Sol
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa75.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up Level 5 or higher monster on their field, reveal up to 2 Cyberse Type monsters in your hand.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters revealed to meet the requirement] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7a.name: Coil Dragon of Desolation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle a face-up Field Spell Card from your field into the Deck.
[Effect] Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa80.name: Metarion Ashurastar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa80.description:
"Imaginary Actor" + "Sword Dancer"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Destroy 1 face-down card on your opponent's field.
● 1 face-up Cyborg Type monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the total ATK of all face-up Warrior Type monsters on your opponent's field] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa88.name: Sword Dancer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa88.description: A master swordsman that used to serve a great nation. He controls his flying swords with great precision as the audience watches attentively.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa2.name: Winged Celestial Dragon of Weal and Woe
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa2.description:
"Coiled Dragon of Fertility" + "Coiled Dragon of Destruction"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Wyrm Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a Spell Card to the Graveyard by this effect, you can add up to 2 Field Spell Cards from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa3.name: Hyper Upstart King Rex
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa3.description:
"Super King Rex" + "Ritzy King Rex"
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Dinosaur Type monster from your Graveyard on the top or bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] This card gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Upstart Goblin" in your Graveyard, you can add 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa4.name: Worker Warrior - Sinister Chairman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa4.description:
"Worker Warrior - Sinister CEO" + "Worker Warrior - Overhauled Organizer"
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 600 LP.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of Machine Type monsters in your Graveyard] x 200 until the end of this turn, then you can place 1 "Salary Slash" or "Battle Demotion" from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck, and if you do, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faaa.name: Priestess of Wise Salvation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faaa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. If you have a face-up Level 9 monster on your field, all face-up monsters on your field gain 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab2.name: Sevens Road Enchanter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Return 1 face-up non-Level 3 Spellcaster Type monster from the field to the owner's hand. If you added "Sevens Road Magician" to your hand by this effect, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab6.name: Heavy Roller
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 FIRE Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if a face-up Field Spell Card is on the field, you can draw 1 additional card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac0.name: Gagaga Outfielder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac0.description: A baseball warrior with gutsy defense and surprising hitting range. Also known as the fence magician, he is remembered visually rather than statistically.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac1.name: Achacha Catcher
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac1.description: A baseball warrior with a deft lead and an arrow-like delivery. Also known as the bedrock, he leads his teammates with his passionate play style.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac5.name: Medley the Elite Noodle Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac5.description: Overcoming every noodle-front and steadily evolving, the leader of the Noodle Ninja Clan. Unbound by status or noodle identity, he reaches out to members without noodle awareness.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac7.name: Necroman the Third
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 3 Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac8.name: Daybreak Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 Warrior Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 Warrior Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faca.name: Psypickupper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faca.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn, then you can gain 800 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87facf.name: Viscom Nanotron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87facf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] The only monsters in your Graveyard are 3 Cyberse Type monsters.
[Effect] Add all Cyberse Type monsters from your Graveyard to your hand, then place this card from your field on the bottom of the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad0.name: Constructor Sky Wyrm Gantry Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] A face-up Field Spell Card is on the field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Constructor Wyrm Buildragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with Wyrm Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad4.name: Head Bad Cachalot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Umi" or "Big Umi" face-up on your field, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad5.name: Gogogo Umpire
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 "Feverous Spirit Stadium" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 FIRE Attribute Normal Monster with 400 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with FIRE Attribute monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad7.name: Player #39: Home Run Hitter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If a face-up "Feverous Spirit Stadium" is on the field, send 2 face-up Level 4 FIRE Attribute monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 2500 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, you can only attack with this card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fada.name: Clean Machine Newsweeper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fada.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if an EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can add 1 Machine Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fadc.name: Sea Dragon Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fadc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Look at 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. If a card with the same name is in your opponent's Graveyard, you can destroy that card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fade.name: Raidacross Ash, Hero of Chaos
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fade.description:
"Raidacross, Hero of the Dawn" + "Dark Sorcerer"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters on the field] x 300 until the end of this turn.
● Look at all face-down Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field, and destroy 1 of them.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae0.name: Yamiterasu the Divine Ruler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae0.description:
"Yamiruler the Dark Delayer" + "Needlkyrie the Celestial Seamstress"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Until the end of your opponent's next turn, while this card is face-up, it gains 500 ATK, also neither player can Special Summon Level 9 or lower monsters in face-up Attack Position.
● Change the battle position of 1 monster on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae1.name: Newsflash the Journalistic Juggernaut
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae1.description:
"Printing Presser" + "Scoop Scooter"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Your opponent excavates the top 7 cards of their Deck. Your opponent places the excavated cards on the top of their Deck in any order. You can make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of excavated monsters] x 500 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae2.name: Instant Miso the Special Noodle Ninja
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae2.description:
"Medley the Elite Noodle Ninja" + "Flavor Inspector"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Pyro Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card gains 600 ATK, and also inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae4.name: Hunter of Titans
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae4.description:
"Descendant of Titans" + "Babysitter Goat"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Fiend Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faea.name: Stream of Elimination
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faea.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Sea Serpent Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf1.name: Stream
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Level 3 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, and Aqua Type monsters on the field gain 600 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf2.name: Card Revitalization
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands. You can make 1 face-up monster on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe9.name: Road Magic - Dark Night
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field, send 1 DARK Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbeb.name: Sevens Road Protection
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbeb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster.
[Effect] All face-up DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects this turn. If you have "Sevens Road Magician" in your Graveyard, you can change that opponent's Normal Summoned monster to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbee.name: Princess Omega the Shining Megastar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbee.description:
"Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar" + "Ama Lilith"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] ●Change the battle positions of all monsters on your field. You can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your field] x 800 until the end of this turn. ●Shuffle up to 7 cards from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf4.name: Psychic Omega Blast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 2 or more face-up monsters on their field, shuffle 4 Psychic Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster with the lowest ATK on your opponent's field. Then, if you have a face-up Omega Psychic Type monster on your field, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the original ATK of the monster destroyed by this effect].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf5.name: Encountering the Unknown
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Omega Psychic or Psychic Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Return the attacking monster to the owner's hand. Then, if you have a face-up "Handy Lady" on your field, you can add 1 Level 3 or lower monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfa.name: Tiramisu Dark Witch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfa.description: An angelic store attendant who carries both tiramisu and all the raging fads. Even against the ever-changing trends and the hearts of evil, she will never lose.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfc.name: Change of Dessert
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfc.description: An angel-like store attendant that's actually a demon. Her heart is jiggling like jelly, wondering whether to bring the order or not.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfd.name: Mother's Rain
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 8 or higher Aqua Type monster on your field, send 1 Aqua Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you destroyed a Machine Type monster by this effect, you can destroy all monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc00.name: Master's Cure
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc00.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 7 or higher monster face-up.
[Effect] Gain 1000 LP. Then, you can make 1 face-up Aqua Type monster on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc02.name: Crawling Torso
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc02.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 Zombie Type Normal Monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc06.name: Doll of Dread
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc06.description: When you're sleeping in the dressing room, you'll feel a bit of sleep paralysis... In the darkness, if you squint your eyes at your bedside...

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc07.name: Samba Zombie Rio
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc07.description: A zombie that constantly shuffles around awkwardly. It has no sense of self left, but it hasn't forgotten the rhythm of the samba that seeped into its body.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1e.name: Pangoflame
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa1e.description: A free-spirited creature inhabiting an eruptive crater. The flames from its body can ignite a sea of fire, but it is not bothered by mere infernal walls.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa20.name: Northern Dumplina
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa20.description: The poster-girl for a restaurant up North, an advocate for more work-life balance. Numerous corporate soldiers leave work on time to swing by, but she herself had also left on time.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa24.name: Thunderbold, the Blazing Thunder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa24.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have 4 or more Level 7 monsters with different names in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa25.name: Stock Buster Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa25.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 5 or more cards on their field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] All face-up Level 7 or lower monsters on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2b.name: Air Formula Eagle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 or more WIND Attribute Normal Monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 WIND Attribute Normal Monster from your hand to your field face-up, then you can Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower WIND Attribute Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your field face-up.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2d.name: Worker Warrior - Sinister CEO
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa2d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field, send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Set up to 1 each of "Salary Slash" and "Battle Demotion" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa35.name: Reset Runner
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa35.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle your Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa37.name: Gate Gargoyle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa37.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Increase the Level of 1 face-up monster on your field by 1 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3d.name: JAM:P Set!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Level 2 or lower Psychic Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard on top of the Deck.
[Effect] Place 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster from your opponent's field on top of the owner's Deck. Then, if you placed "CAN:D" on top of the Deck to meet the requirement, you can shuffle up to 2 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into their Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3f.name: Against Buster
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa3f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] 1 face-up WIND Attribute monster with 2000 or more ATK on your field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn, then you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa46.name: Wild Kitchen
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa46.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if you have 3 face-up FIRE Attribute monsters on your field.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, all face-up FIRE Attribute monsters on the field gain 300 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa47.name: Beast Battlefield Barrier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa47.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up monsters on the field lose 200 ATK, and face-up Beast Type Normal Monsters on the field gain 400 DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa49.name: Talismanic Seal Array
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa49.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [its Level] x 200 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4a.name: Berserker Colosseum
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card by sending the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up monsters on the field gain 100 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4d.name: Mismatched Rivalry
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa4d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 5 or higher monster.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa51.name: Backup Barrage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa51.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up WIND Attribute monster, shuffle 1 WIND Attribute Normal Monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] The attacking monster loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa53.name: Battle Demotion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa53.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack on your face-up Machine Type monster, pay 600 LP.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa60.name: Accel Wonder Flare
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa60.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Inflict 400 damage to your opponent. Then, if you inflicted damage to your opponent by this effect, you can make 1 face-up monster on your field become Spellcaster Type until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa61.name: Aqua Sorcerer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa61.description: A magician with a pure mind that's beyond reproach. His unclouded eyes were supposed to always see the way to the path of reason, but at some point he began hiding them behind a mask.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa69.name: Matsugumi the Ruler's Squad
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa69.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send 1 Warrior Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Set 1 "Ruler's Current", "Ruler's Deadly Duel", or "Ruler's Dance" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6b.name: Bowing Brotherhood
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa6b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase, pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Change up to 2 Attack Position monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position. Then, if you have 3 Defense Position monsters on your field, you can shuffle up to 5 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa72.name: Followl of the Fornether
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa72.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 3 Fiend Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa76.name: Belsectacle Mani
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa76.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the number of face-up Cyberse Type monsters on your field] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7d.name: Evergreen of Blisstopia
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa7d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if you have face-up monsters on your field whose total Levels equal 10 or more.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, all face-up non-EARTH Attribute monsters on the field lose 300 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa81.name: Metarion Vritrastar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa81.description:
"Imaginary Actor" + "Serpainter"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Change 1 monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position.
● Destroy face-up Dragon Type monsters on your opponent's field, up to [the number of face-up Cyborg Type monsters on your field].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa84.name: Fire Jester
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa84.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 5 or higher LIGHT Attribute monster on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa86.name: Glaciasaurus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa86.description: A gentle dinosaur that doesn't like conflict. It's always gracefully watching the audience.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8a.name: Imaginary Arc Turbo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 9 LIGHT Attribute monster or 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Normal Monster on your field gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Imaginary Actor" in your Graveyard, that monster gains 1000 more ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8d.name: Imaginary Arc Turnback
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa8d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your Attack Position LIGHT Attribute monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Cyborg Type monster or 1 LIGHT Attribute Normal Monster with 500 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa93.name: Swordsman of Roadstar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa93.description: A swordsman of the shooting stars with unknown powers, capable of carving open a miraculous path.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa98.name: The Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa98.description: The dragon of justice signaling supernova clashes! Its name is The Dragon!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa99.name: The Power Up
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa99.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9d.name: Chemical Cure Red
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Gain 500 LP. Then, you can add any number of "Red Medicine" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9f.name: Crescent Moon Swordmaster
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fa9f.description:
"Masaki the Legendary Samurai" + "Hero of the Yeast"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa0.name: Fearstute Followl
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa0.description:
"Followl of the Fornether" + "Followl of the Dark Wisdom"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Fiend Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa1.name: Permillind Hicrotron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faa1.description:
"Femtron" + "Cycliptron"
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 or more Cyberse Type Effect Monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards, then place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faad.name: Spectral Swords of the Everloyal Guard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] 1 face-up Fusion Monster on your field cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faaf.name: Graceful Charity
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faaf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Draw 3 cards. Then, send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab8.name: Flame Manipulator
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fab8.description: This Spellcaster attacks enemies with fire-related spells such as "Sea of Flames" and "Wall of Fire".

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faba.name: Masaki the Legendary Swordsman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faba.description: Legendary swordmaster Masaki is a veteran of over 100 battles.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabb.name: Spike Seadra
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabb.description: Using the spikes sprouting from its body, this creature stabs its opponents and floods them with electricity.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabe.name: Takriminos
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fabe.description: A member of a race of sea serpents that freely travels through the sea.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac6.name: U.M.U. - Unidentified Mysterious Urchin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac6.description: A creature that appears everywhere throughout the ocean. Despite massive overfishing, its population doesn't appear to be shrinking.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac9.name: Porcupine Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fac9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Mountain" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad8.name: Player #99: Grand Slam Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fad8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 FIRE Attribute monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Player #39: Home Run Hitter" from your Graveyard face-up to your field, then this card gains 2000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fadd.name: Dosodon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fadd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard, including at least 1 Normal Monster.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae9.name: Shape of Aqua
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fae9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, or Aqua Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. It loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faeb.name: Feverous Spirit Stadium
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faeb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up FIRE Attribute monsters on your field gain 400 ATK during your turn only, and face-up FIRE Attribute monsters on your opponent's field gain 400 ATK during their turn only.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf0.name: Back Beat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Shuffle 2 to 7 monsters with the same Type from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you shuffled 4 or more monsters by this effect, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf5.name: Seastorm of Iruqua
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack while you have "Umi" or "Big Umi" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position). Then, you can Special Summon 1 Sea Serpent Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf7.name: Gagaga Guts
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 FIRE Attribute monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, if you Special Summoned "Player #39: Home Run Hitter" or "Player #99: Grand Slam Dragon" by this effect, you can destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb01.name: Ancient Arrive Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb01.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Up to 2 face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 400 ATK until the end of this turn, then you can Special Summon up to 1 each of "Clear Ice Dragon" and "Burning Blaze Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb07.name: Smashing Ground
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb07.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster with the highest DEF on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0a.name: Crystal Brain
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Each player sends cards equal to [the number of face-up Cyberse Type monsters on your field] from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb17.name: Constructor Princess Pylon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb17.description: The princess of the Wyrms that live in Blisstopia. She cherishes the bonds she has with her precious friends.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1b.name: Kaibaman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb28.name: Dark Femtron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb28.description: The origin of the dragon tree, connected to a different curiosity. With its concealed infinite branches, it unfolds into unknown worlds.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb29.name: Snake Clown
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb29.description: A charming serpent that's super sociable. It performs a slithery dance to the tune of a flute, turning spectators' frowns upside down.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb32.name: Sevens Road Sorcerer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb32.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 3 face-up monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned "Sevens Road Magician" by this effect, you can Special Summon 1 "Sevens Road Witch" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb37.name: Player #C39: Home Run Smasher
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb37.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Level 4 FIRE Attribute monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This card gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if your LP are 1000 or lower, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 3000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb39.name: Clawmeleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb39.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-down monster on their field, send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Level 7 or higher Reptile Type monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3a.name: Fiery Infernleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your LP are lower than your opponent's, pay 600 LP.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a Reptile Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Reptile Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb40.name: Zap Zap Octospark
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb40.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and have a face-up Thunder Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] This card gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf3.name: Shocking Comeback!!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 6 or higher monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Gain LP equal to [the ATK of 1 Level 6 or lower Psychic Type monster in your Graveyard]. Then, if you gained 1000 or more LP by this effect, you can add that monster to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf9.name: Reporting from the Scene!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faf9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack, send 1 EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict 300 damage to your opponent. This turn, you take no battle damage.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faff.name: Doma the Talismanic Master
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87faff.description:
"Sakakaze the Talismanic Warrior" + "Karatake the Talismanic Warrior"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of cards on your opponent's field] x 200 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb03.name: Kimeterasu the Divine Luna
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb03.description:
"Kimeluna the Dark Shifter" + "Needlkyrie the Celestial Seamstress"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Add 1 monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.
● Destroy up to 2 Defense Position monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb09.name: Daigyakutenno Megami
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb09.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Gyakutenno Megami" in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card and send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. If you sent a monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can destroy 2 face-up monsters on your opponent's field with the same Type as that monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0c.name: Dark Resonance Burst
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Make 1 face-up Level 6 or higher DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. If you have a face-up "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" on your field, that monster also gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0d.name: Burst Stream of Destruction
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb0d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" on your field.
[Effect] Destroy all monsters on your opponent's field. This turn, you cannot attack with "Blue-Eyes White Dragon".

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb12.name: Heavenly Bliss
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb12.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect and you have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, if a Level 10 monster was destroyed, you can destroy 1 face-down card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb16.name: Beaver Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb16.description: What this creature lacks in size it makes up for in defense when battling in the prairie.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb18.name: Pholus the Star Knight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb18.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters with the same Type from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or 6 Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field, then you can reduce the Levels of all face-up Level 5 or higher monsters on your opponent's field by 4 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb19.name: Karatake the Talismanic Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb19.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have another face-up Warrior Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards on their field] x 200.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1c.name: Crack Fall
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb1c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Destroy all cards in the Field Zones. Then, if you destroyed a card by this effect, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb21.name: Alligator's Sword Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb21.description:
"Baby Dragon" + "Alligator's Sword"
[REQUIREMENT] The only face-up monsters on your opponent's field are EARTH, WATER, or FIRE Attribute.
[Effect] This turn, this card can attack directly.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb22.name: Mechaleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb22.description: This monster can hide just about anywhere by adopting the colors of its surroundings.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb25.name: Emperor of the Land and Sea
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb25.description: A reptilian monster that sprays fire in every direction.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2b.name: Armored Lizard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2b.description: A lizard with a very tough hide and a vicious bite.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2e.name: Anglercoilfish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb2e.description: An anglerfish with evolved electric organs. Attacks enemies with sharp fangs and electric shocks.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb30.name: Germalewe
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb30.description: A ferocious being in a world of fire. The devoured pray leaves not a single bone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb31.name: Antsgiving
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb31.description: Ants who always give thanks to their comrades for their support. They're determined to further increase the number of their allies.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb35.name: Shearkyrie the Celestial Seamstress
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb35.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Fairy Type monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb38.name: Kamaleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb38.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 300 LP.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a Reptile Type Normal Monster(s) is among the cards sent, add 1 Reptile Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. You can only attack with Reptile Type monsters the turn you activated this effect.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3b.name: Metal Megaleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your LP are lower than your opponent's, pay 600 LP.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. This card gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3d.name: Ecdysis Caesarleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of cards in your Graveyard] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3e.name: Spyturtle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb3e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Reduce the Level of 1 face-up Level 3-8 monster on your opponent's field by 2 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb43.name: Sensor Duckbuill
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb43.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 5 or higher Thunder Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb45.name: Blast Jaws
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb45.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 1 or less cards in their hand, shuffle 1 Thunder Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up Thunder Type monster on your field gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb48.name: Master of the Sevens Road
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb48.description:
"Sevens Road Magician" + "Sevens Road Witch"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters with different names in your Graveyard] x 300. If you have 7 or more DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters in your Graveyard, this card inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference), if it attacks a Defense Position monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4e.name: Durga the Shadow Flower Submarine
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4e.description:
"Gatling the Shadow Flower Shinobi" + "Lindo the Shadow Flower Warrior"
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 6 or higher monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4f.name: Metarion King Cobrastar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4f.description:
"Imaginary Actor" + "Snake Clown"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Draw 2 cards. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
● Up to 3 face-up Reptile Type monsters on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. This card can attack twice during this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb53.name: Offal GunMcQueen, the Magnificent Shichirin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb53.description:
"Shichirin Samurai - Kushiro the Skewer Master" + "Flavor Inspector"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 "Shichirin Samurai - Kushiro the Skewer Master" and/or "Taste Inspector" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 9 or lower non-FIRE Attribute monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb54.name: Ether F Striker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb54.description:
"Ether Seeker" + "Ether Finder"
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard on either the top or bottom of your Deck.
[Effect] This card gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can place 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard on top of your Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb58.name: Shadow Flower Flurry
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb58.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Plant Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 Defense Position monster on either field to face-up Attack Position. Then, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb5b.name: Destructurtle Meteor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb5b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] 2 face-up Reptile Type monsters on your field and 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb64.name: Buried Shield
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb64.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, place 1 Field Spell Card from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Change that monster to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can make 1 face-up Wyrm Type monster on your field gain 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb65.name: Wrath of Light
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb65.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 7 or higher monster face-up while you have a face-up Reptile Type monster on your field.
[Effect] This turn, your opponent's monsters with 3000 or more ATK cannot attack. Also, you can shuffle up to 5 Reptile Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb68.name: Electrical Discharge
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb68.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 2 Thunder Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb69.name: Maid's Baneful Gift
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb69.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Necromaid Nana" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb71.name: Barrel Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb71.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose 1 monster on your opponent's field, and toss a coin 3 times. If at least 2 of the results are heads, destroy that monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb76.name: Wooly Wonderland Night Mutton
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb76.description: The most pensive of the Wooly Wonderland flock. Something of a black sheep, it prefers to stick to its own knitting.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb77.name: Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb77.description: Baa-dum, baa-dum, baa-dum, baa-dum, baaaaa-dum! The sheep's in the meadow, the cow's in the corn! You can call me "miss", but i'm actually Wooly Wonderland royalty. I'm never sheepish about chowing on paper (even if it happens to be an important letter).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb79.name: Decennium Mystic Sword
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb79.description: A sword with a soul. Those who wield this sword are encouraged to bide their time and wait to make their move.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7a.name: Centennial Wooden Blade
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7a.description: A wooden sword with a soul. It's said as it's exchanged hands, it's seen people's fortunes wax and wane.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb84.name: Jointech Rex
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb84.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb85.name: Wooly Wonderland Planewe
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb85.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Beast Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Set 1 "Meet and Greed" or 1 "Wooly Wonderland - Graveyard Grudge" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, if you have a face-up "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" on your field, you can gain 600 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb87.name: Swordfish Vanguard Gaju
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb87.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Set 1 "Dolphin Counterattack" or "Seastorm of Iruqua" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Dolphin King Iruqua" from your hand or your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8a.name: Swapling Silkworm Fibron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up Insect Type monster on your field, send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field becomes Insect Type this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8b.name: Therappi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Reptile Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Gain 500 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb90.name: Crusher Drone
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb90.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster on your field, send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb91.name: Ravenous Matiless
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb91.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Insect Type monster on your opponent's field loses 800 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb93.name: Ungrad Diggra
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb93.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if an Insect Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, this card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 400 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb94.name: Grand Cerberus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb94.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of face-up EARTH Attribute Machine Type monsters on your field] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb97.name: Constructor Chief Wyrm Handtoolon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb97.description:
"Constructor Warrior Shovelon" + "Picklon the Constructor Fairy"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 200 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if a face-up Field Spell Card is not on your field, you can add 1 "Peaks of Blisstopia" or "Silvermountain of Blisstopia" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9d.name: Meet and Greed
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Beast Type Normal Monster on your field can make 3 attacks on monsters this turn. Then, if you have a face-up "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" on your field, you can make all face-up Effect Monsters on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba4.name: Intruding Beetles
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If 2 or more face-up Insect Type monsters are on the field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba6.name: Ghost Cyclone
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no monsters on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, if you have 3 or less monsters in your Graveyard, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbad.name: Climax Clash
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your EARTH Attribute monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of EARTH Attribute Normal Monsters in your Graveyard] x 100. Then, you can destroy 1 face-up Normal Monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb1.name: Hunting Strawberries
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbb1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Spell/Trap Card on your field is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster with 1500 or less ATK on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbf.name: Universe Dea
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you sent a Galaxy Type Normal Monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, gain 800 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc0.name: Celestial Ganzel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc0.description: This ethereal dragon carries the hopes of many an innocent star. Its attacks draw strength by resonating with the pure of heart. Ungoldo Guwahi!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc4.name: Meteorhino
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc4.description: A mysterious life-form with soft skin. In order to protect itself from space carnivores, it attaches meteorites to its body. Igyai Du Uvaai!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc6.name: Shadow Sentinel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc6.description: A galactic warrior with no tolerance for villainry. Its strikes cleave apart even the deepest of darkness. Hideunri Va Yamerdei!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc7.name: Vortex Shooter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbc7.description: A galactic warrior that attacks by launching saucers. Igyah Du Zuwahi!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbca.name: Orbit Skater
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbca.description: This free-wheeling gravity-defier tears across the stars. These days he can be found weaving amid the crowd of grown-ups on interplanetary street. Inzundewmo Idohshowar!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbcc.name: Sora Puyo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbcc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4a.name: Endless Romance Blitz
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb4a.description:
"Folder Blitz the Infinite Dream" + "Romanpick"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 "Folder Blitz the Infinite Dream" and 1 "Romanpick" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.
● Draw 3 cards. Then, send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb50.name: Poseigyon Adventurer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb50.description:
"Anglercoilfish" + "Pluggyfish"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] All face-up Thunder Type monsters on your field gain 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb52.name: Prime Roast Beef Horseman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb52.description:
"Barbeque Ox" + "Mystic Roastman"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, place 4 FIRE Attribute Beast Type monsters from your Graveyard on top of your Deck in any order.
[Effect] Add up to 1 each of "Best Bite", "B・B・Q", and "Wild Kitchen" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb5a.name: Bobble Header
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb5a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add up to 2 "Feverous Spirit Stadium" and/or "Tag-Up-Magic Sacrifice Force" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb60.name: Trailblitzing Thunderblast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb60.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Thunder Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb63.name: Jurassic Oasis
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb63.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card by sending the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard while you have a face-up Dinosaur Type monster on your field.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Dinosaur Type monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by monster effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb66.name: Ultimate Fighting Spirit
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb66.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 9 or lower monster declares an attack targeting your Defense Position monster.
[Effect] Negate the attack. Then, change 1 Defense Position monster on your field to face-up Attack Position. Then, if you changed a Normal Monster to face-up Attack Position by this effect, it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb67.name: Sakuretsu Force
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb67.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Sakuretsu Armor" in your Graveyard, you can destroy up to 2 Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6b.name: Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb6b.description: A dragon commonly found guarding mountain fortresses. Its signature attack is a sweeping dive from out of the blue.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb75.name: Wooly Wonderland Pyro Wool
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb75.description: The elder of the Wooly Wonderland flock. It tires to ram through its decisions but the others refuse to be herded.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7e.name: Dark Handshaker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Shuffle 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Normal Monster on your field, you can change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7f.name: Astro Rescue
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb7f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field and you have 2 face-up Normal Monsters on your field.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot attack with Level 8 or lower Effect Monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb80.name: Ozone Slayer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb80.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb82.name: Satellite Pegasus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb82.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have 1 or less monsters in your Graveyard, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb89.name: Pakupakuchu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb89.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, place 1 Beast Type monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck.
[Effect] Add 1 Beast Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8c.name: Rapid Carriearth
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 3 monsters on their field, shuffle 3 EARTH Attribute Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. This turn, your Level 6 or lower monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8d.name: Dramoth Caterpillar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Insect Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8e.name: Shitotsu the Talismanic Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb8e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only face-up monsters on your field are Warrior Type monsters, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Warrior Type monster with 1000 ATK and 1000 DEF from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb92.name: Excutie Phermi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb92.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Normal Monster on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb95.name: Dynas Dorcus the Beetle King
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb95.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 5-8 Insect Type monster on your opponent's field. This turn, you can only attack with Insect Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9b.name: Surge Vortex Dragoon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fb9b.description:
"Surge Bolt Lizard" + "Surge Bolt Lizard"
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up monster on their field.
[Effect] Add 1 "Electrical Discharge" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba7.name: Strange Wall
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fba7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have a Galaxy Type monster in your Graveyard.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbab.name: Security Hole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbab.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Cyberse Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Shuffle the attacking monster into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbac.name: Roar of the Demolisher
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbac.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 7 or higher monster while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy that Normal Summoned monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbba.name: Pitch-Black Warwolf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbc.name: Ancient Rules
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbe.name: Cosmo Titan
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbbe.description: An insttumient of conquest controlled by 5 rings. It reduces the civilizations in its path to mere dust. Duguyahi Bu Zuwahi!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbcd.name: Interstellime
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbcd.description: Slime formed from interstellar gaseous matter. Smells faintly of lime. Iyashgewai!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbcf.name: Universal Storm
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbcf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd2.name: Vacua Annihilation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Galaxy Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field, up to [the number of face-up Galaxy Type Normal Monsters on your field].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd3.name: Transam Alive
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect while you have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Galaxy Type Normal Monster with 1600 or more ATK from your hand or your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd6.name: Jointech Ace
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd6.description: An autonomous robot that excels at construction. Its joint parts hide an unknown power.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd8.name: Cliptera
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbd8.description: A winged dragon that glides through the room with its beautiful wings. It captures childlike minds and won't let go of them.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbdc.name: Jointech Bumper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbdc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack, shuffle 3 Machine Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy up to 3 Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe2.name: Supreme Beasteam Magnum Overlord (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] During the turn your opponent Special Summoned a Level 5 or higher monster face-up, while this card is face-up, your opponent cannot activate the effects of face-up Level 10 or lower monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe4.name: Magician of Dark Sevens
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe4.description:
"Sevens Road Magician" + "Darkness Zerorogue"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters in your Graveyard] x 300. You take no battle damage from battles involving your other monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf0.name: CAN - Sp:D
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up Omega Psychic or Psychic Type monster on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up monster on your field gains 200 ATK and your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when it declares an attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf7.name: Dian Keto the Cooking Master
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if your LP are 2000 or less, you can gain LP equal to [the number of Aqua Type monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 1000.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf8.name: Brick Phone Nyan Nyan
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 Level 7 or higher Aqua Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfb.name: Frenzied Panda Cotta
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbfb.description: A savage panda store clerk. It completely snaps when someone orders panna cotta.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbff.name: Party Up
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbff.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Aqua Type monster.
[Effect] Gain LP equal to [the attacking monster's ATK].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc01.name: Dark Doom Dread Ruler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc01.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Zombie Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a Level 7 Zombie Type monster in your Graveyard, inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc03.name: Cyber-Stein Frankenshrine
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc03.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Level 4 or lower Zombie Type Normal Monster in your Graveyard during the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 Level 4 or lower Zombie Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe5.name: Darkness Zerorogue
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 8 or more DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters in your Graveyard during your Main Phase this card was Special Summoned.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe7.name: Darkness Rogue
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbe7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, place this card from your field on the bottom of the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbea.name: Darkness Road
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbea.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Level 5 or higher DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters on the field gain 400 ATK and lose 1500 DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbec.name: Magic Fire Guard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbec.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack while you have 2 or more Spellcaster Type monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 Attack Position Spellcaster Type monster on your field cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbed.name: Omega Guitarna the Shining Megastar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbed.description:
"Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar" + "Ama Lilith"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] ●This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 1000 until the end of this turn. This turn, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects. ●Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf6.name: Featuring Omega
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] 1 face-up Omega Psychic or Psychic Type monster on your field gains 1200 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if that monster's Level is 9, it cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf9.name: Fashion of Faith
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fbf9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and have a face-up Level 7 or higher Aqua Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, all face-up Level 7 or higher Aqua Type monsters on your field gain 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc08.name: Nightmare Knock
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc08.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or more Spell/Trap Cards on their field.
[Effect] Choose 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field, and destroy all other Spell/Trap Cards on their field. This turn, your monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0a.name: Zombie Carnival
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Zombie Type monsters on the field gain ATK/DEF equal to [the number of face-up Zombie Type monsters on the field] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0b.name: Zombie Fireworks
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 5 or higher Zombie Type monster in your hand.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 Level 6 or lower Zombie Type monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, send 1 Level 5 or higher Zombie Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard. This turn, you can only attack with Zombie Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc14.name: Peeking Magician
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc14.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Each player excavates the top 2 cards of their Deck. Then, they place their excavated cards on top of their Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1c.name: Rice Terrace Secure
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change non-Aqua Type Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position, up to [the number of face-up Aqua Type monsters on your field].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc23.name: Kappa Rapper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc23.description: A rhymester representin' the riverside. He stirs up passerby who approach the water.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc27.name: Abyss Soldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc27.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 WATER Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Return 1 card from the field to the hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc29.name: Wooly Wonderland Thunder Rambda
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc29.description: The most lambent of the Wooly Wonderland flock. It conducts the others' activities, always with a twinkle in its eye.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2d.name: Mean Mutt Blasting Bowwow
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2d.description: He fights back with water guns against any foe. Trust from his allies? So-so.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2e.name: Heartless Hound Blade Bulldosu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2e.description: A Heartless Hound who threatens with a throaty deep voice. His ability to intimidate others is... so-so.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2f.name: Heartless Hound Striking Kai Ken Knuckle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2f.description: A young Heartless Hound who is extremely motivated, but also pretty reckless. The strength of his grip is... so-so.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc34.name: The Three Warp-Granny Sisters
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc34.description: A trio of sisters who warp in unique poses. Their hobby is to frighten the operators of spaceships while running alongside them.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc36.name: Ichtyosterguard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc36.description: An Ichthyostega soldier with incredible toughness. Since it wears hard and heavy armor, it is quite slow moving.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc38.name: Blue-Fang Burst Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc38.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up monsters with 1500 or less ATK on your opponent's field. Then, this card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters destroyed by this effect] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3b.name: Chemicalized Salamander
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Pyro Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of monsters in your opponent's Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3c.name: Parafungus Colony
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Parashroom Colony" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3e.name: Star Trancer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Galaxy Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned a Level 8 monster by this effect, this turn, it gains 400 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc43.name: Kappa Emperor River Slider
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc43.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Aqua Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy up to 2 face-up Level 7 or lower Normal Monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc46.name: Heartless Hound Thunder Emperor Drainu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc46.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you activated this effect during your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, you can Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Beast-Warrior Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc49.name: Freshberry Happiness
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc49.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Aqua Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you sent a monster with 100 or less ATK to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4d.name: Rice Terrace Ripple
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if your opponent has a card in their Spell & Trap Zone, you can change 1 face-up Normal Monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4e.name: Headhunters' Digmole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more monsters in your Graveyard, shuffle 3 Beast-Warrior Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
