[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc52.name: Amabear Lilith
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc52.description:
"Ama Lilith" + "Ice Pop Bear"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Return 1 monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand. Then, your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their hand to their field in face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc53.name: Splendid Floor Master
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc53.description:
"Amazing Dealer" + "Amazing Dealer"
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 600 LP.
[Effect] Toss a coin. If the result is heads, draw 2 cards. If the result is tails, draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc54.name: Eclipse
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc54.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster on your field and 1 face-up monster with the same Level on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc56.name: Embracing the Rain
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc56.description:
[REQUIREMENT] A face-up Field Spell Card is on the field.
[Effect] All face-up Normal Monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 300 until the end of this turn. Then, you can destroy 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc58.name: Kingdom of Bubbles
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc58.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Aqua Type Normal Monsters on the field gain 500 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc59.name: Woofderful Heartless Hound
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc59.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Beast-Warrior Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent 4 Beast-Warrior Type monsters to the Graveyard by this effect, you can make 1 face-up monster on your field gain 1200 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5a.name: 300 Light-Year Red Cloak
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 face-up Reptile Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] All face-up Reptile Type monsters on your field gain 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if your opponent's LP are at least 3000 higher than yours, you can destroy 1 face-up Normal Monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5b.name: Triumphant Arrival
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Level 3 or lower Reptile Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Reptile Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5c.name: Area 33
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if you have 2 or more face-up Level 3 or lower Reptile Type Normal Monsters on your field.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Reptile Type Normal Monsters on the field gain 600 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5f.name: Yamata no Tsurugi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Level 8 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, you can make 1 face-up Level 8 monster on your field gain 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc61.name: Power Shock
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc61.description:
[REQUIREMENT] After your opponent activates a Spell Card.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc66.name: The Three Moonlit Mystery Geckos
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc66.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have a face-up Level 3 or lower Reptile Type Normal Monster on your field.
[Effect] 1 face-up Reptile Type monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Reptile Type monsters on your field] x 1000 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6a.name: Mirage Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6b.name: Flame Ruler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a FIRE Attribute monster in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc78.name: Corktrooper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc78.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field and your opponent has 2 or less Spell/Trap Cards on their field.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards on their field] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc81.name: Beta Burn Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc81.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and have another face-up Dragon Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters on their field] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc84.name: Dragosite
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc84.description: A rare electronic lifeform in the Network World. They don't like fighting and grow by eating Bugs.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8a.name: Flame Champion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8a.description: A warrior protected by a flaming shield that nullifies any attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8e.name: Methyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 4 Pyro Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with Pyro Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc94.name: Voidvelg Hecatoncheir
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc94.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change this Attack Position card to face-up Defense Position.
[Effect] Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Then, if you have a face-up Level 8 monster on your field, you can change the battle position of 1 face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc97.name: Dimension Azarth
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc97.description: After many years dormant, it has set out once more to devour lifeforms across the cosmos. It invades domain after domain via the interdimensional portals that surround it.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9b.name: Voidvelg Peltast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9b.description: Imbued with energy from a crescent moon, this warrior fends off every attack with a monumental shield. Its inner power awakens with the arrival of the full moon.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9d.name: Void Intercept
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster face-up while the only face-up monsters on your field are DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monsters.
[Effect] Send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more cards in their hand, they can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9e.name: Void Veil
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster face-up while you have 2 or more face-up DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Change 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you have a face-up Level 8 Galaxy Type monster on your field, you can return 1 Defense Position monster from your opponent's field to the hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca5.name: Darklord Zerato
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca5.description:
If you have 4 or more DARK Attribute monsters with different names in your Graveyard, you can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 DARK Attribute monster.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 DARK Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all monsters on your opponent's field. Destroy this card during the End Phase of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca7.name: Arts Angel Guard Dolby
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca7.description: A rookie angel who reads out letters from a flying radio. The first is a letter from Radio Name: Mr. Corrupt Hermit.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca8.name: Arts Angel Glyco Razer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca8.description: A music weapon that fell from heaven. Its special sound waves that it releases are as sharp as a laser.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcaa.name: Bean Soljersey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcaa.description: A jersey-warrior that attacks with seeds and sword.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb2.name: Arts Angel Dia Needle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up DARK Attribute Fairy Type monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb7.name: Iris the Rare Shadow Flower
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Set 1 "Shadow Flower Sewing" or "Shadow Flower Duplication" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, send the bottom card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a Level 5 Plant Type Normal Monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can Special Summon 1 Plant Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbb.name: Bluegrass Stealer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a Psychic Type monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can choose 1 face-up Psychic Type monster on your field. This turn, the chosen monster can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a WIND Attribute Psychic Type monster in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc0.name: Beast Gear Side Fennec
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Beast-Warrior Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up Beast-Warrior Type monster on your field gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a face-up Spell Card on your field, you can make 1 face-up monster on your field gain 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc8.name: Neo Plandish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the bottom card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects. Then, if you sent a Plant Type monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, this card gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fccc.name: Kuzuha the Talismanic Supreme Sage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fccc.description:
"Shitotsu the Talismanic Warrior" + "Miginagi the Talismanic Warrior"
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Spell/Trap Card from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of monsters with 1000 ATK and DEF in your Graveyard] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fccf.name: Qwerty Keyblade
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fccf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Dragon Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Spell Cards on your field] x 200. If the equipped monster is DARK Attribute, it inflicts piercing battle damage.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd4.name: Preparation of Jersey Rites
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 8 monster with 500 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can add 1 "Black Luster Jersey Ritual" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd6.name: Shadow Flower Duplication
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 Plant Type Normal Monsters with an equal or lower Level than the Level of 1 face-up Plant Type Normal Monster on your field, from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have a face-up Level 5 monster on your field, you can destroy all face-up Level 7 or higher Normal Monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd8.name: Flame Arms - Fretberge
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up monster on your field whose original Type is Psychic.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 400 ATK. While the equipped monster is face-up on your field, your opponent cannot declare an attack on monsters that are not equipped with an Equip Spell Card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce1.name: Slash Halo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your Attack Position Fairy Type monster, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce2.name: Back Jersey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 5 or higher monster face-up, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster with 500 DEF on your field gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can shuffle up to 5 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce9.name: Update Wyvern
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce9.description: A flying dragon that can transform itself freely. By logging the enemy's movement, it performs the most optimal update for itself.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcea.name: Begonia the Pressed Shadow Flower
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcea.description: A flower spirit that never abandons her beloved. She is always happy.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcef.name: Combustion Oni Bunsel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcef.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Each player sends the top 2 cards of their Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can reduce the Level of 1 face-up Level 3-8 monster on your opponent's field by 1 or 2 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf3.name: Doomblaze Fiend Overlord Despairacion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf3.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Doomblaze Fiend Overlord Despairacion [L]" and "Doomblaze Fiend Overlord Despairacion [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 Maximum Monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, draw 2 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0e.name: I Hear Footsteps
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase while you have a face-up Zombie Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Look at your opponent's hand. You can choose up to 3 Spell/Trap Cards from their hand. If you do, your opponent Sets those cards to their field, and they take damage equal to [the number of cards Set by this effect] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc10.name: Terrorphone Number
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc10.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase while you have a Zombie Type monster in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict 900 damage to your opponent. This turn, if your opponent attacks a face-up monster, they can only attack the monster on your field with the lowest Level.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc11.name: Oriental Tiger
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc11.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change this card's battle position (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards in their Graveyard] x 100. Then, if your opponent has 10 or more Spell Cards in their Graveyard, inflict 1200 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc13.name: Cursed Skeletal Dragon Diarga
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc13.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up Zombie Type monster on your field, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 5 or higher monster on your opponent's field loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc17.name: Sacrificial Summon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc17.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up monster with 1600 or more ATK from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Effect Monster from your hand face-up to your field. If you sent an Effect Monster whose original Level is 7 or higher to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, the monster Special Summoned by this effect can make up to 2 attacks on monsters this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc18.name: Trade-In
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc18.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 8 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1e.name: Mystical Sandbox
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1e.description: She bends water to her will, hardening sand into stone. With muddy hands, She brings all sorts of creations to life.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc26.name: Luster Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc26.description: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2a.name: Wooly Wonderland Air Aries
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2a.description: The free-roamer of the Wooly Wonderland flock. It remains blase even while others around are venting.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2b.name: Hyosube
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2b.description: This amphibian is strong on the attack, but leaves much to be desired when defending.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc30.name: Meat Mutt Blasting Chow Chow
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc30.description: While normally calm, this is one mutt you don't want to cross. His motivation? So-so.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc31.name: Heartless Hound Apex Katana Danbiramatian
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc31.description: The apex of the Heartless Hounds who presides over his clumsy so-so subordinates. His proficiency is quite woofderful.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc32.name: Sannomiya Golden G Robo MK-III
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc32.description: Its power source is AA Batteries. Its daily routine is to watch videos while taking a walk. It never works or studies.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc33.name: Aliyen 33
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc33.description: A specialist in spacecraft design and maintenance. Currently assisting  with an outlandish project at a certain facility.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc39.name: Nitro Hound
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc39.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Inflict 400 damage to your opponent. You can only attack with Pyro Type monsters this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3a.name: Dynamo Might
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3f.name: Ultra Violady
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Neither player can Special Summon Level 7 monsters from the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc47.name: Heartless Hound Martial Master Shiba
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc47.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5-7 Beast-Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc55.name: Melo Melo Meeeg☆Uuultra Beam
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc55.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Magical Sheep Girl Meeeg-chan" face-up on your field, send 2 Beast Type Normal Monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field. This turn, you can only attack with Beast Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5d.name: Dolphin's Treasure Chest
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 WATER Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if your opponent has a face-up Level 7 monster on their field, you can draw 1 additional card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5e.name: Strange Seas
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc5e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon up to 3 Level 4 or lower WATER Attribute monsters from your hand face-up to your field. Then, if you have 3 face-up WATER Attribute monsters on your field, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc63.name: Kappa's River Flow
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc63.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 2 Aqua Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 800 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can make 1 face-up Normal Monster on your opponent's field lose 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc67.name: Trap Lid
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc67.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Special Summons a monster from the Graveyard face-up.
[Effect] Change up to 2 face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc70.name: Transam Jelai
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc70.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up monster with 1600 or more ATK on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up Level 4 LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type monster on your field can make up to 2 attacks on monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc71.name: Galactica Jamais Vu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc71.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card, shuffle 2 Spell Cards from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc73.name: Galactica Repulsion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc73.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 face-up Galaxy Type Normal Monsters on your field.
[Effect] Return 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc74.name: Galactica Lattice
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc74.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] Change up to 3 Attack Position Galaxy Type Normal Monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position. Then, all face-up monsters on your field gain DEF equal to [the number of face-up Galaxy Type monsters on your field] x 500 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc77.name: Tapanchula
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc77.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You Normal Summoned this card this turn and your opponent has 2 or more Spell/Trap Cards on their field.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 4 Machine Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc79.name: Carpendra
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc79.description: A mass-produced demolition machine with excellent mobility and functionality. The joints are very brittle, meaning its arms and wings often fall off.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7b.name: Craftroll
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7b.description: A crafting robot popular with children. It's also active as an amusement park mascot. It transforms when the central handle is turned.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7c.name: Nail Hedgepeg
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc82.name: Applizard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc82.description: A race of dragonoids that have transformed from being mere dragons. They demonstrate both great cunning and agility, and can wield their tablets when they attack as both swords and shields.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc83.name: SSD Drake
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc83.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field, send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower Dragon Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc87.name: RB Draphone
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc87.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a face-up Dragon Type monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have no monsters on your field, you can Special Summon 1 "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" or "Red-Boot Boost Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc88.name: Analyze Phlogiston
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc88.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle 3 Pyro Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck, whose total Levels equal [the total Levels of the Attack Position Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field]. Then, destroy all Attack Position Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field. This turn, you can only attack with 1 monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8c.name: Dr. Red Robe
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8c.description: A leading light in the field of combustion research. Fiercely proud of his gloves, which come in handy any time something needs turning to ash.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc91.name: Scale of Flames
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc91.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Pyro Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up Pyro Type monster on your field gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc99.name: Voidvelg Meteon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc99.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Galaxy Type monster on your field, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 6 or lower LIGHT Attribute monster on your opponent's field. Then, inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9a.name: Meteor Larva
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send cards equal to [the number of face-up Galaxy Type monsters on your field] from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca0.name: Magician's Valkyria
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Your opponent cannot attack other face-up Spellcaster Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca9.name: Arts Angel CD Fender
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca9.description: A battle anthem valkyrie who once flourished in Heaven. Her rainbow-colored shield reads and reflects any attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcad.name: Robbarim
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcad.description: A curious apprentice adventurer. She often works with Prophecy Phrase's gang in search of the treasures of their ancestors.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb3.name: Arts Angel Metal Position
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your LP are lower than your opponent's, send 1 other face-up DARK Attribute Fairy Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 face-down monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [its original ATK].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb4.name: Penguin Soljersey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send 1 monster with 500 DEF from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Return up to 2 face-up Level 4 or lower monsters from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb6.name: Black Luster Soljersey - Envoy of the Drying
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters with 500 DEF and different Attributes from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Place 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck. This turn, this card cannot attack directly.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb9.name: Radrogue Mael
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 15 or more cards in your Deck.
[Effect] Each player with no cards in their hand draws 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc2.name: Brain Harvester
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field, send up to 2 Fairy Type monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] If your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field, send up to 2 Fairy Type monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc4.name: Fillan Dwarf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can place 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc6.name: Ghost Vicious
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up Level 5 Zombie Type monster on your field, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 5 Zombie Type monster on your field can attack twice during this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc7.name: Watchman of the Apocalypse
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If your opponent has 6 or more monsters in their Graveyard, this card gains 500 ATK and cannot be destroyed by the effects of your opponent's Level 8 or lower monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc9.name: Salvage Wolfish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Add 1 WATER Attribute Sea Serpent Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if you added "U.M.U. - Unidentified Mysterious Urchin" to your hand by this effect, this card gains 1400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcca.name: Doushin Kaika the Shadow Flower Full Moon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcca.description:
"Gekka the Shadow Flower Beauty" + "Lindo the Shadow Flower Warrior"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Plant Type monster on your field can attack directly this turn. Then, you can Set 1 "Shadow Flower Stance" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd0.name: Chemicalizer Red
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Pyro Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 300 ATK and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd1.name: Voidvelg Tyrfing
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 400 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd2.name: Auto Reverse
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 3 monsters on their field.
[Effect] Change all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can change up to 3 face-down monsters on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcda.name: Sacred Arms - Strabishop
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcda.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Psychic Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 100 ATK and 1500 DEF, also it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcdb.name: JAM:P Check!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcdb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Psychic Type monsters on your field, including a Normal Monster.
[Effect] Look at up to 2 face-down Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field, and destroy 1 of them. Then, if you have "CAN:D" face-up on your field, you can gain 1000 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcdc.name: Music Princess's Prelude
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcdc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 WIND Attribute monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned a Warrior Type monster by this effect, you can add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcdd.name: Atrium's Wind
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcdd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 WIND Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 2 or more face-up WIND Attribute monsters with 1800 or more ATK on your field, you can draw 1 additional card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcde.name: Descent of the Sweeping Spirit
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcde.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 2 Fairy Type monsters in your hand.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Fairy Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned a monster other than "Arzareth the Sweeping Wind" by this effect, send 2 monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce3.name: Force of Thief
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a card in your Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Set up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, you can choose up to 3 face-up Level 7 or higher Psychic Type monsters on your field. If you do, those monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce4.name: Indigo Prison
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, neither player can Special Summon Level 7 or 8 monsters from the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce5.name: Site Preview
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] After your opponent activates a Spell Card.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce6.name: Revenge MAX
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster face-up.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your field. Then, if you destroyed an Equip Spell Card by this effect, you can destroy 1 of those Normal or Special Summoned Level 8 or lower monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce8.name: Blast Examiner
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce8.description: A specialist in safety assurance. She tends to be overlooked due to her work habits, but she's got a positive and gentle personality.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf7.name: Blaze Fiend Overlords Beelucitaroth (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card gains 600 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfd.name: Doomblaze Despair
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack on your face-up Maximum Monster, pay 600 LP.
[Effect] Shuffle the attacking monster into the owner's Deck. Then, if you have a monster in Maximum Mode on your field, inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfe.name: Cyber End Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfe.description:
"Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd00.name: Cyber Rush Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd00.description:
"Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field.
[Effect] Draw until you have 5 cards in your hand. Then, send 4 cards from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Machine Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd02.name: Cyber Stealth Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd02.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 face-up "Cyber Dragon".
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you have "Cyber Dragon" in your Graveyard, this card gains 2000 DEF and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's monster effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd04.name: Cyber Gryphon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd04.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Level 5 or higher Machine Type monster on your field. This turn, that monster cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects. Then, if that monster is LIGHT Attribute, draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd07.name: Evolution Rush Burst
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd07.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 5 or higher Machine Type monster on your field, shuffle 5 LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd09.name: Multiple Adapter Unit
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd09.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, send 1 face-up Level 5 or higher Machine Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change that Normal Summoned monster to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Cyber Assault Dragon" or "Cyber Stealth Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0a.name: Excutie Lumière
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0a.description:
If you have no monsters on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Shuffle 1 face-up Level 6 monster on your field and 1 face-up Level 7 or 8 monster on your opponent's field into the owners' Decks. This turn, your Level 7 or higher monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0b.name: Excutie Leya
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0b.description:
If you have a face-up Level 6 monster with 500 DEF on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Face-up Level 7 or higher monsters on the field lose 300 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0e.name: Excutie Lucy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Level 6 monster with 500 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd12.name: Excutie Scramble!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd12.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 6 monster with 500 DEF from your hand or your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, your Level 7 or higher monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd17.name: Jointech Stegosilos
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd17.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 3 EARTH Attribute Machine Type monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy face-up monsters with 1600 or less DEF on your opponent's field equal to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1b.name: Dark Prophet
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, shuffle 3 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1d.name: Ultimate Flag Beast Lead Unicorn
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 or more LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Change 1 face-up Level 4 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 5 Machine Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd22.name: Beast Gear Emperor Glider Fox
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd22.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other face-up Beast-Warrior Type monster with 1500 or more ATK from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. This turn, you can only attack with Beast-Warrior Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd24.name: Almastra XI - Aquarius
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd24.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or more face-up monsters on their field.
[Effect] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. If [the total Levels of the excavated monsters] is 11 or higher, you can destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field. Shuffle the excavated cards into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd25.name: Magic Mirror Youth
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd25.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 4 Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd26.name: Rising Soldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd26.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, they cannot attack with that monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2a.name: Valkyrian Call
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 4 Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can make 1 face-up "Magician's Valkyria" on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2b.name: Saturnius' Orb
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 6 monster on your field, send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2f.name: Dragonlion Pit Trap
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 8 or lower monster face-up, send 1 face-up Level 5 or higher monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up monsters with the highest Level on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd34.name: Lightwave Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd34.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Up to 3 face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK during this Main Phase.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd35.name: Magic Cylinder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd35.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Negate the attack, and inflict damage to your opponent equal to [that monster's ATK].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd39.name: Garnecia Elefantis
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd39.description: A monster so heavy that each step rocks the earth.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3b.name: Tamainabot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3b.description:
"Tamabot" + "Tamabot"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Your opponent draws 1 card and shows it. Then, if that card is a monster, this card gains ATK equal to [the shown monster's ATK] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd45.name: Red Riser
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd45.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 "Chemicalizer Red" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd48.name: Machvio of the Ultimate Aria
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd48.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the total number of Equip Spell Cards equipped to this card and the number of face-up Normal Monsters on your opponent's field] x 500.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4d.name: Green-Eyes Star Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Beast or Warrior Type monster with 200 DEF from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you sent a Normal Monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a monster with 200 DEF in Attack Position this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd57.name: Dankus, the Knight of Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd57.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal up to 5 Celestial Warrior Type monsters with different names from your Extra Deck to your opponent.
[EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters revealed to meet the requirement] x 200 until the end of this turn. This turn, this card cannot attack directly, and you can only attack with Celestial Warrior, Warrior, and Fairy Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5e.name: Alchemicalize Salamandra
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5e.description:
"Chemicalized Salamander" + "Ember the Super Assistant"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on the field. Then, you can make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of Spell Cards destroyed by this effect] x 1000 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd61.name: The Dragiastar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd61.description:
"The Dragias" + "The Dragias"
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 2 or more Normal Monsters with the same name in your Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● 2 Attack Position monsters with the same name on your field can attack twice this turn.
● Special Summon 2 Normal Monsters with the same name from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd67.name: Dulkmua, the Phantom Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd67.description:
"Dankus, the Knight of Skysavior" + "Lua, the Fairy of Skysavior"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Face-up cards on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6a.name: Voidvelg Phalanx
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 200 ATK/DEF. If the equipped monster is DARK Attribute, it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6d.name: Back To The Fusion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up monsters with the same name on your field.
[Effect] Add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if you have 2 or more Normal Monsters with the same name in your Graveyard, you can add 1 of them to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6f.name: Meowonderful Rush
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 Beast and/or Warrior Type monsters with 200 DEF from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. This turn, you can only attack with monsters with 200 DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd73.name: Skysavior Watch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd73.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 2 Warrior Type and/or Fairy Type monsters in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. Add 1 excavated card to your hand. Then, place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. This turn, your Level 8 or lower monsters cannot attack, and your opponent takes no effect damage.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd78.name: Tribute Block
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd78.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 5 or higher monster.
[Effect] Change that Normal Summoned monster and 1 Attack Position Dragon or Machine Type monster on your field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7c.name: Ether Escape
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 7 or higher monster, shuffle 2 Warrior and/or Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Change that Normal Summoned monster to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you have a face-up Fusion Monster on your field, you can place 1 face-down card from your opponent's field on top of the owner's Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7d.name: Traditional Tax
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws a card(s) during the Main Phase.
[Effect] Send 2 random cards from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd81.name: Princessleon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd81.description: A chameleon that loves cute things. If it finds one of its favorites, it puts it in its mouth and spends time with it until it gets tired.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd82.name: Fairy Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd82.description: This beautiful Dragon spirit harbors hidden strength.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd83.name: Aitsu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd83.description: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd87.name: Plectcrime of the Deadly Dirge
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd87.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, this card gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8a.name: Five-Headed Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8a.description:
5 Dragon Type monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a DARK, EARTH, WATER, FIRE, or WIND Attribute monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8c.name: Great-Tusked Mammoth
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Until the end of the opponent's next turn, while this card is face-up, neither player can activate the effects of face-up Level 4 or lower monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8d.name: Maju Garzett
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the total original ATK of the 2 monsters Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card in Attack Position].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8e.name: Legendary Magician
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate 3 cards from the top of of your Deck and show them. You can send 1 monster among them to the Graveyard. Shuffle the the rest of the cards into the Deck. Then, you can add 1 Legend Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd90.name: Legendary Swordsman - Buster Blader
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd90.description:
This card's name becomes "Buster Blader" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot attack directly. This card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Dragon Type monsters on your opponent's field] x 500.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd91.name: Vanity's Fiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd91.description:
This card cannot be Special Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Neither player can Special Summon monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd92.name: Archfiend Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd92.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have another face-up Fiend Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. If a Level 6 Fiend Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9a.name: Nimble Lemming
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Nimble Lemming" from among the cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect, face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda1.name: Malevolent Catastrophe
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda2.name: Meteor Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda2.description: This dragon appeared from the sky and crashed to the earth.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda4.name: Grand Tiki Elder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda4.description: A masked monster that wields the most deadly of curses.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbe.name: Supreme Electromagnetic Maximum
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbe.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field, reveal 1 Level 10 Machine Type monster in your hand.
[Effect] Add up to 2 Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard to your hand. For the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon or Set monsters from the hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbf.name: B.B.B. - Beast Brave Brandish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Maximum Monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, you can choose 1 monster in Maximum Mode on your field. If you do, while that monster is face-up, it inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference), if it attacks a Defense Position monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc7.name: Manifestriction Dragon Maxseal
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc7.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by revealing 1 Level 10 monster in your hand.
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, reveal 1 Maximum Monster in your hand.
[Effect] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, while this card is face-up, neither player can Tribute Summon Level 8 or lower monsters in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc8.name: Mollusk Dragon Oumugailus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Look at 1 face-down monster on your opponent's field. Then, if your opponent has a monster with the same DEF as that monster's original DEF in their Graveyard, you can destroy that monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdce.name: Abysskite Ultimail
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdce.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a card is sent to your opponent's Graveyard, send 1 other Spell/Trap Card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Sea Serpent Type monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn, and you gain 1000 LP. Then, if that monster is a Maximum Monster, it cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd2.name: Radiant Mirror Force
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while they have 3 Attack Position monsters on their field.
[Effect] Destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd3.name: Deepsea Hunter
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field.
[Effect] Change up to 2 face-up Level 6 or lower monsters with 1000 or less DEF on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd7.name: Legendary Sword
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Warrior Type monster on either field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 300 ATK/DEF.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfb.name: Corruption of the Blaze Fiends
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Level 4 or lower Fiend Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 10 Fiend Type Maximum Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with Maximum Monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfc.name: Resurrection of the Blaze Fiends
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your FIRE Attribute Maximum Monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack, pay 600 LP.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 Level 4 or lower FIRE Attribute Maximum Monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcff.name: Cyber Twin Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcff.description:
"Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card can attack twice per turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd05.name: Proto-Cyber Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd05.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon".

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd06.name: Cyber Serpent
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd06.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have another face-up LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent 2 or more LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters to the Graveyard by this effect, draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd08.name: Cyber Entry
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd08.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 or more LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Cyber Dragon" or "Proto-Cyber Dragon" from your hand or your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd10.name: Excutie Plawtie
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd10.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by revealing 1 other Level 6 monster with 500 DEF in your hand.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Gain 500 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd11.name: Excutie Scout!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd11.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 Level 6 monsters with 500 DEF, but with different names, from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards. This turn, your Level 7 or higher monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd13.name: Excutie Emergency!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd13.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a face-up Level 6 monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect and you have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 6 monster with 500 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd14.name: Excutie Capture!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd14.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster face-up to their field, while you have a face-up Level 6 monster with 500 DEF on your field.
[Effect] Change 1 Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd15.name: Excutie Break!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd15.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, place 1 face-up Level 6 monster with 500 DEF from your field on either the top or bottom of the owner's Deck.
[Effect] Negate the attack. Then, if you have a face-up Level 6 monster with 500 DEF on your field, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd16.name: Galactiara Eve
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd16.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, send 1 Galaxy Type monster with 1600 or more ATK from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send this card from your field to the Graveyard and draw 1 card. Then, if you have 3 or less monsters in your Graveyard, draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd19.name: Finalize Phoenix
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd19.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 2 or more face-up monsters on their field, shuffle 4 Pyro Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 Pyro Type Effect Monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field, whose total Levels equal [the total Levels of the face-up monsters on your opponent's field].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1f.name: Yamiruler the Dark Delayer - Spear Striker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Face-up Level 7 or higher Celestial Warrior and Warrior Type monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd28.name: Delirium Lampyris
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd28.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field, send this face-up card from your field and 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Take control of 1 face-up Level 5-8 monster on your opponent's field with the same Type as the monster sent from your hand to the Graveyard to meet the requirement (move it to your field, and use it yourself).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd31.name: Power Bond
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd31.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Fusion Summon a Machine Type monster by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material. That monster gains ATK equal to [its original ATK]. During the End Phase of this turn, you take damage equal to [the amount of ATK gained from this effect].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd36.name: Star Traleo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd36.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. Send all excavated Galaxy Type monsters to the Graveyard. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3f.name: Chromatographagas
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3f.description: This body vaporizes and burns. So long as my fighting spirit endures, I shall remain immortal.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4c.name: Purple-Eyes Star Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Set 1 "Stray Force" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, you can choose 1 face-up Level 7 or higher monster with 200 DEF on your field. If you do, that monster can attack twice during this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd52.name: Soleil, the Fairy of Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd52.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Warrior Type monster from your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Lua, the Fairy of Skysavior". Then, excavate 4 cards from the top of your Deck and show them. You can add 1 "Fusion" from among the excavated cards to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd55.name: Sael, the Knight of Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd55.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, reveal 1 "Skysavior Prayer" or "Fusion" from your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd59.name: Engine Reviver
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd59.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 2 "Engine Reviver" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. You can only Normal Summon Warrior Type monsters for the rest of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5a.name: Gilford the Rising
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5a.description:
This card cannot be Special Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, shuffle 2 Warrior Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, this card can make up to 3 attacks on monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd60.name: Double Ray Dragons
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd60.description:
"Ray Dragon" + "Ray Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are Dragon and/or High Dragon Type monsters, pay 500 LP.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● 1 face-up Normal Monster on your field can attack twice this turn.
● Set 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd62.name: Star Cat Straynya
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd62.description:
"Cat Claw Girl" + "Silver-Eyes Star Cat"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 2200 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. Then, if you sent a Normal Monster with 200 original DEF to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd63.name: Star Cat Destronya
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd63.description:
"Cat Claw Girl" + "Golden-Eyes Star Cat"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters with 200 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 2 monsters with 200 DEF and the same Level from your Graveyard face-up to your field. If you Special Summoned Normal Monsters by this effect, those Normal Monsters gain 2200 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd75.name: Ring of Storms
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd75.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Shuffle 2-7 monsters with different names from your opponent's Graveyard into their Deck. Then, if you shuffled 6 or more monsters by this effect, you can shuffle 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster from your opponent's field into the owner's Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd76.name: Transam Lightning
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd76.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Level 4 or lower Galaxy Type Normal Monster.
[Effect] This turn, the attack target cannot be destroyed by that battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7a.name: Dragon Double-Doom
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have a face-up High Dragon or Dragon Type monster on your field.
[Effect] You choose which of your monsters becomes the attack target for your opponent's attack. Then, if you have 2 or more face-up monsters with the same name on your field, you can destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7f.name: Phantom Roar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack, shuffle 2 Level 5 or higher monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK until the end of your next turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd88.name: Transamu Rainac Overwrite
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd88.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Reduce the Level of 1 face-up Level 4 or higher monster on either field by 3 until the end of this turn. Then, this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Transamu Rainac" in your Graveyard, this card's name becomes "Transamu Rainac" this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8f.name: Pot of Arrogance
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated a Spell Card.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards. You cannot activate Spell Cards for the rest of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd93.name: Legend Saber
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd93.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, place 1 monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] This card gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 Warrior Type Legend monster from your Graveyard to your hand. If you do, you can only attack with Celestial Warrior or Warrior Type monsters this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd95.name: Dark Magician's Curtain
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd95.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 700 LP.
[Effect] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can choose up to 2 excavated "Dark Magician" and/or "Dark Magician Girl" and add them to your hand. Place the rest on the bottom of the Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd98.name: Hyozanryu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd98.description: A dragon created from a massive diamond that sparkles with blinding light.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9d.name: Night Before the Big March
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 7 or higher Beast Type monster in your hand.
[Effect] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can Special Summon up to 2 excavated Level 4 or lower Beast Type monsters to your field in face-down Defense Position. Send the remaining cards to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9e.name: Dragon Tribe Fusion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Fusion Summon by shuffling 1 face-up Dragon Type Normal Monster from your field and 1 or more Dragon Type monsters from your Graveyard into the owner's Deck as material. This turn, you can only attack with Fusion Monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9f.name: Polymerization
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Fusion Summon by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda8.name: Master Craftsman Kotetsu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Place 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster or 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard on top of the Deck. Then, if you placed a Legend monster or "Helmet of the Master Craftsman", you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdaa.name: Slot Machine PG-7
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdaa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 monster that has a coin tossing effect from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdac.name: Malevolent Seller
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdac.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Malevolent Catastrophe" in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can add 1 Legend Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdad.name: Flapun
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up Beast Type monster on your field, place 1 Beast Type monster from your Graveyard on top of the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdae.name: Cursed Sword of the East
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdae.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Celestial Warrior or Warrior Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Normal Monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdaf.name: Masenkou, the Lashing Light
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdaf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Summoned Skull" face-up on your field, send 1 Fiend Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all Attack Position Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field. This turn, your Effect Monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb1.name: Supreme Railartillery Magnum Overlord (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck and no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Shuffle 3 monsters from the Graveyards into the owners' Decks. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, you can shuffle this card into the owner's Deck. If you do, draw 3 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb3.name: Supreme Railartillery Magnum Overlord (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the Level of the monster sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb6.name: Abyssal Dragon Lord Abyss Poseidra (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you have no monsters in your Graveyard, your opponent cannot Set monsters from the hand, also if this card is in Maximum Mode and your opponent has a face-down Spell/Trap Card on their field, your opponent cannot Set Spell/Trap Cards from the hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb7.name: Abyssal Sea Dragon Abyss Kraken (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle up to 5 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK/DEF equal to [the number of monsters shuffled into the Deck to meet the requirement] x 300 until the end of this turn. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode and you have no monsters in your Graveyard, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdba.name: Shinesteel Ultra Dragon Devastar Okeabyss (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 "Abysskite Protection" or "Abysskite Prevent Wall" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, you can add 1 "Abysskite Ultimail" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbc.name: Shinesteel Ultra Dragon Devastar Okeabyss (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbd.name: Supreme Dog Ropero
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP and shuffle 2 cards from your hand into the Deck.
[Effect] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. Then, you can add 1 Level 10 Maximum Monster, "Supreme Electromagnetic Maximum", or "B.B.B. - Beast Brave Brandish" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdca.name: Deep Sea Dragon Bat Eel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdca.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal up to 3 Level 10 monsters in your hand.
[Effect] Draw cards equal to [the number of monsters revealed to meet the requirement]. Then, shuffle cards from your hand into the Deck equal to [the number of cards drawn by this effect].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdcc.name: Abyss Gash
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdcc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a card is returned from either Graveyard to the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up Sea Serpent Type monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd0.name: Abysskite Protection
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 5 or higher monster face-up.
[Effect] 1 face-up Sea Serpent Type monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if that monster is a Maximum Monster, it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd4.name: Crack Neutron
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd4.description: A mysterious life form born from the final spark. Energy emanating from its cracks carries a will of its own. Hyudury Vaza Vizy!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd5.name: Soitsu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd5.description: Apparently totally unreliable, he wonders if he has incredible potential.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd8.name: Cocosh the Spellcaster of Happiness
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd8.description: A spellcaster with a warm and genial heart that makes people around the world smile with her legendary magic, "Danish", that combines many arts and techniques. For her achievements, she's been given the title "Coco". She has a somewhat playful side, as she loves to dote on her companion "Maple".

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd9.name: Satellite Soldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Increase the Level of 1 face-up Level 6 or lower monster on your field with 1000 DEF by 2 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde2.name: Celeb Rose Mage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Celeb Rose Magician" or an Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 "Charis Magic Scepter - Death Wand" or "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde3.name: Celeb Rose Sorcerer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 3 face-up LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster with 2500 or less ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can Set 1 "Charis Magic Scepter - Death Wand" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde4.name: Celeb Rose Witch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Celeb Rose Magician" in your Graveyard, send 1 LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster or 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Celeb Rose Magician" or 1 Level 9 or lower Spellcaster Type Fusion Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde5.name: Celeb Rose Magician
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Equip Spell Card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you have 3 or more Spell Cards in your Graveyard, this card gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdea.name: Star Monarch Estrome
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdea.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Tribute Summoned this card in Attack Position.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 6 or lower Effect Monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdec.name: Mega Star Monarch Estrome
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdec.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 face-up Level 5 or higher monster with 1000 DEF.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Tribute Summoned this card in Attack Position.
[Effect] Your opponent chooses 1 card on their field, and you destroy 1 other card on either field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fded.name: Zaborg the Thunder Monarch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fded.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Tribute Summoned this card in Attack Position.
[Effect] Destroy 1 monster on either field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf1.name: Braid Reader
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster or 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. If a LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf8.name: Extra Plorer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have 5 or more Galaxy Type monsters in your Graveyard, you can add 1 Galaxy Type Normal Monster and/or 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf9.name: Summoning Sorcerer Doretheo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of Spellcaster Type monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfb.name: Galactiara FUSE Eve
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfb.description:
"Galactiara Eve" + 1 LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard on either the top or bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Galaxy Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfc.name: Eternal Galactica Oblivion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfc.description:
"Galactica Oblivion" + 2 LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type monsters
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 5 Galaxy Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. This turn, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects. Then, you can make this card gain ATK equal to [the number of monsters in your Graveyard] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfd.name: Tamabot Burst Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfd.description:
"Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" + "Tamabot"
[REQUIREMENT] Send cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard equal to [the total number of "Tamabot" in both players' Graveyards].
[Effect] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you sent a monster with 1500 or less ATK to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can destroy 1 face-up monster with 1500 or more ATK on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fddc.name: Galactica Dejavu
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fddc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent's LP are 4000 or higher, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. If you sent a Level 4 or lower LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type Normal Monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can Special Summon that monster face-up to your field. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the original ATK of the monster Special Summoned by this effect].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdde.name: DBF Rebuildra
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdde.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned, reveal 1 "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" or "Red-Boot Boost Dragon" in your hand.
