[Effect] Set 1 "Dragon's Burst Fusion" or "Dragon's Boost Fusion" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde0.name: Voidvelg Logistikos
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 7 or higher Galaxy Type monster in your hand.
[Effect] Set 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, if your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field, you can add 1 Level 8 Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde8.name: Hebe the Star Vassal
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, shuffle 2 monsters with 1000 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Your opponent Special Summons 1 Level 6 or lower Effect Monster from their Graveyard to their field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 Level 5 or higher monster with 1000 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde9.name: Wilhel the Wisdom Monarch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Tribute Summoned this card in Attack Position.
[Effect] Look at 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, if that card is a Spell Card, you can destroy it.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf2.name: Skyporter Max
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 10 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Place 2 or 3 Maximum Monsters from your Graveyard on top of the Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf5.name: Elegant Aurum Avian
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, send 1 LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfa.name: Pulglace Spierce
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change the battle position of this card (Attack Position to face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).
[ EFFECT ] Choose 1 face-up monster on your field . This turn, that monster gains 1000 ATK, and it inflicts piercing battle damage .

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0c.name: Surprising Zomvictory
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up Zombie Type Normal Monsters on your field.
[Effect] Change the battle positions of up to 3 monsters on your opponent's field. Then, you can make all face-up Zombie Type monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of Zombie Type Normal Monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1a.name: Recurring Nightmare
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add 2 DARK Attribute monsters with 0 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0d.name: It's Right Behind You!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent takes damage during the Draw Phase or Main Phase.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Dark Skeleton Dead Ruler" or "Wicked Shadow Dark Lurker" from your hand or your Graveyard face-up to your field. Switch the original ATK and DEF of the monster Special Summoned by this effect until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0f.name: The Cursed Cat Counting Dishes
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc0f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 9 or lower monster declares an attack while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Zombie Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Negate the attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc12.name: Shadow Ghoul
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc12.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters in your Graveyard] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc15.name: Specter of Heaven's End
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc15.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. Send 1 excavated card to the Graveyard. Then, shuffle the remaining cards into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc16.name: Magical Ghost
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc16.description: This creature casts a spell of terror and confusion just before attacking its enemies.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc19.name: Combustion Crisis
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc19.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Inflict 600 damage to your opponent. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more face-up Level 7 monsters on their field, you can shuffle 1 monster from your opponent's field into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1d.name: Curse of Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1d.description: A wicked dragon that taps into dark forces to execute a powerful attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc21.name: Mean Mutt Chihuahua Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc21.description: With innocent eyes that melt hearts, this cutie slips right past enemy defenses. His loyalty? So-so.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc22.name: Psychic Kappa
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc22.description: An amphibian with a myriad of powers to shield it from enemy attacks.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc24.name: Kappa Avenger
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc24.description: An amphibian that sold his soul for unlimited power to avenge his late friend.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc25.name: Headhunters' Jaguar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc25.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle 2 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck, including a Normal Monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc28.name: Wooly Wonderland Aqua Sheep
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc28.description: The most buoyant of the Wooly Wonderland flock. It always remains serene and laid-baaack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3d.name: Burst Ray Blaster
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc3d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 7 or higher Galaxy Type monster in your hand.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of face-up monsters on their field] x 200. Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field become LIGHT Attribute until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc45.name: Dian Keto the Cure Prodigy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc45.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Field Spell Card on your field.
[Effect] Draw 1 card and show it. Then, if that card is a Field Spell Card, gain 1000 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4b.name: Splitter Slime
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up monster with 1500 or more ATK from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 Effect Monster with 1500 or more ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4f.name: Thunder Gazelle
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has no cards in their hand, shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc57.name: Rainapolis
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc57.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if you have 2 or more face-up Aqua Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Aqua Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK, and face-up non-Aqua Type monsters on the field lose 200 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc65.name: Kappa's Gas
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc65.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-down monster.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 2000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc68.name: Boost Rescue
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc68.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster face-up.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, you can change up to 2 Attack Position monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc69.name: Twin-Barrel Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc69.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Choose 1 card on your opponent's field, and toss a coin twice. If both of the results are heads, destroy that card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6d.name: Torrential Tribute
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a player Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] Destroy all monsters on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6e.name: Vanishing Heliacal Riser
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 2 or less cards in your hand, shuffle 1 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This card gains 200 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if a face-up Spell Card is on the field, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc75.name: Nova Spark
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc75.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 3 Galaxy Type Normal Monsters from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc76.name: Jointech Tosceratops
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc76.description:
[REQUIREMENT] This card is in Attack Position.
[Effect] Toss a coin. If the result is heads, this turn, this card gains 1500 ATK and your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when it declares an attack. If the result is tails, change this card to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7d.name: Screwmadillo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Machine Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position Level 6 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7e.name: Thunder Spark
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have a Machine or Thunder Type monster in your Graveyard.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7f.name: Red-Boot Boost Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose up to 7 Dragon Type monsters in your Graveyard. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of chosen monsters] x 100, and this card gains ATK equal to [the number of chosen monsters] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, shuffle the chosen monsters into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc85.name: Alpha Burn Drake
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc85.description: A dragon child with hidden potential. It dreams of those goggles that show a vast virtual world.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc86.name: Dragon's Peak
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc86.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a Dragon Type monster in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Field Spell Card on either side of the field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Dragon Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc90.name: Ember the Super Assistant
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc90.description: My favorite experiment is the flame test! I'll give it my all again today, driven by my burning spirit!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9f.name: Gray Storm Reverie
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if no Spell/Trap Cards are on the field, this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca1.name: Heavy Storm
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcab.name: Black Luster Soljersey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcab.description: A Super Soldier that appears due to Black Luster Jersey Ritual. He cuts though his enemies with his deadly Chaos Nylon Blade.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcaf.name: Astrosoldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcaf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you have a monster on your field equipped with an Equip Spell Card, this card gains 700 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb5.name: Cannon Soljersey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up monster with 500 DEF on your field, send 1 face-up monster with 500 DEF from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Then, you can make 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb8.name: Alpiris the Sower
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you Normal Summoned this card this turn and the only face-up monsters on your field are Plant Type monsters, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a Plant Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc1.name: Shariel, the Novice Sushi Fairy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 face-up monsters on your field during your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Set 1 "Acetic Acid Trap Hole" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, you can add 1 "Gingangel, the Deluxe Sushi Fairy" or "Agaribel, the Finest Sushi Fairy" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fccb.name: Javelin Dux the Shadow Flower Piercer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fccb.description:
"Gatling the Shadow Flower Shinobi" + "Lindo the Shadow Flower Warrior"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can Set 1 "Shadow Flower Return" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd3.name: Black Luster Jersey Ritual
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 8 monster with 500 DEF from your hand face-up to your field. This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 500 ATK, it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd5.name: Shadow Flower Sewing
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Plant Type Normal Monster in your Graveyard, send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the number of Plant Type Normal Monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a Level 5 Normal Monster in your Graveyard, you can destroy all face-up Level 7 or higher Normal Monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcdf.name: Equipment of Ascension
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcdf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up monster on your field.
[Effect] Increase the Level of the equipped monster by 2 and its ATK/DEF by 200.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcec.name: Kudzu the Bruised Shadow Flower
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcec.description: An extremely shy flower spirit. Her sweet sigh is invigorating.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fced.name: Quadcopter GA84
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fced.description: The 84th GA Model aircraft with excellent farming technology and aeronautical performance. It's commonly known as Mr. Plow.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcee.name: Full Jersey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcee.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] All face-up monsters with 500 DEF on your field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf4.name: Doomblaze Fiend Overlord Despairacion (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Neither player can Special Summon Level 7 monsters from the hand or Graveyard. Also, if this card is in Maximum Mode, your opponent cannot Set monsters from the hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf8.name: Guide of the Blaze Fiends
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Maximum Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with Maximum Monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf9.name: Rage Serpent of the Blaze Fiends
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field and you have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 10 Maximum Monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. This turn, you can only attack with Maximum Monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfa.name: Return of the Blaze Fiends
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcfa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Return up to 2 face-up Fiend Type Maximum Monsters from your field to the owner's hand. This turn, you can only attack with Maximum Monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0c.name: Excutie Floa
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 6 non-WATER Attribute monster with 500 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, your Level 7 or higher monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0d.name: Excutie Lilius
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0d.description:
If you have a face-up Level 6 monster with 500 DEF on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Your Level 7 or higher monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0f.name: Excutie RAM
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd0f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 6 monster with 500 DEF from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. This turn, your Level 7 or higher monsters cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd18.name: Hundred Divine Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd18.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you would normal draw until you have 5 cards in your hand during your Draw Phase, normal draw until you have 6 cards in your hand instead.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1a.name: Voidvelg Apocalypse
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1a.description:
"Voidvelg Pale Rider" + "Dark Prophet"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card gains 1000 ATK and cannot be destroyed by card effects. Then, if you activated this effect during your Main Phase this card was Special Summoned, you can add 1 "Dark Hole" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1e.name: Double Twin Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Level 7 Dragon Type monster in Attack Position. This turn, you can only attack with High Dragon or Dragon Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd23.name: Rage Wrecker Dragon Angerogue
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd23.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up Dinosaur Type monster on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] All face-up monsters with the highest ATK on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the DEF of the face-up monster with the highest DEF on your field] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd27.name: Cobalt Cobolt
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd27.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Fiend Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd29.name: Love Angel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd29.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Level 7 or 8 monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2c.name: Heavenly Selection
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] The total Levels of the face-up monsters on your field are 10 or higher.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, if you have 1 face-up monster on your field, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2e.name: Word Working
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 7 or higher monster, or after your opponent activates a Spell Card.
[Effect] Shuffle up to 5 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd30.name: Dark Hole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd30.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Destroy all monsters on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd33.name: Jointech Leo
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd33.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Choose 1 Spell/Trap Card in your opponent's Graveyard. Your opponent Sets that card on their field. Then, you can add 1 Level 7 or higher EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3c.name: Silent Doom
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. While the monster Special Summoned by this effect is face-up, it cannot attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3e.name: Gilford the Lightning
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3e.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 3 monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing 3 monsters.
[Effect] Destroy all monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1b.name: Pot of Avarice
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 5 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1f.name: Kanan the Beautiful Swordmistress
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc1f.description: A little lady warrior whose stage is the drama club. With sword and shield in hand, she floats lightly and dances gracefully.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc20.name: Spirit of the Mini Harp
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc20.description: She is a gentle spirit who plays the harp at recitals. Her melody soothes every soul.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2c.name: Tutumes Dark Witch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc2c.description: An angelic ballerina who never spareseffort. Even through harsh training, she presses on with unwavering determination.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc35.name: Alien Count of the White Dwarf, St. Germain
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc35.description: A count who has been rumored to live for over 300 years. Immediately after he gets a haircut, he cannot fire his lasers.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc37.name: Nekogal #2
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc37.description: A fast and lethal creature with very dangerous claws.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc40.name: Voidvelg Requiem
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc40.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up DARK Attribute monsters on your field] x 300 until the end of this turn. Then, if your opponent has a face-up LIGHT Attribute monster on their field, this card gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc41.name: Wooly Wonderland Wave Schaf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc41.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Gain 200 LP. Then, if you have Beast Type Normal Monsters with 3 or more different Attributes in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Princess of the Flock - MIss Mutton" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc42.name: Pandemonium Kappa Dive Wet
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc42.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Shuffle Level 7 Normal Monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into their Deck, up to [the number of Spell Cards in your opponent's Graveyard]. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Kappa Emperor River Slider" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc44.name: Nuvia the Mischievous
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc44.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 face-up Aqua Type monsters on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] All face-up Aqua Type monsters on your field gain 200 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Rainapolis" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc48.name: Beast Gear Sage Roller Stag
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc48.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, pay 700 LP.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 "Apocalypse - Beast Gear World" or "Beast Gear Secret Art - Primal Fist" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4a.name: Delirium Papillon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change this Attack Position card to face-up Defense Position.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field becomes Insect Type this turn. Then, if another face-up Defense Position monster is on the field, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4c.name: Miginagi the Talismanic Warrior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc4c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up monster with 1000 ATK and 1000 DEF on your field, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 8 monster with 2500 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc50.name: Man-Thro' Tro'
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc50.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Normal Monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc51.name: Abare Ushioni
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc51.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Toss a coin. If the result is heads, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If the result is tails, you take 1000 damage.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc60.name: Yokai Tiger Orient Strike
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc60.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards in your opponent's Graveyard] x 300 until the end of this turn. Then, if your opponent has 5 or more Spell Cards in their Graveyard, you can destroy 1 face-up monster with 1600 or less DEF on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc62.name: Packet Cylinder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc62.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your Attack Position LIGHT Attribute monster.
[EFFECT] The attacking monster loses ATK equal to [its Level] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc64.name: Sunbathing Kappa
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc64.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 5 or higher monster face-up.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Aqua Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6c.name: Archfiend Soldier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6c.description: An expert at battle who belongs to a crack diabolical unit. He's famous because he always gets the job done.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6f.name: Cosmo Auroriser
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc6f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field] x 500 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc72.name: Confeitrion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc72.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 3 face-up Level 1 Galaxy Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7a.name: Forkhawk
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc7a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 face-up Machine Type monsters on your field, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 face-down monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc80.name: Dual Coratlus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc80.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, this card cannot attack directly, but it can make up to 2 attacks on monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc89.name: Flame Cerebrus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc89.description: Known to many as the "Burning Executioner", this monster is capable of burning enemies to cinders.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8b.name: Barrier Statue of the Inferno
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Neither player can Special Summon non-FIRE Attribute monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8d.name: Flame Seeker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8d.description: Team "Firepower Max" Sub-Leader. Recently, he's been using an ultra-high-power burner that he bought using everything he owns. LET'S FIRE!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8f.name: Ethyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc8f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Methyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc92.name: Fire Fall Blaze Barrier
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc92.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Pyro Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of Pyro Type monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 400 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc93.name: Voidvelg Elysium
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc93.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. This card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you sent a monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc95.name: Voidvelg Palerider
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc95.description: An incarnation of the netherworld's sovereign, it claims the souls of the living and carries them to its realm. None may escape its violet edge.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc96.name: Voidvelg Hoplites
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc96.description: Spawned from cosmic chaos, this soldier serves a malicious deity. If its merciless eye fixes upon you, you will know the true meaning of fear.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc98.name: Voidvelg Globule
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc98.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9c.name: Void Corridor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fc9c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster in your Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca2.name: Cosmo Predictor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 8 Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a "Greystorm Reverie" in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca3.name: Voidvelg Transi
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[Effect] Destroy all face-up Normal Monsters on the field. Then, this card gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters destroyed by this effect] x 300 until the end of this turn. This turn, you can only attack with this card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca4.name: Drilling Tractiger
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Pierce!", "Powerful Pierce!!", or "Straight Pierce" in your Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 "Pierce!", "Powerful Pierce!!", or "Straight Pierce" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca6.name: Poliscoop
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fca6.description: Equipped with a multipurpose shovel, this police robot can simultaneously carry out field work and security duties.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcac.name: Blanc de Blanc the Snow Shadow Flower
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcac.description: A pure and innocent flower spirit. It gently responds to the desires of its Lord that believes in it.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcae.name: Acoustiglee
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcae.description: A motherly informant. Lends a helping hand to the Bandijo Clan on their pursuit of a family secret.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb0.name: Galactica Tabula Rasa
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Return 1 card from your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone to the owner's hand. Then, you can make 1 face-up Level 7 or lower monster with 2500 or more ATK on your opponent's field lose 2500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb1.name: Alkyl the Flame Emperor of the Lamp
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcb1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Ethyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp" or "Methyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have "Ethyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp" and "Methyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp" face-up on your field, this card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcba.name: Taiban Bluemai
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 4 or less cards in their hand and you have 2 face-up non-Level 3 Psychic Type monsters on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Shuffle 2 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, your opponent draws until they have 5 cards in their hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbc.name: Heel Healer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Gain 1000 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbd.name: Prophecy Phrase of the Colors of the Wind
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only face-up monsters on your field are WIND Attribute Psychic Type monsters, pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Each player with cards in their hand sends their entire hand to the Graveyard. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 200. Then, you can make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the damage inflicted to your opponent by this effect] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbe.name: Asport Pirate the Wind Crusher
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbe.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 or more Psychic Type monsters in your Graveyard, pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Add Level 4 or lower monsters from your opponent's Graveyard to their hand, up to [the number of face-up monsters on your opponent's field]. Then, this card gains ATK equal to [the total number of cards in both players' hands] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbf.name: Bandijo of the Battle Ballad
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcbf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 2 or lower Psychic Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, this card gains ATK equal to [the total number of cards in both players' hands] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc3.name: Seraph of Darkness
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 5 or higher DARK Attribute monster on your field, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Change 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc5.name: Shadow Buyer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcc5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Increase this card's Level by [the number of face-up monsters on your opponent's field] until the end of this turn. This turn, you can only attack with Fiend Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fccd.name: Galactica Xiphos
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fccd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or 8 monster on their field, equip this card to 1 face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Normal Monsters on your field] x 300. If the equipped monster is "Galactica Oblivion", it gains 1000 more ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcce.name: Jointech Rush Horn
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcce.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Machine Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 300 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd7.name: Road Arms - Sevens Lance
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other face-up "Road Arms - Sevens Lance" on your field, equip this card to 1 face-up "Sevens Road Magician" on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains ATK equal to [the number of different Attributes in your Graveyard] x 400 and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd9.name: Heavy Arms - Double Nexcalibur
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcd9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 WIND Attribute Psychic Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard, and equip this card to 1 face-up Psychic Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster can attack twice per turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce0.name: Beast Swords - Tiger Sabre
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fce0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Normal Monster with 1400 or less ATK on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 900 ATK. The equipped monster can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a monster in Attack Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fceb.name: Dahlia the Sprouting Shadow Flower
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fceb.description: A whimsical flower spirit. Her cheers are small, but full of feelings.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf0.name: Galactica Reminiscences
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 Trap Card from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] All face-up Galaxy Type monsters on your field gain 400 ATK until the end of this turn. If you have "Galactica Oblivion" face-up on your field, you can also make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf1.name: Jointech Raptor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of each player's Deck to the Graveyard, and inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 100. Then, if you have a face-up Equip Spell Card on your field and you inflicted damage to your opponent by this effect, you can change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf2.name: Doomblaze Fiend Overlord Despairacion (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Spell Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf5.name: Blaze Fiend Overlords Beelucitaroth (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Normal Monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf6.name: Blaze Fiend Overlords Beelucitaroth
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fcf6.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Blaze Fiend Overlords Beelucitaroth [L]" and "Blaze Fiend Overlords Beelucitaroth [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] Increase this card's Level by 6, also it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd01.name: Cyber Assault Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd01.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 face-up "Cyber Dragon".
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 "Cyber Dragon" from your Graveyard on top of your Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster with 2400 or more ATK on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd03.name: Cyber Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd03.description:
If only your opponent has a monster on the field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] None

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1c.name: Destroyer of Dragon Sorcerers
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd1c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 Spellcaster and/or Dragon Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects this turn. Then, you can Set 1 "Dark Revelation" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd20.name: CAN - I:D
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd20.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are Omega Psychic and/or Psychic Type, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 Psychic Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, if you have "CAN:D" in your Graveyard, this card gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd21.name: Future Aeromancer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd21.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, shuffle 2 WIND Attribute monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 Equip Spell Card from among the cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2d.name: Valkyrian Guard
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd2d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 4 Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position. Then, you can change up to 3 Attack Position monsters on your field to face-up Defense Position, including "Magician's Valkyria". This turn, while the monsters changed to Defense Position by this effect are in face-up Defense Position, they cannot be destroyed by battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd32.name: Transam Linac - Fight for the Light!
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd32.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have another face-up LIGHT Attribute monster with 1400 or less ATK on your field.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster with 1500 or less ATK on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd37.name: Cyber Search Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd37.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 face-up "Cyber Dragon".
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned, place 1 card from your hand on top of the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Cyber Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd38.name: Hacking Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd38.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Dragon Type monster from your hand to your opponent's field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can return 1 Level 8 or lower Attack Position monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3a.name: Wave Crest Madoor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spellcaster Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3d.name: Widespread Ruin
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd3d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Attack Position monster with the highest ATK on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd41.name: The Dragias
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd41.description: Seven stars colliding bursting supernova Dragon. The name is The Dragias! The Dragias!!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd44.name: Jointech Tinosaurus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd44.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position. Then, that monster loses 2000 DEF until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd46.name: Voidvelg Cataphract
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd46.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have another face-up DARK Attribute monster on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. If you sent a monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can add 1 Level 8 Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd49.name: Double-Doom Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd49.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Gain 200 LP. Then, you can Set 1 "Dragon Double-Doom" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4a.name: The Clone
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon and/or Dragon Type monsters, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have "The Copy" or "Back To The Fusion" in your Graveyard, this card's name becomes "The Dragias" this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4f.name: Dark-Eyes Breakstar Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] If this card attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). Also, if you activated this effect during your Main Phase this card was Special Summoned, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 7 or 8 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd50.name: Cyber Coatl
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd50.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can Special Summon 1 excavated Level 5 Machine Type monster face-up to your field. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd53.name: Lua, the Fairy of Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd53.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Warrior Type monster from your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Soleil, the Fairy of Skysavior". Then, send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. You can also add 1 "Fusion" from among the cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd56.name: Ciela, the Knight of Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd56.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal up to 5 Celestial Warrior Type monsters with different names from your Extra Deck to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of monsters revealed to meet the requirement] x 200 until the end of this turn. This turn, you can only attack with Celestial Warrior, Warrior, and Fairy Type monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5c.name: Transamuroad Rainac
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5c.description:
"Transamu Rainac" + "Sevens Road Magician"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Galaxy Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can make all face-up Galaxy Type monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of different Attributes in both players' Graveyards] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5d.name: Melel the Beautiful Flame Spirit of the Lamp
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5d.description:
"Methyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp" + "Ethyl the Fire Genie of the Lamp"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Draw 1 card and show it. Then, if that card is a Pyro Type monster, you can Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower Pyro Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5f.name: Voidvelg Protostar
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5f.description:
"Voidvelg Globule" + "Dark Prophet"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add 1 Level 4 or lower Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if you have "Dark Hole" in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Level 8 monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd64.name: Solciere, the Radiant Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd64.description:
"Ciela, the Knight of Skysavior" + "Soleil, the Fairy of Skysavior"
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 other card from your field on the bottom of the Deck.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] ●Destroy Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field up to [the number of face-up Celestial Warrior Type monsters on your field]. ●Add 1 "Skysavior Symbol" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd65.name: Altierra the Skysavior Transience
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd65.description:
"Ciela the Skysavior Knight" + "Lua the Skysavior Angel"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] Your opponent cannot activate Normal Spell Cards, except "Fusion".

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd68.name: Stealthagic
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd68.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you sent a Spell Card to the Graveyard to meet the requirement and your LP are 1000 or lower, draw 1 additional card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6b.name: Road Arms - Sword Breaker
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other face-up "Road Arms - Sword Breaker" on your field, equip this card to 1 face-up "Sevens Road Magician" on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains ATK equal to [the number of equipped Equip Spell Cards on the field] x 1000 and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6c.name: The Copy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Normal Monster with the same name as a face-up monster on your field, from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd70.name: Rising Luna Radiant Luster
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd70.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Celestial Warrior Type Fusion Monster or "Kimeluna the Dark Shifter" face-up on your field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd71.name: Blaze Fiend Assault
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd71.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 3 FIRE Attribute Maximum Monsters from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Shuffle all face-up monsters on your opponent's field into the owner's Deck. Then, you can make 1 face-up Maximum Monster on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd72.name: Skysavior Prayer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd72.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 LIGHT or DARK Attribute Celestial Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd77.name: Jointech Great Wall
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd77.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 7 or higher monster face-up while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster on your field.
[Effect] This turn, up to 3 face-up EARTH Attribute Machine Type monsters on your field gain 300 ATK and cannot be destroyed by battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7b.name: Stray Force
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 200 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have 3 face-up Beast, Beast-Warrior, and/or Warrior Type monsters with 200 DEF on your field, you can destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7e.name: Buffered Slime
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd7e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. This turn, you take no battle damage. Also, if your LP are 3000 or more, take 2000 damage.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd84.name: Level Blast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd84.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Each player has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the Level of 1 face-up monster on your field] x 100. This turn, you can only attack with 1 monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd85.name: Transam Lika
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd85.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). Also, if you have "Transam Linac" face-up on your field, you can change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd94.name: Goddess of Whimsy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd94.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field.
[Effect] Toss a coin. If the result is heads, this card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. If the result is tails, send this card from your field to the Graveyard and draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9b.name: Embryonic Dark Ruler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated Fiend Type Legend monster to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of the Deck in any order.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda3.name: Melchid the Four-Face Beast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda3.description: This monster has four different masks for four different attacks.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda6.name: Class-Change Mirror
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 other monster from your field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Summoned Skull" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda7.name: Rogue of Archfiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Fiend Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Up to 2 face-up Fiend Type monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb4.name: Abyssal Dragon Lord Abyss Poseidra (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 5 or more Sea Serpent Type monsters in your Graveyard, place all monsters from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[Effect] Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode and you shuffled 3 or more Maximum Monsters into the Deck to meet the requirement, you can destroy all cards on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc1.name: Abysslayer Makara
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a Sea Serpent Type monster to the Graveyard by this effect, draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc2.name: Abysslayer Cetus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a monster on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Sea Serpent Type monster on your field gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have no monsters in your Graveyard, that monster on your field gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc3.name: Abysslayer Vodyanoy
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, reveal 1 LIGHT or DARK Attribute Sea Serpent Type monster in your hand and place it on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have no monsters in your Graveyard, draw 1 additional card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc5.name: Darkglow Angler
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Sea Serpent Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 Sea Serpent Type Maximum Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc6.name: Groundmaster Bathynomus
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc6.description: A mysterious life form from the ocean floor. It is said legendary sea serpents dwell in its habitat.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc9.name: Ascending Weather Eel
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated Level 10 monster to your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdcb.name: Abyss Flash
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdcb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 5 or more Sea Serpent Type monsters in your Graveyard, shuffle all monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Change the battle positions of all monsters on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd6.name: Dragon Bird
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd6.description: Though often considered a relative of birds, this mysterious creature is something else entirely. Its strength resembles that of a dragon more than a bird, so it is possible that's what it is.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fddb.name: Aero Sorcerer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fddb.description: A magician who enjoys being as free as the wind blows. His selfish behavior will eventually bind his future.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fddf.name: Voidvelg Kyrie
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fddf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Level 7 or lower Galaxy Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 "Voidvelg Requiem" or "Voidvelg Chrysaor" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can choose 1 face-up card on your field. If you do, that card cannot be destroyed by card effects this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde1.name: Voidvelg Chrysaor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. If a DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, this card can attack up to that many times this turn. Then, if the cards sent are 3 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monsters with the same Level, you can destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde6.name: Gearpold the Magically Armored Beast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you have a card your Spell & Trap Zone, this card gains 200 ATK, also during your opponent's turn, while it is in Attack Position, it cannot be destroyed by battle.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde7.name: Zuse the Wisdom Vassal
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fde7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, shuffle 2 monsters with 1000 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Your opponent Sets 1 Spell Card from their Graveyard to their field. Then, you can add 1 Level 5 or higher monster with 1000 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdeb.name: Wilhel the Mega Monarch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdeb.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 face-up Level 5 or higher monster with 1000 DEF.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Tribute Summoned this card in Attack Position.
[Effect] Your opponent chooses 1 card on their field, and you destroy that card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf0.name: Don A. Corn of the Verdant Vast
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 3 Spell/Trap Cards from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf4.name: Splame
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Pyro Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 Level 8 or lower monster in your Graveyard. This turn, this card's name becomes the same as the chosen monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd40.name: Chill Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd40.description: A dragon that resides within the blizzard. It glides through the snow-paths with a swift shift.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd42.name: Silver-Eyes Star Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd42.description: A star cat with eyes of silver. They're filled with wonder.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd43.name: Golden-Eyes Star Cat
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd43.description: A star cat with eyes of gold. They're filled with charm.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd47.name: Voidvelg Black Dwarf
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd47.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 4 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4b.name: Mirroring Wyvern
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon and/or Dragon Type monsters during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, this turn, this card's name becomes the same as the name of the monster Special Summoned by this effect.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4e.name: Cat Claw Girl
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd4e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Beast Type monster with 200 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned a Normal Monster by this effect, you can Set 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd51.name: Excutie Flame
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd51.description:
If your opponent has a face-up Level 6 or higher monster on their field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Level 6 or higher monsters on the field] x 600 until the end of this turn. This turn, you can only attack with this card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd54.name: Langa, the Knight of Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd54.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, reveal 1 "Skysavior Prayer" or "Fusion" from your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 "Soleil, the Fairy of Skysavior" or "Lua, the Fairy of Skysavior" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd58.name: Astrobio Drake
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd58.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned.
[Effect] Set 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. This turn, you can only attack directly with Fusion Monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5b.name: Gilford the Legend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd5b.description:
This card cannot be Special Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Equip up to 3 Equip Spell Cards from your Graveyard to a face-up Warrior Type monster(s) on your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd66.name: Degrace, the Flash Skysavior
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd66.description:
"Dankus, the Knight of Skysavior" + "Soleil, the Fairy of Skysavior"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● This card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Celestial Warrior Type monsters on your field] x 1000 until the end of this turn.
● This turn, this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd69.name: Cracking Claw
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd69.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Dragon Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Dragon Type monsters on the field] x 200. If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position Level 7 or higher monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6e.name: Vice Slasher
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd6e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 2 or more face-up Dragon Type Normal Monsters with the same name on your field, equip this card to 1 of them.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains ATK equal to [its original ATK]. The equipped monster cannot attack directly.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd74.name: Skysavior Symbol
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd74.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up monster on their field, equip this card to 1 face-up Celestial Warrior, Warrior, or Fairy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains ATK equal to [its Level] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd79.name: Dark Nebula
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd79.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster with 1500 or more ATK is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position. The monster Special Summoned by this effect loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd80.name: Digger Skipper
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd80.description: A civil engineering machine that excels at excavation. It moves in a bouncing motion to plow the earth.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd86.name: Ruthless Slash - Megaplunder
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd86.description: A ferocious plunderer that hunts under the cover of the moonlit night. Its razor sharp claws slice through its enemies!

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8b.name: Behemoth the King of All Animals
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd8b.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 monster. If you do, its original ATK becomes 2000.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add Beast Type monsters from your Graveyard to your hand equal to [the number of monsters Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd96.name: The Origin Stone of Legend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd96.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can Special Summon 1 excavated Dragon Type Legend Normal Monster face-up to your field. Shuffle the remaining cards into the Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd97.name: Steel Steed Martin Vainari
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd97.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Toss a coin a number of times equal to [the number of face-up monsters on your opponent's field]. 1/2/3 head(s): This turn, this card can attack twice. 3 heads: This turn, this card also inflicts piercing damage.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd99.name: Great Maju Garzett
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd99.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the original ATK of 1 monster Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card in Attack Position] x 2.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9c.name: Final Destiny
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fd9c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 5 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all cards on the field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda0.name: Primordial Slash
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, pay 400 LP.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses 700 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a face-up Legend Normal Monster on your field, you can destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda5.name: Goblin Digging Captain
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "The Warrior Returning Alive" or "Trap Hole" in your Graveyard, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the total number of "The Warrior Returning Alive" and "Trap Hole" in your Graveyard] x 1000 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda9.name: Witness of Dragon Destroyer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fda9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Buster Blader" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdab.name: Trap Mole
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdab.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Trap Hole" in your Graveyard during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Set 1 Trap Card from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb0.name: Helmet of the Master Craftsman
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 200 ATK/DEF. Then, if the equipped monster is "Master Craftsman Kotetsu" or a Legend monster whose original Level is 4 or lower, it gains ATK equal to [its original ATK].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb2.name: Supreme Railartillery Magnum Overlord
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb2.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Supreme Railartillery Magnum Overlord [L]" and "Supreme Railartillery Magnum Overlord [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects until the end of your opponent's next turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb5.name: Abyssal Dragon Lord Abyss Poseidra
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb5.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Abyssal Dragon Lord Abyss Poseidra [L]" and "Abyssal Dragon Lord Abyss Poseidra [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you have no monsters in your Graveyard, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when this card declares an attack, also if this card is in Maximum Mode, it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb8.name: Abyssal Sea Dragon Abyss Kraken
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb8.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Abyssal Sea Dragon Abyss Kraken [L]" and "Abyssal Sea Dragon Abyss Kraken [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you have no monsters in your Graveyard, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, also if this card is in Maximum Mode, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when it declares an attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb9.name: Abyssal Sea Dragon Abyss Kraken (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdb9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, this card inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference), if it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbb.name: Shinesteel Ultra Dragon Devastar Okeabyss
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdbb.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Shinesteel Ultra Dragon Devastar Okeabyss [L]" and "Shinesteel Ultra Dragon Devastar Okeabyss [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: If you have 10 or more Sea Serpent Type monsters in your Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the ATK of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field] until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc0.name: Abysslayer Apsaras
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck.
[Effect] Place up to 3 Sea Serpent Type monsters from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Sea Serpent Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position. Then, if you have no monsters in your Graveyard, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc4.name: Legacyrex Legarex
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdc4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 5 or less monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a Sea Serpent Type monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can add 2 Level 7 or higher Sea Serpent Type monsters with the same Level from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdcd.name: Wrath of Abyss
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdcd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster while you have 2 or more face-up LIGHT and/or DARK Attribute Sea Serpent Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] Destroy that Normal Summoned monster. Then, if you have no monsters in your Graveyard, destroy all face-up monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdcf.name: Abysskite Prevent Wall
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdcf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Sea Serpent Type monster.
[Effect] The attack target cannot be destroyed by that battle. Then, if the attack target is in Maximum Mode, you gain 1000 LP.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd1.name: Heavenly Invitation
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdd1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have no monsters on your field, you can add 1 Level 10 monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdda.name: Earth Sorcerer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdda.description: A magician who carries the pride of his family in his heart. On that day, he left his hometown as if he were on the run.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fddd.name: Booster Wyvern
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fddd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" or "Red-Boot Boost Dragon" face-up on your field during your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned.
[Effect] Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdee.name: Cyber Processor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdee.description:
If you have a face-up Machine Type monster on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" this turn. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Cyber Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdef.name: Star Replacer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdef.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, return this card from your field to the owner's hand.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-down Defense Position. For the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters from your hand or Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf3.name: Devil Foolish
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, reveal up to 2 monsters with 0 DEF in your hand.
[Effect] Special Summon monsters with 0 DEF from your Graveyard, up to [the number of monsters revealed to meet the requirement], to your field in face-down Defense Position. For the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon Level 9 or lower monsters nor Set monsters from the hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf6.name: Plaster Scout
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] During your opponent's Main Phase, you take no damage from your opponent's card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf7.name: Mad Rare Aquila
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdf7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card can attack twice. Then, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 6 Effect Monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you destroyed a monster by this effect, this card gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe02.name: Celeb Rose Fabulous Magician
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe02.description:
"Celeb Rose Magician" + "Celeb Rose Witch"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe04.name: Sevens Chariot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe04.description:
"Sevens Road Magician" + "Gearpold the Magically Armored Beast"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● This card gains ATK equal to [the number of cards in the Spell & Trap Zones] x 500 until the end of this turn.
● This turn, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. You can also destroy face-up cards on your opponent's field, up to [the number of cards in your Spell & Trap Zone].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe06.name: Space Fusion - Extra Plasma
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe06.description:
"Extra Plorer" + 1 LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0f.name: Sevens Wonder Fusion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Fusion Summon by shuffling monsters from your field or Graveyard into their owner's Deck as materials, including "Sevens Road Magician".

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe11.name: The Emperor Realm
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe11.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card by sending the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Level 5 or higher monsters on the field with 1000 original DEF gain 400 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1e.name: Harpie Lady Sisters (L)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1e.description:
This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady Sisters" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady Sisters" and it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, increase its Level by 5.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe25.name: Harpie Cara
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe25.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Harpie's Electro Shield" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe36.name: Destruction of the Universe
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe36.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, pay 3000 LP.
[Effect] Destroy the attacking monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe37.name: Giant Tiger Strike
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe37.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, return 1 face-up Level 7 or higher WIND Attribute monster from your field to the owner's hand.
[Effect] Change the attacking monster to face-up Defense Position. Then, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe39.name: Destructor Detonator Heavy Contractor
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe39.description:
"Destructor Soldier Steeplejack" + "Destructor Soldier Helmet"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Add 1 Level 8 or higher Wyrm Type monster and/or 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, destroy 1 card on your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3d.name: Destructor Soldier Helmet
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, except "Fusion", and pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can add 1 Field Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe43.name: Destructor Survey
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe43.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard equal to [the number of face-up Wyrm Type monsters on your field]. Then, you can add 1 "Destructor Soldier Helmet" or 1 Field Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe47.name: Phantasm Spiral Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe47.description: A ferocious serpent that was being hunted by Atlanteans. Battle-weary and ragged, it came upon an ancient light, and gained new strength for its battle. With its increased power, it launched an invasion of enemy territory with a renewed assault.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe49.name: Icarus Attack
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe49.description:
