[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, or after your opponent activates a Spell Card, send 1 face-up Winged Beast Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy up to 2 cards on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe03.name: Celeb Rose Luxury Magicians
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe03.description:
"Celeb Rose Magician" + "Celeb Rose Witch"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 9 or lower LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, if this card is equipped with an Equip Spell Card, this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe07.name: Advance Impact
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe07.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no monsters on your field.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field, and send monsters from your hand to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal the chosen monster's Level. This turn, if you would Tribute Summon a monster, you can Tribute the chosen opponent's face-up monster instead of 1 monster on your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0b.name: Voidvelg Gullinbursti
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster cannot be destroyed by Spell Card effects, also it gains 800 ATK during your turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe10.name: Magical Lance - Grace Spear
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe10.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Magical Knight or Spellcaster Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 200 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). If the equipped monster is Magical Knight Type, it gains additional ATK equal to [its Level] x 200.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe13.name: Lifeline Linac
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe13.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack.
[Effect] Gain 800 LP. Then, draw 1 card and show it. If that card is a Galaxy Type Normal Monster with 1600 or more ATK, also negate that attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe16.name: Rose Chain Salvage
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe16.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Special Summons a monster while you have a Level 6 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field equipped with an Equip Spell Card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, gain LP equal to [the original Level of the monster Special Summoned by this effect] x 100.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe17.name: Machinations of the Monarchs
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe17.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster while you have a face-up Level 5 or higher monster with 1000 DEF on your field.
[Effect] Change that Normal Summoned monster to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 Level 5 or higher monster with 1000 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe19.name: Shared Sentiments
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe19.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, shuffle 2 LIGHT Attribute monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the ATK of that Normal Summoned monster] and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1c.name: Majestic Masterburst
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1c.description: The glittering glow of the conquering king that rules over tens of thousands of stars. Once one reaches the highest heights, its true form will be revealed.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1f.name: Harpie Lady Sisters
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1f.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Harpie Lady Sisters [L]" and "Harpie Lady Sisters [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 WIND Attribute Winged Beast Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your field gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe22.name: Harpie Lady 2
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe22.description:
This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, this card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" and your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when it declares an attack.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe28.name: Triangle Ecstasy Spark
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe28.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Harpie Ladies" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Up to 3 face-up WIND Attribute monsters on your field gain 600 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe29.name: Elegant Egotist
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe29.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" face-up on your field.
[EFFECT] Special Summon up to 2 "Harpie Lady" and/or "Harpie Lady Sisters" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you cannot declare an attack on Attack Position monsters with 1200 or less ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2a.name: Harpie's Feather Tempest
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, shuffle 2 "Harpie Lady" and/or "Harpie Ladies" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy that Normal Summoned monster. Then, if you shuffled a Normal Monster into the Deck to meet the requirement, you can change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2e.name: Trumpetiger the Music Fiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower WIND Attribute Warrior Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe30.name: Tubardiche the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe30.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have another face-up Warrior Type monster on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 7 or higher WIND Attribute monster and 1 Warrior Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate monster effects, except WIND Attribute Warrior or Beast Type monsters'.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe35.name: Tiger Doom Sight
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe35.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher WIND Attribute Warrior or Beast Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Change the attacking monster to face-up Defense Position. Then, if your LP are less than or equal to your opponent's, you can destroy 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the original ATK of the monster destroyed by this effect].

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe38.name: Explosive Destructor Wyrm Dangerous Bakhamut
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe38.description:
"Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut" + "Destructor Soldier Helmet"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-up card on your field and 1 or 2 monsters on your opponent's field. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field that were destroyed by this effect] x 500.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3a.name: Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If either player has a card in their Field Zone, send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard, including a Wyrm Type monster.
[EFFECT] Destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters destroyed by this effect] x 300.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3e.name: Destructor Soldier Steeplejack
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3e.description: Demolish, construct, demolish, construct... Striving to reach a utopia, this soldier aims ever higher.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe41.name: Destructor Sword Conquedea
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe41.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Wyrm Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. If you have 5 or more Wyrm Type monsters in your Graveyard, the equipped monster gains an additional 500 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe44.name: Destructor Wall
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe44.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower monster declares an attack while you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Wyrm Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Negate the attack. This turn, your opponent cannot attack with Level 7 or lower monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe45.name: Destructor Art - Total Destruction
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe45.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[EFFECT] Shuffle up to 6 Wyrm Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck. If [the total Levels of the monsters shuffled into the Deck by this effect] is 16 or higher, you can also destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfe.name: Blue-Fang Enhanced Burst Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdfe.description:
"Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" + "Booster Wyvern"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up card on either field. Then, if you sent a monster whose original Level is 7 or higher to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can Special Summon 1 "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdff.name: Red-Boot Enhanced Boost Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fdff.description:
"Red-Boot Boost Dragon" + "Booster Wyvern"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose up to 9 monsters in any Graveyard(s). Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of chosen monsters] x 200, and this card gains ATK equal to [the number of chosen monsters] x 200 until the end of this turn. Then, shuffle the chosen monsters into the owner's Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe00.name: Voidvelg Theogonia
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe00.description:
"Voidvelg Chrysaor" + "Dark Prophet"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Special Summoned.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 8 Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. The monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot be destroyed by card effects until the end of your opponent's next turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe01.name: Voidvelg Gigantomachia
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe01.description:
"Voidvelg Requiem" + "Voidvelg Chrysaor"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on either field. Then, this turn, this card gains 500 ATK and can attack twice.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe14.name: Recombination Galactica
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe14.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Galaxy Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe15.name: Nobody Phantom Thief
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe15.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[Effect] Draw 3 cards. Then, send 1 or more cards from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, if you have no monsters on your field, you take no battle damage from your opponent's Level 8 or lower monsters' attacks this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe18.name: Nativity of the Monarchs
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe18.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 8 or lower monster face-up, send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher monster with 1000 DEF from your hand to your field in face-up Attack Position. Then, you can destroy 1 of those opponent's Normal or Special Summoned monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1a.name: Vortex of Shattered Light
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 8 or lower monster face-up, shuffle 3 LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy 1 of those Normal or Special Summoned monsters.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1b.name: Rice Terrace Crisis
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Special Summons a monster from the hand or Graveyard.
[Effect] Change up to 2 face-up monsters on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position, whose total Levels equal 12 or less.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe20.name: Harpie Lady Sisters (R)
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe20.description:
This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady Sisters" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady Sisters" and it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's monster effects. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, it can make up to 3 attacks on monsters each turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe23.name: Harpie Lady 3
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe23.description:
This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. If chosen, your opponent cannot attack with that monster during their next turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe27.name: Harpie's Electro Shield
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe27.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 800 ATK and 400 DEF. If you have 1 or 3 face-up monsters on your field, the equipped monster inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference), if it attacks a Defense Position monster.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2b.name: Divinebreath the Orchestral Music Fiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2b.description:
"Digisoon the Music Fiend" + "Boton the Music Princess"
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 3 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects, and it inflicts piercing battle damage. If you activated this effect during your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, it also gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] x 1000 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2f.name: Sansetsukontra the Music Fiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck and no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if your opponent has a face-up monster with 3000 or more ATK on their field, you can draw 3 cards.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe31.name: Ophiclaymore the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe31.description: The veteran of the band. She provides her allies with resounding support. The impressive progress of the young Tubardiche gives her hope for the future.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe32.name: Boton the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe32.description: The linchpin of the band. She commands her characterful comrades with deft motions of her rod. Say anything about her glasses and she'll stir up a storm.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3b.name: Destructor Soldier Depot
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a Wyrm Type monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can add 1 "Destructor Soldier Helmet" or 1 Level 8 Wyrm Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3c.name: Constructor Sentry Dragline
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Wyrm Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 8 Wyrm Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned "Constructor Wyrm Buildragon" by this effect, you can add 1 Wyrm Type monster with 0 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe42.name: Destructor Claw Shield
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe42.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Wyrm Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] While the equipped monster is in Attack Position, it cannot be destroyed by battle. If either player has a card in their Field Zone, the equipped monster and this card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe48.name: Raiza the Storm Monarch
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe48.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Tribute Summoned this card in Attack Position.
[Effect] Place 1 card from either field on top of the owner's Deck.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe05.name: Cyber Tactical Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe05.description:
"Cyber Assault Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Destroy up to 2 face-up monsters on your opponent's field, whose total ATK is less than or equal to this card's.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe08.name: Galactica Adargatling
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe08.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 200 ATK/DEF and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe09.name: Dragons Burst Fusion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe09.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Fusion Summon by sending face-up Dragon Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard as material. Then, if you sent "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" to the Graveyard by this effect, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0a.name: Dragons Boost Fusion
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Fusion Summon by sending face-up Dragon Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard as material. Then, if you sent "Red-Boot Boost Dragon" to the Graveyard by this effect, you can send the top 7 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you sent a card from the Deck to the Graveyard, you can send the top 7 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0c.name: Voidvelg Shroud
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains ATK equal to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards on your field] x 100. While the equipped monster is face-up on your field, Spell/Trap Cards on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0d.name: Charis Magic - Elegant Change
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster or 1 Equip Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 4 or more monsters in your Graveyard, draw 1 additional card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0e.name: Charis Magic Scepter - Death Wand
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe0e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster gains 400 ATK and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. If the equipped monster is a Fusion Monster, it gains 600 more ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe12.name: Protection of Arthenée
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe12.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck, and equip this card to 1 face-up monster on your field.
[Effect] The equipped monster cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Then, if you have an Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard, the equipped monster gains 300 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1d.name: Light Sorcerer of Sanctity
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe1d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 300 LP.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the number of face-up LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters on your field] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe21.name: Harpie Lady 1
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe21.description:
This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady". Face-up WIND Attribute monsters on the field gain 300 ATK.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe24.name: Harpie Regina
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe24.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have another face-up WIND Attribute Winged Beast Type monster on your field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have a face-up Normal Monster on your field, you can add 1 "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Ladies" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe26.name: Harpie's Pet Dragon
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe26.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up "Harpie Lady" on the field] x 300 and [the number of face-up "Harpie Lady Sisters" on the field] x 900.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2c.name: Full Orchestra the Music Fiend
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2c.description:
"Ensembullfighter the Music Fiend" + "Boton the Music Princess"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy all face-down cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. Then, this card gains ATK equal to [the number of cards destroyed by this effect] x 600 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2d.name: Axtion Melody the Music Princess
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe2d.description:
"Tubardiche the Music Princess" + "Boton the Music Princess"
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard on either the top or bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 2000 ATK/DEF until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, if you placed "Straight Pierce" or "Fusion" to meet the requirement, you can draw 1 card.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe33.name: Music Princess's Battle Ballet
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe33.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 5 or more WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Fusion Summon a WIND Attribute Warrior Type monster by shuffling monsters from your hand and/or Graveyard into the Deck as material.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe34.name: Music Princess's Requiem
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe34.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your Attack Position Level 7 or higher WIND Attribute Warrior or Beast Type monster.
[Effect] The attacking monster loses ATK equal to [the attacking monster's Level] x 600 until the end of this turn.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3f.name: Destructor Soldier Plasterer
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe3f.description: Demolish, construct, demolish, construct... Endeavoring to erect a utopia, this soldier tackles one layer at a time.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe40.name: Destructor Soldier Plumber
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe40.description: Demolish, construct, demolish, construct... Seeking a route to a utopia, this soldier pushes forth without relent.

64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe46.name: Gold Rush
64d2a04dc80b440a3e87fe46.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 7 or higher monster face-up, send all monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 3 cards and show them. Then, if a Level 7 or higher monster is among them, you can Special Summon any number of those Level 7 or higher monsters to your field in face-down Defense Position.

64d4820c938551eac4dd7e15.name: Eternal Favorite

64d4821e938551eac4dd7f63.name: Mature Chronicle
64d4821e938551eac4dd7f63.description:
Each time a monster(s) is Special Summoned that is a "Yubel" monster or mentions "Yubel", place 1 Chronicle Counter on this card. You can remove Chronicle Counters from your field to activate 1 of these effects;
● 1: Special Summon 1 "Yubel" from your GY.
● 2: Add 1 of your banished cards to your hand.
● 3: Banish 1 card from your Deck.
● 4: Destroy 1 card on the field.
● 5: Add 1 "Super Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.
You can only use this effect of "Mature Chronicle" once per turn.

64d4822a938551eac4dd8037.name: Nightmare Pain
64d4822a938551eac4dd8037.description: During your Main Phase: You can destroy 1 DARK monster in your hand or face-up field, and if you do, add 1 "Yubel", or 1 card that mentions it, from your Deck to your hand, except "Nightmare Pain". You can only use this effect of "Nightmare Pain" once per turn. While you control a "Yubel" monster, your opponent's monsters that can attack must attack "Yubel" monsters. Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving your "Yubel" monsters.

64d4824d938551eac4dd8411.name: Yubel - The Loving Defender Forever
64d4824d938551eac4dd8411.description:
1 "Yubel" monster + 1+ Effect Monsters on the field
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each material used. You can only use this effect of "Yubel - The Loving Defender Forever" once per turn. Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, also you take no battle damage from battles involving this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled an opponent's monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that opponent's monster's ATK, and if you do, banish that monster.

64d48261938551eac4dd85c2.name: Samsara D Lotus
64d48261938551eac4dd85c2.description: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Yubel" monster from your Deck. During your opponent's turn, when a monster effect is activated, while you control a "Yubel" monster (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; the activated effect becomes "Destroy 1 "Yubel" monster on the field". During your End Phase, if you control "Yubel" and this card is in your GY: You can add this card to your hand, or Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Samsara D Lotus" once per turn.

64d4827e938551eac4dd888a.name: Geistgrinder Golem
64d4827e938551eac4dd888a.description: You can only Special Summon "Geistgrinder Golem" once per turn. You can reveal 1 "Yubel" monster in your hand; Special Summon this card from your hand to your opponent's field, then you can Special Summon the revealed monster to your field. Once per turn, during damage calculation, if this card battles a "Yubel" monster: Your opponent gains 3000 LP. If you Special Summon "Yubel" while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card to your opponent's field.

64d48290938551eac4dd89fc.name: Spirit of Yubel
64d48290938551eac4dd89fc.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle, also you take no damage from battles involving this card. If this card is destroyed: You can Special Summon 1 of your "Yubel" that is banished or in your hand, Deck, or GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Spirit of Yubel" once per turn. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add to your hand or Set 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck that mentions "Yubel".

64d60ded9d16825948c03044.name: Centur-Ion True Awakening
64d60ded9d16825948c03044.description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated: Send 1 face-up Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only activate 1 "Centur-Ion True Awakening" per turn.

64d60df99d16825948c0314e.name: Centur-Ion Phalanx
64d60df99d16825948c0314e.description: Target 1 face-up Monster Card on the field; banish it, and if you do, during the Standby Phase of the next turn, Special Summon that banished monster to its owner's field. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Centur-Ion" Synchro Monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but it loses 1500 ATK. You can only use 1 "Centur-Ion Phalanx" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

64d60e099d16825948c032e3.name: Centur-Ion Bonds
64d60e099d16825948c032e3.description: Place 1 "Centur-Ion" monster from your hand or GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. If a "Centur-Ion" Synchro Monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 "Centur-Ion" monster in your GY; place it in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. You can only use each effect of "Centur-Ion Bonds" once per turn.

64d60e1c9d16825948c0343e.name: Stand Up Centur-Ion!
64d60e1c9d16825948c0343e.description: Cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects while you control a "Centur-Ion" Monster Card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Stand Up Centur-Ion!" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY; place 1 "Centur-Ion" monster from your Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster, using monsters you control as material, including a "Centur-Ion" monster.

64d60e589d16825948c039a5.name: Centur-Ion Legatia
64d60e589d16825948c039a5.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Your monsters with 2000 or less ATK cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Centur-Ion Legatia" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can draw 1 card, then you can destroy the monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). During the End Phase: You can place 1 non-Synchro "Centur-Ion" monster from your hand or GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap.

64d60e6f9d16825948c03bf5.name: Centur-Ion Emeth VI
64d60e6f9d16825948c03bf5.description: During your opponent's turn, if this card is in your hand or GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Centur-Ion" monster you control, except "Centur-Ion Emeth VI"; place it in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap, and if you do, Special Summon this card, also you cannot Special Summon "Centur-Ion Emeth VI" for the rest of this turn. During the Main Phase, if this card is a Continuous Trap: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Centur-Ion Emeth VI" once per turn.

64d60eb09d16825948c042e0.name: Centur-Ion Trudea
64d60eb09d16825948c042e0.description: During your Main Phase: You can place this card you control and 1 "Centur-Ion" monster from your hand or Deck, except "Centur-Ion Trudea", in your Spell & Trap Zones as face-up Continuous Traps, also you cannot Special Summon "Centur-Ion Trudea" for the rest of this turn. During the Main Phase, if this card is a Continuous Trap: You can Special Summon this card, then you can increase its Level by 4. You can only use each effect of "Centur-Ion Trudea" once per turn.

64d60ec99d16825948c044e2.name: Centur-Ion Primera
64d60ec99d16825948c044e2.description: While this card is a Continuous Trap, Level 5 or higher "Centur-Ion" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Centur-Ion Primera" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Centur-Ion" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Centur-Ion Primera", also you cannot Special Summon "Centur-Ion Primera" for the rest of this turn. During the Main Phase, if this card is a Continuous Trap: You can Special Summon this card.

64d905caeeb24313636cdcb5.name: Fireyarou

[Effect] Change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you have "Gaia the Dragon Champion" face-up on your field, you can destroy 1 face-down card on your opponent's field.

64d9188adc21546c5c6196d9.name: Dragonic Escape
64d9188adc21546c5c6196d9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Gaia the Dragon Champion" or 1 Level 5 or lower Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

64d9189df061c98cc59eb752.name: Amusi Annoyance
64d9189df061c98cc59eb752.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a card is sent to your opponent's Graveyard during their Main Phase.
[Effect] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of cards in their hand] x 300. Then, if you activated this card when a card was sent from the Deck to your opponent's Graveyard, send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard.

64d918b2f061c98cc59eb995.name: Excutie Riding!
64d918b2f061c98cc59eb995.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons an Effect Monster face-up.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 monster with ATK less than or equal to that monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position. Then, you can make up to 2 face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1800 ATK until the end of this turn.

64d918c8f061c98cc59ebc69.name: Negate Attack
64d918c8f061c98cc59ebc69.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[Effect] Negate the attack. This turn, your opponent cannot declare an attack.

64d918e1f061c98cc59ebf01.name: Automatic Accident Avoidance
64d918e1f061c98cc59ebf01.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase while you have 2 or more cards in your hand.
[Effect] Draw 2 cards. Then, you can Special Summon up to 3 monsters from your hand to your field in face-down Defense Position.

64d9190e7630794a49521aea.name: Fusionic Revivern
64d9190e7630794a49521aea.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned a monster, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, you can Special Summon 1 High Dragon Type Fusion Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned a monster by this effect, you can add 1 "Fusion" or "Polymerization" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64da10b6a7fddc1888d95d8c.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
64da10b6a7fddc1888d95d8c.description: "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"

64da10daa7fddc1888d95f36.name: Blue-Eyes Vision Dragon
64da10daa7fddc1888d95f36.description:
If you have a face-up Level 8 or higher Dragon Type monster on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand to your field in face-up Defense Position.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card's name becomes "Blue-Eyes White Dragon", and if you Fusion Summon "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon", this face-up card can be treated as 2 materials.

64da10f3a7fddc1888d9609d.name: Blue-Eyes Bright Dragon
64da10f3a7fddc1888d9609d.description:
This card's name becomes "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" while in the hand.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, this card's name becomes "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" and it gains 500 ATK. Then, if you have a face-up Legend Normal Monster on your field, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

64da1115a7fddc1888d96292.name: Light Effigy
64da1115a7fddc1888d96292.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT Attribute Normal Monster in Attack Position.

64da112ea7fddc1888d963c8.name: Treasure of Eyes of Blue
64da112ea7fddc1888d963c8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 8 or higher LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" face-up on your field, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

64dba65177d840ebb18715f9.name: My Patience Has Run Out!
64dba65177d840ebb18715f9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your LP are lower than your opponent's.
[Effect] This turn, up to 2 face-up Omega Psychic and/or Psychic Type monsters on your field gain 900 ATK, and if they attack a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

64dcba235cd49e67e1f64ce7.name: Sanctum of Legend
64dcba235cd49e67e1f64ce7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Level 8 or higher Dragon Type monsters on the field gain 500 ATK, and face-up Dragon Type Legend monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by card effects.

64dcbf93722714d7c5407f6c.name: Vaalmonica Scelta
64dcbf93722714d7c5407f6c.description:
Apply 1 of these effects. Unless you have a "Vaalmonica" card in your Pendulum Zone, your opponent chooses the effect.
●Gain 500 LP, then you can place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck, then draw 2 cards.
●Take 250 damage, then you can add 1 "Vaalmonica" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Vaalmonica Scelta".
You can only activate 1 "Vaalmonica Scelta" per turn.

64de081432541a5596254196.name: The Trinity Dragiastar
64de081432541a5596254196.description:
"The Dragias" + "The Dragias" + "The Dragias"
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect] ● This card can attack thrice during this turn.
● Shuffle up to 3 Normal Monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck. Then, you can destroy Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field, up to [the number of "The Dragias" shuffled into the Deck by this effect].

64ded9c91094db56c26bf2ee.name: Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight
64ded9c91094db56c26bf2ee.description:
If this card is the only card in your hand, you can Normal Summon this card without a Tribute.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] None

64deda3a1094db56c26bfb40.name: Harpie Cielo
64deda3a1094db56c26bfb40.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Return 1 face-up "Harpie Lady Sisters" from your field to the owner's hand.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" was among the cards sent, you can add 1 "Harpie's Feather Tempest" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64dedbfd1094db56c26c1acd.name: Sevens Road Magician
64dedbfd1094db56c26c1acd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of different Attributes in your Graveyard] x 300, until the end of this turn.

64dedc58fac3ad97411fed32.name: Multistrike Dragon Dragias
64dedc58fac3ad97411fed32.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, if this card destroyed a monster by battle, it can make a second attack during that Battle Phase.

64dedc70fac3ad97411fee90.name: CAN:D
64dedc70fac3ad97411fee90.description: Carrying infinite potential, she continues to chase her shining dream with a smile on her face.

64dedc82fac3ad97411fef9b.name: Kimeluna the Dark Shifter
64dedc82fac3ad97411fef9b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Change the battle positions of up to 2 monsters on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position). Then, if you changed a battle position by this effect, you can change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your field.

64e259404469832b91dcad6e.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
64e259404469832b91dcad6e.description: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

64e259ab58ead9a1e1b03cce.name: Dark Magician Girl
64e259ab58ead9a1e1b03cce.description: Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in the GYs.

64e25a9c58ead9a1e1b05046.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
64e25a9c58ead9a1e1b05046.description: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

64e25acd58ead9a1e1b0547c.name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon
64e25acd58ead9a1e1b0547c.description: A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.

64e33c5c87e637a03e1462f9.name: Cyc the Child of Wind
64e33c5c87e637a03e1462f9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have another face-up WIND Attribute Spellcaster Type monster on your field during a turn you have not activated the effect of "Cyc the Child of Wind".
[Effect] Add 1 Level 4 or lower Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64e33c988f719cf92bdd9baf.name: High Magic - Double Acceleration
64e33c988f719cf92bdd9baf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Level 5 or higher Spellcaster Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] 1 face-up Spellcaster Type monster on your field gains ATK equal to [its original ATK] until the end of this turn.

64e33cb96867a3829a9727c5.name: Dragonic Demolisher
64e33cb96867a3829a9727c5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon and/or Dragon Type monsters, send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Dragonic Slayer" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64e33cd88f719cf92bdd9c88.name: Dragonic Force
64e33cd88f719cf92bdd9c88.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Dragon Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, 1 face-up monster on your field gains 900 ATK and your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when it declares an attack. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Dragonic Slayer" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64e33cef6867a3829a9729f6.name: Resolve
64e33cef6867a3829a9729f6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1500 LP.
[Effect] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Effect Monster with 2500 ATK from among the cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect face-up to your field.

64e33d038f719cf92bdd9d2b.name: Shining Superstar Riff
64e33d038f719cf92bdd9d2b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up monster with 2100 or more ATK on their field.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 Effect Monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, all face-up monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 300 until the end of this turn.

64e33d1c8f719cf92bdd9d91.name: Magician's Sense
64e33d1c8f719cf92bdd9d91.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster and you have 3 or more Spell Cards in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Set up to 2 "Thousand Knives", "Dark Magic Attack", and/or "Dark Resonance Burst" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, you take no battle damage from your opponent's Level 9 or lower monsters' attacks this turn.

64e33d4b8f719cf92bdd9e80.name: Dark Sword Magician
64e33d4b8f719cf92bdd9e80.description:
If the number of face-up Level 7 or higher monsters on your opponent's field exceeds the number of monsters on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you have 6 or more Spell Cards in your Graveyard, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's effects.

64e5e09f75fc7ffd7a08927a.name: Accel Wonder Light
64e5e09f75fc7ffd7a08927a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can send up to 2 excavated non-Trap Cards to the Graveyard. Shuffle the remaining cards into the Deck.

64e5fa7921a580d5b1277a46.name: Emblema Oath
64e5fa7921a580d5b1277a46.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
●Place 1 "Centur-Ion" monster from your Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. For the rest of this turn, while you control that card, or any card with that same original name, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Centur-Ion" monsters.
●Set 1 "Centur-Ion" Spell/Trap directly from your Deck.
You can only activate 1 "Emblema Oath" per turn.

64e8825014194fb2eba56f1e.name: Undulating Barrier
64e8825014194fb2eba56f1e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a Defense Position monster you control is attacked by an opponent’s monster.
[Effect] Send the top 5 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a monster(s) is among the cards sent, the attacking monster loses ATK equal to [the total Levels of the monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 100 until the end of this turn.

64eb403a39090e747824312e.name: Twin Edge Fire Dragon
64eb403a39090e747824312e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up Dragon Type monster on your field gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if it was "Twin Edge Dragon", it gains 500 more ATK until the end of this turn.

64ee1a580b32aaa60843deb2.name: Camelot, Realm of Noble Knights and Noble Arms
64ee1a580b32aaa60843deb2.description: Once per turn, if a "Noble Knight" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 Equip Card you control instead. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card (until the next Standby Phase), and if you do, place 1 "Noble Knights of the Round Table" from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Field Zone, then you can Special Summon 1 "Artorigus" monster, or add to your hand 1 "Noble Arms" card, from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "Camelot, Realm of Noble Knights and Noble Arms" once per turn.

64ee1a6b0b32aaa60843e29a.name: Time Thief Power Reserve
64ee1a6b0b32aaa60843e29a.description: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Psychic/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1900/DEF 2500) (this card is also still a Trap), then you can Special Summon 1 Machine "Time Thief" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY. If you control an Xyz Monster(s) that has both a Spell and a Trap as material: You can banish this card from your GY; banish 1 card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Time Thief Power Reserve" once per turn.

64ee1a8ae7637312895b0da2.name: SPYRAL Double Agent
64ee1a8ae7637312895b0da2.description: If you have a "SPYRAL" card on your field or in your GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand to your opponent's field in Defense Position (but it cannot be Tributed, nor be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon), then both players reveal the top card of their Deck. You can only use this effect of "SPYRAL Double Agent" once per turn. All "SPYRAL" monsters on the field gain 500 ATK, also "SPYRAL Super Agent" on the field can attack directly.

64f1f2e0530a8464c07c2b16.name: Node of Legend
64f1f2e0530a8464c07c2b16.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "The Origin Stone of Legend" or "Sanctum of Legend" from your Graveyard to your hand.

64f20d59b325baee79bbfdc5.name: Anotherverse Gluttonia
64f20d59b325baee79bbfdc5.description: A massive, malevolent monstrosity, devourer of diverse dimensions, who molds multiple domains where only the mightiest dare dwell.

64f3d64cb6495d233727cab9.name: Lullalabind
64f3d64cb6495d233727cab9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, shuffle 2 Psychic Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Change 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 2 Psychic Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

64f7068a3e39bb52262b22fd.name: Ordoll the Adorable Star
64f7068a3e39bb52262b22fd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Shuffle 2 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Ordoll the Adorable Star" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

64f706ad3e39bb52262b2559.name: Dragonic Scout
64f706ad3e39bb52262b2559.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon and/or Dragon Type monsters, send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Increase this card's Level by 4 until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 Level 7 EARTH Attribute Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

64f7227a1cc886f6aaffb680.name: Legendary Fire King Ponix
64f7227a1cc886f6aaffb680.description: If your monster(s) that was originally FIRE is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Fire King" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. During the next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed and sent to the GY: Add this card from the GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Legendary Fire King Ponix" once per turn.

64f942000a1d16ec5919f466.name: Blaze, Supreme Ruler of all Dragons
64f942000a1d16ec5919f466.description:
2 Level 7 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; destroy 2 cards (1 from your hand or field, and 1 your opponent controls). You can banish a total of 2 FIRE and/or Dragon monsters from your hand and/or GY; Special Summon this card from your GY, but return it to the Extra Deck when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Blaze, Supreme Ruler of all Dragons" once per turn.

64f94264734ac5940e702d9e.name: Dark Ruler Battlegear
64f94264734ac5940e702d9e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 8 DARK Attribute Warrior Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 3 cards. Then, shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck.

64f9e67b236e7b1dca785b5b.name: The Guard
64f9e67b236e7b1dca785b5b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Negate the attack.

64f9e6a576d61c9de159d57a.name: The Ultimate Blue-Eyed Legend
64f9e6a576d61c9de159d57a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Fusion Summon a Level 10 or higher Dragon Type monster by sending up to 3 Dragon Type monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material. This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

64f9e6c876d61c9de159d6dc.name: Absolute Lord of D.
64f9e6c876d61c9de159d6dc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned.
[Effect] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated Level 8 LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monster and/or 1 excavated "The Ultimate Blue-Eyed Legend" to your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into the Deck.

64fdb7aa5d3397a60d8e9655.name: Descending Dragon of Clear Water
64fdb7aa5d3397a60d8e9655.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have a High Dragon Type monster in your Graveyard, the monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

64fed418f1312cec14051ce9.name: Radiance of the Voiceless Voice
64fed418f1312cec14051ce9.description:
During the Main Phase: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Shuffle 1 LIGHT Ritual Monster (Warrior or Dragon) or 1 Ritual Spell from your hand or GY into the Deck, and if you do, add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 "Voiceless Voice" monster from your Deck.
● Target cards your opponent controls, up to the number of LIGHT Ritual Monsters (Warrior or Dragon) you control; destroy both this card and as many of the targeted cards as possible.
You can only use the effect of "Radiance of the Voiceless Voice" once per turn.

64fed42ef1312cec14052180.name: Barrier of the Voiceless Voice
64fed42ef1312cec14052180.description: While you control "Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice" and a LIGHT Ritual Monster, your opponent's monsters can only target Ritual Monsters for attacks, also your opponent cannot target LIGHT monsters you control with card effects. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Voiceless Voice" card or 1 "Skull Guardian" Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Barrier of the Voiceless Voice". You can only use this effect of "Barrier of the Voiceless Voice" once per turn.

64fed43ef1312cec1405259d.name: Prayers of the Voiceless Voice
64fed43ef1312cec1405259d.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any LIGHT Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute LIGHT monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster. If a face-up LIGHT Ritual Monster(s) you control leaves the field by an opponent's card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Sauravis, the Ancient and Ascended", "Saffira, Queen of Dragons", or "Skull Guardian, Protector of the Voiceless Voice" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only use this effect of "Prayers of the Voiceless Voice" once per turn.

64fed469f1312cec14052cbf.name: Skull Guardian, Protector of the Voiceless Voice
64fed469f1312cec14052cbf.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Prayers of the Voiceless Voice". Gains 2050 ATK while you have "Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice" on your field or in your GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Skull Guardian, Protector of the Voiceless Voice" once per turn. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 1 "Voiceless Voice" monster, or 1 Ritual Monster (Warrior or Dragon), from your Deck to your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect while you control "Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice" (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

64fed48af1312cec140533df.name: Sauravis, Dragon Sage of the Voiceless Voice
64fed48af1312cec140533df.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by shuffling 2 Spells from your hand and/or GY into the Deck, including a Ritual Spell. You can only Special Summon "Sauravis, Dragon Sage of the Voiceless Voice" once per turn this way. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can return this card from the field to the hand; Special Summon 1 LIGHT Ritual Monster (Warrior or Dragon) from your hand or Deck, but shuffle it into the Deck during the End Phase of the next turn. You can only use this effect of "Sauravis, Dragon Sage of the Voiceless Voice" once per turn.

64fed49ef1312cec1405377e.name: Saffira, Dragon Queen of the Voiceless Voice
64fed49ef1312cec1405377e.description: You can discard this card; send 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to the GY, then you can add 1 LIGHT Ritual Monster (Warrior or Dragon) from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; Ritual Summon 1 LIGHT Ritual Monster (Warrior or Dragon) from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster. You can only use each effect of "Saffira, Dragon Queen of the Voiceless Voice" once per turn.

64fed4b3f1312cec14053b85.name: Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice
64fed4b3f1312cec14053b85.description: If you Ritual Summon exactly 1 LIGHT Ritual Monster (Warrior or Dragon) with a card effect that requires use of monsters, this card can be used as the entire Tribute. You can only use each of the following effects of "Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Voiceless Voice" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. If a LIGHT Ritual Monster (Warrior or Dragon) is Special Summoned to your field, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card.

64fff8790f7ce143e623c289.name: Majespecter Porcupine - Yamarashi
64fff8790f7ce143e623c289.description: During the Main Phase, if you control a "Majespecter" monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Majespecter" Spell in your GY; Set it. You can only use each of the previous effects of "Majespecter Porcupine - Yamarashi" once per turn. While this card is in your Monster Zone, your opponent cannot target it with card effects, also it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

64fff916f5614350618ca0b2.name: Majespecter Draco - Ryu
64fff916f5614350618ca0b2.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have a "Majespecter" or "Dracoslayer" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can add 1 "Majespecter" card from your Deck to your hand, then you can destroy 1 card in your Pendulum Zone. You can only use this effect of "Majespecter Draco - Ryu" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
2 Level 4 monsters
If you can Pendulum Summon Level 4, you can Pendulum Summon this face-up card from your Extra Deck. If a monster(s) is Tributed while this card is on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower WIND Spellcaster monster from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Majespecter Draco - Ryu" up to twice per turn. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by battle or card effect, or Tributed: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

64fff96bd046f514c901857a.name: Majespecter Orthrus - Nue
64fff96bd046f514c901857a.description:
2 Pendulum Monsters, including a "Majespecter" monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add up to 2 face-up "Majespecter" Pendulum Monsters from your Extra Deck to your hand, then you can add up to 2 "Majespecter" Pendulum Monsters with different names from your Deck to your face-up Extra Deck, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "Majespecter" or "Dracoslayer" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Majespecter Orthrus - Nue" once per turn.

64fff99cd046f514c9018da6.name: Majespecter Wind
64fff99cd046f514c9018da6.description: When you activate this card, you can also Tribute 1 WIND Spellcaster monster; Special Summon 1 "Majespecter" monster from your hand or GY, or if you Tributed a monster at activation, you can Special Summon 1 "Majespecter" monster from your Deck instead. You can only activate 1 "Majespecter Wind" per turn.

6501329a2cfb7ad110cad445.name: White Sunfish
6501329a2cfb7ad110cad445.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Fish monster in your GY with the same name as a card you control; Special Summon this card, and if you do, Special Summon that monster. You can only use this effect of "White Sunfish" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can treat it as a Tuner this turn.

650132e7c9622da518cbc39f.name: White Sardine
650132e7c9622da518cbc39f.description: You can send 1 "White Sardine" from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except WATER monsters. You can only use this effect of "White Sardine" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can treat it as a Tuner this turn.

6501332025aa0f3d0bb5cf64.name: White Aura Porpoise
6501332025aa0f3d0bb5cf64.description:
1 WATER Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Fish monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, then you can Special Summon 1 monster with that same name from your GY. You can only use this effect of "White Aura Porpoise" once per turn. If this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY: You can banish 1 other WATER monster from your GY; Special Summon this card, and if you do, it is treated as a Tuner.

6501334a678705eb2e479981.name: White Reincarnation
6501334a678705eb2e479981.description: When this card is activated: Add 1 Fish monster with an effect that treats itself as a Tuner from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, at the end of the Damage Step, if your "White Aura" monster attacked: You can activate this effect; the attacking monster can make a second attack in a row. Once per turn, if a Level 8 or higher Fish Synchro Monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY, even during the Damage Step: You can destroy all monsters your opponent controls. You can only activate 1 "White Reincarnation" per turn.

6501a0ec717441ea93663191.name: Straynge Magician
6501a0ec717441ea93663191.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster with 0 ATK from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have "Straynge Cat" in your Graveyard, you can choose 1 face-up monster with 0 ATK on your field. If you do, that monster cannot be destroyed by card effects this turn.

6501a1321b4565762ba5a02c.name: Soul Drake
6501a1321b4565762ba5a02c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned, send 2 face-up Level 4 or lower Effect Monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 8 LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, your Level 7 or lower monsters cannot attack.

6501a18e1b4565762ba5a412.name: Phoenix Dragoon
6501a18e1b4565762ba5a412.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Gain 300 LP. Then, if you have a Level 8 monster in your Graveyard, draw 1 card.

6502d05c57011f848e852945.name: Walls of the Imperial Tomb
6502d05c57011f848e852945.description: This card's name becomes "King's Sarcophagus" while in the Field Zone. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Horus" monster from your Deck to your hand, then place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Walls of the Imperial Tomb" once per turn. If you activate the effect of "Horus the Black Flame Deity": You can draw 1 card.

6502d07057011f848e852d5f.name: Horus the Black Flame Deity
6502d07057011f848e852d5f.description: If you control a "Horus" monster and "King's Sarcophagus": You can reveal this card in your hand, then send 1 card from your hand or field to the GY; send 1 card on the field to the GY. If a face-up "Horus" monster(s) you control, except "Horus the Black Flame Deity", or a face-up "King's Sarcophagus" you control, leaves the field by an opponent's card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can send all other monsters on the field to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Horus the Black Flame Deity" once per turn.

6504287cac6b1251479cd3af.name: Lancea, Ancestral Dragon of the Ice Mountain
6504287cac6b1251479cd3af.description:
1 WATER Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
Once per Chain, if your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 "Ice Barrier" monster from your hand, Deck, Extra Deck, or GY, then you can change 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls to Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Lancea, Ancestral Dragon of the Ice Mountain" twice per turn. If this face-up Synchro Summoned card in its owner's control leaves the field by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Ice Barrier" Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Synchro Summon).

6504289e2130f56b1e64dd32.name: Georgius, Swordman of the Ice Barrier
6504289e2130f56b1e64dd32.description: While you control another "Ice Barrier" monster, your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Georgius, Swordman of the Ice Barrier" once per turn. If you control an "Ice Barrier" monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower "Ice Barrier" monster from your hand or GY.

650428b4ac6b1251479cd638.name: Mirror Mage of the Ice Barrier
650428b4ac6b1251479cd638.description: You can Tribute 1 other Effect Monster; Special Summon up to 3 "Ice Barrier Tokens" (Aqua/WATER/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0), and if you do, increase this card's Level by that number, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except WATER Synchro Monsters. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 of your "Ice Barrier" cards that is banished or in your Deck to your hand, except "Mirror Mage of the Ice Barrier". You can only use each effect of "Mirror Mage of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

650428d0ac6b1251479cd79e.name: Infernoid Evil
650428d0ac6b1251479cd79e.description:
2 "Infernoid" monsters
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can banish 1 "Infernoid" monster from your GY; send "Infernoid" monsters with different names from your Deck to the GY equal to the banished monster's Level. If this card is sent to the GY or banished: You can add 1 "Void" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Infernoid Evil" once per turn.

650428ed268dde893535db77.name: Infernoid Flood
650428ed268dde893535db77.description:
2+ monsters, including an "Infernoid" monster
When your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s) (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster; negate the Summon, and if you do, banish that monster(s). If a card(s) is banished from your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish 1 card on the field. If this Link Summoned card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Infernoid" monster from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only use each effect of "Infernoid Flood" once per turn.

650428fcac6b1251479cd9b4.name: Frozen Domain of the Ice Barrier
650428fcac6b1251479cd9b4.description: Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to the activation of your "Ice Barrier" monster effects. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck (except during the Damage Step): You can return to the hand or shuffle into the Deck, 1 "Ice Barrier" monster you control, then you can place 1 card from the field or either GY on the bottom of the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Frozen Domain of the Ice Barrier" once per turn. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Reveal 3 "Ice Barrier" monsters with different names in your Extra Deck or destroy this card.

65042908ac6b1251479cda66.name: Void Reignition
65042908ac6b1251479cda66.description: Reveal 1 "Infernoid" monster or 1 "Void" Spell/Trap in your hand; discard your entire hand, then draw the same number of cards you discarded. If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are Fiend monsters, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target up to 11 of your banished "Infernoid" monsters with different names; return them to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Void Reignition" once per Duel.

65042913ac6b1251479cdb1a.name: Void Breach
65042913ac6b1251479cdb1a.description:
"Infernoid" monsters you control gain 100 ATK for each of your banished "Infernoid" monsters. If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are Fiend monsters: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 of your banished "Infernoid" monsters to your hand.
● Special Summon 1 "Infernoid" monster from your hand, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
You can only use this effect of "Void Breach" once per turn.

65042dd784325fdcf0bf9d8d.name: Ultimate Flag Beast Boltricorn
65042dd784325fdcf0bf9d8d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field cannot be activated until the end of your opponent's next turn.

65042e007014daea7489b7f6.name: Draco the Hand-Sewn
65042e007014daea7489b7f6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 1 monster with 1400 DEF from your Graveyard to your field in face-down Defense Position. Then, if you Special Summoned a Normal Monster by this effect, draw 1 card.

65042e3b4a6d2f16d1148394.name: Kimeterasu the Divine Ruler
65042e3b4a6d2f16d1148394.description:
"Kimeruler the Dark Raider" + "Needlkyrie the Celestial Seamstress"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Multi-Choice Effect]
● Up to 2 face-up monsters on your field can attack directly this turn.
● This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn.

65042e5f7014daea7489bd4d.name: Hagoromo the Cloudle-Handling Celestial Seamstress
65042e5f7014daea7489bd4d.description:
"Valkyrian Cutpasterie" + "Needlkyrie the Celestial Seamstress"

[REQUIREMENT] Pay 300 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior or Fairy Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can Set 1 "Fusion" or "Divine Transformation" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

65042e90355ddf3137ae6c6d.name: Transcendent Transformation
65042e90355ddf3137ae6c6d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a LIGHT Attribute monster by sending monsters from your field to the Graveyard as materials, including a Fairy Type monster. If you Fusion Summon a Celestial Warrior Type monster by this effect, you can also use monsters in your hand as materials.

65042eb2355ddf3137ae6e5d.name: Vi-FRND
65042eb2355ddf3137ae6e5d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 5 cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Giftarist", "Romic n' Roller", "Berry Bassist", "Dream Drummer", and "Keytar Kid" in your Graveyard, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

65042ecf355ddf3137ae6fa0.name: Psykickoff Concert
65042ecf355ddf3137ae6fa0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 or more Psychic Type monsters in your Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar" or "Esperade the Smashing Superstar" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

65042f01355ddf3137ae71c6.name: Wizened Dark Magician
65042f01355ddf3137ae71c6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

65042f1d355ddf3137ae72fb.name: Stone of the Dark Magicians
65042f1d355ddf3137ae72fb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Special Summon 1 DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster with 2500 ATK and/or 1 DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster with 2000 ATK from your hand and/or Graveyard face-up to your field.

65133e81cec6568889b7014d.name: Hammer Crush
65133e81cec6568889b7014d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

651423c81289e29cc0d93243.name: Phantasmal Summoning Beast
651423c81289e29cc0d93243.description: You can Tribute this card; add 1 "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder" or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" from your Deck or GY to your hand, then you can Special Summon 1 Level 10 Pyro, Thunder, or Fiend monster from your hand whose ATK equals its own DEF, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but it cannot attack directly this turn. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Dimension Fusion Destruction" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Phantasmal Summoning Beast" once per turn.

651819ef6b6923944816d7a9.name: Magmacho Dragon
651819ef6b6923944816d7a9.description: You can banish up to 3 FIRE monsters from your GY; this card gains 400 ATK for each, until the end of this turn. If a face-up FIRE monster(s) you control is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card (but banish it when it leaves the field), then draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Magmacho Dragon" once per turn.

651acbb5454c07ebf735595b.name: Lightning Volteagle
651acbb5454c07ebf735595b.description:
If you have a face-up Level 7 LIGHT Attribute Winged Beast Type monster on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Lightning Voltcondor" face-up on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card can attack twice this turn.

651acbda311ff6f756aecb45.name: Thunderbold, the Echoing Thunder
651acbda311ff6f756aecb45.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 LIGHT Attribute Winged Beast Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can make up to 3 face-up monsters on your opponent's field become LIGHT Attribute until the end of this turn.

651acc5ba60574479d5f7d0a.name: Lightning Voltkite
651acc5ba60574479d5f7d0a.description:
If you have a face-up Level 7 LIGHT Attribute Winged Beast Type monster on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck and you have "Lightning Voltcondor" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Draw 1 card.

651accdb7a32c6ad337f3051.name: Flash Voltchick
651accdb7a32c6ad337f3051.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 LIGHT Attribute Winged Beast Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you sent a Level 7 monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

651acd1f7a32c6ad337f3361.name: Spark Voltegg
651acd1f7a32c6ad337f3361.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 LIGHT Attribute monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT Attribute Winged Beast Type monster in Attack Position. Then, you can add 1 "Lightning Voltcondor" from your Graveyard to your hand.

651acda425f2f62ffd7b1cde.name: Furtunate Cat
651acda425f2f62ffd7b1cde.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 2 "Straynge Cat" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you Special Summoned by this effect, this face-up card and the monsters Special Summoned by this effect can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a monster in Attack Position this turn.

651ace0f21fec04bb8443ecc.name: Straynge Gathering
651ace0f21fec04bb8443ecc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spellcaster Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 2 or more "Straynge Cat" and/or "Furtunate Cat" in your Graveyard, draw 1 additional card.

651ace4b21fec04bb8444173.name: Straynge Cat Signal
651ace4b21fec04bb8444173.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Up to 3 face-up Spellcaster Type monsters with 0 original ATK on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 1400 until the end of this turn. Then, you can Set 1 "Recovery Force" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

651acea893688fbb453c25a9.name: Lightning Voltcharge
651acea893688fbb453c25a9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 LIGHT Attribute Winged Beast Type monster on your field.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, if your opponent has a face-up LIGHT Attribute monster on their field, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

651acf0b21fec04bb8444893.name: Straynge Cat Jealousy
651acf0b21fec04bb8444893.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have "Straynge Cat" or "Furtunate Cat" in your Graveyard, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting a face-up monster with 0 ATK.
[Effect] Negate the attack. Then, you can change the battle position of the attack target. If you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 200.

651acf7aa60574479d5f8ea7.name: 7 Shift
651acf7aa60574479d5f8ea7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower Effect Monster from your hand face-up to your field.

651acff293688fbb453c3616.name: The Block
651acff293688fbb453c3616.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster in face-up Attack Position, and they have 2 or more monsters on their field.
[Effect] Change up to 2 Level 8 or lower Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

651ad06a787c408b240bc56e.name: Yamiluna the Dark Devotee
651ad06a787c408b240bc56e.description:
If you have "Yamiruler the Dark Delayer" face-up on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.[REQUIREMENT] Change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your field.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up "Yamiruler the Dark Delayer" on your field. While that monster is face-up, it gains 500 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

651ad0eb93688fbb453c411c.name: Koi of Winter Wonder
651ad0eb93688fbb453c411c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send all monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. You can only Normal or Special Summon Celestial Warrior, Warrior, or Fairy Type monsters for the rest of this turn.

651ad15893688fbb453c45fb.name: Shield in the Right Hand
651ad15893688fbb453c45fb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned.
[Effect] Set up to 2 "Shield & Sword" and/or "Sword & Shield" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, if you Set "Shield & Sword" by this effect, you can change the battle position of up to 3 monsters on your opponent's field.

651ad1aa25f2f62ffd7b493e.name: Sword in the Left Hand
651ad1aa25f2f62ffd7b493e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Add 1 "Shield in the Right Hand" or 1 Warrior Type Normal Monster with 500 or less ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.

651ad2027a32c6ad337f723d.name: Seyanen the Blazing Conqueror
651ad2027a32c6ad337f723d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 8 FIRE or DARK Attribute Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Your monsters with 1900 or less DEF cannot attack this turn.

651ad2fba60574479d5fae79.name: Star's Hand Director
651ad2fba60574479d5fae79.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 2 Psychic Type monster with 500 ATK/0 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with Omega Psychic or Psychic Type monsters.

651ad34b787c408b240bde8f.name: Star's Hand Illuminator
651ad34b787c408b240bde8f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have "Vi-FRND" face-up on your field, you can look at up to 2 face-down cards on your opponent's field.

651ad39f7a32c6ad337f85f7.name: Star's Hand Roadie
651ad39f7a32c6ad337f85f7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was Normal or Special Summoned.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have "Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar" face-up on your field, you can make up to 2 face-up monsters on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn.

651ad3e67a32c6ad337f89c0.name: Psychicomposition
651ad3e67a32c6ad337f89c0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
