[Effect] Add 1 DARK Attribute Psychic Type monster with 0 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if you added "Vi-FRND" to your hand by this effect, you can send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

651ad42225f2f62ffd7b66c6.name: Dream Ticket
651ad42225f2f62ffd7b66c6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar" or "Esperade the Smashing Superstar" face-up on your field.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. This turn, you can only attack with Omega Psychic or Psychic Type monsters.

651ad4767a32c6ad337f9155.name: Raging Rock
651ad4767a32c6ad337f9155.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster while you have 3 face-up Omega Psychic and/or Psychic Type monsters on your field.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your field gain 200 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can choose 1 face-up Effect Monster on your opponent's field. If you do, your opponent cannot activate the chosen monster's effects this turn.

651ad4f521fec04bb8448491.name: True Beast Gear King Liogon
651ad4f521fec04bb8448491.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other face-up Beast-Warrior Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the original ATK of the monster sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement] until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a card in your Field Zone, you can change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field.

651ad5467a32c6ad337f9a77.name: True Beast Gear Emperor Kong
651ad5467a32c6ad337f9a77.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other face-up Beast-Warrior Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-down card on your opponent's field. This turn, you can only attack with Beast-Warrior Type monsters.

651ad59b93688fbb453c7dc9.name: Apocalypse - Beast Over World
651ad59b93688fbb453c7dc9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up EARTH and DARK Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monsters with 1600 or more original ATK on the field gain 400 ATK/DEF and cannot be destroyed by card effects.

651c58ec561039c67800c98c.name: Kibatsu the Cutting Edge Deity
651c58ec561039c67800c98c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle your Deck.
[Effect] Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck. You can send 1 excavated monster to the Graveyard. Shuffle the remaining cards into the Deck. If you sent "Kibatsu the Cutting Edge Deity" to the Graveyard by this effect, you can destroy 1 face-up card on your opponent's field.

651c59d8c9f8a85e5263d689.name: Time Wizard
651c59d8c9f8a85e5263d689.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Toss a coin. If the result is heads, destroy all monsters on your opponent's field. If the result is tails, destroy all monsters on your field, and you take damage equal to [the total original ATK of the monsters destroyed by this effect].

651c5ace5b10b96d6448674b.name: Cyber Tutu
651c5ace5b10b96d6448674b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has no face-up monsters with 1000 or less ATK on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card can attack directly this turn.

651c5b50561039c67800f096.name: Red Archery Girl
651c5b50561039c67800f096.description: A mermaid archer that hides in a protective shell, waiting for the right moment to strike.

651c5bbbc9f8a85e5263f4db.name: Destroyer Golem
651c5bbbc9f8a85e5263f4db.description: A golem with a massive right hand for crushing its victims.

651c5c0ca9fb43b1ec8c4aa3.name: The Snake Hair
651c5c0ca9fb43b1ec8c4aa3.description: A monster with a head of poison snakes. One look from this monster can turn an opponent to stone.

651c5c7d5a7ea1e80fdd1ebe.name: Confiscation
651c5c7d5a7ea1e80fdd1ebe.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] Look at your opponent's hand and send 1 card from it to the Graveyard.

651c5d755a7ea1e80fdd2d4e.name: Darkness Drake
651c5d755a7ea1e80fdd2d4e.description: The incarnation of darkness that deceives and corrupts one's mind. It eats away at everything.

651c5ddf5b10b96d64488bf4.name: Striping Wyvern
651c5ddf5b10b96d64488bf4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck and this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" or "Red-Boot Boost Dragon" from your hand to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 "Dragon's Burst Fusion" or "Dragon's Boost Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

651c5e3c5a7ea1e80fdd3816.name: Flap Dragon
651c5e3c5a7ea1e80fdd3816.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Dragon Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 face-down monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position. Then, if the only face-up monsters on your field are Dragon Type monsters, you can Special Summon 1 "Flip Dragon" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

651c5e8ac9f8a85e52641ddd.name: Flip Dragon
651c5e8ac9f8a85e52641ddd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Dragon Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, if the only face-up monsters on your field are Dragon Type monsters, you can Special Summon 1 "Flap Dragon" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

651c5ee95a7ea1e80fdd4131.name: Red Reboot Enhanced Boost Dragon
651c5ee95a7ea1e80fdd4131.description:
"Red-Boot Boost Dragon" + "Darkness Drake"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[Effect] Choose up to 3 DARK Attribute monsters in your Graveyard. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the total Levels of the chosen monsters] x 100, and this card gains ATK equal to [the total Levels of the chosen monsters] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, shuffle the chosen monsters into the Deck.

651c5fa2c9f8a85e52642d14.name: Dragonic Progress
651c5fa2c9f8a85e52642d14.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[Effect] Add 1 Level 1 LIGHT or DARK Attribute Dragon Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can add 1 "Dragon's Burst Fusion" or "Dragon's Boost Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

651c5fbdc9f8a85e52642ed5.name: Star Protector's Protection
651c5fbdc9f8a85e52642ed5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws a card during their turn, or when your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster during their turn, send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, your opponent can only declare an attack once. Also, you can take control of 1 face-up Level 9 or higher Magical Knight Type Fusion Monster with 3000 original ATK on your opponent's field.

651d532b6626ab578f2010f1.name: Spellbook Rejection
651d532b6626ab578f2010f1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck.
[Effect] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. Send all excavated DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters and Spell Cards to the Graveyard. Shuffle the remaining cards into the Deck. If you sent 4 cards to the Graveyard by this effect, draw 1 card.

651e95f99984442bdcd82120.name: Major Audition
651e95f99984442bdcd82120.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Special Summon up to 1 each of "Giftarist", "Romic n' Roller", "Berry Bassist", "Dream Drummer", and "Keytar Kid" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. You can only attack with Omega Psychic or Psychic Type monsters this turn.

651ffa39a61bda964e8b10d2.name: Spell Extraction
651ffa39a61bda964e8b10d2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other card from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Draw 1 card. Then, you can reveal 1 DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster with 2000 or 2500 ATK in your hand. If you do, draw 1 card.

65203195d4ed2c4dccd9e8d2.name: Ken the Warrior Dragon
65203195d4ed2c4dccd9e8d2.description: Once per turn, at the end of the Battle Phase: Return this card from the field to the hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ken the Warrior Dragon" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Gen the Diamond Tiger" from your hand or Deck to your opponent's field in Defense Position. If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of "Gen the Diamond Tiger": Your opponent draws 2 cards, then they discard 1 card.

652031a9d4ed2c4dccd9eb72.name: Gen the Diamond Tiger
652031a9d4ed2c4dccd9eb72.description: Once per turn, at the end of the Battle Phase: Return this card from the field to the hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Gen the Diamond Tiger" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Ken the Warrior Dragon" from your hand or Deck to your opponent's field in Defense Position. If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of "Ken the Warrior Dragon": Discard 1 card.

652031c1d4ed2c4dccd9ee5d.name: Asset Mountis
652031c1d4ed2c4dccd9ee5d.description: If your opponent controls a Level 6 or lower monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If you have more cards in your hand than your opponent: You can change the battle positions of all monsters on the field, all other Insect monsters on the field become the same Attribute and Level as this card, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Insect monsters. If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 Level 8 or higher Insect monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Asset Mountis" once per turn.

652031e9d4ed2c4dccd9f3a8.name: Pitknight Filly
652031e9d4ed2c4dccd9f3a8.description:
2 Effect Monsters
If this card is Special Summoned to a zone a Link Monster points to: You can target 1 monster you control with 1500 or less ATK; this turn, it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase, also if it battles an opponent's monster, any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is doubled. During the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card was destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Pitknight Filly" once per turn.

65203200d4ed2c4dccd9f75a.name: Wattsychic Fighting Porter
65203200d4ed2c4dccd9f75a.description: Special Summon up to 2 Level 3 or lower LIGHT monsters from your hand. If you Summoned 2 monsters with the same original Type, those monsters can attack directly this turn. If they have the same original Level, they also cannot be destroyed by battle this turn. You can only activate 1 "Wattsychic Fighting Porter" per turn.

6520321ad4ed2c4dccd9fa89.name: Fallen of the Tistina
6520321ad4ed2c4dccd9fa89.description: You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; place 1 "Divine Domain Baatistina" from your Deck, face-up in your Field Zone. If a face-up "Tistina" Spell/Trap(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 LIGHT "Tistina" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY. You can only use each effect of "Fallen of the Tistina" once per turn.

6520323cd4ed2c4dccd9fe9c.name: Returned of the Tistina
6520323cd4ed2c4dccd9fe9c.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 "Tistina" monster you control, except "Returned of the Tistina"; Special Summon this card, and if you do, its Level becomes that targeted monster's Level. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 Aqua Xyz Monster you control; attach this card to it as material. You can only use each effect of "Returned of the Tistina" once per turn.

65203251d4ed2c4dccda00f1.name: Tainted of the Tistina
65203251d4ed2c4dccda00f1.description: You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing 1 face-down monster your opponent controls. This card's Level becomes 10 if it was Normal Summoned/Set. If this card is sent to the GY, except from the field: You can target 1 "Tistina" monster you control; this turn, it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase, also you can only attack with 1 monster.

65203269d4ed2c4dccda03f6.name: Tistina, the Divinity that Defies Darkness
65203269d4ed2c4dccda03f6.description:
2 Level 10 monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can send all face-down cards your opponent controls to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Tistina, the Divinity that Defies Darkness" once per turn. Once per turn, if this card has "Crystal God Tistina" as material: You can detach 1 material from this card; it gains 2000 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn. If this card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card while it has material: You can Special Summon 1 "Tistina" monster from your GY.

6520327cd4ed2c4dccda065c.name: Play of the Tistina
6520327cd4ed2c4dccda065c.description: Special Summon 1 "Tistina" monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, but return it to the hand during the End Phase. You can only activate 1 "Play of the Tistina" per turn.

6520328bd4ed2c4dccda08b8.name: Embrace of the Tistina
6520328bd4ed2c4dccda08b8.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field: You can target that monster; change it to face-down Defense Position. During the End Phase: You can target 1 face-down Defense Position monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster. You can only use each effect of "Embrace of the Tistina" once per turn, and can only activate them while you control a "Tistina" monster with 3000 or more DEF.

652032aad4ed2c4dccda0c30.name: Discordance of the Tistina
652032aad4ed2c4dccda0c30.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● If you control a "Tistina" monster: Banish 1 card from your opponent's GY, face-down.
● If you control a "Tistina" monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: Banish all cards from your opponent's GY, face-down.
You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Tistina" monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use 1 "Discordance of the Tistina" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6520cf3cdcace2a68460b40c.name: Pendulum Witch
6520cf3cdcace2a68460b40c.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If a face-up Fusion, Synchro, and/or Xyz Monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect while this card is in the Pendulum Zone: You can add 1 Pendulum Monster with the same original Type as 1 of those monsters, from your Deck to your face-up Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Pendulum Witch" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is Normal or Pendulum Summoned: You can target 1 card in your Pendulum Zone; destroy both that target and this card, and if you do, add 1 Level 4 or lower Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Pendulum Witch" once per turn. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

652152cf55d226377ef5cb23.name: Goblin Freefall Squad
652152cf55d226377ef5cb23.description: If this card is Special Summoned from the hand in Attack Position: You can target 1 face-up Effect Monster your opponent controls; change this card to Defense Position, also negate the effects of that monster while this monster is in face-up Defense Position. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can discard 1 card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Goblin Freefall Squad" once per turn.

652182725e0f2764a2ee5c39.name: Magicians of Bonds and Unity
652182725e0f2764a2ee5c39.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 25 or more cards in your GY. While your opponent has 25 or more cards in their GY, this card gains 2500 ATK/DEF.

6522a0dca5a5dc2316c4c5f5.name: The Black Goat Laughs
6522a0dca5a5dc2316c4c5f5.description: Declare 1 Monster Card name; this turn, neither player can Special Summon monsters with that original name, except from the GY. You can banish this card from the GY, then declare 1 Monster Card name; this turn, neither player can activate the effects of monsters on the field with that original name. You can only use 1 "The Black Goat Laughs" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6522abc0784ad029704ccbe4.name: Owlchannel
6522abc0784ad029704ccbe4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has 2 or more cards on their field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This turn, you take no damage from your opponent's Trap Card effects. Then, you can add 1 Winged Beast Type monster with 2200 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.

6522ac29784ad029704cd2a4.name: Gias x Gias
6522ac29784ad029704cd2a4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 1500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can choose 1 face-up monster on your field with the same Level and Type as that monster. If you do, that monster on your field can attack twice this turn.

6522aea3dc13b612ac899fcd.name: Mementotlan Ghattic
6522aea3dc13b612ac899fcd.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Memento" card in your GY, except "Mementotlan Ghattic"; add it to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY by a "Memento" monster's effect: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Mementotlan Ghattic" once per turn.

6522aeb8dc13b612ac89a2a1.name: Mutamorphosis
6522aeb8dc13b612ac89a2a1.description: Tribute 1 Fusion or Synchro Monster; Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster's original Level, but return it to the hand during the End Phase. You can only activate 1 "Mutamorphosis" per turn.

6523c5da92b5f0ee2f3d8ef7.name: Goblin Biker Dugg Charger
6523c5da92b5f0ee2f3d8ef7.description: If this card is in your hand: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on either field, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Goblin Biker" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Goblin Biker Dugg Charger" once per turn.

6523c5f792b5f0ee2f3d91ea.name: Goblin Biker Clatter Sploder
6523c5f792b5f0ee2f3d91ea.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Goblin" monster in your GY, except "Goblin Biker Clatter Sploder"; Special Summon it. During your opponent's Main Phase, if this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on either field, and if you do, Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Goblin Biker Clatter Sploder" once per turn.

6523c61492b5f0ee2f3d9471.name: Goblin Biker Boom Mach
6523c61492b5f0ee2f3d9471.description: Once per Chain, during the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand or GY (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on either field, and if you do, Special Summon this card, also you cannot Special Summon "Goblin Biker Boom Mach" until the end of the next turn.

6523c63092b5f0ee2f3d96a4.name: Goblin Biker Mean Merciless
6523c63092b5f0ee2f3d96a4.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Goblin" monster from your hand, except "Goblin Biker Mean Merciless". During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on either field, and if you do, Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Goblin Biker Mean Merciless" once per turn.

6523c65d92b5f0ee2f3d9bc3.name: Snake-Eyes Poplar
6523c65d92b5f0ee2f3d9bc3.description: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Snake-Eye" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 FIRE monster in your GY; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. You can only use each effect of "Snake-Eyes Poplar" once per turn.

6523c68492b5f0ee2f3d9fd6.name: Goblin Biker Big Gabonga
6523c68492b5f0ee2f3d9fd6.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can add 1 "Goblin" monster from your Deck to your hand. If material is detached from a monster(s) on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field, except this card; attach it to this card as material. During the End Phase: You can attach 1 "Goblin" monster from your Deck to this card as material. You can only use each effect of "Goblin Biker Big Gabonga" once per turn.

6523c6a292b5f0ee2f3da324.name: Goblin's Crazy Beast
6523c6a292b5f0ee2f3da324.description:
2+ Level 6 monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; detach 2 materials from a monster(s) on the field, and if you do, attach that target to this card as material. If a monster(s) you control would be destroyed by card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead. If this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, then you can attach 1 "Goblin" monster from your GY to this card as material. You can only use this effect of "Goblin's Crazy Beast" once per Duel.

6523c6c492b5f0ee2f3da640.name: Goblin Biker Grand Bash
6523c6c492b5f0ee2f3da640.description:
"Goblin" monsters you control gain 300 ATK for each "Goblin" monster you control. During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Goblin" monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) You can target 2 "Goblin" monsters you control, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Make the Level of 1 of the monsters become the current Level of the other.
● Both of their Levels become their combined original Levels.
You can only use this effect of "Goblin Biker Grand Bash" once per turn.

6523c6d692b5f0ee2f3da823.name: Goblin Biker Grand Entrance
6523c6d692b5f0ee2f3da823.description:
Add 1 "Goblin" monster from your Deck to your hand, then you can apply the following effect.
● Detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on either field, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Goblin" monster from your hand.
You can banish this card from your GY; detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on either field, then you can add 1 "Goblin" monster from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Goblin Biker Grand Entrance" once per turn.

6523c6e792b5f0ee2f3da9c6.name: Dramatic Snake-Eye Chase
6523c6e792b5f0ee2f3da9c6.description: Place 1 "Diabellstar" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. During the End Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Monster Card treated as a Continuous Spell you control; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Dramatic Snake-Eye Chase" once per turn.

6523c6fe92b5f0ee2f3dac17.name: Goblin Biker Grand Stampede
6523c6fe92b5f0ee2f3dac17.description: During the Main Phase, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Xyz Monster, using only "Goblin" monsters you control. If you control a "Goblin" Xyz Monster: You can target 1 Effect Monster on the field; detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on either field, and if you do, negate that monster's effects until the end of this turn. You can only use 1 "Goblin Biker Grand Stampede" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6524c5b73179314493fd8c09.name: Dark Guardian
6524c5b73179314493fd8c09.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Gate Guardian" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be either Special Summoned by "Dark Element", or Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by shuffling into the Deck, 1 each of your "Sanga of the Thunder", "Kazejin", and "Suijin" that is in your hand, face-up field, GY, and/or banished. Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Element", it is unaffected by other monsters' effects or your opponent's activated Spell Cards or effects.

6524c5c73179314493fd8dd4.name: Dark Element
6524c5c73179314493fd8dd4.description: If you have a "Gate Guardian" monster in your GY: Pay half your LP; Special Summon 1 Level 11 or higher "Gate Guardian" monster from your hand, Deck, or Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 of your "Sanga of the Thunder", "Kazejin", or "Suijin" from your Deck or banishment to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Dark Element" once per turn.

65261b4f94ac8edb4abcd013.name: Keaf, Murk of the Ghoti
65261b4f94ac8edb4abcd013.description: If a Fish monster is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of those monsters and 1 of your banished Level 6 or lower Fish monsters; banish both that opponent's monster and this card, and if you do, Special Summon your targeted monster. During the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card was banished: You can Special Summon this banished card. You can only use each effect of "Keaf, Murk of the Ghoti" once per turn.

65261b850ed352275cee08b5.name: Psiics, Moonlight of the Ghoti
65261b850ed352275cee08b5.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Fish monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Psiics, Moonlight of the Ghoti", then banish 1 Fish monster from your hand or face-up field. If this card is banished: You can banish 1 Fish monster from your hand, GY, or face-up field, except "Psiics, Moonlight of the Ghoti"; Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Psiics, Moonlight of the Ghoti" once per turn.

6526934cba5e2bb90529be48.name: Fish Lamp
6526934cba5e2bb90529be48.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can Special Summon 2 "Lamp Tokens" (Fish/FIRE/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 0), also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fish monsters. If you control a Fish Synchro Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Fish Lamp" once per turn.

65279f53ae36cab22bfcbf0c.name: R-Genex Turing
65279f53ae36cab22bfcbf0c.description: During your opponent's Main Phase, if you control a "Genex" monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 "Genex" Synchro Monster. You can only use this effect of "R-Genex Turing" once per turn. This card on the field can be treated as a Level 1 or 3 monster when used for a Synchro Summon of a "Genex" Synchro Monster.

65279f72ae36cab22bfcc3df.name: R-Genex Undine
65279f72ae36cab22bfcc3df.description: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Genex" monster from your GY; this card gains that monster's Attribute, then if you banished a Tuner to activate this effect, you can treat this card as a Tuner until the end of this turn. If you control a "Genex" Synchro Monster: You can target 2 "Genex" monsters in your GY, including this card; add them to your hand, also for the rest of this turn, any card sent to your GY is banished instead.

65279f98ae36cab22bfcc9f5.name: Repair Genex Controller
65279f98ae36cab22bfcc9f5.description:
1 Level 4 or lower "Genex" monster
You can only Special Summon "Repair Genex Controller(s)" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Genex" monster from your GY to your hand. Once per Chain, if a "Genex" monster(s) is added to your hand, except by drawing it, you can (except during the Damage Step): Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Genex" monster, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Summon using a "Genex" Tuner as material.

65279fc0ae36cab22bfccf64.name: Arms of Genex Return Zero
65279fc0ae36cab22bfccf64.description:
1 DARK Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 monster from your GY with the same Attribute; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster. (You can only banish each Attribute once per turn to activate this effect of "Arms of Genex Return Zero".) Once per turn: You can target up to 6 of your "Genex" monsters with different Attributes that are banished and/or in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, then you can destroy up to that many cards in the Spell & Trap Zones.

652907c487d485449c4c5199.name: Shining Star Dragon
652907c487d485449c4c5199.description: During your opponent's Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Dragon Synchro Monster in your GY; Special Summon this card, and if you do, Special Summon the targeted monster (but its effects are negated), then, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Dragon Synchro Monster using this card you control. You can only use this effect of "Shining Star Dragon" once per turn. A Dragon monster that was Synchro Summoned using this card as material cannot be destroyed by battle.

652907dc87d485449c4c5535.name: Winged Kuriboh LV6
652907dc87d485449c4c5535.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Elemental HERO" and "Favorite" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by banishing 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster or 1 "Winged Kuriboh" from your hand, face-up field, or GY. You can only Special Summon "Winged Kuriboh LV6" once per turn this way. When an opponent's monster declares an attack, or when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; destroy that monster, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its original ATK.

652a89ad9115c0cc98ed9884.name: Sorcerer of Sebek
652a89ad9115c0cc98ed9884.description:
2 Effect Monsters
When this card or your monster this card points to inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can gain that much LP. If a player gains LP, even during the Damage Step: You can make each player take 1000 damage. You can only use each effect of "Sorcerer of Sebek" once per turn.

652be04545c15212bf9d1283.name: Ages of Stars and Frost
652be04545c15212bf9d1283.description: If a monster(s) you control was destroyed by your Spell effect or your opponent's card effect and sent to the GY this turn: You can conduct your next Battle Phase twice. If a monster you control is shuffled into the Deck or returned to the Extra Deck face-down, while this card is in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ages of Stars and Frost" once per turn.

652fcfec6dd9a84bf7678315.name: EM:P Meowmine
652fcfec6dd9a84bf7678315.description: If a Link Monster is on the field or in either GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "EM:P Meowmine" once per turn this way. If a Link-2 monster you control is sent to the GY or banished face-up (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your GY (if it was there when the monster was sent or banished) or hand (even if not), then target 1 card your opponent controls; return it to the hand. You can only use this effect of "EM:P Meowmine" once per turn.

6531210f9d3d3a9ae1aef724.name: Enigmaster Packbit
6531210f9d3d3a9ae1aef724.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned, or sent to the GY: You can target 1 monster in your GY, or 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; discard 1 card, and if you do, place that monster in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. During either player's turn, if this card is a Continuous Trap: You can Special Summon 1 face-up Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use each effect of "Enigmaster Packbit" once per turn.

65326f6fa9f75e2d83594c64.name: Master of Ham
65326f6fa9f75e2d83594c64.description:
2 Beast monsters
If this card is Fusion Summoned or flipped face-up: You can Special Summon 1 Flip monster from your hand or Deck in face-down Defense Position. If this card is in your GY: You can banish 2 Flip monsters from your face-up field and/or GY; Special Summon this card in face-down Defense Position, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Master of Ham" once per turn.

6533c5b2bf2fc97c659821b4.name: Iron Thunder
6533c5b2bf2fc97c659821b4.description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated on the field: Pay half your LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, then destroy any other cards in the same column the destroyed card was in, that are in the Monster Zones or Spell & Trap Zones.

65352245aba3e293f639c14a.name: Earthbound Fusion
65352245aba3e293f639c14a.description: You can only activate this card during the Main Phase, unless a card is in a Field Zone. Fusion Summon 1 DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. During your Main Phase, if a card is in a Field Zone: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Earthbound" monster from your hand or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion or Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Earthbound Fusion" once per turn.

65366d3d91945421f672a654.name: Aromalilith Rosalina
65366d3d91945421f672a654.description: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then target 1 "Aroma" monster you control; gain LP equal to half its ATK. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 non-Tuner "Aroma" monster from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Plant monsters. You can only use each effect of "Aromalilith Rosalina" once per turn.

65366d5891945421f672aa8a.name: Aromalilith Magnolia
65366d5891945421f672aa8a.description:
1 "Aroma" monster + 1 Plant monster
While your LP are higher than your opponent's, Plant monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn: You can pay 2000 LP; banish cards on the field equal to the number of "Humid Winds", "Dried Winds", and "Blessed Winds" you control. Once per turn, if you gain LP, even during the Damage Step: You can make all Plant monsters you currently control gain ATK equal to the LP gained, until the end of this turn.

65366d7791945421f672aece.name: Aromalilith Rosemary
65366d7791945421f672aece.description:
2+ Plant monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Aroma" card from your Deck to your hand. If you gain LP, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon up to 3 "Aroma" monsters from your hand to your zones this card points to. You can Tribute 1 monster this card points to, then target 1 card on the field; banish it, and if you do, gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "Aromalilith Rosemary" once per turn.

65366d9691945421f672b245.name: Promethean Princess, Bestower of Flames
65366d9691945421f672b245.description:
2+ Effect Monsters
You cannot Special Summon, except FIRE monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "Promethean Princess, Bestower of Flames" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster from your GY. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 FIRE monster you control and 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy them, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

65366da691945421f672b561.name: Aroma Blend
65366da691945421f672b561.description: Discard 1 card; place 1 "Humid Winds", "Dried Winds", or "Blessed Winds" from your hand or Deck, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 Plant Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing its materials from your hand or field. If your LP are higher than your opponent's, you can also banish Plant monsters from your GY as material. You can only use each effect of "Aroma Blend" once per turn.

65366db391945421f672b6e8.name: Aroma Healing
65366db391945421f672b6e8.description: Gain 1000 LP for each "Aroma" monster you control with a different name. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Aroma" monster in your GY; Special Summon it (but banish it when it leaves the field), then gain 500 LP. You can only use 1 "Aroma Healing" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6536779869cbb6ad91b2f5ae.name: Raidraptor - Noir Lanius
6536779869cbb6ad91b2f5ae.description: During your Main Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 "Raidraptor" monster you control; add 1 "Raidraptor" monster with a different Level than that monster from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; increase or decrease the Levels of all "Raidraptor" monsters you currently control by 1. You can only use each effect of "Raidraptor - Noir Lanius" once per turn.

653677ab69cbb6ad91b2f81a.name: Raidraptor - Bloom Vulture
653677ab69cbb6ad91b2f81a.description: If you do not control any face-up monsters, other than Winged Beast monsters: You can Special Summon both this card and 1 "Raidraptor" monster from your hand. If you control no monsters: You can target 2 Level 4 or lower "Raidraptor" monsters in your GY, including this card; Special Summon them in Defense Position. You can only use 1 "Raidraptor - Bloom Vulture" effect per turn, and only once that turn, also you cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate either of these effects, except DARK monsters.

653677d669cbb6ad91b2fd30.name: Raidraptor - Rising Rebellion Falcon
653677d669cbb6ad91b2fd30.description:
5 Level 13 Winged Beast monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can destroy as many cards your opponent controls as possible, then if this card has 3 or more "Raidraptor" Xyz Monsters with different names as material, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of the destroyed monsters. Once per turn: You can detach 3 materials from this card, then target 1 "Raidraptor" Xyz Monster in your GY; this card gains that monster's effects until the End Phase.

653677f569cbb6ad91b300ab.name: Raidraptor - Brave Strix
653677f569cbb6ad91b300ab.description:
2 Level 5 monsters
A "Raidraptor" Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains this effect.
● This card gains ATK equal to its Rank x 100.
You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Raidraptor - Brave Strix" per turn, and only once that turn. You can detach 1 material from this card; Set 1 "Raidraptor" Spell/Trap from your Deck. If this card has a Winged Beast monster as material: You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your Deck to your hand.

6536780869cbb6ad91b30342.name: Rise Rank-Up-Magic Raidraptor's Force
6536780869cbb6ad91b30342.description: During the Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase: Target 2 or more "Raidraptor" Xyz Monsters you control and/or in your GY, including a monster on the field; if at least 2 remain face-up at resolution, Special Summon 1 "Raidraptor" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck with a Rank equal to their combined Ranks, and if you do, attach the targeted monsters to it as material. (This is treated as an Xyz Summon. Transfer their materials to the Summoned monster.) You can only activate 1 "Rise Rank-Up-Magic Raidraptor's Force" per turn.

6536781369cbb6ad91b304e2.name: Raidraptor - Roost
6536781369cbb6ad91b304e2.description: If a "Raidraptor" monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Raidraptor" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Raidraptor - Roost". You can target 3 of your "Raidraptor" monsters that are banished and/or in your GY; place them on the bottom of your Deck in any order, then draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Raidraptor - Roost" once per turn.

6536782169cbb6ad91b306cb.name: Raidraptor - Glorious Bright
6536782169cbb6ad91b306cb.description: If you control a "Raidraptor" monster: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, or if you control a "Raidraptor" Xyz Monster, you can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate that card's effects until the end of this turn. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 of your "Raidraptor" monsters that is banished or in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use 1 "Raidraptor - Glorious Bright" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6537b824e0c850f938445ef4.name: Terrors of the Afterroot
6537b824e0c850f938445ef4.description: Target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your opponent's field, then you can banish 1 monster your opponent controls, then if your opponent has a banished monster(s), return 1 of them to the GY. You can banish this card from your GY, except the turn it was sent there, then target 1 Level 1 monster in your GY; shuffle that monster into the Deck, then you can Set 1 "Terrors of the Underroot", "Terrors of the Overroot", or "Terrors of the Afterroot" from your Deck.

65390ac06fd86fb09fc9febb.name: Carnot the Eternal Machine
65390ac06fd86fb09fc9febb.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) during a Duel in which your opponent has activated a monster effect in their hand or GY. You can only Special Summon "Carnot the Eternal Machine" once per turn. Once per turn, if your opponent activates a monster effect (except during the Damage Step): You can make this card gain 1000 ATK. If this card is sent to the GY, except from the hand or Deck: Shuffle this card into the Deck.

653b5dba19e768dc76224315.name: Materialization
653b5dba19e768dc76224315.description:
Target 1 face-up Monster Card in any Spell & Trap Zone, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon it to its owner's field.
● Return it to the hand.
● Destroy it, then you can destroy 1 monster on the field with an equal or lower Level.
You can only activate 1 "Materialization" per turn.

653b5ddd6cce462b77c278d0.name: Jongleur-Ghoul Illusionist
653b5ddd6cce462b77c278d0.description: A captivating street performer, who'll catch you off guard with his song and dance and hocus pocus attacks. Once his eyes start spinning, danger is impending, so make a run for it!

653b5df66cce462b77c279e6.name: Royal Rhino with Deceitful Dice
653b5df66cce462b77c279e6.description:
Once per turn, when a card or effect is activated, even during the Damage Step (Quick Effect): You can roll a six-sided die, then apply the appropriate effect, depending on the Chain Link number of this effect.
● 2: This card gains ATK equal to the result x 500 until the end of this turn.
● 3: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the result x 250.
● 4+: Destroy cards on the field up to the result.

653b5e076cce462b77c27a6d.name: Principug
653b5e076cce462b77c27a6d.description:
You can target 1 monster you control with "Guardian" in its original name, that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Guardian" monster in your GY that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, and activate 1 of these effects;
● Add it to your hand.
● Add 1 other card that is mentioned on that monster from your GY to your hand.
You can only use each effect of "Principug" once per turn.

653b5e276cce462b77c27b10.name: Procession of the Tea Jar
653b5e276cce462b77c27b10.description: Face-down Defense Position monsters in this card's column cannot change their battle positions, also neither player can activate the Set cards in the Spell & Trap Zones in this card's column. You can only use each of the following effects of "Procession of the Tea Jar" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can move this card to an unused adjacent Main Monster Zone. If this card in the Monster Zone moves to another Monster Zone: Change all other monsters in this card's current column to face-down Defense Position.

653b5e416cce462b77c27bbc.name: Mokomoko
653b5e416cce462b77c27bbc.description:
FLIP: Draw 1 card.
During your Main Phase: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.
You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Mokomoko" once per turn. If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle.

653b5e586cce462b77c27c45.name: Emissary from the House of Wax
653b5e586cce462b77c27c45.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Emissary from the House of Wax" once per turn. If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. At the end of your opponent's Battle Phase: You can activate this effect; until the start of your opponent's next Battle Phase, all Attack Position monsters your opponent currently controls cannot change their battle positions, nor be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon, also their effects are negated.

653b5e766cce462b77c27d0c.name: E Stranger Big Bang
653b5e766cce462b77c27d0c.description: If a monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your Main Phase: You can reduce the Levels of all other monsters on the field by 1, and if you do, increase the Level of this card by the number of monsters whose Levels were reduced by this effect. During your Battle Phase or your opponent's Main Phase, if this card's Level is 8 or higher (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 other card on the field, and if you do, this card's Level becomes 5. You can only use each effect of "E Stranger Big Bang" once per turn.

653b5e8c6cce462b77c27da5.name: Berserk Archfiend
653b5e8c6cce462b77c27da5.description: You can target up to 2 face-up monsters you control, including a Fiend monster; Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, destroy those monsters. You can only use this effect of "Berserk Archfiend" once per turn. When a monster(s) is destroyed by this card's effect: You can target face-up monsters your opponent controls equal to the number destroyed; this card gains ATK equal to their combined original ATK, until the end of your next turn.

653b5ea76cce462b77c27e91.name: Time Reloader
653b5ea76cce462b77c27e91.description: During the Main Phase, if a monster on the field is flipped face-up: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then change 1 face-up monster on the field to face-down Defense Position. During the Main Phase, if this card is flipped face-up: You can target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, then change 1 face-up monster on the field to face-down Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Time Reloader" once per turn.

653b5ecb6cce462b77c28008.name: Flock Together
653b5ecb6cce462b77c28008.description: Place 1 monster from your Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can banish this card from your GY; place 1 monster from your Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. You can only use 1 "Flock Together" effect per turn, and only once that turn. The total number of cards in the Monster Zones and face-up Monster Cards in the Spell & Trap Zones must be 10 or more to activate either of this card's effects.

653b613b7794b8fad40562ff.name: Vagnawa the Moon-Eating Dragon
653b613b7794b8fad40562ff.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can activate this effect; this card gains 300 ATK for each Level that the non-Tuners used had, then inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each Level that the Tuner used had. The ATK increase lasts until the end of the next turn. You can only use this effect of "Vagnawa the Moon-Eating Dragon" once per turn.

654636f697b5996cf169a032.name: Void Imagination
654636f697b5996cf169a032.description: "Infernoid" monsters you control whose original Levels are 2 or higher become Level 1 and all battle damage they inflict to your opponent is halved. You can send this card to the GY; Fusion Summon 1 "Infernoid" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. If your opponent controls a monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, and you do not, you can also use up to 6 monsters in your Deck as Fusion Materials.

6549b1f07bcae3b727c09bd1.name: Surgical Striker - S.P.E.C.T.R.A.
6549b1f07bcae3b727c09bd1.description:
2+ monsters, including a Link Monster
(This card is always treated as a "Sky Striker Ace" card.)
Must first be Link Summoned. Loses 3000 ATK while you have no Spells in your GY. When your opponent activates a card or effect as Chain Link 2 or higher (Quick Effect): You can banish 2 Spells from your hand and/or GY; negate that effect, then you can destroy 1 card your opponent controls. You can only use this effect of "Surgical Striker - S.P.E.C.T.R.A." once per turn.

654b86576753c13029c07560.name: Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara
654b86576753c13029c07560.description: You can only Special Summon "Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara(s)" once per turn. You can discard this card; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Ritual Beast" monster from your hand. If a "Ritual Beast" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your field or GY instead. If this card is banished: You can Special Summon 1 "Ritual Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara". You can only use each effect of "Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara" once per turn.

654b867d6753c13029c0790c.name: Ritual Beast Ulti-Nochiudrago
654b867d6753c13029c0790c.description:
1 "Ritual Beast Tamer" monster + 1 "Spiritual Beast" monster
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards from your field and/or GY. You can only Special Summon "Ritual Beast Ulti-Nochiudrago(s)" once per turn. Your opponent cannot target other "Ritual Beast" monsters you control with card effects. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, then target 1 of your banished "Ritual Beast" monsters; Special Summon it, but it cannot attack directly.

654b86c55e1c7aa3ddc3af65.name: Ritual Beast Ulti-Reirautari
654b86c55e1c7aa3ddc3af65.description:
3+ Effect Monsters
Neither player can Tribute cards to activate a card or effect. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ritual Beast Ulti-Reirautari" once per turn. You can target 1 of your banished "Ritual Beast" cards; return it to the hand or Extra Deck, then, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 "Ritual Beast" monster from your hand. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Ritual Beast" card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; banish them.

654b86d95e1c7aa3ddc3b491.name: Ritual Beast Inheritance
654b86d95e1c7aa3ddc3b491.description: Monsters your opponent controls lose 200 ATK for each different Type among the "Ritual Beast" monsters you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ritual Beast Inheritance" once per turn. You can reveal 1 "Ritual Beast" monster in your hand; add 1 "Ritual Beast" monster with a different Type from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. If 2 or more monsters are Special Summoned to your field at the same time (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 monster on the field; change its battle position.

654b87e55bc58545b0defe6a.name: Medallion of the Ice Barrier
654b87e55bc58545b0defe6a.description: Add 1 "Ice Barrier" monster from your Deck to your hand.

654c937abe69366e0c13a929.name: Supreme King Z-ARC - Synchro Universe
654c937abe69366e0c13a929.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You can Tribute 1 "Supreme King Dragon" or "Supreme King Gate" Pendulum Monster; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Supreme King Z-ARC - Synchro Universe" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner DARK Pendulum Monsters
This card's name becomes "Supreme King Z-ARC" while on the field. After damage calculation, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle, OR when this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can Special Summon up to 2 "Supreme King Dragon" monsters from your Deck, Extra Deck, and/or GY in Defense Position. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

654c9392be69366e0c13aabf.name: Code of Soul
654c9392be69366e0c13aabf.description: If you control a Link Monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect; once this turn, if you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 Link-3 or higher Cyberse Link Monster. You can only use each effect of "Code of Soul" once per turn.

654dfec8db1d232b9fbb9232.name: Stronghold the Hidden Fortress
654dfec8db1d232b9fbb9232.description:
Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 0/DEF 2000) with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap).
● Gains 1000 ATK for each "Shining Sarcophagus", and monster that mentions it, that you control.
● Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares an attack, while you control "Shining Sarcophagus": You can destroy that monster.

654dfedcdb1d232b9fbb9410.name: Future Silence
654dfedcdb1d232b9fbb9410.description: Add 1 monster that mentions "Shining Sarcophagus" from your Deck to your hand, then, if you activated this card during the Battle Phase while you controlled "Shining Sarcophagus" and a monster that mentions it, each player draws until they have 6 cards in their hand. You can only activate 1 "Future Silence" per turn.

654dfef0db1d232b9fbb966b.name: Ties That Bind
654dfef0db1d232b9fbb966b.description: If you control "Shining Sarcophagus" and a monster that mentions it: Special Summon up to 2 Level 4 or lower monsters with different names that mention "Shining Sarcophagus" from your hand and/or Deck, also, for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck. You can only activate 1 "Ties That Bind" per turn.

654dff06db1d232b9fbb98df.name: Turn Silence
654dff06db1d232b9fbb98df.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; increase its Level by 3, also if you activated this card in response to your opponent's monster effect activation, while you control "Shining Sarcophagus" and a monster that mentions it, negate that opponent's effect. During damage calculation, if your monster that mentions "Shining Sarcophagus" battles: You can banish this card from your GY; end the Battle Phase. You can only activate 1 "Turn Silence" per turn.

654dff19db1d232b9fbb9aa8.name: Shining Sarcophagus
654dff19db1d232b9fbb9aa8.description: Cannot be destroyed by monster effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Shining Sarcophagus" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 card that mentions "Shining Sarcophagus" from your Deck to your hand, except "Shining Sarcophagus". If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) from the GY (except during the Damage Step): You can discard 1 Spell, then target 1 of those monsters; send it to the GY.

654dff3bdb1d232b9fbb9e6d.name: Moremarshmallon
654dff3bdb1d232b9fbb9e6d.description: While you control "Shining Sarcophagus", this card cannot be destroyed by battle, also your opponent's monsters cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one. You can only use each of the following effects of "Moremarshmallon" once per turn. During your opponent's turn, if you control "Shining Sarcophagus" (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Moremarshmallon" from your hand, Deck, GY, or banishment, except this card, and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

654dff5cdb1d232b9fbba24a.name: Gadget Trio
654dff5cdb1d232b9fbba24a.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Shining Sarcophagus" or 1 Spell/Trap that mentions it from your Deck to your hand. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Set 1 "Stronghold the Hidden Fortress" from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Gadget Trio" once per turn.

654dff78db1d232b9fbba57f.name: Silent Magician Zero
654dff78db1d232b9fbba57f.description: If your opponent draws a card(s): Increase this card's Level by the number drawn. While this card's Level is higher than its original Level, it gains ATK equal to the difference x 500. When your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect, while you control "Shining Sarcophagus" (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, increase this card's Level by 1. You can only use this effect of "Silent Magician Zero" once per turn.

654dff8cdb1d232b9fbba7af.name: Silent Swordsman Zero
654dff8cdb1d232b9fbba7af.description: Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: Increase this card's Level by 1. While this card's Level is higher than its original Level, it gains ATK equal to the difference x 500. When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets "Shining Sarcophagus", or a monster(s) that mentions it, that you control (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, increase this card's Level by 1. You can only use this effect of "Silent Swordsman Zero" once per turn.

654dffad66c45099c7d287f1.name: Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction
654dffad66c45099c7d287f1.description: Gains 300 ATK for each banished card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction" once per turn. If you control "Shining Sarcophagus": You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can pay half your LP; destroy as many other cards on the field as possible, and if you do, banish them, then Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower monster that mentions "Shining Sarcophagus" from your Deck, and increase its Level by the number of cards destroyed by this effect.

654e0e55804cc2cbbe3bb877.name: Mira Match
654e0e55804cc2cbbe3bb877.description: If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 3 cards with different names from your hand and/or Deck that match the names of 3 different cards in your opponent's GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send this card Summoned by its previous effect to the GY; send 1 card with the same name as that opponent's card from your Deck or Extra Deck to the GY, and if you do, negate the activation. You can only use each effect of "Mira Match" once per turn.

654e0e75804cc2cbbe3bbbe6.name: Ace★Spades Speculation
654e0e75804cc2cbbe3bbbe6.description:
1 monster with 2500 or more ATK + 1 face-down Defense Position monster with 2500 or less DEF
You can only Special Summon "Ace★Spades Speculation(s)" once per turn. You can Tribute 1 Attack Position monster and 1 face-down Defense Position monster; Special Summon this card from your GY. This card gains the following effect based on its battle position.
● Attack Position: Gains ATK equal to the highest original ATK among monsters your opponent controls (your choice, if tied).
● Defense Position: Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

6554b6c5586ccf7d3c589f44.name: Genex Ally Birdman
6554b6c5586ccf7d3c589f44.description: You can return 1 face-up monster you control to the hand; Special Summon this card from your hand, but banish it when it leaves the field, also it gains 500 ATK if the returned monster was WIND on the field.

655727c4ebce34749aca045d.name: Combined Maneuver - Engage Zero!
655727c4ebce34749aca045d.description:
2 LIGHT and/or DARK monsters
(This card is always treated as a "Sky Striker Ace" card.)
You can only Special Summon "Combined Maneuver - Engage Zero!(s)" once per turn. Cannot be used as Link Material. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster on the field with 2500 or more ATK; negate its effects until the end of this turn. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks, while you have "Sky Striker Ace - Raye" and "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" in your GY: You can destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

655727ed8e692d8e1ffd8c7d.name: Sky Striker Ace - Azalea Temperance
655727ed8e692d8e1ffd8c7d.description:
2+ monsters, including a Link Monster
Must first be Link Summoned. If this card is Special Summoned: You can banish 1 Spell from your hand or GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls with 2500 or less ATK; equip that face-up monster to this card as an Equip Spell. You can only use this effect of "Sky Striker Ace - Azalea Temperance" once per turn. When this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 other "Sky Striker" monster from your hand or GY.

655728058e692d8e1ffd8ee8.name: Pillar of the Future - Cyanos
655728058e692d8e1ffd8ee8.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Sky Striker" card.)
You can discard 1 Spell; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" from your Deck or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Machine monsters. You can banish this card from your GY; take 1 of your "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" that is banished or in your GY, and either add it to your hand or Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Pillar of the Future - Cyanos" once per turn.

6558825cb84ac6e1684c8637.name: Sky Striker Ace - Roze
6558825cb84ac6e1684c8637.description: If a "Sky Striker Ace" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned, except "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If an opponent's monster in the Extra Monster Zone is destroyed by battle, or leaves the field by your card effect, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, then you can negate the effects of 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" once per turn.

655bc125cd1fd1d01835299f.name: Royal Rebel's Beginitar
655bc125cd1fd1d01835299f.description: A guitar fiend that works hard every day to get everyone to hear its songs.

655bc145cd1fd1d018352af0.name: Royal Rebel's Babybass
655bc145cd1fd1d018352af0.description: A bass fiend that coolly supports Beginitar and Kidrum.

655bc15fcd1fd1d018352be0.name: Royal Rebel's Kidrum
655bc15fcd1fd1d018352be0.description: A drum fiend that started a band because it admired the greater Royal Rebels.

655c762535edce8b14df9034.name: Arbitration of White
655c762535edce8b14df9034.description: You can target 1 Fish monster you control; it is treated as a Tuner this turn. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can discard 1 Fish monster; change all monsters your opponent controls to Defense Position. If your Fish monster is destroyed by battle or sent to your GY: You can send this face-up card from your Spell & Trap Zone to the GY; Special Summon 1 Fish monster from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Arbitration of White" once per turn.

655c763e35edce8b14df9251.name: White Circle Reef
655c763e35edce8b14df9251.description: Target 1 Fish monster you control; destroy that Fish monster, and if you do, add 1 monster with the same name it had on the field from your Deck to your hand, or, if you controlled a Fish Synchro Monster when you activated this card, you can Special Summon it instead. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 2 Fish monsters with the same name in your GY; place 1 of the 2 on the bottom of your Deck, and if you do, Special Summon the other. You can only use each effect of "White Circle Reef" once per turn.

655c767535edce8b14df967d.name: Ebon Sun
655c767535edce8b14df967d.description: If a face-up monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can gain LP equal to their combined original ATK. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned face-up from your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; it gains 1000 ATK. If a Spell/Trap(s) is discarded from your hand to your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Ebon Sun" once per turn.

655c769335edce8b14df9883.name: Toy Box

655c76ba35edce8b14df9b9b.name: Red Lotus King, Flame Crime
655c76ba35edce8b14df9b9b.description: During the Main Phase, if you control a Fiend Tuner, or your opponent controls a Special Summoned monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each FIRE monster you control with different names. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can send 1 Normal Trap from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Red Lotus King, Flame Crime" once per turn.

655c76e335edce8b14df9ee7.name: Toy Tank
655c76e335edce8b14df9ee7.description: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell. You can only use each of the following effects of "Toy Tank" once per turn. If this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this monster; Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower monster from your hand, or, if you control "Toy Box", you can Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower monster from your GY instead, except "Toy Tank".

655c770135edce8b14dfa190.name: Toy Soldier
655c770135edce8b14dfa190.description: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell. You can only use each of the following effects of "Toy Soldier" once per turn. If this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Toy Box" from your Deck to your hand, or, if you control "Toy Box", you can add 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster instead.

655ca1e2fde92ee00249c360.name: Surging-Wave Swordsman Yoshimitsu Shark
655ca1e2fde92ee00249c360.description: A legendary samurai merman who received the divine blessing of the Surging-Wave Sword. There is none that can see the sword fights that take place in the ocean depths.

655ca2b86c7bfba0566ff897.name: Darkness Dwarf
655ca2b86c7bfba0566ff897.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other face-up Galaxy Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a DARK Attribute monster by sending face-up monsters from your field to the Graveyard as material, including this card.

655ca32c2dcf9f5534b9879c.name: Darkness Transamu Craisis
655ca32c2dcf9f5534b9879c.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 3 monsters with the same Attribute.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card the above way.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, you can make this card gain ATK equal to [the original Level of the monster destroyed by this effect] x 200 until the end of this turn.

655ca3a76c7bfba0567002ad.name: Celeb Rose Wiz
655ca3a76c7bfba0567002ad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, reveal 1 LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster or 1 Equip Spell Card in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Celeb Rose Magician"/"Celeb Rose Witch"/"Fusion" from among the cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect to your hand.

655ca4219277a5847a017eb0.name: Darkness Paparazzi
655ca4219277a5847a017eb0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck and have a face-up Level 5 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field, shuffle 3 Spellcaster Type monsters with the same Attribute from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Draw cards equal to [the number of face-up Level 7 or higher monsters on your opponent's field].

655ca494fde92ee00249e054.name: Darkness Phantomyte
655ca494fde92ee00249e054.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Wyrm Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change 1 face-up Level 9 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, your opponent excavates the top 3 cards of their Deck. Your opponent places the excavated cards on the top of their Deck in any order.

655ca51f2dcf9f5534b99af2.name: Footsoldier of Demolition
655ca51f2dcf9f5534b99af2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or less monsters on your field.
[EFFECT] Send cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard equal to [the number of face-up Wyrm Type monsters on your field] x 2. Then, if 2 or more monsters are among the cards sent, this turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Wyrm Type monster in Attack Position.

655caf17e7cb5faf9bf388a3.name: Fiddlebadour
655caf17e7cb5faf9bf388a3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 WIND Attribute Psychic Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Psyquip Fusion" or 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

655caf712dcf9f5534b9f4f6.name: Vibra Brigand
655caf712dcf9f5534b9f4f6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on their field.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if an Equip Spell Card(s) is among the cards sent, you can draw 1 card.

655cafa12dcf9f5534b9f676.name: Plandolin
655cafa12dcf9f5534b9f676.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 100 LP.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can add up to 2 excavated "Fusion" and/or "Psyquip Fusion" to your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into the Deck.

655cafecbbe3ca551e80136f.name: Star's Hand Camera Lady
655cafecbbe3ca551e80136f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal Summoned or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have "Esperade the Smashing Superstar" face-up on your field, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

655cb05ebbe3ca551e8017ea.name: Surging-Wave Swordsman Tanegashima Tuna
655cb05ebbe3ca551e8017ea.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Level 7 Fish Type monster/"Fusion"/"Wave Fusion" in your Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 7 Fish Type monster/"Fusion"/"Wave Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

655cb0f82dcf9f5534ba00ce.name: Hydro Gun Mini Bluefin
655cb0f82dcf9f5534ba00ce.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the total Levels of the face-up Fish Type monsters on your field] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, you can take 1 "Hydro Cannon Big Bluefin" from your Graveyard, and either add it to your hand or Special Summon it face-up to your field.

655cb1220b83626b78c5a592.name: Charge Remora
655cb1220b83626b78c5a592.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Fish Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Fish Depth Charge" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

655cb14c0b83626b78c5a63c.name: Carrier Manta Ray
655cb14c0b83626b78c5a63c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Charge Remora" or 1 "Fish Depth Charge" from among the cards sent to the Graveyard by this effect to your hand.

655cb1790b83626b78c5a6aa.name: Cyber Fish
655cb1790b83626b78c5a6aa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 WATER Attribute Fish Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card.

655cb1a5e7cb5faf9bf39f46.name: Cyber Shark
655cb1a5e7cb5faf9bf39f46.description:
If you have a face-up WATER Attribute monster on your field, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] None

655cb1d2fde92ee0024a5c90.name: Surging-Wave Swordsman Onimaru Kunituna
655cb1d2fde92ee0024a5c90.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Face-up Fish Type monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

655cb207fde92ee0024a5e46.name: Infernal Kappa River Sprinter
655cb207fde92ee0024a5e46.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 "Kappa Emperor River Slider"/"Infernal Kappa Diwet"/"Kappa's Gas" from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, if you have 3 or more Aqua Type monsters in your Graveyard, you can draw 1 card.

655cb2579277a5847a01ff4c.name: Meteor Dragon's Chick
655cb2579277a5847a01ff4c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 EARTH Attribute Dragon Type monster with 1800 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.

655cb2c6fde92ee0024a6302.name: Red-Eyes Moon Dragon
655cb2c6fde92ee0024a6302.description:
This card's name becomes "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" while in the hand.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] If used as material for a Fusion Summon, this card's name becomes "Red-Eyes Black Dragon".

655cb307fde92ee0024a64ba.name: Alligator's Black Knight
655cb307fde92ee0024a64ba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Alligator's Sword" or a DARK Attribute monster with 1200 DEF in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Change 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

655cb33afde92ee0024a6607.name: Rocket Medic
655cb33afde92ee0024a6607.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Meteor Dragon" or 1 "Meteor Flare Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

655cb37282acbcd02bd520bc.name: Meteor Drake
655cb37282acbcd02bd520bc.description:
If you have no monsters on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated "Meteor Dragon" or 1 excavated "Meteor Flare Fusion" to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

655cb6fe2dcf9f5534ba2c2b.name: Planting Pixie
655cb6fe2dcf9f5534ba2c2b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] 2 or more face-up monsters with the same Attribute are on the field.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 6 or lower Normal Monster or 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can Special Summon 1 EARTH Attribute Plant Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

655cb751852b1a4043368294.name: Pure Love Angel
655cb751852b1a4043368294.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster with 2500 or more ATK. If this card battles a Level 9 or lower monster, you take no battle damage.

655cb7aa6c7bfba05670c0b7.name: Dark Effigy
655cb7aa6c7bfba05670c0b7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK Attribute Normal Monster in Attack Position.

655cb82f852b1a4043368b69.name: Dead End the Mad Fiend of Despair
655cb82f852b1a4043368b69.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you have 6 or more monsters with the same Attribute in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower monster from your opponent's Graveyard face-up to your field.

655cb87e2dcf9f5534ba36a3.name: Glacies the Snowmeister of Sacred Splendor
655cb87e2dcf9f5534ba36a3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 6 other cards from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and its Level is increased by 1. Then, you can shuffle up to 1 face-down card from your opponent's field into the owner's Deck for every 3 cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement.

655cb8c42dcf9f5534ba382d.name: Darkness Doom Giant
655cb8c42dcf9f5534ba382d.description:
"Darkness Dwarf" + 1 LIGHT Attribute or DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 7 or 8 Galaxy Type monster or 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, this turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 or 3 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Level 8 Galaxy Type monster in Attack Position.

655cb90fe7cb5faf9bf3ddb8.name: Darkness Galactica Oblivion
655cb90fe7cb5faf9bf3ddb8.description:
"Galactica Oblivion" + "Darkness Dwarf"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] 1 face-up Effect Monster on your opponent's field with 100 or more original ATK loses ATK equal to [its original ATK] until the end of this turn. Then, you can negate its Continuous Effects until the end of this turn.

655cb95ae7cb5faf9bf3e0ec.name: Celeb Rose Gossip Witch
655cb95ae7cb5faf9bf3e0ec.description:
"Celeb Rose Witch" + "Darkness Paparazzi"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, if you have a face-up Spell Card on your field, draw 1 card.

655cb99de7cb5faf9bf3e436.name: Celeb Rose Gossip Magician
655cb99de7cb5faf9bf3e436.description:
"Celeb Rose Magician" + "Darkness Paparazzi"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of Equip Spell Cards in your Graveyard] x 400. If you have a face-up Spell Card on your field, this card cannot be destroyed by battle.

655cb9dce7cb5faf9bf3e6fe.name: Destructor Wyrm Darkness Bakhamut
655cb9dce7cb5faf9bf3e6fe.description:
"Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut" + "Darkness Phantomite"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard. If a monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can also destroy face-down cards on your opponent's field, up to [the number of monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect]. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of cards destroyed by this effect] x 500.

655cba5be7cb5faf9bf3eb53.name: Bluegrass High Stealer
655cba5be7cb5faf9bf3eb53.description:
"Bluegrass Stealer" + "Fiddlebadour"
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Spell Card on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Return 1 Spell/Trap Card from the field to the owner's hand. Then, you can add 1 "Fiddlebadour" from your Graveyard to your hand.

655cbb83ab684abe9ff1fcf1.name: Bandiva the Ballistic Battle Ballad
655cbb83ab684abe9ff1fcf1.description:
"Bandijo of the Battle Ballad" + "Fiddlebadour"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, this card gains ATK equal to [the total number of cards in both players' hands] x 500 until the end of your opponent's next turn. If you have 1 card in your hand, you can also destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

655cbbb782acbcd02bd55c64.name: Plectclive the Dynamauve Deadly Dirge
655cbbb782acbcd02bd55c64.description:
"Plectcrime of the Deadly Dirge" + "Fiddlebadour"
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal up to 2 Spell Cards in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Special Summon Level 8 or lower WIND Attribute Psychic Type monsters from your Graveyard equal to [the number of cards revealed to meet the requirement] face-up to your field.

655cbc9204ebae47bfbfbc00.name: Dark Hydro Cannon Neutron Bluefin
655cbc9204ebae47bfbfbc00.description:
"Hydro Cannon Big Bluefin" + "Surging-Wave Swordsman Tanegashima Tuna"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] If the only face-up monsters on your field are Fusion Monsters, this card can attack directly. If your opponent has a face-up Maximum Monster on their field, your opponent cannot activate monster effects.

655cbcc882acbcd02bd56414.name: Pitch-Dark Surging-Wave Swordsman Onimaru Kunituna
655cbcc882acbcd02bd56414.description:
"Surging-Wave Swordsman Onimaru Kunituna" + "Hydro Gun Mini Bluefin"
[REQUIREMENT] None
