[EFFECT] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Fiend Type monster in Attack Position. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field, increase this card's Level by 1 until the end of this turn.

663106313d7923899f24c064.name: Abysspiny Turtle
663106313d7923899f24c064.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Sea Serpent Type monster with 800 ATK/0 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. You can only attack with Sea Serpent Type monsters this turn.

663106563d7923899f24c1b4.name: Shining Shamaness
663106563d7923899f24c1b4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] 1 LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster on your field equipped with an Equip Spell Card can attack directly this turn. Then, if that monster is Level 7 or higher, it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

6631067c3d7923899f24c2cf.name: King's Greed
6631067c3d7923899f24c2cf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard, or shuffle 3 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change 1 Attack Position LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monster on your field to face-up Defense Position. Then, you can draw 2 cards.

6631069f3d7923899f24c41b.name: Magical Firestorm
6631069f3d7923899f24c41b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Destroy face-up monsters on your opponent's field whose original Level is 6 or lower, up to [the number of face-up Spellcaster Type monsters on your field].

663106c03d7923899f24c544.name: Voidvelg Morgenstein
663106c03d7923899f24c544.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-down monster on their field, equip this card to 1 face-up Level 7 or higher DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster can attack twice each turn.

663106e13d7923899f24c6a9.name: Celeb Blade - Death Wild
663106e13d7923899f24c6a9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains 400 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). If you use the equipped monster as material for a Fusion Summon while you have "Celeb Rose Witch" in your Graveyard, its name can be treated as "Celeb Rose Witch".

663107043d7923899f24c89c.name: Celeb Robe - Death Wind
663107043d7923899f24c89c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains 400 ATK, and it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. If you use the equipped monster as material for a Fusion Summon while you have "Celeb Rose Magician" in your Graveyard, its name can be treated as "Celeb Rose Magician".

663107293d7923899f24ca86.name: King's Authority
663107293d7923899f24ca86.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster during their turn.
[EFFECT] Choose face-up Level 4 or higher Effect Monsters on your opponent's field, up to [the number of face-up Level 5 or higher LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monsters on your field]. This turn, your opponent cannot activate their effects, nor Tribute them for a Tribute Summon.

663107563d7923899f24cc5d.name: Interstellive
663107563d7923899f24cc5d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck and have 2 "Interstellive" and/or "Interstellime" face-up on your field.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card.

663107a63d7923899f24cfab.name: Peace Dragon
663107a63d7923899f24cfab.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck and have 3 Spell Cards in your Graveyard, place those 3 on the bottom of your Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Each player gains 1000 LP.

663107cb3d7923899f24d165.name: Kaiser Dragon
663107cb3d7923899f24d165.description: "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1" + "Fairy Dragon"

663108786146a00257feffa0.name: Remove Trap
663108786146a00257feffa0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Look at 1 face-down card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. Then, if that card is a Trap Card, destroy it.

66399d517aae5cec0191e1ec.name: Detonating Kuriboh
66399d517aae5cec0191e1ec.description:
If a "Kuriboh" Monster Card is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can equip this card you control to that opponent's monster as an Equip Spell with the following effect.
● The equipped monster's effects are negated.
You can only use each effect of "Detonating Kuriboh" once per turn.

663af87a550e551479fb1693.name: X-Cross Cannon
663af87a550e551479fb1693.description: If you control a LIGHT Machine Fusion or Union monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your Main Phase: You can equip 1 appropriate LIGHT Machine Union monster from your Deck to this card as if it were equipped by that monster's effect, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT monsters. You can only use each effect of "X-Cross Cannon" once per turn.

663af89a550e551479fb1933.name: Y-Yare Head
663af89a550e551479fb1933.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can equip 1 Level 4 LIGHT Machine monster from your hand or GY to this card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT monsters. Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

663af8a9550e551479fb1b0d.name: Z-Zillion Tank
663af8a9550e551479fb1b0d.description: If this card is Special Summoned: You can equip 1 of your banished Level 4 LIGHT Machine monsters to this card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT monsters. Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

663af8d2550e551479fb1ee0.name: XYZ-Hyper Dragon Cannon
663af8d2550e551479fb1ee0.description:
"X-Cross Cannon" + "Y-Yare Head" + "Z-Zillion Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards from your field and/or GY. Once per opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. You can banish this card from your field or GY and reveal 1 Level 8 LIGHT Machine Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck; Special Summon up to 3 of the Fusion Materials mentioned on it from your GY and/or banishment.

663af8f57ab98780fee353f2.name: Union Controller
663af8f57ab98780fee353f2.description:
1 LIGHT Machine monster + "Y-Yare Head" or "Z-Zillion Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand that mentions "Union monster" in its text. You can only use this effect of "Union Controller" once per turn. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Machine Normal or Union monster from your hand.

663af920fcbf22d2a5c8a451.name: Union Activation
663af920fcbf22d2a5c8a451.description: Send 1 LIGHT Machine Normal or Union monster from your hand or Deck to the GY, and if you do, add 1 LIGHT Machine monster with the same ATK, but a different original name, from your Deck to your hand. If you Special Summon 3 LIGHT Machine monsters at the same time while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; add 1 monster with 3000 or more ATK from your Deck to your hand, then, immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Union Activation" once per turn.

663b75faf7fd1e18f8004288.name: Trickstar Aqua Angel
663b75faf7fd1e18f8004288.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Marincess" card.)
Link Monsters that point to this card cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Trickstar Aqua Angel" once per Duel. If you control a "Trickstar" or "Marincess" monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY. If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material: You can look at all cards in your opponent's hand and all Set cards they control.

663d98b093d013c7ff307b7f.name: Clear Wall
663d98b093d013c7ff307b7f.description: If "Clear World" is on the field: You can add 1 monster that mentions "Clear World" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Clear Wall" once per turn. Monsters that mention "Clear World" cannot be destroyed by battle, also you take no battle damage from that battle. While you control a Level 7 or higher monster that mentions "Clear World", your opponent receives all effects of "Clear World", regardless of the monster Attributes they control.

663d98d793d013c7ff3080a9.name: Clear Vicious Knight
663d98d793d013c7ff3080a9.description: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 monster that mentions "Clear World". Gains ATK equal to the highest original ATK among monsters your opponent controls (your choice, if tied). You are unaffected by the effects of "Clear World". While this Tribute Summoned card is in the Monster Zone, your opponent cannot activate the effects of Special Summoned monsters on the field with less ATK than this card.

663d98e993d013c7ff3082be.name: Clear Cube
663d98e993d013c7ff3082be.description: You are unaffected by the effects of "Clear World". During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 monster that mentions "Clear World", in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) If this face-up card in its owner's control leaves the field by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Clear World" from your Deck.

663d98fe93d013c7ff30851e.name: Clear Rage Golem
663d98fe93d013c7ff30851e.description: You are unaffected by the effects of "Clear World". If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can activate this effect; this turn, your monsters that mention "Clear World" can attack directly. You can only use this effect of "Clear Rage Golem" once per turn. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand.

663d991593d013c7ff3087cd.name: Clear Phantom
663d991593d013c7ff3087cd.description: You are unaffected by the effects of "Clear World". You can discard 2 cards, including this card; add 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, that are "Clear World" or Spells/Traps that mention it. You can only use this effect of "Clear Phantom" once per turn. If this card is destroyed: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it, and if you do, send the top 3 cards of their Deck to the GY.

6641ac368c36119a978487a9.name: The Duke of Demise
6641ac368c36119a978487a9.description:
2 Fiend and/or Zombie monsters
Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 500 LP or destroy this card. Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Duke of Demise" once per turn. During your Main Phase, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 monster. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 4 or higher Fiend or Zombie monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

6641ac7a8c36119a978490ac.name: Golden Allure Queen
6641ac7a8c36119a978490ac.description:
3 Spellcaster monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Allure Queen" monster from your Deck or GY, and if you do, this card gains 1500 ATK until the end of the next turn. You can activate the effects of your monsters with "Allure Queen" in their original names, that equip monsters to themselves, as Quick Effects. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 card on the field, also "Allure Queen" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by card effects this turn.

6641ac8f8c36119a9784932d.name: Spirit Illusion
6641ac8f8c36119a9784932d.description:
Equip only to a Level 5 or higher Fiend or Zombie monster. When an attack is declared involving the equipped monster and an opponent's monster: You can make that opponent's monster lose ATK equal to the equipped monster's ATK. You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field.
● Special Summon 1 "Doppelganger Token" (Level 5/ATK ?/DEF 0) with the equipped monster's Type, Attribute, and ATK.
You can only use this effect of "Spirit Illusion" once per turn.

6641aca48c36119a978495b4.name: Allure Palace
6641aca48c36119a978495b4.description:
Spellcaster monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF. You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY; add to your hand or Special Summon to your opponent's field, 1 "Allure Queen" monster from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Allure Palace" thrice per turn. "Allure Queen" Effect Monsters you control gain this effect.
● You can send this card equipped with a card(s) by its own effect to the GY; Special Summon 1 Spellcaster monster with 1500 or less ATK from your hand or Deck.

6641acbb8c36119a97849876.name: Allure Dance
6641acbb8c36119a97849876.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Allure Queen" monster or 1 "Allure Palace" from your Deck to your hand. Each "Allure Queen" monster you control gains ATK, equal to the ATK of the monsters equipped to it by its effect. You can send 1 other Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon as many "Allure Queen" monsters with different names as possible from your GY. You can only use this effect of "Allure Dance" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Allure Dance" per turn.

6641acd68c36119a97849b5e.name: Spirit Shield
6641acd68c36119a97849b5e.description: Once per battle, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can banish 1 Fiend or Zombie monster from your GY; negate that attack. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect that would destroy a card(s): You can banish 1 Fiend or Zombie monster from your GY; negate that activation. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if you do not control a Fiend or Zombie monster: Send this card to the GY.

6641c05f5c3ec02816bf40f2.name: Sevens Road Magician
6641c05f5c3ec02816bf40f2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of different Attributes in your Graveyard] x 300, until the end of this turn.

6641c0725c3ec02816bf41ba.name: Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar
6641c0725c3ec02816bf41ba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[Effect] All face-up monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field] x 300 until the end of this turn.

6641c0915c3ec02816bf42c3.name: Ultimate Flag Mech Gold Rush
6641c0915c3ec02816bf42c3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Machine Type Effect Monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Add 1 Machine Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if your opponent has 3 Attack Position monsters on their field, you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand face-up to your field.

6641c0c05c3ec02816bf4475.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
6641c0c05c3ec02816bf4475.description: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

6641c0d05c3ec02816bf4523.name: Sevens Road Witch
6641c0d05c3ec02816bf4523.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher, DARK Attribute, Spellcaster Type monster from your hand, face-up to your field. If you Special Summoned "Sevens Road Magician" by this effect, this card gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

6641c0f15c3ec02816bf466c.name: Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord (L)
6641c0f15c3ec02816bf466c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: If your LP are lower than your opponent's, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the difference between your LP and your opponent's LP] until the end of this turn.

6641c12a5c3ec02816bf4845.name: Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord (R)
6641c12a5c3ec02816bf4845.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the Level of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field] x 200 until the end of this turn.

6641c13d5c3ec02816bf48fa.name: Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord
6641c13d5c3ec02816bf48fa.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord [L]" and "Supreme Machine Magnum Overlord [R]".
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[Continuous Effect] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects.

6641c1694b4e87726c2dad51.name: Kuribot
6641c1694b4e87726c2dad51.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, pay 500 LP.
[Effect] Add 1 "Kuribot" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6641c7677753d6217ceb02de.name: Chaos Femtron
6641c7677753d6217ceb02de.description:
[REQUIREMENT] The only monsters in your Graveyard are Cyberse Type.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 Cyberse Type monster with 0 DEF from among the cards sent to your hand.

6641ca1e3afafa502dbbb611.name: Rising Light Angel Essel
6641ca1e3afafa502dbbb611.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not Special Summoned a monster.
[Effect] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you activated this effect during the first turn of the second player, you can Special Summon 1 monster from either Graveyard face-up to your field.

66427ea78ec9bd0955754ddc.name: Zero Drake
66427ea78ec9bd0955754ddc.description: New encounters, new adventures, a new world. A new road for the dragon whelp that turns zero into one.

66427efc8ec9bd09557550b2.name: Jespell Wizard
66427efc8ec9bd09557550b2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more Spell Cards in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Shuffle 2 Spell Cards from your Graveyard into the Deck, and this card gains 500 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn.

66427f648ec9bd09557553c8.name: Praime Dwarf
66427f648ec9bd09557553c8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard. Then, you can shuffle 3 LIGHT Attribute monsters with different Types from your Graveyard into the Deck. If you do, you can Fusion Summon 1 LIGHT Attribute monster by sending LIGHT Attribute monsters from among the face-up monsters on the field to the Graveyard as material.

66427f8c8ec9bd09557554f7.name: Praime Phantomite
66427f8c8ec9bd09557554f7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 LIGHT Attribute monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change 1 Level 7 or higher Attack Position monster on the field to face-down Defense Position. Then, each player excavates the top 3 cards of their Deck. Each player places their excavated cards on the top of their Deck in any order.

66427fc58ec9bd0955755718.name: Interspraime
66427fc58ec9bd0955755718.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are LIGHT Attribute, reveal 1 Level 7 or 8 Effect Monster in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Transamu Praime Armor Nova" or 1 "Transamu Rainac" from your Graveyard to your hand.

66427ff28ec9bd095575588d.name: Praime Claw Girl
66427ff28ec9bd095575588d.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 monster. If you do, its original ATK becomes 200.

[REQUIREMENT] Place 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 LIGHT Attribute Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

664280218ec9bd0955755a06.name: Praime Tractiger
664280218ec9bd0955755a06.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 monster. If you do, its original ATK becomes 1800.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

6642805b8ec9bd0955755bb7.name: Praime Bandijo
6642805b8ec9bd0955755bb7.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 monster. If you do, its original ATK becomes 1800.
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT Attribute Normal Monster or 1 "Praime Call" from your Graveyard to your hand, and this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

664280818ec9bd0955755cf9.name: Praime Dian Keto
664280818ec9bd0955755cf9.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 monster. If you do, its original ATK becomes 1000.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Gain 1000 LP, and this card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Praime Call" from your Graveyard to your hand.

664280ac8ec9bd0955755e34.name: Transamu Praime Armor Nova
664280ac8ec9bd0955755e34.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 or 3 monsters. If you Tributed 1 this way, its original ATK becomes 1800.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card that was Normal Summoned by Tributing 3 monsters gains ATK equal to [the total original Levels of the monsters Tributed for its Normal Summon] x 100.

664280e08ec9bd0955756034.name: Dice Angel
664280e08ec9bd0955756034.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, except "Graceful Dice".
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Graceful Dice" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field, roll a six-sided die. Gain 600 LP if you roll a number other than 6.

664281068ec9bd0955756115.name: Dice Demon
664281068ec9bd0955756115.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, except "Skull Dice".
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Skull Dice" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more monsters on their field, roll a six-sided die. Inflict 600 damage to your opponent if you roll a number other than 1.

6642814f93ef678c3f8e02d0.name: Dice Archswordsman
6642814f93ef678c3f8e02d0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die. This turn, this card can attack a number of times, up to [the result]. Then, you can draw 1 card if the result was 3 or lower.

6642817693ef678c3f8e03c5.name: Dice Archangel
6642817693ef678c3f8e03c5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die. Until the end of this turn, all face-up monsters on your field gain ATK/DEF equal to [the result] x 100, or [the result] x 200 instead if you have "Graceful Dice" in your Graveyard.

664281a093ef678c3f8e0428.name: Dice Archdemon
664281a093ef678c3f8e0428.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die. Until the end of this turn, all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK/DEF equal to [the result] x 100, or [the result] x 200 instead if you have "Skull Dice" in your Graveyard.

664281d593ef678c3f8e04d8.name: Dice Key Caramail
664281d593ef678c3f8e04d8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] While you have a face-up Level 7 or higher monster with an effect that requires a die roll on your field, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

6642820593ef678c3f8e0547.name: Dice Key Minna
6642820593ef678c3f8e0547.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up monster with an effect that requires a die roll on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] All face-up monsters on your field gain 600 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can add 1 Fairy Type monster with 300 ATK/1200 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

6642825bf3a4bc0df7a66352.name: Dicemite Girl Chirori
6642825bf3a4bc0df7a66352.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die and apply the result until the end of this turn.
● 1 or 2: This card loses 1000 ATK.
● 3 or 4: This card gains 600 ATK.
● 5 or 6: This card gains ATK equal to [the original ATK of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field].

66428285f3a4bc0df7a663b6.name: Jointech Nesstrydar Tank
66428285f3a4bc0df7a663b6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 cards from your hand into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or 8 DARK Attribute monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. If you do, until the end of this turn, you can only Special Summon "Jointech Tridynabase", and cannot activate the effects of DARK Attribute monsters.

664282aef3a4bc0df7a6643a.name: Darkness Jointech Tyrant
664282aef3a4bc0df7a6643a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated a monster effect.
[EFFECT] Add 2 Level 7 or 8 DARK Attribute monsters with different Types from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, this card's name becomes "Jointech Nesstrydar Tank" this turn.

664282dbf3a4bc0df7a664be.name: Vande the Electric Lion
664282dbf3a4bc0df7a664be.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or less monsters on your field.
[EFFECT] Send cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard equal to [the number of face-up Pyro/Aqua/Thunder Type monsters on your field] x 2.

6642830bf3a4bc0df7a66530.name: James the Steam Swallow
6642830bf3a4bc0df7a66530.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower FIRE Attribute Thunder Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can Set 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

6642835e55977ddf548f549a.name: Abysslayer Quintiamat
6642835e55977ddf548f549a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle up to 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck, including a Sea Serpent Type Maximum Monster.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, you can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. You can add up to 3 excavated Level 7 or higher Sea Serpent Type monsters to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

6642838e55977ddf548f56bc.name: Agent Misfire
6642838e55977ddf548f56bc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, pay 300 LP.
[EFFECT] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of face-up LIGHT Attribute Reptile Type monsters on your field] x 300. You can only attack with Reptile Type monsters this turn.

664283b855977ddf548f583c.name: Secret Base Guardian Misshot
664283b855977ddf548f583c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Level 3 LIGHT Attribute Reptile Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] This card gains 3000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, if you activated this effect during the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing "Elite Secret Investigator Mystery", you can destroy up to 3 face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

664283e055977ddf548f59f9.name: Sevens Fear Magician
664283e055977ddf548f59f9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Sevens Road Magician" this turn. Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of different Attributes in your Graveyard] x 300 until the end of this turn.

6642843755977ddf548f5bae.name: CAN - St:D
6642843755977ddf548f5bae.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are Omega Psychic Type and/or Psychic Type, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Return 1 face-up monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand. Then, if you have "CAN:D" in your Graveyard, gain 700 LP.

664284e8d820be3ad1a894f4.name: Jinzo #7.7
664284e8d820be3ad1a894f4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck.
[EFFECT] This card can attack directly this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Machine Inspector" or 1 "Accelerator" from your Graveyard to your hand.

66428514d820be3ad1a89597.name: Jinzo - Returner
66428514d820be3ad1a89597.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 "Jinzo" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6642854393ef678c3f8e1202.name: Jinzo the Machine Menace
6642854393ef678c3f8e1202.description:
If a player has a Trap Card in their Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 "Jinzo" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can look at all face-down cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. If you do, destroy all Trap Cards among them.

664285697195db1805d1ee65.name: Jinzo - Amplified
664285697195db1805d1ee65.description:
This card's name becomes "Jinzo" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Trap Card effects this turn. Then, you can make this card gain ATK equal to [the number of Machine Type monsters in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn.

664285937195db1805d1ef1e.name: Catapult Baby Turtle
664285937195db1805d1ef1e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Gaia the Dragon Champion" or 1 Aqua Type monster with 2000 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

664285c97195db1805d1f08f.name: Animagica Witch
664285c97195db1805d1f08f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal up to 2 Level 7 or 8 LIGHT Attribute Effect Monsters in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Draw cards equal to [the number of monsters revealed to meet the requirement]. Then, shuffle cards from your hand into the Deck equal to [the number of cards drawn by this effect].

664285fb7195db1805d1f19d.name: Obnoxious Celtic Guard
664285fb7195db1805d1f19d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or more ATK.

664286257195db1805d1f2ca.name: Snipe Hunter
664286257195db1805d1f2ca.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send any number of cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die a number of times equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement]. Destroy cards on your opponent's field, up to [the number of times you rolled a number other than 1 or 6].

664286637195db1805d1f42a.name: Golden Flying Fish
664286637195db1805d1f42a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other face-up Fish Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on the field.

664286a27195db1805d1f596.name: Mist Assailant
664286a27195db1805d1f596.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 "Fusion" and/or "Fusion Cancel" from your Graveyard to your hand.

664286cf7195db1805d1f70d.name: Deity of Seven Treasures - Ryozai
664286cf7195db1805d1f70d.description:
If you have a monster with 2700 DEF or "Ship of Seven Treasures" in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Face-up Level 7 monsters on your field and face-down Spell/Trap Cards on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

664286f97195db1805d1f8c3.name: Praime Pierce Giant
664286f97195db1805d1f8c3.description:
"Praime Dwarf" + 1 Level 8 or lower LIGHT Attribute monster
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] If your Level 7 or higher LIGHT Attribute monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). During your opponent's turn, monsters on your field cannot be used as material for a Fusion Summon.

664287764c66b2f63c6b496b.name: Praime Cat Straynya
664287764c66b2f63c6b496b.description:
"Praime Claw Girl" + 1 LIGHT Attribute monster
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Face-up Level 7 or higher LIGHT Attribute monsters on your field gain 200 ATK, and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

664287a04c66b2f63c6b4aa0.name: Transamu Praime Full Armor Nova
664287a04c66b2f63c6b4aa0.description:
"Transamu Praime Armor Nova" + "Transamu Rainac"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of different Types in both players' Graveyards] x 300. If there are 5 or more different Types in the Graveyards, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, then it gains additional 3000 ATK if there are 10 or more different Types in the Graveyards.

664287c38ec9bd0955757840.name: Transamuvelgr Rainac
664287c38ec9bd0955757840.description:
"Transamu Rainac" + "Voidvelgr Requiem"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 900 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, if you sent a LIGHT Attribute or DARK Attribute monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK until the end of their next turn.

664287f08ec9bd0955757924.name: Jointech Tridynabase
664287f08ec9bd0955757924.description:
"Jointech Nesstrydar Tank" + 2 non-Machine Type monsters
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). This card can make a second and third attack during the turn it was Fusion Summoned by sending monsters whose original names are "Voidvelgr Requiem" and "Abysslayer Leviaknight" to the Graveyard as material.

664288198ec9bd0955757a40.name: Flame Archer the Super Graphagas
664288198ec9bd0955757a40.description:
"Chromatographagas" + "Ember the Super Assistant"
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 Level 7 Pyro Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard on top of the Deck.
[EFFECT] This card gains 2500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can make 1 face-up Level 9 or lower monster on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

6642884a8ec9bd0955757b6d.name: Prophecy Flail of the Colors of the Wind, Butterflies, and Flowers
6642884a8ec9bd0955757b6d.description:
"Prophecy Phrase of the Colors of the Wind" + "Fiddlebadour"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can shuffle all monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. If you do, this card gains 1200 ATK until the end of this turn, and you draw 1 card.

6642887e8ec9bd0955757d0a.name: Celeb Rose Influencers
6642887e8ec9bd0955757d0a.description:
"Celeb Rose Enchanter" + "Celeb Rose Wiz"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Place 1 monster from your opponent's Graveyard on the bottom of their Deck, and this card gains ATK equal to [the Level of the monster placed by this effect] x 200 until the end of this turn. Then, if this card is equipped with an Equip Spell Card, this turn, it cannot be destroyed by card effects, and can make up to 2 attacks on monsters.

664288a88ec9bd0955757df8.name: Murin Duke the Shadow Flower Wave
664288a88ec9bd0955757df8.description:
"Flower Fan Clematis" + "Lindo the Shadow Flower Warrior"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] 1 face-up monster on your field gains ATK equal to [the number of monsters on your field] x 500 until the end of this turn. Then, inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

664288e08ec9bd0955757fe1.name: Nelkrita the Skysavior Hadal
664288e08ec9bd0955757fe1.description:
"Seir the Skysavior Knight" + "Lua the Skysavior Angel"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] If your Celestial Warrior/Warrior/Fairy Type monster equipped with an Equip Spell Card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

6642890a8ec9bd0955758236.name: Swift Gaia the Dragon Champion
6642890a8ec9bd0955758236.description:
1 Warrior Type monster with 2100 DEF + "Curse of Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] If this card attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). Then, if you have no cards in your hand, you can draw 1 card.

664289388ec9bd0955758420.name: Praime Call
664289388ec9bd0955758420.description:
[REQUIREMENT] The only monsters in your Graveyard are LIGHT Attribute.
[EFFECT] Add 1 monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand. You cannot activate monster effects until the end of this turn, except those of "Praime Dwarf".

664289568ec9bd0955758528.name: Graceful Dice
664289568ec9bd0955758528.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die. All face-up monsters on your field gain ATK/DEF equal to [the result] x 100 until the end of this turn.

664289778ec9bd0955758648.name: Dice of Greed
664289778ec9bd0955758648.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, send 3 cards with an effect that requires a die roll from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die. Draw cards equal to [the result]. Then, you can add up to 2 "Graceful Dice" and/or "Skull Dice" from your Graveyard to your hand if the result was 3 or lower.

664289948ec9bd0955758783.name: The Secret of Manifestation
664289948ec9bd0955758783.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 2 monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. You cannot activate monster effects until the end of this turn, except those of LIGHT Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters.

664289c08ec9bd09557588d4.name: Abysskite Mapping
664289c08ec9bd09557588d4.description:
This card's name becomes "Abysskite Prevent Wall" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Gain LP equal to [the number of face-up Sea Serpent Type monsters on your field] x 300. Then, you can add 1 "Abysskite Party" from your Graveyard to your hand.

664289e08ec9bd0955758997.name: Secret Alteration
664289e08ec9bd0955758997.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 3 cards from your hand to the Graveyard, including 2 LIGHT Attribute Reptile Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Draw 3 cards. Then, you can make 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field lose 1300 ATK until the end of this turn.

66428a078ec9bd0955758ae1.name: Secret Investigation Mobile Thunderbird
66428a078ec9bd0955758ae1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Reptile Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains 300 ATK, and can attack directly.

66428a288ec9bd0955758c48.name: Royal Rebel's King's Return
66428a288ec9bd0955758c48.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Reduce the Level of 1 face-up Level 3 or higher monster on your opponent's field by 2 until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 Level 7 or higher Fiend Type monster with 0 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

66428a4c93ef678c3f8e3212.name: Accelerator
66428a4c93ef678c3f8e3212.description:
This card's effect cannot be negated.
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Machine Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. If the equipped monster's original name is "Jinzo", its Continuous Effect becomes "Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards, and their Trap Card effects are negated".

66428adb8ec9bd09557593a1.name: Machine Inspector
66428adb8ec9bd09557593a1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Each player excavates the top 4 cards of their Deck. You can send up to 2 excavated Machine Type monsters and/or Trap Cards to the Graveyard. Each player places their remaining cards on the bottom of their Deck in any order. Then, if you sent a Trap Card to the Graveyard by this effect, draw 1 card.

66428afb8ec9bd09557594eb.name: Jointech Joint
66428afb8ec9bd09557594eb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change 1 monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. Then, you can Fusion Summon 1 Level 9 or lower EARTH Attribute or DARK Attribute Machine Type monster by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

66428b1d8ec9bd0955759651.name: Threat from Outer Space
66428b1d8ec9bd0955759651.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 1000 LP.
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Set it to your field (if it was a monster, you can Special Summon it in face-down Defense Position). If you Special Summoned a Level 2 monster from the Graveyard by this effect, you can also destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

66428b468ec9bd09557597e7.name: De-Spell
66428b468ec9bd09557597e7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up Spell Card or 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. If that card is face-up, destroy it. If that card is face-down, look at it. Then, if it is a Spell Card, destroy it.

66428b6b8ec9bd09557599bb.name: Abysskite Ray Monochrome
66428b6b8ec9bd09557599bb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[EFFECT] Shuffle 3 Level 4 or lower LIGHT Attribute and/or DARK Attribute monsters from the Graveyards into the owner's Decks. Then, the attacking monster loses ATK equal to [the total Levels of the monsters shuffled by this effect] x 200 until the end of this turn.

66428b8b8ec9bd0955759b5c.name: Skull Dice
66428b8b8ec9bd0955759b5c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die. All face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK/DEF equal to [the result] x 100 until the end of this turn.

66428bab8ec9bd0955759cd1.name: Asura Dice
66428bab8ec9bd0955759cd1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster face-up.
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the result] x 100, and all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK/DEF equal to [the result] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, you can make all face-up monsters on your field gain ATK/DEF equal to [the result] x 100 until the end of this turn.

66428bcb8ec9bd0955759e4b.name: Fusionic Defense
66428bcb8ec9bd0955759e4b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Fusion" or "Fusion Cancel" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, you can choose 1 face-up monster on your field. If chosen, this turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

66428bec8ec9bd0955759f87.name: Secret File 3000 - Final Tragedy
66428bec8ec9bd0955759f87.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have 3 face-up LIGHT Attribute Reptile Type monsters on your field, shuffle 3 LIGHT Attribute Reptile Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field. Then, inflict 3000 damage to your opponent.

66428c0b8ec9bd095575a100.name: Sunset Rebirth
66428c0b8ec9bd095575a100.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws a card(s) during their turn, or when a monster(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Graveyard to your field in face-down Defense Position. Then, up to 3 cards on your field other than this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects this turn.

66428c3d474e5ffa6b1beb26.name: Transamu Scraied
66428c3d474e5ffa6b1beb26.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. If you sent a LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type monster to the Graveyard by this effect, you can choose up to 3 face-up monsters on your field. If you do, those monsters inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference) if they attack a Defense Position monster this turn. Then, if you chose "Transamu Rainac" by this effect, you can change all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

66428c668ec9bd095575a438.name: Seiyaryu
66428c668ec9bd095575a438.description: A mystical dragon that burns away the unworthy with its mystic flames.

66428c958ec9bd095575a5c8.name: Progrigger Vancing
66428c958ec9bd095575a5c8.description:
If your opponent has a face-up monster with 2500 ATK on their field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This Attack Position card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 2500 original ATK.

66428cc18ec9bd095575a7c2.name: Jundee of the Dark Path
66428cc18ec9bd095575a7c2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if an EARTH Attribute monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can draw 1 card. If you do, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck.

66428d028ec9bd095575aa08.name: Voidvelg God Requiem
66428d028ec9bd095575aa08.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 3 monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card the above way, shuffle 5 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy all face-up monsters with the highest Level on your opponent's field. Then, you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the total ATK of the face-up monsters on their field].

66428d318ec9bd095575ab60.name: Kanan the Swordmistress
66428d318ec9bd095575ab60.description: A lady warrior armed with sword and shield, she floats lightly and stings sharply.

66428d5b8ec9bd095575acc6.name: Excite Ground Dragon
66428d5b8ec9bd095575acc6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] If you would conduct a normal draw until you have 5 cards in your hand during the Draw Phase while your opponent has 3 monsters on their field, conduct a normal draw until you have 6 cards in your hand instead.

66428da28ec9bd095575af64.name: LED Pigeon
66428da28ec9bd095575af64.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field gains 1000 ATK, and cannot be destroyed by battle.

66428df2474e5ffa6b1c0378.name: Dream Live
66428df2474e5ffa6b1c0378.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card by shuffling 5 monsters with 0 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up monsters on the field gain 500 ATK.

66428e588ec9bd095575b5ae.name: Cheater's Hidden Ball Trick
66428e588ec9bd095575b5ae.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 20 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy the attacking monster. You take no battle damage this turn.

6642e68f8fd0347b23cc0904.name: Number C32: Shark Drake LeVeiss
6642e68f8fd0347b23cc0904.description:
4 Level 5 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by discarding 1 Spell, and using a Rank 4 "Shark Drake" Xyz Monster you control as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, and if you do, its ATK/DEF become 0. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase, also if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

6642e6e88fd0347b23cc1453.name: Surfacing Big Jaws
6642e6e88fd0347b23cc1453.description: If this card is used for the Xyz Summon of a WATER monster, it can be treated as a Level 3 or 5 monster. You can only use each of the following effects of "Surfacing Big Jaws" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if a Spell Card was activated this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Xyz Monsters. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Fish "Shark" monster from your Deck to your hand.

6642e7f0263ca739048d9b6d.name: Drake Shark
6642e7f0263ca739048d9b6d.description:
A "Shark Drake" Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains this effect.
● Once per turn: You can detach 2 materials from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; attach it to this card as material.
You can only use each of the following effects of "Drake Shark" once per turn. If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon this card. This card can be treated as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a WATER Xyz Monster that requires 3 or more materials.

6642eaae8fd0347b23cc9717.name: Armored Shark
6642eaae8fd0347b23cc9717.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Armored Xyz" card.)
You can send 1 WATER Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck to the GY, then target 1 Fish monster in your GY with the same Level as the Rank of that monster; Special Summon it. During your opponent's turn, if this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 WATER Xyz Monster you control; equip this card to that monster as an Equip Spell that gives it 500 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Armored Shark" once per turn.

6642eb652d667f08f826c292.name: LeVirtue Dragon
6642eb652d667f08f826c292.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Virtue Stream" from your Deck to your hand. You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Detach 1 material from a monster you control, then add 1 Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster from your GY to your hand, except "LeVirtue Dragon".
● Target 2 Xyz Monsters on the field; attach 1 material from 1 of those monsters to the other.
You can only use each effect of "LeVirtue Dragon" once per turn.

6642eba52d667f08f826c7a8.name: Aqua Jet Surface
6642eba52d667f08f826c7a8.description: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster from your hand or GY, but you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Xyz Monsters, while you control that face-up monster. If your opponent controls an Attack Position monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Aqua Jet Surface" once per turn.

6642ec4eb55ca0c2a033917a.name: Reincarnation Unveiling Mail
6642ec4eb55ca0c2a033917a.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Armored Xyz" card.)
An Xyz Monster equipped with this card gains these effects.
● Cannot be destroyed by battle.
● Once per turn, if this card battled this turn (Quick Effect): You can return 1 card equipped to this card to the hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 WATER Xyz Monster.
Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there this turn: You can equip this card to 1 Xyz Monster you control. You can only activate 1 "Reincarnation Unveiling Mail" per turn.

6642ec63b55ca0c2a03393e4.name: Virtue Stream
6642ec63b55ca0c2a03393e4.description: Target 1 Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster you control and 2 cards your opponent controls; destroy them. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; if it is a WATER monster, the next time it would be destroyed by card effect this turn, it is not destroyed. If it is not, it becomes WATER. You can only use each effect of "Virtue Stream" once per turn.

6642ec73b55ca0c2a033958e.name: Xyz Poseidon Splash
6642ec73b55ca0c2a033958e.description: If you control an Xyz Monster that has an Xyz Monster as material: Declare 1 monster Attribute on the field; destroy all monsters on the field with that Attribute, except monsters equipped with an Equip Spell. You can banish this card from your GY and detach 1 material from a monster you control; Special Summon 1 Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster from your GY to either field. You can only use 1 "Xyz Poseidon Splash" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

66443347d645925fa6f5bed8.name: Cutter Shark
66443347d645925fa6f5bed8.description: When a card or effect is activated that targets 1 monster you control (and no other cards) or when a monster you control is targeted for an attack, while this card is in your hand or GY (Quick Effect): You can Tribute that monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 WATER monster from your GY to your hand, except "Cutter Shark". You can only use each effect of "Cutter Shark" once per turn.

66443371d645925fa6f5c530.name: Gimmick Puppet Fiendish Knight
66443371d645925fa6f5c530.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 "Gimmick Puppet" monster in your GY or 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to its owner's field in Defense Position (but its effects are negated), then Special Summon this card. If this card is sent to the GY, except from the hand: You can add it to your hand. You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except "Gimmick Puppet" monsters. You can only use each effect of "Gimmick Puppet Fiendish Knight" once per turn.

6644ab6b48e5447e5e2a8755.name: Seventh Tachyon
6644ab6b48e5447e5e2a8755.description: Reveal 1 "Number" Xyz Monster in your Extra Deck that has a number between "101" and "107" in its name; add 1 monster with the same Type and/or Attribute as the revealed monster, and a Level equal to its Rank, from your Deck to your hand, then place 1 card from your hand on top of the Deck. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Xyz Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Seventh Tachyon" per turn.

664861b20be8d672efdcfb5f.name: Otonari Thunder
664861b20be8d672efdcfb5f.description: If you control 2 or more Thunder monsters and this card is in your hand or GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can target 1 Xyz Monster you control; attach 2 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monsters from your hand, face-up field, and/or GY to it as material, including this card you control. You can only use each effect of "Otonari Thunder" once per turn.

664861da0be8d672efdcff8b.name: Giant Kra-Corn
664861da0be8d672efdcff8b.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position, and if you do, change the attack target to it and perform damage calculation. You can target 1 Plant monster you control, except "Giant Kra-Corn"; its ATK and this card's become their total original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Giant Kra-Corn" once per turn.

664861fb0be8d672efdd02f1.name: Splitting Planarian
664861fb0be8d672efdd02f1.description: You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 2 Level 3 Insect monsters from your Deck with the same name from each other, but their effects are negated, also banish them during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Splitting Planarian" once per turn.

664de5e43ad73c2e34969add.name: A-to-Z Energy Load
664de5e43ad73c2e34969add.description: When your opponent activates a card or effect: Draw cards equal to the number of Level 8 or higher LIGHT Machine Fusion Monsters you control. During your Standby Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; shuffle up to 6 of your banished LIGHT Machine monsters into the Deck, including a Union monster. You can only use each effect of "A-to-Z Energy Load" once per turn.

66571c80924939da5e2f946b.name: Grief Tablet
66571c80924939da5e2f946b.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Wedju" card.)
The equipped monster cannot attack or be Tributed, also its effects are negated. Once per turn, if you control the equipped monster: You can add 1 "Wedju" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Grief Tablet". If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster is destroyed: You can inflict 500 damage to your opponent. You can only activate 1 "Grief Tablet" per turn.

6660575a410d13bc38f179c4.name: Break the Seal
6660575a410d13bc38f179c4.description:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Place 1 "Break the Seal" from your Deck or GY, face-up on your field.
● Send 2 face-up "Break the Seal" you control to the GY, including this card; add 1 "Forbidden One" monster from your Deck to your hand.
If this card on the field is destroyed: You can reveal up to 5 "Forbidden One" monsters in your hand; return that many cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Break the Seal" once per turn.

66626e5fde75d3ab7ca59f14.name: Deep Space Yggdrago
66626e5fde75d3ab7ca59f14.description:
"Space Yggdrago" + "Space Yggdrago" + "Space Yggdrago"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card cannot be destroyed by card effects, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). Face-up Level 7 or higher monsters on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK.

66626e9ade75d3ab7ca5a140.name: Dual Space Yggdrago
66626e9ade75d3ab7ca5a140.description:
"Space Yggdrago" + "Space Yggdrago"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Shuffle monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field]. This turn, this card can attack monsters a number of times, up to [the number of monsters shuffled by this effect]. Then, if you shuffled 3 monsters by this effect, this card inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference) if it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn.

66626ec2de75d3ab7ca5a2a2.name: Space Yggdrago
66626ec2de75d3ab7ca5a2a2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Cyberse Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

66626ee9de75d3ab7ca5a41d.name: Multi-Space Yggdrago
66626ee9de75d3ab7ca5a41d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Space Yggdrago" this turn. Then, you can add 1 non-Level 8 Cyberse Type monster with 0 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

66626f0fde75d3ab7ca5a5c0.name: Guardian of Cyberse
66626f0fde75d3ab7ca5a5c0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, 1 face-up Cyberse Type monster on your field gains 300 ATK, and cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

66626f36de75d3ab7ca5a73e.name: Space Bud Exploit
66626f36de75d3ab7ca5a73e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Cyberse Type monster on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Then, you can Set 1 "Deep Warning Fusion" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

66626f63de75d3ab7ca5a928.name: Space Seed Driver
66626f63de75d3ab7ca5a928.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 7 or higher monster on your field and the only monsters in your Graveyard are Cyberse Type.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 2 or higher LIGHT Attribute or DARK Attribute monster with 0 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

66626f90de75d3ab7ca5ab5b.name: Strange Attractor
66626f90de75d3ab7ca5ab5b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Cyberse Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard, or shuffle 5 Cyberse Type monsters with different Levels from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. If you do, you cannot activate monster effects until the end of this turn, except those of Cyberse Type monsters.

66626fafde75d3ab7ca5accd.name: Space Call
66626fafde75d3ab7ca5accd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Cyberse Type monster in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Cyberse Type monster from among the cards sent face-up to your field. If it was "Space Yggdrago", you can draw 1 card.

66626fccde75d3ab7ca5ae88.name: Space Resonance
66626fccde75d3ab7ca5ae88.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a Level 7 or higher LIGHT Attribute or DARK Attribute Cyberse Type monster in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Cyberse Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. If you Special Summoned a Level 7 monster by this effect, you can also draw 1 card.

66626febde75d3ab7ca5afbf.name: Deep Warning Fusion
66626febde75d3ab7ca5afbf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a LIGHT Attribute or DARK Attribute Cyberse Type monster by sending only monsters from your hand, or only face-up monsters from your field, to the Graveyard as material. Then, if you sent to the Graveyard a monster whose original name is "Space Yggdrago" by this effect, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

66627010de75d3ab7ca5b1eb.name: Absurd Void Hole
66627010de75d3ab7ca5b1eb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your Attack Position Cyberse Type monster.
[EFFECT] This turn, your opponent cannot declare an attack, and your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle. You can gain LP equal to [the difference between the ATK of the attack target and the ATK of the attacking monster] x 2.

6662702bde75d3ab7ca5b3a1.name: Critical Service
6662702bde75d3ab7ca5b3a1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Cyberse Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can send 1 Level 7 or 8 monster from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the Level of the monster sent to the Graveyard by this effect] x 200.

66627048de75d3ab7ca5b541.name: Deep Space Impact
66627048de75d3ab7ca5b541.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[EFFECT] Place 3 to 6 Cyberse Type monsters/"Fusion"/"Deep Warning Fusion" from your Graveyard on top of your Deck in any order. Then, if you have a face-up Fusion Monster on your field, you can destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

666270ef4e79b00210347453.name: Valkyrion the Magna Wings
666270ef4e79b00210347453.description:
"Alpha The Magnet Warrior" + "Beta The Magnet Warrior" + "Gamma The Magnet Warrior"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] This card cannot be destroyed by card effects this turn. Then, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

6662712e4e79b00210347a3a.name: Valkyrion the Unity Warrior
6662712e4e79b00210347a3a.description:
"Alpha The Magnet Warrior" + "Beta The Magnet Warrior" + "Gamma The Magnet Warrior"
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", 1 "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and 1 "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

666271534e79b00210347e46.name: Alpha the Magnet Cavalry
666271534e79b00210347e46.description:
"Alpha The Magnet Warrior" + 1 Level 4 or lower Rock Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Magnet Twin Saber" and/or 1 "Repulsive Force" from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

6662717e4e79b002103481e4.name: Magnet Citadel Jar
6662717e4e79b002103481e4.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 3 Rock Type monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card the above way.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, you can draw 1 card.

666271ae4e79b002103486d1.name: Protorion the Magna Warrior
666271ae4e79b002103486d1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 Rock Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can Fusion Summon by sending Rock Type monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

666271d94e79b00210348a8e.name: Alpha The Magnet Warrior
666271d94e79b00210348a8e.description: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.

666271f74e79b00210348cb8.name: Beta The Magnet Warrior
666271f74e79b00210348cb8.description: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.

666272144e79b00210348eda.name: Gamma The Magnet Warrior
666272144e79b00210348eda.description: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.

6662723c4e79b00210349181.name: Alpha The Eternal Magnet Warrior
6662723c4e79b00210349181.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Alpha The Magnet Warrior" this turn. Then, you can Fusion Summon by sending Rock Type monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

666272624e79b00210349424.name: Beta The Eternal Magnet Warrior
666272624e79b00210349424.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Beta The Magnet Warrior" this turn. Then, you can Fusion Summon by sending Rock Type monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

666272874e79b00210349675.name: Gamma The Eternal Magnet Warrior
666272874e79b00210349675.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" this turn. Then, you can Fusion Summon by sending Rock Type monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

666272b14e79b0021034991d.name: Magnet Thunder Charge
666272b14e79b0021034991d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Rock Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. Then, if you have a face-up Rock Type monster on your field with 3500 original ATK, you can destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

666272d04e79b00210349b3a.name: Magnet Return
666272d04e79b00210349b3a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Level 4 or lower Rock Type monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or 8 Rock Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

666272f44e79b00210349db1.name: Magnet Twin Saber
666272f44e79b00210349db1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Rock Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. If the equipped monster is "Valkyrion the Unity Warrior", it can make up to 2 attacks on monsters each turn.

6662731a4e79b0021034a029.name: Repulsive Force
6662731a4e79b0021034a029.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 3 Rock Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

66627469b6cd244b92d4683f.name: All Love Goddess
66627469b6cd244b92d4683f.description:
If you have a face-up monster on your field with 0 original ATK, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up monsters on your field with 0 original ATK] x 1000. You take no battle damage from battles involving your monsters with 0 ATK.

66627492af8e09782832bad0.name: Peace Love Ángel
66627492af8e09782832bad0.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 monster with 0 ATK.
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] This card gains 2500 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can add 1 "Love Shoot" from your Graveyard to your hand.

666274bbb6cd244b92d46bad.name: Love Ángel
666274bbb6cd244b92d46bad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a monster(s) in your Graveyard and their total ATK is 0, you can make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

666274e6b6cd244b92d46d3c.name: Cute Lovely Anela
666274e6b6cd244b92d46d3c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Up to 3 face-up monsters on your field with 0 original ATK gain 600 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a monster(s) in your Graveyard and their total ATK is 0, you can place 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

6662750ab6cd244b92d46ebf.name: Lovely Anela
6662750ab6cd244b92d46ebf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, shuffle 3 non-Level 4 monsters with 0 ATK from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card.

6662752db6cd244b92d46fd7.name: Love Wolf
6662752db6cd244b92d46fd7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, reveal 1 Fairy Type monster with 0 ATK in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your field or 1 monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can add 1 "Love Protection" from your Graveyard to your hand.

66627550b6cd244b92d47173.name: Love Dove
66627550b6cd244b92d47173.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, reveal 1 Fairy Type monster with 0 ATK in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Love Angel" or 1 "Love Safety" from your Graveyard to your hand.

66627585b6cd244b92d4746e.name: Lovely Shoot
66627585b6cd244b92d4746e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, 1 face-up Fairy Type monster on your field with 0 original ATK gains 100 ATK, and can attack directly. You can only attack directly with 1 monster this turn.

666275a4b6cd244b92d47604.name: Love Study
666275a4b6cd244b92d47604.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 6 or more monsters in your Graveyard and their total ATK is 0.
[EFFECT] Place 1 card from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

666275c4b6cd244b92d47796.name: Lovely Letter
666275c4b6cd244b92d47796.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 or more monsters in your Graveyard and their total ATK is 0.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Fairy Type monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can add 1 "Lovely Memory" from your Graveyard to your hand.

666275ebb6cd244b92d479c7.name: Love Safety
666275ebb6cd244b92d479c7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Fairy Type monster on your field with 0 original ATK and DEF.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster and face-down cards in your Spell & Trap Zone cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. While the equipped monster is face-up on your field, your opponent cannot declare an attack on monsters that are not equipped with an Equip Spell Card.

6662760fb6cd244b92d47b8d.name: Love Protection
6662760fb6cd244b92d47b8d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster while you have a face-up Fairy Type monster on your field with 0 original ATK.
[EFFECT] Change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field. Your opponent cannot activate the effects of that monster this turn.

66627630b6cd244b92d47d35.name: Love Million
66627630b6cd244b92d47d35.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting your face-up Fairy Type monster with 0 original ATK.
[EFFECT] The attacking monster loses 1,000,000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a face-up monster with 0 DEF on your field, the attack target gains 100 ATK until the end of this turn.

6662764db6cd244b92d47f30.name: Lovely Memory
6662764db6cd244b92d47f30.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster(s) on your field is destroyed by an opponent's attack or their card effect.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Fairy Type monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6662766bb6cd244b92d481d5.name: Love Return
6662766bb6cd244b92d481d5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When you conduct a normal draw during the Draw Phase while you have a face-up Fairy Type monster on your field with 0 original ATK and DEF.
[EFFECT] Return all monsters with the highest original ATK among the face-up monsters on the field to the owner's hand.

66627b86e89d23ded40f5340.name: Magistus Chorozo
66627b86e89d23ded40f5340.description:
1 Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
Must first be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the correct Fusion Material Monster Cards you control to the GY. Once per turn, when a monster declares an attack: You can target it; negate the attack, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to that monster's ATK (until the end of this turn), then you can return that monster to the hand.

666522a99ca3e463840fafdb.name: Heart of the Blue-Eyes
666522a99ca3e463840fafdb.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Millennium" card.)
Control of this card cannot switch. You can discard this card; add 1 "Millennium Ankh" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Heart of the Blue-Eyes" once per turn. If this card is in your GY, and you have successfully activated "Millennium Ankh" this Duel, and your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) that is Level 8 or higher, or has 3000 or more ATK: You can send that monster to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Heart of the Blue-Eyes" once per Duel.

66668342468b2739f51567a0.name: Performage Fire Dancer
66668342468b2739f51567a0.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 "Performage" monster you control; if it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Performage" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Performage Fire Dancer". You can only use this effect of "Performage Fire Dancer" once per turn. If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 500 ATK.

66668370468b2739f5156bc9.name: Performage Water Dancer
66668370468b2739f5156bc9.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you control a "Performage" monster: You can Special Summon this card. When a monster declares an attack: You can target 1 Attack Position monster on the field; change it to Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Performage Water Dancer" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is Pendulum Summoned: You can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Performage Water Dancer" once per turn. If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 Attack Position monster on the field; change it to Defense Position.

666683a0468b2739f5157b8f.name: Performage Wind Drainer
666683a0468b2739f5157b8f.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn: You can target 1 "Performage" Pendulum Monster you control, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Reduce its Level by 1.
● Increase this card's Pendulum Scale by that monster's.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If your opponent controls a monster, or a "Performage" monster is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, but while it is face-up in the Monster Zone, you cannot Special Summon, except "Performage" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Performage Wind Drainer" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can reduce its Level by 1. Once per turn: You can change the Levels of all Level 4 "Performage" monsters you control to Level 5.

666683f2468b2739f51581b3.name: Performage Cup Tricker
666683f2468b2739f51581b3.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You can target 1 "Performage" Xyz Monster you control; attach this card to it as material. If a card(s) is added to your Extra Deck (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 face-up "Performage" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Performage Cup Tricker" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Xyz Monster on the field; detach 1 material from it, and if you do, Special Summon this card, then make 1 Xyz Monster on the field lose 600 ATK. If this card is detached from an Xyz Monster and sent to the GY to activate that monster's effect: You can target 2 Xyz Monsters you control; attach 1 material from 1 of those monsters to the other. You can only use each effect of "Performage Cup Tricker" once per turn.

6666840a468b2739f51583db.name: Performage Trapeze Witch
6666840a468b2739f51583db.description:
2 "Performage" monsters
"Performage" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your card effects, also your opponent cannot target them with card effects. While you control a "Performage" monster, except "Performage Trapeze Witch", your opponent's monsters cannot target this card for attacks. When an attack is declared involving your "Performage" monster and an opponent's monster: You can make that opponent's monster lose 600 ATK.

66668448468b2739f515885e.name: Performage Shadow Maker
66668448468b2739f515885e.description:
3 Level 5 monsters
When a card or effect is activated that targets this card (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Performage Shadow Maker" from your Extra Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Performage Shadow Maker" once per turn. You can detach 1 material from this card, then send 1 "Performage" monster from your Deck to the GY; add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your Deck to your hand. If the last material(s) is detached from this card (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 "Performage" monster from your GY.

66668476468b2739f5158c11.name: Performage Trapeze High Magician
66668476468b2739f5158c11.description:
2 Level 5 Spellcaster monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while it has material. Your opponent takes any effect damage you would have taken, a number of times each turn up to the number of materials attached to this card. If this card has "Performage Trapeze Magician" as material, it gains this effect.
● You can detach 1 material from this card; this card can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase this turn.

666686b1f00954f96f9a9048.name: Rank-Up-Magic Magical Force
666686b1f00954f96f9a9048.description: Target 1 Rank 4 Spellcaster Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it (but negate its effects), then Special Summon 1 Rank 5 Spellcaster Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck, by using it as material, and if you do, attach this card to the Summoned monster (this is treated as an Xyz Summon). You can only activate 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Magical Force" per turn.

6667d566a05b28f04ddc3e87.name: Primite Howl
