6667d566a05b28f04ddc3e87.description: Declare 1 Normal Monster Card name; you take no battle damage from battles involving your declared Normal Monsters or your "Primite" monsters (for the rest of this turn), then if you control no monsters, you can Special Summon 1 declared Normal Monster from your Deck or GY. During your opponent's turn: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Normal Monster you control or in your GY; take control of 1 monster your opponent controls with higher ATK than that monster, until the End Phase.

6667d60c836fd837ea799408.name: Primite Drillbeam
6667d60c836fd837ea799408.description: Reveal 1 "Primite" card, or 1 Normal Monster, in your hand, except "Primite Drillbeam" (or if you control a Normal Monster or a Level 5 or higher "Primite" monster, except a Token, you can activate this effect without revealing a card), then target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects, and if you do, banish it. During your Main Phase, if you control a "Primite" monster: You can Set this card from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Primite Drillbeam" once per turn.

6667d61b836fd837ea7995f5.name: Primite Roar
6667d61b836fd837ea7995f5.description: Pay 2000 LP, then declare 1 Normal Monster Card name; the declared Normal Monsters and "Primite" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle (until the end of your opponent's turn), then if you control no monsters, you can Special Summon 1 declared Normal Monster from your Deck in Defense Position. If your opponent Normal Summons a monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Normal Monster you control or in your GY; banish 1 monster from the field with less ATK than that monster.

6667d63e836fd837ea799a47.name: Primite Lordly Lode
6667d63e836fd837ea799a47.description: When this card is activated: Add 1 "Primite" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Primite Lordly Lode". You can declare 1 Normal Monster Card name; Special Summon 1 declared Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY in Defense Position, also you cannot activate the effects of Special Summoned monsters on the field this turn. You can only use each effect of "Primite Lordly Lode" once per turn. Normal Monsters and "Primite" monsters you control gain 300 ATK for each Normal Monster with different names in your GY.

6667d680836fd837ea79a155.name: Primite Imperial Dragon
6667d680836fd837ea79a155.description:
Cannot be Normal Summoned, except by Tributing 1 Normal Monster (but can be Normal Set). During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Primite" monster. You can only use this effect of "Primite Imperial Dragon" once per turn. If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can apply these effects in sequence.
● Negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls.
● Banish all monsters your opponent controls with the same Type or Attribute as a Normal Monster in your GY.

66691c573d08a6897c4b81f6.name: Anarchist Monk of the Six Samurai
66691c573d08a6897c4b81f6.description:
If you control a "Six Samurai" monster other than "Anarchist Monk of the Six Samurai", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Anarchist Monk of the Six Samurai" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Anarchist Monk of the Six Samurai" once per turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Six Samurai" Quick-Play Spell from your Deck to your hand. A "Six Samurai" monster that was Synchro Summoned using this card gains this effect.
● The Levels of all monsters your opponent controls are reduced by 1.

66691c6d3d08a6897c4b8413.name: Tactical Trainer of the Six Samurai
66691c6d3d08a6897c4b8413.description:
If you control a "Six Samurai" monster other than "Tactical Trainer of the Six Samurai", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Tactical Trainer of the Six Samurai" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Tactical Trainer of the Six Samurai" once per turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Six Strike" card from your Deck or GY to your hand. A "Six Samurai" monster that was Synchro Summoned using this card gains this effect.
● Monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK.

66691ce521fca5bd46256877.name: Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Shi En
66691ce521fca5bd46256877.description:
1 Warrior Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner "Six Samurai" monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 "Six Samurai" monster or "Shien" Effect Monster from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Shi En" once per turn. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If this card on the field would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 monster you control instead.

66691d0c21fca5bd46256d9c.name: Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Enishi
66691d0c21fca5bd46256d9c.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Warrior monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF during the Battle Phase only. You can only use each of the following effects of "Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Enishi" once per turn. If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can banish any number of "Six Samurai" monsters from your GY, then target that many monsters your opponent controls; return those monsters to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 of your banished "Six Samurai" monsters.

66691dd367731faf9a87bb22.name: Six Strike - Double Assault
66691dd367731faf9a87bb22.description:
Apply 1 of these effects, or if you control 2 or more "Six Samurai" monsters, you can apply both effects in sequence.
● Special Summon 1 "Six Samurai" monster with 2000 or less ATK from your hand or GY.
● Change 1 monster your opponent controls with 2000 or less ATK to face-down Defense Position.
During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Six Samurai" monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use 1 "Six Strike - Double Assault" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

66699440c7d33e64d641e9be.name: Earthbound Immortal Red Nova
66699440c7d33e64d641e9be.description:
There can only be 1 "Earthbound Immortal" monster on the field. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your hand or GY; send 1 "Earthbound Immortal" monster or "Red Dragon Archfiend" from your hand or face-up Monster Zone to the GY, then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 "Earthbound" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck.
● Special Summon 1 "Red Nova Dragon" from your Extra Deck. (This is treated as a Synchro Summon.)
You can only use this effect of "Earthbound Immortal Red Nova" once per turn.

666a7247cb4c3aa72f1b0197.name: Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon
666a7247cb4c3aa72f1b0197.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Max Metalmorph" that was activated by Tributing a Level 5 or higher Dragon monster. You can reveal this card in your hand; Set 1 "Metalmorph" Trap from your Deck, and if you do, shuffle this card into the Deck. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, then you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon" once per turn.

666a7267cb4c3aa72f1b05ce.name: Metalzoa X
666a7267cb4c3aa72f1b05ce.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Max Metalmorph" that was activated by Tributing a Level 5 or higher Fiend monster. You can reveal this card in your hand; Set 1 "Metalmorph" Trap from your Deck, and if you do, shuffle this card into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Metalzoa X" once per turn. Twice per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect, or Spell Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

666a7289cb4c3aa72f1b09de.name: Zoa the Fiendish Beast
666a7289cb4c3aa72f1b09de.description: If your opponent controls a monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zoa the Fiendish Beast" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can Special Summon this card in Defense Position, then if "Max Metalmorph" is not in your GY, your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their hand. During your Main Phase: You can Set 1 "Metalmorph" Trap from your Deck.

666a72a8cb4c3aa72f1b0ddb.name: Metal Illusionist
666a72a8cb4c3aa72f1b0ddb.description: Increase this card's Level by 4 during your opponent's turn only. You can only use each of the following effects of "Metal Illusionist" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Metalmorph" Trap from your Deck, then if "Max Metalmorph" is in your GY, you can draw 1 card. You can declare 1 other Monster Type; this card becomes that Type, until the end of your opponent's turn.

666a72c1cb4c3aa72f1b113a.name: Incoming Machine!
666a72c1cb4c3aa72f1b113a.description: Add 1 monster that mentions "Max Metalmorph" or 1 "Metalmorph" Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. If you control a "Metalmorph" Trap: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Defense Position monster your opponent controls; change it to face-up Attack Position. You can only use this effect of "Incoming Machine!" once per turn.

666a72dccb4c3aa72f1b145e.name: Max Metalmorph
666a72dccb4c3aa72f1b145e.description:
Tribute 1 face-up monster; Special Summon 1 monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set and mentions "Max Metalmorph" from your hand, Deck, or GY, then you can equip this card to it with the following effect.
● The equipped monster gains 400 ATK/DEF, it cannot be destroyed by Spell or monster effects, also your opponent cannot target it with monster effects or Spell Cards or effects.
You can only activate 1 "Max Metalmorph" per turn.

666a73bb62108ad679c33cc9.name: Time Engine
666a73bb62108ad679c33cc9.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Metalmorph" card.)
If a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: Target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon it, then if you Special Summoned a Level 5 or higher Machine monster by this effect and have a "Metalmorph" Trap on your field or GY, except this card on the field, you can apply this effect.
● Destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, then you can inflict damage to your opponent, equal to that Special Summoned monster's original ATK.

666bbd24e0fb7ce65b7b501e.name: Neverending Nightmare Absorber
666bbd24e0fb7ce65b7b501e.description: Gains 1000 ATK each time your opponent activates a monster effect. If your opponent activates a monster effect in their hand, GY, or banishment (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when they activated) or hand (even if not), but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Neverending Nightmare Absorber" once per turn.

666bbd94e2eeeb1a98066944.name: Union Pilot
666bbd94e2eeeb1a98066944.description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Effect Monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. You can return this card equipped to a monster to your hand; equip 1 appropriate, banished Union monster to 1 monster you control as an Equip Spell, as if it were equipped by that Union monster's effect, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Union Pilot" once per turn.

666bbe35e0fb7ce65b7b70ad.name: Dream Absorber
666bbe35e0fb7ce65b7b70ad.description:
You can only use the 1st effect of this card’s name once per turn.
(1) If your opponent activates a monster effect in the hand, GY, or banishment: You can Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when the effect was activated) or hand (even if not), but destroy it during the End Phase.
(2) Each time your opponent activates a monster effect, this card gains 1000 ATK immediately after it resolves.

666bbe5fe0fb7ce65b7b7588.name: Tsuru-Puru-Purun
666bbe5fe0fb7ce65b7b7588.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 WATER monster in your Main Monster Zone; destroy that monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon this card to the zone that monster was in, then you can destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls in this card's column. You can only use this effect of "Tsuru-Puru-Purun" once per turn.

666bbe7ee0fb7ce65b7b79e4.name: Khaos Starsource Dragon
666bbe7ee0fb7ce65b7b79e4.description:
1 LIGHT or DARK Dragon monster + 1 Dragon monster
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target cards your opponent controls up to the number of your LIGHT and DARK monsters used as its material; destroy them. If this card is banished: You can target 1 Level 4 LIGHT or DARK Dragon monster you control; its Level becomes 8. You can only use each effect of "Khaos Starsource Dragon" once per turn.

666bbfc6fc50b5264ff5c711.name: Succumbing-Song Morganite
666bbfc6fc50b5264ff5c711.description:
For the rest of this Duel, apply the following effects.
● You cannot activate monster effects in the hand.
● Monsters you control can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase.
● If your monster battles an opponent's monster, any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is doubled.
You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Morganite" card from your Deck to your hand, then place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.

6672cf62a38b2d2a4af3cd8a.name: Ocean of Regeneration
6672cf62a38b2d2a4af3cd8a.description: You can target 1 WATER monster with 1000 or less ATK in your GY; Special Summon it, but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Ocean of Regeneration" once per turn.

667c0977ed74be2f80e56284.name: Ragnaraika Wisteria of Woe
667c0977ed74be2f80e56284.description: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Plant/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1600/DEF 0) (this card is also still a Trap), then if you control a "Ragnaraika" Link Monster, you can banish up to 2 cards from your opponent's GY. During the End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can shuffle 2 Insect, Plant, and/or Reptile monsters from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck, and if you do, Set this card. You can only use this effect of "Ragnaraika Wisteria of Woe" once per turn.

6681472a4af5a66bfad6036a.name: Transam Power Linac
6681472a4af5a66bfad6036a.description:
"Transam Linac" + 1 Level 4 Galaxy Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card gains 1000 ATK, and it cannot attack directly. If you shuffled "Transam Ephyrai" into the Deck to meet the requirement, also this card gains 2600 ATK until the end of  this turn.

668147724af5a66bfad605af.name: Sevens Road Charmy Witch
668147724af5a66bfad605af.description:
"Sevens Road Witch" + 1 Level 1 EARTH Attribute Spellcaster Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field. Then, this card inflicts piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference) if it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn. Then, if you have "Sevens Road Magician" in your Graveyard, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects this turn.

668147be4af5a66bfad606fb.name: Vapor Lancer Super Graphagas
668147be4af5a66bfad606fb.description:
"Chromatographagas" + "Icelyn the Super Assistant"
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has a face-up card on their field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, your opponent returns as many face-up cards from their field to the owner's hand as possible, up to [the number of FIRE Attribute monsters with different Types sent to the Graveyard by this effect].

668147e46917b44e361429bd.name: Dian Keto the Food Prodigy
668147e46917b44e361429bd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If a Spell/Trap Card is on the field, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Gain 1000 LP. Then, you can make this card gain ATK equal to [the number of face-up Spell Cards on the field] x 300 until the end of this turn.

6681481b6917b44e36142b1a.name: Dian Keto the Cleaning Prodigy
6681481b6917b44e36142b1a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your LP are lower than your opponent's, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Gain 1000 LP. Then, this card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

6681487f4af5a66bfad60c0d.name: Dicemite Girl Laps
6681487f4af5a66bfad60c0d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Roll a six-sided die twice and apply the appropriate effect based on the total result.
● 7 or 11: Place 1 card from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.
● 2, 3, or 12: Change the battle position of 1 monster on your field.
● Other: This card gains ATK equal to [the total result] x 200 until the end of your opponent's next turn.

668148ba4af5a66bfad60dc4.name: Dice Key Nel
668148ba4af5a66bfad60dc4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up monster with an effect that requires a die roll on your field.
[EFFECT] Change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field (Attack Position becomes face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).

668149133cd07b84fd0b0c26.name: Supreme Machine Burning Overlord
668149133cd07b84fd0b0c26.description:
If you have a face-up Machine Type Maximum Monster on your field, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing.
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 3 or more DARK Attribute Machine Type Maximum Monsters in your Graveyard, pay 500 LP.
[EFFECT] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, this card gains 1200 ATK, and cannot be destroyed by card effects.

6681493ff426ee7c0c267f09.name: Impactor Comet
6681493ff426ee7c0c267f09.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, send 1 Rock Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 3 face-up Rock Type monsters on your field, you can add 1 Level 6-8 Rock Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

668149836917b44e3614354c.name: Trombow the Music Princess of Melodic Crown
668149836917b44e3614354c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard, and send 1 WIND Attribute Warrior Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have a Normal Monster in your Graveyard, you can change the battle position of 1 monster on the field.

668149ba6917b44e36143668.name: Scarechair Code
668149ba6917b44e36143668.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 Cyberse Type Maximum Monsters and/or DARK Attribute Fiend Type monsters with 0 ATK/2400 or more DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

668149e76917b44e36143868.name: Tribute Kaiser
668149e76917b44e36143868.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Reduce the Level of 1 Level 3-8 face-up Effect Monster on your opponent's field by 2 until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 Level 8 monster with 2400 ATK/1000 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

66814a0f6917b44e361439ce.name: Animagica Leader
66814a0f6917b44e361439ce.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower monsters with 900 or less DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field. If you do, you cannot activate the effects of Level 8 or lower monsters until the end of this turn.

66814a816917b44e36143cbf.name: Oriental Statue
66814a816917b44e36143cbf.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of Spell Cards in their Graveyard] x 100. Then, if you inflicted 1000 or more damage by this effect, you can add up to 2 "Oriental Tiger" and/or "Yokai Tiger Orient Strike" from your Graveyard to your hand.

66814ac46917b44e36143e8e.name: Cornful Charity
66814ac46917b44e36143e8e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Aqua Type monster on your field and an Aqua Type monster in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. Then, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of  the Deck.

66814b066917b44e36143ffc.name: Over Rush Storm
66814b066917b44e36143ffc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 2 monsters from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Place 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

66814b3a6917b44e361441fd.name: Shiny Shady
66814b3a6917b44e361441fd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster during their turn, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Change up to 2 face-up Effect Monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you changed a monster on your opponent's field with 2600 or more original ATK to face-down Defense Position by this effect, gain 1500 LP.

66814b6a6917b44e3614439f.name: Labyrinth Wall
66814b6a6917b44e3614439f.description: These walls form a labyrinth with no exit for enemies.

66814ba86917b44e36144587.name: Sky Emperor Minion
66814ba86917b44e36144587.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated "Space Yggdrago" or 1 excavated Cyberse Type Maximum Monster to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the top of your Deck in any order.

66814bd3702e4c1d77c69be4.name: Mage Power
66814bd3702e4c1d77c69be4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip this card to 1 face-up monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains ATK/DEF equal to [the number of Spell/Trap Cards on your field] x 500.

66814c35a93d5990d0d66dcc.name: Stone Chariot Gravelriot
66814c35a93d5990d0d66dcc.description: An ancient tank that drives with incredible balance. It shatters the balance of the enemy forces by penetrating a single point.

66814c59a93d5990d0d66fb3.name: Gravebronze Dragon
66814c59a93d5990d0d66fb3.description: A giant dragon that has a stately sheen. Its scales are said to grant the wishes of those who obtain them.

66814c85a93d5990d0d67147.name: Hybridrive Scale
66814c85a93d5990d0d67147.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monster and an EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, this turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Dragon Type or Machine Type monster in Attack Position.

66814ca5a93d5990d0d67251.name: Hybridrive Tusk
66814ca5a93d5990d0d67251.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Hybridrive Screwdriver" from your Graveyard to your hand.

66814ceda93d5990d0d67541.name: Hybridrive Lizard
66814ceda93d5990d0d67541.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 "Hybridrive Scale" or 1 "Hybridrive Tusk" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

66814d16a93d5990d0d67674.name: Hybridrive Screwdriver
66814d16a93d5990d0d67674.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 2 Dragon Type monsters and 2 Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 monster on the field. Then, neither player can Normal or Special Summon monsters with the same original name as the monster destroyed by this effect face-up until the end of your opponent's next turn.

66814d59a93d5990d0d678ee.name: Straynge Witch
66814d59a93d5990d0d678ee.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have no other monsters on your field.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 "Sevens Road Charm Witch" or 1 "Sevens Road Witch" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

66814dbca93d5990d0d67cd0.name: Lily Slayer
66814dbca93d5990d0d67cd0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a Spellcaster Type monster was sent to the Graveyard by this effect, this face-up card can also be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster in Attack Position this turn.

66814e1d6917b44e361459d9.name: Chemipet Chirp
66814e1d6917b44e361459d9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no other monsters on your field, reveal 1 Pyro/Aqua/Thunder Type monster in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 Pyro/Aqua/Thunder Type monster with the same Level as [the Level of the monster revealed to meet the requirement] from among the cards sent to your hand.

66814e446917b44e36145abd.name: Dice Key Mekuru
66814e446917b44e36145abd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 6 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated "Dice Key Ribbon" or 1 excavated LIGHT Attribute monster with an effect that requires a die roll to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

66814e6c6917b44e36145be6.name: Dice Key Kuu
66814e6c6917b44e36145be6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Dice Key Nel" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, roll a six-sided die. You can place 1 face-up Defense Position monster from your opponent's field on the top of the owner's Deck if the result was 6.

66814e8f6917b44e36145d03.name: Dice Key Ribbon
66814e8f6917b44e36145d03.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 "Dice Key Mekuru" or 1 LIGHT Attribute monster with an effect that requires a die roll from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

66814f00d7e854b10a763f18.name: Cybersepice Hotpot
66814f00d7e854b10a763f18.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal Summoned or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 7 or higher FIRE Attribute Cyberse Type monster or 1 "Spice Cross Mix" from your Graveyard to your hand.

66814f25d7e854b10a764001.name: Cybersepice Cinnamon
66814f25d7e854b10a764001.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Your opponent excavates the top card of their Deck. Then, if that card is a Level 5 or higher monster, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand face-up to your field. Your opponent places the excavated card on the top of their Deck.

66814f56d7e854b10a764219.name: Cybersepice Turmeric
66814f56d7e854b10a764219.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck and have a face-up FIRE Attribute Cyberse Type monster other than this card on your field.
[EFFECT] Look at 1 face-down card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. Then, if that card is a Trap Card, draw 1 card.

66814f7ad7e854b10a76430e.name: Cybersepice Cumin
66814f7ad7e854b10a76430e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Your opponent excavates the top card of their Deck. If that card is a monster, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [its Level] x 100. Your opponent places the excavated card on the top of their Deck.

66814fa1d7e854b10a764461.name: Wheatcloth Demeter
66814fa1d7e854b10a764461.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not Special Summoned a monster from the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Your opponent excavates the top 2 cards of their Deck. You can Special Summon 1 monster with a Level equal to or lower than [the total Levels of the excavated monsters] from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Your opponent places the excavated cards on the top of their Deck in any order.

66814fc9d7e854b10a764672.name: Cybersepice Nutmeg
66814fc9d7e854b10a764672.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 Cyberse Type monster.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Each player sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can place 1 of the cards sent on either the top or bottom of the owner's Deck.

66814fefd7e854b10a7647c4.name: Cybersepice Garam Masala
66814fefd7e854b10a7647c4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a face-up monster on their field.
[EFFECT] Your opponent excavates the top 3 cards of their Deck. 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses ATK equal to [the total Levels of the excavated monsters] x 300 until the end of this turn. Your opponent places the excavated cards on the top of their Deck in any order.

66815080300eb92ddb606f33.name: Dark Matter Deadcheer
66815080300eb92ddb606f33.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 5 Galaxy Type monster with 1300 DEF from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position.

668150e1a93d5990d0d69cee.name: Dark Matter Lockdoll
668150e1a93d5990d0d69cee.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster with 1300 DEF from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Dark Matter Mist" this turn. Then, you can draw 1 card.

6681511ea93d5990d0d69f7d.name: Dark Matter Jelly
6681511ea93d5990d0d69f7d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster on your field other than this card, send 1 face-down monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase this turn. Then, change this card to face-down Defense Position.

66815142a93d5990d0d6a22f.name: Dark Matter Craydoll
66815142a93d5990d0d6a22f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Dark Matter Mist" this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6681516fa93d5990d0d6a4af.name: Dark Matter String
6681516fa93d5990d0d6a4af.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 5 or lower DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster with 1300 DEF in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Special Summon the monster revealed to meet the requirement to your field in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. Then, this card gains 700 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn.

6681518ea93d5990d0d6a6ab.name: Dark Matter Knight
6681518ea93d5990d0d6a6ab.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the total number of face-up Fusion Monsters on your field and face-down monsters on your field] x 500.

668151b6a93d5990d0d6a8be.name: Dark Matter Hazardoll
668151b6a93d5990d0d6a8be.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal Summoned or Special Summoned this card, send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Dark Matter Mist" this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Dark Matter Craydoll" or 1 "Dark Matter Lockdoll" from your Graveyard to your hand.

668151dba93d5990d0d6aaab.name: Dark Matter Freya
668151dba93d5990d0d6aaab.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change this card's battle position.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monster on your field. If it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference). Then, you can change 1 face-up monster on the field to face-up Defense Position or face-down Defense Position.

668152ce3cd07b84fd0b6b4b.name: Stone Machine Gareking
668152ce3cd07b84fd0b6b4b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 2 face-up Rock Type Normal Monsters on your field, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 1400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have 3 Level 5-7 face-up monsters with different Levels on your field, you can destroy all face-up Level 7 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

668153153cd07b84fd0b6f91.name: Dragonic Geist
668153153cd07b84fd0b6f91.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon Type and/or Dragon Type, send 2 face-up Level 4 or lower Effect Monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 7 EARTH Attribute or DARK Attribute monster with 2500 ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6681534f3cd07b84fd0b7352.name: Twin Edge Phantom Dragon
6681534f3cd07b84fd0b7352.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon Type and/or Dragon Type, change this card's battle position.
[EFFECT] This turn, 1 face-up Level 7 DARK Attribute Dragon Type monster with 2500 ATK on your field gains 500 ATK, and can make up to 2 attacks on monsters.

6681537c3cd07b84fd0b7541.name: Royal Wisdom Guards
6681537c3cd07b84fd0b7541.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, shuffle 4 monsters with 1000 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck, except monsters with 1200 ATK.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, increase this card's Level by 2 until the end of this turn.

668153ab3cd07b84fd0b77e2.name: Advance Form
668153ab3cd07b84fd0b77e2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send up to 2 cards from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Shuffle monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck equal to [the number of cards sent to the Graveyard to meet the requirement]. Then, you can add 1 "Advance Impact" or 1 "Emperor Realm" from your Graveyard to your hand.

668153d83cd07b84fd0b7ae7.name: Granmarg the Rock Monarch
668153d83cd07b84fd0b7ae7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Tribute Summoned this card in Attack Position.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-down card on the field.

668154033cd07b84fd0b7d18.name: Watermirror Serpent
668154033cd07b84fd0b7d18.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon Type and/or Dragon Type, shuffle 2 non-Fusion Monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon by sending 1 Level 7 WATER Attribute or EARTH Attribute Dragon Type monster and 2 or more Dragon Type monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard.

6681542d3cd07b84fd0b7f0a.name: Dragon Remover
6681542d3cd07b84fd0b7f0a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, change the battle position of 1 face-up Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Look at 1 face-down card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. Then, if that card is a Trap Card, destroy it.

66815455a93d5990d0d6cd3a.name: Fusionic Tribevern
66815455a93d5990d0d6cd3a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your Graveyard are High Dragon Type and/or Dragon Type, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Increase this card's Level by 4 until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Watermirror Serpent" or 1 "Dragon Tribe Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6681547aa93d5990d0d6ce8c.name: Innocent Fadrawl
6681547aa93d5990d0d6ce8c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, if you have not drawn a card during this Main Phase.
[EFFECT] Both players draw 1 card.

6681549ea93d5990d0d6d09f.name: Data Eater
6681549ea93d5990d0d6d09f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 EARTH Attribute monster and 1 non-EARTH Attribute monster in your hand to your opponent.
[EFFECT] Shuffle 2 cards from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

668154c2a93d5990d0d6d280.name: Defrostrooper Mk-II
668154c2a93d5990d0d6d280.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Inflict 200 damage to your opponent. Then, if you have a Level 3 FIRE Attribute Cyberse Type monster or an Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 600 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

668154eca93d5990d0d6d4b4.name: Plus Skull
668154eca93d5990d0d6d4b4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change this Attack Position card to face-up Defense Position.
[EFFECT] This turn, 1 face-up DARK Attribute Fiend Type monster on your field with 0 original ATK and DEF gains 1000 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

6681550aa93d5990d0d6d68b.name: Multiply Skull
6681550aa93d5990d0d6d68b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK Attribute Fiend Type Effect Monster with 0 ATK/0 DEF in Attack Position.

66815538a93d5990d0d6d9bc.name: Deity of Seven Treasures - Beidai
66815538a93d5990d0d6d9bc.description:
If you have a monster with 2700 DEF or "Ship of Seven Treasures" in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 700 ATK/DEF until the end of their next turn.

6681557da93d5990d0d6dd72.name: God Maju Garzett
6681557da93d5990d0d6dd72.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 3 Effect Monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the total original ATK of the Effect Monsters Tributed for its Tribute Summon in Attack Position]. This card that was Normal Summoned by Tributing 3 monsters gains 800 ATK.

668155aba93d5990d0d6dfb4.name: Bluetech Burst Rex
668155aba93d5990d0d6dfb4.description:
"Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" + "Jointech Rex"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy up to 3 face-down cards on your opponent's field, and this card gains ATK equal to [the number of destroyed cards] x 500 until the end of this turn. Then, you can make all face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

668155d8a93d5990d0d6e201.name: Sevens Road Ultima Witch
668155d8a93d5990d0d6e201.description:
"Sevens Road Witch" + 1 Magical Knight Type or Spellcaster Type Fusion Monster
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Shuffle 1 Spell Card from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck. Then, you can add 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand. If you do, you can only activate 1 Normal Spell Card until the end of this turn.

6681560da93d5990d0d6e508.name: Cybersepice Queen Cinnamon
6681560da93d5990d0d6e508.description:
"Cybersepice Cinnamon" + "Cybersepice Hotpot"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Each player excavates the top 2 cards of their Deck. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the total Levels of the excavated monsters] x 100. Each player shuffles their excavated cards into their Deck.

66815633a93d5990d0d6e754.name: Cybersepice Curry Bread Pandora Drapery
66815633a93d5990d0d6e754.description:
"Cybersepice Garam Masala" + "Wheatcloth Demeter"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Your opponent excavates the top 4 cards of their Deck. If a Spell/Trap Card(s) is among the excavated cards, you can destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field. Your opponent places the excavated cards on the top of their Deck in any order.

66815662a93d5990d0d6ea1d.name: Dark Matter Enigmata
66815662a93d5990d0d6ea1d.description:
"Dark Matter Mist" + "Dark Matter Mist"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the total original ATK of the monsters used as material for its Fusion Summon]. If you have a face-down monster on your field, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

66815684a93d5990d0d6ecc0.name: Dark Matter Enigknight Sieger
66815684a93d5990d0d6ecc0.description:
"Dark Matter Knight" + "Dark Matter Mist"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. All face-up Level 7-9 monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of face-down monsters on your field] x 1000.

668156afa93d5990d0d6efd1.name: Blue-Eyes Blazing Bright Dragon
668156afa93d5990d0d6efd1.description:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + 1 Level 8 LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 500 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, if you have "Engine of Destruction" in your Graveyard, you can destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

668156d5a93d5990d0d6f287.name: Tribemirror Dragon
668156d5a93d5990d0d6f287.description:
1 Level 7 EARTH Attribute Dragon Type monster + 2 Dragon Type monsters
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, 1 face-up monster on your field cannot be destroyed by card effects, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage (if the ATK of the attacking monster exceeds the DEF of the attack target, inflict the difference).

668156f8a93d5990d0d6f4b1.name: Hybridrive Back Fusion
668156f8a93d5990d0d6f4b1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 Dragon Type and/or Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Your opponent Special Summons 1 monster from their Graveyard to their field in face-down Defense Position. Then, you can Fusion Summon by shuffling 1 Dragon Type monster and 1 Machine Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck as material. You can only attack with Fusion Monsters until the end of this turn.

66815715a93d5990d0d6f653.name: Hybridrive Restruct
66815715a93d5990d0d6f653.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 2 LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monsters from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6681573fa93d5990d0d6f86d.name: Blue-Fang Reconnect
6681573fa93d5990d0d6f86d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Shuffle 2 LIGHT Attribute Dragon Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6681575ea93d5990d0d6fa5d.name: Spice Cross Mix
6681575ea93d5990d0d6fa5d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon by sending FIRE Attribute Cyberse Type monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material. Then, you can place 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard on either the top or bottom of their Deck.

66815786a93d5990d0d6fc5f.name: Dark Matter Storm
66815786a93d5990d0d6fc5f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 face-down monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field. You can only attack with DARK Attribute Galaxy Type Effect Monsters this turn.

668157a3a93d5990d0d6fdf7.name: Dark Matter Force
668157a3a93d5990d0d6fdf7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] 1 face-up "Dark Matter Enigmata" or 1 face-up "Dark Matter Enigknight Sieger" on your field gains ATK equal to [the original ATK of the face-up monster with the highest original ATK on your opponent's field] until the end of this turn.

668158e3a93d5990d0d70e5e.name: Jest of the Cosmos Princess
668158e3a93d5990d0d70e5e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 3 cards from your hand to the Graveyard, including 2 monsters.
[EFFECT] Destroy up to 2 cards on your opponent's field. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more cards on their field, you can draw 2 cards.

66815903a93d5990d0d71019.name: Hybridrive Bumper
66815903a93d5990d0d71019.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 4 Dragon Type and/or Machine Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] The attacking monster loses 1600 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you shuffled 2 different Types to meet the requirement, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 9 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

6681591fa93d5990d0d7115a.name: Spice Cross Secret Recipe
6681591fa93d5990d0d7115a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, shuffle 2 Cyberse Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change 1 face-up Level 9 or lower monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can place 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard on either the top or bottom of their Deck.

66815945a93d5990d0d71386.name: Spice Cross Black Pepper
66815945a93d5990d0d71386.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard while you have 3 or more FIRE Attribute Cyberse Type monsters with different names in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Choose 5 cards in your opponent's Graveyard, including 2 Level 4 or lower monsters. Your opponent places them on top of their Deck in any order.

66815960a93d5990d0d7148c.name: Dark Matter Eliminate
66815960a93d5990d0d7148c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Reveal 1 face-down card on the field. Then, if that card is a Monster Card with 1300 DEF, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster or 1 face-down card on your opponent's field.

66815982a93d5990d0d71629.name: JAM:P Catch!
66815982a93d5990d0d71629.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack, shuffle 2 to 4 Psychic Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change the attacking monster to face-up Defense Position. Then, if you have a Psychic Type Normal Monster in your Graveyard, you can draw until you have 6 cards in your hand.

668159bba93d5990d0d7192a.name: Dragonic Domination
668159bba93d5990d0d7192a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Inflict 400 damage to your opponent. Then, if you have a face-up Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monster on your field, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower Effect Monster on your opponent's field.

668159dc702e4c1d77c74d60.name: Auspicious Arrival of Divine Doubt
668159dc702e4c1d77c74d60.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a monster(s) is sent from your opponent's field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. Then, you can send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard.

668159faa93d5990d0d71c90.name: Invitation to a Delirious Dream
668159faa93d5990d0d71c90.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, place 1 monster from your field and 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the owner's Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Take control of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field, except a Maximum Monster. While the monster you took control of by this effect is face-up on the field, it cannot attack or activate its effects.

66815a28a93d5990d0d71f3f.name: The Twin Dragons of the Heavens
66815a28a93d5990d0d71f3f.description: Noble and majestic lights that pervade the heavens and earth throughout all eternity. They move based on the logic of the divine, calmly wielding majesty and authority.

66815a54a93d5990d0d7215a.name: Copycat
66815a54a93d5990d0d7215a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal Summoned or Special Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field with 100 or more original ATK. While this card is face-up, it gains ATK equal to [that monster's original ATK], and if that monster's original DEF is 100 or higher, this card gains DEF equal to [that monster's original DEF].

6682d3677eb95d3af2c13a58.name: Ignihorse Dragonis
6682d3677eb95d3af2c13a58.description: This draco-horse races across the sea, boiling the water's surface while keeping its own flames from going out. Its dream is to set foot one day upon its homeland.

668543e52d1d365376f34c4b.name: Sangen Furo
668543e52d1d365376f34c4b.description: Once per turn, when a monster is destroyed by battle involving your FIRE Dragon monster: You can target 1 of those destroyed monsters; Special Summon it to your field in Defense Position. During your opponent's End Phase: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 "Sangen" Spell/Trap in your GY; Set it, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Sangen Furo" once per turn.

668938dbb54262137b1af538.name: Scourge of the White Forest
668938dbb54262137b1af538.description: Tribute 1 Synchro Monster, then target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects (until the end of this turn), then if you Tributed a "White Forest" Synchro Monster to activate this effect, you can Special Summon 1 Illusion monster from your GY. If this card is sent to the GY to activate a monster effect: You can Set this card. You can only use each effect of "Scourge of the White Forest" once per turn.

668a09a7378e6601b9cc62db.name: Performapal Sky Magician Girl
668a09a7378e6601b9cc62db.description: If you control a Continuous Spell: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned from the hand: You can send 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT Spellcaster monster from your Deck to the GY. If this face-up card leaves the field: You can target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Performapal Sky Magician Girl" once per turn.

668b78ee24732f494b587a13.name: Azamina Ilia Silvia
668b78ee24732f494b587a13.description:
1 Illusion monster + 1 LIGHT Spellcaster monster
Any battle damage your "Azamina" monsters, except "Azamina Ilia Silvia", inflicts to your opponent is doubled. You can only use each of the following effects of "Azamina Ilia Silvia" once per turn. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate that effect. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can add 1 "Sinful Spoils" Trap from your Deck to your hand.

668b792524732f494b588005.name: Azamina Mu Rcielago
668b792524732f494b588005.description:
1 Illusion monster + 1 LIGHT Spellcaster monster
Monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK/DEF for each "Azamina" monster you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Azamina Mu Rcielago" once per turn. If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can add 1 "Azamina" or "Sinful Spoils" card from your Deck to your hand. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can add 1 "Sinful Spoils" Spell from your Deck to your hand.

668b79c463ce6e7a6802886d.name: Azamina Moa Regina
668b79c463ce6e7a6802886d.description:
1 Illusion monster + 1 Level 6 or higher Fiend monster
You can target 1 Illusion monster in your GY, except "Azamina Moa Regina"; Special Summon it. When an "Azamina" or "Sinful Spoils" card or effect is activated, except "Azamina Moa Regina" (Quick Effect): You can target up to 2 cards on the field; destroy them. You can only use each effect of "Azamina Moa Regina" once per turn.

668b79e724732f494b58972e.name: The Hallowed Azamina
668b79e724732f494b58972e.description: Reveal 1 "Azamina" Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, and for every 4 Levels it has (round down), send 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your hand and/or field to the GY (if face-down, reveal it), then Special Summon that revealed monster. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon.) If this card is in the GY: You can target 1 "Azamina" monster you control or in your GY; shuffle it into the Deck, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "The Hallowed Azamina" once per turn.

668b7a0063ce6e7a68028e9a.name: Azamina Debtors
668b7a0063ce6e7a68028e9a.description: During the Main Phase: Reveal 1 "Azamina" Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, and for every 4 Levels it has (round down), send 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your hand and/or field to the GY (if face-down, reveal it), then Special Summon that revealed monster. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon.) During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Azamina" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use 1 "Azamina Debtors" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

668b7a1863ce6e7a68029132.name: Azamina Determination
668b7a1863ce6e7a68029132.description: Reveal 1 "Azamina" Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, and for every 4 Levels it has (round down), shuffle 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck, then Special Summon the revealed monster. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon.) You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Sinful Spoils" Spell/Trap in your GY; Set it, but it cannot be activated this turn. You can only use 1 "Azamina Determination" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

668b7a2e63ce6e7a680293ce.name: Deception of the Sinful Spoils
668b7a2e63ce6e7a680293ce.description: You can Tribute 1 monster from your hand or field; add 1 "Azamina" card from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY, and you control an "Azamina" monster (except during the Damage Step): You can make your opponent lose 1500 LP, and if you do, gain 1500 LP. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there from the Spell & Trap Zone this turn while face-up: You can Set it. You can only use each effect of "Deception of the Sinful Spoils" once per turn.

668b7bf463ce6e7a6802c61b.name: Goblin Bikers Gone Wild
668b7bf463ce6e7a6802c61b.description: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Goblin" monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Goblin Bikers Gone Wild" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Goblin" monster from your Deck. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 card on the field; attach it to 1 "Goblin" Xyz Monster you control.

668b7c0e63ce6e7a6802c942.name: Goblin Biker Grand Breakout
668b7c0e63ce6e7a6802c942.description: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 "Goblin" monster from your Deck, but it cannot attack this turn. When a monster declares an attack: You can banish this card from your GY and detach any number of materials from "Goblin" Xyz Monsters you control; all monsters your opponent currently controls lose 1000 ATK for each material detached, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Goblin Biker Grand Breakout" once per turn.

668b7c2763ce6e7a6802cbd8.name: Goblin Biker Grand Crisis
668b7c2763ce6e7a6802cbd8.description: You can target 1 "Goblin" monster you control and 1 monster your opponent controls, or target 1 "Goblin" monster in your GY and 1 monster in your opponent's GY; banish both monsters. You can send this face-up card from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, then target 5 of your banished "Goblin" monsters with different names; Special Summon them. You can only use 1 "Goblin Biker Grand Crisis" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

668b7d18f3fc0a8cb7d5bc9b.name: Azamina Sol Erysichthon
668b7d18f3fc0a8cb7d5bc9b.description:
1 Illusion monster + 1 Fiend monster
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target 1 card on the field; send it to the GY. During the Standby Phase: You can target 1 "Azamina" or "Sinful Spoils" card in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Azamina Sol Erysichthon" once per turn.

668b7d6b24732f494b58fea4.name: Guilt of the Sinful Spoils
668b7d6b24732f494b58fea4.description: If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) from the Deck or Extra Deck and you control a "Diabellstar" Monster Card (except during the Damage Step): Target 1 monster your opponent controls; shuffle it into the Deck. During the Damage Step, when your "Diabellstar" monster battles an opponent's monster: You can banish this card from your GY; that opponent's monster's ATK becomes halved until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Guilt of the Sinful Spoils" once per turn.

668cb02b8c19ac08c32f61ab.name: Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn
668cb02b8c19ac08c32f61ab.description:
2 LIGHT Machine monsters
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the Standby Phase of the next turn, add 1 card from your GY to your hand, with an effect that Fusion Summons a monster(s). When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 face-up LIGHT Machine monster you control or 2 LIGHT Machine monsters from your GY; negate the activation. You can only use each effect of "Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn" once per turn.

668cb06b8c19ac08c32f6931.name: Final Bringer of the End Times
668cb06b8c19ac08c32f6931.description: Target 1 monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls; destroy them. You can only activate 1 "Final Bringer of the End Times" per turn.

668cb5d1f03c5f2ecf88a9df.name: L Magi Mergy
668cb5d1f03c5f2ecf88a9df.description: Gains ATK equal to the total Link Rating of the Link Monsters in your GY x 400. During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 Cyberse monster or 1 Link Monster; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "L Magi Mergy" once per turn.

668cb723f03c5f2ecf88cf92.name: Flying Mary, the Wandering Ghost Ship
668cb723f03c5f2ecf88cf92.description:
2 Zombie monsters
You can target 1 of your Level 5 or higher Zombie monsters that is banished or in your GY; place this card in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon that monster. While this card is a Continuous Spell: You can target 1 Level 5 or higher Zombie monster you control; destroy 1 monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to that monster. You can only use each effect of "Flying Mary, the Wandering Ghost Ship" once per turn.

668e12533653a83d5e15d038.name: Sword Ryzeal
668e12533653a83d5e15d038.description: If you have a "Ryzeal" monster in your field or GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Rank 4 Xyz Monsters. You can only Special Summon "Sword Ryzeal" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 LIGHT Pyro monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Sword Ryzeal" once per turn.

668e12753653a83d5e15d351.name: Node Ryzeal
668e12753653a83d5e15d351.description: If you have an Xyz Monster in your field or GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Rank 4 Xyz Monsters. You can only Special Summon "Node Ryzeal" once per turn this way. You can send 1 card from your hand or field to the GY, then target 1 "Ryzeal" monster in your GY, except "Node Ryzeal"; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but negate its effects. You can only use this effect of "Node Ryzeal" once per turn.

668e128d3653a83d5e15d545.name: Ice Ryzeal
668e128d3653a83d5e15d545.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by sending 1 card from your hand or field to the GY. If Summoned this way, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Rank 4 Xyz Monsters. You can only Special Summon "Ice Ryzeal" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Ryzeal" monster from your Deck, except "Ice Ryzeal". You can only use this effect of "Ice Ryzeal" once per turn.

668e12f93684a3187c9d12f3.name: Ext Ryzeal
668e12f93684a3187c9d12f3.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by sending 1 Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck to the GY. If Summoned this way, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Rank 4 Xyz Monsters. You can only Special Summon "Ext Ryzeal" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned and you control no other face-up monsters, except Level/Rank 4 monsters: You can add 1 FIRE Thunder monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ext Ryzeal" once per turn.

668e13253684a3187c9d19a8.name: Palm Ryzeal
668e13253684a3187c9d19a8.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling 1 "Ryzeal" monster from your hand or GY into the Deck/Extra Deck. You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Rank 4 Xyz Monsters. Once per turn, during damage calculation, if this card battles an opponent's monster: You can send 1 Level 4 monster from your hand or Deck to the GY, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to that monster's ATK, until the end of the Battle Phase.

668e133e3684a3187c9d1d3b.name: Ryzeal Duo Drive
668e133e3684a3187c9d1d3b.description:
2+ Level 4 monsters
For each material this card has, monsters you control gain 100 ATK and monsters your opponent controls lose 100 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ryzeal Duo Drive" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can attach 1 "Ryzeal" monster from your GY to this card as material. During your Main Phase: You can detach 2 materials from a monster(s) you control, and if you do, add 2 "Ryzeal" cards with different names from your Deck to your hand.

668e13573684a3187c9d2122.name: Ryzeal Detonator
668e13573684a3187c9d2122.description:
2+ Level 4 "Ryzeal" monsters
When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ryzeal Detonator" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can attach 1 monster from your GY to this card as material. If an Xyz Monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead.

668e13743684a3187c9d256f.name: Ryzeal Plugin
668e13743684a3187c9d256f.description: Target 1 of your Xyz Monsters or "Ryzeal" monsters that is banished or in your GY; Special Summon it, then you can attach 1 "Ryzeal" card from your Deck to 1 Rank 4 Xyz Monster you control, also you cannot declare attacks for the rest of this turn, except with Rank 4 Xyz Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Ryzeal Plugin" per turn.

668e13863684a3187c9d27cd.name: Ryzeal Plasma Hole
668e13863684a3187c9d27cd.description: Target face-up cards your opponent controls, up to the number of "Ryzeal" Xyz Monsters you control; destroy them, then you can attach 1 "Ryzeal" card from your GY to 1 Rank 4 Xyz Monster you control. You can banish this card from your GY; immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Xyz Monster using monsters you control, including a "Ryzeal" monster. You can only use each effect of "Ryzeal Plasma Hole" once per turn.

668e7b81f41bde5827d1a22d.name: Mulcharmy Fuwalos
668e7b81f41bde5827d1a22d.description:
If you control no cards (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; apply these effects this turn.
● Each time your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) from the Deck and/or Extra Deck, immediately draw 1 card.
● Once, during this End Phase, if the number of cards in your hand is more than the number of cards your opponent controls +6, you must randomly shuffle cards from your hand into the Deck so the number in your hand equals the number your opponent controls +6.
You can only activate 1 other "Mulcharmy" monster effect, the turn you activate this effect.

668f56895d1be3a3af7c8e6f.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon
668f56895d1be3a3af7c8e6f.description:
2+ Tuners + 1 non-Tuner "Blue-Eyes" monster
Your opponent cannot banish cards from your GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon" once per turn. When a card or effect is activated on the field (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, this card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Dragon monster from your GY, except "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon".

668f56a85d1be3a3af7c90ee.name: Maiden of White
668f56a85d1be3a3af7c90ee.description: You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; place 1 "True Light" from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. If you Special Summon "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. When a card or effect is activated that targets this card on the field, or when this card is targeted for an attack (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or 1 Level 1 LIGHT Tuner from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Maiden of White" once per turn.

668f56c55d1be3a3af7c93ba.name: Wishes for Eyes of Blue
668f56c55d1be3a3af7c93ba.description: Discard 1 card; add 1 Level 1 LIGHT Tuner, and 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Blue-Eyes White Dragon", from your Deck to your hand, except "Wishes for Eyes of Blue". You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" you control; equip 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your Extra Deck to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 400 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Wishes for Eyes of Blue" once per turn.

668f56ce5d1be3a3af7c9479.name: Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons
668f56ce5d1be3a3af7c9479.description: Special Summon in Defense Position, 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your Deck, GY, or banishment (but if you control no "Blue-Eyes White Dragon", you can only Special Summon "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" with this effect), also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Dragon monsters. You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field, including a "Blue-Eyes" monster. You can only use 1 "Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

668ffc35c172a68f3dbe596b.name: Dipsea Fiend
668ffc35c172a68f3dbe596b.description: You can discard 1 card, then declare 1 Attribute, except WATER; Special Summon this card from your hand to either field, then this card becomes that Attribute (until the end of this turn), then if you Special Summoned this card to your opponent's field, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Fiend monster with an original Attribute other than the declared one, from your hand or GY to your field, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Fiend monsters. You can only use this effect of "Dipsea Fiend" once per turn.

668ffc7ac172a68f3dbe6272.name: Magicolloidal Sol
668ffc7ac172a68f3dbe6272.description:
If a monster(s) is Special Summoned by your Trap effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, but if you Summon it from the GY, banish it when it leaves the field. During your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control.
● Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon using this card you control.
You can only use each effect of "Magicolloidal Sol" once per turn.

668ffc97c172a68f3dbe6654.name: Vulmina, Statue of the Sacred Dragon
668ffc97c172a68f3dbe6654.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If a monster(s) is Special Summoned by your Trap effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand, then you can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Vulmina, Statue of the Sacred Dragon" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can place this monster in your Pendulum Zone, and if you do, return the opponent's monster to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Vulmina, Statue of the Sacred Dragon" once per turn. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

668ffcb8c172a68f3dbe6ad7.name: Necroquip Princess
668ffcb8c172a68f3dbe6ad7.description:
1 monster equipped with a Monster Card + 1 Fiend Monster Card
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from your hand and/or field to the GY. You can only control 1 "Necroquip Princess". If a monster(s) is sent from the hand to the GY to activate a card or effect: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Equip 1 of those monsters to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 500 ATK.
● Draw 1 card.
You can only use this effect of "Necroquip Princess" once per turn.

668ffcd2c172a68f3dbe6dbb.name: Kochobo's Hinamatsuri
668ffcd2c172a68f3dbe6dbb.description: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can target 1 Machine monster on the field; for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Xyz Monsters, also Special Summon this card (but banish it when it leaves the field), and if you do, halve that monster's ATK, also this card's Level becomes that monster's. You can only use this effect of "Kochobo's Hinamatsuri" once per turn.

668ffcebc172a68f3dbe70d6.name: Zapper Shrimp
668ffcebc172a68f3dbe70d6.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can send 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY, then target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Zapper Shrimp" once per turn. Once per Chain, during your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control.

668ffd0dc172a68f3dbe75cd.name: Aerial Eater
668ffd0dc172a68f3dbe75cd.description:
2 Fiend monsters with the same Attribute
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can send 1 Fiend monster from your Deck to the GY. If this card is in your GY: You can banish 2 Level 6 or higher Fiend monsters with the same Attribute as each other from your GY, except "Aerial Eater"; Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Aerial Eater" once per turn.

668ffd23c172a68f3dbe783b.name: Mimighoul Master
668ffd23c172a68f3dbe783b.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while your opponent controls any face-down monsters or you control a "Mimighoul" monster other than "Mimighoul Master". You can only use each of the following effects of "Mimighoul Master" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Mimighoul" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Mimighoul Master". During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can change 1 face-down monster on the field to face-up Attack or Defense Position.

668ffd48c172a68f3dbe7c36.name: Mimighoul Dragon
668ffd48c172a68f3dbe7c36.description:
FLIP: If it is the Main Phase: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Destroy all face-up monsters you control, except "Mimighoul" monsters.
● Give control of this card to your opponent.
During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand to your opponent's field in face-down Defense Position. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Mimighoul" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Mimighoul Dragon" once per turn.

668ffd60c172a68f3dbe7e9b.name: Mimighoul Cerberus
668ffd60c172a68f3dbe7e9b.description:
FLIP: If it is the Main Phase: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Banish the top 3 cards of your Deck, then Special Summon 1 of your banished monsters to your opponent's field in Defense Position.
● Give control of this card to your opponent.
During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand to your opponent's field in face-down Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Mimighoul Cerberus" once per turn. Your opponent cannot target face-up Spells you control with card effects.

668ffd7dc172a68f3dbe81bd.name: Mimighoul Archfiend
668ffd7dc172a68f3dbe81bd.description:
FLIP: If it is the Main Phase: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Your opponent draws 1 card. ● Send 1 card from your hand to the GY. ● Give control of this card to your opponent.
During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand to your opponent's field in face-down Defense Position. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can change 1 face-down monster on the field to face-up Attack or Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Mimighoul Archfiend" once per turn.

668ffda3c172a68f3dbe85f5.name: Kuebiko
668ffda3c172a68f3dbe85f5.description:
Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Fairy/EARTH/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the following effect (this card is also still a Trap).
● Once per Chain, when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field that targets a card(s) you control (Quick Effect): You can Set this card in your Spell & Trap Zone, and if you do, negate that opponent's effect, then if that monster has the highest ATK on your opponent's field, return it to the hand.
You can only activate 1 "Kuebiko" per turn.

668ffdafc172a68f3dbe873f.name: The League of Uniform Nomenclature Strikes
668ffdafc172a68f3dbe873f.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip 2 monsters with the same original name as that target from your hand, Deck, and/or GY to that target as Equip Spells, and if you do, it cannot attack or be destroyed by battle while equipped with those 2 cards. You cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except monsters with the same original Type as the targeted monster. You can only activate 1 "The League of Uniform Nomenclature Strikes" per turn.

668ffdbfc172a68f3dbe88c2.name: Mimighoul Dungeon
668ffdbfc172a68f3dbe88c2.description: "Mimighoul" monsters you control that were not Normal or Special Summoned this turn gain ATK equal to their original DEF. Any player who controls a face-down monster cannot Normal Summon monsters, nor declare an attack with monsters that were Special Summoned this turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Mimighoul" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mimighoul Dungeon" once per turn.

668ffdcac172a68f3dbe89be.name: Mimighoul Maker
668ffdcac172a68f3dbe89be.description: Reveal 2 Flip monsters with different names from your Deck, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Special Summon to their field in face-down Defense Position, and you add the other to your hand, then you can Special Summon 1 "Mimighoul" monster from your hand. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-down monster your opponent controls; change it to face-up Attack or Defense Position. You can only use 1 "Mimighoul Maker" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

668ffde4c172a68f3dbe8c55.name: Mimighoul Room
668ffde4c172a68f3dbe8c55.description: Special Summon 1 "Mimighoul" monster from your hand or Deck to your field, or in face-down Defense Position to your opponent's field, then you can change 1 face-up monster on the field to face-down Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY, then target any number of "Mimighoul" cards you control; return them to the hand. You can only use 1 "Mimighoul Room" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

66927287b2fc3093746152b2.name: Chaos Allure Queen
66927287b2fc3093746152b2.description: You can discard 1 other LIGHT or DARK monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can target 1 monster in either GY; equip it to this card as an Equip Spell, and if you do, this card's name becomes that equipped monster's name (until the End Phase), then if you equipped a LIGHT or DARK Monster Card by this effect, you can Special Summon 1 DARK "Allure Queen" monster from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Chaos Allure Queen" once per turn.

6693a52b559deed8eb6f212d.name: Dominus Impulse
6693a52b559deed8eb6f212d.description: If your opponent controls a card, you can activate this card from your hand. When a card or effect is activated that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster(s): Negate that effect, then if you have a Trap in your GY, destroy that card. If you activated this card from your hand, you cannot activate the effects of LIGHT, EARTH, and WIND monsters for the rest of this Duel. You can only activate 1 "Dominus Impulse" per turn.

6695054f9bc21a510e695c36.name: Absolute King - Megaplunder
6695054f9bc21a510e695c36.description: The king of dinosaurs that rules over the Earth. Its mighty roar makes its foes tremble in fear!

6697beae11cc4ce0bab2eab4.name: Performage Ball Balancer
6697beae11cc4ce0bab2eab4.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
During your Main Phase: You can send 1 "Performage" Pendulum Monster from your face-up Extra Deck to the GY, then you can increase this card's Pendulum Scale by that sent monster's. You can only use this effect of "Performage Ball Balancer" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If you control a "Performage" monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 "Performage" Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your face-up Extra Deck.
● Destroy 1 "Performage" Monster Card you control.
When an opponent's Special Summoned monster declares a direct attack: You can Special Summon this card from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Performage Ball Balancer" once per turn.

6698e31b849678685284fd15.name: Odd-Eyes Solblaze Dragon
6698e31b849678685284fd15.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 face-up Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck, but you cannot Special Summon, except Pendulum Monsters, while you control that face-up monster. If this card is in your GY: You can banish 2 other monsters (Fusion/Synchro/Xyz/Pendulum) from your GY; Special Summon this card. You can only use 1 "Odd-Eyes Solblaze Dragon" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

669a5f474d5f5fd7b2abaed4.name: Lacrima the Crimson Tears
669a5f474d5f5fd7b2abaed4.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Fiendsmith" card.)
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Fiendsmith" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Lacrima the Crimson Tears". During your opponent's turn, if this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Fiendsmith" Link Monster in your GY; shuffle this card into the Deck, and if you do, Special Summon that monster. You can only use each effect of "Lacrima the Crimson Tears" once per turn.

669a5f604d5f5fd7b2abb239.name: Fiendsmith's Agnumday
669a5f604d5f5fd7b2abb239.description:
2+ monsters, including a LIGHT Fiend monster
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 LIGHT non-Link Fiend monster in your GY; Special Summon it, and if you do, equip this card you control to that monster as an Equip Spell with the following effects.
● The equipped monster gains ATK equal to the total Link Rating of Link Monsters equipped to it x 600.
● If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

669bae03391d853036ce1c9e.name: Mementotlan Akihiron
669bae03391d853036ce1c9e.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can activate this effect; this turn, Level 9 or higher "Memento" monsters can attack directly. If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can target 1 of your other "Memento" cards that is banished or in your GY; add it to your hand. If a "Memento" monster(s) in your hand and/or face-up field is destroyed by battle or card effect, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Mementotlan Akihiron" once per turn.

669cb59a2c64ec7ce5d49199.name: Battlewasp - Rapier the Onslaught
