6807a34c9b8b11164821723c.description: Target 1 Spell/Trap you control; destroy it, and if you do, Set 1 Normal Trap from your Deck, except "Trap Holic". It can be activated this turn, while you have 3 or more Traps in your GY. You can only activate 1 "Trap Holic" per turn.

680cce7709f3eb587c2543ab.name: Gorgon of Zilofthonia
680cce7709f3eb587c2543ab.description:
2+ Effect Monsters
You cannot Summon/Set monsters to a zone(s) this card points to. Monsters this card points to cannot attack, also their activated effects are negated. Gains ATK equal to the total original ATK of monsters this card points to. Cannot be destroyed by battle or monster effects, while this card points to no monsters.

680cce9509f3eb587c2545c6.name: WAKE CUP! Mocha
680cce9509f3eb587c2545c6.description: Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. You can only use each of the following effects of "WAKE CUP! Mocha" once per turn. You can target 1 face-down Defense Position monster on the field; Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, change that monster to Attack Position. If this card is flipped face-up: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1000 ATK, but send it to the GY during the End Phase.

680cceaa09f3eb587c254781.name: THE Star Ham
680cceaa09f3eb587c254781.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 monster from your GY that was used as material for this card's Synchro Summon, and if you do, it is treated as a Tuner. If this card is in your GY: You can discard 2 cards; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "THE Star Ham" once per turn.

680cceba09f3eb587c2548ed.name: Sudden Thunder Swamp
680cceba09f3eb587c2548ed.description: When this card is activated: You can discard 1 card, and if you do, Set 1 Continuous Trap from your Deck or GY, with an effect that Special Summons itself as a monster, except the discarded card. If a card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, and sent to the GY or banished face-up: You can target 1 of them; add 1 card with the same name from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Sudden Thunder Swamp" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Sudden Thunder Swamp" per turn.

680ccec309f3eb587c254997.name: Shipping Error
680ccec309f3eb587c254997.description: When a card or effect is activated that includes an effect that adds a card(s) from the Deck to the hand: The activated effect becomes "Your opponent takes 1 card from their Deck for you to add to your hand, and you must keep that card revealed. During the End Phase of this turn, shuffle it into the Deck, and if you do, draw 1 card".

680ccece09f3eb587c254ab7.name: Spirit Poacher
680ccece09f3eb587c254ab7.description:
Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Place 1 monster from your Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell.
● Your opponent can Special Summon 1 Monster Card with less original ATK than their LP from your Spell & Trap Zone to their field, then they pay LP equal to its original ATK.
If an Effect Monster(s) you own is Special Summoned to your opponent's field: You can send this face-up card from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your Deck.

680cd36b09f3eb587c259590.name: Gagaga Girl
680cd36b09f3eb587c259590.description:
You can target 1 "Gagaga Magician" you control; this card's Level becomes the current Level of that monster. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using only this card and other "Gagaga" monsters as material gains this effect.
● When it is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; its ATK becomes 0.

68121608783e6548675fce23.name: Illusion Gate
68121608783e6548675fce23.description: Pay half your LP; destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, then you can Special Summon 1 monster from your opponent's GY to your field, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only apply this effect of "Illusion Gate" once per Duel.

68123f6e2d7e103a25f9d2ea.name: Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
68123f6e2d7e103a25f9d2ea.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Traps you control to the GY. Gains 1000 ATK for each Continuous Trap in your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target. Neither player can activate Spell/Trap Cards in response to this effect's activation.

681a994dd217a01ecde26d00.name: Master of the Sevens Road

[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster while you have a face-up Level 6 or higher DARK Attribute Fiend Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

681aa7a3b654202c3f7fefc7.name: Animagica Majesty
681aa7a3b654202c3f7fefc7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Beast Type monster on your field. Change up to 2 face-up monsters on your opponent's field with a lower Level than that monster's Level to face-down Defense Position.

681aa7ba5cd2a9e783328fd0.name: Bone Spine Whip
681aa7ba5cd2a9e783328fd0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Select 1 Level 5 or lower Zombie Type monster in your Graveyard and add it to your hand or Special Summon it face-up to your field. Then, if you have a face-up WIND Attribute monster on your field, you can return 1 face-up Level 8 or higher monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

681aa7e1b654202c3f7ff1c5.name: Elemental HERO Voltic Wingman
681aa7e1b654202c3f7ff1c5.description:
"Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Avian"
Must be Fusion Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a Level 6-8 Warrior Type monster that cannot be Special Summoned except by Fusion Summon by shuffling monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck as material.

681aa8015cd2a9e783329294.name: Miracle Contact
681aa8015cd2a9e783329294.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a monster that lists "Elemental HERO Neos" as material by shuffling monsters from your field and/or Graveyard into the owner's Deck as material.

681aa82f5cd2a9e7833294ee.name: Voidvelg Gehennamagia
681aa82f5cd2a9e7833294ee.description:
"Voidvelg Requiem" + "Voidvelg Hecatoncheir"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card, send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Return up to 2 face-down cards from your opponent's field to the owner's hand. Then, if you sent 2 Normal Spell Cards to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, neither player can activate Normal Spell Cards until the end of your opponent's next turn.

681aa881865c7d30cfcac583.name: Chimeratech Overdragon
681aa881865c7d30cfcac583.description:
"Cyber Dragon" + 1 or more Machine Type monsters
This card's original ATK/DEF become equal to [the number of monsters used as material when Fusion Summoning this card] x 800.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This Fusion Summoned card can attack monsters a number of times per turn, up to [the number of monsters used as material when Fusion Summoning this card].

681aa8a1865c7d30cfcac6aa.name: Cyber Dragon Rakete
681aa8a1865c7d30cfcac6aa.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monster.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon". Then, you can make 1 face-up monster on your field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

681aa8be865c7d30cfcac7b1.name: Cyber Dragon Zwei
681aa8be865c7d30cfcac7b1.description:
This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Spell Card in your hand.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon", and it gains 300 ATK.

681aa8e9865c7d30cfcac933.name: Cyber Kirin
681aa8e9865c7d30cfcac933.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send this card from your field to the Graveyard. This turn, you take no effect damage.

681aa91a865c7d30cfcacaa8.name: Cyber Dragon Nachster
681aa91a865c7d30cfcacaa8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon". Then, you can Special Summon 1 Machine Type monster with 2100 ATK or DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

681aa941865c7d30cfcacc94.name: Cyber Variation
681aa941865c7d30cfcacc94.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, place 1 face-up LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monster from your field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. You can only Special Summon Machine Type monsters until the end of this turn.

681aa958865c7d30cfcacd57.name: Cyber Rush Fusion
681aa958865c7d30cfcacd57.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a monster that lists "Cyber Dragon" as material by shuffling up to 5 LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters from your field and/or Graveyard into the owner's Deck as material. Then, if you have a monster on your field other than the monster Special Summoned by this effect, destroy all those monsters.

681aa96f865c7d30cfcace32.name: Cybernetic Overflow
681aa96f865c7d30cfcace32.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, place 2 "Cyber Dragon" with different Levels from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Destroy 2 cards on your opponent's field.

681aa9a8865c7d30cfcad063.name: Harpie Lady Sisters Triangle Beauty
681aa9a8865c7d30cfcad063.description:
"Harpie Lady Sisters" + 2 WIND Attribute Winged Beast Type monsters
You can Summon this card by Contact Fusion.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady Sisters", and it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Spell/Trap Card effects. Face-up Level 12 monsters on your field cannot be used as material for a Fusion Summon.

681aa9c5aff88b2fa710189f.name: Harpie Lady Feather Duster
681aa9c5aff88b2fa710189f.description:
1 Level 4 "Harpie Lady" + 1 WIND Attribute Winged Beast Type Normal Monster
You can Summon this card by Contact Fusion.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Harpie Lady". Then, if you activated this effect during your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

681aa9e7aff88b2fa7101a63.name: Harpie Lady 2 & 3
681aa9e7aff88b2fa7101a63.description:
"Harpie Lady 2" + 1 Level 4 or lower Winged Beast Type monster
You can Summon this card by Contact Fusion.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady". When you Normal or Special Summon a monster face-up, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards.

681aaa05aff88b2fa7101bd4.name: Harpie Regina Splendid Armor
681aaa05aff88b2fa7101bd4.description:
"Harpie Regina" + 1 Level 4 or lower Winged Beast Type monster
You can Summon this card by Contact Fusion.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you have "Splendid Slash" in your Graveyard, you can destroy 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's field.

681aaa1faff88b2fa7101d08.name: Harpie Cara Charming Dress
681aaa1faff88b2fa7101d08.description:
"Harpie Cara" + 1 Level 4 or lower Winged Beast Type monster
You can Summon this card by Contact Fusion.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have a Level 2 Winged Beast Type monster in your Graveyard, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

681aaa42aff88b2fa7101e7a.name: Harpie Signora
681aaa42aff88b2fa7101e7a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, if you have 10 or more cards in your Deck.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. If a "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" is among the cards sent, you can also draw 1 card.

681aaa5faff88b2fa7101f5f.name: Harpie Belle
681aaa5faff88b2fa7101f5f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 2 Winged Beast Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. If you Special Summoned a Normal Monster by this effect, you can also destroy 1 face-down card on your opponent's field.

681aaa7eaff88b2fa710202b.name: Hysteric Party
681aaa7eaff88b2fa710202b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws a card(s) during their turn, or when your monster is destroyed by an opponent's attack.
[EFFECT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon up to 3 "Harpie Lady", "Harpie Lady Sisters", and/or WIND Attribute Winged Beast Type Fusion Monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

681aaaa3aff88b2fa7102128.name: Outer Chaostellime
681aaaa3aff88b2fa7102128.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if a Normal Monster(s) is among the cards sent, you can Special Summon 1 Galaxy Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

681aaac3aff88b2fa7102273.name: Road Servant Flare
681aaac3aff88b2fa7102273.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not Special Summoned a monster, reveal 1 "Road Magic - Explosion", "Road Magic - Tempest", or "Road Magic - Tectonic Shift" in your hand.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, return this card to the owner's hand.

681aaaebaff88b2fa71023c1.name: Eternity Ether Dragon
681aaaebaff88b2fa71023c1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, pay 500 LP.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. You cannot activate the effect of "Eternity Ether Dragon" this turn.

681aaaeeaff88b2fa71023df.name: Eternity Ether Dragon
681aaaeeaff88b2fa71023df.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, pay 500 LP.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. You cannot activate the effect of "Eternity Ether Dragon" this turn.

681aab2caff88b2fa7102534.name: Dark Paladin
681aab2caff88b2fa7102534.description:
"Dark Magician" + "Buster Blader"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the total number of face-up Dragon Type monsters on the field and in both players' Graveyards] x 500. If you have cards in your hand, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Spell Card effects, and your opponent cannot activate Legend Spell Cards.

681aab57aff88b2fa71026da.name: Sevens Knight the Multistrike Dragon Knight
681aab57aff88b2fa71026da.description:
"Sevens Road Magician" + "Multistrike Dragon Dragias"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT]
●This turn, this card gains 500 ATK, and can make up to 2 attacks on monsters. ●This card cannot be destroyed by card effects until the end of your opponent's next turn.

681aab7aaff88b2fa710282f.name: The Perfect Dragiastar
681aab7aaff88b2fa710282f.description:
"The Dragias" + 4 Level 7 monsters
[REQUIREMENT] If your LP are lower than your opponent's, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card can attack all opponent's monsters once each.

681aaba0aff88b2fa7102975.name: Bandiva Duo the Elegy of the Wailing Winds
681aaba0aff88b2fa7102975.description:
2 Level 7 WIND Attribute Psychic Type monsters
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other card from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the total number of cards in your opponent's hand and on their field] x 300 until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a Normal Monster in your Graveyard, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

681aac02aff88b2fa7102cee.name: Dark Cavalry
681aac02aff88b2fa7102cee.description:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Warrior Type monster with 2100 DEF
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the total number of Spell/Trap Cards in both players' Graveyards] x 100. This card inflicts piercing battle damage. If you have cards in your hand, other monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

681aac60aff88b2fa7103063.name: Elemental HERO Heliosphere
681aac60aff88b2fa7103063.description:
"Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card and show it. If it is a monster, you can also destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

681aac825cd2a9e78332c0a3.name: Ancient Gear Megaton Golem
681aac825cd2a9e78332c0a3.description:
3 EARTH Attribute Machine Type monsters whose original ATK equals their own original DEF
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when this card declares an attack. If this card was Fusion Summoned using 2 or more monsters whose original Levels are 8 as material, it can attack twice per turn.

681aaca1aff88b2fa71032e1.name: Chimeratech Crush Dragon
681aaca1aff88b2fa71032e1.description:
"Cyber Dragon" + 2 or more Machine Type monsters
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Monsters on your field cannot be destroyed by Spell Card effects. Face-up Machine Type monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of monsters used as material when Fusion Summoning this card] x 100.

681aacc4aff88b2fa7103415.name: Harpie Lady 1 & 2 & 3
681aacc4aff88b2fa7103415.description:
"Harpie Lady" + "Harpie Lady" + "Harpie Lady"
You can Summon this card by Contact Fusion.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady", and it can make up to 3 attacks on monsters per turn. This card cannot attack directly. Face-up Level 12 monsters on your field cannot be used as material for a Fusion Summon.

681aacea5cd2a9e78332c40b.name: Excutie Plawtie Frontier
681aacea5cd2a9e78332c40b.description:
"Excutie Plawtie" + "Executie Leya"
You can Summon this card by Contact Fusion.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Face-up non-Level 6 monsters on your opponent's field lose 600 ATK/DEF. If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, gain 600 LP.

681aad22aff88b2fa7103811.name: CAN - Eb:D
681aad22aff88b2fa7103811.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 100 LP.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 Psychic Type monster in your Graveyard. This turn, this card's name becomes the same as that monster. Then, if you have no face-up Fusion Monsters on your field, you can add 1 "CAN:D" or 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

681aad465cd2a9e78332c750.name: Ember the Ultra Assistant
681aad465cd2a9e78332c750.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have "Ember the Super Assistant" in your Graveyard, send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add to your hand 1 FIRE Attribute monster from among the cards sent. You cannot activate the effects of monsters whose original Level is 5 until the end of this turn.

681aad8faff88b2fa7103cd9.name: Abysskite Ulti-Ange
681aad8faff88b2fa7103cd9.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 "Abysskite Ange".
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated "Abysskite Party" to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

681aadbeaff88b2fa7103ea8.name: Deity of Seven Treasures - Bika
681aadbeaff88b2fa7103ea8.description:
If you have a monster with 2700 DEF or "Ship of Seven Treasures" in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up Level 7 monsters on your field] x 400 until the end of this turn.

681aaddf5cd2a9e78332cc57.name: Neutron Blast
681aaddf5cd2a9e78332cc57.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" on your field. This turn, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when that monster declares an attack. This turn, that monster can make up to 3 attacks on monsters.

681aae11aff88b2fa7104283.name: Harpie Cielo Light Skirt
681aae11aff88b2fa7104283.description:
"Harpie Cielo" + 1 Level 4 or lower Winged Beast Type monster
You can Summon this card by Contact Fusion.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 "Harpie Lady Sisters" from your Graveyard to your hand.

681aae32aff88b2fa7104374.name: Phoenix Dealer
681aae32aff88b2fa7104374.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, send 1 Level 7 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 9 Magical Knight Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

681aae4f5cd2a9e78332d0c5.name: Volcano Black Dragon
681aae4f5cd2a9e78332d0c5.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 Dragon Type monster.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Dragon Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. If you Special Summoned a monster whose original Level is 9 by this effect, you can also draw 1 card.

681aae6d5cd2a9e78332d1fc.name: Evil Dragon of Darkness
681aae6d5cd2a9e78332d1fc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Dragon Knight of Darkness" or 1 Level 9 Dragon Type monster with 2500 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.

681aae85aff88b2fa7104718.name: Shadowbringer Dragon
681aae85aff88b2fa7104718.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 "Nightbringer Dragon" or 1 DARK Attribute Dragon Type monster with 1100 ATK and 500 DEF from your Graveyard in face-up Defense Position to your field.

681aaeaa5cd2a9e78332d3f0.name: Maginical Fantastic
681aaeaa5cd2a9e78332d3f0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Psychic Type monster with 100 ATK or DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field. You cannot Normal Summon Level 2 Effect Monsters until the end of this turn.

681aaedcaff88b2fa7104aa2.name: Jointech Baby Tyrant
681aaedcaff88b2fa7104aa2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have 3 or more Machine Type monsters in your Graveyard, you can add 1 "Jointech Joint" from your Graveyard to your hand.

681aaeff5cd2a9e78332d6a3.name: Preferlyre
681aaeff5cd2a9e78332d6a3.description:
If you have a face-up WIND Attribute Psychic Type monster on your field, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing.
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 4 or less cards in their hand during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Your opponent draws 3 cards. Then, increase this card's Level by 2 until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Fusion" or "Psyquip Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

681aaf1a5cd2a9e78332d7be.name: Sitarloot
681aaf1a5cd2a9e78332d7be.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up Level 7 or higher WIND Attribute Psychic Type monster on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send 1 card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Return 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's field to the owner's hand. Then, you can add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

681aaf375cd2a9e78332d896.name: Ancient Gear Hunting Hound
681aaf375cd2a9e78332d896.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field and you have another face-up EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster on your field during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Inflict 600 damage to your opponent. Then, you can Fusion Summon an EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster whose ATK equals its own DEF by sending Effect Monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

681aaf535cd2a9e78332da24.name: Cyber Basilisk
681aaf535cd2a9e78332da24.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 5 or higher Machine Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field, and change it to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you have a face-up Level 8 or higher Machine Type Fusion Monster on your field, you can destroy the chosen monster.

681aaf6eaff88b2fa71052fc.name: Excutie Mates
681aaf6eaff88b2fa71052fc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 6 monster with 500 DEF in your hand.
[EFFECT] Increase this card's Level by 2 until the end of this turn. Then, if you have not drawn a card during this Main Phase, you can draw 1 card. This turn, you cannot attack with Level 7 or higher monsters.

681aaf8daff88b2fa71054f6.name: The Versus Fusion
681aaf8daff88b2fa71054f6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a monster that lists "The Dragias" as material by shuffling 1 or more Normal Monsters from your field and 1 or more monsters from your Graveyard into the owner's Deck as material. Dragon Type monsters cannot be used as material by this effect, except "The Dragias".

681aafa65cd2a9e78332ddcd.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
681aafa65cd2a9e78332ddcd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field.

681aafd25cd2a9e78332dec1.name: Magician of Black Chaos
681aafd25cd2a9e78332dec1.description:
This card's name becomes "Dark Magician" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] None

681aaff0aff88b2fa71059cc.name: Ceremonial Sorcerer
681aaff0aff88b2fa71059cc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 8 Spellcaster Type Ritual Monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

681ab00aaff88b2fa7105b21.name: Ceremonial Knight
681ab00aaff88b2fa7105b21.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have a face-up Level 8 Spellcaster Type Ritual Monster on your field, all face-up monsters on your field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

681ab02a5cd2a9e78332e21e.name: Winged Dragon of Chaos
681ab02a5cd2a9e78332e21e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Black Magic Ritual" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone. Then, if you have not drawn a card during this Main Phase, you can draw 1 card.

681ab04b5cd2a9e78332e344.name: Marching Beaver Warrior
681ab04b5cd2a9e78332e344.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 monster with 1200 ATK/1500 DEF or 1400 ATK/1200 DEF from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

681ab0695cd2a9e78332e44c.name: Light-Calling Griffore
681ab0695cd2a9e78332e44c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Warrior or Spellcaster Type Ritual Monster with 2500 or more DEF in your Extra Deck.
[EFFECT] Set 1 Ritual Spell Card that mentions the monster revealed to meet the requirement from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

681ab08a5cd2a9e78332e515.name: Dark-Guiding Kuriboh
681ab08a5cd2a9e78332e515.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. During your opponent's next turn, your opponent cannot attack with that monster. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Dark-Guiding Kuriboh" or 1 Level 7 monster with 2100 DEF from your Graveyard to your field in face-down Defense Position.

681ab0b3aff88b2fa710612e.name: Explorer of the Temple
681ab0b3aff88b2fa710612e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 7 Ritual Monster with 2300 ATK/2500 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

681ab157865c7d30cfcb1856.name: Mind Control
681ab157865c7d30cfcb1856.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Take control of 1 monster on your opponent's field that is not in Maximum Mode until the End Phase (when control of that monster is returned, if there is no Monster Zone to return to, send it to the Graveyard). This turn, that monster cannot attack or be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

681ab17b865c7d30cfcb1aca.name: Black Magic Ritual
681ab17b865c7d30cfcb1aca.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Magician of Black Chaos" by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).

681ab193865c7d30cfcb1b79.name: Ceremonial Gate
681ab193865c7d30cfcb1b79.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Ceremonial Sorcerer" or "Ceremonial Knight" by sending face-up monsters from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 7 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).

681ab1ba865c7d30cfcb1d84.name: Torna the Magician of Whirlwinds
681ab1ba865c7d30cfcb1d84.description:
"Torna the Windweaver" + 1 DARK Attribute Spellcaster Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 9 Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

681ab1dcb654202c3f805305.name: Manifestation of Takamikami
681ab1dcb654202c3f805305.description: A sign of divine will that dances and sings glory. Lead those who have assembled together towards an unparalleled stage.

681c29c7b9d70121dfec9b84.name: Elemental HERO Thunder Giant - Voltic Thunder
681c29c7b9d70121dfec9b84.description:
2 "Elemental HERO" monsters with different Attributes
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Special Summoned and your opponent controls more cards than you do: You can destroy all other cards on the field. You can Tribute this card that was Fusion Summoned using a Normal Monster(s) as material, then target 1 "Elemental HERO" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Elemental HERO Thunder Giant - Voltic Thunder" once per turn.

681c29ee4043dc0d62398aa6.name: Drill Armed Dragon
681c29ee4043dc0d62398aa6.description: You can send this card and 1 other WIND monster from your hand to the GY; for the rest of this turn, all WIND Dragon monsters you control gain 300 ATK. You can banish any number of Dragon monsters that are Level 7 or higher and/or WIND from your GY; add 1 Dragon monster from your Deck to your hand with a Level equal to the number banished, except "Drill Armed Dragon". You can only use each effect of "Drill Armed Dragon" once per turn.

681c2a1b4043dc0d62398e8c.name: Light Water Dragon
681c2a1b4043dc0d62398e8c.description:
(This card is always treated as "Water Dragon".)
You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 3 Level 5 or lower Dinosaur monsters (WATER or WIND) from your Deck in Defense Position (but their effects are negated), also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Dinosaur or Sea Serpent monsters. You can only use this effect of "Light Water Dragon" once per turn.

681c2a40a1f3a90619b44d25.name: Sandwich Day
681c2a40a1f3a90619b44d25.description:
If you have a monster in your GY: Pay 200 LP; draw 1 card and reveal it, then, if it is a monster, apply this effect based on its Attribute.
● An Attribute not in your GY: Draw 1 card.
● An Attribute in your GY: Discard 1 card.
You can only activate 1 "Sandwich Day" per turn.

681c2b55a1f3a90619b46dca.name: Secrets of Dark Magic

681c2c5014a50a8cb7d91c96.name: The Gaze of Timaeus
681c2c5014a50a8cb7d91c96.description: Target 1 "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" in your field or GY; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions that monster as material, by shuffling it into the Deck as material (this is treated as a Fusion Summon with "The Eye of Timaeus"), but banish it during the End Phase of the next turn. You can only activate 1 "The Gaze of Timaeus" per turn.

681c2c9714a50a8cb7d9232b.name: Timaeus the United Magical Dragon
681c2c9714a50a8cb7d9232b.description:
"Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" + 1 Dragon or Spellcaster monster
After this card is Special Summoned, it is unaffected by other cards' effects until the end of your next turn. You can only use each of the following effects of "Timaeus the United Magical Dragon" once per turn. If this card battles, during damage calculation: You can make this card gain 100 ATK for each Spell in the GYs and banishment. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it.

681c2cc1b75e19e32d1378b3.name: Dark Magician of Destruction
681c2cc1b75e19e32d1378b3.description:
"Dark Magician" + 1 LIGHT or DARK monster
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) during the turn a Spell Card or effect is activated, by banishing 1 Level 6 or higher DARK Spellcaster monster you control as material. You can only Special Summon "Dark Magician of Destruction" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. This card's name becomes "Dark Magician" while on the field or in the GY. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Dark Magician" or 1 card that mentions it from your Deck to your hand.

6825cb57ebfc8161f7b9f198.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
6825cb57ebfc8161f7b9f198.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

682613d80759e2aa30d22bcb.name: Exodia the Forbidden One
682613d80759e2aa30d22bcb.description: If you have "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", "Left Leg of the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One" and "Left Arm of the Forbidden One" in addition to this card in your hand, you win the Duel.

682613da0759e2aa30d22bea.name: Exodia the Forbidden One
682613da0759e2aa30d22bea.description: If you have "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", "Left Leg of the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One" and "Left Arm of the Forbidden One" in addition to this card in your hand, you win the Duel.

682b2e988744dabb51db2ba5.name: Dragonic Warrior
682b2e988744dabb51db2ba5.description: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dragon monster from your hand or Deck, except "Dragonic Warrior", but negate its effects. You can only use this effect of "Dragonic Warrior" once per turn.

682b2ec89d21a5a3c5e699bd.name: Nurikabe
682b2ec89d21a5a3c5e699bd.description: If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 other Zombie monster in your GY; Special Summon both it and this card, but their effects are negated, also banish them when they leave the field. You can only use this effect of "Nurikabe" once per turn.

682b2eef59d8b9ce34f56089.name: Einroid
682b2eef59d8b9ce34f56089.description: If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can send 2 Level 4 or lower Machine monsters from your Deck to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Einroid" once per turn.

682c3ccda9e1416b6e030d7c.name: D/D Lance Soldier
682c3ccda9e1416b6e030d7c.description: You can target 1 "D/D" monster you control; increase its Level by up to the number of "Dark Contract" cards in your field and GY. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Dark Contract" card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "D/D Lance Soldier" once per turn.

682c3cefa9e1416b6e031101.name: D/D Defense Soldier
682c3cefa9e1416b6e031101.description:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Target 1 "D/D" card in your Pendulum Zone; Special Summon it.
● Banish 1 "D/D" monster from your GY; if your "D/D/D" monster attacks this turn, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step.
You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "D/D" Pendulum Monster from your face-up Extra Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "D/D Defense Soldier" once per turn.

682c3d8bd2df215456889318.name: D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex
682c3d8bd2df215456889318.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can place 1 "Dark Contract" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck face-up on your field. You can only use this effect of "D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If a face-up "D/D/D" and/or "Dark Contract" card(s) you control, except "D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex", is destroyed while this card is face-up in your Extra Deck, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card, then you can destroy 1 card on the field. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone. You can only use each effect of "D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex" once per turn.

682c3dc7d2df215456889bf7.name: D/D/D/D Dimensional King Arc Crisis
682c3dc7d2df215456889bf7.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You can target any number of "Dark Contract" cards you control; destroy them, then you can Special Summon up to that many "Doom King" Pendulum Monsters from your Deck and/or Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "D/D/D/D Dimensional King Arc Crisis" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
4 Fiend monsters (1 Fusion, 1 Synchro, 1 Xyz, and 1 Pendulum)
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your face-down Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards from your field and/or GY. You can only Special Summon "D/D/D/D Dimensional King Arc Crisis" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. If this card is Special Summoned: You can negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls. Can attack all your opponent's monsters, once each. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

682c3df8a9e1416b6e032ab3.name: D/D/D First King Clovis
682c3df8a9e1416b6e032ab3.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 of your banished "D/D" monsters, or if a "Dark Contract" card is on the field, you can target 1 in your GY instead; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "D/D/D First King Clovis" once per turn. If this card is banished: You can activate this effect; if your "D/D" monster attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

682c3e27a9e1416b6e03300c.name: D/D/D Wise King Solomon
682c3e27a9e1416b6e03300c.description:
2 Level 4 "D/D" monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "D/D" card from your Deck to your hand. If this card is banished: You can target 1 "D/D" Effect Monster you control; that Effect Monster gains this effect until the end of this turn.
● If this card destroys a monster by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.
You can only use each effect of "D/D/D Wise King Solomon" once per turn.

682c3e51a9e1416b6e03334a.name: D/D/D Sky King Zeus Ragnarok
682c3e51a9e1416b6e03334a.description:
2+ "D/D" monsters
You can target 1 "D/D" or "Dark Contract" card you control; destroy it, also during your Main Phase this turn, you can conduct 1 Pendulum Summon of a "D/D" monster(s) in addition to your Pendulum Summon (you can only gain this effect once per turn). When your opponent activates a monster effect in the hand (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "D/D" monster and 1 "Dark Contract" card from your GY; negate the activation. You can only use this effect of "D/D/D Sky King Zeus Ragnarok" once per turn.

682c3e71d2df21545688aea0.name: Dark Contract with the Zero King
682c3e71d2df21545688aea0.description:
(This card is always treated as a "D/D" card.)
You can target 1 "D/D" card you control, except "Dark Contract with the Zero King"; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "D/D" monster from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except "D/D" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Dark Contract with the Zero King" once per turn. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

682c3e7bd2df21545688afaa.name: Dark Contract with the Different Dimension
682c3e7bd2df21545688afaa.description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dark Contract with the Different Dimension" once per turn. You can shuffle 2 "Dark Contract" cards from your GY into the Deck, then target 1 card in your opponent's field or GY; banish it. If this card is destroyed: You can gain 500 LP, then if it was destroyed by an opponent's card effect, gain another 500 LP.

683e14dfa50ea92bbeef8700.name: Junk Warrior
683e14dfa50ea92bbeef8700.description:
"Junk Synchron" + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: It gains ATK equal to the total ATK of all Level 2 or lower monsters you currently control.

683e14f0107c65ab204a8673.name: Skull Servant
683e14f0107c65ab204a8673.description: A skeletal ghost that isn't strong but can mean trouble in large numbers.

683e14fb107c65ab204a87df.name: Honest
683e14fb107c65ab204a87df.description: During your Main Phase: You can return this face-up card from the field to the hand. During the Damage Step, when a LIGHT monster you control battles (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; that monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling, until the end of this turn.

683e150e107c65ab204a8a81.name: Gearfried the Iron Knight
683e150e107c65ab204a8a81.description: If either player equips an Equip Card(s) to this card: Destroy that Equip Card(s).

683e151e107c65ab204a8c62.name: Elemental HERO Neos
683e151e107c65ab204a8c62.description: A new Elemental HERO has arrived from Neo-Space! When he initiates a Contact Fusion with a Neo-Spacian his unknown powers are unleashed.

683e1538a0431312469927e3.name: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon
683e1538a0431312469927e3.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 2 monsters with 2000 or more ATK. During the Battle Step, if this card battles an opponent's monster (Quick Effect): You can target that opponent's monster; banish both this card from the field and that target. Return those banished monsters to the field at the end of the Battle Phase, and if you banished an Xyz Monster, this card gains 500 ATK for each material it had when it was banished.

683e1549a043131246992a0b.name: Ojama Trio
683e1549a043131246992a0b.description: Special Summon 3 "Ojama Tokens" (Beast/LIGHT/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 1000) to your opponent's field in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, and each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 300 damage.

683e1554107c65ab204a9196.name: Dark Paladin
683e1554107c65ab204a9196.description:
"Dark Magician" + "Buster Blader"
Must be Fusion Summoned. When a Spell Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster on the field and in the GYs.

6843b0955d702bba5323f06e.name: Dark Magic Talisman
6843b0955d702bba5323f06e.description: You can activate this card the turn it was Set, by revealing 1 Spellcaster monster in your hand. When a monster effect is activated in response to the card or effect activation of a card that mentions "Dark Magician": Negate that effect, and if you do, for the rest of this turn, negate the activated effects of monsters with that same original name. If you Special Summon "Dark Magician" while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can pay 2500 LP; Set this card.

684842afd91410dcb592756b.name: Anotherverse Stratios
684842afd91410dcb592756b.description: This war god from the otherworld has trod countless battlefields beneath his armored feet. If you want his glory, come and get it!

6849775ae4cc2c4bfc6d8cdf.name: Dark Magical Circle
6849775ae4cc2c4bfc6d8cdf.description: When this card is activated: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, then you can reveal 1 of them that is "Dark Magician" or a Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Magician", and add it to your hand, also place the remaining cards on top of your Deck in any order. If "Dark Magician" is Normal or Special Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it. You can only use each effect of "Dark Magical Circle" once per turn.

684c76e9d2013e692a07e8c8.name: Gouki Machine Suprex
684c76e9d2013e692a07e8c8.description: You can reveal this card and 1 "Gouki" monster in your hand; Special Summon both monsters, but for each one, as long as it remains face-up in your Monster Zone, you cannot Special Summon, except "Gouki" monsters. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Gouki" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Gouki Machine Suprex". You can only use each effect of "Gouki Machine Suprex" once per turn.

684c7714e575808214ce2736.name: Radiant Typhoon Meghala
684c7714e575808214ce2736.description: If you have "Mystical Space Typhoon" in your GY, or your opponent controls no Spells/Traps, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Radiant Typhoon Meghala" once per turn this way. If a "Radiant Typhoon" Quick-Play Spell Card or "Mystical Space Typhoon" is activated (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 "Radiant Typhoon" monster from your Deck with a different name than the monsters you control, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WIND monsters. You can only use this effect of "Radiant Typhoon Meghala" once per turn.

684c7734e575808214ce2a20.name: Radiant Typhoon Eldam
684c7734e575808214ce2a20.description: If you have "Mystical Space Typhoon" in your GY, or your opponent controls no Spells/Traps, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Radiant Typhoon Eldam" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Radiant Typhoon" monster (except "Radiant Typhoon Eldam") or 1 "Mystical Space Typhoon" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Radiant Typhoon Eldam" once per turn.

684c774f0454dd7957a8bf74.name: Radiant Typhoon Swen
684c774f0454dd7957a8bf74.description: If you have "Mystical Space Typhoon" in your GY, or your opponent controls no Spells/Traps, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Radiant Typhoon Swen" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Radiant Typhoon" Spell/Trap or 1 "Mystical Space Typhoon" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Radiant Typhoon Swen" once per turn.

684c778ad2013e692a07f643.name: Radiant Typhoon Krosea
684c778ad2013e692a07f643.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while your opponent controls no Spells/Traps. You can only use each of the following effects of "Radiant Typhoon Krosea" once per turn. If a Quick-Play Spell Card is activated (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Radiant Typhoon" card (except "Radiant Typhoon Krosea") and/or 1 "Mystical Space Typhoon" from your Deck and/or GY to your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WIND monsters.

684c77a00454dd7957a8c746.name: Radiant Typhoon Varuroon, the Vibrant Vortex
684c77a00454dd7957a8c746.description: If a Quick-Play Spell Card is activated (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. When your opponent activates a monster effect and you have "Mystical Space Typhoon" in your GY (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then if you have 2 or more "Mystical Space Typhoon" in your GY, you can destroy that monster. If "Mystical Space Typhoon" is activated while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Radiant Typhoon Varuroon, the Vibrant Vortex" once per turn.

684c77bbe575808214ce379f.name: Radiant Typhoon Fonix, the Great Flame
684c77bbe575808214ce379f.description: If a Quick-Play Spell Card is activated (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If a Quick-Play Spell Card is activated (except during the Damage Step): You can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; shuffle them into the Deck. If "Mystical Space Typhoon" is activated while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Radiant Typhoon Fonix, the Great Flame" once per turn.

684c780d0454dd7957a8cff7.name: Solfachord Solfegia
684c780d0454dd7957a8cff7.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
When your opponent's monster effect activated on the field resolves, if you control a "GranSolfachord" monster, you can negate that effect, then destroy this card. You can only use this effect of "Solfachord Solfegia" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Solfachord" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect (you can also Tribute this card); Special Summon 1 "Solfachord" monster from your hand, except "Solfachord Solfegia", or, if you Tributed this card when you activated this effect, you can Special Summon from your face-up Extra Deck or GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Solfachord Solfegia" once per turn.

684c783ae575808214ce40fc.name: Solfachord Primoa
684c783ae575808214ce40fc.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
When you Pendulum Summon: You can target 1 "Solfachord" card in your Pendulum Zone; return it to the hand.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
While you have "Solfachord" cards in both of your Pendulum Zones (1 odd and 1 even Pendulum Scale), the activated effects of your "Solfachord" cards cannot be negated. You can only use each of the following effects of "Solfachord Primoa" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Solfachord" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Solfachord Primoa". If you Link Summon a "Solfachord" monster: You can add 1 "Solfachord" card from your face-up Extra Deck or GY to your hand.

684c7873d2013e692a080b3e.name: Megalith Phuloch
684c7873d2013e692a080b3e.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Megalith" card. You cannot activate the following effects of "Megalith Phuloch" in the same Chain. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 1 "Megalith" card from your GY to your hand. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can activate this effect; Ritual Summon 1 "Megalith" Ritual Monster from your GY, except "Megalith Phuloch", by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, including this card on your field, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use this effect of "Megalith Phuloch" once per turn.

684c788e0454dd7957a8dc95.name: Megalith Notrah Plura
684c788e0454dd7957a8dc95.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Megalith" card. Must be Ritual Summoned using only Ritual Monsters. You can reveal this card in your hand; this turn, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to the activation of your "Megalith" Ritual Monster effects. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, then if that negated card or effect targeted a card(s) on the field, you can Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "Megalith Notrah Plura" once per turn.

684c78ade575808214ce4a87.name: Gouki The Tyrant Ogre
684c78ade575808214ce4a87.description:
1 "Gouki" Link Monster + 1 Warrior, Dinosaur, or Cyberse monster
If this card battles, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step. If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target cards on the field up to the total Link Rating of "Gouki" monsters used as this card's material (if you used a Link-3 or higher monster, neither player can activate those targeted cards or their effects in response to this effect's activation); destroy them. You can only use this effect of "Gouki The Tyrant Ogre" once per turn.

684c78c6d2013e692a081133.name: Gouki Dragon Ogre
684c78c6d2013e692a081133.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 "Gouki" Spell from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 EARTH monster you control; while you control that face-up monster, your opponent's monsters can only target it for attacks, also add 1 "Gouki" monster with less ATK than that monster from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gouki Dragon Ogre" once per turn.

684c78ece575808214ce4e6e.name: Gouki Sheik Ogre
684c78ece575808214ce4e6e.description:
2 "Gouki" monsters
If a "Gouki" monster(s) is added from the Deck to your hand, except by drawing it (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon any number of "Gouki" monsters with different Levels from your hand, but for each one, as long as it remains face-up in your Monster Zone, you cannot Special Summon, except "Gouki" monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Gouki" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Gouki Sheik Ogre" once per turn.

684c7909d2013e692a0816c0.name: Gouki Gameface
684c7909d2013e692a0816c0.description: When this card is activated: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower EARTH monster (Warrior, Dinosaur, or Cyberse) from your hand in Defense Position. You can Tribute 1 Link-3 or higher "Gouki" monster; Special Summon 1 "Dinowrestler" or "G Golem" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Gouki Gameface" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Gouki Gameface" per turn.

684c7917e575808214ce5109.name: Radiant Typhoon Chant

684c7920e575808214ce51da.name: Radiant Typhoon Manifestation

684c792dd2013e692a08193c.name: Radiant Typhoon Vision

684c794d859eaea659c53de1.name: Solfachord Happiness
684c794d859eaea659c53de1.description:
Activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Solfachord Happiness" once per turn);
● Discard 1 card, and if you do, add 2 "Solfachord" Pendulum Monsters with different Scales from your Deck to your hand, then you can Special Summon "Solfachord" Pendulum Monsters from your hand, up to the number of monsters your opponent controls +1.
● During your Main Phase this turn, you can conduct 1 Pendulum Summon of a "Solfachord" monster(s) in addition to your Pendulum Summon (you can only gain this effect once per turn).
● Special Summon 2 "Solfachord" cards from your Pendulum Zones.

684c795b859eaea659c53e92.name: Megalith Anastasis

684c7968d2013e692a081e16.name: Radiant Typhoon Mandate
684c7968d2013e692a081e16.description:
Once per turn: You can target 3 Quick-Play Spells in your GY, including a "Radiant Typhoon" card; apply the following effects in sequence.
● Shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card.
● All WIND monsters you control gain 300 ATK/DEF this turn.
Once per Chain, when "Mystical Space Typhoon" is activated: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects. If this card is destroyed by the effect of "Mystical Space Typhoon": You can Set this card.

684c7cd2859eaea659c57a8b.name: Masked HERO Dusk Crow
684c7cd2859eaea659c57a8b.description: If this card is in your hand: You can banish 1 "HERO" monster from your GY; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Masked HERO" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, except "Masked HERO Dusk Crow". You can only use each effect of "Masked HERO Dusk Crow" once per turn.

684c7cedc9432706b34b4e9f.name: Masked HERO Furnace
684c7cedc9432706b34b4e9f.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Mask Change" or "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except "HERO" monsters. If you Special Summon a non-FIRE "HERO" Fusion Monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when the Summon resolved), or hand (even if not), but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Masked HERO Furnace" once per turn.

684c7d09859eaea659c57f27.name: Masked HERO Atomic
684c7d09859eaea659c57f27.description: Must be Special Summoned with "Mask Change". The first time this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. You can only use each of the following effects of "Masked HERO Atomic" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 non-FIRE "Masked HERO" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it in Defense Position, ignoring its Summoning conditions. During your End Phase: You can target 1 "Change" Quick-Play Spell in your GY; Set it.

684c7d2e859eaea659c581cf.name: Masked HERO Dark Law
684c7d2e859eaea659c581cf.description: Must be Special Summoned by "Mask Change". Any card sent to your opponent's GY is banished instead. Once per turn, if your opponent adds a card(s) from their Deck to their hand (except during the Draw Phase or the Damage Step): You can banish 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

684c7d58c9432706b34b5709.name: Sanaki the Mikanko Devotee
684c7d58c9432706b34b5709.description: You can target 1 "Mikanko" card you control; return it to the hand. If an Equip Card becomes equipped to this card: You can Special Summon 1 non-Illusion "Mikanko" monster from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "Mikanko" monsters. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card to it as an Equip Spell. You can only use each effect of "Sanaki the Mikanko Devotee" once per turn.

684c7d71859eaea659c586b1.name: Uzuhime the Manifested Mikanko
684c7d71859eaea659c586b1.description:
2 Level 3 "Mikanko" monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Equip Spell from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Uzuhime the Manifested Mikanko" once per turn. Cannot be destroyed by battle, also your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. If this card attacks and battles, at the end of the Damage Step: You can detach 1 material from this card; it can attack again in a row.

684c7d8d859eaea659c58933.name: Mikanko Shinbu - Noble Twins
684c7d8d859eaea659c58933.description: Send 1 "Mikanko" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Mikanko Shinbu - Noble Twins", then you can Set 1 "Mikanko" Spell/Trap from your Deck, except "Mikanko Shinbu - Noble Twins". You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except "Mikanko" monsters. You can banish this card from your GY and detach 1 material from a monster you control; Special Summon 1 "Mikanko" Ritual Monster from your hand or Deck. You can only use 1 "Mikanko Shinbu - Noble Twins" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

684c7da8859eaea659c58dfc.name: Hu-Li the Jewel Mikanko
684c7da8859eaea659c58dfc.description: If this card is not equipped with an Equip Card, you take no damage from battles involving this card. If this card is equipped with an Equip Card, it cannot be destroyed by battle and your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. While you control an Equip Card, your opponent cannot target "Mikanko" cards you control with card effects. If either player equips an Equip Card(s) to this card: You can add 1 "Mikanko" Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Hu-Li the Jewel Mikanko" once per turn.

6850cab69af6f95ace0e2e14.name: R.B. Ga10 Driller
6850cab69af6f95ace0e2e14.description: If you control no face-up monsters, or the only face-up monsters you control are "R.B." monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "R.B. Ga10 Driller" once per turn this way. During the Main Phase, if this card is linked to an "R.B." Link Monster (Quick Effect): You can pay 500 LP, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy both that monster and this card. You can only use this effect of "R.B. Ga10 Driller" once per turn.

6850caca2c420cf006b7b7df.name: R.B. Ga10 Cutter
6850caca2c420cf006b7b7df.description: If you control no face-up monsters, or the only face-up monsters you control are "R.B." monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "R.B. Ga10 Cutter" once per turn this way. When your opponent's Spell/Trap Card or effect is activated, and this card is linked to an "R.B." Link Monster (Quick Effect): You can pay 700 LP; destroy this card, and if you do, negate that effect, and if you do that, destroy that card. You can only use this effect of "R.B. Ga10 Cutter" once per turn.

6850cae39af6f95ace0e3095.name: R.B. VALCan Rocket
6850cae39af6f95ace0e3095.description: If you control no face-up monsters, or the only face-up monsters you control are "R.B." monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "R.B. VALCan Rocket" once per turn this way. If this card is linked to an "R.B." Link Monster: You can pay 1000 LP, then target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; destroy them, also this card, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each card destroyed. You can only use this effect of "R.B. VALCan Rocket" once per turn.

6850cb039af6f95ace0e3257.name: R.B. VALCan Booster
6850cb039af6f95ace0e3257.description:
2 Machine monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "R.B." Spell from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in the Extra Monster Zone: You can Special Summon 1 "R.B." monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, then you can move this card you control to another of your Main Monster Zones, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Machine monsters with 1500 or less ATK. You can only use each effect of "R.B. VALCan Booster" once per turn.

6850cb20c5f6748273a692bc.name: R.B. The Brute Blues
6850cb20c5f6748273a692bc.description:
2+ Machine monsters
Gains the following effects while this card points to an "R.B." monster.
● Gains ATK equal to the total original ATK of "R.B." monsters it points to.
● Can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.
● Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.
During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "R.B." card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "R.B. The Brute Blues" once per turn.

6850cb369af6f95ace0e3508.name: R.B. Funk Dock
6850cb369af6f95ace0e3508.description: When this card is activated: Add 1 "R.B." card from your Deck to your hand, except "R.B. Funk Dock". Each time a monster(s) your opponent controls is destroyed by battle or card effect, gain 500 LP. If a face-up "R.B." monster(s) you control leaves the field by card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 "R.B." monster from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "R.B. Funk Dock" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "R.B. Funk Dock" per turn.

6850cb44c5f6748273a695c1.name: R.B. Stage Landing
6850cb44c5f6748273a695c1.description: Special Summon 1 "R.B." monster from your Deck/Extra Deck with a different name than the cards you control. If an "R.B." monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this card, except Machine monsters with 1500 or less original ATK.

6853ffdc99a6f0fcc66f0d6c.name: Miracle Raven
6853ffdc99a6f0fcc66f0d6c.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can Ritual Summon this card, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed 1.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
You can Ritual Summon this card with "Miracle Raven". Must be Ritual Summoned. This Ritual Summoned card is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. If you Ritual Summon exactly 1 Ritual Monster with a card effect that requires use of monsters, this card you control can be used as the entire Tribute. If this card is Tributed for a Ritual Summon: You can add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Miracle Raven" once per turn.

6853fffe99a6f0fcc66f0edf.name: ASHLAN U1000
6853fffe99a6f0fcc66f0edf.description:
2 monsters with different Types and Attributes
If a Ritual Monster this card points to attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. You can only use each of the following effects of "ASHLAN U1000" once per turn. You can reveal 1 Ritual Monster in your hand; add 1 Ritual Monster with a different Type and Attribute from your Deck to your hand. If you Ritual Summon (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; return it to the hand.

68540010d281d0a91ae95420.name: Readying of Rites
68540010d281d0a91ae95420.description: Add 1 Fiend Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a Pendulum Monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Sacrificial Offering Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 300). While you control that Token, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck. When your Ritual Monster inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can banish this card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Readying of Rites" once per turn.

6854b309be58e0edd649a0ea.name: Xyz Lay
6854b309be58e0edd649a0ea.description:
The equipped monster gains 200 ATK for each Xyz Material on the field. Once per turn: You can activate the following effect, based on the equipped monster's card type;
● Xyz: Detach 2 materials from a monster(s) you control; Set 1 "Xyz" Spell/Trap from your Deck.
● Other: Special Summon 1 monster with the same Level as the equipped monster from your hand in Defense Position, but negate its effects.
You can only activate 1 "Xyz Lay" per turn.

6854b312559cf920d00548ee.name: Mutiny in the Sky
6854b312559cf920d00548ee.description: Fusion Summon 1 Fiend or Fairy Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling Fiend and/or Fairy monsters from your GY into the Deck as material. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Fiend or Fairy monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Mutiny in the Sky" once per turn.

6854b330559cf920d0054b22.name: Steel-Stringed Sacrifice
6854b330559cf920d0054b22.description:
If this card is in your hand or GY: You can reveal 1 Level 5 or higher monster in your hand, then activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Steel-Stringed Sacrifice" once per turn); during the End Phase of this turn, lose 1000 LP if you did not Normal Summon the revealed monster, or a monster with the same original name, after activating this effect.
● Special Summon this card from your hand.
● Add this card from your GY to your hand.
● Banish this card from your GY, and if you do, add 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your GY to your hand.

6854b343559cf920d0054c71.name: Buio the Dawn's Light
6854b343559cf920d0054c71.description: Monsters in your leftmost or rightmost Main Monster Zones cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Buio the Dawn's Light" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Fiend Effect Monster you control; negate its effects, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 "Mutiny in the Sky" from your Deck to your hand.

6854b359559cf920d0054dfb.name: Psychic Omnibuster
6854b359559cf920d0054dfb.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Psychic monsters
Each time your opponent activates a card or effect on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can pay 2000 LP and declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) (but you can only declare each card type once per turn to activate this effect of "Psychic Omnibuster"); look at 1 random card in your opponent's hand, and if it is the declared card type, apply these effects in sequence (skip over any that do not apply).
● This card cannot be destroyed by the effects of the declared card type this turn.
● Banish the card you looked at, face-up, until the End Phase.

6854b372559cf920d0054fc4.name: Luce the Dusk's Dark
6854b372559cf920d0054fc4.description:
3 Fiend and/or Fairy monsters in your GY
Monsters in your leftmost or rightmost Main Monster Zones cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Luce the Dusk's Dark" once per turn. You can target 1 card your opponent controls; send 1 Fiend or Fairy monster from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, destroy that card. If another card(s) you control is destroyed by card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

685bb3df3a13d30920ab9514.name: Red-Boot Enhanced Boost Dragon
685bb3df3a13d30920ab9514.description:
"Red-Boot Boost Dragon" + "Booster Wyvern"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Effect] Choose up to 9 monsters in any Graveyard(s). Inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of chosen monsters] x 200, and this card gains ATK equal to [the number of chosen monsters] x 200 until the end of this turn. Then, shuffle the chosen monsters into the owner's Deck.

685bb3ec3a13d30920ab95b2.name: Blue-Fang Enhanced Burst Dragon
685bb3ec3a13d30920ab95b2.description:
"Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" + "Booster Wyvern"
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Destroy 1 face-up card on either field. Then, if you sent a monster whose original Level is 7 or higher to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can Special Summon 1 "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

685bb3f63a13d30920ab95e4.name: Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman
685bb3f63a13d30920ab95e4.description:
"Elemental HERO Flame Wingman" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman"
Must be Fusion Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of Warrior Type monsters in your Graveyard] x 300. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [that monster's original ATK].

685bb6dc6f105a189378287a.name: Royal Rebel's Heavy Metal
685bb6dc6f105a189378287a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing a Level 5 or higher monster.
[Effect] Choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster with the lowest Level on your opponent's field, and this card gains ATK equal to [that monster's ATK] until the end of this turn. Destroy that monster.

685bb6f252c01769517a9018.name: Hundred Divine Dragon
685bb6f252c01769517a9018.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] If you would normal draw until you have 5 cards in your hand during your Draw Phase, normal draw until you have 6 cards in your hand instead.

685be7cae844448754819fb3.name: Ohime the Manifested Mikanko
685be7cae844448754819fb3.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Mikanko Kagura". Cannot be destroyed by battle, also your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ohime the Manifested Mikanko" once per turn. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Mikanko" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Ohime the Manifested Mikanko", then discard 1 card. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Equip Spell in your GY; equip it to 1 appropriate monster on the field.

685dacb7f3ac7472c476048b.name: Gallugallud the Endless Enigma
685dacb7f3ac7472c476048b.description: This sinister spirit of wavering flames can transform into any being. As it shifts from bird to human, and human to bird, it has forgotten its true self.

685e9b3655bd20bea4908d9a.name: Mask Change
685e9b3655bd20bea4908d9a.description: Target 1 "HERO" monster you control; send it to the GY, also, after that, if it left the field by this effect, Special Summon 1 "Masked HERO" monster from your Extra Deck with the same Attribute that the sent monster had when it was on the field (its original Attribute, if face-down).

6861a4b7b9e70b8805beb6d3.name: Infernal Punisher

6865df488f5494642136eaf8.name: Onomatokage
6865df488f5494642136eaf8.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Zubaba", "Gagaga", "Gogogo", and "Dododo" card.)
If you control a "Zubaba", "Gagaga", "Gogogo", or "Dododo" monster and this card is in your hand or GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can banish this card from your GY; return up to 2 Xyz Monsters from your GY to the Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Onomatokage" once per turn.

686bcd25056f3fd502fa0acf.name: Ichiki Sayori-Hime
686bcd25056f3fd502fa0acf.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up this turn: Return this card to the hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ichiki Sayori-Hime" once per turn. If you control a monster with 800 ATK or DEF, and this card is in your hand: Immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon this card. If this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 Level 4 LIGHT or DARK monster with 800 ATK or DEF from your Deck to your hand, except "Ichiki Sayori-Hime".

686bcdb402cf12d28718aece.name: Laevateinn the Burning Blade
686bcdb402cf12d28718aece.description:
2 FIRE monsters
During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other FIRE monster, then target 1 FIRE monster in your GY with the same original Type but a lower original Level than that monster; Special Summon it in Defense Position. If a face-down card(s) in your Spell & Trap Zone would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, you can banish this card you control instead. You can only use each effect of "Laevateinn the Burning Blade" once per turn.

686bcdfa02cf12d28718b3d8.name: Axon Kicker Oracle
686bcdfa02cf12d28718b3d8.description:
1 Psychic monster + 1 Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster
After this card is Fusion Summoned, it gains 1000 ATK for each Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monster used as its material, until the end of the next turn. You can only use each of the following effects of "Axon Kicker Oracle" once per turn. When your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s) (Quick Effect): You can negate the Summon, and if you do, banish that monster(s). If this Fusion Summoned card is sent to the GY: You can banish 1 "Teleport" Normal or Quick-Play Spell from your GY; Special Summon this card.

686bce2c02cf12d28718b7a1.name: Serene Psychic Sorceress
686bce2c02cf12d28718b7a1.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can pay 1000 LP; Set 1 "Teleport" Normal or Quick-Play Spell from your Deck, GY, or banishment. If this Synchro Summoned card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 card your opponent controls, or target 2 if you control a Psychic monster (Fusion or Synchro); return that card(s) to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Serene Psychic Sorceress" once per turn.

686bce6402cf12d28718bb3c.name: Arequus the Shining Mars Saint
686bce6402cf12d28718bb3c.description: If you control a face-up card in your Spell & Trap Zone, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Arequus the Shining Mars Saint" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Arequus the Shining Mars Saint" once per turn. You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap you control; destroy both it and this card, then draw 1 card. If this card is destroyed: You can target 1 Xyz Monster you control; attach this card to it.

686bcea7056f3fd502fa25e0.name: Full-Speed Warrior
686bcea7056f3fd502fa25e0.description: Monsters you control that mention "Junk Warrior", or are a Synchro Monster with "Warrior" in their original name, gain 900 ATK during your Battle Phase only. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Junk Synchron" or 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Junk Warrior" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Full-Speed Warrior" once per turn.

686bceea8e98ca3c069673f2.name: Anchorbolt Hedgehog
686bceea8e98ca3c069673f2.description: If you control "Junk Warrior" or a monster that mentions it, except "Anchorbolt Hedgehog", and this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Anchorbolt Hedgehog" once per turn.

686bcf2602cf12d28718c9e5.name: Synchro Fellowship
686bcf2602cf12d28718c9e5.description: Add 2 monsters from your Deck to your hand (1 "Junk Synchron" and 1 monster that mentions "Junk Warrior" or "Stardust Dragon"), then discard 1 card. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Synchro Monster you control; reduce its Level by 1, then you can Normal Summon 1 "Synchron" monster during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). You can only activate 1 "Synchro Fellowship" per turn.

686bd2a510da1fb343e6ae2c.name: Junk Warrior Extreme
686bd2a510da1fb343e6ae2c.description:
"Junk Synchron" + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon as many Level 2 or lower monsters as possible from your GY, but neither player can activate those monsters' effects this turn, also you can only Special Summon one more time this turn. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 "Junk" Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Synchro Summon). You can only use each effect of "Junk Warrior Extreme" once per turn.

686f8b6fadb4ba77aedfe06e.name: Hecahands Ibtel
686f8b6fadb4ba77aedfe06e.description: If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hecahands Ibtel" once per turn. You can reveal this card in your hand; shuffle this card into the Deck, then Special Summon 1 "Hecahands" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Hecahands Ibtel". If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 "Hecahands" monster in your GY, except "Hecahands Ibtel"; Special Summon it.

686f8b9eadb4ba77aedfec02.name: Hecahands Yadel
686f8b9eadb4ba77aedfec02.description: If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hecahands Yadel" once per turn.
