691c56b31eccb8c960d50e79.name: The Monarchs Stormforth
691c56b31eccb8c960d50e79.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not Special Summoned a monster from the Extra Deck.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 monster on your opponent's field. This turn, if you would Tribute Summon a monster, you can Tribute that opponent's monster instead of 1 monster on your field. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck until the end of this turn.

691c56bdfef945bc60dcbf85.name: Invasion of the Monarchs
691c56bdfef945bc60dcbf85.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Add 1 monster with 2000 or 2400 ATK/1000 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand.

691c56ca1eccb8c960d50fc9.name: Triumph of the Monarchs
691c56ca1eccb8c960d50fc9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have no cards in your Extra Deck, send 1 monster with 2000 or 2400 ATK/1000 DEF from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. Then, you can shuffle up to 2 cards from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck.

691c56d81eccb8c960d5101f.name: Perseverance of the Monarchs
691c56d81eccb8c960d5101f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Shuffle 3 monsters with 1000 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you have no cards in your Extra Deck, you can destroy 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field.

691c56f11eccb8c960d51115.name: OuTerverSe Direct Driver
691c56f11eccb8c960d51115.description:
This card's name becomes "OuTerverSe" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card becomes Galaxy Type until the end of this turn. Then, you can choose 2 face-up Level 4 Galaxy Type Effect Monsters on your field. This turn, those monsters can attack directly, but you can only declare up to 2 attacks.

691c9d72c13085b0d44b0620.name: Super Princess of the Flock - Max Mutton (L)
691c9d72c13085b0d44b0620.description:
This card's name becomes "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card inflicts piercing battle damage. Then, if this card is in Maximum Mode, this turn, it gains 1000 ATK, and cannot be destroyed by card effects.

691c9d82c13085b0d44b0799.name: Super Princess of the Flock - Max Mutton
691c9d82c13085b0d44b0799.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Super Princess of the Flock - Max Mutton [L]" and "Super Princess of the Flock - Max Mutton [R]". This card's name becomes "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 "Meet and Greed" or "Beaming Bell Beam" from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

691c9d93c13085b0d44b08c8.name: Super Princess of the Flock - Max Mutton (R)
691c9d93c13085b0d44b08c8.description:
This card's name becomes "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Add 1 Beast Type Normal Monster, "Meet and Greed", or "Beaming Bell Beam" from your Graveyard to your hand. If this card is in Maximum Mode, you can add up to 3 of those cards to your hand instead.

691c9daac13085b0d44b0a7a.name: Royal Princess of the Wooly Wunderworld - Miss Mutton
691c9daac13085b0d44b0a7a.description: "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" + 2 Beast Type Normal Monsters

691c9db7c13085b0d44b0b83.name: Wooly Wunderworld Pyro Wool
691c9db7c13085b0d44b0b83.description: "Wooly Wonderland Pyro Wool" + "Wooly Wonderland Pyro Wool"

691c9dcec13085b0d44b0d83.name: Wooly Wunderworld Thunder Rambda
691c9dcec13085b0d44b0d83.description:
"Wooly Wonderland Thunder Rambda" + "Wooly Wonderland Thunder Rambda"
[REQUIREMENT] Change this Attack Position card to face-up Defense Position.
[EFFECT] Destroy up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field.

691c9dddc13085b0d44b0ea3.name: Wooly Wunderworld Aqua Sheep
691c9dddc13085b0d44b0ea3.description:
"Wooly Wonderland Aqua Sheep" + "Wooly Wonderland Aqua Sheep"
[REQUIREMENT] Change this Attack Position card to face-up Defense Position.
[EFFECT] Place 1 monster from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

691c9dedc13085b0d44b0f8d.name: Wooly Wunderworld Ground Mouton
691c9dedc13085b0d44b0f8d.description:
"Wooly Wonderland Ground Mouton" + "Wooly Wonderland Ground Mouton"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card cannot attack, and this Defense Position card cannot be destroyed by battle. Face-up "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" and "Royal Princess of the Wooly Wunderworld - Miss Mutton" on your field gain 700 ATK, and they inflict piercing battle damage.

691c9e02c13085b0d44b1156.name: Wooly Wonderland Shadow Merry
691c9e02c13085b0d44b1156.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Beast Type Normal Monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Gateway to the Wooly Wunderworld" from your Graveyard to your hand.

691c9e14c13085b0d44b1270.name: Wooly Wonderland Fluffy
691c9e14c13085b0d44b1270.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" in your Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Select 1 "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" in your Graveyard and add it to your hand or Special Summon it face-up to your field.

691c9e25c13085b0d44b13c4.name: Gateway to the Wooly Wunderworld
691c9e25c13085b0d44b13c4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send 1 face-up Beast Type monster from your field to the Graveyard. Then, you can Fusion Summon a DARK Attribute Beast Type monster with 1600 DEF by shuffling Beast Type monsters from your field and/or Graveyard into the owner's Deck as material.

691c9e32c13085b0d44b149d.name: Miss Mutton's Flocking Fanmail
691c9e32c13085b0d44b149d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Beast Type Normal Monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. Then, if you sent "Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton" to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Beast Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

691c9e3cc13085b0d44b1575.name: Wooly Wonderland Naptime
691c9e3cc13085b0d44b1575.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can change face-up monsters on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position, up to [the total number of Beast Type Maximum Monsters and Beast Type Normal Monsters sent to the Graveyard by this effect].

691c9e4bc13085b0d44b1676.name: Exchange of the Meeeg
691c9e4bc13085b0d44b1676.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws a card(s) while you have 15 or more Beast Type monsters in your Graveyard, send your entire hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Shuffle all cards from the Graveyards into the owners' Decks. Then, you can draw 1 card and show it. If that card is a Level 7 or higher Beast Type monster, you can Special Summon it face-up to your field.

691ca19447d11a6da1379a5b.name: Dedicated Gaia The Fierce Knight
691ca19447d11a6da1379a5b.description:
This card's name becomes "Gaia The Fierce Knight" while in the hand or Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Black Luster Ritual" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can increase this card's Level by 1 until the end of this turn.

691ca1a847d11a6da1379bbd.name: Chaoswordrider
691ca1a847d11a6da1379bbd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 4 monster with 500 ATK/1000 DEF in your hand, and send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can make 1 face-up Level 8 Warrior Type Ritual Monster on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

691ca1b847d11a6da1379c5f.name: Chaos Material
691ca1b847d11a6da1379c5f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 4 monster with 500 ATK/1000 DEF in your hand, and send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can increase this card's Level by 4 until the end of this turn.

691ca1ca47d11a6da1379d13.name: Shaman of Chaos
691ca1ca47d11a6da1379d13.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Level 4 monsters with 500 ATK/1000 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can destroy 1 face-down card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone.

691ca1d947d11a6da1379da1.name: Reviver of Chaos
691ca1d947d11a6da1379da1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 Level 4 monsters with 500 ATK/1000 DEF from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] This card gains 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 8 non-Effect Warrior Type Ritual Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

691ca1ee47d11a6da1379e8d.name: Quick Attack Knight
691ca1ee47d11a6da1379e8d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, or reveal 1 Level 4 monster with 500 ATK/1000 DEF in your hand.
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Black Luster Ritual" or "Super Soldier Strike" from your Graveyard to your hand.

691ca1ff47d11a6da1379f6d.name: Black Luster Ritual
691ca1ff47d11a6da1379f6d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Black Luster Soldier" by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).

691ca20c47d11a6da137a018.name: Super Soldier Strike
691ca20c47d11a6da137a018.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Black Luster Soldier" face-up on your field.
[EFFECT] Shuffle 1 face-up monster from your opponent's field into the owner's Deck.

691ca21747d11a6da137a0b9.name: Chaos Ceremonial Object
691ca21747d11a6da137a0b9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 "Black Luster Ritual" from among the excavated cards or your Graveyard to your hand. Place the other excavated cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

691ca22147d11a6da137a149.name: Dark-Piercing Sword
691ca22147d11a6da137a149.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 4 LIGHT or DARK Attribute monster with 500 ATK/1000 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can change 1 monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

691ca22e47d11a6da137a1fa.name: Super Soldier Radiance
691ca22e47d11a6da137a1fa.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck, or change the battle position of 1 face-up "Black Luster Soldier" on your field.
[EFFECT] Change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. If you have "Black Luster Soldier" face-up on your field, you can choose 2 monsters instead.

691ca30a4b33c680aec96be6.name: Princess Cosmos the Cosmic Trickster
691ca30a4b33c680aec96be6.description:
"Princess Cosmos the Trickster" + 2 or more Galaxy Type monsters with 900 ATK
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. If you used 9 or more monsters as material when Fusion Summoning this card, destroy all other cards on the field instead.

691ca31d4b33c680aec96c98.name: Cosmostar the Black Hole Polairy
691ca31d4b33c680aec96c98.description:
2 Galaxy Type monsters with 900 ATK
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card inflicts piercing battle damage. During your turn, face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK/DEF.

691ca32d4b33c680aec96dd1.name: Cosmostar the White Hole Polairy
691ca32d4b33c680aec96dd1.description:
3 Galaxy Type monsters with 900 ATK
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Galaxy Type Fusion Monster with 1900 or 2600 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can add 1 "Jest of the Cosmos Princess" from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Cosmostar the White Hole Polairy".

691ca34447d11a6da137b3e3.name: Princess Cosmos the Trickster
691ca34447d11a6da137b3e3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Destroy up to 3 monsters on your field. Then, you can Fusion Summon a Galaxy Type monster with 1900 or 2600 DEF by shuffling up to 9 Galaxy Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck as material. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Princess Cosmos the Trickster".

691ca3564b33c680aec96f41.name: Uranulycoris the Planetairy
691ca3564b33c680aec96f41.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by revealing 1 "Princess Cosmos the Trickster" or 1 "Jest of the Cosmos Princess" in your hand.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that a card on your field was destroyed by a card effect.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

691ca36947d11a6da137b5fa.name: Saturnchamomile the Planetairy
691ca36947d11a6da137b5fa.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by revealing 1 "Princess Cosmos the Trickster" or 1 "Jest of the Cosmos Princess" in your hand.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a Galaxy Type monster with 1900 or 2600 DEF by sending face-up Galaxy Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard as material.

691ca3784b33c680aec97151.name: Osmanjupiter the Planetairy
691ca3784b33c680aec97151.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Destroy this card on your field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 6 or higher Galaxy Type monster with 900 ATK from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

691ca3884b33c680aec97219.name: Marsphlox the Planetairy
691ca3884b33c680aec97219.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your field. Then, you can change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field. You cannot activate the effects of non-Galaxy Type monsters until the end of this turn.

691ca3974b33c680aec972bb.name: Yewearth the Planetairy
691ca3974b33c680aec972bb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 other card on your field. Then, you can draw 1 card. You cannot activate the effects of non-Galaxy Type monsters until the end of this turn.

691ca3a54b33c680aec973dc.name: Dendrovenus the Planetairy
691ca3a54b33c680aec973dc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can destroy this card on your field.

691ca3b247d11a6da137ba11.name: Mercissus the Planetairy
691ca3b247d11a6da137ba11.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated Level 6 or higher Galaxy Type monster with 900 ATK to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

691ca3c84b33c680aec97504.name: Princess Cosmos Stirs
691ca3c84b33c680aec97504.description:
This card's name becomes "Jest of the Cosmos Princess" while in the hand.
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 5 or more Galaxy Type monsters in your Graveyard, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a Galaxy Type monster with 1900 or 2600 DEF by shuffling up to 3 Galaxy Type monsters from your field and/or Graveyard into the owner's Deck as material.

691ca3db47d11a6da137bbab.name: Princess Cosmos' Astronomical Observation
691ca3db47d11a6da137bbab.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Princess Cosmos' Astronomical Observation".
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 5 or lower Galaxy Type monster with 900 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand.

691ca4004b33c680aec97799.name: Princess Cosmos' Beauty Sleep
691ca4004b33c680aec97799.description:
This card's name becomes "Jest of the Cosmos Princess" while in the hand or Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] When a player Normal Summons a monster, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy that Normal Summoned monster. Then, you can draw 2 cards.

691ca5184b33c680aec984d8.name: Wish of OuTerverSe the World-Shattering Emperor (L)
691ca5184b33c680aec984d8.description:
This card's name becomes "OuTerverSe" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects. Then, you can make up to 3 face-up monsters on your opponent's field become Fairy Type until the end of this turn.

691ca52a4b33c680aec985da.name: Wish of OuTerverSe the World-Shattering Emperor
691ca52a4b33c680aec985da.description:
You can Maximum Summon this card together with "Wish of OuTerverSe the World-Shattering Emperor [L]" and "Wish of OuTerverSe the World-Shattering Emperor [R]". This card's name becomes "OuTerverSe" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Face-up non-Galaxy Type monsters on your opponent's field lose 3000 ATK. During your turn, this card becomes Galaxy Type, and it inflicts piercing battle damage.

691ca53e4b33c680aec986b5.name: Wish of OuTerverSe the World-Shattering Emperor (R)
691ca53e4b33c680aec986b5.description:
This card's name becomes "OuTerverSe" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Maximum Mode
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] During your opponent's turn, this card gains ATK equal to [the number of face-up non-Galaxy Type monsters on your opponent's field] x 3000.

691ca5594b33c680aec98811.name: OuTerverSe Wish of Angeleva
691ca5594b33c680aec98811.description:
This card's name becomes "Wish of OuTerverSe the World-Shattering Emperor [L]" while in the hand, and this card's name becomes "OuTerverSe" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] This card is not in Maximum Mode.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 10 "OuTerverSe" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can make this card become Galaxy Type until the end of this turn.

691ca5784b33c680aec9894d.name: OuTerverSe Wish of Devilgear
691ca5784b33c680aec9894d.description:
This card's name becomes "Wish of OuTerverSe the World-Shattering Emperor [R]" while in the hand, and this card's name becomes "OuTerverSe" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] This card is not in Maximum Mode.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 10 "OuTerverSe" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can make this card become Galaxy Type until the end of this turn.

691ca5964b33c680aec98ad1.name: OuTerverSe Mother Fungus
691ca5964b33c680aec98ad1.description:
"OuTerverSe Bug Fungus" + 1 non-LIGHT Attribute monster
This card's name becomes "OuTerverSe" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 "OuTerverSe" from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] This card becomes Galaxy Type until the end of this turn. Then, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

691ca5ad4b33c680aec98bf1.name: Condurglar the Assisting Anthem
691ca5ad4b33c680aec98bf1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 WIND Attribute Psychic Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck, except monsters with 1300 ATK.
[EFFECT] Increase this card's Level by 3 until the end of this turn. Then, you can Set 1 "Nobody Scat Thief" or "Traditional Tax" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone. If you do, you can change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field.

691ca6614b33c680aec993e9.name: Legend Lineage Magician
691ca6614b33c680aec993e9.description:
This card is treated as a Legend Card while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card inflicts piercing battle damage. This Attack Position card cannot be changed to Defense Position by your opponent's card effects.

691ca67347d11a6da137d71b.name: Legend Necromancer
691ca67347d11a6da137d71b.description:
This card is treated as a Legend Card while in the hand or Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 LIGHT Attribute monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Set 1 Ritual Spell Card from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

691ca6834b33c680aec995c6.name: Grand Legend Saber Spirit
691ca6834b33c680aec995c6.description:
This card is treated as a Legend Card while in the hand or Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 7 LIGHT Attribute Legend monster with 300 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Grand Legend Saber Spirit".

691ca69947d11a6da137d891.name: Legend Possessed
691ca69947d11a6da137d891.description:
This card is treated as a Legend Card while in the hand or Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Legend Possessed".
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Legend Lineage Magician" by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 10 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). You cannot use non-Legend monsters in the hand as material by this effect.

691ca6ba4b33c680aec99887.name: Excutie Leya Frontier
691ca6ba4b33c680aec99887.description:
"Excutie Leya" + "Excutie Plawtie"
This card can be Contact Fusioned.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only attack with monsters with 500 DEF this turn.

691ca6cd47d11a6da137da83.name: Excutie Pegasus
691ca6cd47d11a6da137da83.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Excutie Leya" or 1 "Excutie Riding!" from your Graveyard to your hand. If you added "Excutie Riding!" by this effect, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1800 ATK until the end of this turn.

691ca6e44b33c680aec9999b.name: Cattle Healer Amore
691ca6e44b33c680aec9999b.description:
"Towline Cattle Healer" + 1 Level 4 or lower WIND Attribute monster
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Neither player takes battle damage from battles involving this card. During your turn, this card gains 200 ATK.

691ca6f847d11a6da137dd62.name: The Battle Bump
691ca6f847d11a6da137dd62.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Equip to 1 face-up monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The equipped monster gains 200 ATK. While the equipped monster is face-up on your field, your opponent cannot activate Equip Spell Cards. If the equipped monster battles an opponent's Defense Position monster, but the opponent's monster was not destroyed, change that opponent's monster to face-up Attack Position.

691ca7114b33c680aec99bea.name: Rescue Rabbit
691ca7114b33c680aec99bea.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place this face-up card from your field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower Normal Monsters with the same Type from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Destroy the monsters Special Summoned by this effect during the End Phase of this turn. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Rescue Rabbit".

6920464a69f03f0c9e597447.name: Lev Shaddoll Fusion
6920464a69f03f0c9e597447.description: When this card is activated: Send 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to the GY. You can Tribute 1 Fusion Monster; Special Summon 1 "Shaddoll" Fusion Monster with a different Attribute from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Fusion Summon), but its ATK becomes 0. You can only use each effect of "Lev Shaddoll Fusion" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except "Shaddoll" monsters.

6921eb290aac202dcb6e8af9.name: Learning Elf
6921eb290aac202dcb6e8af9.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 Trap from your Deck with an effect that equips itself as an Equip Card. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Learning Elf" once per turn.

6921eb9f0aac202dcb6ea5a4.name: Masked HERO Fountain
6921eb9f0aac202dcb6ea5a4.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "HERO" monster from your hand in Defense Position. If this card is sent to the GY by card effect, or to activate a card effect: You can Set 1 "Mask Change" from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Masked HERO Fountain" once per turn.

6921ebc3eaacc1c2bdf3fe98.name: Poisonous Viper
6921ebc3eaacc1c2bdf3fe98.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon it, or if your opponent controls no monsters, Special Summon it to their field in Defense Position instead. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 500 damage. If this card is banished, or sent to the GY by card effect: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy it. Your opponent cannot activate that card in response to this effect's activation. You can only use this effect of "Poisonous Viper" once per turn.

6921ebe5eaacc1c2bdf40080.name: Junk Armor
6921ebe5eaacc1c2bdf40080.description: Your opponent cannot target Synchro Monsters you control with "Warrior" or "Stardust" in their original names, with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Junk Armor" once per turn. If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Junk" or "Synchron" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Junk Armor".

6921ec038b006b54e396f0d5.name: Junk Meister
6921ec038b006b54e396f0d5.description: If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 "Warrior" or "Stardust" Synchro Monster in your Extra Deck; Special Summon this card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Junk" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Junk Meister". You can target 1 "Junk" monster you control; reduce its Level by up to 2. You can only use each effect of "Junk Meister" once per turn.

6921ec23eaacc1c2bdf405dc.name: Sky Striker Mecha - Adil Saber
6921ec23eaacc1c2bdf405dc.description: During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then target 1 "Sky Striker" monster on the field; it gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 "Sky Striker" Link Monster you control; equip this card to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 1500 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Sky Striker Mecha - Adil Saber" once per turn.

6921ec6e0aac202dcb6eb79c.name: Armament Reincarnation
6921ec6e0aac202dcb6eb79c.description:
Special Summon "Armament Reincarnation Tokens" (Warrior/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 500/DEF 500) up to the number of cards in your GY, that are Equip Spells OR Traps with effects that equip themselves as Equip Cards, then you can apply the following effect, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn.
● Destroy as many cards in your Spell & Trap Zone as possible, including this card, then Set as many cards as possible from your GY, that are Equip Spells OR Traps with effects that equip themselves as Equip Cards. These Set Traps can be activated this turn.

6921ec7d8b006b54e396fc78.name: Mirror Barrier
6921ec7d8b006b54e396fc78.description:
Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to it with the following effect.
● Once per Battle Step, if the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster: You can destroy that opponent's monster.
If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 "Armament Reincarnation" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mirror Barrier" once per turn.

6921ec8d8b006b54e3970284.name: Fallen Angel in Darkness
6921ec8d8b006b54e3970284.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Darklord" card.)
Send 1 Fairy monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Darklord" monster from your hand, Deck, or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only activate 1 "Fallen Angel in Darkness" per turn.

6921ec9aeaacc1c2bdf40fd2.name: Over Tuning
6921ec9aeaacc1c2bdf40fd2.description: If you control a Tuner: Special Summon 1 Tuner from your hand, Deck, or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Synchro Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Over Tuning" per turn.

6921ecb18b006b54e397071c.name: Champion's Pulse
6921ecb18b006b54e397071c.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● During your opponent's Battle Phase: Your opponent gains 1000 LP, then end the Battle Phase.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect, while they control more cards than you do: Special Summon 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" or "Hot Red Dragon Archfiend" from your Extra Deck or GY, and if you do, negate that effect, and if you do that, destroy that card.
You can only activate 1 "Champion's Pulse" per turn.

6921ecc08b006b54e3970881.name: Gagaga Illusion
6921ecc08b006b54e3970881.description: If you control a "Gagaga" monster: Target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it, then you can make its Level/Rank become equal to that of 1 "Gagaga" monster you control. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Gagaga" monster. You can only use each effect of "Gagaga Illusion" once per turn.

6921ecd5eaacc1c2bdf4148c.name: Gagaga Escape
6921ecd5eaacc1c2bdf4148c.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect, while you control a "Gagaga" monster: Negate the activation, then you can discard 1 card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Gagaga" monster from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; change as many "Gagaga" monsters you control as possible to Defense Position, and if you do, for the rest of this turn, "Gagaga" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You can only use each effect of "Gagaga Escape" once per turn.

6921ece98b006b54e3970ba3.name: Endless Bond
6921ece98b006b54e3970ba3.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Xyz" card.)
When this card is activated: You can Special Summon 1 "Number 39: Utopia" from your GY, and if you do, it gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of all LIGHT "Utopia" and "Utopic" Xyz Monsters in your GY. When your attacking "Utopia" or "Utopic" Xyz Monster whose original Attribute is LIGHT destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can make your monster lose exactly 1000 ATK, and if you do, it can attack again in a row. You can only activate 1 "Endless Bond" per turn.

6921ecffeaacc1c2bdf41884.name: Thorns of Violet Poison
6921ecffeaacc1c2bdf41884.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Predap" card.)
Target 1 "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon" in your Monster Zone; it cannot attack this turn, also destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible with less ATK than that monster, then you can discard your entire hand, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of monsters destroyed by this effect.

6921ed118b006b54e3970f74.name: Penetration Fusion
6921ed118b006b54e3970f74.description:
If a monster(s) was destroyed by battle this turn: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field, and if you do, it gains this effect.
● (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card, then target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 500 ATK.
You can only activate 1 "Penetration Fusion" per turn.

6921ed1f8b006b54e39710a3.name: Surprise Fusion
6921ed1f8b006b54e39710a3.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control, then declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; that monster becomes that Type and Attribute, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control, including that monster. You can banish this card from your GY; Tribute 1 Fusion Monster, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Surprise Tokens" (Spellcaster/DARK/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the same Level as the Tributed monster had on the field. You can only use this effect of "Surprise Fusion" once per turn.

6922d3d1e66c31963df3150e.name: Verre, the Maid of Endymion
6922d3d1e66c31963df3150e.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Witchcrafter" card.)
Gains 2300 ATK while you have "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your field or GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Verre, the Maid of Endymion" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if a Spell Card or effect was activated this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell/Trap or "Magical Dimension" from your Deck to your hand.

692e7e3a10398f7f971e8480.name: Curse of the Rising Light
692e7e3a10398f7f971e8480.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 1 card or less in their hand.
[EFFECT] Change 1 monster on your opponent's field to face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. Then, if your opponent activated a Trap Card this turn, or if this turn is the first turn of the player going second, each player draws 2 cards.

6932294cbed2c9fcaaebfe00.name: Heavy Armored Knight Babeldecker
6932294cbed2c9fcaaebfe00.description: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Heavy Armored Knight Babeldecker" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 EARTH Machine monster from your hand. During your Main Phase, if your opponent activated a card or effect this turn: You can Special Summon 1 Rank 10 EARTH Machine Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck using this card you control as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon).

69322970bed2c9fcaaec02b5.name: Night Train Blue Traveler
69322970bed2c9fcaaec02b5.description: You can discard this card; add 1 "Train Connection" or "Revolving Switchyard" from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 other EARTH Machine monster in your GY; Special Summon both it and this card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Machine monsters. You can only use this effect of "Night Train Blue Traveler" once per Duel, and its previous effect only once per turn.

693229b3d655c36a12358ae4.name: Fairy Tail - Matchgiru
693229b3d655c36a12358ae4.description: If a Spellcaster monster with 1850 original ATK is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Spellcaster monsters. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Fairy Tail" Spell/Trap or 1 "Fairy Tale Tails" from your Deck to your hand. You can pay 500 LP; the name of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls becomes "Prince of Fairies". You can only use each effect of "Fairy Tail - Matchgiru" once per turn.

693229cbd655c36a12358cc4.name: Weaver of Fairy Tails
693229cbd655c36a12358cc4.description:
1 "Fairy Tail" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
All "Prince of Fairies" on the field become Spellcaster monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Fairy Tail" monster from your Deck or banishment. You can only use this effect of "Weaver of Fairy Tails" once per turn. If you Normal or Special Summon a non-EARTH "Fairy Tail" monster, while this card is in your Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, also its name becomes "Prince of Fairies".

693229eebed2c9fcaaec12d1.name: Teller of Fairy Tails
693229eebed2c9fcaaec12d1.description:
1 LIGHT "Fairy Tail" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
"Fairy Tail" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Teller of Fairy Tails" once per turn. If this card is Fusion Summoned using "Prince of Fairies" as material: You can destroy as many cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each card destroyed. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "Fairy Tail" card from your hand or GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

69322a1ed655c36a12359229.name: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket
69322a1ed655c36a12359229.description:
3 Level 10 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket" by discarding 1 card and using 1 "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max" you control (transfer its materials). When your opponent activates a monster effect, while this card has material (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card, then inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. You can only use this effect of "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket" once per turn. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Detach 1 material from this card or destroy this card.

69322a3cbed2c9fcaaec1b79.name: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher
69322a3cbed2c9fcaaec1b79.description:
2 Level 10 monsters
During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 Machine monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). You can only use each of the following effects of "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher" once per turn. If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can add 1 EARTH Machine monster or 1 "Barrage Blast" from your Deck to your hand. You can detach any number of materials from this card, then target that many Spells/Traps on the field; destroy them.

69322a6bd655c36a123597d0.name: Fairy Tail - Wiccat
69322a6bd655c36a123597d0.description:
2 Level 4 Spellcaster monsters
Each "Fairy Tail" monster you control whose original Attribute is LIGHT, is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Fairy Tail - Wiccat" once per turn. You can detach up to 2 materials from this card; send "Fairy Tail" cards from your Deck to the GY, equal to the number detached. If this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Fairy Tail" monster you control whose original Attribute is LIGHT; Special Summon this card, and if you do, send that monster to the GY.

69322a8bbed2c9fcaaec24de.name: Exceptional Schedule
69322a8bbed2c9fcaaec24de.description: Add 1 "Special Schedule" or "Urgent Schedule" from your Deck to your hand, then you can Special Summon 1 "Diagram Token" (Machine/EARTH/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 3000) to your opponent's field. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 10 Machine monster in your GY or banishment; send 1 card you control to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon that monster. You can only use each effect of "Exceptional Schedule" once per turn.

69322aaabed2c9fcaaec2921.name: Once Upon a Fairy Tail
69322aaabed2c9fcaaec2921.description: Special Summon up to 1 LIGHT "Fairy Tail" monster each from your hand, GY, and banishment, with different names, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Spellcaster monsters. If this card is banished, or sent to the GY except from the field: You can Set this card, but it cannot be activated unless you control a "Fairy Tail" monster. You can only use each effect of "Once Upon a Fairy Tail" once per turn.

69322abd60185ac022e751ed.name: Fairy Tail Ball
69322abd60185ac022e751ed.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Fairy Tail" monster or 1 "Fairy Tale Tails" from your Deck or banishment to your hand. Your "Fairy Tail" monsters can attack directly. Once per turn, if your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) and you control a "Fairy Tail" monster (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, also its name becomes "Prince of Fairies". You can only activate 1 "Fairy Tail Ball" per turn.

69322ad17f4cc0feb5fb9717.name: Tails of the Fairy Tails
69322ad17f4cc0feb5fb9717.description: The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Spellcaster Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand, field, and/or "Prince of Fairies" your opponent controls as material. If this card is in your GY: You can equip this card to 1 "Fairy Tail" monster on the field, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 Spellcaster monster with 1850 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Tails of the Fairy Tails" once per turn.

69364ecea5caf3ae66d56df8.name: Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
69364ecea5caf3ae66d56df8.description: When a monster on the field activates its effect, or when a Spell/Trap that is already face-up on the field activates its effect (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; destroy that card on the field. You can only use this effect of "Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit" once per turn.

69364edda5caf3ae66d56f87.name: Dimension Shifter
69364edda5caf3ae66d56f87.description: If you have no cards in your GY (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; until the end of the next turn, any card sent to the GY is banished instead.

69364f01a5caf3ae66d572e2.name: Sky Striker Ace - Roze
69364f01a5caf3ae66d572e2.description: If a "Sky Striker Ace" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned, except "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If an opponent's monster in the Extra Monster Zone is destroyed by battle, or leaves the field by your card effect, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, then you can negate the effects of 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" once per turn.

69364f16a5caf3ae66d57558.name: Vanquish Soul Razen
69364f16a5caf3ae66d57558.description:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 non-Warrior "Vanquish Soul" monster from your Deck to your hand. (Quick Effect): You can activate 1 of these effects, by revealing monster(s) in your hand with the listed Attribute(s);
● FIRE: This card cannot be destroyed by card effects this turn.
● FIRE & DARK: Destroy all other monsters in this card's column.
You can only use each effect of "Vanquish Soul Razen" once per turn, and cannot activate more than 1 in the same Chain.

69364f28a5caf3ae66d57865.name: Nightmare Apprentice
69364f28a5caf3ae66d57865.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 card. You can only Special Summon "Nightmare Apprentice" once per turn this way. If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Illusion monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Nightmare Apprentice". You can only use this effect of "Nightmare Apprentice" once per turn.

69364f34b939a0ff56398eea.name: Maliss P White Rabbit
69364f34b939a0ff56398eea.description:
You take no damage from battles involving "Maliss" Link Monsters that point to this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Maliss

White Rabbit" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Maliss" Trap from your Deck with a different name than the cards in your GY. If this card is banished: You can pay 300 LP; Special Summon it, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Link Monsters.

69364f49a5caf3ae66d58939.name: Gimmick Puppet Fantasix Machinix
69364f49a5caf3ae66d58939.description:
2 Level 8 monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your Deck to your hand, also you can Normal Summon 1 Machine monster during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). If you Special Summon a "Gimmick Puppet" Xyz Monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY to either field in Defense Position, then you can add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gimmick Puppet Fantasix Machinix" once per turn.

69364f5bb939a0ff56399203.name: Foolish Burial
69364f5bb939a0ff56399203.description: Send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY.

69364f6da5caf3ae66d58c87.name: Infernity Launcher
69364f6da5caf3ae66d58c87.description: Once per turn: You can send 1 "Infernity" monster from your hand to the GY. You can send this face-up card from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, then target up to 2 "Infernity" monsters in your GY; Special Summon them. You must have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.

69364f7fb939a0ff563994a1.name: Infinite Impermanence
69364f7fb939a0ff563994a1.description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects (until the end of this turn), then if this card was Set before activation and is on the field at resolution, for the rest of this turn all other Spell/Trap effects in this column are negated. If you control no cards, you can activate this card from your hand.

6936e7419b19451c53d1523c.name: Regulus, the Prince of Endymion
6936e7419b19451c53d1523c.description: The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. You can only use each of the following effects of "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 other Spellcaster monster in your hand; you lose LP equal to the revealed monster's Level x 300, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell that mentions "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" from your Deck to your hand.

6936e7aeceac9db057c742dc.name: Genni, the Maid of Endymion
6936e7aeceac9db057c742dc.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Witchcrafter" card.)
If you control a Spellcaster monster and this card is in your hand: You can Special Summon this card. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Spellcaster monster you control; banish it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Witchcrafter" monster from your Deck, except "Genni, the Maid of Endymion". You can only use each effect of "Genni, the Maid of Endymion" once per turn.

6936e81069c129b71bf6223c.name: Empire of Endymion
6936e81069c129b71bf6223c.description: When this card is activated: Add 1 "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" or 1 monster that mentions it from your Deck to your hand, then if your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster monster from your hand. If a card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your hand or face-up field instead. You can only use this effect of "Empire of Endymion" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Empire of Endymion" per turn.

6936e83f69c129b71bf62746.name: Arrow of Regulus
6936e83f69c129b71bf62746.description:
If you control "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion": Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls that battled this turn.
● When a Normal or Quick-Play Spell Card is activated: Negate that effect.
During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" or 1 monster that mentions it in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Arrow of Regulus" once per turn.

693b8f7ee2f0b06b964c343b.name: Hiita the Fire Charmer
693b8f7ee2f0b06b964c343b.description: FLIP: Target 1 FIRE monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster while this card is face-up on the field.

693b8fa0e2f0b06b964c3829.name: Wynn the Wind Charmer
693b8fa0e2f0b06b964c3829.description: FLIP: Target 1 WIND monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster while this card is face-up on the field.

693b8face2f0b06b964c391c.name: Eria the Water Charmer
693b8face2f0b06b964c391c.description: FLIP: Target 1 WATER monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster while this card is face-up on the field.

693b8fb74dbd0aa40364b1a1.name: Aussa the Earth Charmer
693b8fb74dbd0aa40364b1a1.description: FLIP: Target 1 EARTH monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster while this card is face-up on the field.

693f7ea0ce40358adaf90139.name: Black Luster Soldier
693f7ea0ce40358adaf90139.description: The mightiest warrior, whose abilities equal the Blue-Eyes White Dragon.

6942d4c9e40446483d3d6812.name: Archfiend Matriarch
6942d4c9e40446483d3d6812.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You can target 1 "Archfiend" Spell/Trap in your GY or banishment; destroy this card, and if you do, add that target to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Archfiend Matriarch" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
You can Ritual Summon this card with "Throne of the Archfiends". Must be Ritual Summoned. Unaffected by other monsters' effects while in the Extra Monster Zone. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can destroy as many Spells/Traps your opponent controls as possible, then if this card is in the Extra Monster Zone, you can banish all Spells/Traps from your opponent's GY. You can only use this effect of "Archfiend Matriarch" once per turn.

6942d4f7eb1dc3118af40691.name: Archfiend's Usurpation
6942d4f7eb1dc3118af40691.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Set 1 "Archfiend" Trap from your Deck or GY. It can be activated this turn.
● Ritual Summon 1 "Archfiend" Ritual Monster from your hand or face-up Extra Deck, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level.
You can only activate 1 "Archfiend's Usurpation" per turn.

6942d52ee40446483d3d706d.name: Fleeting Phantom Mask Master
6942d52ee40446483d3d706d.description: If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 Fiend, Illusion, or Spellcaster monster from your Deck to the GY, then you can make this card's Type become the original Type of that sent monster. If this card is in your GY: You can banish 1 Spell from your GY; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Fleeting Phantom Mask Master" once per Duel, and its previous effect only once per turn.

6946436d85756fa8561b2455.name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon
6946436d85756fa8561b2455.description: A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.

6946442a9c734a6a31eaf849.name: Dimension Linker
6946442a9c734a6a31eaf849.description:
Duel Dimension System Activated–
Born in the Sea of Neuron, a proud swordswoman who journeyed across nine dimensions.
Her blade, wielded alongside countless Duelists, is not meant to sever, but to unite.

People's hope link beyond time and space.

6947062fcaeb20b7384c25d4.name: Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon
6947062fcaeb20b7384c25d4.description:
"Dark Magician" + "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" or 1 Dragon Effect Monster
Cannot be destroyed by card effects. Neither player can target this card with card effects. During your Main Phase: You can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK. You can use this effect a number of times per turn up to the number of Normal Monsters used as Fusion Material for this card. Once per turn, when a card or effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, and if you do that, this card gains 1000 ATK.

6947063a649f7306c2078e47.name: Dominus Purge
6947063a649f7306c2078e47.description: If your opponent controls a card, you can activate this card from your hand. When a card or effect is activated that includes an effect that adds a card(s) from the Deck to the hand: Negate that effect, then if you have a Trap in your GY, destroy that card. If you activated this card from your hand, you cannot activate the effects of DARK, WATER, and FIRE monsters for the rest of this Duel. You can only activate 1 "Dominus Purge" per turn.

694706f0caeb20b7384c3576.name: Kurikara Divincarnate
694706f0caeb20b7384c3576.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing all face-up monsters on the field that activated their effects this turn in your opponent's Monster Zone. Gains 1500 ATK for each monster Tributed to Special Summon this card. During your End Phase: You can target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your field. You can only use this effect of "Kurikara Divincarnate" once per turn.

6947071b73f1136e4c0c26d3.name: Super Polymerization
6947071b73f1136e4c0c26d3.description: Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

6947072c73f1136e4c0c27f6.name: Wake Up Your Elemental HERO
6947072c73f1136e4c0c27f6.description:
1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster + 1+ Warrior monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 300 ATK for each material used for its Summon. Can make a number of attacks on monsters each Battle Phase, up to the number of Fusion Monsters used as material for its Summon. After damage calculation, if this card battled a monster: Destroy that monster, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK. If this Fusion Summoned card is destroyed: Special Summon 1 Warrior monster from your hand or Deck.

6947073d8f70e9b6225d24aa.name: Shooting Quasar Dragon
6947073d8f70e9b6225d24aa.description:
1 Tuner Synchro Monster + 2+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned. Can attack a number of times each Battle Phase, up to the number of non-Tuners used for its Synchro Summon. Once per turn, when a card or effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. When this face-up card leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "Shooting Star Dragon" from your Extra Deck.

6947727685756fa8561b3510.name: Elemental HERO Burst Wingman
6947727685756fa8561b3510.description:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] 1 face-up Warrior Type monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

6947727eb225fa3e3d6c2cec.name: Pulglace Spierce
6947727eb225fa3e3d6c2cec.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change the battle position of this card (Attack Position to face-up Defense Position, Defense Position becomes face-up Attack Position).
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up monster on your field. This turn, that monster gains 1000 ATK, and it inflicts piercing battle damage.

6947729085756fa8561b3521.name: Cyber Rush Dragon
6947729085756fa8561b3521.description:
"Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has a monster on their field.
[Effect] Draw until you have 5 cards in your hand. Then, send 4 cards from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Machine Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

69486a45cc3b933d5cad30e8.name: Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant
69486a45cc3b933d5cad30e8.description: This card's name becomes "Dark Magician" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant" per turn, and only once that turn. If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 Spell in your hand; Special Summon this card, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Magician" from your Deck. (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Spell; destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.

69486c39131604f9a8437d13.name: Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant
69486c39131604f9a8437d13.description: This card's name becomes "Dark Magician" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant" per turn, and only once that turn. If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 Spell in your hand; Special Summon this card, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Magician" from your Deck. (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Spell; destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.

69486c91d8043dc79533f710.name: Favorite HERO Shining Flare Wingman
69486c91d8043dc79533f710.description:
1 Fusion Monster + 1 face-up monster on the field
(This card is always treated as an "Elemental HERO" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can shuffle 5 monsters from your GY into the Deck, then draw 2 cards, and if you do, this card gains 1000 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Favorite HERO Shining Flare Wingman" once per turn. If this card destroys a monster by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

69486ccccc3b933d5cad316e.name: Stardust Dragon - Victim Sanctuary
69486ccccc3b933d5cad316e.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your card or effect activation (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate the activation of your opponent's card or effect, and if you do, destroy that card. If a monster(s) in your possession was Tributed this turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Stardust" Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Stardust Dragon - Victim Sanctuary" once per turn, and cannot activate more than 1 in the same Chain.

69486cfecc3b933d5cad3179.name: Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light
69486cfecc3b933d5cad3179.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle, except with a "Number" monster. (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 monster you control; the first time it would be destroyed by battle or card effect this turn, it is not destroyed. When the second attack of each turn is declared: You can make this card gain 2500 ATK, and if you do, it gains this effect.
● When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon it to your field.

69486d558db5a5b342f5083d.name: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
69486d558db5a5b342f5083d.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
During your Main Phase: You can destroy this card, and if you do, add 1 Pendulum Monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot activate monster effects on the field until you Pendulum Summon. You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
This Pendulum Summoned card gains these effects.
● Gains ATK equal to the difference in the Pendulum Scales of the 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones x 300.
● Any battle damage your opponent takes from battles involving this card is doubled.
If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can add this card to your hand, then if it was destroyed by your opponent's card, you can Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

69486dc17fff721c2d2ab34f.name: Master Spirit Tech Force - Pendulum Ruler
69486dc17fff721c2d2ab34f.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
During your Main Phase: You can return this card to the Extra Deck, then you can add 1 Level 7 Pendulum Monster from your Deck or face-up Extra Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Master Spirit Tech Force - Pendulum Ruler" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
1 Level 7 or higher Pendulum Monster + 1 Pendulum Monster
Cannot be destroyed by card effects. Your opponent's monsters cannot attack, except Pendulum Monsters without a Level. You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it, and if you do, inflict 1600 damage to your opponent. You can use this effect of "Master Spirit Tech Force - Pendulum Ruler" twice per turn. Once per turn: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

69486e128665ec9779b06c2a.name: Decode Talker Integration
69486e128665ec9779b06c2a.description:
2+ Effect Monsters
While this card is in the Extra Monster Zone, it gains 500 ATK for every other Link Monster in the field and the GYs, also your opponent cannot target it with card effects. (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster this card points to; send 1 Cyberse monster from your Extra Deck to the GY, also this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. You can only use this effect of "Decode Talker Integration" once per turn.

69486e5bd8043dc79533f79f.name: Borreload Liberator Dragon
69486e5bd8043dc79533f79f.description:
3+ Effect Monsters
You can only Special Summon "Borreload Liberator Dragon(s)" once per turn. Once per turn, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can place 1 monster your opponent controls in a zone this card points to and take control of it. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. Once per Chain, if this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

69486e9b8db5a5b342f508ac.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon, the White Phantom Beast
69486e9b8db5a5b342f508ac.description: When this card is added from the Deck to your hand, or a monster you control is destroyed by battle: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned from the hand or Deck: You can destroy all monsters your opponent controls, also you can only attack directly with "Blue-Eyes" monsters for the rest of this turn. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Blue-Eyes White Dragon, the White Phantom Beast" once per turn. When a card or effect is activated that targets this card on the field (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate that effect.

69486eeae3ea042050503234.name: Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon
69486eeae3ea042050503234.description:
3 Machine monsters with 2100 or more ATK
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Fusion Summoned using only LIGHT monsters: You can pay 4000 LP; add 1 "Limiter Removal" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon" once per turn. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. While its ATK is higher than its original ATK, this card can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase.

69486f19c4ecd273ac3e32dd.name: Crimson Dragon Quetzalcoatl
69486f19c4ecd273ac3e32dd.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
Gains ATK equal to the total original ATK of all other Synchro Monsters you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Crimson Dragon Quetzalcoatl" once per turn. If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon as many Dragon Synchro Monsters from your GY as possible, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can return 1 other Dragon Synchro Monster you control to the Extra Deck, and if you do, negate that activation.

69486f538665ec9779b06cd3.name: Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon - Photon Howling
69486f538665ec9779b06cd3.description:
3 Level 8 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon - Photon Howling" by using 1 Rank 8 Xyz Monster you control (transfer its materials). If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can take 1 "Photon" monster from your Deck, and either Special Summon it in Defense Position or attach it to this card as material. (Quick Effect): You can detach 3 materials from this card; Tribute 1 other Xyz Monster, and if you do, negate the effects of all other face-up cards currently on the field until the end of this turn.

69486f7e75dd1056d1a46c8b.name: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
69486f7e75dd1056d1a46c8b.description:
2 DARK monsters on the field
(This card is always treated as a "Predaplant" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 other face-up monster on the field; change its ATK to 0, negate its effects, also it becomes DARK. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using DARK monsters on either field, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

69486fbacc3b933d5cad32cf.name: Gatling Ogre
69486fbacc3b933d5cad32cf.description: You can send any number of face-down cards from your Spell & Trap Zone to the GY; inflict 800 damage to your opponent for each, also your opponent takes no damage from non-Fiend monsters' effects for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Gatling Ogre" thrice per turn. Once per turn, when this card is targeted for an attack: You can inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each Attack Position monster they control, then end the Battle Phase.

69486fe6a3979e6ba7dbde6f.name: Infernity Doom Slinger
69486fe6a3979e6ba7dbde6f.description:
During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your hand. If you have no cards in your hand (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; your opponent chooses 1 of these effects for you to apply.
● Reveal the top card of your Deck, and if it is a monster, your opponent takes any effect damage you would have taken this turn instead. Otherwise, you take 4000 damage.
● You take no effect damage this turn.
You can only use each effect of "Infernity Doom Slinger" once per turn.

69487025bff3bb5609e270af.name: Dark Ceruvim Irisfil
69487025bff3bb5609e270af.description:
2 Level 8 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Dark Ceruvim Irisfil" by using 1 Xyz Monster you control that did not activate its effects in the Monster Zone this turn (transfer its materials). If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the Battle Phase of this turn, Xyz Monsters you control gain ATK equal to their Rank x 100. If this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from a monster you control instead. You can only use this effect of "Dark Ceruvim Irisfil" once per turn.

694870c78665ec9779b06d42.name: Predaplant Lilizard
694870c78665ec9779b06d42.description: If you control a "Predaplant" or "Starving Venom" monster and this card is in your hand: You can Special Summon this card, then you can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; it becomes DARK until the end of this turn. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Predaplant Lilizard" once per turn.

694871101bf6012e25188b80.name: Predaplant Longinephila
694871101bf6012e25188b80.description:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Predap" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Predaplant Longinephila". You can banish this card from your GY, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Place 1 Predator Counter on 1 face-up monster on the field, and if you do, any of those monsters that are Level 2 or higher become Level 1 as long as they have a Predator Counter.
● Set 1 "Polymerization" from your GY or banishment.
You can only use each effect of "Predaplant Longinephila" once per turn.

694871576b25e2eb8c8be599.name: Starving Venom Wing Dragon
694871576b25e2eb8c8be599.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Each time a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field, place 1 Predator Counter on it, and if it is Level 2 or higher, it becomes Level 1 as long as it has a Predator Counter.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
1 Fusion Monster + 1 "Clear Wing" monster
Once per turn, if your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) face-up (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; this card gains ATK equal to that monster's ATK, and if it does, that monster's effects are negated. These changes last until the end of this turn. Once per turn, when another card or their effect is activated on the field (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 card on the field. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

694871a81bf6012e25188bbd.name: Predaplant Bal Teah
694871a81bf6012e25188bbd.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Predaplant" or "Starving Venom" monster from your face-up Extra Deck or GY. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field (except during the Damage Step): You can banish 1 "Polymerization" and this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Predaplant Bal Teah" once per turn.

6948720c131604f9a8437f10.name: Red Hypernova Dragon
6948720c131604f9a8437f10.description:
4 Tuners + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned with the above materials. Gains 500 ATK for each Tuner in your GY. Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects, also it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card, also banish as many cards in your opponent's field and GY as possible, then you can Special Summon 1 "Red Nova Dragon" from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Synchro Summon).

6948731ee7e7f1a00108fc1b.name: Assault Sonic Warrior
6948731ee7e7f1a00108fc1b.description: If you control "Junk Warrior", "Assault Mode Activate", or a card that mentions either of those cards: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Synchron" monster or 1 "Assault Mode Activate" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can make all monsters you control gain 500 ATK, for the rest of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Assault Sonic Warrior" once per turn.

694874d85e1745f6741984c8.name: Spiritual Art Familiars
694874d85e1745f6741984c8.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Familiar-Possessed" card.)
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Possessed" Spell/Trap or 1 "Grand Spiritual Art - Ichirin" from your Deck to your hand. You can declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; this card becomes that Type and Attribute until the end of this turn. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster monster with 1500 DEF from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Spiritual Art Familiars" once per turn.

6948753abff3bb5609e271ac.name: Charmer Quartet in Bloom
6948753abff3bb5609e271ac.description:
2+ monsters
Gains 300 ATK for each different Attribute on the field. Once, while this card is face-up on the field, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 2 monsters in your GY with the same Attribute but different Types, or with the same Type but different Attributes; Special Summon both, also until the end of the next turn, this card and the Special Summoned monsters cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon. You can only use this effect of "Charmer Quartet in Bloom" once per turn.

694875c9a3979e6ba7dbdfd6.name: Possessed Destiny
694875c9a3979e6ba7dbdfd6.description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; Special Summon 1 "Charmer" or "Familiar-Possessed" monster with the same Attribute from your hand, Deck, or GY in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position, then you can change that target to face-down Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster you control; change its battle position. You can only use each effect of "Possessed Destiny" once per turn.

694875e734407dc060a04be8.name: Underworld Circle
694875e734407dc060a04be8.description: Activate this card if both players have 5 or more monsters in their GYs; destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, then each player banishes (face-down) as many monsters from their Deck as possible, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: Activate this effect; each player can Special Summon 1 monster from their GY, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only activate 1 "Underworld Circle" per Duel.

6948760ce3ea042050503480.name: Junk Signal
6948760ce3ea042050503480.description:
Activate 1 of these effects (also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters);
● Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 monster, except the Tributed monster, from your hand, Deck, or GY, that is "Junk Warrior" or "Stardust Dragon", or that mentions either of them.
● When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your Synchro Monster's effect activation: Negate that effect.
You can only activate 1 "Junk Signal" per turn.

6948763415ce6383c718d88b.name: Predaprimitive
6948763415ce6383c718d88b.description: Send 1 "Predap" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Predaprimitive"; add 1 "Polymerization" Spell or "Fusion" Spell from your Deck to your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Plant or Dragon monsters. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster you control; destroy it. You can only activate 1 "Predaprimitive" per turn.

694876616b25e2eb8c8be7bf.name: Super Duper Polymerization
694876616b25e2eb8c8be7bf.description:
Pay 2000 LP, then target 1 Effect Monster on the field; Special Summon 1 monster from your Extra Deck, with the same Type and Attribute but a different Level (but negate its effects), then apply 1 of these effects. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.
● Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using the Special Summoned monster and the targeted monster.
● Send the Special Summoned monster to the GY.
You can only activate 1 "Super Duper Polymerization" per turn.

694981852206957906e8c09b.name: Number 99: Utopia Dragonar
694981852206957906e8c09b.description:
3+ Level 12 monsters
(Quick Effect): You can detach 2 materials from this card; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Number" monster that has a number between "1" and "100" in its name (this is treated as an Xyz Summon). The turn you activate this effect, other monsters you control cannot attack directly, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Xyz Monsters. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can change the ATK of the opponent's monster to 0. You can only use each effect of "Number 99: Utopia Dragonar" once per turn.

69498195ea609b2f5710487c.name: Odd-Eyes Arcray Dragon
69498195ea609b2f5710487c.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If you have 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones: You can Special Summon this card, then you can apply this effect.
● Shuffle 1 card from your Pendulum Zone into the Deck, then if it was added to your Extra Deck, you can Special Summon it, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Arcray Dragon" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
4 Dragon monsters (1 Fusion, 1 Synchro, 1 Xyz, and 1 Pendulum)
(This card is always treated as "Supreme King Z-ARC".)
This face-down card in the Extra Deck must first be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned by Tributing 1 Level 12 DARK "Supreme King Z-ARC". If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can place 1 Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

694981a44673698fff9b6bc1.name: Firewall Dragon Singularity
694981a44673698fff9b6bc1.description:
3+ Effect Monsters
(Quick Effect): You can target cards in your opponent's field and/or GY, up to the number of different card types (Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz)  in your field and GY; return them to the hand, also this card gains 500 ATK for each returned card. If a monster this card points to is destroyed by battle, or sent to the GY: You can target 1 Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Firewall Dragon Singularity" once per turn.

694981ba4673698fff9b6d49.name: Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon
694981ba4673698fff9b6d49.description:
"Fallen of Albaz" + 1 Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster
You can only control 1 "Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon". Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to the GY that mentions "Fallen of Albaz" as material; banish 1 monster on the field, also this card cannot use this effect next turn. If this Fusion Summoned card in its owner's control leaves the field by an opponent's card: You can destroy all monsters your opponent controls during the End Phase of this turn.

694981d22206957906e8c8ca.name: Dragon Master Magia
694981d22206957906e8c8ca.description:
"Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" or 3 "Blue-Eyes" monsters + 1 "Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier" Ritual Monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use this effect of "Dragon Master Magia" in response to each card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) once per turn. If this face-up card in its owner's control leaves the field because of an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster or 1 "Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier" Ritual Monster from your Extra Deck or GY.

694981dd4673698fff9b704c.name: Chimeratech Megafleet Dragon
694981dd4673698fff9b704c.description:
1 "Cyber Dragon" monster + 1+ monsters in the Extra Monster Zone
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from either field to the GY. The original ATK of this card becomes 1200 x the number of materials used for its Special Summon.

694981eb2206957906e8cb63.name: Red Supernova Dragon
694981eb2206957906e8cb63.description:
3 Tuners + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for each Tuner in your GY. Cannot be destroyed by an opponent's card effects. Once per turn, when your opponent's monster effect is activated, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack (Quick Effect): You can activate this effect; banish this card, also banish all cards your opponent controls. Once per turn, during your next End Phase after this card was banished by its own effect: Special Summon this banished card.

694981faea609b2f57105325.name: Number 62: Galaxy-Eyes Prime Photon Dragon
694981faea609b2f57105325.description:
2 Level 8 monsters
If this card battles, during damage calculation (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card once per battle; this card gains ATK equal to the combined Ranks of all Xyz Monsters currently on the field x 200, during that damage calculation only. If this card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect while it has "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" as material: You can Special Summon this card during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation and double its ATK. Any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is halved unless it has "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" as material.

694982082206957906e8cecf.name: Supreme King Z-ARC
694982082206957906e8cecf.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz Monsters your opponent controls cannot activate their effects. Once per turn, when a card(s) is added from the Main Deck to your opponent's hand (except during the Draw Phase or the Damage Step): You can destroy that card(s).
