[EFFECT] Draw 3 cards. Then, if you have 4 or more monsters in your Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

699f927ea27872f2888cb513.name: Skullcrag Incursion
699f927ea27872f2888cb513.description:
[REQUIREMENT] There are 3 or more monsters on the field.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, you can Fusion Summon a Zombie Type monster with 0 DEF by shuffling Zombie Type monsters from your field and/or Graveyard into the owner's Deck as material.

699f928e68ec3d208994fce3.name: Destined Doom of the Defiant Souls
699f928e68ec3d208994fce3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Choose up to 2 Attack Position Level 5 or lower WIND Attribute Zombie Type monsters on your field. This turn, those monsters cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects.

699f93daf025d6b4d6dfe498.name: Sparkhearts Passion Girl
699f93daf025d6b4d6dfe498.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other card from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, if you have "Sparks" and "Curtain of Sparks" in your Graveyard, inflict 700 damage to your opponent. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Sparkhearts Passion Girl".

699f93e96f9c57c9484c9009.name: Sparkhearts Passion Anesh
699f93e96f9c57c9484c9009.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other card from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can draw 1 card. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Sparkhearts Passion Anesh".

699f93f92f22e8462ddb0b3c.name: Sparkhearts Passion Makma
699f93f92f22e8462ddb0b3c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Any damage you inflict by the effect of "Sparks" becomes 700. Face-up "Sparkhearts Girl" on your field gain 1300 ATK. Face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose ATK equal to [the number of "Sparks" and "Curtain of Sparks" with different names in your Graveyard] x 400.

699f940c4092e8faef55f4e3.name: Leave it to the Sparkhearts!
699f940c4092e8faef55f4e3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated Ritual Spell Card to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If you have "Sparks" or "Curtain of Sparks" in your Graveyard, excavate 6 cards instead.

699f941e0914a773bcf8f666.name: Sparkhearts Anesh
699f941e0914a773bcf8f666.description:
If you have "Sparks" or "Curtain of Sparks" in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add to your hand 1 FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monster from among the cards sent. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Sparkhearts Anesh".

699f942c72c37fd6df64a754.name: Sparkhearts Makma
699f942c72c37fd6df64a754.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters or 4 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change the battle position of up to 2 face-up monsters on your field and/or monsters on your opponent's field. Then, if you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, you can add up to 4 "Sparkhearts Girl", "Sparks", and/or "Curtain of Sparks" from your Graveyard to your hand.

699f943ab797f795db144ef9.name: Peit the Ally Spark
699f943ab797f795db144ef9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Increase this card's Level by 3 until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Sparkhearts Girl" or 1 "I Need Holy Water to Ward Off Evil Spirits!" from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters.

699f9445abc73edbe7671285.name: Fiarma the Ally Spark
699f9445abc73edbe7671285.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Increase this card's Level by 3 until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Sparkhearts Girl" or 1 "I'm Having Trouble with My Fields Being Destroyed!" from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters.

699f94552614ded0451a0bb2.name: Sparkhearts Hat
699f94552614ded0451a0bb2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send 1 other card from your hand or field to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand, except a monster with 600 ATK. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Sparkhearts Hat".

699f9460669bdf4535fd8851.name: Sparkhearts Familiar
699f9460669bdf4535fd8851.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck during the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send 2 other cards from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard. Then, if you have "Sparkhearts Girl", "Sparks", or "Curtain of Sparks" in your Graveyard, you can draw 2 cards. This turn, you can only attack with FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters.

699f9470c41382b04fde167a.name: I'm Having Trouble with My Fields Being Destroyed!
699f9470c41382b04fde167a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Sparkhearts Passion Girl" or "Sparkhearts Passion Makma" by sending face-up FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard as material whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the monster you Ritual Summon (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). Then, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 6 or lower Beast or Winged Beast Type monster on your opponent's field.

699f9479729e3348d15a33ef.name: I Need Holy Water to Ward Off Evil Spirits!
699f9479729e3348d15a33ef.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Sparkhearts Passion Girl" or "Sparkhearts Passion Anesh" by sending face-up FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard as material whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the monster you Ritual Summon (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). Then, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 6 or lower Fiend or Warrior Type monster on your opponent's field.

699f948430b991fed86203a2.name: Sparkhearts Studio
699f948430b991fed86203a2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by card effects, and face-up Level 6 or lower FIRE Attribute Spellcaster Type monsters on the field gain 400 ATK.

699fc10d62f17e0759a60385.name: Great Moth Alternative
699fc10d62f17e0759a60385.description:
"Cocoon of Evolution" + 1 Level 5 or higher EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster
This card's name becomes "Great Moth" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card's name becomes "Great Moth", and it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Your Level 8 Insect Type monsters inflict piercing battle damage.

699fc1246f9c57c9484d0d33.name: Pupating Larvae Moth
699fc1246f9c57c9484d0d33.description:
"Petit Moth" + 1 Level 5 or lower Insect Type monster
This card can be Contact Fusioned.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Cocoon of Evolution". Then, you can Fusion Summon an EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material, including this card.

699fc147fcd710b9e374ff76.name: Great Moth
699fc147fcd710b9e374ff76.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by sending 1 "Petit Moth" from your field to the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] None

699fc15ac4ab86f4ede26af6.name: Pulsating Cocoon of Evolution
699fc15ac4ab86f4ede26af6.description:

[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Cocoon of Evolution". Then, you can Fusion Summon "Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth" by shuffling monsters from your field and/or Graveyard into the owner's Deck as material, including this card.

699fc16862f17e0759a604c2.name: Double Cannon Armor
699fc16862f17e0759a604c2.description:
If you have a face-up EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster on your field, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster on your field gain 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

699fc174256be32b4099e07c.name: Scissor Hercules
699fc174256be32b4099e07c.description:
If you have a face-up EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster on your field, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing.

[EFFECT] Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated Level 3 or 8 EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

699fc1820b511ef1c27bfeaa.name: Cocoon of Evolution
699fc1820b511ef1c27bfeaa.description:

[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a Level 8 or lower EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material, including this card.

699fc1930b511ef1c27bfed0.name: Swarming Basic Insect
699fc1930b511ef1c27bfed0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have an EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster with 2000 DEF in your Graveyard, send 1 other monster from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Add 1 EARTH Attribute Insect Type monster with 2000 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. If you added "Double Cannon Armor" by this effect, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

699fc1a6c4ab86f4ede26b93.name: Petit Moth of Evolution
699fc1a6c4ab86f4ede26b93.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.

699fc1b54449084bc7359af9.name: Magical Plant of the Verdant Forest
699fc1b54449084bc7359af9.description:

699fc1bff50b59e47d871ffb.name: Nephrite Insect Whistle
699fc1bff50b59e47d871ffb.description:

699fc1daa006cf64d1f42d56.name: Lana the Holy Wind of Healing
699fc1daa006cf64d1f42d56.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand to your field in face-up Defense Position by sending 1 other card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Return 1 Spell/Trap Card from your opponent's field to the owner's hand. Then, you can change this card's battle position.

699fc1ee72c37fd6df652264.name: Yabume the Frost-Purifying Purebreed
699fc1ee72c37fd6df652264.description:

[EFFECT] Set 1 non-Legend Normal Spell Card from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone. This turn, you cannot activate that card or the effect of "Yabume the Frost-Purifying Purebreed".

699fc202199cea41e5db35e2.name: Storming Mirror Force
699fc202199cea41e5db35e2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[EFFECT] Return all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

699fc216abc73edbe7678d94.name: Udzue the Frost-Purifying Purebreed
699fc216abc73edbe7678d94.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 non-Legend Normal Trap Card from your Graveyard to your hand. You cannot Set Spell/Trap Cards from the hand until the end of this turn.

699fc22928ad4a4ca8c81529.name: Voidvelg Whiterider
699fc22928ad4a4ca8c81529.description:

You can add 1 "Voidvelg Requiem" or 1 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type Normal Monster from those cards to your hand. Place the rest of the cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

699fc6bba27872f2888d3edc.name: Beast King Barbaros
699fc6bba27872f2888d3edc.description:
You can Normal Summon this card in Attack Position without Tributing or by Tributing 3 face-up EARTH Attribute monsters. If Summoned without Tributing, its original ATK becomes 1900.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card by Tributing 3 monsters the above way.
[EFFECT] Destroy all face-up cards on your opponent's field.

699fc6d57cb40b575530613f.name: Voidvelg Stork
699fc6d57cb40b575530613f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand or the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Contact Darkmatter Explorer". If you sent a card from your hand to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can have this card's name become "Voidvelg Requiem" this turn instead.

699fc6e7c4ab86f4ede27892.name: Voidalfr Voyastrider
699fc6e7c4ab86f4ede27892.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, send 1 EARTH, WATER, FIRE, or WIND Attribute Galaxy Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard or shuffle 4 non-Level 1 Galaxy Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card.

699fc6f84449084bc735a765.name: Voidalfr Buprestruve
699fc6f84449084bc735a765.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Voidalfr Heavenstar". Then, you can add up to 2 "Micronova" from your Graveyard to your hand. You cannot activate the effects of non-Galaxy Type monsters until the end of this turn.

699fc70ab4da73ba742a362b.name: Voidalfr Mantistar
699fc70ab4da73ba742a362b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 3 different Attributes face-up on your field, or you have "Micronova" in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Add 1 non-Level 4 EARTH, WATER, FIRE, or WIND Attribute Galaxy Type Effect Monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can add 1 "Micronova" from your Graveyard to your hand.

699fc71e25323ddb3ffad791.name: Voidalfr Antromeda
699fc71e25323ddb3ffad791.description:
If you have 3 or more Galaxy Type monsters in your Graveyard, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this face-up card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Galaxy Type monster in Attack Position. Then, you can add 1 "Voidalfr Heavenstar" from your Graveyard to your hand.

699fc734729e3348d15ac1d5.name: Voidalfr Heavenstar
699fc734729e3348d15ac1d5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck, shuffle 1 card from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, you can draw 1 card. If you do, you can add 1 "Micronova Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

699fc747f50b59e47d872d9c.name: Nafl of the Monumenthes
699fc747f50b59e47d872d9c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monster with 1000 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monsters.

699fc757a27872f2888d4085.name: Yorishiro of Isyria
699fc757a27872f2888d4085.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Offering to Isyria", "Sarcophagus of Isyria", or "Spirit of Isyria" from your Graveyard to your hand. If you do, you can add 1 "Monumenthes Festival -The Isyria Seance-" from your Graveyard to your hand.

699fc7702750eb215c56f0aa.name: Qadi of the Monumenthes
699fc7702750eb215c56f0aa.description:
If you have "Gunde of the Monumenthes" or "Yorishiro of Isyria" face-up on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand to your field in face-up Defense Position.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can only declare up to 2 attacks. Then, you can shuffle 3 Beast-Warrior Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.

699fc7812f22e8462ddb92d4.name: Emir of the Monumenthes
699fc7812f22e8462ddb92d4.description:

699fc7930b511ef1c27c0f49.name: Moonforce Piyopi

[EFFECT] Draw cards equal to [the number of cards placed to meet the requirement]. You cannot activate monster effects until the end of this turn, except those of EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monsters.

699fc7aa4449084bc735a957.name: Moonforce Rifet
699fc7aa4449084bc735a957.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 4 or less monsters in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if your opponent has 5 or more monsters in their Graveyard, and you have not drawn a card during this Main Phase, you can draw 2 cards. You cannot activate monster effects until the end of this turn, except those of EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monsters.

699fc7b97cb40b57553063ad.name: Moonforce Sheila
699fc7b97cb40b57553063ad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 4 or less monsters in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 non-Level 2 EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monster and/or 1 "The Eternal Land -Spectrika-" to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. This turn, you can only attack with EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monsters.

699fc7c70b511ef1c27c0fea.name: Moonforce Ziggy
699fc7c70b511ef1c27c0fea.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. During your opponent's next turn, your opponent cannot attack with that monster. Then, you can place 1 monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck. If you do, this card gains 500 DEF until the end of your opponent's next turn.

699fc7d94449084bc735a9a7.name: Moonforce Timo
699fc7d94449084bc735a9a7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 10 or more cards in your Deck during the turn you Normal Summoned this card, place 1 card from your hand and 1 EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. This turn, you can only attack with EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monsters, and your opponent takes no effect damage.

699fc7eb7cb40b5755306410.name: Straigh the Noodle Ninja
699fc7eb7cb40b5755306410.description:

699fc80828ad4a4ca8c823f8.name: Special Operative Flavor Inspector
699fc80828ad4a4ca8c823f8.description:

699fc81e27ac3c9cce152ef1.name: Lovely Rabbit

699fc82c72c37fd6df6532f6.name: Lovely Fereshte

699fc83d2624031bd27d3b98.name: Grace Dog

699fc84ca27872f2888d42e7.name: Grace Princess Emaki
699fc84ca27872f2888d42e7.description:

If you added "Grace Princess Kana" by this effect, you can Set 1 Ritual Spell Card from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

699fc9e0055232011c618e67.name: Hungry Onion Rings
699fc9e0055232011c618e67.description:

699fc9f14449084bc735af87.name: Mech Dolphin

699fca03b4da73ba742a3d68.name: Mech Misairuzame

699fca5ff50b59e47d8734ac.name: Chainsaw Insect

699fcaaa2f22e8462ddb99c4.name: Voidalfr Star Stripe

699fcab8729e3348d15ac969.name: Voidalfr Star Mayfly

699fcacab176e3e1e9bf7485.name: Beginning Hiyashi the Sonic Noodle Ninja

699fcad6abc73edbe767a1aa.name: Spice the Special Noodle Ninja Rich Broth
699fcad6abc73edbe767a1aa.description:
"Spice the Elite Noodle Ninja" + "Flavor Inspector"

699fcaed2750eb215c56f963.name: Isyria, Deity of the Monumenthes
699fcaed2750eb215c56f963.description:
Must be Special Summoned by the effect of "Monumenthes Festival -The Isyria Seance-".
[REQUIREMENT] None

During your turn, other face-up EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monsters on your field gain 3000 ATK, and they inflict piercing battle damage.

699fcafe2624031bd27d41ee.name: Luna Moonforce Alba
699fcafe2624031bd27d41ee.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 5 or less monsters in your Graveyard during your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, while this card is face-up, your opponent cannot Special Summon Level 5 or lower monsters from the Graveyard face-up.

699fcb0e2750eb215c56f9d8.name: Luna Moonforce Mochi
699fcb0e2750eb215c56f9d8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 3 other monsters from your Graveyard and/or face-up on your field on the bottom of the owner's Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field. Then, if your opponent has 5 or more monsters in their Graveyard, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on their field.

699fcb1f2624031bd27d423e.name: Luna Moonforce Dralia
699fcb1f2624031bd27d423e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If the number of monsters in your opponent's Graveyard exceeds the number of monsters in your Graveyard, place 1 monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, this card gains ATK equal to [the difference between the number of monsters in both players' Graveyards] x 100, and it inflicts piercing battle damage.

699fcb4025323ddb3ffae215.name: Shadowforce Explosion
699fcb4025323ddb3ffae215.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Shadowforce Explosion", place 1 card from your hand on the top or bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Add 2 Level 8 or lower DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monsters with different names from your Graveyard to your hand.

699fcc602f22e8462ddb9dc1.name: Worm Void Hole
699fcc602f22e8462ddb9dc1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a Level 9 or lower Galaxy Type monster that mentions "Voidvelg Requiem" or "Contact Dark Matter Voyager" as material by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

699fcc6b2f22e8462ddb9ddc.name: Micronova
699fcc6b2f22e8462ddb9ddc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on your field gain 800 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of different Attributes in your Graveyard] x 100.

699fcc792f22e8462ddb9def.name: Micronova Fusion
699fcc792f22e8462ddb9def.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a monster that mentions "Voidalfr Heavenstar" as material by sending monsters whose original Type is Galaxy from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

699fcc854449084bc735b58c.name: Monumenthes Festival -The Isyria Seance-
699fcc854449084bc735b58c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 "Offering to Isyria", 1 "Sarcophagus of Isyria", and 1 "Spirit of Isyria" from your hand and/or face-down on your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Isyria, Deity of the Monumenthes" by sending face-up "Yorishiro of Isyria" from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 4 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).

699fcc912f22e8462ddb9ed7.name: Offering to Isyria
699fcc912f22e8462ddb9ed7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Gain 600 LP. Then, you can make 1 face-up EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monster on your field gain 600 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, you can only attack with EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monsters.

699fcc9ca9b75df8e0d4455a.name: Sarcophagus of Isyria
699fcc9ca9b75df8e0d4455a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a Level 7 EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monster in your Graveyard, send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 7 EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monsters.

699fcca6a9b75df8e0d4456b.name: Preparations for the Monumenthes Festival
699fcca6a9b75df8e0d4456b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated "Yorishiro of Isyria", "Monumenthes Festival -The Isyria Seance-", "Offering to Isyria", "Sarcophagus of Isyria", or "Spirit of Isyria" to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

699fccb1a27872f2888d4c7c.name: Endless Partner
699fccb1a27872f2888d4c7c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon an EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monster with a different name from the monsters used as material by shuffling face-up Galaxy Type monsters from your field into the owner's Deck as material whose total Levels equal the Level of the monster you Ritual Summon. Then, you can send cards from the top of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard, up to [the number of monsters used as material by this effect].

699fccbc9eb5a50d052b19c2.name: Memory of Sunlit
699fccbc9eb5a50d052b19c2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Memory of Sunlit".
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 6 cards of your Deck. You can Special Summon 1 excavated Level 5 or lower EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monster face-up to your field. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. This turn, you can only attack with EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monsters.

699fccc8f50b59e47d873a16.name: The Eternal Land -Spectrika-
699fccc8f50b59e47d873a16.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card if you have 4 or less monsters in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, if a player Ritual Summons by the effect of "Endless Partner", they can also use Galaxy Type monsters in their Graveyard as material.

699fccdaf025d6b4d6e07bc8.name: The Noodle Art of Flavor Shift
699fccdaf025d6b4d6e07bc8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you have not activated "The Noodle Art of Flavor Shift", reveal 1 FIRE Attribute Fusion Monster with 2900 ATK in your Extra Deck, and declare 1 card name mentioned on that monster as material.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up monster on your field. This turn, that monster’s card name becomes the monster's card name declared to meet the requirement.

699fcce30914a773bcf98b00.name: Lovely Connect
699fcce30914a773bcf98b00.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 DARK Attribute Fairy Type monster with 0 ATK from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if you have a face-up LIGHT Attribute Fairy Type monster with 0 original ATK and DEF on your field, you can place 1 face-down card from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

699fccee72c37fd6df653df5.name: Hungry Special Coupon
699fccee72c37fd6df653df5.description:
This card's name becomes "Hungry Coupon" while in the hand or Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position. Then, you can choose 1 face-up Level 6 or lower DARK Attribute Warrior Type monster on your field. This turn, that monster's Level is increased by 3, and it inflicts piercing battle damage.

699fccf79eb5a50d052b1a34.name: Post-Stellar Shower Princess Cosmos
699fccf79eb5a50d052b1a34.description:
This card's name becomes "Jest of the Cosmos Princess" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Post-Stellar Shower Princess Cosmos".
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 9 Galaxy Type non-Fusion Monster from your hand or Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

699fcd04729e3348d15acf34.name: Fortress Whale's Oath
699fcd04729e3348d15acf34.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Fortress Whale" by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 7 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).

699fcd0fa27872f2888d4d4b.name: The Shallow Grave
699fcd0fa27872f2888d4d4b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Your opponent has 2 or less monsters on their field and a monster in their Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-down Defense Position. Then, your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their Graveyard to their field in face-down Defense Position.

699fcd187cb40b5755306f7d.name: Spinning Abduction
699fcd187cb40b5755306f7d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck.
[EFFECT] Shuffle 6 DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monsters from your Graveyard into your Deck. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or 8 Galaxy Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

699fcd3aa9b75df8e0d446c0.name: Insect Taurus
699fcd3aa9b75df8e0d446c0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can make all face-up monsters on your field gain ATK equal to [the number of Galaxy Type monsters with different Attributes in your Graveyard] x 100 until the end of this turn. Then, you can Set 1 "Micronova" or "Micronova Fusion" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

699fcd439eb5a50d052b1b01.name: Spirit of Isyria
699fcd439eb5a50d052b1b01.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster during their turn.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower Effect Monster on your opponent's field. This turn, your opponent cannot activate that monster's effects. Then, you can draw 1 card.

699fcd4e4449084bc735b710.name: Monumenthes Records
699fcd4e4449084bc735b710.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's monster declares an attack while you have an EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monster in your Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Negate the attack. Then, you can Special Summon 1 EARTH Attribute Beast-Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

699fcd58c4ab86f4ede2872f.name: Lovely Clean
699fcd58c4ab86f4ede2872f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Make up to 3 face-up Fairy Type monsters with 0 original ATK on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "All Love Goddess" face-up on your field, you can return 1 monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

699fcd630b511ef1c27c1f23.name: Dust Tornado
699fcd630b511ef1c27c1f23.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent draws a card, when your opponent Sets a Spell/Trap Card, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, you can Set 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand to your field.

699fcd79256be32b4099fd9b.name: Elemental HERO Bladedge
699fcd79256be32b4099fd9b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card inflicts piercing battle damage. During your turn, if "Skyscraper" is face-up on the field, this card gains 1000 ATK.

699fcd8c4449084bc735b78b.name: Lastcal Chainverse
699fcd8c4449084bc735b78b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, pay 500 LP.
[EFFECT] Draw 3 cards. Then, place 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Lastcal Chainverse".

699fcda5055232011c619682.name: Elemental HERO Plasma Vice
699fcda5055232011c619682.description:
"Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Bladedge"
Must be Fusion Summoned.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field. Then, this card inflicts piercing battle damage this turn.

699ff5d271d7e2f8145b4d5c.name: Dark Magical Curtain
699ff5d271d7e2f8145b4d5c.description: Each player can Special Summon 1 DARK Spellcaster monster from their hand or Deck (but neither player can activate their effects this turn), then if you Special Summoned a monster whose original name is "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl", you can add 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Magician" from your Deck to your hand, except "Dark Magical Curtain". You can only activate 1 "Dark Magical Curtain" per turn.

69a15fabebc6ba57ea226e3e.name: Kuriboh - Multiply!
69a15fabebc6ba57ea226e3e.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect, or an opponent's monster declares an attack (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Kuriboh - Multiply!" once per turn. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field, or during damage calculation when an opponent's monster attacks (Quick Effect): You can add to your hand or Special Summon, from your Deck or GY, 1 "Dark Magician" or 1 monster with 300 ATK/200 DEF, then you can change that opponent's monster's ATK to 0.

69a15fe60c46bf1a132b10ec.name: Dark Magical Curtain
69a15fe60c46bf1a132b10ec.description: Each player can Special Summon 1 DARK Spellcaster monster from their hand or Deck (but neither player can activate their effects this turn), then if you Special Summoned a monster whose original name is "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl", you can add 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Magician" from your Deck to your hand, except "Dark Magical Curtain". You can only activate 1 "Dark Magical Curtain" per turn.

69a160098f8cbf98a4c80878.name: Favorite HERO Shining Flare Wingman
69a160098f8cbf98a4c80878.description:
1 Fusion Monster + 1 face-up monster on the field
(This card is always treated as an "Elemental HERO" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can shuffle 5 monsters from your GY into the Deck, then draw 2 cards, and if you do, this card gains 1000 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Favorite HERO Shining Flare Wingman" once per turn. If this card destroys a monster by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

69a1602d30626f425bb8c799.name: Favorite HERO Flame Wingman
69a1602d30626f425bb8c799.description:
2 monsters with the same Type but different Attributes
(This card is always treated as an "Elemental HERO" card.)
When an attack is declared involving this card and a monster with 2200 or more ATK: You can make this card gain 1000 ATK, then you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand in Defense Position. If a monster(s) was destroyed by battle this turn (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Favorite HERO Flame Wingman" once per turn.

69a1605495af605565618e5a.name: Winged Kuriboh Sabatiel LV10
69a1605495af605565618e5a.description: You can reveal this card in your hand and pay half your LP; add 1 "Polymerization" Spell or "Fusion" Spell from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, shuffle this card into the Deck, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "HERO" monsters. During your opponent's turn, if your LP are 1000 or less (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to the highest ATK among the monsters they control. You can only use each effect of "Winged Kuriboh Sabatiel LV10" once per turn.

69a160773a5983362c9b58e5.name: Stardust Dragon - Victim Sanctuary
69a160773a5983362c9b58e5.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your card or effect activation (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate the activation of your opponent's card or effect, and if you do, destroy that card. If a monster(s) in your possession was Tributed this turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Stardust" Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Stardust Dragon - Victim Sanctuary" once per turn, and cannot activate more than 1 in the same Chain.

69a160a671d7e2f8145eb5ed.name: Starjunk Synchron
69a160a671d7e2f8145eb5ed.description: For a Synchro Summon, you can substitute this card for any 1 "Synchron" Tuner. You can only use each of the following effects of "Starjunk Synchron" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Level 2 or lower monster in your GY; Special Summon this card, and if you do, Special Summon that monster but negate its effects, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. You can banish this card from your GY; this turn, no "Junk Warrior" you control can be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

69a160ca38bd7bd36297d9f9.name: Synchro Emergency
69a160ca38bd7bd36297d9f9.description: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can activate this card from your hand. Special Summon 1 monster from your hand (but negate its effects), then if your opponent controls a monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, you can Special Summon 1 "Synchron" monster from your Deck. Until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can banish this card from your GY; immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster. You can only activate 1 "Synchro Emergency" per turn.

69a160ed8f8cbf98a4c80a19.name: Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light
69a160ed8f8cbf98a4c80a19.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle, except with a "Number" monster. (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 monster you control; the first time it would be destroyed by battle or card effect this turn, it is not destroyed. When the second attack of each turn is declared: You can make this card gain 2500 ATK, and if you do, it gains this effect.
● When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon it to your field.

69a160f7ccd9119f5dbe826e.name: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic
69a160f7ccd9119f5dbe826e.description: If this card is in your hand: You can Special Summon both this card and 1 "Zubaba", "Gagaga", "Gogogo", or "Dododo" monster from your hand or GY, except "Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic", then immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 "Zubaba", "Gagaga", "Gogogo", "Dododo", "Djinn", "Heroic Champion", "Number", "ZW -", or "ZS -" Xyz Monster using only those 2 monsters. When you do, treat the Level of 1 of the monsters the same as the other monster's. You can only use this effect of "Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic" once per turn.

69a160ffc064194636d37858.name: Gagaga Girl - Cell Phone Subtraction
69a160ffc064194636d37858.description: If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) from the Extra Deck (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 face-up monster you control; Special Summon this card from your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon using only this card and the targeted monster. When you do, treat this card's Level as the same as the targeted monster's. If this card is detached from an Xyz Monster to activate that monster's effect: You can change the ATK of 1 face-up monster your opponent controls to 0. You can only use each effect of "Gagaga Girl - Cell Phone Subtraction" once per turn.

69a1610f30626f425bb8ca0c.name: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
69a1610f30626f425bb8ca0c.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
During your Main Phase: You can destroy this card, and if you do, add 1 Pendulum Monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot activate monster effects on the field until you Pendulum Summon. You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
This Pendulum Summoned card gains these effects.
● Gains ATK equal to the difference in the Pendulum Scales of the 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones x 300.
● Any battle damage your opponent takes from battles involving this card is doubled.
If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can add this card to your hand, then if it was destroyed by your opponent's card, you can Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

69a16118d8c34705d06d9ac2.name: Horoscope Sorcerer, the Stargazer Magician
69a16118d8c34705d06d9ac2.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
When a Spell Card or effect activated by your opponent resolves, if you control a "Magician" Pendulum Monster or an "Odd-Eyes" monster, you can negate that effect, then destroy this card. You can only use this effect of "Horoscope Sorcerer, the Stargazer Magician" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other "Magician" Pendulum Monster, "Performapal" monster, or "Odd-Eyes" monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Pendulum Monster with 2500 ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 Pendulum Monster Card you control; destroy it, then you can add 1 face-up Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Horoscope Sorcerer, the Stargazer Magician" once per turn.

69a161276dd1798949025a58.name: Astrograph Sorcerer, the Starfrost Magician
69a161276dd1798949025a58.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
During your Main Phase: You can destroy this card, and if you do, place 1 Scale 1 Pendulum Monster from your hand or Deck in your Pendulum Zone, except "Astrograph Sorcerer, the Starfrost Magician", but neither player can activate its Pendulum Effects this turn. You can only use this effect of "Astrograph Sorcerer, the Starfrost Magician" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If a face-up Monster Card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can Special Summon 1 of those destroyed monsters from your face-up Extra Deck or GY. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Dragon Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling its materials from your field and/or face-up Extra Deck into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Astrograph Sorcerer, the Starfrost Magician" once per turn.

69a1612fb4acf1e9c446ef82.name: Decode Talker Integration
69a1612fb4acf1e9c446ef82.description:
2+ Effect Monsters
While this card is in the Extra Monster Zone, it gains 500 ATK for every other Link Monster in the field and the GYs, also your opponent cannot target it with card effects. (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster this card points to; send 1 Cyberse monster from your Extra Deck to the GY, also this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. You can only use this effect of "Decode Talker Integration" once per turn.

69b739f506ec74f11e7302c3.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Place 1 "Blitzclique" Continuous Trap from your Deck, face-up on your field.
● Return 1 Thunder monster you control to the hand, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Breakaway" once per turn.

69b73a0ad6c005cd7342f4b6.name: Blitzclique - Steppleader
69b73a0ad6c005cd7342f4b6.description: If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Thunder monster in your GY; add it to your hand. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, then destroy this card. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Steppleader" once per turn.

69b73a1c1249d700eb1b2d49.name: Blitzclique Return Stroke
69b73a1c1249d700eb1b2d49.description: "Blitzclique" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Return Stroke" once per turn. When your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect: You can return 1 "Blitzclique" monster you control to the hand; negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Blitzclique" monster in your field or GY; return it to the hand.

69b73a30890b93b21ed56f55.name: Blitzclique Alternator
69b73a30890b93b21ed56f55.description: Monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK/DEF for each Thunder monster you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Alternator" once per turn. You can shuffle 1 other "Blitzclique" card from your hand or face-up field into the Deck; add 1 Thunder monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Blitzclique" Spell or "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" from your Deck to your hand.

69b73a42b63f97720ca3281e.name: Thunder King Rai-Oh
69b73a42b63f97720ca3281e.description: Neither player can add cards from their Deck to their hand except by drawing them. When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster (Quick Effect): You can send this face-up card to the GY; negate the Special Summon, and if you do, destroy it.

69b73c61a76e30f506defaac.name: Triple Borrel Launch
69b73c61a76e30f506defaac.description:
Activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Triple Borrel Launch" once per turn);
● Shuffle 1 Dragon monster from your GY into the Deck, then you can Special Summon 1 "Rokket" monster with a different name from your Deck.
● Shuffle 2 Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, then add 1 Field Spell from your GY to your hand.
● Shuffle 3 Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, then shuffle up to 3 monsters from your opponent's GY into the Deck.

69b73c963976354d758b738d.name: Sky Striker Mobilize - Linkage!
69b73c963976354d758b738d.description: If you control no monsters in your Main Monster Zone: You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except "Sky Striker Ace" monsters, also send 1 other card you control to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Sky Striker Ace" monster from your Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone, and if you have at least 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK "Sky Striker Ace" monsters on your field and/or in your GY, the Summoned monster gains 1000 ATK.

69b74046ac476c21c8c540fb.name: The Phantom Knights of Decayed Cloak
69b74046ac476c21c8c540fb.description: If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 other "The Phantom Knights" card in your hand; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster you control; this turn, you can use that face-up Xyz Monster as material for an Xyz Summon using its Rank as if it were a Level. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Decayed Cloak" once per turn.

69b7406d1b0644db26e748a9.name: The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret
69b7406d1b0644db26e748a9.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "The Phantom Knights" Spell/Trap from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target up to 2 Level/Rank 3 DARK monsters you control; increase their Levels/Ranks by 1.

69b7409632745bca16fa5b43.name: The Phantom Knights of Malevolent Scythe
69b7409632745bca16fa5b43.description:
2 Level 3 DARK monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster from your Deck. If you Xyz Summon an "Xyz Dragon" monster, while this card is in your Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your Deck to your hand. If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 of your banished "The Phantom Knights" cards to your hand, except Xyz Monsters. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Malevolent Scythe" once per turn.

69b740c2890b93b21ed58056.name: The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem
69b740c2890b93b21ed58056.description:
Target 1 "The Phantom Knights" or "Xyz Dragon" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, then apply the following effect.
● Choose 1 DARK Xyz Monster you control, and Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "The Phantom Knights" or "Xyz Dragon" Xyz Monster that is 1 Rank higher than that monster, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials).
You can only activate 1 "The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem" per turn.

69b740dad1110f2c3cee40ae.name: The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil
69b740dad1110f2c3cee40ae.description: If you have a "The Phantom Knights" monster in your field or GY, you can activate this card the turn it was Set. Special Summon this card in Defense Position as a Normal Monster (Warrior/DARK/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 300) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then you can change 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls to Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY; immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 DARK Xyz Monster. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil" once per turn.

69b7417e72b54e46ba4da332.name: Phantom Knights' Fog Blade
69b7417e72b54e46ba4da332.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 Effect Monster on the field; negate that face-up monster's effects, that face-up monster cannot attack, also monsters cannot target that face-up monster for attacks. When it leaves the field, destroy this card. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Phantom Knights' Fog Blade" once per turn.

69b741fa818ffa4e11afd05f.name: Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
69b741fa818ffa4e11afd05f.description:
2 Level 4 DARK monsters
(This card is always treated as a "The Phantom Knights" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target an equal number of cards on each field; destroy them. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 Rank 4 DARK Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck, using this card you control (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer this card's materials). You can only use each effect of "Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

69b9ebfb11af170c56df5cb5.name: Frost Tiger
69b9ebfb11af170c56df5cb5.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Level 5 or higher WATER Spellcaster monster or 1 "Twin Pillars of Ice" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Frost Tiger" once per turn.

69b9ec218a38eacf086bb04f.name: Guivre
69b9ec218a38eacf086bb04f.description: Gains 400 ATK for each Dragon monster you control. When this card destroys a monster by battle: You can Special Summon 1 "Wyvern Token" (Dragon/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 400/DEF 400). During the Battle Phase or Main Phase 2, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon 1 Dragon monster face-up. You can only use this effect of "Guivre" once per turn.

69b9ec4b21c087537d7edd19.name: Long-Tailed Black Horse
69b9ec4b21c087537d7edd19.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can reveal 1 Zombie monster in your hand and send 1 EARTH Zombie monster from your Deck to the GY; send the revealed monster to the GY, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Long-Tailed Black Horse" once per turn.

69bb2da1d134f78ba68b8929.name: The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons
69bb2da1d134f78ba68b8929.description: If a Spellcaster monster is on the field: Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon monster from your Deck, then if your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with the same name as the Summoned monster, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Dragon or Spellcaster monsters. During your Main Phase 2, if this card is in your GY because it was sent there this turn: You can banish it; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons" once per turn.

69bb2db9c136e3ddb2b3ddf2.name: Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon
69bb2db9c136e3ddb2b3ddf2.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only use each of the following effects of "Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using this card you control and monsters from your hand or field.

69bb2dde0ba0bc49600c5b2b.name: Red Nova Dragon - Burning Soul
69bb2dde0ba0bc49600c5b2b.description:
2 Tuners + 1 non-Tuner
Must be either Synchro Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing 2 Tuners and 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" from your GY. Cannot be destroyed by card effects. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand, and if you do, this card gains 2000 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Red Nova Dragon - Burning Soul" once per Duel, and only if you have Synchro Summoned "Red Dragon Archfiend".

69bb2df39cd00f2d020e615a.name: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon
69bb2df39cd00f2d020e615a.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 2 face-up monsters with 2000 or more ATK from anywhere on the field, including a monster you control. You can only Special Summon "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon" once per turn this way. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" from your Deck or GY, then you can banish 1 monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon" once per turn.

69bb2e15a60d7e9089760e56.name: Funny Dark Rabbit
69bb2e15a60d7e9089760e56.description: After this card is Normal or Special Summoned, you can Normal Summon 1 monster that mentions "Toon World" during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). This card is treated as a Toon monster while "Toon World" is on the field. Once per turn: You can add to your hand or place face-up on your field, 1 "Toon" Field or Continuous Spell from your Deck.

69bb2e22f36ca95477581427.name: Comic Cat
69bb2e22f36ca95477581427.description: This card is treated as a Toon monster while "Toon World" is on the field. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster (if you control "Toon World", you can Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls, even though you do not control it), and if you do, Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Toon World" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only use this effect of "Comic Cat" once per turn.

69bb2e3793e86d30484b5c16.name: Evil Box
69bb2e3793e86d30484b5c16.description: If you control "Toon World": You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add to your hand or Set 1 "Toon" Trap from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Evil Box" once per turn. This card is treated as a Toon monster while "Toon World" is on the field. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card in either GY; place it on the bottom of the Deck.

69bb2e55508f0d37b467b7af.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Toon Dragon
69bb2e55508f0d37b467b7af.description:
"Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon" + 2 Toon monsters
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards from your hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck/Extra Deck. Your Toon monsters can attack directly. Once per turn: You can add 1 "Toon" card, or 1 card that mentions a "Toon" card's name, from your GY to your hand. During damage calculation, if your Toon monster is attacked: You can banish it until the end of the Damage Step.

69bb2e6eb73706db369b274b.name: Perfect Toon World
69bb2e6eb73706db369b274b.description: This card's name becomes "Toon World" while in the Field Zone. Once per turn: You can add 1 "Toon" card, or 1 card that mentions a "Toon" card's name, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Perfect Toon World" thrice per turn. Before resolving another activated card or effect, you can banish 1 Toon monster you control until immediately after that card/effect resolves, also you cannot banish monsters with that same original name with this effect of "Perfect Toon World" for the rest of this turn.

69bb2e7eea0989a5572d3c1b.name: Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon
69bb2e7eea0989a5572d3c1b.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 2 monsters, while you control "Toon World". Cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 LP to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. Can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster, in which case this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks.

69bb84e64c4e449988378d80.name: Slifer the Sky Dragon
69bb84e64c4e449988378d80.description: Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the GY. Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your opponent's field in Attack Position: That monster(s) loses 2000 ATK, then if its ATK has been reduced to 0 as a result, destroy it.

69bb85cdc6d00e006860c218.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra
69bb85cdc6d00e006860c218.description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, other cards and effects cannot be activated. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can pay LP so that you only have 100 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid. You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

69bb85e8f5380d7b74c0ea48.name: Obelisk the Tormentor
69bb85e8f5380d7b74c0ea48.description: Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. Neither player can target this card with card effects. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the GY. You can Tribute 2 monsters; destroy all monsters your opponent controls. This card cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

69bc2dcf6f83a53e64a9dff1.name: Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss
69bc2dcf6f83a53e64a9dff1.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Blue-Eyes" card.)
You can discard this card; add 1 Level 1 LIGHT Tuner from your Deck to your hand. If a "Blue-Eyes" Ritual Monster(s) and/or "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is sent to your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when the monster was sent) or hand (even if not), and if you do, its ATK becomes that monster's, also banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss" once per turn.

69bc2dd8e4ea59d7fa62df82.name: The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons
69bc2dd8e4ea59d7fa62df82.description: If a Spellcaster monster is on the field: Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon monster from your Deck, then if your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with the same name as the Summoned monster, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Dragon or Spellcaster monsters. During your Main Phase 2, if this card is in your GY because it was sent there this turn: You can banish it; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons" once per turn.

69bc2de04c8c5feb467cd709.name: Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon
69bc2de04c8c5feb467cd709.description:
3 Machine monsters with 2100 or more ATK
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Fusion Summoned using only LIGHT monsters: You can pay 4000 LP; add 1 "Limiter Removal" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon" once per turn. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. While its ATK is higher than its original ATK, this card can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase.

69bc2de7c06be1262c00ca3c.name: Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon
69bc2de7c06be1262c00ca3c.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using this card you control and monsters from your hand or field.

69bc2dee4c4e449988392685.name: Future Fusion Nova
69bc2dee4c4e449988392685.description: When this card is activated: Fusion Summon 1 LIGHT Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your Deck, including "Cyber Dragon", also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon, except Machine monsters, also you cannot declare attacks, except with the Summoned monster. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card. You can only activate 1 "Future Fusion Nova" per turn.

69bc2df7d134f78ba68e0372.name: Crimson Dragon Quetzalcoatl
69bc2df7d134f78ba68e0372.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
Gains ATK equal to the total original ATK of all other Synchro Monsters you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Crimson Dragon Quetzalcoatl" once per turn. If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon as many Dragon Synchro Monsters from your GY as possible, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. 69bc2dfe508f0d37b46a814c.name: Red Nova Dragon - Burning Soul
69bc2dfe508f0d37b46a814c.description:
2 Tuners + 1 non-Tuner
Must be either Synchro Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing 2 Tuners and 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" from your GY. Cannot be destroyed by card effects. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand, and if you do, this card gains 2000 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Red Nova Dragon - Burning Soul" once per Duel, and only if you have Synchro Summoned "Red Dragon Archfiend".

69bc2e0713fc48ce718d5ecb.name: Red Dragon Archfiend's Chains
69bc2e0713fc48ce718d5ecb.description: You can activate this card the turn it was Set, by revealing 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" in your Extra Deck. Activate this card by revealing any number of monsters in your hand, then target Effect Monsters your opponent controls equal to the number of Tuners revealed +1; they lose 100 ATK for each card you revealed in the hand to activate this card, also their effects are negated. If the last of those monsters is not on the field, destroy this card. You can only activate 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend's Chains" per turn.

69bc2e0fd134f78ba68e03c3.name: Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon - Photon Howling
69bc2e0fd134f78ba68e03c3.description:
3 Level 8 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon - Photon Howling" by using 1 Rank 8 Xyz Monster you control (transfer its materials). If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can take 1 "Photon" monster from your Deck, and either Special Summon it in Defense Position or attach it to this card as material. (Quick Effect): You can detach 3 materials from this card; Tribute 1 other Xyz Monster, and if you do, negate the effects of all other face-up cards currently on the field until the end of this turn.

69bc2e16c6efea4933b38540.name: Galaxy Defense Robot Orbital 7
69bc2e16c6efea4933b38540.description: You can Tribute this card from your hand or field; take 1 "Photon" monster and 1 "Galaxy" monster from your Deck, add 1 of them to your hand, and send the other to the GY, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT monsters. 2 DARK monsters on the field
(This card is always treated as a "Predaplant" card.)

You can only use each effect of "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

69bc2e28d134f78ba68e040a.name: Clear Wing Synchro Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
69bc2e28d134f78ba68e040a.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
(This card is always treated as a "Speedroid" card.)

When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WIND Tuner from your hand or GY (but negate its effects), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 WIND Synchro Monster. 69bc2e2f9cd00f2d0210e5a8.name: Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
69bc2e2f9cd00f2d0210e5a8.description:
2 Level 4 DARK monsters
(This card is always treated as a "The Phantom Knights" card.)

When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 Rank 4 DARK Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck, using this card you control (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer this card's materials). You can only use each effect of "Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

69bc2e37f36ca954775a91cd.name: Borreload Liberator Dragon
69bc2e37f36ca954775a91cd.description:
3+ Effect Monsters
You can only Special Summon "Borreload Liberator Dragon(s)" once per turn.
