Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. Once per Chain, if this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

69bc2e3dfb7f28bd99f054c4.name: Rokket Barrage
69bc2e3dfb7f28bd99f054c4.description: You can send 1 DARK Dragon monster from your Deck to the GY, except a Level 5 monster; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters. When a Link Monster's effect is activated that targets this card on the field (Quick Effect): You can destroy this card, then Special Summon up to 1 "Rokket" monster each from your hand, Deck, GY, and/or banishment, except "Rokket Barrage". You can only use each effect of "Rokket Barrage" once per turn.

69bc2e44816f40969162bbb2.name: Triple Borrel Launch
69bc2e44816f40969162bbb2.description:
Activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Triple Borrel Launch" once per turn);
● Shuffle 1 Dragon monster from your GY into the Deck, then you can Special Summon 1 "Rokket" monster with a different name from your Deck.
● Shuffle 2 Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, then add 1 Field Spell from your GY to your hand.
● Shuffle 3 Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, then shuffle up to 3 monsters from your opponent's GY into the Deck.

69bc3008f36ca954775a975e.name: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon
69bc3008f36ca954775a975e.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 2 face-up monsters with 2000 or more ATK from anywhere on the field, including a monster you control. You can only Special Summon "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon" once per turn this way. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" from your Deck or GY, then you can banish 1 monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon" once per turn.

69bd3abaea0989a55732b88c.name: Spiritual Power Recovery Potion
69bd3abaea0989a55732b88c.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Possessed" card.)
Banish any number of Spellcaster monsters and/or Spells from your GY; monsters you control gain 200 ATK x the number banished, and if they do, you gain 400 LP x the number banished. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon any number of Spellcaster monsters with different Attributes from your hand. You can only use 1 "Spiritual Power Recovery Potion" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

69be4d62a5a1376c97eccc12.name: Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens
69be4d62a5a1376c97eccc12.description:
2+ Effect Monsters
You can also use 1 monster in your hand as material to Link Summon this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY, or if all materials used for its Link Summon were monsters you controlled, you can send 1 monster from your Extra Deck instead. During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 monster from your GY to your hand.

69c1ae2e25935fea8120e351.name: Astrazma Urania
69c1ae2e25935fea8120e351.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 or 2 monsters you control to the hand. You can only Special Summon "Astrazma Urania" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Astrazma Urania" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can reveal any number of monsters in your hand with different Levels, then target that many face-up cards your opponent controls; negate their effects. If this card on the field is destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can add this card to your hand.

69c1af4c9eccf67755b50fc2.name: Breeze the Electrovore of Rkunas
69c1af4c9eccf67755b50fc2.description: A mysterious dog that emits light for a brief moment by emitting its own life energy. After witnessing it, its endearing image is etched into your mind and never leaves you.

69c3d42fe4512773fbcf4361.name: Glitch Clutch Nullgainer
69c3d42fe4512773fbcf4361.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 Level 8 or higher monster with 0 ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 monster with 0 ATK in your GY; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, also it cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon. You can only use each effect of "Glitch Clutch Nullgainer" once per turn.

69c6dbf18cc8883fdf778843.name: Red Nova Dragon
69c6dbf18cc8883fdf778843.description:
2 Tuners + "Red Dragon Archfiend"
This card gains 500 ATK for each Tuner monster in your Graveyard. Cannot be destroyed by an opponent's card effects. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can target the attacking monster; banish this card, and if you do, negate that attack. During the next End Phase: Special Summon this card banished by this effect.

69d12798fc13a677c41b5557.name: Twilight Specter Rayrage
69d12798fc13a677c41b5557.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If a Pendulum Monster(s) you control would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, you can destroy this card instead of 1 of those Pendulum Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Twilight Specter Rayrage" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Pendulum Monster you control; place that Pendulum Monster in your Pendulum Zone (neither player can activate its Pendulum Effects this turn), and if you do, Special Summon this card. (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card, then target 1 card in your Pendulum Zone; it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Twilight Specter Rayrage" once per turn.

69d127c88fb778b5009eaadf.name: Summer
69d127c88fb778b5009eaadf.description: Once per turn: You can place Season Counters on this card equal to the number of your opponent's unused Main Monster Zones. Once per turn, when your monster declares an attack: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to the total number of Season Counters on this card and "Spring" in your GY x 400. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can take 1 Field Spell from your hand or Deck that you can place a Season Counter on, and place it face-up on your field (but neither player can activate its effects this turn), and if you do, place all Season Counters on this card on that card.

69d127ee77ce73412597a57f.name: Foolish Trap Hole
69d127ee77ce73412597a57f.description: When a monster effect is activated on your opponent's field, during a turn your opponent has Special Summoned: Destroy the monster that activated its effect, then if your opponent controls a card(s) in its adjacent Monster Zones and/or Spell & Trap Zones, destroy them.

69d1280d483e9248440457b3.name: Lane Restriction
69d1280d483e9248440457b3.description: When this card is activated: You can Special Summon 1 of your banished monsters to your rightmost Main Monster Zone. If your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s) in their Main Monster Zone, they must use their leftmost zone(s) that can be used.

69d128608fb778b5009eaca4.name: Gray Layer
69d128608fb778b5009eaca4.description: You can Tribute this card, then reveal 1 Machine monster in your hand; add 1 Machine monster with a different Attribute from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster with 1200 or less ATK, you can Special Summon 1 Machine monster from your hand. If a monster(s) in your possession is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; destroy 1 card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Gray Layer" once per turn.

69d2556fba6926fe8935dbb1.name: Garden of Talistones
69d2556fba6926fe8935dbb1.description: While you control 5 cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, any battle damage a player takes is halved, also once per turn, you can activate 1 Continuous Trap Card the turn it was Set. During the Standby Phase: You can reveal 5 Continuous Traps from your Deck with different names, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Set, and shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Garden of Talistones" once per turn.

69d47862a003b8bd321db16b.name: Ilios the Black Sun Dragon
69d47862a003b8bd321db16b.description: You can reveal 3 Dragon monsters in your Extra Deck with 3000 or more ATK and different names; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 Dragon Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster you control; your opponent cannot target it with card effects this turn. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. You can only use each effect of "Ilios the Black Sun Dragon" once per turn.

69db9a1854d511375ad0d472.name: Elfnote June Pride
69db9a1854d511375ad0d472.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner Spellcaster monster
While this card is in the center Main Monster Zone, neither player can declare attacks, except with monsters in their center Main Monster Zones. During the Main Phase, if this card is in the center Main Monster Zone (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon up to 1 "Elfnote" monster each from your hand, Deck, and GY. You can only use this effect of "Elfnote June Pride" once per turn.

69db9a62abba94632c6c9d25.name: Aleister the Reminiscent
69db9a62abba94632c6c9d25.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Spellcaster monster or 1 Fusion Monster on the field; Special Summon this card, and if you do, the targeted monster gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or flipped face-up: You can banish 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck; add 1 "Invocation", or 1 Spell that mentions it, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Aleister the Reminiscent" once per turn.

69db9a93ecdedfcc1249154a.name: Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law
69db9a93ecdedfcc1249154a.description: You can banish this card from your hand or field; add 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck to your hand, then if this effect was activated on the field, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 Spellcaster monster. If a face-up Fusion Monster(s) you control is sent to the GY, except by battle, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, then you can Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law" once per turn.

69db9ac1997d4bf316fe3290.name: Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice
69db9ac1997d4bf316fe3290.description: If you have an "Aleister" monster in your field or GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Invocation", or 1 Spell that mentions it, from your Deck. When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your Fusion Monster's effect activation (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control, and if you do, negate that opponent's effect, and if you do that, banish it. You can only use each effect of "Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice" once per turn.

69db9aefd55c663d73f24338.name: Invoked Sorath
69db9aefd55c663d73f24338.description:
1 "Aleister" monster + 1 FIRE or WIND monster
During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Level 6 or lower monster in either GY; Special Summon it to your field in Defense Position, but negate its effects. If this card is in your GY: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing this card from your GY and monsters from your field or GY as material. You can only use each effect of "Invoked Sorath" once per turn.

69db9b255b5b3db304b4778b.name: Invoked Baybarron
69db9b255b5b3db304b4778b.description:
1 "Aleister" monster + 1 LIGHT or EARTH monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice" or 1 "Gamma Summon" from your Deck to your hand, then you can banish 1 monster from either GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster you control; monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK equal to the targeted monster's ATK, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Invoked Baybarron" once per turn.

69db9b4dc35f961214a81db3.name: Invoked Oceanus
69db9b4dc35f961214a81db3.description:
1 "Aleister" monster + 1 DARK or WATER monster
While this card is in the Main Monster Zone, your opponent's monsters cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one. While this card is in the Extra Monster Zone, any monster sent to your opponent's GY is banished instead. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster you control; it can attack directly this turn. You can only use this effect of "Invoked Oceanus" once per turn.

69db9b8444bbc25fbd774c10.name: Hyperinvoked Aeon
69db9b8444bbc25fbd774c10.description:
2+ Fusion Monsters with different Attributes
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can banish cards from the field and/or GYs, up to the number of monsters used as material, then if you used 3 or more materials, you can look at your opponent's Extra Deck and banish up to 3 cards from it. (Quick Effect): You can declare 1 Attribute; all other monsters on the field become that Attribute until the end of this turn. You can only use 1 "Hyperinvoked Aeon" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

69db9bb94114d7108baa41d2.name: Witchcrafter Terracottan
69db9bb94114d7108baa41d2.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 "Witchcrafter" card in your GY, except "Witchcrafter Terracottan"; add it to your hand, and if you do, Special Summon this card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "Witchcrafter" monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Witchcrafter" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Terracottan" once per turn.

69db9bd95b5b3db304b47a1e.name: Witchcrafter Madame Rilliona
69db9bd95b5b3db304b47a1e.description:
"Witchcrafter Madame Verre" + 2 Spellcaster monsters
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 3 Level 7 or lower "Witchcrafter" monsters with different Attributes from each other from your hand and/or Deck, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion Monsters. During your End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can reveal 1 Spell in your hand; Special Summon this card in Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Madame Rilliona" once per turn.

69db9c10844a844dcd9c22df.name: Sorcerer of the Swamp
69db9c10844a844dcd9c22df.description: If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and banish 1 material whose name is mentioned on it from your Deck, then Special Summon this card, and if you do, this card's name can be treated as the banished monster's, if used as Fusion Material this turn. You can only use this effect of "Sorcerer of the Swamp" once per turn.

69db9c4127530aba015ca1d3.name: Purification Power Patron
69db9c4127530aba015ca1d3.description:
2 non-Link Monsters
If this card is Link Summoned, and you have a "Power Patron" monster in your GY: You can add 1 "Theorealize" card from your Deck to your hand. During the Main Phase, if you control another DARK Fairy monster, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 Link Monster using materials you control, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Purification Power Patron" once per turn.

69db9c61daab7b9abc4f4682.name: Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden
69db9c61daab7b9abc4f4682.description:
1 Level 4 or lower Spellcaster monster
If another "Magistus" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned while you control this monster (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of those monsters; equip this card you control to it. While this card is equipped to a monster: You can add 1 "Magistus" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden" once per turn. You can only Special Summon "Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden" once per turn.

69db9c8d27530aba015ca2c6.name: Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea
69db9c8d27530aba015ca2c6.description: Show 1 "Nerva the Power Patron of Creation", 1 "Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction", and 1 "Junora the Power Patron of Tuning" from your Extra Deck, face-up Monster Zone, and/or GY, and if you do, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to the activation of your "Power Patron" monster effects this turn. If you would banish the top card(s) of your Deck to activate the effect of a "Power Patron" monster you control, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea" once per turn.

69db9ca5aa27c02df5cbf9c9.name: Theorealize Past Lull
69db9ca5aa27c02df5cbf9c9.description: If you control an "Artmage", "DoomZ", or "Elfnote" card: You can Special Summon 1 "Medius the Pure" from your hand or Deck. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when that monster is Special Summoned. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only use 1 "Theorealize Past Lull" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

69db9cbd44bbc25fbd774f70.name: Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour
69db9cbd44bbc25fbd774f70.description:
Special Summon 1 "Power Patron" monster from your hand, face-up Extra Deck, or GY, then you can apply these effects in sequence, based on the number of different card types (Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz) you control.
● 1+: Banish (face-down) 3 cards from the top of your opponent's Deck.
● 2+: Banish (face-down) 1 card your opponent controls.
● 3: Banish (face-down) 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
You can only activate 1 "Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour" per turn.

69db9cd5c35f961214a821d6.name: Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession
69db9cd5c35f961214a821d6.description: The monster in your center Main Monster Zone cannot be banished by your opponent's card effects. You can send 1 other Spell/Trap from your hand or field to the GY, then declare a Level from 1 to 4; Special Summon 1 "Elfnote Seraphim Token" (Plant/Tuner/FIRE/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the declared Level. While that Token is in the Monster Zone, the player who Summoned it cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Elfnote" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession" once per turn.

69db9cf58f1b06603e33a223.name: Superconductive Plasma Blast
69db9cf58f1b06603e33a223.description:
Activate the following effect depending on whose turn it is;
● Yours: Place 1 Thunder or Rock monster from your Deck on top of your Deck, then if you have a Thunder or Rock monster in your field or GY, you can destroy 1 card on the field.
● Opponent's: Add 1 Thunder or Rock monster from your field, GY or banishment to your hand, or if a monster(s) was destroyed by battle or card effect this turn, you can add 1 such monster from your Deck instead.
You can only activate 1 "Superconductive Plasma Blast" per turn.

69db9d1204f0e58436e00bf0.name: Invocation - "Sword"
69db9d1204f0e58436e00bf0.description: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control. If Summoning an "Invoked" Fusion Monster this way, you can also return monsters from any banishment to the GY as material. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Aleister" monster or "Invocation" in your GY; shuffle this card into the Deck, and if you do, add that target to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Invocation - "Sword"" once per turn.

69db9d3124df2a31cda9d708.name: Sacred Spirit Sword Aiwass
69db9d3124df2a31cda9d708.description:
Activate 1 of these effects, but you cannot declare attacks for the rest of this turn, except with Fusion Monsters;
● Special Summon 1 "Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law" from your Deck or GY.
● Take 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck, and either send it to the GY or banish it.
● Look at 3 random face-down cards in your opponent's Extra Deck, and if you do, banish 1 of them.
You can only activate 1 "Sacred Spirit Sword Aiwass" per turn.

69db9d4204f0e58436e00c4e.name: Gamma Summon
69db9d4204f0e58436e00c4e.description: Banish 1 "Aleister" monster or 1 Fusion Monster from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but banish it during the End Phase. If a monster is banished face-up, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of your banished "Invoked" monsters; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Gamma Summon" once per turn.

69db9d6b6e5cc503eaf75e18.name: Witchcrafter Celebration
69db9d6b6e5cc503eaf75e18.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy 1 "Witchcrafter" monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Witchcrafter" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling Spellcaster monsters from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck.
During your End Phase, if you control a "Witchcrafter" monster, while this card is in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use 1 "Witchcrafter Celebration" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

69db9d82c721b6e98b560c5a.name: Witchcrafter Walpurgis
69db9d82c721b6e98b560c5a.description: During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Witchcrafter" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Witchcrafter Walpurgis" once per turn. During your turn, if you would discard to activate the effect of a "Witchcrafter" monster you control, you can send 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY instead, except "Witchcrafter Walpurgis".

69db9d9b4114d7108baa46ee.name: Witchcrafter Distortion
69db9d9b4114d7108baa46ee.description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated and you control a Level 5 or higher "Witchcrafter" monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; add 1 Level 5 or higher Spellcaster monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Distortion" once per turn.

69db9db1e5b51515119516b9.name: Annihilate Retroglight
69db9db1e5b51515119516b9.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field, except monsters that were Summoned this turn: Negate that activation, then you can banish (face-down) all face-up monsters your opponent controls, except monsters Summoned this turn. If this Set card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can Set 1 Trap from your Deck.

69db9dc52e2f9b0e2ecb4166.name: Witchcrafter Vice-Madame
69db9dc52e2f9b0e2ecb4166.description:
1 "Witchcrafter" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
When a Spell Card or effect, or a non-Fusion Spellcaster monster effect, is activated (Quick Effect): You can activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Vice-Madame" once per turn).
● Destroy 1 card on the field.
● Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower "Witchcrafter" monster from your hand or Deck.
● Add 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand.

69e228b0abd43377987ecf1c.name: Sevens Road Magician
69e228b0abd43377987ecf1c.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of different Attributes in your Graveyard] x 300, until the end of this turn.

69e228c2db7785a969fd6f2f.name: Sevens Road Witch
69e228c2db7785a969fd6f2f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[Effect] Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher, DARK Attribute, Spellcaster Type monster from your hand, face-up to your field. If you Special Summoned "Sevens Road Magician" by this effect, this card gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

69e6e9c84ba06b58cabc098b.name: S-Force Signify
69e6e9c84ba06b58cabc098b.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "S-Force" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "S-Force Signify", then if your opponent controls a monster in this card's column, you can draw 1 card. If your opponent activates a monster effect in the same column as a monster you control (except during the Damage Step): You can make all "S-Force" monsters you control gain 1000 ATK. You can only use each effect of "S-Force Signify" once per turn.

69e6ea2153aaf9c330fa7ab0.name: S-Force Nightcatcher
69e6ea2153aaf9c330fa7ab0.description:
2 monsters, including an "S-Force" monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "S-Force" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control and 1 "S-Force" card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "S-Force" monster from your Deck/Extra Deck, except "S-Force Nightcatcher". You can only use each effect of "S-Force Nightcatcher" once per turn.

69e6ea435c01571a4829becf.name: S-Force Mystify
69e6ea435c01571a4829becf.description:
2+ monsters, including an "S-Force" monster
While your opponent controls a monster in this card's column, they cannot target this card with card effects, nor Special Summon by an activated monster effect. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster on the field; move it to another Main Monster Zone on its controller's field. You can only use this effect of "S-Force Mystify" once per turn.

69e6ea6a5e70b8a7687413c4.name: S-Force Origin
69e6ea6a5e70b8a7687413c4.description: Special Summon 1 "S-Force" monster from your hand, GY, or banishment, but banish it when it leaves the field. If another card is banished, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; take 2 "S-Force" cards from your Deck, except "S-Force Origin", banish 1 of them, and send the other to the GY. You can only use each effect of "S-Force Origin" once per turn.

69e6ea87bc6d01b34bc24066.name: S-Force World Sorting
69e6ea87bc6d01b34bc24066.description: If an "S-Force" monster you control would banish a card(s) from your hand to activate its effect, you can send 1 "S-Force" card from your Deck to the GY instead, except "S-Force World Sorting". If another card(s) is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card in your opponent's field or GY; banish it, then you can move 1 "S-Force" monster you control to another of your Main Monster Zones. You can only use each effect of "S-Force World Sorting" once per turn.

69e6eabe42c9a5db678a3994.name: Dark-Eyes Illusionist Faceless Mage

69e6eadae6ec7d6876dcc062.name: Mind Scan
69e6eadae6ec7d6876dcc062.description: While you have a "Toon" card in your field or GY, your opponent must keep their hand revealed, also you can look at their Set cards at any time. If you have a Toon monster and a "Toon" Spell in your field and/or GY: You can declare 1 card name that is not among the cards/effects activated in this Chain; negate the activated effects of cards with that original name until the end of this turn, while this card is face-up on the field. You can only use this effect of "Mind Scan" once per turn.

69e6eb0dd150efb96b48e4b8.name: Melffy Rabbys
69e6eb0dd150efb96b48e4b8.description: If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can Fusion Summon 1 "Melffy" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Melffy" monster from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a Normal Monster, you can Special Summon any number of Beast monsters from your hand. You can only use 1 "Melffy Rabbys" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

69e6eb2e60fd1964a40873f1.name: Melffys' Joyful Surprise
69e6eb2e60fd1964a40873f1.description:
1 "Melffy" monster + 1 Beast monster
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target an equal number of "Melffy" cards you control and cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step), or if an opponent's monster targets this card for an attack: You can target 1 Beast monster in your GY; reduce this card's Level by exactly 2, and if you do, Special Summon that target. You can only use each effect of "Melffys' Joyful Surprise" once per turn.

69e6eb4eed9d1d90727ff257.name: Melffy Godmommy
69e6eb4eed9d1d90727ff257.description:
3+ Level 2 Beast monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Melffy Godmommy" by using "Melffy Mommy" you control (transfer its materials). If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Melffy" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. Gains ATK equal to the combined ATK and DEF of "Melffy" monsters attached to it. You can detach 5 materials from this card; return all cards your opponent controls to the hand.

69e6eb898a99e82f35b934eb.name: Melffy Footsteps
69e6eb898a99e82f35b934eb.description: Add up to 4 "Melffy" monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, then it becomes the End Phase of this turn. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 2 "Melffy" cards in your GY, except "Melffy Footsteps"; add 1 of them to your hand, and if you do, place the other on the bottom of your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Melffy Footsteps" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon the turn you activate this card, except "Melffy" monsters.

69e6eba45c01571a4829c208.name: Melffy Playtime Surprise
69e6eba45c01571a4829c208.description: Target 1 "Melffy" monster in your field or GY; return it to the hand, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Beast Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. If you control a "Melffy" Xyz Monster: You can banish this card from your GY; for the rest of this turn, "Melffy" monsters you control that are Special Summoned from the Extra Deck are unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can only use each effect of "Melffy Playtime Surprise" once per turn.

69e6ebc6ab9adc10a656851a.name: Ragged Records of Rites
69e6ebc6ab9adc10a656851a.description: Reveal 1 Ritual Spell from your hand or Deck, and if you do, add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand that mentions that Spell's name. If a face-up Ritual Monster(s) you control leaves the field by card effect while this card is in your GY, and you do not control any face-up monsters, other than Ritual Monsters (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Ragged Records of Rites" once per turn.

69e6ed0196b4051dd5cb936f.name: Phara the Primordial Goddess
69e6ed0196b4051dd5cb936f.description: You can reveal this card and 1 Spell/Trap in your hand; until the end of the next turn, neither player can activate cards or effects in response to the activation of cards, or effects of cards, with the revealed Spell/Trap's name. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY by a Spell/Trap effect: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can take control of 1 monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). You can only use each effect of "Phara the Primordial Goddess" once per turn.

69e6ed1242d9f839308c82a6.name: Phara the Primordial Goddess
69e6ed1242d9f839308c82a6.description: You can reveal this card and 1 Spell/Trap in your hand; until the end of the next turn, neither player can activate cards or effects in response to the activation of cards, or effects of cards, with the revealed Spell/Trap's name. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY by a Spell/Trap effect: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can take control of 1 monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). You can only use each effect of "Phara the Primordial Goddess" once per turn.

69e6ed6796b4051dd5cb9479.name: Pot of Sloth
69e6ed6796b4051dd5cb9479.description: Draw cards equal to the number of cards your opponent controls, then if you drew 2 or more cards, place cards from your hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order, equal to the number you drew -1. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot activate "Pot of Sloth".

69e6edbdc6e9a6a37b824e80.name: Dark Tyranno
69e6edbdc6e9a6a37b824e80.description: Can attack directly if all monsters your opponent controls are in Defense Position. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dark Tyranno" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if a Spell Card or effect was activated this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Level 8 or higher Dinosaur monster from your Deck to your hand, then you can Special Summon it if your opponent controls a monster.

69e6ede0a96c9d0a3de2a5a4.name: Arcana Force XII - The Hangman
69e6ede0a96c9d0a3de2a5a4.description:
When a card or effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Arcana Force" monster from your hand in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Arcana Force XII - The Hangman" once per turn. If this card is Summoned: Toss a coin.
● Heads: Destroy 1 monster you control, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK.
● Tails: Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK.

69e6ee0f96b4051dd5cb9612.name: Candelato, the Beast of Light
69e6ee0f96b4051dd5cb9612.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Phantom Beast" card.)
Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Candelato, the Beast of Light" once per turn. You can discard 2 other cards; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 card from your Deck to your hand that has a coin tossing effect. When a card or effect is activated that includes an effect that adds a card(s) from the Deck to the hand (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect.

69e6ee401ad75af93d541546.name: Plasma Warrior Eitom
69e6ee401ad75af93d541546.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Magna Warrior" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by Tributing 1 Level 7 or higher monster. You can only Special Summon "Plasma Warrior Eitom" once per turn this way. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Magnet Warrior" or "Magna Warrior" monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Plasma Warrior Eitom"; for the rest of this turn, this card's original ATK becomes 1500, also it can attack directly.

69e6ee9cab9adc10a6568c6a.name: White Knight Lord
69e6ee9cab9adc10a6568c6a.description:
You can banish 3 monsters from your GY; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 "White Knight" or "White Night" monster from your hand or Deck.
● Add 1 "White Veil" from your Deck to your hand.
You can only use this effect of "White Knight Lord" once per turn. When an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's monster: Change that opponent's monster's ATK to 0. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

69e6eeb909ae46be2ba202c9.name: Invincible Demise Lord
69e6eeb909ae46be2ba202c9.description: During the End Phase, if a monster(s) was destroyed by battle this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, and if "Invincible Demise Lord" was destroyed by battle this turn, this card's original ATK becomes 3000, also it cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your Main Phase: You can reveal cards in your Deck, including "Slash Draw", equal to the number of cards your opponent controls +1 and place those revealed cards on top of the Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Invincible Demise Lord" once per turn.

69e6eedf09ae46be2ba20323.name: Elemental HERO Clay Guardian
69e6eedf09ae46be2ba20323.description:
1 "Elemental HERO" monster + 1 Warrior monster
(This card is not treated as a "Guardian" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck, then if your opponent controls a card, you can inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "HERO" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Elemental HERO Clay Guardian" once per turn. Other "Elemental HERO" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

69e6eefefa29dac39ff31c64.name: Doll Hammer
69e6eefefa29dac39ff31c64.description: Target 1 monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, draw 2 cards, then you can change the battle position of 1 monster your opponent controls. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Doll Hammer" once per turn.

69e6ef1937222ea291f1b60b.name: Quick Summon
69e6ef1937222ea291f1b60b.description: Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster. When you do, if your opponent controls a monster, you can Normal Summon a Level 5 or higher monster without Tributing. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; add 1 Level 5 or higher monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck or GY to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Quick Summon" once per turn.

69e6ef30bc6d01b34bc24bd1.name: D - Burst
69e6ef30bc6d01b34bc24bd1.description: Target 1 face-up Spell you control; destroy it, and if you do, draw 1 card, then if you control a "Destiny HERO" monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your hand, GY, or banishment. At the end of the Damage Step, if a monster equipped with an Equip Card, or "Destiny HERO - Dogma", attacked: You can banish this card from your GY; that monster can make a second attack in a row. You can only activate 1 "D - Burst" per turn.

69e6efeb7b5f3c949bede1a9.name: Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
69e6efeb7b5f3c949bede1a9.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Continuous Spells you control to the GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. While this card is in face-up Defense Position, monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one.

69e8538070602340424e469b.name: Pre-Preparation of Rites
69e8538070602340424e469b.description: Add 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand, and add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck or GY to your hand whose name is mentioned on that Ritual Spell. You can only activate 1 "Pre-Preparation of Rites" per turn.

69ea7cb18e0fa916b4bf7d93.name: Shade the Obscure
69ea7cb18e0fa916b4bf7d93.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You cannot Pendulum Summon, except Pendulum Monsters (this effect cannot be negated). If a monster(s) with 1000 ATK or less is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can return this card to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Shade the Obscure" once per turn.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If you have a card in your Pendulum Zone and this card is in your hand: You can Special Summon this card. You can pay 1000 LP; destroy 1 Pendulum Monster Card in your hand or face-up field, then you can add 1 Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your face-up Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Shade the Obscure" once per turn.

69ea7ccd96895cef89f1f661.name: VIP Whale
69ea7ccd96895cef89f1f661.description: You can Tribute additional monsters when you Tribute Summon this card face-up. If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can place VIP Counters on this card equal to the number of monsters Tributed for its Tribute Summon. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can remove 1 VIP Counter from this card; toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, negate that effect. If you call it wrong, this card's original ATK becomes halved until the end of this turn.

69ea7cef3f91a0639b0afb91.name: GMX Partner Selandea
69ea7cef3f91a0639b0afb91.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "GMX" monster or 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand, also you can only attack directly with "GMX" monsters for the rest of this turn. If this card is Special Summoned by a monster effect: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "GMX" or Dinosaur monster from your hand, GY, or banishment in Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "GMX Partner Selandea" once per turn.

69ea7d01b1cb2cd0ffcebf2b.name: GMX Suppression Squad
69ea7d01b1cb2cd0ffcebf2b.description: If this card is in your hand and you control a "GMX" monster or a Dinosaur monster: You can Special Summon this card. You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; excavate the top cards of your Deck until you excavate a Dinosaur monster, send that Dinosaur monster to the GY, and if you do, the targeted monster becomes a Dinosaur monster (until the end of this turn), also shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "GMX Suppression Squad" once per turn.

69ea7d305970a876b1bfbdab.name: Evolved Daneen
69ea7d305970a876b1bfbdab.description:
"Returned Dino Daneen" + 1 Dinosaur monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "GMX" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Evolved Daneen" once per turn. If you excavate a card(s) by a "GMX" card effect: You can activate the following effect, based on where this card is at activation (but you can only use each effect of "Evolved Daneen" once per turn);
● Field: Gain 1500 LP.
● GY: Special Summon this card.

69ea7d4ff1057ddd1805fac3.name: GMX - COMPREX
69ea7d4ff1057ddd1805fac3.description:
1 "GMX" monster + 2+ Dinosaur monsters
Gains these effects based on the number of Dinosaur monsters used as Fusion Material for this card.
● 3+: Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects.
● 4+: Can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase.
● 5+: Each time your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s), they lose 800 LP.
Once per turn, if you excavate a card(s) by a "GMX" card effect: You can destroy all other monsters on the field.

69ea7d6055b49b5e51fbce28.name: GMX 55th Experiment Report
69ea7d6055b49b5e51fbce28.description: Fusion Summon 1 Dinosaur Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck using monsters from your hand or field. If your opponent controls a monster, you can also use 1 "GMX" monster in your Deck as material. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; excavate the top cards of your Deck until you excavate a "GMX" card, add that "GMX" card to your hand, also shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use 1 "GMX 55th Experiment Report" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

69ea7d708955eefed9c2b01e.name: GMX Lab #5
69ea7d708955eefed9c2b01e.description: Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when you Normal or Special Summon a "GMX" monster(s). During your Main Phase: You can Set 1 "GMX" Spell/Trap from your Deck, except "GMX Lab #5", then place 1 card from your hand on top of the Deck. You can only use this effect of "GMX Lab #5" once per turn.

69ea7d7c37e809e7b879b1bf.name: Anti-GMX Final Experiment
69ea7d7c37e809e7b879b1bf.description: Activate only if you control a "GMX" monster. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, then if you excavated a "GMX" card(s), negate that activated effect, also place all the excavated cards on the top or bottom of the Deck in any order.

69ec011f58df0d2564a48826.name: Gaming Gamer GG
69ec011f58df0d2564a48826.description:
2 Level 4 Machine monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can change all monsters your opponent controls to Attack Position. If your opponent has a monster in their field or GY: You can detach 1 material from this card; send 1 Machine monster from your Deck/Extra Deck to the GY, then you can apply this effect.
● Choose 1 Machine Xyz Monster in your GY, and this card's name becomes that monster's name until the End Phase.
You can only use this effect of "Gaming Gamer GG" once per turn.

69ec01775970a876b1c39b24.name: Fata Dragna
69ec01775970a876b1c39b24.description:
2 monsters with the same Type and Attribute, but different Levels
Your opponent cannot target Fusion Monsters you control with card effects. If this card is sent to the GY as material for a Fusion Summon: You can Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position (but negate its effects, also return it to the Extra Deck during the End Phase), also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Fata Dragna" once per turn.

69ec0190584fdfb951b7bdda.name: Genia of the Ring
69ec0190584fdfb951b7bdda.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; Special Summon this card, also that target becomes a Spellcaster monster. The next time that target would be destroyed by card effect this turn, it is not destroyed, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Spellcaster monsters. If this card is Tributed, or banished, to activate a Spellcaster monster's effect: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Genia of the Ring" once per turn.

69ec01a280848381b4f03ff0.name: Checkker
69ec01a280848381b4f03ff0.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned if you control a monster. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Machine monster from your Deck whose ATK equals its own DEF, but return it to the hand during the End Phase. You can banish this card from your GY and discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Iron Rubble Token" (Machine/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0), but it cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, or Link Summon. You can only use each effect of "Checkker" once per turn.

69ec01b0d37360e8620b6009.name: Rustin Mammoth
69ec01b0d37360e8620b6009.description: If this card is in your hand: You can banish Machine Link Monsters from your Extra Deck whose combined Link Ratings equal exactly 5; Special Summon this card. You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. This is a Quick Effect if this card is linked to a Link-3 or higher Machine Link Monster. You can only use each effect of "Rustin Mammoth" once per turn.

69ec01c3f002afb503e3fe1b.name: Officiating Reverie
69ec01c3f002afb503e3fe1b.description: If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other card; Special Summon this card. If an Xyz Monster(s) is sent to the GY, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 Zombie monster from your GY. During the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card was banished: You can target 1 Zombie Xyz Monster you control; attach this banished card to it. You can only use each effect of "Officiating Reverie" once per turn.

69ec01d4f1057ddd180a018b.name: Officiator of Doom Samuel
69ec01d4f1057ddd180a018b.description:
2 Level 6 monsters
During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 Zombie monster in your GY; Special Summon it, then you can negate the effects of 1 monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to that monster. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 monster in either GY; shuffle it into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Officiator of Doom Samuel" once per turn.

69f085f314c338322acd7f9d.name: Junk Warrior
69f085f314c338322acd7f9d.description:
"Junk Synchron" + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: It gains ATK equal to the total ATK of all Level 2 or lower monsters you currently control.

69f0f76d10aeeff2a4ec8c3e.name: Summoned Skull
69f0f76d10aeeff2a4ec8c3e.description:
A fiend with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the Fiend-Type monsters, this monster boasts considerable force.

(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

69f213ea13a8cc1e75beb10d.name: Witchcrafter Marka
69f213ea13a8cc1e75beb10d.description: You can Tribute this card from your hand or field; add 1 "Witchcrafter" Field or Continuous Spell from your Deck to your hand. If a face-up "Witchcrafter" monster(s) you control leaves the field by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card (but banish it when it leaves the field), and if you do, Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Marka" once per turn.

69f21414daefbcbd128152d4.name: Witchcrafter Pupils
69f21414daefbcbd128152d4.description:
1 "Witchcrafter" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
During the Main or Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell from your Deck to your hand.
● Reveal 1 "Witchcrafter" Normal or Quick-Play Spell in your hand; apply that Spell's activation effect.
During your End Phase: You can return 1 of your banished "Witchcrafter" cards to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Pupils" once per turn.

69f9b8258cfd59f0f3097f4f.name: Dark Magician
69f9b8258cfd59f0f3097f4f.description: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

69f9b8378348447851a974f9.name: Dark Magician Girl
69f9b8378348447851a974f9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[Continuous Effect] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of "Dark Magician" in both players' Graveyards] x 500.

69fae3345b71e2d05771baed.name: Unchained Ogre Shara
69fae3345b71e2d05771baed.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your hand, then destroy 1 card you control. If a card(s) on the field is destroyed by card effect, except by the effect of "Unchained Ogre Shara", or by battle, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card (but place it on the bottom of the Deck when it leaves the field) or add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Ogre Shara" once per turn.

69fae34e6ec95dc32b481184.name: Unchained Ogre Shma
69fae34e6ec95dc32b481184.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Unchained" monster from your Deck, except "Unchained Ogre Shma", then destroy 1 card you control, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Fiend monsters. If this card on the field is destroyed by card effect, except "Unchained Ogre Shma", or by battle: You can Special Summon 1 "Unchained" monster from your hand or Deck, except "Unchained Ogre Shma". You can only use each effect of "Unchained Ogre Shma" once per turn.

69faeb0b0414c2ee2ea05b6c.name: Unchained Enma Lord Yama
69faeb0b0414c2ee2ea05b6c.description:
2+ monsters, including an "Unchained Soul" monster
During your End Phase: You can target up to 2 Fiend monsters in your GY that were destroyed and sent there this turn; Special Summon them, but you cannot Special Summon, except Fiend monsters, while you control either of those face-up monsters. If this card on the field would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 face-up card on either field instead. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Enma Lord Yama" once per turn.

69faeb4809c1ef349a2918e1.name: Unchained Soul Rage Abominator
69faeb4809c1ef349a2918e1.description:
2+ monsters, including a Fiend monster
If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) face-up (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; destroy 1 Fiend monster you control, and if you do, negate the targeted monster's effects until the end of this turn. When a monster effect is activated on the field and you control a Link-4 or higher "Unchained" Link Monster (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; destroy the monster that activated that effect. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Soul Rage Abominator" once per turn.

69faeb7c93b2db7e61c0433c.name: Unchained Syncretism
69faeb7c93b2db7e61c0433c.description: Target 2 face-up monsters on the field, including an "Unchained Soul" Link Monster you control; immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 Fiend monster using only those 2 monsters. If this Set card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Unchained" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Syncretism" once per turn.

69faeb99e6ca98ae4c59bb28.name: Unchained Abomination
69faeb99e6ca98ae4c59bb28.description:
2+ monsters, including a Link Monster
If a card(s) on the field is destroyed by card effect, except by "Unchained Abomination" (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it. When another monster is destroyed by battle: You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it. During the End Phase: You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Abomination" once per turn.

69ffbe647459e0214d6365ac.name: Destiny HERO - Destro-Dogma
69ffbe647459e0214d6365ac.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by banishing 3 Warrior and/or DARK monsters from your GY. You can only Special Summon "Destiny HERO - Destro-Dogma" once per turn this way. If Summoned this way: You can activate this effect; inflict 2000 damage to your opponent during the next Standby Phase. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 DARK or Warrior Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling its materials from your hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck.

69ffbe89364e7af974d7b23c.name: Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord
69ffbe89364e7af974d7b23c.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it until the next Standby Phase. You can send 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to the GY; add 1 "Clock Tower Prison" or "Dark City at Midnight" from your Deck or GY to your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK "HERO" monsters. You can only use each effect of "Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord" once per turn.

69ffbea0852324679800904d.name: Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Servant
69ffbea0852324679800904d.description: If you control a "Destiny HERO" monster or a face-up Field Spell: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can destroy 1 card you control, and if you do, add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Capsule Monster Chess" once per turn.
