6a2d2addf0f93b750b6aac22.description: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

6a2d2ae5165c2b98caa47704.name: Dark Magician Girl
6a2d2ae5165c2b98caa47704.description: Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in the GYs.

6a2d2aee165c2b98caa47721.name: Polymerization
6a2d2aee165c2b98caa47721.description: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field.

6a2d2af9051dbb7dcf0cf0fb.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
6a2d2af9051dbb7dcf0cf0fb.description: "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"

6a305b735acb71350a42e835.name: Akasuna the Battle Ashtra
6a305b735acb71350a42e835.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand/Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Akasuna the Battle Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Akasuna the Battle Ashtra" once per turn. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Trap from your hand or face-down field to the GY; change all face-up monsters your opponent controls to face-down Defense Position. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Ashtra" Trap from your Deck.

6a305ba747ce4eb77eaf16e9.name: Kuzuha the Hex Ashtra
6a305ba747ce4eb77eaf16e9.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand or Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Kuzuha the Hex Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Kuzuha the Hex Ashtra" once per turn. You can target 1 card on the field for every 2 face-down cards on the field; destroy it. During your End Phase: You can target 1 "Ashtra" Trap in your GY; Set it.

6a305bcb14fecf8782056914.name: Yoa the Plague Ashtra
6a305bcb14fecf8782056914.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand/Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Yoa the Plague Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Yoa the Plague Ashtra" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Set 1 "Ashtra" Spell/Trap from your Deck. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; increase or decrease its Level by 1.

6a305beba4198f62a1934ae5.name: Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra
6a305beba4198f62a1934ae5.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand/Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 non-Wyrm "Ashtra" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material for an "Ashtra" monster: You can target 1 Normal Trap in your GY; Set it.

6a305c0463f55c9537631ca4.name: Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus
6a305c0463f55c9537631ca4.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus" once per turn. If you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" or "Umi": You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 3 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; add that many cards that mention "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand, except Level 7 monsters, then you can send 1 card on the field to the GY.

6a305c4124a25200d7adfcd2.name: Warchief of Atlantis
6a305c4124a25200d7adfcd2.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Warchief of Atlantis" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand. If you control "Umi" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card.

6a305c5412e77bca85fbb790.name: Monster Arms of Atlantis
6a305c5412e77bca85fbb790.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Monster Arms of Atlantis" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position. When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your field or GY, and send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; negate that activated effect.

6a305c63e7afdf3414926c94.name: Siren Vortex of Atlantis
6a305c63e7afdf3414926c94.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Siren Vortex of Atlantis" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 card that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to the GY, except "Siren Vortex of Atlantis". If this card is sent to the GY and you control "Umi": You can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand.

6a305cc32d18398507ceb12b.name: Ashtraja Susanoo
6a305cc32d18398507ceb12b.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can banish any number of Traps from your GY; banish that many cards on the field. During the End Phase: You can target up to 2 "Ashtra" monsters and/or "Ashtra" Traps in your GY and/or banishment; for each of them, add it to your hand or Set it, then if you targeted 2 cards, return this card to the Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Ashtraja Susanoo" once per turn.

6a305ceacbdc7263cde34072.name: Ashtraya Mikumari-no-Mikoto
6a305ceacbdc7263cde34072.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Ashtra" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, send 1 card on the field to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Ashtraya Mikumari-no-Mikoto" once per turn. If your opponent activates a monster effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 "Ashtra" Trap in your GY or banishment, or if there are 3 or more face-down cards on the field, you can target 1 Trap in your GY instead; Set it.

6a305d0d047a20faa0a2217a.name: Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage
6a305d0d047a20faa0a2217a.description:
4 monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 3 monsters that mention "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your GY to your zones this card points to, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. This card's name becomes "Umi" while in the Monster Zone. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; send all cards on the field to the GY, except "Umi".

6a305d286f9bd680bb58ffb6.name: Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus
6a305d286f9bd680bb58ffb6.description:
3 WATER monsters
This card's name becomes "Umi" while in the Monster Zone. You can only use each of the following effects of "Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; discard your opponent's entire hand, and if you do, they draw the same number of cards. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation.

6a305d8645eede9dae68eb56.name: Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond
6a305d8645eede9dae68eb56.description: You can target any number of face-down cards you control; add "Ashtra" cards from your Deck to your hand, except Field Spells, each with a different name, equal to the number of those face-down cards, then send those face-down cards to the GY. If you control an "Ashtra" monster and a face-down card, and either player Sets a card: You can target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond" once per turn.

6a305dc39bcda26726bce308.name: Ashtra's Web
6a305dc39bcda26726bce308.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Insect/Tuner/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● Target 1 "Ashtra" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Web" per turn.

6a305dd12d18398507ceb467.name: Ashtra's Howl
6a305dd12d18398507ceb467.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Spellcaster/Tuner/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● If you have an "Ashtra" monster in your field or GY: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Howl" per turn.

6a305de01a0abc7451fee85d.name: Ashtra's Domain
6a305de01a0abc7451fee85d.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua/Tuner/WATER/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect, and your opponent controls no face-down cards: Negate that effect.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Domain" per turn.

6a305df8047a20faa0a22502.name: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
6a305df8047a20faa0a22502.description: While a monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" is on the field, reduce the Levels of all monsters in both players' hands and fields by 1. If you Link Summon a "Daedalus" monster, you can reduce the material requirement listed on it by 1 and Link Summon it with 1 less material. If this card is in your GY and you control "Umi": You can place this card face-up on your field. You can only use this effect of "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" once per turn.

6a305e036c17809c3b277193.name: Call of Atlantis
6a305e036c17809c3b277193.description: Add 1 monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand, then if you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon", you can negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn. If you control "Umi": You can banish this card from your GY; WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF. You can only use each effect of "Call of Atlantis" once per turn.

6a305e0c12e77bca85fbbde6.name: Advent of Atlantis
6a305e0c12e77bca85fbbde6.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while in the Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use each of the following effects of "Advent of Atlantis" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can place 1 "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" or "Umi" from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Level 7 Sea Serpent monster from your Deck to your hand.

6a305e1845eede9dae68ed6e.name: Daedalus Maelstrom
6a305e1845eede9dae68ed6e.description: When your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s) while you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon": Negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s), then if you control a WATER Link Monster, you can destroy all non-WATER monsters on the field. You can banish this card from your GY and send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only use 1 "Daedalus Maelstrom" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6a3119f66a744cf9d6769213.name: Jar of Greed
6a3119f66a744cf9d6769213.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When a player Normal Summons a monster, or when you draw a card during your turn.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card.

6a311a019770f29e0a25cd86.name: Painful Choice
6a311a019770f29e0a25cd86.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. Your opponent chooses 1 excavated card, and you add it to your hand. Send the other cards to the Graveyard.

6a311a203142a8045e38c1c8.name: Aussa the Earth Charmer
6a311a203142a8045e38c1c8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was flipped face-up, or you have another face-up Spellcaster Type monster with 1500 DEF on your field.
[EFFECT] Take control of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower EARTH Attribute monster on your opponent's field, except a Maximum Monster.

6a311a2d9770f29e0a25cdb8.name: Eria the Water Charmer
6a311a2d9770f29e0a25cdb8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was flipped face-up, or you have another face-up Spellcaster Type monster with 1500 DEF on your field.
[EFFECT] Take control of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower WATER Attribute monster on your opponent's field, except a Maximum Monster.

6a311a3bd50b0ccb874a1d7d.name: Hiita the Fire Charmer
6a311a3bd50b0ccb874a1d7d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was flipped face-up, or you have another face-up Spellcaster Type monster with 1500 DEF on your field.
[EFFECT] Take control of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower FIRE Attribute monster on your opponent's field, except a Maximum Monster.

6a311a4943276659c13b6e1a.name: Wynn the Wind Charmer
6a311a4943276659c13b6e1a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was flipped face-up, or you have another face-up Spellcaster Type monster with 1500 DEF on your field.
[EFFECT] Take control of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower WIND Attribute monster on your opponent's field, except a Maximum Monster.

6a311a5a9fa8b3c215121456.name: Aussa the Earth Spiritualist
6a311a5a9fa8b3c215121456.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send 1 monster from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Aussa the Earth Spiritualist".

6a311a66f2591724b8e546fb.name: Eria the Water Spiritualist
6a311a66f2591724b8e546fb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send 1 monster from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Place 1 monster from your opponent's Graveyard on the top of the Deck. Then, your opponent cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters with the same original name as that monster face-up until the end of your opponent's next turn. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Eria the Water Spiritualist".

6a311a71e3b1d8c0e25ba4bc.name: Hiita the Fire Spiritualist
6a311a71e3b1d8c0e25ba4bc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send 1 monster from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Then, you can draw 1 card. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Hiita the Fire Spiritualist".

6a311a7be4fa496ab5d51c18.name: Wynn the Wind Spiritualist
6a311a7be4fa496ab5d51c18.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send 1 monster from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Place 1 face-up Effect Monster from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck, except a Maximum Monster. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Wynn the Wind Spiritualist".

6a311b296a744cf9d676939d.name: Familiar of the Earth Spiritualist
6a311b296a744cf9d676939d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field or the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field become EARTH Attribute until the end of this turn. Then, you can change 1 face-down "Aussa the Earth Charmer" on your field to face-up Defense Position.

6a311b3b7e66d60bf16b8403.name: Familiar of the Water Spiritualist
6a311b3b7e66d60bf16b8403.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field or the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field become WATER Attribute until the end of this turn. Then, you can change 1 face-down "Eria the Water Charmer" on your field to face-up Defense Position.

6a311b4e999edf8fdb4cec31.name: Familiar of the Fire Spiritualist
6a311b4e999edf8fdb4cec31.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field or the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field become FIRE Attribute until the end of this turn. Then, you can change 1 face-down "Hiita the Fire Charmer" on your field to face-up Defense Position.

6a311b5a235f3b9ff55824b2.name: Familiar of the Wind Spiritualist
6a311b5a235f3b9ff55824b2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field or the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field become WIND Attribute until the end of this turn. Then, you can change 1 face-down "Wynn the Wind Charmer" on your field to face-up Defense Position.

6a311b6c999edf8fdb4cec79.name: Spiritual Coven
6a311b6c999edf8fdb4cec79.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Spellcaster Type monster with 500 or 1900 ATK/1500 DEF from your hand or Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you cannot attack with Level 9 or higher monsters.

6a311b78506e6ac751090efe.name: Spiritual Refinement
6a311b78506e6ac751090efe.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spellcaster Type monster with 500 or 1900 ATK/1500 DEF from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 5 Spellcaster Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. This turn, you cannot attack with Level 9 or higher monsters.

6a311b8242a55305e9301fdd.name: Handbook to the Spiritual Arts
6a311b8242a55305e9301fdd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Handbook to the Spiritual Arts".
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. You can destroy up to 1 card on your opponent's field for every 2 excavated Spellcaster Type monsters with 500 or 1900 ATK/1500 DEF. Place the excavated cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If you destroyed 2 cards, you can only attack directly with 1 monster this turn.

6a311b8cda89a61d90a85e73.name: Spiritualization Training
6a311b8cda89a61d90a85e73.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Spiritualization Training", reveal 2 monsters with the same Attribute in your hand.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Spellcaster Type monster with 500 or 1900 ATK/1500 DEF, and/or 1 Level 4 monster with 1500 ATK/200 DEF, with the same Attribute as the monsters revealed to meet the requirement from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a311b99b925e83c879d4073.name: Home of the Charmers
6a311b99b925e83c879d4073.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Level 3-5 Spellcaster Type monsters with 1500 original DEF on the field gain 500 ATK, and both players can Normal Summon Level 5 Spellcaster Type monsters with 1500 DEF without Tributing.

6a311c3e242b2dac92d7ffac.name: Digracheon the Skysavior Radiaknight
6a311c3e242b2dac92d7ffac.description:
1 WATER Attribute Warrior Type monster + "Soleil the Skysavior Angel" + "Soul of the Skysavior Angel"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] ●This turn, this card can attack directly. ●This card gains 1500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. ●This turn, this card can attack twice.

6a311c5276f8b27553a972de.name: Chartres the Skysavior Shining Light
6a311c5276f8b27553a972de.description:
"Claymont the Skysavior Advisor" + "Soleil the Skysavior Angel"
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] ●Until the end of your opponent's next turn, while this card is face-up, neither player can Special Summon Level 8 or lower Effect Monsters in face-up Attack Position. ●Until the end of your opponent's next turn, while this card is face-up, your opponent cannot Set monsters from the hand.

6a311c6318ff50da888c6d83.name: Cuilades the Skysavior Dismal Dark
6a311c6318ff50da888c6d83.description:
"Claymont the Skysavior Advisor" + "Lua the Skysavior Angel"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] During your turn, face-up Celestial Warrior and Warrior Type monsters on your field gain 500 ATK, and your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when they declare attacks.

6a311c7791d515be4b01c91d.name: Sanmarth the Skysavior Bright Brilliance
6a311c7791d515be4b01c91d.description:
"Seir the Skysavior Knight" + "Soleil the Skysavior Angel"
[REQUIREMENT] Show 1 other card from your hand or field, and place it on the bottom of the owner's Deck.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] ●Destroy 1 face-up Level 9 or lower monster on your opponent's field. ●Add 1 Level 1 Fairy Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a311c8fe4fa496ab5d51de2.name: Limlith the Skysavior Princess
6a311c8fe4fa496ab5d51de2.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 WATER Attribute Warrior Type monster or 1 Fairy Type monster.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 "Soleil the Skysavior Angel", "Lua the Skysavior Angel", and/or "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.

6a311ca3394cdd32767f0bba.name: Claymont the Skysavior Advisor
6a311ca3394cdd32767f0bba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send 1 card from your field to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 WATER Attribute Warrior Type monster, except a monster with 1200 DEF, or 1 "Skysavior Prayer" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a311cb6f882cca2b4dee320.name: Soul of the Skysavior Angel
6a311cb6f882cca2b4dee320.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Soleil the Skysavior Angel" or "Lua the Skysavior Angel" from your Graveyard to your hand. If you do, you can send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard.

6a311cc701bedadb13c503a0.name: Skysavior Oath
6a311cc701bedadb13c503a0.description:
This card's name becomes "Skysavior Prayer" while in the hand or Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a Celestial Warrior Type monster by sending 1 WATER Attribute Warrior Type monster and 1 or more Fairy Type Effect Monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

6a311cd1f95b930e7b1f45b3.name: Skysavior Aspiration
6a311cd1f95b930e7b1f45b3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 non-Legend Warrior or Fairy Type monster or 1 "Fusion" from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. Until the end of this turn, you cannot Special Summon non-Celestial Warrior Type monsters from the Extra Deck or attack with Level 8 or lower monsters.

6a311ce1c29d7e7edb0826cc.name: Skysavior Defense
6a311ce1c29d7e7edb0826cc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, shuffle 2 WATER Attribute Warrior Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Choose up to 2 Attack Position Celestial Warrior and/or Warrior Type monsters on your field. This turn, those monsters cannot be destroyed by battle. Then, you can Set 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

6a311ced9989f756dd389d96.name: Soul Flip
6a311ced9989f756dd389d96.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 4 or lower Effect Monster with 1400 or less DEF.
[EFFECT] Change that monster to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you have 3 or more different Attributes in your Graveyard, you can take control of that face-down Defense Position monster.

6a311da392e88b1cbb7e3b7d.name: The End the Mad Fiend Deity of Despair
6a311da392e88b1cbb7e3b7d.description:
"Dead End the Mad Fiend of Despair" + "Bad End the Mad Fiend of Despair"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 6 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy up to 2 cards on your opponent's field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your opponent's Graveyard face-up to your field.

6a311db53142a8045e38c585.name: Lock Core the Mad Fiend of Despair
6a311db53142a8045e38c585.description:
"Dead Core the Mad Fiend of Despair" + "Dead Lock the Mad Fiend of Despair"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card cannot be destroyed by card effects. This card cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon. Face-up non-Fiend Type monsters on your field lose 2000 ATK.

6a311dc52d511b5f822bda30.name: Heat Core the Mad Fiend of Despair
6a311dc52d511b5f822bda30.description:
"Dead Core the Mad Fiend of Despair" + "Dead Heat the Mad Fiend of Despair"
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 9 or lower monster from your opponent's Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Fiend Type monster from your Graveyard to your opponent's field in face-up Defense Position.

6a311dd7235f3b9ff558272e.name: Dead Core the Mad Fiend of Despair
6a311dd7235f3b9ff558272e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a DARK Attribute Fiend Type monster with 2400 DEF by sending monsters from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard as material.

6a311decf95b930e7b1f46ae.name: Bad End the Mad Fiend of Despair
6a311decf95b930e7b1f46ae.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 4 Spell/Trap Cards from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field. Then, if you have 6 or more monsters with the same Attribute in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower monster from your opponent's Graveyard face-up to your field.

6a311dfd999edf8fdb4ceef1.name: Dead Lock the Mad Fiend of Despair
6a311dfd999edf8fdb4ceef1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card cannot be Tributed for the Tribute Summon of a monster in Attack Position. Face-up non-Fiend Type monsters on your field lose 1000 ATK.

6a311e0a98c576c9f7ee127b.name: Dead Heat the Mad Fiend of Despair
6a311e0a98c576c9f7ee127b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have "Dead Core the Mad Fiend of Despair" face-up on your field.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add to your hand 1 DARK Attribute Fiend Type monster from among the cards sent.

6a311e19d50b0ccb874a20e8.name: Peace Core the Mad Fiend of Despair
6a311e19d50b0ccb874a20e8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Rite of Despair" or "Root of Despair" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone.

6a311e29968517cba1eba398.name: Rite of Despair
6a311e29968517cba1eba398.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Dead Core the Mad Fiend of Despair" by sending face-up Fiend Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 3 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).

6a311e32b239756f6a3df4b9.name: Root of Despair
6a311e32b239756f6a3df4b9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Dead Core the Mad Fiend of Despair" by sending Fiend Type monsters from your hand to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 3 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). Then, you can send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

6a311e3ef06ad0239d25e6b9.name: Despair and Desire
6a311e3ef06ad0239d25e6b9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Despair and Desire", send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 3 or 8 DARK Attribute Fiend Type monster with 1200 DEF from your hand face-up to your field. Then, if you have "Dead Core the Mad Fiend of Despair" on your field, you can add 1 DARK Attribute Fiend Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a311e4ae3b1d8c0e25ba909.name: Encounter with Despair
6a311e4ae3b1d8c0e25ba909.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 DARK Attribute Fiend Type monster with 1200 or 2400 DEF from your hand or Graveyard to your opponent's field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field.

6a311f413d5f982113e19e8c.name: Speed Officer
6a311f413d5f982113e19e8c.description:
"Speed Carrier" + "Speed Trooper"
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you activated this effect during your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card, you can destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

6a311f5201121b9a0ab05c07.name: Speed Major
6a311f5201121b9a0ab05c07.description:
"Speed Sniper" + 1 Warrior Type Effect Monster with 2000 or less DEF
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Other face-up WIND and EARTH Attribute Warrior Type monsters on your field gain 500 ATK. Those monsters gain an additional 500 ATK if you have a face-up WIND or EARTH Attribute Warrior Type monster with 2600 or more original ATK on your field.

6a311f65506e6ac7510912f9.name: Speed Commander
6a311f65506e6ac7510912f9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 3-5 Warrior Type Effect Monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, you can add 1 Warrior Type monster with 1400 ATK/100 DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Speed Commander".

6a311f74e3b1d8c0e25baa11.name: Speed Carrier
6a311f74e3b1d8c0e25baa11.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 3 or 4 WIND Attribute Warrior Type Effect Monster with 1000 or more ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can add 1 "Speed Up" or "Speed Turn" from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with Warrior Type monsters.

6a311f82b239756f6a3df5c1.name: Speed Sniper
6a311f82b239756f6a3df5c1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a Warrior Type monster with 2300 DEF by shuffling face-up Warrior Type Effect Monsters from your field into the owner's Deck as material. If you activated this effect during your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, you can also use Warrior Type Effect Monsters in your Graveyard as material. This turn, you can only attack with Warrior Type monsters, and you cannot activate the effect of "Speed Sniper".

6a311f8cb925e83c879d44b5.name: Speed Trooper
6a311f8cb925e83c879d44b5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains 200 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you activated this effect during your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, you can send the top card of either player's Deck to the Graveyard.

6a311f9c3d5f982113e19ef8.name: Speed Up
6a311f9c3d5f982113e19ef8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower WIND Attribute Warrior Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. Then, if you have 2 or more face-up WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters on your field, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

6a311fa5f67502af276adf3e.name: Speed Roll
6a311fa5f67502af276adf3e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Speed Roll".
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Warrior Type monster with 1400 ATK/100 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, if you have not drawn a card during this Main Phase, you can draw 1 card.

6a311fb176f8b27553a9762f.name: Speed Turn
6a311fb176f8b27553a9762f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 7 or higher monster face-up.
[EFFECT] Special Summon up to 2 WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters with 2000 or less ATK from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6a3120555f9614a0becc28a3.name: Miraculous Swordsman - Buster Blader
6a3120555f9614a0becc28a3.description:
"Buster Blader" + 1 Level 8 or lower Warrior Type monster
[REQUIREMENT] You have 10 or more cards in your Deck during your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, you can make this card gain ATK equal to [the total number of Dragon and Warrior Type monsters in both players' Graveyards] x 100 until the end of this turn.

6a312067968517cba1eba627.name: Beacon of Dragon Destroyer
6a312067968517cba1eba627.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Beacon of Dragon Destroyer".
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Warrior Type monster from your hand to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, if you have "Buster Blader" face-up on your field, you can draw 2 cards.

6a3120a898c576c9f7ee1477.name: Draco the Palm Greaser
6a3120a898c576c9f7ee1477.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have 2 or more cards in your hand, change this Attack Position card to face-up Defense Position.
[EFFECT] Your opponent gains 100 LP. Then, reveal 1 random card in your hand. Then, if that card is a Dragon Type monster, you can Special Summon it face-up to your field.

6a3120d2e4fa496ab5d521ab.name: Plasmatic Model Another Rising Blau
6a3120d2e4fa496ab5d521ab.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] Face-up monsters on your opponent's field lose 600 ATK/DEF.

6a3120eff63661af2f2277ab.name: Plasmatic Model Tool Ceto
6a3120eff63661af2f2277ab.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 Level 8 or higher monster.
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower Thunder Type monsters with 800 DEF from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 "Plasmatic Model Open" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a3121019989f756dd38a12e.name: Plasmatic Model Another Play
6a3121019989f756dd38a12e.description:
This card's name becomes "Plasmatic Model Play" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Plasmatic Model Another Rising Blau" or "Plasmatic Model Rising Lystella" by sending face-up Thunder Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). This turn, you can only attack with Thunder Type monsters.

6a31211ca31c9d5567547a30.name: Freshberry Collaboration
6a31211ca31c9d5567547a30.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send 1 other card from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your field to face-up Defense Position. Then, if you sent a WATER Attribute Aqua Type monster to the Graveyard to meet the requirement, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 10 or lower non-Maximum Monster on your opponent's field. This turn, you can only attack with Aqua Type monsters.

6a312130999edf8fdb4cf1e9.name: Brassdes of the Diabolic Duds
6a312130999edf8fdb4cf1e9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up non-Maximum Effect Monster with 100 or more ATK on your opponent's field, and this card gains ATK equal to [the chosen monster's ATK] until the end of this turn. Then, until the end of your opponent's next turn, neither player takes battle damage from battles involving this card.

6a312141999edf8fdb4cf1f7.name: Light of Bewitchment
6a312141999edf8fdb4cf1f7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Light of Bewitchment", declare the Attribute of 1 face-up Spellcaster Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] The Attribute of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field becomes the Attribute declared to meet the requirement until the end of this turn. After activation, you can Set this card instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

6a31214f76f8b27553a97756.name: Departure Zone
6a31214f76f8b27553a97756.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card by sending the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard, except during the first turn of the player going first.
[EFFECT] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, it cannot be destroyed by card effects, and during the Draw Phase of a player that has a card in their Field Zone, if they would draw until they have 5 cards in their hand for their normal draw, instead they draw until they have 6 cards.

6a31215ca31c9d5567547a84.name: Over Rush Volcano
6a31215ca31c9d5567547a84.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When an opponent's Level 8 or lower Effect Monster declares an attack, place 3 monsters with different ATK from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[EFFECT] Destroy the attacking monster. If it was not destroyed, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

6a323552cfc72fb187fa8616.name: Adamancipator Luminous
6a323552cfc72fb187fa8616.description:
2 Effect Monsters, including a Synchro Monster
If this card is Link Summoned, or a monster(s) is Special Summoned to a zone(s) this card points to: You can target 1 monster in your field or GY that has a Level; Special Summon 1 "Glimmer Token" (Rock/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the same Level. When another monster on the field activates its effect (Quick Effect): You can place it on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Luminous" once per turn.

6a3236348758e9943397c026.name: Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite
6a3236348758e9943397c026.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If you have a DARK monster in your GY: You can add 1 "Adamancipator" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, and if you do, you can return cards your opponent controls to the hand, up to the number of excavated Rock monsters, also place the excavated cards on the bottom of the Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite" once per turn.

6a32375a32a87d4d96f1412c.name: Adamancipator Mates
6a32375a32a87d4d96f1412c.description: Add 1 "Adamancipator" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can place 1 card from your hand on top of the Deck; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Mates" once per turn.

6a328a9685a2ef127eec84ea.name: Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite
6a328a9685a2ef127eec84ea.description: If this card is Special Summoned by an "Adamancipator" card's effect: You can add 1 "Adamancipator" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite", then you can Special Summon 1 Rock monster from your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 Rock Synchro Monster in your field or GY; return it to the Extra Deck, and if you do, place this card on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite" once per turn.

6a3298aff0ae823160ec9bef.name: Adamancipator Conductor
6a3298aff0ae823160ec9bef.description: If this card is in your hand: You can place 1 other "Adamancipator" card from your hand on top of the Deck; Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, and if you do, you can Special Summon 1 excavated Level 4 or lower Rock monster, also place the rest on the bottom of the Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Conductor" once per turn.

6a3298f42164ec6ece0afa85.name: Ancient Secrets
6a3298f42164ec6ece0afa85.description:
Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY in Defense Position (if you Special Summon from the Deck, it must be Level 4 or lower), or if you control a Normal Monster Card, you can apply 1 of these effects instead.
● Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
● Destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.
● Draw 2 cards.
● Special Summon 1 monster from either GY to your field.
You can only activate 1 "Ancient Secrets" per turn.

6a32990fa831ee0799ae2786.name: Hey, Space Trunade!
6a32990fa831ee0799ae2786.description: Return up to 2 cards on the field to the hand, then each player places cards from their hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order equal to the number returned to their hand. You can only activate 1 "Hey, Space Trunade!" per turn.

6a329aa8d2a3325678c979b5.name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
6a329aa8d2a3325678c979b5.description:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 monster on the field; banish it. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.
● If this attacking card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: It can make a second attack in a row.

6a329ac8cd124db733debd32.name: Call of the Haunted
6a329ac8cd124db733debd32.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

6a336d48314d231be5be2c35.name: Mind Mirror Force
6a336d48314d231be5be2c35.description:
If your opponent controls 5 or more face-up cards, this card's activation and effect cannot be negated, also you can activate this card the turn it was Set. At any of the following timings: Negate the effects of as many face-up cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, destroy them, also your monsters cannot attack directly until the end of the next turn after this card resolves.
● When the monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (even if tied) declares an attack.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect that would destroy a card(s) on the field.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect in the hand or field during your turn.

6a338411f690c5a4782087c7.name: WINDS OF VICTORY
6a338411f690c5a4782087c7.description: The equipped monster gains 300 ATK, also it becomes WIND.

6a3384796ddb0e1e61e7d832.name: Trap of the Poisonous Scorpion
6a3384796ddb0e1e61e7d832.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy it, then inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

6a33fd3afb6a4fe968855800.name: Helping Robo for Underwater Combat
6a33fd3afb6a4fe968855800.description:
2 Machine monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it, also this card, then you can Special Summon 1 non-WATER Machine monster with 1600 or less ATK from your GY. If this card is banished: You can add 1 Machine monster whose ATK equals its own DEF from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helping Robo for Underwater Combat" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except Machine monsters.

6a34348284c576cb68255c73.name: Witness of the Ancient
6a34348284c576cb68255c73.description: If you have a Synchro Monster in your field or GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can place up to 3 Synchro Monsters with different names from your Extra Deck and/or GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as face-up Continuous Spells, and Special Summon 1 "Arc Token" (Machine/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0) with a Level equal to the number placed, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use each effect of "Witness of the Ancient" once per turn.

6a3434ab4f31e8e03168b194.name: Shamanite Shamanknight
6a3434ab4f31e8e03168b194.description:
2+ Level 3 monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned, or if a Trap you own is banished: You can target 1 of your banished Traps; attach it to this card. You can detach any number of materials from this card, then target 1 DARK monster in your GY or banishment with a Level equal to the number detached; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Shamanite Shamanknight" once per turn.

6a3434c07b0c56b84b4038d7.name: Angelechy Problem
6a3434c07b0c56b84b4038d7.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell/Trap; Special Summon 1 Level 2 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck, and if you do, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. If a face-up "Angelechy" Monster Card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it.

6a3434ce7b0c56b84b40390b.name: Angelechy Disturbance
6a3434ce7b0c56b84b40390b.description: Give control of 1 "Angelechy" monster you control to your opponent (until the End Phase), then if your opponent controls a face-up card(s) in its adjacent Monster Zones and/or Spell & Trap Zones, their effects are negated. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Angelechy Disturbance". You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Disturbance" once per turn.

6a3434d683fb99678a9872d2.name: Angelechy Opening to e4
6a3434d683fb99678a9872d2.description: If your opponent goes first, you can also activate this card from your hand during the Standby Phase of their first turn. Place 1 "Angelechy" Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up on your field, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 2 or 7 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone, and if you do that, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. Until the end of your next turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters.

6a3434f63eca03c6ba812ce6.name: Angelechy Shatranga
6a3434f63eca03c6ba812ce6.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can add 1 "Angelechy" Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Shatranga" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, your opponent can only attempt to activate up to 5 monster effects per turn.

6a3435040e7e0e9e13f89912.name: Angelechy Bastion
6a3435040e7e0e9e13f89912.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 other card in this card's column; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can place 1 "Angelechy Shatranga" from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Bastion" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, other "Angelechy" cards on the field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

6a3435127743077d5f380815.name: Angelechy Destrier
6a3435127743077d5f380815.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 monster in another column; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can add 1 "Angelechy" Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Destrier" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, each time your opponent activates a card or effect, inflict 500 damage to your opponent when it resolves.

6a3435218cb21ff81e4a54c0.name: Angelechy Enlisted
6a3435218cb21ff81e4a54c0.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner
You can target 1 opponent's monster in this card's adjacent column; banish it, then change control of this card by moving it to one of your opponent's Main Monster Zones in this card's adjacent columns. If the control of this face-up card changes: Return this card to the Extra Deck, then the owner of this card Special Summons 1 "Angelechy" monster from their Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Enlisted" once per turn.

6a3438a3ba029160e2f1744a.name: Witness of the Ancient
6a3438a3ba029160e2f1744a.description: If you have a Synchro Monster in your field or GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can place up to 3 Synchro Monsters with different names from your Extra Deck and/or GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as face-up Continuous Spells, and Special Summon 1 "Arc Token" (Machine/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0) with a Level equal to the number placed, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use each effect of "Witness of the Ancient" once per turn.

6a346875ba029160e2f2177b.name: Yomagna the Fire Phantom
6a346875ba029160e2f2177b.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling 3 cards of the same type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from your GY into the Deck/Extra Deck. If this card is Special Summoned: You can declare 1 Monster Type; this card becomes that Type until the end of this turn. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck using monsters on either field, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Yomagna the Fire Phantom" once per turn.

6a346889ba029160e2f217aa.name: Thundercrash Snarecrow
6a346889ba029160e2f217aa.description: Each time a non-Thunder monster(s) is Special Summoned face-up, while this card is in the Monster Zone: That monster(s) cannot attack this turn, also destroy it during the End Phase. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Thundercrash Snarecrow" once per turn.

6a34689e96363a155ad9b848.name: Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest
6a34689e96363a155ad9b848.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can banish (face-up) 1 Beast monster from your hand or face-up field until the End Phase; Special Summon 1 EARTH Beast monster from your Deck or GY, with an equal or lower Level than that monster's original Level, then your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their hand. You can only use this effect of "Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest" once per turn. Your opponent's monsters that can attack must attack the monster you control with the highest ATK (their choice, if tied).

6a3468bc7954f34d56a5b918.name: Mixousia the Confounder
6a3468bc7954f34d56a5b918.description:
1 Spellcaster monster + 1 non-Spellcaster monster
You can target 1 face-up monster on the field and declare 1 Attribute; it becomes that Attribute. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing this card you control and monsters from your field or GY as material. If this card is in your GY: You can declare 1 Attribute; this card in the GY becomes that Attribute until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Mixousia the Confounder" once per turn.

6a3468d0f5a16e6e4a1c48bd.name: Mortilux Heruvur
6a3468d0f5a16e6e4a1c48bd.description:
2+ Level 8 monsters
If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; attach it to this card. You can only use this effect of "Mortilux Heruvur" once per turn. This card gains effects based on the number of materials attached to it.
● 2+: Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.
● 3+: Your opponent cannot target cards in the GYs with card effects.
● 4+: You can detach 3 materials from this card; send 1 monster on the field to the GY.

6a3468e27adaab3df4d00407.name: Imposter Shift
6a3468e27adaab3df4d00407.description: When a monster effect that was activated on your opponent's field by targeting a card(s) on the field resolves, if any of those targets are in a different column than that opponent's monster, they can banish 1 card from their GY. If they did not, negate the activated effect. You can banish 1 monster from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Imposter Token" (Psychic/EARTH/ATK 800/DEF 800) with the same Level as that monster. You can only use this effect of "Imposter Shift" once per turn.

6a3468eead61baa10ee5dc10.name: Distrust Paranoia
6a3468eead61baa10ee5dc10.description:
Take control of all your opponent's monsters in this card's column. If this Set card in its owner's control has left the field by an opponent's effect, and is now in the GY or banished: You can Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Fiend/DARK/Level 10/ATK 4000/DEF 4000) with the following effect (this card is NOT treated as a Trap).
● Unaffected by your opponent's card effects activated in the same column.
You can only activate 1 "Distrust Paranoia" per turn.

6a346df00e7e0e9e13f9588e.name: Stealth Angecradle
6a346df00e7e0e9e13f9588e.description: A mysterious entity said to be an angel who brings salvation to heretical souls. After "it" passes through, only eternal silence remains - Ange Passe.

6a364b32e9f59a2ce2bce2b8.name: Hubrow, Founder of the Ominous Observers
6a364b32e9f59a2ce2bce2b8.description: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hubrow, Founder of the Ominous Observers" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 Level 6 or higher Zombie monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Hubrow, Founder of the Ominous Observers", then you can add 1 Level 6 or higher Zombie monster from your GY to your hand. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the GY, while this card is in the Monster Zone, you can (except during the Damage Step): Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Zombie Xyz Monster.

6a3a6efb5351e70a9f167fe6.name: The Magical King of Dimension Zeta
6a3a6efb5351e70a9f167fe6.description: The observer of the void. Through every rift and distortion in spacetime, it contemplates all things in existence. Take heed. Whenever you peek through a door, Zeta peeks into your world in return.

6a3a6f4a43ca485dda353d97.name: Father Grizzly
6a3a6f4a43ca485dda353d97.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster with 1400 ATK from your Deck, or if you have 2 or more Level 4 monsters with 1400 ATK in your GY, you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster instead. When your opponent activates a monster effect, while you control a face-up non-Effect Monster (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use this effect of "Father Grizzly" once per turn.

6a3a6f65a2a5abcc55480c6d.name: Myriaday Dragon
6a3a6f65a2a5abcc55480c6d.description: Once per turn, during the End Phase: You can pay 100 LP; place 1 Myriad Counter on this card. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can place 1 Myriad Counter on this card for every 1000 points difference between your LP and your opponent's. Gains 10,000 ATK/DEF while it has 10 or more Myriad Counters. If this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect, remove 1 Myriad Counter from it instead.

6a3a6f7516e3be8f00ebcb9d.name: Stratiae the Stratasmasher Dino
6a3a6f7516e3be8f00ebcb9d.description:
2 monsters, including a Dinosaur monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can make this card gain ATK equal to half the combined original ATK of the Dinosaur monsters used as Link Material. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Dinosaur Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing its materials from your field or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Dinosaur monsters. You can only use this effect of "Stratiae the Stratasmasher Dino" once per turn.

6a3b0f00d5ccf27b7174fda7.name: Number 39: Utopia
6a3b0f00d5ccf27b7174fda7.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
When a monster declares an attack: You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the attack. If this card is targeted for an attack, while it has no material: Destroy this card.

6a3b0fa8dd835f5dd85e4b46.name: Firewall Dragon
6a3b0fa8dd835f5dd85e4b46.description:
2+ monsters
Once while face-up on the field (Quick Effect): You can target monsters on the field and/or GY up to the number of monsters co-linked to this card; return them to the hand. If a monster this card points to is destroyed by battle or sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Cyberse monster from your hand. You can only use each effect of "Firewall Dragon" once per turn.

6a3c1ceb68e312982bd0e765.name: Emissaries from Darkness
6a3c1ceb68e312982bd0e765.description:
If you take battle or effect damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, gain 2000 LP, then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 "Emissaries from Darkness" from your hand, Deck, or GY.
● Destroy up to 2 Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.
During the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Trap in your GY; Set it. You can only use each effect of "Emissaries from Darkness" once per turn.

6a3c768f782ad57f941bbded.name: Card of Last Will
6a3c768f782ad57f941bbded.description: If the ATK of a monster(s) you control becomes 0 by a card effect: Draw until you have 5 cards in your hand.

6a41be1f98a057009295ea74.name: Cartoon Shade
6a41be1f98a057009295ea74.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) while a face-up monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set is on the field. You can only Special Summon "Cartoon Shade" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 monster with 2000 ATK or DEF that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck to your hand. If this card on the field is Tributed: You can target 1 card on the field, or you can target 2 if you control a monster with 2000 ATK or DEF; return that card(s) to the hand.

6a41be35de6549af4981f8c4.name: Revenge of the Paper Dolls
6a41be35de6549af4981f8c4.description: Target 1 monster you control and 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy your monster, and if you do, negate the effects of that opponent's card until the end of this turn. If this Set card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Revenge of the Paper Dolls" once per turn.

6a41be43a9828c2c3d428cd5.name: Ms. Tick Call
6a41be43a9828c2c3d428cd5.description: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can discard 1 other Spellcaster monster or 1 Spell/Trap; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can banish 1 Level 4 Spellcaster monster from your Deck, and if you do, during the End Phase of this turn, add to your hand or Special Summon that banished monster. You can only use each effect of "Ms. Tick Call" once per turn.

6a41be55ba06ab9ced38d7ef.name: Bingo!

6a427733ffab6804d1fcc71e.name: Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse
6a427733ffab6804d1fcc71e.description:
Send the top cards of your Deck to the GY, up to the number of Traps with different names from each other in the GYs +1 (max. 4), then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 monster from among those cards.
● Set 1 Spells/Trap from among those cards, except "Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse". If you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn.

6a43e1068a3d1588b46a9694.name: Coralianectes, the Luminous Cradle Dragon
6a43e1068a3d1588b46a9694.description: While you control "Umi", your opponent cannot target WATER Link Monsters you control with card effects. If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can reveal this card and 1 WATER monster in your hand; Special Summon both, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WATER monsters. You can only use this effect of "Coralianectes, the Luminous Cradle Dragon" once per turn.

6a44d86976a191e2c9337ed5.name: Explosive Destructor Wyrm Dangerous Bakhamut
6a44d86976a191e2c9337ed5.description:
"Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut" + "Destructor Soldier Helmet"
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-up card on your field and 1 or 2 monsters on your opponent's field. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters on your opponent's field that were destroyed by this effect] x 500.

6a44d9faa40bdb8f8e756f2f.name: Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut
6a44d9faa40bdb8f8e756f2f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If either player has a card in their Field Zone, send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard, including a Wyrm Type monster.
[EFFECT] Destroy all face-up Level 8 or lower monsters on your opponent's field. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of monsters destroyed by this effect] x 300.

6a44df8cfa69a6a3776da4e4.name: Innocent Fadrawl
6a44df8cfa69a6a3776da4e4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, if you have not drawn a card during this Main Phase.
[EFFECT] Both players draw 1 card.

6a44e5aa9b40b1ae2131e753.name: Star of Beginning
6a44e5aa9b40b1ae2131e753.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP.
[EFFECT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 Level 5 or lower Normal Monster, "Fusion", or "Polymerization" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a4558f4f66be8b97cd7bcb3.name: Dark Armed Dragon Punisher
6a4558f4f66be8b97cd7bcb3.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 3 DARK monsters in your GY. You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower DARK monster from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish up to 3 DARK monsters from your GY, then target that many cards on the field; destroy them. You can only use each effect of "Dark Armed Dragon Punisher" once per turn.

6a478d97bc8233cfbbe0933f.name: The Great Gallant Bandit
6a478d97bc8233cfbbe0933f.description: You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing monsters in your hand and/or your opponent's field, while you control no monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Great Gallant Bandit" once per turn. When your opponent activates a card effect in the hand, GY, or banishment, and you control this Normal Summoned/Set card (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal your entire hand; change all monsters your opponent controls to Defense Position.

6a4b2332c972a871cc3c874b.name: Spell Power Attainment
6a4b2332c972a871cc3c874b.description: Add 1 card from your Deck or GY to your hand that mentions "Spell Counter" in its text, except "Spell Power Attainment", then if you control a Level 7 or higher "Endymion" Monster Card, you can remove any number of Spell Counters from your field, and if you do, negate the effects of that many face-up cards your opponent controls, and if you do that, destroy them. You can only activate 1 "Spell Power Attainment" per turn.

6a4faec91bc983443af3fb53.name: Evil Lord - Zorc
6a4faec91bc983443af3fb53.description:
You can discard 2 cards, including this card; add 1 Level 8 Fiend monster from your Deck to your hand. When your Fiend monster is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon this card from your GY. During your Main Phase: You can roll a six-sided die and apply this effect based on the result.
● 1, 2, 3, or 4: Take control of, or destroy, 1 monster your opponent controls.
● 5 or 6: Destroy 1 card you control.
You can only use each effect of "Evil Lord - Zorc" once per turn.

6a4faeecd81fb740e31e19aa.name: Garbage Golem
6a4faeecd81fb740e31e19aa.description: If you control a monster with 0 ATK or DEF: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can reveal 3 Xyz Monsters with different Ranks in your Extra Deck, then target 1 other card on the field; destroy both it and this card. You can banish this card from your GY; detach 1 material from a monster you control, then you can Special Summon 1 monster with 0 ATK or DEF from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Garbage Golem" once per turn.

6a4faf36901d24aea0300a39.name: Invocation - "Grail"
6a4faf36901d24aea0300a39.description:
If you have an "Aleister" monster in your field, GY, or banishment: Activate 1 of these effects;
● Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing 1 monster in your hand or field and 1 monster in your Deck as material.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing 1 monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls as material.
You can only activate 1 "Invocation - "Grail"" per turn.

6a4faf8c5ac75d038c04c5f6.name: Invoked De Anima
6a4faf8c5ac75d038c04c5f6.description:
1 "Aleister" monster + 1 monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck
If this card is Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy all monsters your opponent controls that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.
● Destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.
When your opponent activates a card effect in the GY (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck, and if you do, negate that activated effect. You can only use each effect of "Invoked De Anima" once per turn.

6a4fafc5398a4a4d123feac9.name: Theorealized Medius
6a4fafc5398a4a4d123feac9.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Power Patron" card.)
If a "Power Patron" card is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 "Theorealize" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is banished face-up: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 "Ars Magna" card from your Deck to your hand.
● Banish this card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Diactorus" monster from your Extra Deck.
You can only use each effect of "Theorealized Medius" once per turn.

6a4fb019ccd2db4cc2eb3ef8.name: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite
6a4fb019ccd2db4cc2eb3ef8.description: You can banish this card from your hand; add 1 non-Warrior "Ars Magna" monster from your Deck to your hand, also the original ATK of "Power Patron" Link Monsters you control become tripled for the rest of this turn. If a Fusion and/or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. If you control a "Power Patron" Link Monster: You can target 1 monster on the field; banish it. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite" once per turn.

6a4fb034230c8b5ac68799dc.name: Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification
6a4fb034230c8b5ac68799dc.description: You can banish this card from your hand; add 1 "Ars Magna" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, also until the end of the next turn, the first 3 times each of your "Power Patron" Link Monsters would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. If an Xyz and/or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can target Spells/Traps on the field up to the number of "Power Patron" Link Monsters you control; banish them. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification" once per turn.

6a4fb0aaaebd6f4f4d526985.name: Ars Magna the Division and the Union
6a4fb0aaaebd6f4f4d526985.description: You can banish this card from your hand; Special Summon 1 non-Spellcaster "Ars Magna" monster from your GY or banishment, also your "Power Patron" Link Monsters can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. If a Synchro and/or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can banish 1 "Ars Magna" card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Division and the Union" once per turn.

6a4fb0f373fd4c8c7a2b293c.name: Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron
6a4fb0f373fd4c8c7a2b293c.description:
2+ monsters, including a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster
Gains these effects based on the number of monsters it points to.
● 1+: Once per turn: You can negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls, also until the end of this turn, their ATK's become halved.
● 2+: Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects.
● 3: Once per opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card, also banish all cards your opponent controls.

6a4fb11f746d920e95e43ad9.name: Ars Magna "Citrinitas"
6a4fb11f746d920e95e43ad9.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Artmage", "DoomZ", and "Elfnote" card.)
You can activate the effects of monsters you control with "Ars Magna" in their original names as Quick Effects while you control a "Power Patron" Link Monster. Once while face-up on the field: You can add 1 "Medius" or "Ars Magna" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ars Magna "Citrinitas"" once per turn.

6a4fb1409360cc47dfacbb06.name: Ars Magna "Philosophorum"
6a4fb1409360cc47dfacbb06.description: Target up to 3 "Ars Magna" monsters in your field and/or GY; banish them, then you can negate the effects of up to that many other face-up cards on the field until the end of this turn. You can banish this card from your GY; return 1 "Power Patron" Link Monster from your GY into the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can only use 1 "Ars Magna "Philosophorum"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6a4fb1d249aec5fa37ff6bce.name: Blitzclique Overvolt
6a4fb1d249aec5fa37ff6bce.description: Target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Blitzclique Overvolt" once per turn.

6a4fb1e29360cc47dfacbd3e.name: Sacred Beasts Skyfall
6a4fb1e29360cc47dfacbd3e.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your "Sacred Beast" monster's effect activation: Negate that opponent's effect.
● Reveal 1 Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your hand; discard 1 card, and if you do, add 1 "Illusion Gate" from your Deck to your hand.
● Shuffle 3 "Sacred Beast" Traps from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.
You can only activate 1 "Sacred Beasts Skyfall" per turn.

6a522d565030b31efefc15a6.name: Ekhajar, Descendant Dragon of the Ice Barrier
6a522d565030b31efefc15a6.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can discard 1 card; banish 2 cards from your opponent's field and/or GY. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can banish 1 card from your hand; return 1 card in either field or GY to the hand. If this Synchro Summoned card is sent to the GY during your opponent's turn: You can banish 1 card from your opponent's hand (at random), field, or GY. You can only use each effect of "Ekhajar, Descendant Dragon of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

6a522d6d903cfd95ef21bf50.name: Shining Umbral Horror
6a522d6d903cfd95ef21bf50.description: If you Normal or Special Summon an "Umbral Horror" monster(s) and/or a "Masquerade" Xyz Monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card, then if you drew an "Umbral Horror" monster, you can Special Summon it. Can be treated as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a "Number" Xyz Monster that requires 3 or more materials. You can only use each effect of "Shining Umbral Horror" once per turn.

6a522d7c35ddfac9b79e6406.name: V Umbral Horror
6a522d7c35ddfac9b79e6406.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Umbral Horror" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "V Umbral Horror". You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Masquerade" Xyz Monster you control; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Number" monster that is 1 Rank higher than that monster you control, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials). You can only use each effect of "V Umbral Horror" once per turn.

6a522d897d6c907ef1f1af12.name: Gorgonic Umbral Horror
6a522d897d6c907ef1f1af12.description: You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Number" Xyz Monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "Gorgonic Umbral Horror" once per turn. If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Umbral Horror" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, add 1 non-Rock "Umbral Horror" monster from your Deck to your hand. Can be treated as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a "Number" Xyz Monster that requires 3 or more materials.

6a52474d98e1f038f2edcac3.name: Thousand Umbral Horror
6a52474d98e1f038f2edcac3.description: (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; place 1 "Seventh Barian's" from your hand or Deck face-up in your Field Zone, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck until the end of your next turn, except Xyz Monsters. If an Xyz Monster(s) is Special Summoned while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, also you take no effect damage from your card effects for the rest of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Thousand Umbral Horror" once per turn.

6a52475b3179444ff1a3a3dc.name: Barian's Seventh Untopia
6a52475b3179444ff1a3a3dc.description: Each player can only Special Summon non-"Number" monsters from the Extra Deck twice per turn while this card is face-up on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Barian's Seventh Untopia" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Umbral Horror" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. During the End Phase: Each player takes 400 damage for each Xyz Monster on the field.

6a524775cbbdb0ed2f9fc040.name: Barian's Hope
6a524775cbbdb0ed2f9fc040.description: Special Summon 1 "Umbral Horror" monster or "Masquerade" Xyz Monster from your hand or GY, then you can make the Levels of all "Umbral Horror" monsters you control become the Level of 1 "Umbral Horror" monster in your field or GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 "Number" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck or GY to it. You can only use each effect of "Barian's Hope" once per turn.

6a52478918e44d7766c4e654.name: Barian's Seal
6a52478918e44d7766c4e654.description: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, while you control a "CXyz" monster or a "Number C" monster with a number between "101" and "107" in its name: Negate the activation, then you can attach 1 monster from either field or GY to 1 Xyz Monster you control. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 2 "Umbral Horror" monsters from your GY. You can only use 1 "Barian's Seal" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6a524792bfa1c331260366c6.name: Number 104: Masquerade V
6a524792bfa1c331260366c6.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "Barian's" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use the following effect of "Number 104: Masquerade V" once per turn. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as material gains this effect.
● If this card is Xyz Summoned: Activate this effect; your opponent can banish 4 monsters with different Attributes and 1 Spell from their Deck. If they did not, you banish the top 10 cards of their Deck.

6a52479f7610e8d21507c3f2.name: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory
6a52479f7610e8d21507c3f2.description:
4 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. If this card battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation: This card's ATK/DEF become that opponent's monster's ATK or DEF (whichever is higher) +100 during damage calculation only. If this card destroys a monster by battle: Send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the GY, and if you do, halve your opponent's LP.

6a5247ab38f8a51cd85dbe25.name: CXyz Hope Chaos Barian Dragon
6a5247ab38f8a51cd85dbe25.description:
3+ Level 7 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using 1 monster you control with "Number C101" through "Number C107" in its name (transfer its materials). Gains 1000 ATK for each material attached to it. While this card has a "Number C" monster as material, cards cannot be added from the Main Deck to your opponent's hand except by drawing them. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; attach the top 2 cards of your opponent's Deck to this card.

6a5247b69c546eaec55cc366.name: Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity
6a5247b69c546eaec55cc366.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect. [EFFECT] Change the battle position of up to 2 monsters on your opponent's field. If you changed the battle position of a Ritual Monster by this effect, your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters with the same original name as that Ritual Monster this turn.

6a787a4ed234c2cde121c0f9.name: Brassdes Trap Hole

6a787a599347cf1e9dae3f9f.name: Beacon of the Dark Titan

[EFFECT] Look at 1 face-down monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you have a face-up monster with ATK greater than or equal to [that monster's original ATK] on your field, you can destroy the monster you looked at.

6a787a76c276f7e54161265e.name: Weaksauce Brassdes

[EFFECT] Excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated "Brassdes of the Diabolic Duds" or "Brassdes Trap Hole" to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

6a787a8799876e6e5c85a4be.name: Harpie Raffinato

6a787c2cd234c2cde121c4a1.name: Command Knight
