6a7fd828e9fba57d56402316.name: Scapegoat
6a7fd828e9fba57d56402316.description: Special Summon 4 "Sheep Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Normal Set).

6a7fd8494072e242e90bb8c4.name: Polymerization
6a7fd8494072e242e90bb8c4.description: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field.

6a7fd84eaf6003ebce3e5b63.name: Polymerization
6a7fd84eaf6003ebce3e5b63.description: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field.

6a7fd86f4e6711370386bf44.name: Fiend's Sanctuary
6a7fd86f4e6711370386bf44.description: Special Summon 1 "Metal Fiend Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). It cannot attack, also the opponent takes any battle damage its controller would have taken from battles involving it. Once per turn, during its controller's Standby Phase, they pay 1000 LP or destroy this Token.

6a7fd8704072e242e90bb946.name: Fiend's Sanctuary
6a7fd8704072e242e90bb946.description: Special Summon 1 "Metal Fiend Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). It cannot attack, also the opponent takes any battle damage its controller would have taken from battles involving it. Once per turn, during its controller's Standby Phase, they pay 1000 LP or destroy this Token.

6a7fd88dd69afb8957c6a5d6.name: Mirror Force
6a7fd88dd69afb8957c6a5d6.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

6a7fd88d892354168326e757.name: Mirror Force
6a7fd88d892354168326e757.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

6a7fd8a64e6711370386c010.name: Magic Cylinder
6a7fd8a64e6711370386c010.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.

6a7fd8a677463d40596dd2ce.name: Magic Cylinder
6a7fd8a677463d40596dd2ce.description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.

6a7fd8cf3ad023f70bdeddec.name: Exchange of the Spirit
6a7fd8cf3ad023f70bdeddec.description: If both players have 15 or more cards in their GYs: Pay 1000 LP; each player swaps the cards in their GY with the cards in their Deck, then shuffles their Deck. You can only activate 1 "Exchange of the Spirit" per Duel.

6a7fd8cf956b7c21cc0b6a1d.name: Exchange of the Spirit
6a7fd8cf956b7c21cc0b6a1d.description: If both players have 15 or more cards in their GYs: Pay 1000 LP; each player swaps the cards in their GY with the cards in their Deck, then shuffles their Deck. You can only activate 1 "Exchange of the Spirit" per Duel.

6a7fdecc501cb97302906d00.name: Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God
6a7fdecc501cb97302906d00.description: You can discard 1 other card; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God", then if your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours, you can discard 1 random card from their hand. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God" once per turn.

6a7fdedf501cb97302906d51.name: Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God
6a7fdedf501cb97302906d51.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God" once per turn.

6a7fdeffc4a0851ae9483992.name: Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God
6a7fdeffc4a0851ae9483992.description: If this card is in your hand and you control a "Sun God" card: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 other card in either GY; send 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, place the targeted card on the bottom of the Deck. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God" once per turn.

6a7fdf27f3183ac2f9887c58.name: Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God
6a7fdf27f3183ac2f9887c58.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God" once per turn. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY and you control a "Sun God" card, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return 1 other card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do that, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand.

6a7fdf560310184aaa00b9bf.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra, Sun God of Darkness
6a7fdf560310184aaa00b9bf.description:
"The Winged Dragon of Ra" + 3 "Sun God" monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard any number of "Sun God" cards, then choose that many of your opponent's occupied Main Monster Zones; your opponent must send the monsters in those zones to the GY. When an attack is declared involving this card: You can pay LP so that you only have 1 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid and the total ATK of all "Sun God" monsters currently in your GY.

6a7fdf773ad023f70bdef2fa.name: The Immortal Sun God
6a7fdf773ad023f70bdef2fa.description: Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your GY or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then if you Special Summoned "The Winged Dragon of Ra" by this effect, you can send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your Extra Deck. During the End Phase, send the monsters Special Summoned by this effect to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 "Sun God" card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Immortal Sun God" once per turn.

6a7fdf8a892354168326fc58.name: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness
6a7fdf8a892354168326fc58.description: Activate this card by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Sun God" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Its controller takes damage equal to its original ATK, then if you have "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your GY, you gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness" once per turn.

6a7fdf9c77463d40596de648.name: Sun God Domination
6a7fdf9c77463d40596de648.description:
If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster is on the field: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Special Summon 1 monster from each GY to your field.
● If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is on the field, take control of all monsters your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY and Tribute 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster; gain LP equal to the ATK it had on the field. You can only use each effect of "Sun God Domination" once per turn.

6a7fdfb1d028adcca9d2a5b8.name: Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God
6a7fdfb1d028adcca9d2a5b8.description:
Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 3000) with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap).
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster by this effect during your opponent's turn, you can Special Summon it.
● Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
You can only activate 1 "Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God" per turn.

6a7fdfc1e8a58ef5aae7a096.name: Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God
6a7fdfc1e8a58ef5aae7a096.description:
1 "Sun God" monster you control + 2 face-up monsters on the field
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) to your opponent's Main Monster Zone by sending the above cards from either field to the GY, but if you Special Summon this card with the second method, you can only Special Summon once for the rest of this turn. You can only Special Summon "Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

6a800e12a9426ba498fd8026.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra, Sun God of Darkness
6a800e12a9426ba498fd8026.description:
"The Winged Dragon of Ra" + 3 "Sun God" monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard any number of "Sun God" cards, then choose that many of your opponent's occupied Main Monster Zones; your opponent must send the monsters in those zones to the GY. When an attack is declared involving this card: You can pay LP so that you only have 1 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid and the total ATK of all "Sun God" monsters currently in your GY.

6a800e362df55650776665e4.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix
6a800e362df55650776665e4.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect. If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is sent from the field to your GY while this card is in your GY: Special Summon this card. Cards and effects cannot be activated in response to this effect's activation. Unaffected by other cards' effects. You can pay 1000 LP; send 1 monster on the field to the GY. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Send this card to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" from your hand, Deck, or GY, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

6a88099f83976b4e885fd2ed.name: A Journey Back to the Light - "Zenet"
6a88099f83976b4e885fd2ed.description:
Show 2 or 3 Normal Monster Cards in your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then apply the appropriate effect based on the number shown, then if you showed a card(s) in the hand, you can draw 1 card.
● 2: Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck as a Normal Monster Card.
● 3: Special Summon 1 "Zenet" monster from your Deck or 1 Normal Monster from your GY.
You can only activate 1 "A Journey Back to the Light - "Zenet"" per turn.

6a9919328d928529595657a7.name: Crocodile
6a9919328d928529595657a7.description: Thirteen stripes on its belly. Thirteen holes on its feet. Wherever people express themselves without hesitation, the crocodile is said to appear with a quiet grin.

6a991946df55e817431b65c6.name: Trirealm Rift Gospel
6a991946df55e817431b65c6.description: Activate this card by banishing (face-down) 5 cards from your GY and/or the top of your Deck. During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Trirealm Rift" monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). During your Main Phase: You can banish (face-down) 1 "Trirealm Rift" monster you control whose original Level is 4 or lower, and if you do, Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Trirealm Rift Gospel" once per turn.

6a991958f6e7eb5b5ad2d99d.name: The Stars of Raise Moon

6a9de2a6aca3f1c8004fc9f4.name: Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End
6a9de2a6aca3f1c8004fc9f4.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by placing 1 LIGHT Attribute and 1 DARK Attribute monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck in any order.
[REQUIREMENT] If you have not activated any effect during the turn you Special Summoned this card the above way, pay 1000 LP.
[EFFECT] Send all cards in both players' hands and fields to the Graveyard. Then, inflict damage to your opponent equal to [the number of cards sent to their Graveyard by this effect] x 300.

6a9de2e63ba410d22c48a332.name: XYZ-Dragon Cannon
6a9de2e63ba410d22c48a332.description:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Y-Dragon Head" + "Z-Metal Tank"
This card can be Union Fusioned (Fusion Summon by placing the above face-up cards from your field on the bottom of the owner's Deck in any order as materials).
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field.

6a9de2f4ff422ae108b002e9.name: YXZ-Cannon Dragon
6a9de2f4ff422ae108b002e9.description:
"Y-Dragon Head" + "X-Head Cannon" + "Z-Metal Tank"
This card can be Union Fusioned. This card's name becomes "XYZ-Dragon Cannon" while in the Extra Deck.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Fusion Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 8 LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6a9de305e49d521dc72205e5.name: XY-Dragon Cannon
6a9de305e49d521dc72205e5.description:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Y-Dragon Head"
This card can be Union Fusioned. This card can be treated as 2 materials, "X-Head Cannon" and "Y-Dragon Head", for the Fusion Summon of "XYZ-Dragon Cannon".
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-up Spell Card on your opponent's field.

6a9de3197ffff2e9847f5393.name: XZ-Tank Cannon
6a9de3197ffff2e9847f5393.description:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Z-Metal Tank"
This card can be Union Fusioned. This card can be treated as 2 materials, "X-Head Cannon" and "Z-Metal Tank", for the Fusion Summon of "XYZ-Dragon Cannon".
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

6a9de329ef89ba4e2a72eb01.name: YZ-Tank Dragon
6a9de329ef89ba4e2a72eb01.description:
"Y-Dragon Head" + "Z-Metal Tank"
This card can be Union Fusioned. This card can be treated as 2 materials, "Y-Dragon Head" and "Z-Metal Tank", for the Fusion Summon of "XYZ-Dragon Cannon".
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-down monster on your opponent's field.

6a9de34fd485706be9f06131.name: X-Trial Cannon
6a9de34fd485706be9f06131.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "X-Head Cannon". Then, you can add 1 "Y-Trial Dragon" or "Z-Trial Tank" from your Graveyard to your hand. You cannot Special Summon non-LIGHT Attribute monsters from the Extra Deck until the end of this turn.

6a9de35d5b445509bd79f550.name: Y-Trial Dragon
6a9de35d5b445509bd79f550.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Y-Dragon Head". Then, you can Fusion Summon "XY-Dragon Cannon" or "YZ-Tank Dragon" by placing monsters from your field or Graveyard on the bottom of the owner's Deck in any order as material, including this card.

6a9de36bd485706be9f06163.name: Z-Trial Tank
6a9de36bd485706be9f06163.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Z-Metal Tank". Then, you can Fusion Summon "XZ-Tank Cannon" or "YZ-Tank Dragon" by placing monsters from your field or Graveyard on the bottom of the owner's Deck in any order as material, including this card.

6a9de37b30eefd72d937d1e8.name: Union Supporter
6a9de37b30eefd72d937d1e8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard, and declare 1 card name from among "X-Head Cannon", "Y-Dragon Head", and "Z-Metal Tank".
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes the name declared to meet the requirement. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 6 LIGHT Attribute Machine Type Fusion Monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

6a9de38d95149a0eba5c84cc.name: Searching Union
6a9de38d95149a0eba5c84cc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Take the bottom 5 cards of your Deck and show them. You can add up to 2 "X-Head Cannon", "Y-Dragon Head", and/or "Z-Metal Tank" from among the shown cards to your hand. Shuffle the other cards into the Deck.

6a9de39d5d5e38c93895ef9f.name: Product Union
6a9de39d5d5e38c93895ef9f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Add 1 "X-Head Cannon", "Y-Dragon Head", or "Z-Metal Tank" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can look at 1 face-down card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. If that card is a Trap Card, destroy it.

6a9de4a74687d8cb6a665a41.name: Pliage the Star Sanctuary
6a9de4a74687d8cb6a665a41.description:
"Pliage the Sacred Shooting Star" + 1 Level 4 or lower DARK Attribute monster + 1 Normal Monster
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can make the monster Special Summoned by this effect gain ATK equal to [its original DEF] until the end of this turn.

6a9de4d7bcfa2e731c2c7e36.name: Star Replete of the Star Sanctuary
6a9de4d7bcfa2e731c2c7e36.description:
"Star Replete" + 1 Normal Monster
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field. Then, this card inflicts piercing battle damage this turn.

6a9de4ea1a1eb7a645af7215.name: Fairy of the Stars
6a9de4ea1a1eb7a645af7215.description:
"Spirit of the Stars" + 1 Normal Monster
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 Level 5 or lower monster in your Graveyard. This turn, this card's name becomes the same as the chosen monster. Then, you can add 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Fairy of the Stars".

6a9de4fb9361c3c1c8c86762.name: Star Replete
6a9de4fb9361c3c1c8c86762.description: The tiny star dragon has grown and taken on a new form. Fueled by its bonds with people and the power of the stars, it contains a mysterious power within its body. When the fated hour comes, its name will be engraved in the star sanctuary.

6a9de50df2e9e25e6fafaafe.name: Journeying Pliage
6a9de50df2e9e25e6fafaafe.description:
This card's name becomes "Pliage the Sacred Shooting Star" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Pliage the Sacred Shooting Star". Then, you can add 1 Normal Monster or 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a9de51fb9df4bc8da4682e8.name: Spirit of the Stars
6a9de51fb9df4bc8da4682e8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can Fusion Summon a monster that mentions "Spirit of the Stars" or "Pliage the Sacred Shooting Star" as material by sending monsters from your hand or field to the Graveyard as material.

6a9de52be08370b6e7b2e78a.name: Spirit Sprite of the Stars
6a9de52be08370b6e7b2e78a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This turn, this card's name becomes "Spirit of the Stars". Then, you can add 1 "Pliage the Sacred Shooting Star" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a9de53c1de8d723f871ab24.name: Pliage's Clustering Stars
6a9de53c1de8d723f871ab24.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 "Fusion", "Star of Beginning", or "Star Restart" from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add to your hand 2 cards from among the cards sent. This turn, you can only attack with Fusion or Normal Monsters.

6a9de544ed94866a516ae79d.name: Encounter of the Stars
6a9de544ed94866a516ae79d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Encounter of the Stars".
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 6 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated Level 2 DARK Attribute monster with 1200 DEF, "Star Replete", or "Fusion" to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

6a9de54eaca3f1c8004fcf28.name: Evolution of the Star Dragon
6a9de54eaca3f1c8004fcf28.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Return 1 LIGHT or DARK Attribute Fusion Monster from your Graveyard to the Extra Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Attribute Normal Monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6a9de55aef89ba4e2a72eef7.name: Star Sanctuary of the Beginning
6a9de55aef89ba4e2a72eef7.description:
This card's name becomes "Star of Beginning" while in the hand or Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, place 1 Fusion Monster or Normal Monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Change that Normal Summoned monster to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you placed a Fusion Monster to meet the requirement, you can destroy 1 face-down card on your opponent's field.

6a9de63ff2e9e25e6fafacc7.name: Player #C39: Home Run Smasher V
6a9de63ff2e9e25e6fafacc7.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by sending 1 face-up Level 8 FIRE Attribute monster from your field to the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, place 1 Level 8 monster from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field. Then, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

6a9de64dbcfa2e731c2c80a5.name: Onomatopitcher
6a9de64dbcfa2e731c2c80a5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] "Feverous Spirit Stadium" is face-up on the field.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 4 FIRE Attribute Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position. Then, you can add 1 Level 8 FIRE Attribute monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Onomatopitcher".

6a9de65d30eefd72d937d760.name: SW - Asura Bat
6a9de65d30eefd72d937d760.description:
[REQUIREMENT] "Feverous Spirit Stadium" is face-up on the field.
[EFFECT] Equip this card to 1 face-up Level 8 or higher FIRE Attribute Warrior Type monster on your field as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect. This turn, you can only declare up to 3 attacks. ●The equipped monster can attack all opponent's monsters once each.

6a9de66995149a0eba5c89e4.name: Gagaga Cheergirl
6a9de66995149a0eba5c89e4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send 2 face-up Level 4 FIRE Attribute monsters from your field to the Graveyard. Then, you can Special Summon 1 FIRE Attribute monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. If you do, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Gagaga Cheergirl".

6a9de6773ba410d22c48acd4.name: Reliefcar D
6a9de6773ba410d22c48acd4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card, send all monsters from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have "Feverous Spirit Stadium" face-up on your field, you can draw 1 additional card. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Reliefcar D".

6a9de68930eefd72d937d7b4.name: The Player Returning Alive
6a9de68930eefd72d937d7b4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "The Player Returning Alive", send 1 Warrior Type monster or 1 Field Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, add to your hand 1 card from among the cards sent. Then, if you have "The Warrior Returning Alive" in your Graveyard, you can add 1 Level 4 or 8 Warrior Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

6a9de6937cff39cad0b9197c.name: Feverous Colorful Ball Park
6a9de6937cff39cad0b9197c.description:
This card's name becomes "Feverous Spirit Stadium" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Activate this card by sending the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, this card's name becomes "Feverous Spirit Stadium", neither player can activate Trap Cards when FIRE Attribute monsters declare attacks, and they inflict piercing battle damage.

6a9de69dd485706be9f06722.name: Barrel-Up-Magic Liner's Force
6a9de69dd485706be9f06722.description:
This card's name becomes "Tag-Up-Magic Sacrifice Force" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 face-up Level 4 or lower FIRE Attribute Warrior Type monster or 1 face-up Field Spell Card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 8 FIRE Attribute Warrior Type monster with 2500 or more ATK from your hand or Graveyard face-up to your field.

6a9de6b3a8f9b108ca2f0cc2.name: Koitsu
6a9de6b3a8f9b108ca2f0cc2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Equip this card to 1 face-up "Aitsu" on your field that is not equipped with a Union Monster Card as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect. ●The equipped monster gains 3000 ATK, and it inflicts piercing battle damage.

6a9de6c4f3973c3b5ead795e.name: Doitsu
6a9de6c4f3973c3b5ead795e.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Equip this card to 1 face-up "Soitsu" on your field that is not equipped with a Union Monster Card as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect. ●The equipped monster gains 2500 ATK.

6a9de6d6d485706be9f06797.name: Headhunters' Goraliath
6a9de6d6d485706be9f06797.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 Level 7 monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Headhunters' Goraliath".

6a9de6e5e08370b6e7b2eac7.name: Dirham the Holy Empress
6a9de6e5e08370b6e7b2eac7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 Union monster or 1 Field Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand. If you do, send 1 monster from your field or 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

6a9de6f5b5b9f7e471bc9807.name: Instant Fusion
6a9de6f5b5b9f7e471bc9807.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Instant Fusion", pay 1000 LP.
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Fusion Monster without using materials. The monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, and is sent to the Graveyard during the End Phase of this turn.

6a9de7070d8fc4f925e8ae1c.name: X-Head Cannon
6a9de7070d8fc4f925e8ae1c.description: A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.

6a9de717e08370b6e7b2eb2a.name: Y-Dragon Head
6a9de717e08370b6e7b2eb2a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Equip this card to 1 face-up "X-Head Cannon", or Fusion Monster that mentions it as material, on your field as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect. ●The equipped monster gains 400 ATK/DEF.

6a9de722aca3f1c8004fd321.name: Z-Metal Tank
6a9de722aca3f1c8004fd321.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Equip this card to 1 face-up "X-Head Cannon", "Y-Dragon Head", or Fusion Monster that mentions either of those cards as material, on your field as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect. ●The equipped monster gains 600 ATK/DEF.

6a9fd1c86d60a41337e47d23.name: Gearfried the Steel Knight
6a9fd1c86d60a41337e47d23.description: If a monster(s) you control was destroyed by battle or card effect this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, equip 1 monster from your GY to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 800 ATK. During your Main Phase: You can destroy as many cards equipped to this card as possible, then if you destroyed a Monster Card by this effect, you can add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand with the same Attribute and Type as 1 of them, but a different Level. You can only use each effect of "Gearfried the Steel Knight" once per turn.

6a9fd1da2db0a6fa7de44000.name: Armor Wizard Pazoo
6a9fd1da2db0a6fa7de44000.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Prophecy" card.)
If this card is in your hand or GY: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to it as an Equip Spell with the following effects. You can only use this effect of "Armor Wizard Pazoo" once per turn.
● The equipped monster gains 2100 ATK/DEF while your LP are 4000 or less.
● When a card or effect activated by your opponent resolves, if you control a card with an effect that requires a die roll, you can negate the activated effect, then banish this card.

6a9fd1f12db0a6fa7de440c6.name: King of Yamimado
6a9fd1f12db0a6fa7de440c6.description: While you control a face-down card, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, also your opponent cannot target it with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "King of Yamimado" once per turn. If this card is in your hand, and "Yami" and/or 2 or more face-down cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card. When a monster on the field with less ATK than this card activates its effect or declares an attack (Quick Effect): You can destroy that monster.

6a9fd20c4efffeeb413eba53.name: Attribute Rejection
6a9fd20c4efffeeb413eba53.description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; send 1 DARK or Zombie monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY, and if you do, the targeted monster loses ATK equal to the sent monster's original ATK, then if the targeted monster is LIGHT, negate its effects. You can only activate 1 "Attribute Rejection" per turn. If this card was activated as Chain Link 3 or higher, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

6a9fd21dfc39e83c1d967bef.name: Knight of Twin Swords
6a9fd21dfc39e83c1d967bef.description: Can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Knight of Twin Swords" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a card with an effect that requires a die roll: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can roll a six-sided die 3 times, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to the total x 350 (until the end of this turn), then if 2 or more of the results were the same, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

6a9fd235dc23a3eaa26ed742.name: Flashforce Sword
6a9fd235dc23a3eaa26ed742.description:
Banish (face-up) 1 random card from your opponent's hand (until the Standby Phase of the next turn), then if this card was Set before activation and it banished a monster, you can apply this effect based on its Level.
● 4 or lower: Your opponent banishes all monsters with its same name from their hand, Deck, and GY.
● 5 or higher: Add 1 Level 5 or higher monster with the same Type, Attribute, and/or Level from your Deck to your hand.
You can only activate 1 "Flashforce Sword" per turn.

6a9fd24ffc39e83c1d967cf6.name: Archfiend of Gilfer - Flame Attack
6a9fd24ffc39e83c1d967cf6.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; draw 1 card, then discard 1 card, also all monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK this turn. When a monster is destroyed by battle involving your Fiend monster, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Archfiend of Gilfer - Flame Attack" once per turn.

6a9fd269b0b655f0c4f6350d.name: Spell Card "Enemy Controller"
6a9fd269b0b655f0c4f6350d.description:
Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; apply 1 of these effects.
● Destroy it.
● Immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon 1 monster by Tributing monsters including the targeted opponent's monster, even though you do not control it.
During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Spell Card "Enemy Controller"" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Spell Card "Enemy Controller"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6a9fd3e6fcda1bce7c0a53da.name: Final Journey of the Soul
6a9fd3e6fcda1bce7c0a53da.description: When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a Monster Card(s) from the GY: Negate that effect, and if you do, Special Summon 1 monster from your opponent's GY to their field, then send any number of face-up monsters they control to the GY whose total ATK equal 6000 or less. If this card is banished: You can add it to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves (except during the Damage Step), you can Normal Summon 1 monster from your hand that requires 1 or more Tributes without Tributing. You can only use each effect of "Final Journey of the Soul" once per turn.

6a9fd40a594ac7fa1dff59d5.name: Aroma Strategy
6a9fd40a594ac7fa1dff59d5.description:
Once per turn: You can declare 1 card name; reveal the top card of your Deck, and if it is the declared card, you can apply this effect based on its card type. If it is not, destroy this card.
● Monster: Special Summon it.
● Spell/Trap: Set it.
If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Harpie" monster from your Deck or GY.

6a9fd439e152bf00d4cf1ced.name: Field Power Bonus
6a9fd439e152bf00d4cf1ced.description: If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned and there is another monster(s) on the field with the same Type: That Summoned monster(s) gains 1000 ATK/DEF. If this card is destroyed: Negate the effects of all face-up monsters currently on the field, also their ATK/DEF become their original ATK/DEF. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase, if this card is in your GY and there are no cards in the Field Zones: You can place this card face-up on your field.

6aa168aa70e7fa0da853e1ee.name: Perfect Eclosion - Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
6aa168aa70e7fa0da853e1ee.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 6 or more Insect monsters in your GY. You can only Special Summon "Perfect Eclosion - Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned: You can return as many cards your opponent controls as possible to the hand, then if you have a Normal Monster in your GY, you can make this card gain 300 ATK for each Insect monster in your GY. Each time your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s): All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK equal to their own Level x 100.

6aa1703ac5b29f0960628c08.name: Reindsurm Amurusa
6aa1703ac5b29f0960628c08.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 non-WIND "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Amurusa" once per turn.

6aa170698aaa9a133972662a.name: Reindsurm Luvian
6aa170698aaa9a133972662a.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 "Reindsurm" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Luvian" once per turn.

6aa170806a9ca369629ee190.name: Reindsurm Carcasas
6aa170806a9ca369629ee190.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can send 2 "Reindsurm" cards from your Deck to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Carcasas" once per turn.

6aa1709de3031d58aa12010c.name: Reindsurm Gigalovendra
6aa1709de3031d58aa12010c.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". (Quick Effect): You can send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, including this card; add 1 non-FIRE "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Ritual Summoned, or your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can shuffle up to 2 monsters on the field into the Deck. If this card and a WATER "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Gigalovendra" once per turn.

6aa170bf9784885bae3f166e.name: Reindsurm Giriakarma
6aa170bf9784885bae3f166e.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". When your opponent activates a monster effect in the field or GY and you control this Ritual Summoned card (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, then you can shuffle 1 monster each from both your opponent's field and GY into the Deck, also if either of them was a Dragon monster, double this card's ATK. If this card and a LIGHT "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Giriakarma" once per turn.

6aa1716b7aa246b01becf0d1.name: Reindsurm Conquest
6aa1716b7aa246b01becf0d1.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any number of Insect Ritual Monsters. You must also shuffle Insect and/or Dragon monsters from the GY(s) into the Deck whose total Levels equal or exceed the total Levels of the Ritual Monsters. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Insect monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Conquest" once per turn.

6aa1717f6a9ca369629ee84b.name: Reindsurm Carnation
6aa1717f6a9ca369629ee84b.description: While you control a "Reindsurm" monster whose original Level is 8 or higher or your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, the activated effects of your "Reindsurm" monsters cannot be negated. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Reindsurm" monster or Dragon monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add 1 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand with the same original Level, but a different original name.

6aa17192bb707c82de16fcaf.name: Reindsurm Butterfly
6aa17192bb707c82de16fcaf.description: Send 2 monsters from your Deck to the GY, including an Insect monster, also you cannot Special Summon until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, except Insect monsters. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; all "Reindsurm" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK/DEF. You can only use 1 "Reindsurm Butterfly" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6aa171a17aa246b01becf226.name: Reindsurm Practice
6aa171a17aa246b01becf226.description: Add 2 "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then if your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, you can add 1 Insect monster from your GY to your hand. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; place 1 "Reindsurm" Field Spell from your Deck face-up on your field. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Practice" once per turn.

6aa171b7c5b29f0960629516.name: Reindsurm Encounter
6aa171b7c5b29f0960629516.description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Reindsurm" monster: Negate the activation, then you can add 1 "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, and if you do, send 1 Insect monster you control to the GY. If a "Reindsurm" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can place this card from your GY on the bottom of the Deck instead. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Encounter" once per turn.

6aa1a4af9afb004e7f274f7d.name: Yubel
6aa1a4af9afb004e7f274f7d.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You take no battle damage from battles involving this card. Before damage calculation, if this face-up Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that attacking monster's ATK. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Tribute 1 other monster or destroy this card. When this card is destroyed, except by its own effect: Its owner can Special Summon 1 "Yubel - Terror Incarnate" from their hand, Deck, or GY.

6aa1a4db5470519fa749dd45.name: Wicked Canon
6aa1a4db5470519fa749dd45.description: Each time an opponent's monster declares an attack, place 1 Sinister Doctrine Counter on this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Wicked Canon" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 DARK Fiend monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 Fiend monster. You can send this card with 4 or more Sinister Doctrine Counters to the GY; Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your Deck, then you can add 1 "Super Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

6aa1a4ecc75631a804735be3.name: Hope for the Future
6aa1a4ecc75631a804735be3.description: If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster or "Elemental HERO Neos": Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions a "HERO" monster as material, using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Hope for the Future" once per turn.

6aa6b49afa6d85db5cae4d4f.name: Salamangreat Markhor
6aa6b49afa6d85db5cae4d4f.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY as material for a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE Cyberse monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Markhor" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except FIRE monsters.

6aa6b4af279763c15f55be53.name: Salamangreat Bastella
6aa6b4af279763c15f55be53.description: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Salamangreat" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can increase or decrease the Level of 1 monster on the field by 1. If you Link Summon a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; Set 1 "Salamangreat" Trap from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Bastella" once per turn.

6aa6b4be1bcb53d471d6cebe.name: King of Beasts, Risen from the Valley of Flames
6aa6b4be1bcb53d471d6cebe.description:
3 FIRE Effect Monsters
(This card is always treated as "Salamangreat Heatleo".)
Face-up monsters on the field become FIRE. During the Main Phase, if this card was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Heatleo" (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card your opponent controls; shuffle it into the Deck, then you can make the ATK of 1 FIRE monster your opponent controls become the ATK of 1 monster in your GY. You can only use this effect of "King of Beasts, Risen from the Valley of Flames" once per turn.

6aa6b4cc74a45dffdac9a383.name: Salamangreat Gearblade
6aa6b4cc74a45dffdac9a383.description: Special Summon 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your hand or GY, and if you do, equip this card to it. You can send 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your Deck to the GY; the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the sent monster's Level x 300. If this card is in your GY: You can shuffle 3 "Salamangreat" cards from your GY into the Deck, except Equip Spells, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gearblade" once per turn.

6aa6b4dbb76ab02e85be7d26.name: Salamangreat Shrine
6aa6b4dbb76ab02e85be7d26.description:
(This card is always treated as "Salamangreat Sanctuary".)
"Salamangreat" monsters you control are unaffected by your opponent's activated FIRE monsters' effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Salamangreat Shrine" once per turn. If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During your Main Phase: You can shuffle any number of "Salamangreat" cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw the same number of cards.

6aa6b4ebc711d4db90b3a2ba.name: Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest
6aa6b4ebc711d4db90b3a2ba.description: If you control a "Winter Raven" card, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" Spell/Trap or 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card or 1 Level 7 or 8 Monster Card in the Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it to your field.

6aa6b4f84c6b3d5828faed82.name: Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven
6aa6b4f84c6b3d5828faed82.description: You can send 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY; place this card face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon up to 2 "Winter Raven" monsters with different names from each other from your Deck, except "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven". When a monster declares an attack and this card is a Continuous Spell: You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

6aa6b50d279763c15f55c192.name: Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven
6aa6b50d279763c15f55c192.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Winter Raven" monster you control; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". You can only use each effect of "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

6aa6b55db9c0e254347cb266.name: Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest
6aa6b55db9c0e254347cb266.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by placing 1 Level 1 FIRE Monster Card from your face-up field or GY on the bottom of the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the hand, then target 1 monster in the face-up field or either GY; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. You can only use this effect of "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn.

6aa6b56c07460bf9ca10bb00.name: Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest
6aa6b56c07460bf9ca10bb00.description:
1 Fusion or Synchro Monster + 1 Spellcaster or Illusion monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can place any number of monsters you control face-up in their owners' Spell & Trap Zones as Continuous Spells, then you can return cards on the field to the hand up to the number of Spells/Traps you control. You can only use this effect of "Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. Gains 700 ATK/DEF for each Spell/Trap on the field. This face-up Fusion Summoned card cannot be used as Fusion Material.

6aa6b580b85f9d28c1da06e2.name: Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven
6aa6b580b85f9d28c1da06e2.description:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck.
● Extra Deck: Add 1 "Winter Raven" card from your GY to your hand.
You can only use each effect of "Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

6aa6b58db80368a5f085d45e.name: Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven
6aa6b58db80368a5f085d45e.description:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Target 1 card on the field; shuffle it into the Deck.
● Extra Deck: Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

6aa6b59d83e4e4ff2fdb4e8c.name: Deep Forest of the Winter Raven
6aa6b59d83e4e4ff2fdb4e8c.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your Deck to your hand. "Winter Raven" Monster Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" per turn.

6aa6b5ab6d190e8d179cd22d.name: Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch
6aa6b5ab6d190e8d179cd22d.description:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Diabell" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using up to 1 "Winter Raven" monster each from your hand, Extra Deck, and/or field.
● If you control a "Diabell" monster: Target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects until the end of this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch" once per turn.

6aa6b5b9279763c15f55c61c.name: Illusion of the Winter Raven Witch
6aa6b5b9279763c15f55c61c.description: Fusion Summon 1 Illusion Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your Extra Deck and/or field, also you cannot activate monster effects in the hand or GY for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Illusion monsters'. If the activation of this card in its owner's possession was negated by an opponent's card effect and sent to your GY: You can Set this card, and if you do, return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only activate 1 "llusion of the Winter Raven Witch" per turn.

6aa6b9a01bcb53d471d6f3a5.name: King of Beasts, Risen from the Valley of Flames
6aa6b9a01bcb53d471d6f3a5.description:
3 FIRE Effect Monsters
(This card is always treated as "Salamangreat Heatleo".)
Face-up monsters on the field become FIRE. During the Main Phase, if this card was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Heatleo" (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card your opponent controls; shuffle it into the Deck, then you can make the ATK of 1 FIRE monster your opponent controls become the ATK of 1 monster in your GY. You can only use this effect of "King of Beasts, Risen from the Valley of Flames" once per turn.

6aa6ba6b83e4e4ff2fdb7018.name: Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest
6aa6ba6b83e4e4ff2fdb7018.description:
1 Fusion or Synchro Monster + 1 Spellcaster or Illusion monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can place any number of monsters you control face-up in their owners' Spell & Trap Zones as Continuous Spells, then you can return cards on the field to the hand up to the number of Spells/Traps you control. You can only use this effect of "Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. Gains 700 ATK/DEF for each Spell/Trap on the field. This face-up Fusion Summoned card cannot be used as Fusion Material.

6ab07260f6788b3b663c34ba.name: Ace Sword Slash
6ab07260f6788b3b663c34ba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard, or if this is the first turn of the player going second this Duel.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, you can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monster with 2500 ATK and 1600 DEF from your Graveyard face-up to your field.

6ab072b53eefe376dc200bad.name: Session Together!
6ab072b53eefe376dc200bad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] You have 2 or more face-up monsters with the same Type on your field.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, you can make 2 face-up monsters on your field with the same Attribute gain 400 ATK until the end of this turn.

6ab072ec0c23e35d2fd70ce6.name: Transcendent Transformation
6ab072ec0c23e35d2fd70ce6.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon a LIGHT Attribute monster by sending monsters from your field to the Graveyard as materials, including a Fairy Type monster. If you Fusion Summon a Celestial Warrior Type monster by this effect, you can also use monsters in your hand as materials.

6ab2eaba3e26f903367d29db.name: Chaospawn Bishop
6ab2eaba3e26f903367d29db.description: If this card you control would be used as Synchro Material, you can treat it as a non-Tuner. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Chaospawn Bishop" from your hand, Deck, or GY, and if you do, it becomes LIGHT, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon, except LIGHT or DARK monsters, and you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Chaospawn Bishop" once per turn.

6ab2eacfd2e6c7d8e7759f2e.name: Angelechy Castellan
6ab2eacfd2e6c7d8e7759f2e.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 opponent's monster in this card's adjacent column, or 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone that is 2 columns away from this card's; banish that card. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can send 1 "Angelechy" card from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Castellan" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, each player can only activate 1 card or effect per Chain.

6ab2eba5f2eb9d7f95446249.name: Tigress in Silent Repose
6ab2eba5f2eb9d7f95446249.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that card when this card leaves the field. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can send 1 Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Tigress in Silent Repose" once per turn.

6ab2ebb8877e0e8807880365.name: Just Flip a Coin
6ab2ebb8877e0e8807880365.description:
If a face-up card(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, Special Summon 1 monster from your GY. If you call it wrong, Set 1 Trap from your GY. If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 monster from your GY.
● Set 1 Trap from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Just Flip a Coin" once per turn.

6ab2ebd0d2e6c7d8e775a700.name: Kumenyo, the Nine-Hued Deer
6ab2ebd0d2e6c7d8e775a700.description:
2+ Level 4 LIGHT and/or DARK monsters
During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; attach 1 card from your hand, GY, or banishment to this card, except the detached material. You can only use this effect of "Kumenyo, the Nine-Hued Deer" once per turn. Gains the following effects, based on the number of different Monster Types attached to it.
● 2+: Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
● 3+: Draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase.

6ab2ebe49cd519d1cc24b27c.name: Kerolia the Frolicsome
6ab2ebe49cd519d1cc24b27c.description: If a Spell/Trap(s) on the field is returned to the hand (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when that card was returned) or hand (even if not), in face-up or face-down Defense Position, but if you Summoned it from the GY, banish it when it leaves the field. If another card(s) on the field is returned to the hand, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of your banished Normal Traps; Set it. You can only use each effect of "Kerolia the Frolicsome" once per turn.

6ab2ec0e5d0078b7a7fd5121.name: Archidux, the Squid Sorcerer
6ab2ec0e5d0078b7a7fd5121.description:
2 WATER monsters
You can send 1 card you control to the GY; all WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF this turn. If a WATER Link Monster(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of those destroyed monsters; Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand or GY, with a Level less than or equal to that monster's Link Rating. You can only use each effect of "Archidux, the Squid Sorcerer" once per turn.

6ab2ec25c6e317cefbd41f84.name: Skyborne Blue Cularsaw
6ab2ec25c6e317cefbd41f84.description:
1 Level 8 or higher DARK monster + 1 Warrior monster
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can equip 1 Warrior monster from your GY or banishment, or 1 monster from your opponent's GY or banishment, to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 500 ATK/DEF. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Equip Card you control to the GY; negate the activation. You can only use each effect of "Skyborne Blue Cularsaw" once per turn.

6ab2ec3a935a363286aac793.name: Half Slice of Nickeline
6ab2ec3a935a363286aac793.description: If this card is Special Summoned from the Deck: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower Rock monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Half Slice of Nickeline". If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material, you can (except during the Damage Step): Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 Rock monster. You can only use each effect of "Half Slice of Nickeline" once per turn.

6ab2ec53935a363286aac839.name: Angelechy Seneschal
6ab2ec53935a363286aac839.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: Activate this effect; each player can Special Summon 1 Fairy Synchro Monster from their Extra Deck (but negate its effects), also this card, and monsters Special Summoned by this effect, cannot be used as material for an Xyz or Link Summon, and return them to the Extra Deck when they leave the field. If an "Angelechy" monster targets this card for an attack: Negate that attack, and if you do, give control of this card to your opponent. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Seneschal" once per turn.

6ab2ec62cee73ed1daa3f9fc.name: Angelechy Strategy Score
6ab2ec62cee73ed1daa3f9fc.description: Add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Angelechy Strategy Score", also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Strategy Score" once per turn.

6ab2ec6af2eb9d7f9544682f.name: Angelechy Brilliant Move
6ab2ec6af2eb9d7f9544682f.description: Return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can banish this card from your GY, then send 1 "Angelechy" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Brilliant Move" once per turn.

6ab2ec713e26f903367d372b.name: Angelechy Opposition
6ab2ec713e26f903367d372b.description: Choose 2 "Angelechy" monsters in your Extra Deck, with different names than the cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, Special Summon 1 of them in your opponent's Main Monster Zone, and place the other in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can banish this card from your GY; shuffle up to 5 "Angelechy" cards into the Deck from your GY and/or banishment, except "Angelechy Opposition". You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this card, except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Angelechy Opposition" per turn.

6ab2ec791ac12b892cb87255.name: Angelechy Endgame Problem
6ab2ec791ac12b892cb87255.description:
This card gains the following effects, based on the number of "Angelechy" Monster Cards in your Spell & Trap Zone.
● 1+: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: You can draw 1 card.
● 2+: When your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s), you choose the zone(s) to place it.
● 3+: Once per turn, you can activate 1 "Angelechy" Trap Card the turn it was Set.
● 4+: Once per turn, when your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can banish that monster(s).
● 5: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck.

6ab2ec84877e0e8807880963.name: Angelechy Verdict
6ab2ec84877e0e8807880963.description:
Apply this effect based on the number of "Angelechy" Monster Cards on the field.
● 1 to 4: Negate the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls.
● 5+: Banish all cards your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY; send 1 "Angelechy" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY, then you can place 1 "Angelechy" monster with a different name than the cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Verdict" once per turn.

6ab34e8fcf7df45797881b22.name: Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel
6ab34e8fcf7df45797881b22.description: Once per turn, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either effect, except Fusion Monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add up to 2 "Cubic" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand.

6ab34e9f51bd8bd7f68732fa.name: Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord
6ab34e9f51bd8bd7f68732fa.description:
1 "Cubic" monster + "Vijam the Cubic Seed"
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from your hand and/or field to the GY. Gains 800 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

6ab34f8c43eb316c080bea05.name: Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord
6ab34f8c43eb316c080bea05.description:
3 "Cubic" monsters
Gains 1000 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 3 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

6ab35684822648614d5e303c.name: Divine Anima Infinity the Creation Cubic Overlord
6ab35684822648614d5e303c.description:
4 "Cubic" monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 1500 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can shuffle all your banished "Cubic" cards into the Deck, and if you do, destroy 1 card your opponent controls. If this face-up card in its owner's control leaves the field by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon up to 3 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" from your GY.

6ab35694888e834081a7c6ec.name: Cubic Bodhi
6ab35694888e834081a7c6ec.description: When this card is activated: You can send 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to the GY. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; place 1 Cubic Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls (monsters with a Cubic Counter cannot attack, also negate their effects). If a "Cubic" monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only activate 1 "Cubic Bodhi" per turn.

6ab356a7822648614d5e31eb.name: Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils
6ab356a7822648614d5e31eb.description: If "Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye" or "Snake-Eyes Poplar" is in either GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn. You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela" from your GY; destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera" from your GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

6ab356c0888e834081a7c807.name: Dark Necrofear, the Ruler of Demise
6ab356c0888e834081a7c807.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by card effect. If you have 3 or more Fiend and/or Zombie monsters in your GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card on the field is destroyed: You can add this card to your hand, and if you do, take control of 1 monster your opponent controls (until the End Phase), then you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its ATK. You can only use each effect of "Dark Necrofear, the Ruler of Demise" once per turn.

6ab35710e61668748da0764b.name: Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist
6ab35710e61668748da0764b.description: This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a WIND or EARTH monster: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 2 Level 5 "Harpie" monsters from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WIND or EARTH monsters.

6ab35721d64956a5fc174b3f.name: Exodia the Obliterator
6ab35721d64956a5fc174b3f.description: When you draw this card during your turn: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned during your turn: You can activate this effect; for the rest of this turn, neither player can activate cards or effects, except "Exodia the Obliterator", also you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles: You can destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the total original ATK of those destroyed monsters.

6ab5ccd40925d34229be87ef.name: Exodia the Obliterator
6ab5ccd40925d34229be87ef.description: When you draw this card during your turn: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned during your turn: You can activate this effect; for the rest of this turn, neither player can activate cards or effects, except "Exodia the Obliterator", also you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles: You can destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the total original ATK of those destroyed monsters.

6ab5cce6eebbe1214d9e3654.name: Perfect Eclosion - Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
6ab5cce6eebbe1214d9e3654.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 6 or more Insect monsters in your GY. You can only Special Summon "Perfect Eclosion - Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned: You can return as many cards your opponent controls as possible to the hand, then if you have a Normal Monster in your GY, you can make this card gain 300 ATK for each Insect monster in your GY. Each time your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s): All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK equal to their own Level x 100.

6ab5ccf1c75d7f8b8ce8692b.name: Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist
6ab5ccf1c75d7f8b8ce8692b.description: This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a WIND or EARTH monster: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 2 Level 5 "Harpie" monsters from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WIND or EARTH monsters.

6ab5cd02b3eab35b4ab61db7.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant
6ab5cd02b3eab35b4ab61db7.description:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"
Cannot be destroyed by card effects, also unaffected by your opponent's activated effects during your opponent's turn. Can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase. Once per Chain, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster that was Special Summoned this turn, or 1 face-down card, that your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant" thrice per turn.

6ab5cd11c75d7f8b8ce869e9.name: Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon
6ab5cd11c75d7f8b8ce869e9.description: If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 DARK Machine monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon". During the Battle Phase, if this card is in your GY because it was sent there from the field this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon it, and if you do, toss a coin 3 times, then you can destroy monsters on the field up to the number of heads.

6ab5cd1d82f33ed414c9e997.name: Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion
6ab5cd1d82f33ed414c9e997.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion". Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can Tribute 2 monsters; Special Summon this card (this is treated as a Ritual Summon). During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, and if you do, equip it to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 2000 ATK.

6ab5cd3082f33ed414c9e9fb.name: Dark Necrofear, the Ruler of Demise
6ab5cd3082f33ed414c9e9fb.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by card effect. If you have 3 or more Fiend and/or Zombie monsters in your GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card on the field is destroyed: You can add this card to your hand, and if you do, take control of 1 monster your opponent controls (until the End Phase), then you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its ATK. You can only use each effect of "Dark Necrofear, the Ruler of Demise" once per turn.

6ab5cd3dea5a5ded36fdfa08.name: Gilford the Lightning, the Warrior of Thunderbolts
6ab5cd3dea5a5ded36fdfa08.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters, and if you Tributed a monster(s) that is owned by your opponent, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when this card is Special Summoned this way. If Summoned this way: Your opponent must send all monsters they control to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Gilford the Lightning, the Warrior of Thunderbolts" once per turn.

6ab5cd49ee360ddfc6bbc986.name: Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion
6ab5cd49ee360ddfc6bbc986.description:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Level 7 or higher monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for every other monster on the field. Can attack all your opponent's monsters, once each. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then you can destroy 1 card on the field. After this card destroys a card by battle or card effect and sends it to the GY, neither player can activate its effects while it is in the GY.

6ab5cd6d630be8eedc07b8b5.name: Autumn
6ab5cd6d630be8eedc07b8b5.description: This card's name becomes "Summer" while in the Field Zone. Once per turn: You can place Season Counters on this card equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can take 1 Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY that you can place a Season Counter on, except "Autumn", and place it face-up on your field, and if you do, place all Season Counters on this card on that card. If a card(s) in the Field Zone would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

6ab5ce519265373eb3ff9cfd.name: Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter
6ab5ce519265373eb3ff9cfd.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 Level 7 or lower monster (Spellcaster or Warrior). You can only Special Summon "Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter" once per turn this way. The first time this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. Twice per turn, each time your opponent draws a card(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card, or if your opponent drew by their own card effect, you draw the same number of cards instead. While you have 6 or more cards in your hand, negate all your opponent's activated Spell Cards and effects.

6ab5d4699265373eb3ffd145.name: Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter
6ab5d4699265373eb3ffd145.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 Level 7 or lower monster (Spellcaster or Warrior). You can only Special Summon "Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter" once per turn this way. The first time this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. Twice per turn, each time your opponent draws a card(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card, or if your opponent drew by their own card effect, you draw the same number of cards instead. While you have 6 or more cards in your hand, negate all your opponent's activated Spell Cards and effects.

6ab8de714679bf64f700f66f.name: The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor
6ab8de714679bf64f700f66f.description: During your opponent's End Phase: You can place this card from your GY on top of the Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can return this card from the field to the hand, and if you do, each player draws 1 card, then your opponent can draw 1 card, and if they do, you must keep your hand revealed during this Main Phase. (Quick Effect): You can banish this revealed card from your hand; destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor" once per turn.

6abfe0a0e882a7eccbcf3747.name: Bunnillin: Mocha MOD
6abfe0a0e882a7eccbcf3747.description: You can send 1 Normal Monster with 2000 or less ATK from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Bunnillin" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY face-up on your field. If your opponent Special Summons an Effect Monster(s), while this card is in the Monster Zone: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Bunnillin: Mocha MOD" once per turn.

6abfe0c67461397ce1cfd2a7.name: Bunnillin Extract
6abfe0c67461397ce1cfd2a7.description: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Extract" once per turn. If a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand or Deck.
