6ac7904bc37d5826baf02115.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have "Helpful Items" in your Graveyard, send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of "Helpful Items" in your Graveyard] x 300 until the end of this turn.

6ac791318662d0102fc14b46.name: Royal Rebel's Starting
6ac791318662d0102fc14b46.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If you have a face-up LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monster on your field, pay 600 LP.
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

6ac7913aa47a333954729fed.name: Star Protector Calling
6ac7913aa47a333954729fed.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated Level 4 or lower WATER Attribute monster with 0 or 1500 DEF and/or 1 "Star Protector Awakening" to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

6ac791432390e43ec0fc358e.name: Star Protector Awakening
6ac791432390e43ec0fc358e.description:
This card's name becomes "Fusion" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Place this card from your field on top of the owner's Deck.

6ac7914cbd15f1debf22d5bd.name: The Mysterious Flying Plants Are Real!!
6ac7914cbd15f1debf22d5bd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 4 or lower WIND Attribute Plant Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 6 or higher WIND Attribute Plant Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with Plant Type monsters.

6ac791551427cee484657814.name: Encounter with the Sacred Tree
6ac791551427cee484657814.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated "Lauan Adventurers" and/or 1 WIND Attribute Plant Type Effect Monster to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.

6ac7915f804088cffb1b2fed.name: Healthy's High!
6ac7915f804088cffb1b2fed.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon a Level 7 Pyro Type monster by sending 1 face-up Level 7 or higher Pyro Type monster with 1300 DEF from your field to the Graveyard as material. This turn, you can only attack with Pyro Type monsters.

6ac791738662d0102fc14bba.name: Healthy Mind Speedy Buzzer Battle!
6ac791738662d0102fc14bba.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon a Level 7 Pyro Type monster by sending 1 Level 7 or higher Pyro Type monster with 1300 DEF from your hand or field to the Graveyard as material. You cannot use a monster on your field as material by this effect, except "Healthie Cafferin".

6ac7918416d1e3e5c530f76a.name: A Throw Thanks to Good Health!
6ac7918416d1e3e5c530f76a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 3 Pyro Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 face-down card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. This turn, you can only attack with Pyro Type monsters.

6ac7918d041421063ded8150.name: Helpful Items
6ac7918d041421063ded8150.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 excavated "Goe Goe the Rumored Ninja" or "Ebisu the Ninja of Justice" to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. Then, if you placed 5 cards on the bottom of your Deck by this effect, you can gain 600 LP.

6ac79215976b13eab4dabaf5.name: Take A Short Break
6ac79215976b13eab4dabaf5.description:
This card's name becomes "Helpful Items" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Ninjitsu Art of Ultimate Transformation" or "Ninjitsu Art of Special Transformation" from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters.

6ac7921f041421063ded833d.name: Ninjitsu Art of Ultimate Transformation
6ac7921f041421063ded833d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon a Level 8 monster with 2500 ATK/1500 DEF by sending face-up WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

6ac792282390e43ec0fc3855.name: Ninjitsu Art of Special Transformation
6ac792282390e43ec0fc3855.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon a WIND Attribute Warrior Type monster by sending face-up WIND Attribute Warrior Type monsters from your field to the Graveyard as material whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the monster you Ritual Summon (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).

6ac79234976b13eab4dabb73.name: Sacred War of Arthenée
6ac79234976b13eab4dabb73.description:
This card's name becomes "Protection of Arthenée" while in the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 other face-up Spell Card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field. Then, you can add up to 2 Fairy Type Union monsters from your Graveyard to your hand.

6ac7923eb6699362bd16f0f8.name: Instant Gift
6ac7923eb6699362bd16f0f8.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 7 Warrior Type Fusion Monster with 2500 ATK in your Extra Deck, and declare 1 monster that is mentioned on that monster as material.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 1 monster whose card name was declared to meet the requirement from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Then, you can draw 1 card. This turn, you can only attack with Warrior Type monsters.

6ac792498662d0102fc14f1a.name: Final Ritual of the Ancients
6ac792498662d0102fc14f1a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Final Ritual of the Ancients".
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Reshef the Dark Being" by sending monsters from your hand or field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).

6ac792547ea73080d96671cb.name: Midnight Reading
6ac792547ea73080d96671cb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Midnight Reading", send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. Then, you can Special Summon 1 face-up Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone to your field in face-down Defense Position.

6ac792722390e43ec0fc3971.name: Rebel's Dive
6ac792722390e43ec0fc3971.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 4 or lower monster, shuffle 2 LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Destroy that Normal Summoned monster. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

6ac7927ce89c7f0f27b28e6d.name: Star Protector Recapture
6ac7927ce89c7f0f27b28e6d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, send 1 face-up WATER Attribute monster with 0 or 1500 DEF from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, if you destroyed a Fusion Monster by this effect, you can Special Summon 1 "The Imprisoned Dragon Princess" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot be destroyed by battle.

6ac7928694a327ad345ef0cc.name: Staaart Boasting About Your Health!
6ac7928694a327ad345ef0cc.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your opponent's turn, when your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
[EFFECT] Change up to 3 face-up Level 7 Pyro Type monsters on your field to face-down Defense Position. Then, change them to face-up Attack Position. Then, you can change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field.

6ac792908662d0102fc1506a.name: Cathedral of Arthenée
6ac792908662d0102fc1506a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack.
[EFFECT] Place 1 Fairy Type Union monster or 1 "Protection of Arthenée" from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck. Then, you can change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.

6ac793201582b3cacf2d95e7.name: The Disciple of Sacred Silence
6ac793201582b3cacf2d95e7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Neither player takes battle damage from battles involving this card until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can add 1 Fairy Type Union monster or 1 "Protection of Arthenée" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6ac7933a53bae51688eb5d74.name: Neo-Spacian Grand Mole
6ac7933a53bae51688eb5d74.description:
[REQUIREMENT] This card is in Attack Position.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field with higher ATK than this card, and you take damage equal to [the difference in ATK]. Then, return this card and that monster to the owner's hand. End this Main Phase.

6ac79352d9f1d72a610c45ab.name: Elemental HERO Earth Neos
6ac79352d9f1d72a610c45ab.description:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole"
This card can be Contact Fusioned (Fusion Summon by shuffling the above face-up monsters from your field into the owner's Deck as materials).
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Return 1 card from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.

6ac793688662d0102fc153f9.name: Reshef the Dark Being
6ac793688662d0102fc153f9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Ritual Summoned this card, send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Take control of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field that is not in Maximum Mode until the End Phase. This turn, you cannot activate that monster's effects.

6ac7937c30646c054bec27fb.name: Surtr the Brilliant Magical Sword
6ac7937c30646c054bec27fb.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 500 LP, and send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Return 1 face-up non-Maximum Monster from your field to the owner's hand. Then, if you returned a monster whose original Level is 7 by this effect, you can draw 1 card. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Surtr the Brilliant Magical Sword".

6ac79390604201aa989fa090.name: Crystal Seer
6ac79390604201aa989fa090.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was flipped face-up, or you have another face-up WATER Attribute Spellcaster Type monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck. Add 1 excavated card to your hand. Place the other card on the bottom of your Deck. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Crystal Seer".

6ac793a50a71a5613bb52522.name: Lostream Nereides
6ac793a50a71a5613bb52522.description:
You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 WIND Attribute monster.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Equip this card to 1 face-up monster on your field as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect. ●Other Spell/Trap Cards on your field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

6ac7f36a1579d3a90e70d365.name: Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
6ac7f36a1579d3a90e70d365.description: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY; draw that many cards, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

6acbd0dc501c79d600ff0e1e.name: Ars Magna Artmage
6acbd0dc501c79d600ff0e1e.description:
2+ monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "Artmage" monster
Your opponent cannot target your linked monsters with card effects. During your Main Phase: You can add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 "Ars Magna", "Artmage", "DoomZ", or "Elfnote" monster from your Deck, then if you have 3 or more different Monster Types on your field, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your GY or banishment. You can only use this effect of "Ars Magna Artmage" once per turn.

6acbd1da4c1c8d5bd5994ce7.name: Ars Magna DoomZ
6acbd1da4c1c8d5bd5994ce7.description:
2 monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "DoomZ" monster
Any monster destroyed by battle with your linked monster is banished. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ars Magna DoomZ" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can destroy, or banish, 1 card you control, then you can shuffle up to 2 cards from any GY(s) into the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "DoomZ" monster from your hand.

6acbd1ea3a826fae9931ee88.name: Ars Magna Elfnote
6acbd1ea3a826fae9931ee88.description:
2 monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "Elfnote" monster
Your linked monsters gain 300 ATK for each different Monster Type on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ars Magna Elfnote" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can send to the GY, or banish, 1 card you control, then you can return 1 monster on the field to the hand. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Elfnote" monster from your hand.

6acbd37af8977648b89875d3.name: Ars Magna Academic Arcane Apparition Acropolis
6acbd37af8977648b89875d3.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Artmage" card.)
Your activated "Medius" monsters' effects cannot be negated. If you have a "Power Patron" monster in your GY: You can banish 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster from your GY, and declare 1 "Ars Magna" Link Monster Card name that has not been declared for "Ars Magna Academic Arcane Apparition Acropolis" this turn; Special Summon that monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot be used as Link Material.

6acbe026d3ae78017dc35814.name: The Dark Dragon Lord of Ultum
6acbe026d3ae78017dc35814.description: A dragon from another star that awoke from within a sealed underground world. It's a well-known fact even in Dimension Zeta that when you first wake up, you can only exert one-thousandth of your true strength.

6ace1f86dc0a44fe1de3fdd7.name: Super Polymerization
6ace1f86dc0a44fe1de3fdd7.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Fusion Summon by sending monsters from either field to the Graveyard as material (you cannot use face-down monsters on your opponent's field as material). Neither player can activate Trap Cards when a monster is Special Summoned by this effect.

6ace202cbafe19178695ffb5.name: Dark Magician of Chaos
6ace202cbafe19178695ffb5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[EFFECT] Add 1 non-Legend Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, monsters destroyed by battle with this card this turn are placed on the bottom of the owner's Deck instead of being sent to the Graveyard. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Dark Magician of Chaos".

6ace203e4c07f930f313c3c1.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
6ace203e4c07f930f313c3c1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] ●Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, while this card is face-up, it gains 300 ATK. ●Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field.

6ace205591eb2e1779d43b07.name: Mad Reloader
6ace205591eb2e1779d43b07.description:
[REQUIREMENT] If your opponent has an Attack Position monster with 100 or more ATK on their field, send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

6ace206554e76ba0610c38f0.name: Magician of Faith
6ace206554e76ba0610c38f0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was flipped face-up.
[EFFECT] Add 1 non-Legend Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Magician of Faith".

6ace2074c694c76468bca479.name: Mask of Darkness
6ace2074c694c76468bca479.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was flipped face-up.
[EFFECT] Add 1 non-Legend Trap Card from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Mask of Darkness".

6ace208300278ff373ab4be1.name: Rescue Cat
6ace208300278ff373ab4be1.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send this face-up card from your field to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower Beast Type monsters from your Graveyard face-up to your field. Destroy the monsters Special Summoned by this effect during the End Phase of this turn. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Rescue Cat".

6ace209c90d1228e9793ac35.name: Summoner Monk
6ace209c90d1228e9793ac35.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard, and change this Attack Position card to face-up Defense Position.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 6 cards of your Deck. You can Special Summon 1 excavated Level 4 monster face-up to your field. Shuffle the other cards into the Deck. This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack.

6ace20ae47bf5305bd511a70.name: Maha Vailo
6ace20ae47bf5305bd511a70.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of Equip Cards equipped to this card] x 500.

6ace20c0bafe1917869600dd.name: Happy Lover
6ace20c0bafe1917869600dd.description: Enemies become overjoyed when struck by the Heart Ray emitted from the forehead of this tiny cherub.

6ace20ce6e2f95f15e7e32a5.name: Saggi the Dark Clown
6ace20ce6e2f95f15e7e32a5.description: This clown appears from nowhere and executes very strange moves to avoid enemy attacks.

6ace20e2ebe97f370aa616e8.name: Jerry Beans Man
6ace20e2ebe97f370aa616e8.description: Jerry, a bean soldier, believes he is the strongest warrior in the world, but his true abilities are still untested.

6ace2101ce6013c7088773cb.name: Robotic Knight
6ace2101ce6013c7088773cb.description: The Commander of Machine Types, he serves the Machine King. He is famous for the way he controls his troops.

6ace210e289de868ae7ba8c9.name: Swordstalker
6ace210e289de868ae7ba8c9.description: A monster formed by the vengeful souls of those who passed away in battle.

6ace2127139984b080646ce2.name: Penguin Soldier
6ace2127139984b080646ce2.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase this card was flipped face-up.
[EFFECT] Return up to 2 face-up Level 8 or lower monsters from your opponent's field to the owner's hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Penguin Soldier".

6ace213a1cadaec5f85dbd22.name: Rocket Warrior
6ace213a1cadaec5f85dbd22.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, this turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle, and you take no battle damage from battles involving it.

6ace214d6696cad846268778.name: Panther Warrior
6ace214d6696cad846268778.description:
This card cannot attack during a turn its effect was not activated.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send 1 other monster from your field to the Graveyard.

6ace215d4c07f930f313c616.name: Goblin Attack Force
6ace215d4c07f930f313c616.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, change it to face-up Defense Position.

6ace23823d2f598ee5c9fec9.name: Brain Control
6ace23823d2f598ee5c9fec9.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Pay 800 LP.
[EFFECT] Take control of 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field that is not in Maximum Mode until the End Phase (when control of that monster is returned, if there is no Monster Zone to return to, send it to the Graveyard). This turn, you cannot activate that monster's effects.

6ace238f4db0cb98d267147b.name: Bottomless Trap Hole
6ace238f4db0cb98d267147b.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster with 1500 or more ATK face-up.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 of those monsters, and place it on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

6ace239b4b071ee266790835.name: The Forceful Sentry
6ace239b4b071ee266790835.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and shuffle it into the Deck.

6ace23a36ddfaebe971e6303.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
6ace23a36ddfaebe971e6303.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Mystical Space Typhoon".
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field.

6ace23ac361f95e9a1f1381f.name: Shield Crush
6ace23ac361f95e9a1f1381f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have not activated "Shield Crush".
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 Defense Position monster on the field.

6ace23b56ddfaebe971e632a.name: One for One
6ace23b56ddfaebe971e632a.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can Special Summon 1 Level 1 monster from among the excavated cards or your Graveyard face-up to your field. Shuffle the other cards into the Deck.

6ad20644b6b760928fdae6b5.name: Wako Gozen Riletta
6ad20644b6b760928fdae6b5.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Ritual Summoned this card, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. Then, if you have 3 or more different Types in your Graveyard, this card gains 600 ATK until the end of this turn. This turn, you can only attack with Cyberse Type monsters, and you cannot activate the effect of "Wako Gozen Riletta".

6ad2065775c0ad657a8518ad.name: Waso Gozen Linker
6ad2065775c0ad657a8518ad.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[CONTINUOUS EFFECT] This card gains ATK equal to [the number of different Types in your Graveyard] x 100. If you have 3 or more different Types in your Graveyard, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

6ad2066a75c0ad657a8518f0.name: Dimension Riletta
6ad2066a75c0ad657a8518f0.description:
You can Special Summon this card from your hand to your field in face-up Defense Position by sending 1 other card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[REQUIREMENT] Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on the field. Then, if you have 3 or more different Types in your Graveyard, this card inflicts piercing battle damage this turn.

6ad2067a3450dbef4144f4f3.name: Dimension Oper
6ad2067a3450dbef4144f4f3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 3 or more different Types in your Graveyard, you can add 1 Level 8 LIGHT Attribute Cyberse Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with Level 8 or higher Cyberse Type monsters.

6ad20693c51b2cf1b1c7badd.name: Dimension Pramma
6ad20693c51b2cf1b1c7badd.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, if you have 3 or more different Types in your Graveyard, you can add 1 Level 8 LIGHT Attribute Cyberse Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can only attack with Level 8 or higher Cyberse Type monsters.

6ad206a2266b83e8fb23a0d4.name: Dimension Channel
6ad206a2266b83e8fb23a0d4.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 2 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Increase this card's Level by 4 until the end of this turn. Then, if you shuffled an EARTH Attribute Cyberse Type Ritual Monster to meet the requirement, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

6ad206b74eb8baec4513e15d.name: Reifu the Dimensional Sworn Ally
6ad206b74eb8baec4513e15d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, reveal 1 Cyberse Type monster in your hand.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 400 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Fuden Issen" from your Graveyard to your hand.

6ad206c554c7861177725d84.name: Nehime the Dimensional Sworn Ally
6ad206c554c7861177725d84.description:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Cyberse Type monster in your hand.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Dimension Pair Link L" or "Dimension Pair Link R" from your Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Nehime the Dimensional Sworn Ally".

6ad206dd18ebd8634e09bd46.name: Dimension Pair Link L
6ad206dd18ebd8634e09bd46.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Waso Gozen Linker" by sending face-up monsters from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). Then, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. If you do, you can Special Summon 1 "Dimension Riletta" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.

6ad206e7c51b2cf1b1c7bb8f.name: Dimension Pair Link R
6ad206e7c51b2cf1b1c7bb8f.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Ritual Summon "Wako Gozen Riletta" by sending face-up monsters from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). Then, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. If you do, you can Special Summon 1 "Dimension Linker" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Attack Position.

6ad206f943a5e7c33ee3eab3.name: Dimension Jump
6ad206f943a5e7c33ee3eab3.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add to your hand 1 Level 8 LIGHT Attribute Cyberse Type monster or 1 Level 4 monster with 500 DEF from among the cards sent. This turn, you can only attack with Cyberse Type monsters.

6ad2070d0179cf35efeec7f0.name: Searching Fuden
6ad2070d0179cf35efeec7f0.description:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Dimension Pair Link L", "Dimension Pair Link R", or "Fuden Issen" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you shuffled an EARTH Attribute monster by this effect, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

6ad2071b4eb8baec4513e25d.name: Fuden Issen
6ad2071b4eb8baec4513e25d.description:
[REQUIREMENT] When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, shuffle 1 Cyberse Type monster and 1 non-Cyberse Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field, and change it to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you have a face-up EARTH Attribute Cyberse Type Ritual Monster on your field, you can destroy the chosen monster.

6ad4af8e7e3908cc1dce4497.name: Crimson Nova Trinity the Dark Cubic Lord
6ad4af8e7e3908cc1dce4497.description:
3 x "Crimson Nova the Dark Cubic Lord"
Must be Fusion Summoned with the above Fusion Materials and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Cannot be targeted, or destroyed by, your opponent's card effects. When this card declares an attack: Halve your opponent's LP. When this card destroys a monster by battle: You can activate this effect; this card can make a second attack during this Battle Phase. If you take effect damage: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the damage you took.

6ad4aff3772b320ea2568f2d.name: Marincess Great Bubble Reef
6ad4aff3772b320ea2568f2d.description:
2+ WATER monsters
Once per turn, during each Standby Phase: You can banish 1 WATER monster from your GY or face-up field; draw 1 card. Each time a monster(s) is banished face-up: This card gains 600 ATK for each, until the end of this turn. You can send 1 WATER monster from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 of your banished "Marincess" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Marincess Great Bubble Reef" once per turn.

6ad4b00c0a7c7c9b9f1c2d4a.name: Marincess Azuri
6ad4b00c0a7c7c9b9f1c2d4a.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 WATER Cyberse monster with 1000 or less ATK from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WATER monsters. If you Link Summon a "Marincess" Link Monster(s), while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; equip 1 "Marincess" monster from your GY to 1 of those Link Monsters as an Equip Spell that gives it 600 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Azuri" once per turn.

6ad4b029772b320ea256908d.name: Marincess Ulpis
6ad4b029772b320ea256908d.description: If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other "Marincess" card or WATER monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap from your Deck. You can send 1 "Marincess" Link Monster Card you control to the GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Ulpis" once per turn.

6ad4b03890f6465647c926ce.name: Aqua Leviathan @Marincess
6ad4b03890f6465647c926ce.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Marincess" card. Monsters your opponent controls lose 1000 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Aqua Leviathan @Marincess" once per turn. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Marincess" card from your Deck to your hand, except a Ritual Monster, then discard 1 card. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can return cards your opponent controls to the hand up to the number of "Marincess" Monster Cards you control.

6ad4b0462d1e1267fedadd6a.name: Marincess Truth Heart
6ad4b0462d1e1267fedadd6a.description:
2+ "Marincess" monsters
If this card is Link Summoned using a Link Monster with 0 original ATK: You can Special Summon 1 Link-3 or lower "Marincess" monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Marincess Truth Heart" once per turn. You can banish 1 Link Monster Card from your field or GY; destroy 1 card your opponent controls, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot banish monsters with that same Link Rating to activate this effect of "Marincess Truth Heart".

6ad4b17ca425ff2d8f945add.name: Marincess Reef Lagoon
6ad4b17ca425ff2d8f945add.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 WATER Cyberse monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can shuffle up to 3 WATER monsters from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck. You can send this face-up card to the GY; Ritual Summon 1 WATER Cyberse Ritual Monster from your hand, by banishing WATER monsters from your GY whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster. You can only activate 1 "Marincess Reef Lagoon" per turn.

6ad4b1890a7c7c9b9f1c3665.name: Magistus Witchcrafter Aruru
6ad4b1890a7c7c9b9f1c3665.description: If this card is in your hand and a "Magistus" monster is on the field: You can Special Summon this card. You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can banish it, then target 1 "Magistus" or "Witchcrafter" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Magistus Witchcrafter Aruru" once per turn.

6ad4b1968b088ca8667c58c5.name: Invoked Magistus Heruvim
6ad4b1968b088ca8667c58c5.description:
1 "Magistus" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. When your opponent activates a monster effect, or their monster declares an attack, except during the turn this card was Special Summoned (Quick Effect): You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 "Magistus" or "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, except "Invoked Magistus Heruvim". You can only use each effect of "Invoked Magistus Heruvim" once per turn.

6ad4b1a475cb5d8b40fd9cb5.name: Trinitas Magistus
6ad4b1a475cb5d8b40fd9cb5.description:
2+ Spellcaster monsters
If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can equip 1 "Magistus" or Spellcaster monster from your Extra Deck to this card as an Equip Spell. You can discard 1 card; return all Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters from your opponent's field and GY to the Extra Deck. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can add 1 "Magistus" card from your GY or banishment to your hand. You can only use 1 "Trinitas Magistus" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6ad4b1bd52220d884c03ec31.name: Gandora-X the Blackmetal Rampaging Dragon
6ad4b1bd52220d884c03ec31.description: If this card is added from the Deck to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned: You can pay half your LP; destroy as many other monsters on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the highest ATK on the field among the destroyed face-up monsters they own, and if you do that, this card gains that much ATK. If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 "Final Geas" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gandora-X the Blackmetal Rampaging Dragon" once per turn.

6ad4b1cd75cb5d8b40fd9da2.name: Warrior's Devotion
6ad4b1cd75cb5d8b40fd9da2.description: Send 1 Warrior monster from your hand or Deck to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses ATK equal to the sent monster's ATK. If a Warrior monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Warrior's Devotion" once per turn.

6ad4b1dbfd6b4b018d2262d6.name: Time Chain
6ad4b1dbfd6b4b018d2262d6.description: Destroy this card during your opponent's 2nd Standby Phase after activation. Activate this card when your monster is targeted for an attack: Neither battling monster can be destroyed by that battle, also banish them after damage calculation until their controller's 2nd Standby Phase. Negate the activated effects of monsters with the same original name as monsters that are currently banished by this card's effect. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand.

6ad4b1e96724a29e0ccbdcd8.name: Necromancer of Dragon Magic
6ad4b1e96724a29e0ccbdcd8.description:
2 Effect Monsters
During your Main Phase: You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, choose 1 non-Fusion Monster in your GY whose name is mentioned on the revealed monster, and this card's name becomes that monster's (until the End Phase), then you can Fusion Summon the revealed Fusion Monster, by banishing its materials from your hand, field, and/or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Necromancer of Dragon Magic" once per turn.

6ad4b1f6e0f4ca5a2110a817.name: Castle of Vampire
6ad4b1f6e0f4ca5a2110a817.description: When this card is activated: Special Summon 1 DARK Zombie monster from your Deck or GY. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card. That monster is unaffected by the activated effects of other non-DARK monsters. If this face-up card leaves the field: Destroy as many cards you control as possible, and if you do, take 400 damage for each card destroyed. You can only activate 1 "Castle of Vampire" per turn.

6ad4b204fd6b4b018d22640f.name: Primrose the Twin Rikka Fairy
6ad4b204fd6b4b018d22640f.description: If a monster(s) is Tributed: You can Special Summon this card from your hand and 1 "Rikka" monster from your Deck, except "Primrose the Twin Rikka Fairy", in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Plant monsters. You can target 1 Plant monster you control; increase or decrease its Level by 2. During your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Plant Xyz Monster. You can only use each effect of "Primrose the Twin Rikka Fairy" once per turn.

6ad4b2167e3908cc1dce5567.name: Rikka Black Princess
6ad4b2167e3908cc1dce5567.description: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are Plant monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, but banish it when it leaves the field, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Plant monsters. You can Tribute 1 Plant monster from your hand or field; Special Summon 1 "Rikka" monster from your Deck, except "Rikka Black Princess". You can only use each effect of "Rikka Black Princess" once per turn.

6ad4b226e0f4ca5a2110a991.name: Teardrop the Rikka Empress
6ad4b226e0f4ca5a2110a991.description:
2 Level 10 Plant monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using "Teardrop the Rikka Queen" you control (transfer its materials). (Quick Effect): You can detach up to 6 materials from this card; send that many Spells/Traps on the field to the GY, then you can Tribute 1 monster on the field. You can only use this effect of "Teardrop the Rikka Empress" once per turn. Each time a monster(s) is Tributed: Attach 1 card from your opponent's GY to 1 Plant Xyz Monster you control.

6ad4b234a425ff2d8f945f86.name: Rikka Empress Strenna
6ad4b234a425ff2d8f945f86.description:
2 Level 6 Plant monsters
You can detach 2 materials from this card; Special Summon 1 Plant Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position, except "Rikka Empress Strenna", then if you Special Summoned a "Rikka" monster, you can attach 1 "Rikka" monster from your Deck to it. If a monster(s) is Tributed: You can Set 1 "Rikka" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Rikka Empress Strenna" once per turn.

6ad4b2420a7c7c9b9f1c3aeb.name: Rikka June Moon
6ad4b2420a7c7c9b9f1c3aeb.description: When you activate this card, you can also Tribute 1 Plant monster; take 2 "Rikka" monsters from your Deck with the same Level, but different names, add 1 of them to your hand and send the other to the GY, also if you Tributed a monster at activation, your opponent cannot target "Rikka" monsters you control with card effects this turn. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Plant Xyz Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Rikka June Moon" per turn.

6ad4b2502d1e1267fedaeb72.name: Power of the Duelist
6ad4b2502d1e1267fedaeb72.description:
Declare 2, 3, or 4 Attributes; apply this effect based on the number declared, also during the End Phase of this turn, you must send all cards you control to the GY, unless you have activated effects of monsters of all declared Attributes in your field and/or GY this turn.
● 2: Target 1 monster on the field; banish it.
● 3: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
● 4: Negate the effects of 2 face-up cards on the field.
You can only activate 1 "Power of the Duelist" per turn.

6ad4b2609dcc04fe60cbf514.name: Amazoness Chain Master - Brink of Death Chain Dance
6ad4b2609dcc04fe60cbf514.description: If this card is sent to the GY and you have another "Amazoness" monster in your GY: You can pay 1000 LP; your opponent can choose 1 Level 10 monster in their Deck or Extra Deck, and if they do, you can Special Summon it to your field, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but neither player can activate its effects this turn. If they do not, you discard 1 random card from their hand. You can only use this effect of "Amazoness Chain Master - Brink of Death Chain Dance" once per turn.

6ad4b287c526b9ad5135c8b2.name: Amazoness Fighter - Instant Kill Dance
6ad4b287c526b9ad5135c8b2.description: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck that mentions "Harpie Lady". During damage calculation, if your "Amazoness" monster battles an opponent's monster: You can activate this effect; for that battle, neither monster can be destroyed by battle, also you take no battle damage. You can only use each effect of "Amazoness Fighter - Instant Kill Dance" once per turn.

6ad4b29248005456a5796200.name: Amazoness Spellcaster - Forbidden Spell Dance
6ad4b29248005456a5796200.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Amazoness" monster from your Deck to your hand, except a Level 3 monster. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 EARTH or WIND Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. During damage calculation, if your "Amazoness" monster battles an opponent's monster: You can banish this card from your GY; switch the battling monsters' ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Amazoness Spellcaster - Forbidden Spell Dance" once per turn.

6ad4b29f1d752da2059f5857.name: Harpie Lady - Alluring Dance
6ad4b29f1d752da2059f5857.description: This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Harpie Lady - Alluring Dance" once per turn. During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can target 1 EARTH or WIND monster you control; return it to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand that mentions "Harpie Lady".

6ad4b2ac1d752da2059f58c7.name: Amazoness Swordmaster
6ad4b2ac1d752da2059f58c7.description:
2 "Amazoness" monsters
When your "Amazoness" monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can draw 1 card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Amazoness Swordmaster" once per turn. If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Amazoness" monster from your Deck. (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 Effect Monster on the field; it loses 500 ATK, also negate its effects.

6ad4b2b948005456a57962da.name: Triangle Ecstasy Harpie Lady Sisters
6ad4b2b948005456a57962da.description:
3 "Harpie Lady" monsters
Must first be Fusion Summoned. This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. Gains 500 ATK for each "Harpie Lady" in your GY, also your opponent cannot target this card with non-WIND monster effects. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.

6ad4b2c60033199169e0e87a.name: Elegant Tri-Mirror
6ad4b2c60033199169e0e87a.description: Add 1 "Harpie" monster from your Deck to your hand, then if only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Harpie Lady", or 1 monster that mentions it, from your hand or GY. You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 EARTH or WIND Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Elegant Tri-Mirror" once per turn.

6ad4b2d38b088ca8667c6118.name: Harpie & Amazoness Rakshasa Formation
6ad4b2d38b088ca8667c6118.description:
Target 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it, then you can apply 1 of these effects based on the number of "Amazoness" monsters and "Harpie Lady" you control.
● 1+: Place 1 "Eyelluring Mirror Wall" from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone.
● 2+: Take control of 1 monster your opponent controls.
● 3+: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
You can only activate 1 "Harpie & Amazoness Rakshasa Formation" per turn.

6ad4b2e090f6465647c936de.name: Amazoness Dramatic Rescue
6ad4b2e090f6465647c936de.description: If you control an "Amazoness" monster or "Harpie Lady", you can activate this card the turn it was Set. Target 1 monster on the field; Special Summon 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster from your hand or Deck, and if you do, return the targeted monster to the hand. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster from your GY or banishment to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Amazoness Dramatic Rescue" once per turn.

6ad4b2fb90f6465647c93767.name: Eyelluring Mirror Wall
6ad4b2fb90f6465647c93767.description:
Gains these effects while you control an "Amazoness" monster or "Harpie Lady".
● Face-up monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position and must attack if able.
● Once per battle, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can halve its ATK.
Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: You can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your GY or banishment that mentions "Harpie Lady", except "Eyelluring Mirror Wall".

6ad4b6372d1e1267fedb01fa.name: Power of the Duelist
6ad4b6372d1e1267fedb01fa.description:
Declare 2, 3, or 4 Attributes; apply this effect based on the number declared, also during the End Phase of this turn, you must send all cards you control to the GY, unless you have activated effects of monsters of all declared Attributes in your field and/or GY this turn.
● 2: Target 1 monster on the field; banish it.
● 3: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
● 4: Negate the effects of 2 face-up cards on the field.
You can only activate 1 "Power of the Duelist" per turn.

6add1c1362bfb3d926685bb6.name: Rampant Wings of Atlantis
6add1c1362bfb3d926685bb6.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Rampant Wings of Atlantis" once per turn. You can send this card from your hand and 1 Spell/Trap or "Umi" from your hand or face-up field to the GY, then target 1 card your opponent controls; send it to the GY. If you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon": You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Sea Serpent monster from your hand or Deck.

6add1c21df7d21a7f875b3e1.name: Amazoness Call
6add1c21df7d21a7f875b3e1.description: Take 1 "Amazoness" card from your Deck, except "Amazoness Call", and either add it to your hand or send it to the GY. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Amazoness" monster you control; this turn, that monster can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each, also other monsters you control cannot attack. You can only activate 1 "Amazoness Call" per turn.

6add1c47336105dd632cf6cc.name: Codaedalus
6add1c47336105dd632cf6cc.description:
2 WATER monsters
You can only Special Summon "Codaedalus(s)" once per turn. This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. If this card is Link Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 card from your GY to your hand that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon", except "Codaedalus". Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; send up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field to the GY.

6add1c575e4cb7a79334f93f.name: Ashtrata Tamayori
6add1c575e4cb7a79334f93f.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Ashtra" non-Tuner from your Deck in Defense Position, then you can change 1 face-up monster you control to face-down Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Summon using a Level 1 Tuner. If an "Ashtra" and/or face-down card(s) you control would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Ashtrata Tamayori" once per turn.

6add1c64e00f31f170b400c2.name: Ashtrama Yoami
6add1c64e00f31f170b400c2.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned, or sent from the field to the GY: You can add to your hand, or Set, 1 "Ashtra" Trap from your Deck. If you have a Trap in your GY: You can return as many face-down cards on the field as possible to the hand, then if you have 5 or more Traps in your GY, you can return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Ashtrama Yoami" once per turn.

6add1c755e4cb7a79334fa11.name: Number 96: Dark Manipulator
6add1c755e4cb7a79334fa11.description:
3 Level 2 DARK monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card; this card gains ATK equal to the total original ATK of all monsters your opponent currently controls. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send this card with material to the GY; Special Summon "Umbral Horror" and/or "Malicevorous" monsters from your GY up to the number of materials this card had. You can only use each effect of "Number 96: Dark Manipulator" once per turn.

6add1ca934376e380dced3ee.name: Chaos Barian's Change
6add1ca934376e380dced3ee.description: Target 1 "Masquerade" Xyz Monster you control; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Number" monster that is 1 Rank higher or 2 Ranks lower than that monster you control, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials). You can banish this card from your GY, then target 3 "Umbral Horror" monsters and/or "Masquerade" Xyz Monsters in your GY; place them on the bottom of the Deck in any order, then draw 1 card. You can only use 1 "Chaos Barian's Change" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

6add1ce43ba740c3aeb7827c.name: Invincible Rocket Warrior
6add1ce43ba740c3aeb7827c.description: Cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Invincible Rocket Warrior" once per turn. You can send 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can make 1 monster your opponent controls lose 1500 ATK, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion Monsters. When this card declares an attack: You can add 1 Level 4 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand.

6add1cf2f3b362353b93a812.name: The Legendary Insect Queen
6add1cf2f3b362353b93a812.description:
2 monsters that mention "Dark Time Wizard", and/or Level 1 EARTH Tokens
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing the above monsters. You can only Special Summon "The Legendary Insect Queen" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add up to 2 cards that mention "Dark Time Wizard" from your GY and/or banishment to your hand. Your opponent cannot target other cards you control that mention "Dark Time Wizard" with card effects.

6add1d02e00f31f170b40560.name: Nightmare Twinkle
6add1d02e00f31f170b40560.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower Illusion monster from your Deck, except "Nightmare Twinkle", but return it to the hand during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Nightmare Twinkle" once per turn. If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. Once per turn, at the end of the Damage Step, if a monster battled: You can change the battle positions of all monsters on the field.
